overview: An aspiring, queer stand-up comedian grapples with her career and the greater duty of caring for her 99-year-old grandmother in her final years.

title: Her Only Way Out
overview: After surviving a terrifying crash and being coerced into silence, a woman realizes the only way to escape is to stage her own death and disappear completely.

title: Wenn das Licht gefriert
overview: Elisabeth has been married to Friedrich for 40 years and they’ve been happy, despite a few setbacks. Not even his Alzheimer’s disease can shake their love. Until one evening, during a TV show about the unsolved murder of their daughter’s best friend—which has remained a mystery for 22 years—Friedrich suddenly mentions details he shouldn’t possibly know.

title: Top
overview: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

title: Youri
overview: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

title: Mastermind
overview: A suspect evaporated strangely in the detention compartment of Dongcheng Police Station. Agent "Mozi" (played by Gu Tianle) worked hard to arrest and search, but there were still no clues and clues. When he was puzzled, Mozi received incredible news that the fugitive was exposed in the archives of the police headquarters in the city. In the anti-locked warehouse, the hidden criminal was shot in the chest and killed on the spot. How on earth did he escape from the East City cell, sneak into the archives of the headquarters, and get from one "secret room" to another "secret room"? Headquarters experts confirmed that 9,999 bullets were killed, originating from Mozi's police gun, so he became the biggest suspect. The cause of death of the lurking criminal is treacherous, and the background is complicated. Mozi was complicated by fate, and it was difficult for me to distinguish between hot and strange cases when facing the enemy.

title: Omega
overview: After surviving a catastrophic tsunami, Raven is exiled to a remote prison island inhabited by colossal creatures known as Omegas. But when a new terror emerges, she must stop history from repeating itself - even if it costs her freedom.

title: Don't Forget the Sunshine
overview: After six years in Germany, Maria gradually loses touch with who she is, trapped between the routine of her work and the intensity of her nights in the techno scene. When her ailing mother and older brother come to visit from Greece for the first time, old wounds reopen and long-suppressed conflicts rise to the surface. Caught between her life in the Ruhr region and her ties to Thessaloniki, Maria is forced to confront her family’s past and search for her own identity.

title: Where No One Can Find Her
overview: When her teen daughter Izzy is kidnapped and buried alive, Jamie and her ex-husband must put aside their differences and work together to raise a massive ransom and save Izzy from a premature grave.

title: Wilder
overview: Focusing on the life and legacy of actor Gene Wilder, told through the lens of Jordan Walker-Pearlman, the late actor’s nephew and a filmmaker in his own right.

title: The Children of Kozara
overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horrors of concentration camp Jasenovac.

title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

title: Blind Game
overview: A Cop, under suspension, is on the trail of Missing Cash.

title: Snowbody Like You
overview: A holiday first date ends in a frosty misunderstanding, leaving Peyton and Ethan to go their separate ways. Years later, a Christmas blizzard brings them back together, giving them one more chance to discover if the magic between them was meant to last.

title: Ekeko: el muñeco de la suerte
overview: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. In her desperation, she decides to invoke a traditional Ekeko doll to heal and change her destiny. However, what initially seems to bring her good fortune soon transforms into her worst nightmare. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

title: Hinter
overview: A Deaf American backpacker finds himself stranded in the depths of the German Black Forest, hunted by something unknown. Stumbling upon a rural farmstead, he finds a guarded German farmer who knows no English. With a language barrier dividing them, the backpacker must discern whether this stranger is a lifeline or the threat.
A bankrupt director in need of money to make a dream movie is trying to find her Alzheimer's mother who has just disappeared after promising to sell a house and divide her assets.

title: Chaser Game W: A Match Made in Heaven
overview: Seven years after the events of “Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens”—Itsuki and Fuyu now live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, who is in middle school. Amid their busy daily lives filled with housework, parenting, and work, the time they spend together has gradually become something they take for granted. Over the course of those seven years, their relationship has shifted from “lovers” to “family,” and subtle emotional distance has begun to emerge between them. Though their hearts are shaken by each other’s casual words and actions, they continue to maintain the appearance of a peaceful household. However, their daughter Tsuki senses the growing unease between her parents. One day, after getting caught up in trouble, Tsuki is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter becomes a turning point, prompting Itsuki and Fuyu to finally confront their true feelings and reexamine the form their love has taken as it drifted apart.

title: Maximini - Zwischen den Tagen
overview: After six years in a youth home, 14-year-old Rudi is about to return to Berlin to live with his mother Ruth. A trial weekend is meant to show whether a fresh start is possible and whether Rudi’s wish for a normal life can finally come true. But as they try to reconnect, both are confronted by the wounds of the past. As mother and son struggle to find their place in each other’s lives again, one question becomes more urgent: Can they make it work?

title: Only Known to Us
overview: Set largely within the confines of a hospital ward, the film follows a crisis involving long-time partners Neil and Bong. When Bong falls severely ill, the situation forces a reunion with his estranged parents, Benjie and Gloria, bringing long-standing family rifts and unspoken truths to the surface.

title: The Magpie
overview: A series of encounters in a run-down holiday park change the way an inquisitive young boy perceives the world.

title: The Form and the Silence
overview: Pushed by the precision of a demanding rehearsal, a young actress navigates the quiet tension between who she is and who she feels she needs to be.

title: Talking About Trees
overview: Filmmakers Ibrahim, Suliman, Eltayeb and Manar, close friends for many years, left their motherland in the sixties and seventies to study film abroad and founded the Sudanese Film Group in 1989. After years of distance and exile, they are reunited, hoping to finally make their old dream come true: to bring back cinema to Sudan by reopening the Halfaia Cinema, a dilapidated theater in Khartoum.

title: American Baby
overview: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.

title: I Will Come
overview: Sixteen-year-old Timofey, who foolishly ended up in a juvenile detention center, escapes during an off-site concert to find his gravely ill grandmother—the only family he has—who hasn't responded to his letters for two months. Following him is an eight-year-old street kid, Malek, who uncontrollably creates only difficulties along the way. The detention center's management conceals the escape and conducts their own pursuit of the runaways. The journey home in search of Timofey’s grandmother turns into a trial for both boys, helping them understand the true meaning of friendship, honesty, and justice.

title: The Mask One: Faceless
overview: A troubled medium joins a crew of ghost-hunting con artists, but when the isolated jungle they investigate begins claiming victims through face-erasing murders, she must reveal her genuine gift or become the ancient entity’s next target.

title: Horse on a Stick
overview: Sarah and her best friend Dilek have a YouTube channel together, but it's no success. Sarah then discovers “hobbyhorsing” for herself, but Dilek doesn't think much of it.

title: Stupid Nature
overview: Maty, a preschooler, would love to start first grade alongside his best friend Šíma. According to his teacher, however, he should stay in preschool for another year because he’s too wild, doesn’t listen to his mom, and has a lisp. Fortunately, his grandfather is a bit of a magical grandpa. He knows a Native American secret that might help his grandson. He takes Maty to his cabin far from civilization and, surrounded by nature awakening in the spring, tries to prepare him for his upcoming enrollment interview. The first moments in the wilderness aren’t easy at all for a city boy, because there’s no PlayStation or TV at the cabin.

title: Splatter
overview: As a violent, supernatural force begins to hollow her out from the inside, a young woman must survive appointments with a gynaecologist who insists her gruesome physical symptoms are just part of being a woman.

title: Daffy Season
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

title: mentor
overview: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.

title: Home
overview: Where does the Ukrainian road home begin and where does it end? The poetic journey follows a Ukrainian actress, Yelyzaveta, who emigrated to Lithuania, traveling back to her homeland country ravaged by war. Will we reach the final destination? How to reach home? Relatives? How to get back to the past which no longer exists? Can we wake up from the dream?

title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
overview: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

title: One Team in Tallinn: 30 Years On
overview: In October 1996, it was full steam ahead for the Tartan Army on the way to the World Cup in France. However, when Scotland lined up to face Estonia in Tallinn, there was just one thing missing - the opposition.

title: Unfading
overview: This visually evocative drama, directed by the legendary Marlen Khutsiev and completed after his death, is inspired by the real-life encounters between Anton Chekhov and Leo Tolstoy. Through a series of intimate conversations, the two literary giants confront the fundamental questions of existence—life, death, faith, and immortality. In doing so, they reveal profoundly different worldviews, yet ones rooted in a shared cultural tradition and bound by mutual respect.  In 2026, the film was finished at the initiative of Marlen Khutsiev’s friends and colleagues.

title: Hot Flash
overview: Geri, a skint Yorkshire mum in peri-menopausal chaos, goes viral after a wine-fuelled rant about her menopause app idea. Betrayed by friends and terrified of public speaking, she must conquer her fears, pitch big, and finally back herself.

title: Noutro tempo
overview: Beto, a retired soccer player, returns to his city to start a routine job. He stays in a family apartment with his niece Elisa, focused on the preparation of some oppositions. Throughout a day, the story follows her wandering through the streets, in contrast to her daily routine. At the end and at the end of the day both share memories and silences.

title: Rightleft
overview: Sofia lives with her grandmother, who has dementia and no longer recognises her. To maintain their closeness, she pretends to be someone different every day. When her neighbour – with whom she has been in a casual romantic relationship – invites her to move with him to Germany, Sofia finds herself facing an almost impossible choice.

title: Pickpockets
overview: The flirty rivalry between a lone-wolf pickpocket and a charismatic rookie escalates into a spiteful turf war. Tempted by the score of a lifetime, the former enemies are forced to partner up. But when feelings get involved, their well-laid plans quickly fall apart.

title: Chiram
overview: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

title: The Absurd Story of Gialappa’s Band
overview: Forty years after their beginnings on the frequencies of Radio Popolare, Gialappa’s Band retraces its professional history in a film directed by Walter Veltroni.With his attentive and original perspective, the director takes us through four decades of comedy, invention, and irony, recounting the journey of Giorgio Gherarducci, Marco Santin, and Carlo Taranto, three leading figures who revolutionized the language of entertainment in Italy. L’assurda storia della Gialappa’s Band explores the creative universe of the legendary trio and the mark left by their unique brand of comedy, capable of transcending generations and becoming an integral part of Italian popular culture.

title: The Wallet
overview: Two Florida gangsters Vinny and Pauly kidnap nerdy tech kid Teddy in search for his crypto Wallet. The Question isn't if he hid it, but where he hid the Wallet.

title: Agia
overview: In the 1990s, Albania's totalitarian regime is coming to an end. Agia, a young woman in a remote village still ruled by rigid codes of honour and silence, is barred from learning her family's craft. In her first act of defiance, she secretly begins mastering the tradition reserved for men. When this plunges her into a wider world, Agia dares to assert not only work and visibility, but also her own desires. Her belated coming of age becomes a quiet rebellion, mirroring that of a nation struggling to redefine itself.

title: Atop Babel's Tower
overview: One night, Pérez, a small insomniac rat, wakes up feeling uncomfortable. To find out what's disturbing his sleep, he must descend a towering mattress tower where his commune is sleeping peacefully, unaware of his nocturnal descent.

title: Romare Bearden: A Life in Collage
overview: An athlete, artist, and activist, Romare Bearden defied boundaries placed on Black men of his generation. He partied with James Baldwin in Paris, composed hit songs, and channeled his memories into powerful collages celebrating Black life that changed contemporary art. He challenged social injustice and broke down barriers in art, culminating in a vibrant artistic legacy that inspires and empowers artists, dancers, and musicians.

title: KILL KILL BANG BANG
overview: A restaurant worker just wants to finish her shift and go home, but the night has other plans for her.

title: Seeni
overview: A young woman and her family find their lives turned upside down when a series of unexpected and mysterious events begin unfolding around them, leading them into a situation far beyond anything they could have imagined.

title: Casualty
overview: At the outset of Operation Desert Storm, a mortally wounded Kurdish surgeon reflects on his history—both personal and political—as he observes the bombing of Baghdad from a well outside the city.

title: Devil's Disciple: The Night Stalker
overview: A relentless, killer-POV descent into the mind of Richard Ramirez as he stalks 1980s Los Angeles, leaving terror, bloodshed, and belief-driven brutality in his wake.

title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
overview: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

title: Papaya
overview: Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

title: Fernanda
overview: A portrait of one of Brazil’s greatest actresses, centered on the one thing inseparable from her identity: her craft. The documentary follows Fernanda Montenegro through her most recent work while looking back at the past to trace the making of a great actress over the course of her career. Directed by Pedro Waddington, son of filmmaker Andrucha Waddington—Fernanda’s son-in-law—the film embraces their family relationship as part of its narrative, capturing intimate moments with the actress backstage and unveiling previously unseen footage of projects made together as a family.

title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
overview: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

title: Pina
overview: Pina is a feature-length dance film in 3D with the ensemble of the Tanztheater Wuppertal Pina Bausch, featuring the unique and inspiring art of the great German choreographer, who died in the summer of 2009.

title: Claddagh
overview: Two sisters struggle to decide whether their deceased mother would like to be buried with her favorite Claddagh necklace, or leave it with them as an heirloom. The wrong decision could prove more devastating than either imagined.

title: It's How It Ends
overview: After being expelled from college, Owen returns home to disappointed parents and leaves in the middle of the night with his younger sister Mara, wandering the city and stumbling into unexpected encounters.

title: Hurricane
overview: Manuel, a young filmmaker, seeks help from his friend Facundo to develop his script. Together they make the story come to life and the characters become independent. However, at the end, different possible paths arise that strain their relationship.

title: Scorcher
overview: Elaine, a young crowd canvasser, struggles to raise money for women’s reproductive healthcare on the hottest day of the summer. She’s on the brink of being fired and showing signs of heat exhaustion when a coworker approaches her about starting a canvassing union.

title: When Things Move
overview: During moving day, Joaquina and her cousin Leonor turn the chaos of boxes into an adventure. Between games, jealousy, and discoveries, the girls explore the corners of a house that seems to hold a secret of its own.

title: Accursed
overview: When a nun’s cursed secret resurfaces on Emma’s 21st birthday, a lake-house reunion turns deadly. A masked cult and dark prophecy force Emma and her friends to face possession, betrayal, and a midnight ritual that could raise ancient evil.

title: Pace
overview: After serving a prison sentence, 40-year old Malcolm is intent on rebuilding his life. He looks for purpose in his late brother’s passion for running and trains to run a full marathon. Confronted with unresolved family expectations, a judgemental society and destructive self-loathing, can Malcolm keep pace, or will he succumb to the unrelenting tempo of society?

title: B.A.E. - Before Anything Else
overview: On the threshold of adulthood, Romeo spends a final summer in Tropea with his friends, where he meets Giulia, a local theater enthusiast. As their romance blossoms, the two end up starring in a local production of Romeo and Juliet, and their real lives begin to painfully parallel the classic play. Facing opposition from Giulia’s overprotective brother and the pressure of an uncertain future, their bond deepens until a tragic confrontation alters their lives forever. B.A.E. - Before Anything Else is a poignant exploration of first love, passion, and devastating sacrifice.

title: Another League
overview: Spain, the 1970s. Although Francoist ideology remains deeply entrenched in society, a group of young trailblazers and an ambitious promoter are about to change the history of women’s football.

title: City of Fathers
overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

title: Lizzie Borden: The Hatchet House
overview: Troubled gothic teenager Ellie feels isolated, angry, and betrayed by her fractured family. Seeking connection and understanding, she turns to the legend of Lizzie Borden, the infamous axe murderer of Fall River.

title: Bread of Happiness
overview: A couple decide to relocate from Tokyo to the northern island of Hokkaido where they settle and establish a bakery and café called Mani. One cooks. The other bakes. Everyone walks out happy.

title: Somethin' Stupid
overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

title: Pray for Us
overview: In the mid-to-late 1970s, two young women from different social backgrounds meet inside the Patronato de Protección a la Mujer (Women’s Protection Board), a state-backed institution that confined thousands of women, many single mothers, in convents and boarding schools under the guise of moral 'reform'. Ana, a rebellious 19-year-old from Barcelona, is sent by her wealthy father to a Patronato facility overseen by the merciless Sister Socorro. Amid the harsh conditions, Ana forms a deep bond with Sole, a friendship tested by escape attempts, reprisals, and an ultimate sacrifice.

title: Perder el Piso
overview: Gabriela experiences an event where life pushes her to reconcile with her reality and give new meaning to her present. Through slacklining, she discovers a new way to support herself and regain her balance.

title: Marileidy
overview: The life and career of Dominican athlete Marileidy Paulino.

title: Stalling
overview: Minutes before a job interview, a man with a stubborn case of shy bladder becomes the center of an increasingly surreal restroom spectacle as every well-intention attempt to help only makes things worse.

title: Spring in Imroz
overview: The narrative follows the emotional journey of two distinct individuals whose paths unexpectedly cross on the island, forcing them to confront the heavy shadows of their pasts while discovering the profound possibility of a "second spring" or love being reborn.

title: Miss Holloween
overview: Halloween has come to Hatchetfield, and with it an army of demonic monster-masks who set out to terrorize the tiny town. The only one standing in their way is Hatchetfield's mysterious, witchy guardian, Miss Holloway. But when she makes a deadly deal with the Lords In Black, Miss Holloway is in for more tricks than treats.

title: A Possession in Lincoln County
overview: A man documents his wife's cancer-until a terminal diagnosis leads him to an ancient ritual to summon the Devil and make a deal. His footage spirals into a chilling record of kidnapping, demonic rituals, and the price of desperation.

title: Unauthorised Absence
overview: A single mother fighting for support for her autistic daughter is fined, threatened and pushed to breaking point by an education system that wasn’t built for them.

title: Four Corners
overview: Alba, aged 14, is entering her early teenage years. Through her interactions with several of her classmates, she will begin to understand and see the world in a different light.

title: Schon immer
overview: Manuel and Adrian have known each other forever. But recently, Adrian has made some cool new friends. When Manuel tries to join the group during school break, they are watching a couple of girls dancing to Adrian and Manuel’s favorite song. Manuel makes no secret of the fact that he likes the song, but Adrian suddenly backs out in front of his new friends and humiliates Manuel. When Manuel confronts Adrian the next day, the latter continues to dodge the issue – and Manuel has to ask himself seriously whether he wants to hold on to the friendship any longer.

title: Chimney Town: Frozen in Time
overview: After losing his friend Poupelle, young Lubicchi wanders into a mysterious realm where a clock in a tower is frozen at 11:59. To return home, he must restart it – and find the courage to believe again.

title: Two Seasons, Two Strangers
overview: In summer, Nagisa and Natsuo meet by the sea. Their vacant gazes reflect each other as they exchange awkward words and wade into the rain-drenched ocean. In winter, Li, a screenwriter, travels to a snow-covered village. There, she finds a guesthouse run by Benzo.

title: 77 Hours
overview: 77 Hours is a psychological thriller and political drama set across the nights of January 8 and 9, when Iran's streets become the scene of one of the darkest and bloodiest crackdowns in recent memory.  Unarmed and unprepared, ordinary people are trapped in chaos, gunfire, fear, and death. At the center is a man who is not a hero prepared for battle, but an ordinary person forced to survive in an inhuman catastrophe — surrounded by wounded civilians, security forces, and collapsing memories.  Through a tense, intimate narrative moving between streets, hospital corridors, hidden spaces, and broken recollections, the film explores survival, sacrifice, guilt, silence, and the fragile line between truth and fear.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: The Seventh Day
overview: A group of travel journalist visit the quiet town of Willow Ridge to write a story about the Delaney family, known for their famous blueberry pies. But what they discovers during their stay will change everything.

title: Musical Hetalia ~World⭐︎Starts~
overview: Tenth musical adaptation for Hetalia

title: Raw Meat
overview: A dramatic story featuring Kevin (the hot blooded cooking teacher), Stacy (the kind librarian), Jane (the foreign exchange student), and Ozwald (a student who has fallen in love with Jane). For the next 2 minutes and 55 seconds, you will be transported into their world and experience the DRAMA and SUSPENSE that only an indie film of this caliber could provide.

title: Frangines
overview: Frangines tells the story of Alice's reclusive life in an apartment perpetually shrouded in darkness. A disturbing presence, which she calls "The Dark Thoughts", is preventing her from leaving her mental prison and escaping. But just outside, her sister urges her to return to the light, and thus, to freedom.

title: Robyn – From Child Star to Global Star
overview: She made her breakthrough as a teenager and quickly became one of Sweden’s biggest pop stars. Since then, Robyn has followed her own path, building an international career on her own terms. Yet, behind the success lies a story of pressure, self-doubt, and the quest for self-discovery. This is the story of Robyn—from teenage idol to pop icon.

title: Nhà Ma Xó
overview: The Haunted House revolves around Mrs. Hiền, a woman who single-handedly raises her three children after her husband’s death in an accident. Everything begins when her middle son, while casting his fishing net, pulls up a tightly sealed earthen jar from the water. From that moment on, a series of strange and terrifying events start haunting the family.

title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
overview: On England’s North East coast, where rivers, heavy industry and the sea have shaped lives for generations, fisherman Stan Rennie is watching the world he knows disappear. His family have worked these waters for generations. Then, almost overnight, thousands of dead crabs and lobsters wash ashore, and a community already living with uncertainty is pushed into crisis. Teesside filmmaker Jeanie Finlay brings warmth, wit and deep local feeling to this David-and-Goliath story of environmental damage, official evasions and working-class resilience. At its centre is Stan: funny, stubborn, vulnerable and increasingly determined to be heard.

title: Worthy
overview: The discovery of an icon, which Ilias believes to be crying, sets him on his journey from cemetery caretaker to the chosen one. While he is on his quest to bring the icon to the people of the small town, we also follow three other stories of people who could do with a little help from a miraculous icon.

title: Satu Bungkus
overview: Having just recently transferred to a public school from a private one, Bella is still trying to blend in with her high school peers. After Bella's phone gets stolen, the four of them scours Glodok to hopefully find her phone back.

title: Medley
overview: Lola (16) is a lonely girl marked by a trauma that has followed her since childhood: the mysterious absence of her father. A talented swimmer with a vast collection of medals, Lola keeps a curious secret, she cannot swim the butterfly stroke. She has a strained relationship with her mother, and after one of their arguments she decides to spend her vacation alone in her uncle's town. There, the teenager's life changes radically she falls in love with Gabriel, makes new friends, and joins the town's struggling swim team. Now, every time Lola is in the water, these new emotions stir memories from her past. On the eve of an important championship, Lola finds herself facing fears and traumas she never expected, including the truth about her father's death.

title: Cement
overview: A nightclub owner struggles to balance her work life with her romantic life over the course of one chaotic evening, and is ultimately forced to choose between past and present love.

title: Solo Noi. Una stagione da Double
Gondhal
overview: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

title: A Russian Winter
overview: After the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many people in Russia faced a brutal choice: prison, the army – or exile. Margarita, Yuri and their friends are caught in the crosscurrents of history, with no way to return home, but also no place where they feel truly welcome.

title: Nous l'orchestre de Paris
overview: How can people play together as one? How can one contribute to something greater than oneself? How can a group cohabitate for decades without falling apart? And what role does the conductor really play? For the first time, cameras and microphones slip among the 80 musicians of the Orchestre de Paris, under the baton of their young prodigy conductor, Klaus Mäkelä. A total immersion to share their experiences, emotion and beauty, at the heart of music in the making.

title: Going for Two
overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

title: Blood Border: Cambodia's Second Killing Field
overview: During the war between the Khmer Rouge forces and the Kampuchean United Front for National Salvation in 1979, Channdy and his family flee Cambodia along with another thousands of Cambodian people, hoping to find safety in a third country. After seeking refuge in Thailand, they are promised a new journey to freedom but instead, they are taken to the remote Dangrek Mountains, where a terrifying ordeal begins.

title: Without Blood
overview: Nina, driven by revenge after losing her family during a devastating war, tracks down the man she believes holds the answers to their deaths.

title: A Lonely Night
overview: Samantha’s neighbor confesses that he spies on her at night. Disturbed and seized by a strange feeling, the 38 years old chemistry teacher finds herself caught between fear and curiosity.

title: Call of the She-Demon: Modest Male Exposure 3
overview: Sam is managing an Adult Erotic Club while the owner Mistress Windy  is on an extended vacation. But he is failing to get women to attend the club and male customers are complaining. Sam's friend Goldie finds a tucked-away spell-book and discovers that Windy would practice Witchcraft. In a desperate attempt to balance the male-female attendance ratio, they perform a demon-invoking ritual. But things spiral out of control as unexpected lust and chaos are summoned into the space.

title: Goodbye Postman
overview: Stefan, Markus, and Dieter are among the last postmen of their kind – some have been doing the job for nearly half a century. At Kronberg’s delivery hub, they see how letters are getting smaller, parcels are getting bigger, and their familiar working world is gradually disappearing. Although scanners and efficiency targets now set the pace, they hold fast to their professional ethos: the route doesn’t end until the deliveries are all made. Because there are familiar faces at every drop-off point.

title: Yankıların İzinde
overview: Nevzat, the youngest son of a farming family, relapses into gambling one summer day while tending to the garden. His losses and debts grow, weakening his relationships with those around him. His mental breakdown also damages his family relationships. Hiding his situation, Nevzat becomes increasingly isolated and is forced to confront his addiction within his own inner world.

title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
overview: It’s Halloween, and Ducobu is back for an adventure filled with laughter and mystery! Professor Latouche and Miss Rateau move into a house haunted by the ghost of Anatole, the biggest dunce in the history of Saint-Potache School. This mischievous ghost will drag Ducobu, Léonie, their parents, and Kitrish into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures. But beware: on Halloween, anything can happen!

title: >1,5°C Pyropolitics and the New World
overview: The devastating forest fires in Los Angeles are described in three acts.

title: Back Scratch
overview: Two friends explore old and new intimacy over a New Mexico Christmas weekend.

title: Doïna
overview: Andrei is a Romanian expatriate living in France. One day, his mother Doïna visits him to confirm a gynecological diagnosis made in Romania. Forced to translate the conversation between her and the doctor during the examination, Andrei becomes the unwilling witness to his mother’s intimate history.

title: The Longest Wait
overview: The first feature-length documentary on the journey of the Indonesian National Team. From the struggles on the pitch to capturing moments in the Indonesian national team's dressing room to qualify FIFA World Cup 2026

title: I'm not crazy. Maybe a little...
overview: A desperate middle-aged alcoholic and a heartbroken young woman escape from a psychiatric hospital and embark on an absurd journey through the nighttime streets of Riga to save a cat and, perhaps, themselves as well.

title: He’s Dating a Boldstar
overview: Jeboy, a mild-mannered hotel employee, falls for a woman he believes is an ordinary guest—until he discovers she is a “bold star,” a Filipino term for an adult entertainer.

title: Closing Time
overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

title: Wrapped in Christmas Memories
overview: Seeking a buyer for her family’s antique store this Christmas, tech guru Delphia butts heads with history buff Keenan, who wants to buy it. But when she discovers a mystery in the store’s famous Christmas Dollhouse, he’s the only one who can help her solve it.

title: Birds in the Dark
overview: A police informant Jagtar takes Amir, a Muslim man from Kashmir, into custody. As they travel through the jungle and the mountains towards the bustling city, Jagtar eventually sets Amir free and returns to the hometown he once fled. There, as agricultural workers begin to organize a struggle, Jagtar reunites with Raman, a landowner and his former lover. Meanwhile, Amir comes to the town looking for Jagtar and meets Dilraj, the leader of the workers' organization, and begins to feel a sense of solidarity.

title: Home
overview: In "Home", a contained, experimental short film, a lonely and paranoid Indonesian expat is forced to look inward while rehearsing an acting monologue that is too close to home - or lack thereof.

title: Krew
overview: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

title: Our Revolution
overview: He is exuberant, loud, and charismatic. She is courageous, delicate, and warm. Jacek and Grażyna Kuroń are utterly in love and convinced that together they can change the world. They give up their privacy to dedicate their lives to the fight for freedom. Their apartment becomes the "headquarters" of the opposition; a meeting place for people willing to risk everything in the name of a better tomorrow.

title: Bail
overview: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

title: Nino
overview: Nino is a young man on a journey to reconnect with the world and himself in the streets of Paris, following the suggestion of his doctors. In three days, he will face a major challenge.

title: Trigger
overview: Thailand, 2030 — In an era where the government has legalized euthanasia through the organization ITB (In The Blink), Doc, a middle-aged “Negotiator,” is tasked with screening and evaluating those who request to end their lives for valid and justified reasons. But when a radical youth movement demands the legal age for euthanasia to be lowered — sparking debates over whether life’s achievements should come early, or even matter at all — tensions erupt and spiral into a crisis Doc and the organization could never have foreseen.

title: Wanted Santa
overview: Zoé, an 8-year-old girl, wants to get a BB gun from Santa Claus to get revenge on Timothée, a classmate who annoys her by playing with his Lego robot. Her mother, Nadia, works for Timothée's parents, which complicates her quest for revenge. When she discovers that her Christmas wish hasn't been granted, Zoé is determined to find Santa and force him to grant her wish. And her luck changes when she hears an advertisement revealing that Santa Claus, in person, is on parade every day at Parc Enchanté, the famous amusement park...

title: Killing Time
overview: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

title: Fuxi: Four Tales of Feasting
overview: On a seesaw, Sun and Moon rise and fall, witnessing four feasts and festivities spanning four millennia, where the living and the dead, gods and ghosts unite in a simple, shared joy.

title: Rider
overview: Saluele, known as Sami, is a young fiid delivery rider who spends his days cycling across Milan travelling from one end of the city to the other. On New Year's Eve, while the city bursts into celebration, beneath dazzling lights, he delivers a huge sushi order to a luxorious villa on the city's northern outskirts. Invited to stay for the evening, Sami meets Nia, and the two instantly form a powerful connection. But as a new romance begins to blossom, an impulsive decision will have fatal consequences, forcing Sami to decide whether to face the consequences of his actions.

title: Föa - Once Upon A Future
overview: Nicole, alone at home while pregnant during the G8 demonstrations in Genoa, unwisely opens the door to a group of protesters. During the forced cohabitation, the private world of the woman and the public world of the boys collide and end up changing each other.

title: A Tale of Lost Times
overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

title: Get Comfy
overview: When a newly practicing therapist's office chair falls apart mid session, he must quickly find a solution to his discomfort in order to focus on his patients and get comfy.

title: Mis Tres Animales
overview: Following the disappearance of a group of Catholic missionaries, Commander Julián Montalvo takes on the case, promising to solve it within three days. The investigation soon points toward a dangerous drug cartel. But when the group decides to respond to Montalvo’s threat, it becomes clear that something far darker lies behind them—a history buried for years that is now on the verge of repeating itself. Montalvo has three days to uncover the truth. But by the third day, someone will have to be handed over.

title: Tame
overview: In a remote village where bulls are trained through fear and tradition, a young girl held captive by her family seeks the power of an ancient spirit for liberation, employing the same cruel techniques used to control her.

title: The Two Hornets
overview: Samo, a gay man facing an unplanned pregnancy with a woman overseas, reunites with his narcissistic mother at a remote forest cabin to confront their toxic past. Amidst a drug-fueled sexual affair with his former childhood bully, he struggles to decide if he should embrace fatherhood or break the cycle of inherited family sin. In Samo's warped reality, omnipresent hornets gain an evil power, forcing him to confront his mother with fire and an axe to extract the brutal truth of their relationship.

title: Problem at the Address
overview: Sabri (72) dreams of taking a photo with a politician. With his nephew Ahmet’s (38) help, it happens but the photo never arrives. When the meeting video goes viral, Ahmet’s quiet life unravels under political rumors.

title: Hostile Architecture
overview: Without a place of their own, trans lovers Grace and Billy find intimacy in an extra-dimensional room; but just like the city outside, the room itself threatens to swallow them whole.

title: A Light That Never Goes Out
overview: Successful classical flutist Pauli returns to his small hometown after a breakdown. Reconnecting with old schoolmate Iiris, he is drawn into experimental music. Pauli, who has always sought perfection, is drawn to her chaotic energy, and finds comfort in their sonic experiments.

title: Babystar
overview: Luca is an influencer. For as long as she can remember, she has been the star of her parents' family social media business and their only pride and joy. When her parents decide to have another child, things change. Luca feels betrayed and is afraid of no longer being needed by her parents, whose attention remains tied to her performance for the family account.

title: Matched: True Love
overview: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.

title: El Camino
overview: Young people living in different eras have to overcome obstacles, transform themselves and grow. They demonstrate their resilience, courage and sacrifice. A manifesto about youth and their ability to play a leading role throughout history.

title: A Christmas Ornament to Remember
overview: A big city veterinarian rushes home to help her family recover from a devastating storm and save the tree lighting, but finds her mission complicated when a mysterious Christmas ornament arrives and sets her back on a path back to love.

title: The Late Mathias Pascal
overview: Mathias Pascal, only son of a once-rich family, marries beautiful Romalinda, who has a terrible mother-in-law. She controls her daughter, and soon his home life becomes a nightmare. His only moments of lights are his mother and baby, but both die on the same day. Shocked, he leaves his hometown and goes to Monte Carlo, where he wins a fortune at the casino. Returning home, he reads his own obituary in a paper. They have found a corpse in a creek and connected it with his disappearance. Mathias, noticing that he is now free from all ties to his old life, decides to start a new one.

title: The Shrew of Destiny
overview: Shrews are small, lovely and always hungry mammals… which Happen to have some epic adventures! When dark shadow is cast upon the Valley of Shrews an old prophecy is remembered: the Great Enemy, destroyer of all life in the forest will bring doom to all shrews. But there is also an optimistic part of the legend – the shrew of destiny will come to aid its tribe in the darkest hour. But what if the chosen one turns out to be the smallest, weakest and honestly not-so-bright shrew?

title: Shine!
overview: Davide has a dream: to become a professional wrestler. For him, it’s a full-blown obsession - nothing can stop him. Except for a few details: he doesn’t have Hulk Hogan’s muscles, he’s still in high school, and most of all... he’s terrified of jumping out of the ring.

title: Oh Season
overview: Felix McCoy is a young boy grappling with the loss of his mother, the beloved creator of the town’s annual holiday pageant. When the production is hijacked and rebranded into a shallow spectacle by cocksure director Hamilton Lydell, Felix secretly sabotages the event, only to realize that saving the show might be the only way to keep his late mother’s spirit alive.

title: Wind Up: The Movie
overview: A pitcher who can't throw strikes and his unlikely manager form a heartfelt bond.

title: Anumägi
overview: A young peasant girl in old Estonia is torn between religion and ancient custom in the aftermath of a traumatic event.

title: Appofeniacs
overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

title: Special Unit - The First Murder
overview: Denmark in 1927. The ambitious police officer Otto Himmelstrup leads the newly formed Special Unit, which is tasked with assisting local police in solving particularly difficult crimes. When a body is found in a burnt-out summer house in Esbjerg, Otto and his team begin to unravel an unusual murder mystery, revealing power struggles and corruption among the city’s elite. The closer the unit gets to the  truth, the more dangerous it becomes. Soon, Otto finds himself not only battling powerful enemies but also confronting his own dark side in his quest to solve the case.

title: Paradise Lost
overview: Two sex workers team up to scam and rob their clients across the nightlife district. Their relationship begins to unravel when one dreams of saving enough to build a family together, while the other already has one of her own.

title: A Girl’s Story
overview: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

title: TS-CAM
overview: The commission of a triptych sends a guilty painter into a downward spiral.

title: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
overview: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

title: Las Hijas
overview: A twenty-year-old girl wakes up in a house in the woods after a night of partying. Three young women greet her as the daughters of her kidnapper. They too were kidnapped, and their isolation led them to embrace this community as idyllic.

title: Age Perfect
overview: A video essay that playfully uses performance-based methods of re-enactment to attempt to enter the frame and material conditions of anti-aging cream commercials and other beauty ads to critique their construction while showcasing their artifice.

title: Mustang
overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

title: Drinking and Driving
overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

title: Under the Flags, the Sun
overview: This fully archival journey through the 35 years of Alfredo Stroessner’s regime in Paraguay reveals unseen footage and explores one of the longest-running dictatorships in history, whose effects still resonate today.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: Garv
overview: Garv's only trying to get ahead. Fresh into a new life in Melbourne, he's landed a decent job, a shot at succes, and a workplace that's anything but welcoming. As the cracks begin to show, a few harmless jokes turn into something harder to ignore. But when speaking up makes him the problem, Garv's forced to confront an uncomfortable truth; sometimes, fitting in comes at a cost.

title: Carne
overview: Sewn together in flesh and locked away from the world, Alba and Rubra live under the suffocating grip of a castrating mother. While Rubra accepts their fate in silence, Alba is driven by a visceral need to escape — though the freedom she imagines may not be what she truly desires.

title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

title: The Disenchantment
overview: In a remote village in the Pyrenees, Inés discovers that the relocation of an ancient church is only the beginning of an immersion into a magical and ancestral world that will change her perception of life and death.

title: The Last Act: Ediz Hun
overview: A biographical documentary that chronicles Ediz Hun’s 83-year journey—spanning cinema, academia, and theater—through his roles as an actor, ecologist, and collector, as well as his insatiable curiosity.

title: Eclipse
overview: In a near future, humanity has blotted out the sun with an artificial cloud in an attempt to stop climate collapse, and the world has lost its color. A photographer wanders this gray, lifeless landscape, obsessively searching for one last sign of life. When he meets a mysterious girl, he may finally have the chance to take the photograph he has been chasing all his life.

title: LARA - The Man Who Took on Escobar
BIGFOOT
overview: The film follows Rémi, a man in his fifties who raises bison in the Laurentides region. One morning, while working, he comes across a six-year-old boy in pajamas, Hugo, on his land, who claims to be looking for his father among the bison.

title: De Tatta's: Daan
overview: Daan wants to impress his crush, Layla. He promises to come up with the most epic gift ever for her birthday party. What seems simple turns into a chaotic quest, filled with bizarre situations and unexpected encounters.

title: Red Ink
overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

title: The Metropolitan Opera: Così fan tutte
This Is How the World Ends
overview: When a war breaks out between humanity and the AI Machine States, the world is thrown into a state of confusion.

title: The Trumpeter and the Ghost
overview: A frustrated jazz trumpeter rehearsing for an audition accidentally awakens an invisible ghost with the power to manipulate sound. The ghost promises to turn him into a virtuoso in exchange for his help unearthing an ancient treasure buried deep in the mountains. But what begins as a great deal soon becomes a dangerous adventure leading toward a dark secret.

title: What Lives in Room 214?
overview: "What Lives in Room 214?" is a psychological horror featurette that follows actor Cory King who moves into a hotel for semi-successful actors, producers, and directors. The longer he stays, the more he notices things around him have never been what they seemed. "What Lives in Room 214?" tells a cautionary tale about the cost of fame.

title: Sextape
overview: A young woman is recording her couple.

title: Switches
overview: Jake and Dawn, a married couple sliding towards divorce. Two people who once had it all--the career momentum, the chemistry, the “it couple” energy-- are now buried under bills, resentment, and distance. Enter Switch, the trial drug from a hush-hush pharmaceutical company promising an “empathy revolution” by letting couples swap consciousness for 24 hours.

title: Toutes Directions
overview: When a 71-year-old regional taxi driver hears that he is losing his beloved job, he decides to take a different turn with his worn-out van full of regular passengers. The journey that follows, in which no passenger is left untouched, turns out to be exactly what he needs to start the rest of his life.

title: Last Light
overview: a supernatural horror short film

title: Three Kingdoms: The Beginning
overview: Toward the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, amid nationwide unrest, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao sought to enlist General-in-Chief He Jin’s support to check the power of the eunuchs and restore the Han Dynasty to its rightful order. Unexpectedly, Dong Zhuo seized the chaos to march his troops into the capital, plotting to dethrone the reigning emperor and install a new one.Swept up in the torrential tide of troubled times, a host of warlords emerged one after another: Yuan Shu, Lü Bu, Sun Jian, as well as Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. Turmoil engulfed Luoyang, and the fate of the great Han Empire stood at a crossroads…

title: Making Marie Antoinette
overview: Eleanor Coppola turns her camera on her daughter, Sofia, as she shoots Marie Antoinette. Catching every detail of the behind-the-scenes and on-set action, Eleanor captures the feat of Sofia’s directing a landmark film aged 34, and muses on what it means for a mother to watch her daughter at work.

title: Red Beast
overview: Eetu Salin, a fiery working-class agitator and one of the founders of the Finnish Social Democratic Party, struggles not only with his childhood traumas and alcoholism but also against young radical socialists within the party who are vying for power. Eetu, who advocates for class struggle through peaceful means, joins forces with his friends Väinö Tanner and Yrjö Mäkelin to try to prevent the Finnish working class from being drawn into a violent revolution.

title: Mi casa no es tu casa
BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
overview: This cinema presentation brings BTS’s Buenos Aires concert to the big screen, marking the group’s first performance in Argentina and its first live viewing broadcast from South America. Audiences can experience the explosive atmosphere of a packed stadium in a 195-minute event, with some territories receiving a time-shifted screening.

title: Sleep Sweet
overview: After a date, Lily returns home and settles into her nightly routine while texting her boyfriend. But as an ordinary evening winds down, one unexpected message transforms a familiar space  into a waking nightmare.

title: Ultimatum
overview: Juni realizes that Martin can no longer stand her. He wants her to undergo an assessment, while she feels that he is putting her in an impossible situation.

title: Nagi Notes
overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

title: Learners
overview: When a cantankerous widower reluctantly agrees to teach his son's unemployed girlfriend to drive, an unlikely friendship is sparked.

title: All Yours
overview: After discovering her skin is peeling off, a bored mother is compelled to bake it into little pastries.

title: Pegasus
overview: A DJ drifts through the spectacle of Miami nightlife, torn between the urge to create and the desire to be seen.

title: Lügen über meine Mutter
overview: In the 1980s, the life of a family in a small village is determined by just one issue: the mother's body weight. Her husband Werner decides that she needs to lose weight, Cornelia suffers as a result and their daughter Ela is caught in the middle.

title: The Frontier Under The Blood Moon
overview: The werewolf shaman from Sumo Mohe tribe ambushes the Buddhist maiden presented by Silla to the Tang Dynasty, attempting to sabotage their efforts to build friendly relations, only to run into the detective Di Renjie, who is handling a case at the border. Di joins forces with Sima Xiaodao and Doctor Duan to unravel the tribe's conspiracy, saving the nation from danger once again.

title: Chimera
overview: A shocking revelation forces a widow to wrestle with her conscience over whether to release her late husband’s final novel.

title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
overview: Watch the conclusion of Jet Lag: The Game's biggest season ever with this screening of the final two, action-packed episodes as Tom & Adam race Sam & Ben to the top of Hokkaido.

title: In Spite of Ourselves
overview: Hannah is a determined Portland baker, and Archie, an up-and-coming Los Angeles comedian with a tendency to dodge commitment. What begins as immediate, undeniable chemistry turns into two blissful weeks together—until real life intervenes. Pulled back into their separate worlds, the pair must navigate distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities to determine whether love can truly go the distance.

title: PSYCHO
overview: When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes. Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

title: IceGuys: The Movie
overview: When Iceland's hottest boyband ICEGUYS accidentally enters an international reality show competition, they must out-sing, out-dance and out-last other rival boy bands to win a coveted opening slot on an upcoming world tour.

title: Mothballs
overview: Something is bugging Brian Berger, and all of his work obligations certainly aren’t helping.

title: Celeste & the Cyan Sun
overview: On her last day in Italy, a young woman finds herself swept away by a new intimate friendship towards reckless abandon and tragic circumstances.

title: God's Future Soldiers
overview: At God’s Future Soldiers, an intensive evangelical summer camp, a teen girl’s faith is tested when God comes to her in a dream and demands she harvest souls for the coming end times.

title: The Virgin of the Quarry Lake
overview: On the eve of the 2001 outbreak, a young woman falls for her lifelong friend but turns to incantations and curses with her grandmother's help when a more experienced rival threatens their romance.

title: Amazon Bullseye
overview: Once an Olympic medalist in archery but now the top target for restructuring, Jin-bong heads to the Amazon to seize one last chance offered by his company. After barely surviving a life-threatening ordeal, Jin-bong arrives in the Amazon, where he meets three warriors with god-given archery skills: Sika, Eba, and Walbu! Believing he has found a way to save himself, Jin-bong teams up with Bbang-sik, a Korean-Bolédorian interpreter, and brings the three archery masters to Korea… Now, Jin-bong’s comeback depends entirely on the Amazon trio!

title: See Me
overview: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

title: Skeleton Man
overview: Skater boys are terrorized by a delirious skeleton man at a strip mall pizzeria.

title: Friday the 69th
overview: Porn filmmakers in 1981 seek to cash in on the slasher craze by making their own independent ripoff that follows a group of spring breaking college coeds as they are stalked by a mysterious killer beekeeper at a camp with a tragic past.

title: The Beachnickers 3
overview: Rocha decides to foot the bill for his daughter's wedding in an island and invites his loyal colleagues, Alexandre, Lima, and Diguinho, along with their families, to the all-expenses-paid celebration. The setting seemed perfect for an unforgettable trip, but the peace is short-lived, soon giving way to a series of surprises and mishaps.

title: Westernmost
overview: Two estranged childhood friends reunite to dig up a twenty year old time capsule buried in their youth.

title: A Shonda
overview: “A Shonda” is a short ritual art film filmed in the holy days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. Two transsexual Jews commune with the dead, reimagine gendered cultural practices, and attempt to atone for the sins committed in their name.

title: In This Room
overview: In a world that seems to be falling apart, poetry, empathy, and music remind us of the urgent need to understand one another. Through fado and the distinctive voice of its most famous singer, Carminho, a glimmer of hope emerges across the landscapes of a Japan once devastated by bombings. The film follows the Portuguese artist on tour across the country. Through concerts, backstage moments, hotel rooms, taxis, silences, and whispers, the film weaves together the world of fado and Japan’s cultural landscape.

title: Atonement
overview: In the early days of the Iraq War, a split-second decision made by a U.S. Marine during a tense standoff devastates an Iraqi family. Years later, aided by a New Yorker journalist, he seeks to reconcile with the family he destroyed.

title: Gran Blanco
overview: A portrait of an American tourist in Mexico.

title: De Grote Sinterklaasfilm en de Vliegende Pieten
Sending Spree
overview: Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, becoming the first woman ever to climb both V15 boulders and 5.15 routes.

title: Aitmatov
overview: An upcoming biopic on world-renowned Kyrgyz author Chingiz Aitmatov. The film traces his childhood, losing his father, and the personal struggle that shaped his literary voice—from humble beginnings to becoming the voice of his nation.

title: TrueLink
overview: Reconnect. Remember. Release.

title: Like Lightning
overview: An erotic sense-memory, archival intimacy.

title: Psycho Side Chick
overview: After being dumped by her married lover, a crazed woman fights to win him back and will get rid of anyone who stands in her way.

title: Grace's Theory
overview: Grace, forty, is a scientist at the Exousia Foundation. When her boss Giovanni informs her of the death of her colleague Xiu Chen — his camp ransacked and burned, his computer missing — Grace travels to Costa Rica to recover the documents from his research into plants capable of tolerating high levels of CO₂.  On the island where Xiu conducted secret experiments, guided by his young assistant Santiago, Grace discovers a plant with extraordinarily long leaves, which had already appeared in her daughter’s dreams. After they are followed by a car, Grace flees to Italy with several specimens.  Back home, Xiu’s research attracts powerful interests. Between an old Biology professor, a multinational executive demanding the results, and an IT engineer hiding the data in a secure cloud, Grace discovers the true purpose of Xiu’s work: communicating with certain plant species and understanding their language. She decides to protect the research so it can remain a shared heritage of humanity.

title: The 4 Lives of Pyotr Mamonov
overview: How did four contradictory personas coexist within a single individual—rowdy drifter, rock star, great actor, and Orthodox hermit? Pavel Lungin’s new film chronicles the life journey of Pyotr Mamonov, exploring his search for meaning and the spiritual transformation of this cult musician and actor. The film weaves together unique archival footage, interviews spanning years, previously unseen home videos, and recollections from those close to him—including Sergey Shnurov, Evgeny Margulis, Viktor Sukhorukov, his wife Olga Mamonova, Viktoriya Isakova, Sergey Loban, and many others.
An old man, fated to collect souls for eternity, seeks atonement after trading his daughter's soul.

title: Home
overview: The film is set in a self-storage facility: an anonymous, sterile place made up of countless storage units. For the film’s characters, however, these spaces become places where they can exist without judgement. Between shelves, boxes and locked doors, each character creates a fragile, personal world of their own, transforming the impersonal storage units into places where longing, intimacy and vulnerability can find expression. Their stories form a quiet portrait of a society in which one needs a place outside of everyday life to fully be oneself.

title: Every Breath We Take
overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
overview: Haya's convinced she's going to die before thirty, so she's living like it — loud, reckless, completely unfiltered, no brakes. Then one of her stunts goes wrong and lands her in the ER... right into Youssef. A heart surgeon. Calm, controlled, lives by a schedule. The human opposite of her in every way.  Naturally, she decides he's her destiny.  What follows is chaotic, funny, and a little bit ridiculous — neon nights, strange rituals, the kind of moments you can't plan for. Her countdown keeps ticking. His walls keep cracking. And somewhere in between, they both start remembering what it actually feels like to be alive.  A love story for anyone who's ever felt like too much.

title: Hand of Justice
overview: Blagoje Jovović, a war hero, after World War II moves to Buenos Aires. There he tries to lead a normal life, but an encounter with a man with ustasha tattoo brings up old wounds and desire for vengeance.

title: Zé do Caixão: Inferno em Sitges
overview: The love story between José Mojica Marins and the Sitges Film Festival dates back to 1972, when, during its fifth edition, the Catalan Festival screened This Night I'll Possess Your Corpse. It was in 1978 that the Brazilian actor and director attended the Festival for the first time. He would return later in 1997 and 2008, by then firmly established as a key figure in the global horror film scene. This documentary chronicles Marins’ visits to the Festival through images and documents.

title: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!
overview: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.

title: 12 Gaun 2
overview: Two warriors uncover a massive secret conspiracy orchestrated by powerful forces, plunging them into a deadly battle where every truth comes at a price.

title: Torment
overview: An exhausted security guard is transferred to a morgue and, on their first night, discovers that the shadows and silences hide a torment from which there may be no return.

title: Sanxingdui: Future Past
overview: In the future, humanity receives a mysterious fragmentary intergalactic warning: Jiang Cheng and an ally must collect six Sanxingdui artifacts to complete the information, ultimately uncovering the secret that the female astronaut Xi Ling traveled back to the ancient Shu period, thereby reflecting the position of the Sanxingdui civilization in the origins of world civilization and the pattern of pluralistic unity of Chinese civilization.

title: The Vanishing
overview: Reda seemingly has a life of privilege in Algiers, in his late twenties still living at the family home, with a father who has arranged a job and a fiancée. Reda is eager to please, yet the more he tries the more he veers off course.

title: Cape Farewell
overview: Fresh out of prison, Toni struggles to reconnect with her daughter Anna, who was raised by her grandmother Betty, while resisting the  pull of her ex-lover Max's criminal world. Working at her uncle  Frank's restaurant, she discovers his smuggling ties and Max involves her in a violent altercation on the docks. She faces pressure  from the police and seeks redemption by getting away from Max.  But trouble catches up with her, putting her family in danger. Toni will take all the risks to finally find a chance for her future with Anna and Betty.

title: Я стану капитаном
overview: It is the story of Vanya, a twelve-year-old boy who, after receiving an award for saving lives, is sent to the "Okean" All-Russian Children's Center; he decides to run away to find his father but discovers something far greater.

title: Camouflage
overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

title: The Mirror
overview: Young filmmaker Juan invites Mateo, a former actor who abandoned his artistic ambitions, to star in a short film about two men confronting a forbidden attraction. As rehearsals deepen, the story begins to feel less and less like fiction. Juan and Mateo begin unconsciously mirroring the very relationship they are creating for the screen. Glances linger, boundaries blur and the creative process exposes fears, frustrations and desires neither man is prepared to confront.

title: ee
overview: When a young girl attempts to shoplift an old blind box figure from a collectibles store, the shopkeeper’s seductive wife takes an interest in her.

title: Run Terry Run
overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

title: Sugar Glass
overview: To be determined.

title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

title: First Witch
overview: A couple journey to a small town to visit a traditional healer for alternative conception methods, when they soon discover the dark secrets of the town's past.

title: Spatial
overview: A sound-forward story that follows Henri Beckett, a reclusive, audio field recordist who captures a chilling occurrence during one of her ambient sessions.

title: Thetta
overview: A montage film on the elements of the earth

title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.

title: Backwoods
overview: Marta decides to take her daughters, Agáta and Mína, leave her toxic husband, and start over. She finds refuge in the house of her father, an eccentric loner who has spent his entire life preparing for the end of the world.  Their time together reveals long-suppressed family conflicts, many of them triggered by the husband. When Milan accuses Marta of kidnapping the children, the father drives him away, strengthening the bond with his daughter.

title: Peter
overview: A trans man caring for his father with alcohol-induced dementia finds unexpected reconnection when the disease grants him temporary anonymity.

title: Inhumation
overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

title: Ungelesen
