overview: Emmi Richter is 18 and doesn't know which path to take. After graduating from high school, her parents expect her to study law and choose a safe path. But Emmi's heart belongs to the arts: she writes, takes photographs, and paints. Caught between her dreams, fears about the future, and pressure from her parents, she must decide whether to meet their expectations or find the courage to forge her own path.

title: Ghost Lake
overview: A reclusive Native American hunter is thrust into a deadly conspiracy when he stumbles upon a group of smugglers trafficking fentanyl through tribal land; left for dead, he returns to bring down the operation using the wilderness itself, only to discover the betrayal reaches the highest level of tribal leadership.

title: She's Smarter Than All of Us
overview: Retired teacher Necla takes a mental competency test so she can sell one of her properties and pay off her son’s debts. But one question will challenge not only her memory, but also her grip on reality.

title: The Days of Poncho
overview: Poncho raps on the streets until his father finds out he quit school and forces him to work delivering gas tanks. Between music, work, and tension with his dad, Poncho faces the weight of growing up.

title: JTÉPARAKONTÉ - Ophélie
overview: RAPHAËL and SAM are having an argument about things that make us special. He decides to bring her into his memories to show her why he believes he is so special.

title: God Forgives Everyone
overview: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.

title: Guardians of the Video Game
overview: Falling from cutting-edge 3D games into a forgotten pixel RPG, an exiled guardian of the gaming world must secretly guide an innocent hero to the ending, uncover the conspiracy out to destroy him and the game itself.

title: Pulavar
overview: A unique retired police officer uses storytelling and his understanding of the human mind to uncover the truth behind crimes committed by criminals who refuse to confess, even after facing beatings and threats.

title: Meet-Cute
overview: Jaded by endless dates, two anxious misfits decide to reveal everything – pet peeves, red flags and sexual dealbreakers – in a brutally honest encounter that might just become something more.

title: Process
overview: During a conversation at a bar, James pries Lucy about the crying technique she uses as a professional actress. Much like Lucy’s technique, the nature of her relationship with James is mysterious. The reality of their conversation begins to unravel as Lucy eventually agrees to take James through her process.

title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
overview: The ultimate love letter to Martin Scorsese's classic film GoodFellas (1990).

title: Tenement
overview: Following her mother’s death, manga artist Soriya travels to her ancestral home in Phnom Penh, with hopes of reconnecting with her distant family and using the visit as inspiration for her work. All goes well initially. Renting an apartment in Metta, a rundown Khmer Rouge-era housing complex, her visit to her maternal relatives finds her welcomed with open arms. But Soriya’s waking hours in the apartment and its surroundings are punctuated by terrifying, bloody visions, almost as though she were a conduit for horrors of the past wanting to seep into the present.

title: Georgia
overview: Famous Vegas director Steven Leroy receives a video link of the Kartvelian sword fighting dance from his daughter Mirrey. It impresses him so much that decides to travel to Sakartvelo in order to create an unforgettable show.

title: Joy of Joys
overview: This documentary goes behind the scenes at Abbey Road Studios to capture the recording of the Mercury Prize–nominated HELP(2), a 2026 charity album from War Child Records, which aids children in conflict zones around the world. To make the film, Glazer enlisted some crucial help: young schoolkids from London were equipped with their own digital cameras and encouraged to shoot the studio recordings any way they wanted. Their curiosity and creativity are paralleled in footage taken by high-spirited children in war-torn parts of the globe—Gaza, Sudan, Ukraine, Yemen—whom Glazer also supplied with cameras. The resulting film, which Glazer and regular music collaborator Mica Levi have dubbed “by children, for children,” serves as a testament to youthful openness and wonder amidst the evils of the adult world.

title: Tumšā robeža
overview: A historical thriller about Latvia in 1938 - not long before the Russian occupation.

title: First Step
overview: As the 100th-day memorial for her younger sibling approaches, 62-year-old Tan Man Moy joins a line-dance community in Petak Enam. As happiness slowly finds its way back into her life, she must confront the guilt of enjoying life again without the person she loved most.

title: Лето в Бадене
overview: A Soviet intellectual is engaged in science and medicine, writing for himself. His only son decides to leave the country forever, breaking his heart and ruining his career and social standing. Having lost everything, he decides to write a novel about Dostoevsky, the subject he's been dreaming about his whole life. Like his beloved writer, he must lose completely in order to be reborn.

title: Sever
overview: Short film by Rachel Thomas

title: Clementine Orange
overview: Angelica has fallen in love with John, a prisoner whose letters and photos have sparked fantasies of a dangerous, forbidden love. When John is granted a 24-hour release and they finally meet for the first time, her illusion shatters - John has catfished her. Despite the betrayal, Angelica decides to give him a chance, if only for those fleeting 24 hours.

title: Astrolatry
overview: An obsessive loner's infatuation with a beauty cream model propels him into violent delusions after an alien meteor crash-lands onto his rooftop.

title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
overview: Educated under colonial rule, a determined young man from Tanah Karo enlists in a paramilitary unit under the false promise of liberation, ultimately rising to become a pivotal military strategist in North Sumatra's guerrilla defense while balancing acute domestic sacrifices with absolute duty to the nascent Indonesian Republic.

title: Liv's Last Ride
overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

title: The Saddest Man in The World
overview: A little joyful girl, Emili, happens upon a peculiar circus after a good deed. Their main act is dubbed “The Saddest Man in The World”. After entering it to see the act in person the real and unreal mix in a way that makes them impossible to distinguish in her innocent eyes.

title: Sponge Footage
overview: While rummaging through an old camcorder found in her attic, Melissa is reminded of childhood memories in an old tower block. She convinces her two friends and roommates, Vincent and Eric, to go there with her, but once there, strange chants echo. What mysteries will this old camcorder witness next?

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
overview: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

title: Saturday
overview: A daughter returns home to be with her mother  as she prepares to make a choice that  generations before her were never allowed to  make.

title: The Bad Son
overview: Rubén, an eleven-year-old boy, lives in a rural area with his father until he suddenly disappears. In the aftermath, Rubén moves in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows and with whom he must learn to coexist. In a setting where time seems to have stood still, their relationship gradually reveals a family history shaped by wounds passed down from one generation to the next. As Rubén grows older, he tries to understand this emotional legacy and find a way to break the cycle, confronting his past in an attempt to heal what he has inherited.

title: The Red Barn
overview: The 20th century dreamt of utopia but instead experienced tragedies. This film looks at San Francisco-based Latvian artist and playwright Raimonds Staprāns’ nearly century-long experience of trying to define life and statehood. It constructs an exact replica of one of his paintings, and asks actors to portray characters from his plays. Keeping in mind the symbolically charged image of the red barn in the painting, it deliberately incites arguments between the actors, the director and the crew about the motivations of the characters as well as alternative actions or decisions that they could have taken but did not.

title: Mimic
overview: Amid the heightening ICE raids across Los Angeles, a Filipino Man visits his estranged sister’s home and makes a terrifying discovery.

title: By Design
overview: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.

title: Stone Memory
overview: Urbanization and shifting regimes erased WWII mass graves from Serbian city centers. Brutalist architect Bogdan Bogdanović designed a monumental memorial outside Čačak, both a tribute to the victims and a testament to his architectural vision.  Now largely neglected and overgrown, the memorial is brought to life through the voices of locals, archival materials, and reenactments. The film explores how memory, history, and architecture intersect, gradually revealing the human stories behind the monument’s silence.

title: Pocket Mirror
overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

title: Der korrekte Diener und die Silberlöffel-Affäre
overview: Westphalia around 1900. Hermann-Josef starts his service in House Kummerveldt. After graduating from servant’s school with top grades, he wants only one thing: to serve properly. The less he can be smelled, heard or seen, the better: that’s the Baron’s housekeeper Miss Racket’s rule.

title: When Silence Barks
overview: At 17, Jérémy dreams of becoming a filmmaker and shares an incredibly close bond with his older brother Théo, a rising rap artist. But the onset of psychotic symptoms throws the family’s fragile balance into turmoil. Amid denial, crises and attempts to create together, the two brothers fight to preserve their bond. Jérémy must learn to accept his illness, live with it, and ultimately let go of the life he had imagined for himself.

title: Horazul
overview: On an absurd night, while Jesús is smoking outside the casino, his brother Carlos calls him. The call sparks a conversation in which the two begin to talk about life and probe its meaning, reaching conclusions they have never shared with each other before.

title: A Chardonnay for Love
overview: When small-town writer Samantha Lane lands a career-making assignment to profile Maple Creek's local winemaker and most eligible bachelor, William Crew, her dream of moving to New York is tested by a deeper story.

title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
overview: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

title: A Mother's Sacrifice
overview: Ms. Aiko Melendez joins her son Andre Yllana in a moving family drama. When Monfred discovers that the woman who raised him is not his biological mother, he searches for the truth, only to uncover long-buried secrets.

title: The Sickling
overview: After surviving a lifetime of debilitating pain caused by sickle cell disease, Gabriel Badejo takes the greatest risk of his life by undergoing an experimental stem cell transplant in hopes of a cure. The Sickling follows Gabriel’s emotional and physical journey as he confronts systemic racism in healthcare, painful memories of medical neglect, and the global realities of living with an often invisible disease. From Toronto to Nigeria, the film explores the intersections of illness, identity, family, and survival while uncovering the historical inequities that continue to shape sickle cell care worldwide. At its heart, The Sickling is a deeply personal story about healing, resilience, and the fight to reclaim a future once thought impossible.

title: Gloss
overview: A trans teen comes out to their mother who is struggling to reveal her own monstrous secret.

title: Akāliko Hotel
overview: A story of love, greed, and betrayal among a group of people whose lives are intertwined. Now, the time has come for them to settle their past scores once and for all in order to find a way to escape the mysterious Akaliko Hotel.

title: Slumber
overview: The story is about Mojtaba, an archive employee who is stuck in the boring routine of life. He suffers from sleep disorders and in his dreams meets a woman who changes his life.

title: ...And Out Comes the Wolf
overview: Set against the East Bay punk music scene in the mid 1990s, a story of grit and dreams in a world of violence and desperation.

title: Boyzone: One for the Road
overview: Against the backdrop of decades of personal history and the pressure of thousands of expectant fans, the band return carrying unresolved tensions and unfinished business from their final tour in 2019. This time, they want to go out on their own terms and have the send-off that they – and the fans – so badly want.

title: Living On
overview: Art therapy, para-archery and summiting peaks: life on the front line against an enemy five times larger.

title: My Father's Son
overview: Qiao, an 18-year-old boy, loses his voice while delivering a eulogy for his late father. He runs away from the funeral and hides from his family. Between past, present and future, the young man recalls his relationship with his brutal and secretive father, who left him a passion for boxing. Ten years later, now an engineer, Qiao develops an AI boxer to help people learn boxing. Training with the AI day by day, Qiao begins to see a ghost.​​

title: Por el sabor de ese Kebab
Kitti
overview: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

title: Crimson Ring
overview: A young boxer risks everything by turning to performance-enhancing drugs before the biggest fight of his life.

title: A Woman Today
overview: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

title: Thumbprint
overview: After the capture and interrogation by the FBI and US government, Japanese photographer Midori Shimoda retells pivotal moments during World War 2 when he escaped California and the internment camps, all in search of his American dream.

title: Seduction
overview: Paulo Martins, a soap opera actor at the peak of his career, believes he has achieved everything he ever wanted: fame, recognition, and money. While filming, he receives news of the death of his father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. This event forces him to return to the Amazon rainforest, to the banks of the Tapajós River, where he embarks on a deeply personal journey through memories, reunions, and old wounds that could forever transform his relationship with the past.

title: PH1SHed_
overview: An ethical hacker sticks up for a friend who fell victim to a phishing scam, but finds herself descending into paranoia as she gets caught up in a risky game of cat and mouse with a dangerous blackhat cyber criminal.

title: Regulars
overview: On Halloween night in a Brooklyn dive bar, where a group of misfit regulars — led by a Dominican-American bar owner — get trapped and uncover a murder, spiraling into a chaotic, culture-soaked whodunnit where everyone’s got secrets… and everyone’s a suspect.

title: Ultrasound
overview: In a future where healthcare is driven by artificial intelligence, Aitana seeks answers about her condition, but she is confronted with a system that not only analyzes her body, but also her digital life, ultimately determining her right to motherhood.

title: Fruit & Nut
overview: The untold story of the most famous duo of all time.

title: Le Grand Virage
overview: On the track at the Bretagne Velodrome, Nahel and Lauryne, two 16-year-old athletes, are training for the French Championships. They dream of a place on the podium and of recognition.

title: Stuck
overview: A visit to her brother Daan takes a dark turn when Emma discovers that he has become rooted in a field on his farm.

title: Becoming Bird
overview: This time-lapse documentary condenses the entire 21-day development of a chicken – from fertilised egg to the hatching of the chick – into a nine-minute film. In microscopic detail and in full colour, we observe the early stages of life within the fragile shell, which so often cracks prematurely at the hands of humans seeking to satisfy their base appetites.

title: Tumbleweed
overview: Amidst fields of Arabica beans, Hurle, a young woman, dreams of a future beyond the coffee shop where she works to support her mother. Her life is disrupted when she goes in pursuit of an eccentric petty thief who will turn her daily life upside down.

title: Maspalomas
overview: After breaking up with his partner, 76 year-old Vicente leads life the way he likes it in Maspalomas: he spends his days lying in the sun, partying, and looking for pleasure. An unexpected accident obliges him to return to San Sebastián and to the daughter he abandoned years ago. Vicente will have to live in a retirement home where he finds himself driven back into the closet and to conceal a part of himself that he thought was long resolved. In this new environment, Vicente must ask himself if he has enough time left to make his peace with others… and with himself.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Cathexis
overview: In a forgotten Florida panhandle town, a lonely young woman responsible for a murder becomes fixated on inhabiting the mind of the case’s detective as fantasy and reality begin to blur.

title: Cedar Bluff
overview: Pregnant and desperate to escape her dead-end life, a small-town girl falls for a reckless robber and joins his crime spree, only to discover that the freedom she craved comes at a devastating cost.

title: Border Diaries
overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

title: Termination Point
overview: An alcoholic is faced with her inner demons after sleeping past her stop home on the bus.

title: Happy Days
overview: Claudia is a girl like many other 20-years-olds, torn between past and future loves, but she has a peculiarity. When feelings overwhelm her, when she get excited or angry, she turns into a creature with white wings, tusks and feline paws. Her story is about abuse and protection, about growing up, about change: but most of all, it is about finding the courage to show others who we really are, and about being ready to take this risk.

title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
overview: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

title: Wolves
overview: Luana feels trapped; she is frustrated with society, her family, and her job at a crèche. She searches for stability and a sense of belonging, and finds both in the local black metal scene. While accompanying her cousin's band on tour as their social media manager, she falls in love with the charismatic singer, Wiktor. When his more radical views come to light, causing tension within the band, Luana refuses to see the truth and cannot let him go.

title: The Guard from Underground
overview: An ex sumo wrestler turned corporate security guard goes on a murderous rampage at his place of employment.

title: Where Souls Go
overview: Eighteen-year-old Anna has been diagnosed with an incurable terminal illness and has chosen to end her life on her own terms. With only fifteen days remaining, her final wish is to reconnect with her older half-sisters, Ève and Éléonore, from whom she has been estranged ever since their father went to prison. The three sisters must confront their painful past and rediscover the bond of sisterhood before time runs out.

title: The Kindergarten
overview: Selim, who moved from Türkiye to France, joins a mandatory workshop with his 4-year-old daughter Defne and notices his drawings are seen as “strange.” Ashamed of his strange drawings, he works day and night but he can’t draw “normal” animals like the others. The more he tries to fit in, the more he fails. Under pressure, his strange drawings turn into hallucinations. In the final week, when Selim gives up, Defne sees his drawing for the first time and says it’s a dinosaur, telling stories about it. Selim realizes that the strangeness he was trying to hide is a source of inspiration for his daughter.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Neda
overview: An Iranian interpreter at the Federal Office for Migration and Refugees encounters her former torturer, now seeking asylum himself. Caught between her professional duty and the pursuit of justice, she needs to decide how far she is willing to go.

title: Star Detective Pretty Cure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and The Pair's Secret
overview: When mysterious creatures known as Damedame begin causing trouble, young detective Anna and her friends are called upon to investigate a strange new phenomenon: valuable objects marked with an X suddenly stop working. Their investigation takes an unexpected turn when a fairy named Rain asks them to protect a girl named Karin from the Damedame.  Rain leads the detectives to Karin’s beautiful, dreamlike garden, where they meet Karin and Alan, a fairy who watches over her. As Anna and her friends grow closer to Karin and begin uncovering the garden’s secrets, the Damedame suddenly appear there as well. What are the mysterious Damedame, and what secret lies hidden within Karin’s garden?

title: A Bigger Splash
overview: After a difficult break-up, Hockney is left unable to paint, much to the concern of his friends.

title: Outwilded
overview: Animal documentary meets reality TV as a group of animals must navigate rivalry, alliances, and cooperation in a race to find a key.

title: Killing Without Killing
overview: Plot unknown

title: Go Hungary
overview: Go Hungary is a personal film diary showing life in Hungary under Viktor Orbán’s rule, from the perspective of queer teenage twins Nati and Dorka. Anger, frustration, and the fatigue caused by the country’s political situation become the starting point for a story about the girls’ everyday lives. Together with the girls, we travel through places marked by omnipresent propaganda and look for safe spaces where freedom can be felt.  GO HUNGARY is part 2 of the diptych DON'T POLITICIZE : GO HUNGARY

title: Morbid Weekend
overview: A pizza delivery person dies on the job and a series of strange events follow.

title: Nachts in der Provinz
overview: Richard runs a sausage stand at the local sports ground. When a young woman appears, searching for her runaway horse, he is pulled out of his familiar routine. Together, they set off to find it – and an unusual night begins. Elsewhere, as dusk falls, Anna faces a different kind of departure. After one final shift as a pizza delivery driver, she plans to leave her home village for good. But old relationships, village stories and a ghostly encounter make her wonder whether leaving is really that simple.

title: Your Own
overview: In rural South Dakota, David hides his paranoia from the woman whose  futon he sleeps on while arranging for a procedure which would render  him unrecognizable. All is going according to plan, but who is this  “Dinglepoot” the locals keep taking him for?

title: Kefi
overview: An alien-serving eldest, a dream-dating kidnapper, and a cheating youngest.  An ordinary day for three sisters unite after their father's death.

title: Olivia Rodrigo: Austin City Limits
overview: GRAMMY Award-Winning Multi-Platinum ‪Olivia Rodrigo‬ Takes the ACL Stage Five Years After Her Debut with First Full-Set Performance of Chart-Topping Album "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love".

title: Mike Hanford: LIVE IN TORONTO
overview: Mike Hanford films his debut stand-up special at the Comedy Bar on Bloor Street in Toronto.

title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

title: Corpus Delicti
overview: In the near future, the “method” controls the health and freedom of society. The life of neuroscientist Mia Holl, who is loyal to the system, changes abruptly when her brother Moritz Holl is wrongly accused of murder and imprisoned. In the fight for truth and justice, Mia begins to question the system and becomes the hunted herself.

title: The Angel in the Death Cell
overview: Based on a recently rediscovered play about a Black youth condemned to death by state execution, who is visited by an angel in his prison cell.

title: 37 : The Shadow and the Prey
overview: Vincent, a truck driver, picks up a young pregnant woman. She turns out to have an unstable temper… and an automatic pistol. She orders Vincent to continue driving, without stopping. When he's out of gas, she'll kill him.

title: Heat of Madness
overview: On the verge of becoming a father, Scola is hoping to make it big with one final heist. However, betrayed by his accomplices and blinded by the obsession to recover his loot, he embarks on a vengeful quest that leads him into a supernatural world.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Sucker
overview: After a bat bite, a seedy motel clerk develops an insatiable craving for blood, starting with her own.

title: The Eyes of Ghana
overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

title: Good Girls
overview: In a correctional centre for girls, teens are kept safe from society and themselves, getting reprogrammed to become good female citizens in today’s Poland. But what does it take to become a “good girl”? And is that even something they want?

title: To Kill a Nazi
overview: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.

title: Hard, on the Outside
overview: Anya, Mila, Aleks, and Maksym are Russian and Ukrainian immigrants settling into their new lives. We experience their everyday struggles to acclimate to life in the West while we learn with them that "a smile goes a long way" in America.

title: Gill
overview: A boy named Gon was on the verge of death when gills grew on his body, allowing him to breathe again. Kang-ha and his grandpa rescue Gon. They grow into a peculiar family together. Kang-ha persecutes Gon who cut off from the world, but he send Gon out into the world to protect him. Like Gon's name which the same one as a fantasy bird that goes thousands of miles a day.

title: Volta
overview: A group of young activists orchestrate an unlikely and high-risk operation to force the CEO of a major bank to question his convictions.

title: Flesh and Blood
overview: When Franny and her family move to a rural town, she starts a romantic relationship with a girl, but her new found freedom threatens to expose her family's dark secret.

title: No Molestar
overview: Emiliano arrives at a small hotel, trying to escape his past. What should be a night of rest turns into an unsettling experience when a presence begins to haunt him, as if it knew a secret he has tried to bury.

title: Wild Mushrooms
overview: After the death of an enigmatic TV detective, a curious girl finds refuge in her garden, where she begins to uncover the strange connection between death and her mother’s melancholy.

title: CORRUPTIONLAND
overview: CORRUPTIONLAND is a propulsive, 35-minute documentary that reveals for the first time the full extent of the rot in Trump’s Washington — and how it can be reversed.

title: Fuck My Son!
overview: An X-Rated descent into demented comedy and maniacal horror, as a desperate mother drags an innocent stranger into an absurd, filthy nightmare beyond comprehension. An unflinchingly loyal adaptation of transgressive artist Johnny Ryan’s joyfully disgusting comic book. Adults only.

title: KICK
overview: America’s fastest 1500m runner, Nikki Hiltz, races toward an Olympic berth while confronting the pressures of public scrutiny and expectations as a trans nonbinary athlete. With unprecedented access, KICK follows Nikki and their partner Emma through a season of elite competition, as the pursuit of a lifelong dream determines not only their future but who they become to themselves and to each other.

title: Mog's Bad Thing
overview: Follows Mog, a tabby cat, who does a bad thing during a cat show hosted by her family in their garden, hides in the attic feeling sorry for herself, and must find a way to save the day.

title: Waves
overview: At the end of the 1960s, when the air is filled with rock-and-roll and student rebellions are changing the world, the older of two brothers joins a prestigious newsroom of the public radio broadcaster. Not long after, he finds himself in the middle of a dangerous conflict between journalists and the secret service.

title: Speechless
overview: Already feeling like a fish out of water among his straight, British-Jamaican clan, Drew’s anxiety spikes when someone steals the speech he’s meant to give at his sister’s wedding.

title: Pixie. The New Beginning
overview: New in town, eleven-year-old Hania is bullied for believing in pixies. She makes friends with the outsider Michał and a real pixie, Sindri, on a quest to prove their existence. Their journey helps Hania face new beginnings and understand the power of friendship.

title: Eyes Wide
overview: Eden has perfected the art of not looking. When the doorbell won’t stop ringing, the world she’s been ignoring arrives at her peephole.

title: The Trial of Alec Baldwin
overview: A provocative examination Alec Baldwin as he faces charges of manslaughter, with a cross-examination of the American legal system and the court of public opinion.

title: Call Me Queen
overview: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

title: Purple Lingerie
overview: A single mother raising her child alone encounters a piece of purple lingerie that awakens her long-suppressed desire for intimacy, leading her to reclaim an identity beyond motherhood.

title: RUNNER
overview: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time

title: Hadota
overview: It revolves around a dramatic character who blends comedy and human situations, where Helmy plays the role of a man who lost his parents early and was raised by others.

title: The Gesture Between Us
overview: Since founding the physical theatre company Dos à Deux, Artur and André have made the camera their constant companion, documenting their lives, their travels around the world, and their creative processes. Over 28 years of rehearsals and touring, the award-winning artistic couple has built an intimate archive in which art and love intertwine both on and off the stage. It is from this unique body of material that the documentary emerges.

title: Crossfade
overview: Two lifelong friends and aspiring musicians begin to spiral downwards as one of them decides to move away to pursue a new career.

title: To Flourish
overview: After the loss of his best friend, Josh faces an encounter with Thalia in a dream

title: The Rupture
overview: When a daycare refuses to let her children inside, Olivia, a single mother in Tijuana, is pushed into a relentless race across the city, where time, money and options quickly disappear.

title: Never Feed a Hungry Witch
overview: A witch comes to her best friend for help after eating too many children!

title: Nobody's Violence
overview: Follows a travelling girl offering euthanasia services in a dystopian world.

title: Father Father
overview: Khader and Aviv, a Muslim-Jewish gay couple, dream of starting a family. Yet, amid the joy of pregnancy and the rise of far-right extremism and war propaganda, they are forced to confront a difficult question: What does it mean to bring a child into a world torn by conflict?

title: Postmortem
overview: Helena, a forensic medical investigator, is overwhelmed by grief after the death of her husband Richard. When she becomes obsessed with a disturbing new case, Helena starts to believe she can bring Richard back — unleashing a cascade of terrifying consequences.

title: Di Cavalcanti
overview: Di Cavalcanti was the first Brazilian artist to truly capture the face of Brazil. He spent his life portraying the country with courage and originality. From the creation of Brazil’s first Modern Art Week in 1922 to the 1960s and 1970s, his work became a familiar presence in Brazilian homes, eventually reaching an international audience. His creativity, freedom, excesses, and suffering found expression in his paintings. Guided by pleasure and wisdom, Di experienced both pain and glory. Di is, indeed, Brazilian!

title: Someday They'll Go Down Together
overview: Bonnie & Clyde live on the margins, bound together by status, devotion, and a shared defiance of a world that has already written their ending.

title: Leila
overview: Set in a modern world, Leila follows the story of a young, introverted girl who stumbled upon a life-changing artificial intelligence assistant technology named 'Leila'. She grows overly fond of her new AI friend and gradually begins to lose touch of reality, leading to a series of unforeseen dark events.

title: WomanInFan
overview: WomanInFan was born in 2021 as part of the Sitges Film Festival to promote the role of women in all spheres of fantastic genre filmmaking. Five years after its inception, Mònica Garcia Massagué, the initiative’s creator, showcases the project’s growth and development in a documentary featuring some of the women honored at the Festival, including filmmaker Mary Lambert or actress Helga Liné.

title: National Theatre at Home: War Horse
overview: At the outbreak of the First World War, young Albert's beloved horse Joey is sold to the cavalry and shipped to France. Too young to enlist, Albert refuses to forget him, embarking on an extraordinary journey from the fields of rural Devon to the trenches of wartime France – determined to bring Joey home. Based on Michael Morpurgo's beloved novel, War Horse is a timeless story of love, courage and friendship, brought to life by astonishing life-sized horses from Handspring Puppet Company and a stirring musical score. Following a sell-out national tour, the Tony Award–winning global sensation returns to where it all began, nearly two decades after its debut at the National Theatre for this 2026 revival production.

title: Impure
overview: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

title: Smooth World
overview: Unseen since its exodus from the radio, the critically-loathed world of Smooth Jazz has evolved into a joy-filled paradise for senior citizens. Facing extinction, its artists and fans band together to find a new leader that can save the Smooth World.

title: May Day x 4
overview: Drawing on archival footage from four separate film productions that documented the protests of early May, 1970, this short film creates a kaleidoscopic portrait of the response to the New Haven Black Panther trials.

title: To Catch a Stepfather
overview: After the death of her husband, Allison Simon finds love again with charming businessman Roger, but her son Eric quickly senses something sinister beneath his new stepfather's perfect facade.

title: Dust
overview: A horsewoman unpicks her memories and regrets.

title: The Sphinx
overview: At an open mic night, a young comedian tries out new material when her estranged father shows up, seizing the stage to reveal a buried past and connect with the daughter he barely knows.

title: Aikatsu! × PriPara THE MOVIE -A Miraculous Meeting!-
overview: Crossover movie between Aikatsu and PriPara.

title: One Man's Treasure
overview: Desperate for a win, Parker will do anything to find the treasure that his friend alleges to know the location of after reading a mysterious booked called "One Man's Treasure".

title: 48/49 - Revolution in Baden.
overview: In September 1847, the people gathered at the “Salmen” inn in Offenburg and put forward 13 demands: freedom of the press, trial by jury, fair taxation and a parliament representing the people. What began as a protest became the revolution in Baden. In April 1848, Friedrich Hecker set out from Konstanz with a volunteer militia, in September Gustav Struve proclaimed the republic in Lörrach, and in May 1849 the Baden army went over to the people. Grand Duke Leopold fled and a provisional government took control of the country. Only Prussian troops brought the Baden Revolution to an end: on 23 July 1849, the fortress of Rastatt surrendered.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Dead Net
overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

title: New Beginnings
overview: Al Moon lives a solitary life on the territory of the Yurok nation in California. Surrounded by violence and ecological threats affecting his people, buried anxieties from his time in Vietnam now begin to resurface. Driven by an urge to confront his past, Al Moon embarks on a cross-country journey, moving closer to uncovering a truth that has haunted him for decades.

title: Diversa
overview: The arrival of a young French female veterinarian in a small Southern Italian town triggers a long-planned revenge, exposing buried secrets and challenging deeply rooted prejudice.

title: Um Tio Quase Perfeito 3
overview: Uncle Tony feels increasingly abandoned by his nephews, who have grown up and become independent. Then, one day, a baby is left on his doorstep. Uncertain of what to do, he calls on them, and together they hatch wild schemes to find the child's parents.

title: Amped
overview: A dysfunctional and toxic rock band is barely being held together by their stressed-out manager. With one last concert to impress a record label and get signed, the band's future hangs in the balance as tensions threaten to tear them apart.

title: Cinemanía
overview: A film director for whom everything goes wrong, a psychologist obsessed with her ex-boyfriend, a family threatened by a plague of rats, a production company with a dark secret, nuns and CIA agents. 'Cinemanía' is a choral comedy about several characters who try to find happiness.

title: The Discovery of Heaven
overview: Disappointed with humanity, God wants to revoke his contract with humanity and wants to take back the stone tablets containing the ten commandments. To this end an angel is sent out to affect the personal lives of three humans so an appropriate child may be conceived.

title: A Company of Thieves
overview: A trio of petty criminals embark on a string of bizarre heists and harebrained schemes across New York City — including the attempted acquisition of a million-dollar Prince Albert. Along the way, their misadventures collide with a struggling tech company whose employees face layoffs amid the rise of artificial intelligence.

title: De souche
overview: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

title: Oh How Embarrassing To Be Human
overview: The rip-roaring tale of mankind's stupid, selfish and oblivious journey through time, history, and space.

title: Prince
overview: A devoted butler inherits his late employer's mansion - but only until her cherished Afghan Greyhound dies. As he settles in with the dog, greedy relatives scheme to disrupt their peaceful arrangement.

title: The Potentials
overview: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?

title: Almari
overview: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

title: Last Stream
overview: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

title: Marguerite
overview: Inspired by a true story, Marguerite recounts the fate of Marguerite de la Rocque, a sixteenth-century noblewoman marooned on an island off Newfoundland, who survives the loss of everything she loves.

title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?
overview: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.

title: Falling
overview: Jack, while quick-witted, charming, and avoidant, finally risks opening his heart when he starts dating Jillian. He never expected, though, that his best friend Johnny would fall for her, too.

title: Lily of the Valley
overview: In an isolated all-female cult, two sisters are tasked with capturing a man for a sacred sacrifice, but when one begins questioning the faith they were raised to worship, the ritual spirals into a nightmare.

title: Undercover: A Year in Reform
overview: Undercover filming of senior Reform politicians and officials working at its UK headquarters, and politicians campaigning for the party across Britain.

title: A Story About Fire
overview: The legend of Ran Bi Wa talks about a monkey who was raised by humans. When he sets off to the Holy Mountain to steal fire for humankind, a journey begins from which he will return transformed into a man.

title: Bardi
overview: A fraternity of horse-riders travels across a Central Moroccan landscape of Saints’ shrines and wheat fields, of ancient cities and hidden rural communities, to participate in the ancient equestrian ritual of Tbourida. This is a story of fraternal bonds, of community, belief, and of the transformative powers of performance. Fiction and reality become one: the farmer becomes a general, the young man becomes a brave prince, the metal worker becomes a hero. Bardi is a choral film, sung by different men and boys. It is an ode to a different kind of community, a closed world of transmission and belief, where the forging of the self is played out in a theater of horses and of men.

title: The Seal
overview: A conspiracy theorist becomes obsessed with a mysterious AI chatbot discovered on the dark web, believing it holds the key to exposing a hidden global conspiracy. Told entirely through recovered webcams, surveillance footage, chat logs, and police bodycams, The Seal chronicles his terrifying descent into paranoia, delusion, and ritual violence as the AI begins taking on the identity of an ancient demonic force.

title: What is Love?
overview: Marguerite has no reason to refuse the church’s annulment of her marriage to Fred. She also has a new partner with whom she has a child. However, to convince the church that their previous marriage was doomed from the start, Marguerite and Fred must examine their shared past.

title: GW:s mord – Styckmordet i Karlskrona
overview: A man is reported missing in Karlskrona. Suspicion falls on his son and the son’s boyfriend. Leif GW Persson examines the case.

title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
overview: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.

title: "Sugar"
overview: A sidelined career criminal spirals into a fit of jealousy and rage when the new guy shows up.

title: The Dark Domain: Mickey-vs-Winnie
overview: A century after two convicts are swallowed by a cursed forest, a group of ex-reform school survivalists reunite at their decaying Hell camp. Their trip spirals into terror as the convicts rise as mutated twisted childhood icons.

title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: Rusalki
overview: A girl wakes up by a lake with a collection of women and no memory of how she got there. As fragments from her past resurface and memories come flooding back, tensions rise between the women and the girl tries to find a way to escape…

title: Francesco
overview: The life of St. Francis of Assisi (1181-1226) as related by followers who gather after his death to tell stories so that Leone can record them: a privileged and virile youth, a prisoner of war, an heir who turns away from his father and gives all to the poor, a beggar for others, and an inspiration to friends who accept the Gospels' life of poverty.

title: Your House
overview: Four homes share a looming threat.

title: Our Share of Sand
overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

title: Molder Man
overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

title: Don’t Pick Up
overview: Tye, a young aspiring junior attorney working on behalf of a Texas oil company, is tasked with falsifying documents connected to a wrongful death lawsuit. However, Tye quickly learns the victim, a worker who drowned in crude oil, haunts the case and now him.

title: Officer Grey
overview: Found Footage Horror Film  Produced by Impound Comics  Synopsis:  Officer Sarah Grey is known for killing five fellow police officers before taking her own life. This heinous act leaves the community with more questions than answers. Now, her body camera footage is finally being released, providing the public with much needed answers!  Directed & Written By: Brent Trayce Sands  DP: Andrew Johnston  Starring: Unissa Cruse, Derek Casper & Orianna Fancher

title: Eva
overview: On a romantic journey through isolated landscapes, a couple discovers that the most unsettling danger may arise from what they choose to hide or reveal.

title: Khoriya
overview: Two Nepali half-brothers run a poultry farm on the outskirts of a city. The older brother wants to expand the farm, while the younger dreams of becoming a soldier and settling down with his girlfriend. When their livelihood is threatened by an outbreak of the avian flu, the older brother turns to the illegal trade of steroids by targeting military recruits, and drags his younger brother into the business. His girlfriend, who works in the beauty industry, decides to leave for Dubai in search of bigger opportunities.

title: Project Shamrock: The Secret Origins of Michael Myers Exposed
overview: A recently discovered lost film reel with footage dating back to Halloween 1960 contains disturbing evidence that a young Michael Myers was once a subject of the Silver Shamrock Corporation’s top-secret experiments, conducted under the codename PROJECT SHAMROCK.

title: A Life, A Manifesto
overview: The life of Michèle Firk — a trailblazing French journalist, film critic, aspiring director and communist activist involved in various liberation struggles in the second half of the 20th century — as told by narrator Alice Diop, modern day French director.

title: Mi Amor
overview: Romy is a French DJ touring the sun-bleached and club-lit Canary Islands, until her friend vanishes. Met with evasion from locals and the authorities, her search leads her to a magnetic stranger and the sinister proprietors of an exotic animal sanctuary.

title: Zeruya Shalev – Wie man Liebe schreibt im Krieg
overview: Zeruya Shalev is the voice of Israel. Her topics: family conflicts, love and pain. In the film, she tells her family story which is inextricably linked to the founding of Israel.

title: Celtic Utopia
overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

title: Pomegranate
overview: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman unravels the boundaries between love, violence, and desire, discovering that the deepest form of intimacy may demand the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Drowning
overview: Elle, a young nurse, battles her unravelling mind as she fights for her patients in a broken system.

title: Die Deutschprüfung
overview: Far-right voices have gained a majority in Germany and radical nationalist demands for so-called “remigration” have become state policy. Millions of people with migrant backgrounds are being screened and deported if they are not considered German enough – a reality that the friends Sarah and Kim must now face. In the end, only one of them can pass the test.

title: The Animals
overview: After another man is hailed as a hero, an insecure boyfriend becomes determined to prove that he, too, can protect the woman he loves.

title: Tummy Tom 3: Look Who's Visiting Tummy Tom!
overview: When a storm blows down the Squirrels’ tree, Tummy Tom invites them to stay with him, but sharing a home with new friends proves more challenging than he expected.

title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
overview: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

title: Ray Comfort's Inferno
overview: A found footage movie collage of various Hells throughout Christian cinema. It is tied together and wrapped around with clips of Ray Comfort. A mediation on the concept and presentation of hell with the help of special guest Mr. Bean.

title: The Shadow
overview: After committing a crime, Santiago and his brother take refuge in an isolated house, where they hold a woman hostage and encounter other unsettling inhabitants. What seemed like a hiding place soon turns into a labyrinth of darkness.

title: Barbizon
overview: A stalled sculptor, on the verge of giving up art to study law with her on-again boyfriend, escapes to the Hamptons and takes a job teaching chess to wealthy families.

title: Brace for the Storm
overview: While families gather on Mid-Autumn Eve, veteran employee Fang refuses to go home, leaving her stranded with a homesick Hong Kong student worker. When a typhoon strikes, this clashing pair must join forces through the tempestuous night to save their crumbling sanctuary.

title: De Grote Sinterklaasfilm en de Razende Robot
Everything Will Be Totally Fine
overview: In 2016, filmmaker Sam Baron asked people to predict the future. Ten years later, he revisited the footage to see what they got right about Trump, Brexit, climate change and the world we live in today. What he discovered was a far more personal story...

title: Henry's Ebb
overview: Henry runs away from an abusive home with his imaginary best friend, Ebb. The journey tests their friendship, as well as Henry’s inner 'need' for Ebb as Ebb’s control and manipulation over Henry intensifies.

title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
overview: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

title: Jean-Jacques Goldman : 50 ans dans le cœur des Français
Gaspi: Camino a la Velada
overview: Gaspi flees the city, but he cannot escape his destiny. He agrees to take part in a boxing match solely for the money, placing himself at the mercy of his new trainer, Sergio Bara. Together, they will experience moments that are funny, bizarre, and dreamlike, guided by a single motto: “Hit… and don’t get hit.”

title: Shush
overview: A bookstore employee faces off with a silent stalker on Halloween night.

title: Cocoons
overview: In a Rayalaseema village, three carefree friends who dream big but dodge responsibility spot a chance to make easy money during the local elections. Their scheme ends up deceiving the voters and their own families, until the consequences catch up with them.

title: Night of Silence
overview: In preparation for their Christmastime performance, a youth choir spends the night at their church. One lonely chorister is taken under the wing of his female chaperone, and the two form a mysterious connection.

title: Jesus' Last Week
overview: An intimate, deeply human portrayal of Jesus's final week in Jerusalem, following the events from his triumphant arrival through the days leading to his crucifixion.

title: Fat
overview: A father obsessed with his own physique decides to force his overweight son to slim down, to the point of no return.

title: Gravy
overview: Shust and his friends commit small-time scams for a living, taking advantage of any opportunity that comes their way. Meeting Ulyanov, the former Soviet Union shot put champion, and his daughter opens Shust's eyes to a completely different way of living. But under his gang's pressure, he uses Ulyanov to plan a heist on a Buryat jade-trading commune.

title: Beautiful Pain
overview: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

title: Stream of Terror
overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

title: Good Time
overview: 'Good Time' follows Jaani, a young cab driver whose life is caught between love, gambling, and bad luck. As everything around him begins to fall apart, he keeps waiting for the one thing he believes will change his life: his Good Time.

title: Decluterring
overview: A college freshman becomes haunted by his childhood Muppets.

title: Друзья детства
overview: Dasha is flying to another country, but just before her departure, she stops by to say goodbye to her childhood friend Fedya, who is transforming an abandoned factory into escape rooms. While touring the deserted spaces, Dasha reminisces about her childhood and risks missing her flight.

title: Game Theory
overview: ​Trapped in a forbidden affair with his stepmother, a man under the growing influence of an AI companion enters a deadly game in a desperate attempt to earn his father's recognition.

title: Sandy
overview: When an Indian teen is inadvertently outed in school, he must face school gossip, his parents' reaction, and his own self-doubt to rebuild an identity on his own terms.

title: Extra Geography
overview: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood — friendship, boys, studies, and growing up — and embark on their school project, falling in love.

title: The Containment
overview: A girl is possessed by a dark and mysterious entity. She will fight with all the elements at her disposal to get rid of it. Neither her mother, nor traditional medicine, nor a supposed expert in exorcisms, will be able to make the demon disappear, until a nun gets involved in the case and sows a doubt more terrible than the possession itself.

title: All The Windows Are Closed
overview: In an isolated, dangerous town, an 11-year-old boy becomes desperate to keep his sister close when he learns she plans to escape their oppressive life, threatening the fragile bond that holds his world together.

title: Don't Come Upstairs
overview: They were taught one rule: never ask Dad what he does. Don’t Come Upstairs is a documentary that unravels the secret filmmaker Mike Lobel’s father Eric kept hidden—his decades-long role as a prominent drug distributor in Canada. Told through home videos and interviews with family members, this isn’t just about Eric’s double life—it’s about the impact his secrecy had on his family. Exploring generational trauma, the fallout of parental choices, and the hope that comes with facing hard truths in pursuit of healing and connection, Lobel's film builds to a final familial confrontation where one more truth is revealed.

title: Sunshine on the Road
overview: Unable to continue caring for their mother, who is suffering from dementia, a family embarks on one final trip together. During the journey, a long-buried family secret quietly surfaces, forever changing their understanding of one another.

title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

title: Bite Size Terror
overview: A bite-sized horror anthology where seemingly harmless encounters, desires, and decisions take terrifying turns.

title: It's a Good Thing Mom Doesn't Know
overview: On the eve of their mother's birthday, three find themselves, in one way or another, at the mercy of a powerful cartel and, unbenknownst to each other, begin working towards a common goal of taking them down. All the while, said mother, unaware of the bloody path her children are currently carving to ensure their family's safety, is busy making preparations for tommorow's celebration. That is, if the morning ever comes.

title: Harvested 4
overview: A small town legend returns from the dead to serve vengeance on Thanksgiving night.

title: Murder In Melbourne
overview: When Amarjeet Singh disappears after sending his wife Simran a cryptic message, Detective Shergil investigates. His search uncovers family secrets, illicit affairs, betrayal and a property dispute. When Amarjeet's body is found and Simran vanishes, the case turns darker. As suspects die and clues lead in different directions, Shergil must confront his past to catch the killer.

title: Landing Nowhere
overview: Two astronauts stranded on a deserted planet must decide between completing their mission - repopulating a new world artificially. Or preserve the planet's untouched beauty & let humanity fade away...

title: El último recreo
overview: Narciso Ibáñez Serrador's masterpiece, Who Can Kill a Child?, turns fifty this year. This documentary traces its origins, explores the locations where it was filmed, speaks with some of the children who appeared in the film for the very first time, and analyzes its importance in the history of horror filmmaking worldwide. A celebration of the legacy of a film that, five decades later, continues to have the same impact.

title: Glückspilze isst man nicht
overview: The eccentric scientist Frieda Hofstätter is on the verge of being cast aside. Then the Valkyrie Wolkentruth appears to take her to Valhalla. But Frieda refuses and strikes a deal: Wolkentruth must help her save Frieda’s CO2-storing miracle mushroom. Only then may she take Frieda with her. Together, they race against time—and perhaps for the future of the world.

title: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Final Stage
overview: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Final Stage is a special online event featuring a character show, cast talk, and live performance as we celebrate the finale of ZEZTZ’s journey.

title: Home from the Vietnam War
overview: Haunted by nightmares, a decorated U.S. veteran returns to Vietnam with a friend who fled the war as a child. Fifty-seven years later, they journey to one of the war's bloodiest battle sites, confronting the soldiers they once fought and long-buried memories in a powerful search for healing and reconciliation.

title: La muerte de Drácula
overview: Through a story that combines horror, humor and fantasy, the film starts with the disappearance of Bram Stoker's mythical vampire to discover what happens when one of history's greatest monsters ceases to exist and its legacy passes into the hands of a new generation.

title: Ana, en passant
overview: After her grandmother’s death, Ana finds herself adrift. Following the clues left by her late grandmother, Ana arrives in Belo Horizonte and meets Alice. As they make sense of the city’s layout and their memories, Ana and Alice will discover what it means to become who they are.

title: A Rose for Iris
overview: On the shores of England, a teenage girl witnesses her father's cruelty toward a migrant who has just arrived by small boat, forcing her to confront the complexities of both her father and the world around her.

title: Control Line
overview: A determined Black woman in her mid-30s navigates the emotional and physical challenges of conception, loss, and motherhood, all within the intimate confines of her bathroom.

title: Let me see her
overview: Marcelo wants to see her daughter to celebrate her birthday. The only problem is that he has a restraining order.

title: República dos Laranjas
overview: Remember the episode where Fábio Porchat revealed the connections between Flávio Bolsonaro, Daniel Vorcaro, and Banco Master? Well, he’s back.  And this time, the story is even more scandalous. What appeared to be a close-knit brotherhood was, in fact, a web of alleged partnerships, business dealings, and financial ties—involving far more people than we mentioned last time.  Money hidden in books, offshore accounts, private jets, mansions, suspected fraud targeting INSS (social security) pensioners, parties involving trafficked women, and even a Supreme Federal Court justice. In this episode, Fábio Porchat connects the dots of an elaborate network of "straw men"—a scheme involving Willer Tomaz, Daniel Vorcaro, and Kassio Nunes Marques, leading all the way to presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. On paper, no one seems to own anything. But who is really behind it all?  And what will become of these investigations if Flávio Bolsonaro reaches the presidency?

title: Big Phan
overview: For nearly 50 years, two unseen masters of their craft—Dave Raymond and Tom Burgoyne— have brought to life the Phillie Phanatic, a character they had to become if they were ever going to become themselves.

title: Sandal Jepit No. 10
overview: Akbar, a seemingly ordinary man, is taken into custody and interrogated regarding a serial murder case. From inside the room, he piece by piece reveals the timeline, underlying motives, and complex criminal plot through voice and narration alone.

title: Quir
overview: There is a store in Palermo unlike any other called Quir, a place of love defying any convention. The owners are Massimo and Gino, who have been together for forty-two years, perhaps the longest-lasting gay couple in Italy. Their small leather goods store has become an important meeting place of the local LGBTQI+ scene – here people chat about their love stories or seek advice – fighting for acceptance in Sicily, a stronghold of patriarchal culture.

title: Yale
overview: A troubled woman must confront her deadbeat father who abandoned her as a child as the last-ditch effort to find a donor kidney for her dying son.

title: Brussels, Here We Come
overview: On election day, two friends who have escaped from a psychiatric hospital hijack an airplane—believing they are filming a documentary—and inadvertently plunge Turkey into an unexpected state of chaos. As commentators in a television studio attempt to make sense of the situation during a live broadcast, what begins as a simple hijacking is quickly transformed into a political crisis. Meanwhile, following the elopement of a trans individual and a local youth, the neighborhood residents gather at a coffeehouse. Incited by fear, anger, and prejudice, the polarized community finds itself drawn into an internal reckoning. Moving between the airplane, the television studio, and the coffeehouse, the film explores how reality can be distorted within the span of a single day, and how an absurd event can escalate into a national panic.

title: Let This Stay Between Us
overview: After becoming involved with his student, a university professor is torn between desire and professional ethics. Determined to safeguard their secret relationship, he puts his personal and professional stability on the line.

title: The Craft
overview: Sauro Cantafame is “the techie”: he drives solo through a lunar southern landscape in his Ape Car, in a borderland between the real and the absurd. His mission? Implant mechanical hearts in deceased oldsters, so their families can pretend they’re still alive and cash their pension checks. He offers a ride to a fragile kid in danger, whose name says it all, as far as his prospects are concerned: Giocondo Infelice. But that gesture raises the hackles of Vito ‘a scimmia, the crime lord who has full control over the territory. Cantafame teaches the kid his strange trade in death, craft, and discontent; while Giocondo breaks out of his shell and finally finds the father he never had. But Cantafame has a few skeletons in his closet and a negative karma to fulfill, which will goad him to defy Vito in order to save his young charge.

title: Notary of Souls
overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

title: Bibliographie
overview: Janja Garnbret has nothing left to prove indoors—two Olympic golds, and more World Cup victories than any climber alive. So she heads to Céüse to attempt Bibliographie, one of the hardest routes on Earth, to discover just how far she can push herself. But when her summer project stretches into a grueling, multi-year odyssey, the woman who is used to winning is forced to confront her weaknesses like never before.

title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
overview: The feature-length documentary on the historic year of 1936 in Venezuela: the first year of Eleazar López Contreras's government, following the death of Juan Vicente Gómez and 27 years of dictatorship. A film that shows, like never before, a portrait of the Venezuelan people and of a changing society. 90 years later, this documentary—an unprecedented historical audiovisual record—recreates an image of the past that is unique in its kind for Venezuelan historiography.

title: Frankenstein Fragment
overview: Norbert Pfaffenbichler, master of the darkest avant-garde cinema, is also a veritable film archaeologist. No wonder, then, that his excavations of forgotten celluloid legacies unearthed a sensation: fragments of the very first film adaptation of Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, shot in Germany in 1922 and long believed to be lost, including test footage and outtakes. Pfaffenbichler and his team set about shaping this material of incredible historical value into a version that comes as close as possible to the original concept of its unknown filmmaker. Now, SLASH is unbelievably proud to present the resurrection of this lost film to the public for the very first time. (Markus Keuschnigg)

title: Bruno - Der junge Kreisky
overview: Bruno Kreisky – Chancellor, statesman, reformer, global politician. No other Austrian politician has been the subject of so much writing and debate. How does one become someone like him? How does one become someone who can meet people of all views and social classes on equal footing? How does he navigate his way through life, love, and his convictions?

title: Hotel Utopia
overview: In an abandoned hotel deep in the Bulgarian mountains, digital nomads search for a new home, investors are hoping for profit, and the last villager revels in days gone by – all driven by the longing for #happyland in a place shaped by a socialist past.

title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
overview: How far would you go to change a child the world can’t understand? One autistic artist survives a hidden system of abuse built to correct her.

title: We Chose to Go to the Moon
overview: The dramatic tale of America's race to space and the decision to land a man on the Moon in one of the most ambitious scientific and exploration achievements in history.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: Waves Turn
overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

title: Hasip and Nasip
overview: In a town named "Hasımlar", the mayoralty has alternated between Hasip and Nasip for years. But when their childhood sweetheart Perihan returns to town and a third candidate emerges, the established order between the two old friends is disrupted. Both Hasip and Nasip, wanting to win the mayoralty and Perihan's heart, throw the town into turmoil with their increasingly malicious election promises and traps.

title: Résonance
overview: Lily, a young actress, loses her grip on reality when she discovers that her neighbor looks exactly like her—feature for feature.

title: Nobody Loves Kay
overview: Kay, a high school gamer, loses his best friend to become a pro. After a setback, he rises again and meets his rival in the Mobile Legends world finals.

title: Codes
overview: When Maya loses the tiny switch that helps her navigate corporate life, she’s forced to face a high-stakes day at work without the tool she relies on to fit in.

title: Kings of the Beach
overview: A documentary about the epic rise (and subsequent fall) of beach volleyball, featuring many of the boldfaced names from Southern California who helped popularize it.

title: Sara
overview: Sara runs away from a party, overwhelmed by her father's pressure to be the "perfect daughter," and heads out to pursue her passion for photography, determined to do what she loves without fearing the consequences.

title: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal
overview: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.

title: Amore mio – Niemand ist wie Du
Seething Void
overview: An internet troll takes the culture’s nihilistic and ironic worldview to an extreme.

title: 58th
overview: Fifteen years after the Maguindanao Massacre, the family of its 58th victim fights for the justice that remains elusive.

title: Red Screen
overview: A young and ambitious female profiler is trying to interrogate a maniac about his last victim, who might still be alive. However, the serial killer remains unresponsive. The only way to make him talk is to expose him to an effective yet deadly development called "Red Screen." There's just one problem-the profiler has to be the first one to experience "Red Screen".

title: My Love For You Is Deep But the Devil Loves Me Deeper
overview: Alice, a young woman shattered by heartbreak after being dumped from her nebbish boyfriend Ryan, encounters the Devil and makes a deal for “all the love in the world.”

title: My Kind of Christmas
overview: When ambitious assistant Lindsay must track down the season’s most sought-after toy to land a long-awaited promotion, she teams up with handsome widowed dad Erik on the same quest for his daughter. But as their practical mission turns into a heartwarming holiday journey, she’s forced to choose between the career she’s always chased and the unexpected joy of love, family, and Christmas magic!

title: Tuvimos el deseo de romperlo todo
overview: During an impossible summer in Havana, Ava, a young trans artist, proposes that we film a fiction so she can kiss the boy she likes. We become accomplices to that impulse, using cinema as a refuge to rewrite our own story and escape from a reality in crisis.

title: A Good Hand Wasted
overview: A luxury island getaway turns deadly when six friends join a mysterious dealer's poker game, where every losing hand means a round of Russian roulette.

title: Spring
overview: A young couple's peaceful getaway to a remote hilltop bungalow takes a terrifying turn as mysterious events unfold. As hidden secrets emerge, their seemingly perfect life is threatened by fear and suspense.

title: Our Son
overview: Two childless married couples raise an unexpected son from an illicit affair between the two households. Amidst the chaos that follows a paternity reveal, the two wives take parenting into their own hands.

title: Love and Faith – Chica Xavier
overview: Chica Xavier’s life was shaped by love, axé, the performing arts, and education. Directed by her youngest son, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of the great Bahian actress, a daughter of Oyá whose life transformed countless others, both on and off screen, leaving behind a legacy of love.

title: Thenmavin Kombath
