overview: Sreekrishnan unknowingly falls in love with the woman his best friend, Manikyan, loves. Though Sreekrishnan tries his best to woo her, she resists, leading to a battle that ensues between the friends.

title: 109 Billion Followers
overview: A lonely film student documents a man who believes that he’s the Grim Reaper, as he leads her on a magical journey to meet herself as a teen, as a young girl, and as an infant, to recover her ability to love – while she still can.

title: Doosra
overview: The 2002 NatWest Final was more than a cricketing victory for India. It was a moment when a nation found its voice, and a young girl found the courage to speak her truth.

title: Jhaad Phoonk
overview: Jhaad Phoonk is a horror-drama directed by Rajan Ramgopal Verma. The movie features Padmini Kolhapure, Sumbul Touqeer, Yashpal Sharma, and Harsh Rajput in pivotal roles.

title: Where the River Begins
overview: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

title: Tua Tua Keladi
overview: The quiet lives of elderly residents in a small fishing village are turned upside down when the Health Department announces that exposure to the chemical P172 triggers a dramatic surge in libido. Amid the panic and awkwardness, the villagers must navigate their suddenly chaotic relationships, reawakened by newfound passion.

title: A Dessert for Constance
overview: Bokolo and Mamadou, sweepers in the city of Paris, are looking for a way to pay for the return home of one of their sick comrades. When they find an old book of recipes in the trash, they discover a passion for French cuisine and decide to participate in a televised cooking competition.

title: Children Untold
overview: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

title: True Religion
overview: After visiting her deceased son's grave, Lee is visited by a strange Nun who seems to know more than she lets on about her son's passing.

title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

title: Finding Faith
overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith Tour via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

title: On the Heights
overview: After a suicide in the family, mother Hae-sook and daughter Yoon-seul withdraw into separate silences, each carrying grief in her own way. When Yoon-seul returns home after a long absence, the distance between them becomes impossible to ignore. They share the same space yet remain estranged, bound by what neither can fully name. Hae-sook attempts to endure the loss through restless, self-destructive impulses, while Yoon-seul retreats into emotional numbness. As traces of the past surface in their daily lives, they are confronted with the fragile thread that still connects them. An unforeseen incident disrupts the stillness of their days.

title: Complications
overview: No longer working for the CIA, Dietrich is now a ruthless mercenary on a mission to execute a high value target. But all is not what it seems, and before long the mission becomes a lot more complicated than Dietrich could have imagined.

title: Brianza
overview: Set against the backdrop of the 2009 economic crisis, Brianza follows Giorgio Farina, the heir to a historic gun shop who faces ruin after a failed luxury investment in Switzerland. Desperate to save his social standing, he enters into a dangerous partnership with eccentric businessman Alberto Fumagalli. What begins as an illicit scheme quickly plunges Giorgio into a downward spiral of debt, crime, and peril, threatening his family, his reputation, and his life.

title: È un mondo difficile
overview: Elena and Francesco are bound by a love full of ups and downs, a visceral bond that spans the years, the distances, and diverging life choices. As their paths seem to drift apart, something keeps pulling them back to each other. He finds a new balance with Marta, while she becomes involved with Arthur, who offers her stability and a marriage proposal. But with her wedding just around the corner, the only choice left is the one they’ve never had the courage to make.

title: Humboldt
overview: Humboldt Parkway was a beloved feature of Buffalo. In the 1960s it was bulldozed to make way for an expressway that has caused a great health hazard for people living around it. The expressway has exceeded its life expectancy. Now the people of Buffalo have the opportunity to restore this glorious masterpiece of the Olmsted-designed Parkways system.

title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.

title: Cunning Folk
overview: A father brings home an unusual dagger, intending to end the suffering of his gravely ill son.

title: Unknown Author
overview: A Brazilian filmmaker in Berlin re-enacts past sexual abuse in different versions to process the trauma.

title: The Whisper of Sunlight
overview: Set in Hong Kong, Wong closely observes patients and their families during their final days as they grapple with the difficult questions surrounding access to a costly experimental drug that may offer them a last hope. The film sensitively explores the vulnerability and uncertainty that accompany rare and devastating illnesses.

title: Proposal
overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

title: The Proud Princess
overview: Time has come for young and handsome King Benjamin to find a wife. When presented the portrait of beautiful princess Carolina, he is so enchanted that in return he sends his portrait to her, but spoiled and proud princess Carolina selfishly rejects him. King Benjamin decides to win her over and, disguised as a gardener, manages to work at her castle,” reads a synopsis provided by All Rights. He finds out that the princess was once happy and kind, and with the help of music and flowers, she falls for him. When her counselors, eager to remain in power, found her a weak prince to marry, Carolina and Benjamin hastily flee together. The many obstacles they face in their escape will bring them closer. However, Benjamin will still have to reveal the truth, but love and happiness will prevail.

title: Eine florentinische Tragödie / Herzog Blaubarts Burg - Wiener Staatsoper
overview: The two short operas Eine Florentinische Tragödie and Herzog Blaubarts Burg are linked by a central theme: the progressive recognition of the only seemingly familiar counterpart.  In Zemlinsky's Eine Florentinische Tragödie, the murder of Bianca's lover by her jealous husband Simone leads to a dialog between the two spouses that surprisingly signals a new beginning of love. In Bartók's one-act opera, however, Judith's journey to the inner depths of her beloved Duke Bluebeard - symbolized by the opening of seven mysterious doors - ends in darkness and loneliness.

title: Quiet Life
overview: A refugee family in Sweden faces trauma after their youngest daughter falls into an unexplained coma when denied asylum. Parents struggle to find a cure, resilience tested amid difficult circumstances.

title: The Crystal Planet
overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.

title: Occupied
overview: A club toilet becomes the stage for queer encounters, connection, and community.

title: Tin Castle
overview: Along a long-forgotten road, the O’Reillys live in a rundown trailer stranded in the middle of the fields. Pa’, Lisa, and their ten children weather the seasons in their tin castle, heirs to a way of life on borrowed time. Under threat of eviction, their tenuous balance falters, yet – steadfast in their tradition – they resist. The children laugh, the dogs bark, the trailer holds on – but for how long?

title: Nomad Shadow
overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

title: Seduced by an Amish Stranger
overview: A handsome young man arrives in an Amish community claiming to be homeless. He's taken in and treated with particular kindness by a widowed mother, but she soon discovers he isn't who he claims to be.

title: Frank and Percy
overview: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

title: Crackula
overview: In Moss Side a white vampire offers a black ex-addict immortality. A story about privilege, hunger, and the high cost of power in today’s world.

title: The Harvester
overview: Álava, late 19th century. As the Third Carlist War rages, several women are found strangled to death on the outskirts of Vitoria.

title: How to Survive the Summer Holidays
overview: At a Kashubian campsite, surrounded by a lake and a forest, where families, couples, and singles come searching for a holiday break, new relationships form and conflicts escalate. Some fall in love, whilst others begin to resent each other. While the adults struggle to communicate, the children, left to their own devices, construct a world of their own, fuelled by Kashubian legends and scary stories. When, one morning, holidaymakers discover punctured tyres on their cars, the atmosphere thickens and mutual animosities come to the fore.

title: Do It Live
overview: A newscaster has a mental breakdown behind the scenes.

title: In Winter
overview: Gabit, a physics teacher and father of five, is struggling to make ends meet when he happens upon a bag containing a large sum of cash buried in the snow-covered field outside his apartment building. Suddenly his life becomes comfortable, with him repaying bank loans and treating his family to expensive meals and gifts. But anxiety over where the money came from soon begins to weigh on him.

title: Christmas at the Zoo
overview: An entrepreneur brokering a sponsorship to build the city zoo's new penguin habitat finds herself caught between business and romance after falling for a compassionate zookeeper over the holidays.

title: Linka Linka
overview: Samgyi returns to Lhasa to shoot a film about her childhood. Struggling with creative uncertainty, she finds herself in an endless cycle of arguments with her father. At a chance party, she meets Lhamo, the girl who inspired the character in her story. As the night quietly slips away, the summer that once lingered in fragments of memory gradually comes into full view...

title: Little Thomas
overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

title: Nature
overview: Eight longtime friends head deep into the wilderness for an annual camping trip, hoping for a weekend away from the pressures of everyday life. But when a masked stranger emerges from the woods and brutally murders one of them, their getaway becomes a fight for survival. Trapped and surrounded by a mysterious group known as The Eyes, the remaining campers are given an impossible choice: identify a supposed traitor among them...or sacrifice one of their own each night. With no way out and trust becoming a liability, the group must decide how far they are willing to go to survive.

title: Odd Man In
overview: Explores the complex double life of Donald Webster Cory, a mysterious writer who helped ignite the early gay rights movement—and then betrayed it.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Watermelon
overview: "Sun" sets out to visit "Phlu", who lives in an old apartment building in the middle of the city. When he arrives, he discovers that the building has no running water. He has no choice but to track down six tenants to collect their signatures, as required by the landlord, before the water supply can be restored.  Along the way, "Sun"learns about the struggles of each tenant, all of whom are fighting to get by in a system that keeps pushing them down. As their stories unfold, he begins to see how people are forced to compromise their dignity and moral values just to survive.

title: Lesbian Lines
overview: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

title: An Ordinary Sunday
overview: After a night at a bar in the far south of São Paulo, three friends wake up hungover and realize that the fourth never came back. Amid unanswered messages and an attempt to carry on with their Sunday, the wait teeters between the tragic and the comic.

title: The Flight
overview: On January 8, 2020, Flight PS752 was struck by two surface-to-air missiles, killing everyone on board. Director Soran Mardookhi’s feature documentary The Flight follows the lives of family members left behind as they relentlessly pursue truth, justice and accountability for their loved ones.

title: Mr. Bhaarath
overview: Two siblings share a unique bond where, according to their zodiac signs, any good fortune experienced by one is believed to be reflected in the other's life. Believing in this connection, they decide to get married at the same time. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when one sibling's childish behavior creates a series of complications, leading to emotional and family conflicts that put both weddings at risk.

title: The River Train
overview: Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote Argentinian village where he studies the Malambo, a folk dance full of bravura. He is an excellent dancer, but Milo’s only desire is to escape the countryside on a train for the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

title: Never Crossed the Mind
overview: In the heart of Luxor, Younes embarks on a romantic and comedic adventure when he becomes in charge of a multinational tourist group. While he tries to communicate with them in four different languages, he falls in love with a girl in the middle of ancient temples, and encounters funny situations that prove that the language of the heart is the truest, no matter how different the tongues are.

title: Comeback Dad
overview: An out-of-shape comedian and his 17-year-old son set off on a last-minute road trip. Unable to see eye to eye, these two polar opposites of masculinity clash inside a cramped car. Amidst conflicts and emotions, they discover they need to view the world from each other's perspective to finally understand one another.

title: Dialing Death
overview: Three mischievous teenagers pull what they think will be a harmless prank - a late-night phone call to a random number, pretending they know dark secrets about the man on the other end. What they don't realize is that they've just called a notorious serial killer who's been lying low, and now he believes they actually know something that could expose him.

title: All American Girls
overview: Directed by Conduit Films' founder Christy Wegener, All American Girls features a sit-down with Pleasant Rowland, as well as never-before-seen footage and insights from the American Girl brand's authors, insiders, enthusiasts and journalists. Stop-motion graphics aid the filmmakers as they venture behind the curtain of the brand, which shaped the lives of generations of Americans in the ’80s, ’90s and early 2000s, and maintains cultural relevance today.

title: Chi l'ha visto?
overview: Chi l’ha visto? looks back at the last five years of the life of physicist Ettore Majorana, up to the day in 1938 when, at the age of 32, he boarded a boat from Naples and disappeared forever.

title: The Outside
overview: In the near future, astronaut Ana lives at a space training base in the middle of an arid and desolate landscape on Earth. She is undergoing a long isolation drill to prepare for a possible mission to Mars. At the same time, Ana is receiving treatment to prepare her body for pregnancy in zero gravity.

title: Doitscha – Alles geht vorüber
overview: A German-Jewish mother from Cologne tries to navigate her intercultural family through everyday problems as well as anti-Semitic hostility in German society.

title: The Child
overview: Thirty-seven-year-old Zane and Kaspars seem to have it all – love, careers, a home, and shared hobbies. Still, for a decade, they have been unable to have a child. After trying fertility clinics, diets, churches, and healers, Kaspars is slowly coming to terms with the idea that life can be fulfilling even without children. Meanwhile, Zane cannot accept the thought of not becoming a mother and is ready to go to any lengths to make it happen.

title: Circle the Block
overview: A man confronts his one-night stand after catching him in a white lie. Hookup culture's day of reckoning has come to pass.

title: Zombie Dogs!
overview: Argumentative friends make a final pit stop on the eve of a city-wide apocalypse.

title: The Caregiver
overview: Valea leaves for Italy to earn money for an apartment, but Valera loses the family's savings. Desperate to hide the truth, he heads to Italy and gets caught up with Italian mobsters, precious stones, and total chaos.

title: The Malthus Law
overview: In an attempt to address overpopulation, TV host Olivia is selected by an AI that compels people to defend their right to life, leading to conflicts over the value and malleability of life between her and the other selected individuals.

title: A. Rimbaud
overview: Follows French writer Arthur Rimbaud from his schoolboy days in Charleville to his final years in Africa.

title: About Space and Depth
overview: An intimate and ongoing dialogue between filmmaker Paula Gaitán and Ken Jacobs.  Filmed over the last decade in New York, the documentary reveals Jacobs' thinking and presents previously unseen footage of Ken and his partner in life and art, Flo Jacobs.

title: Mary Anning
overview: England, 19th century. 12-year-old Mary is passionate about the fossils that she collects and sells with her father. When he accidentally dies near the fossil cliffs, Mary, her brother and her mother struggle to make the payments for the family house, meaning they will probably have to leave the seaside that Maëlys loves so much. But her father left a mysterious message: what was it that he saw on the cliffs before he died? With some help from her friends, Mary will fight to save her home and continue to do what she loves, searching for fossils, in the midst of a society where girls should not ​“behave like men”. Mary doesn’t know it yet, but she’s going to go down in history…

title: The Demon Among Us
overview: "The Demon Among Us" is inspired by the 1980s film "The Other Hell." The production features special effects by David Bracci and music by Pino Donaggio.

title: Conjurig
overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

title: Двойник
overview: The 1980s, New Year's Eve. In a quiet Soviet town, a local police officer finds himself at the center of unsettling and inexplicable events. As he investigates, he is drawn ever deeper into a world where the line between reality and delusion blurs.

title: Affirmation
overview: When Xavier meets Sebastien at a local cafe, he doesn't know how his first date after bottom surgery will go. As sparks fly in the cafe, Xavier decides to take his date to an unexpected location, where they share in a magical connection. Affirmation is the first film to feature a trans man with lower dysphoria who has had access to gender-affirming care.

title: On Happiness Road
overview: Chi earned her American dream after persevering with her studies in Taiwan. Following her grandmothers’ death, Chi returns to her family on Happiness Road, where she begins to feel nostalgic about her childhood and starts to contemplate the meaning of “life” and “home”. What is happiness? Will Chi find her own happiness?

title: The Beauty of Errors
overview: A portrait of a relationship between three generations and how it shifts between the search for closeness, understanding and acceptance, as the teenage son steps closer to adulthood. The film continues to follow the lives of Tero and his son Henri, both previously featured in Kärkkäinen’s documentary The Living Room of a Nation.

title: All About the Money
overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

title: Ethical Witchery
overview: Witches, Dahlia and Ivy, have been performing the same ritual for over five centuries. To spice things up, Ivy invites baby witch, Oleander, to join them, but Dahlia is not sure she's ready to change her routine.

title: Kikuyu Land
overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

title: We Are Born Good
overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

title: How Hard Can It Be?
overview: Mallory, an ambitious New York reporter, is assigned to a story on the Best Small Town in America, sending her to Alabama. Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.

title: Достопримечательность
overview: A vigilant station security guard attempts to thwart the theft of Bulgar coins, only to find her greatest ally in the fight for justice to be a massive wall mosaic depicting the revolutionary leader Vladimir Lenin.

title: Bird of Paradise
overview: Eagerly wanting to have a last bloom of her youth, Mama Yeung conceals her stubborn husband and rebellious son, and steps into the new splendid world of pole dance. Yet, this secret has been accidentally revealed, putting her into a dilemma between fulfilling her family’s needs and pursuing her dream…

title: Conceivable
overview: When faced with an unexpected pregnancy, a couple in midlife must navigate their beliefs, relationships, and the support of their community. A compelling story that explores the complexities of family, faith, and the choices that define us.

title: Crowyokan
overview: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

title: Non importa dove - La numerosa vita di Morgan
Dendam Arwah Penari
overview: The bankruptcy of Mr. Kusuma’s business forced Harum and her family to move into an old family home. There, Harum discovered a mysterious shawl that turned out to harbor the grudge of a dancer from the past. Since then, a series of terrifying and strange events has begun to haunt Harum and her family. To put an end to this deadly terror, Harum must uncover the mystery behind the dancer’s unjust death.

title: Kashpirovsky. Under the Spell
overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.

title: Alpha Alice
overview: Alice cannot find an apartment in Munich for her psychology studies. Out of desperation, she accepts the offer of a man who wants to be treated as a slave by his roommate. In her private life, Alice is rather shy, but in her new role she learns to take control, not only over her roommate Olaf, but also over her own life. An unusual friendship develops between Alice and Olaf, giving them both the sense of security they have been looking for.

title: Farewell, Rivers
overview: The last inhabitants of a mountain village resist a time that transforms the ways of life in the region. Eladio, the ranger, witnesses the fate of a community where humans disappear and animals remain. While a bear wanders through the valley, invisible threads are weaven that plot stories of care, loss and resistance.

title: MORELIFE
overview: A young man's plan to jump into an icy river at night is interrupted by a half-man half-fish there for the same reason. These two strike a bargain to find a rare Morel mushroom hoping it will provide something worth living for.

title: Las grullas
overview: Dr. Patricia Torres, a neonatologist, reflects on the experiences that have shaped her career at the hospital. For years, she has cared for premature babies whose lives begin in fragile circumstances. Inspired by a Japanese legend about a thousand paper cranes, she discovered a new way to understand neonatal care and the complex reality faced by families.

title: Viana – The Legend of the Golden Hearts
overview: In the north of medieval Portugal, the beautiful Ana falls in love with Thomas, a poor artisan. Her father immediately forbids their union, demanding that his daughter’s suitors produce a jewel as proof of their nobility. But the young couple refuse to give up. With the help of their faithful companions, the generosity of the townswomen and the talent of a mysterious jewellery maker, Ana and Thomas will face many challenges out of love, including the powerful and evil Duke of Aragon.

title: Zwei Minuten
overview: Following routine, Mai has prepared breakfast, made coffee and packed school lunches. While her mother can’t get out of bed, Mai tries to make sure her little sister Louisa has a perfectly normal morning. But the two need get to school, and time is running short once again. Under mounting pressure, Mai is unable to play the adult today. For the first time, it’s up to Louisa to step into that role. Feeling betrayed and abandoned by her big sister, Louisa bravely takes on the new challenge – even as the sisters’ otherwise strong bond threatens to cracken.

title: Dunes Only Know
overview: On a desolate beach, a nudist looks for a cruising encounter in the dunes. A surveillance drone interrupts the ritual and naked chaos turns into an absurd act of salvation.

title: Forever Mom
overview: Leonora is an overwhelmed mother of two young girls and an architect whose career has been put on hold. While her husband works all day, she carries the weight of raising their children and the quiet feeling that she has lost herself somewhere along the way. One afternoon, in the middle of her daughter?s birthday party, she drives away, leaving behind the noise and contradictions of motherhood.

title: Garuda: Dare to Dream
overview: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

title: De Club van Sinterklaas film: Paniek in het Pietendorp
Between Lands
overview: A long time ago, Ana Laura, Gustavo, and Jesús crossed the border in search of a better opportunity. They worked hard, built a family, and made a life in the United States. Day by day, years after their arbitrary deportations to Mexico, they deal with the grief of being separated from their families. As time goes by, the shattered existence of everyone is slowly and inevitably rebuilt, far away and apart from each other.

title: Non-Migrants
overview: In a small Bulgarian town a young man faces a crisis when his girlfriend plans to emigrate abroad. Angered, he breaks into the abandoned local factory and starts working without any specific purpose, ideology, or political agenda. But this unusual form of “protest” attracts media attention and may unexpectedly restore lost faith and friendships.

title: Transferatu
overview: Viktor and his young female companion Luna have been living in Berlin for over 100 years. They are junkies, kept going by drugs, blood, and art. They have no fixed sexual orientation, living without sexual intercourse. Young male drug dealers are their primary victims, who end up dying as they orgasm. Klaus is their manager and chauffeur, constantly at their beck and call. He utilizes the dead bodies, selling them for transplant purposes. He loves old American films about exploitation, personally embodying their characters. When Vlad, Viktor’s father, disinherits his son due to his drug addiction, their excesses escalate. Viktor becomes captivated by Mandy, a trans woman. Luna joins them, and in a sensual frenzy, they merge with Mandy until dawn breaks.

title: Up Again
overview: A triple jump on ice skates lasts just a few seconds, but requires years of physical training and mental isolation. This time-lapse portrait of Barbora Vránková, three-time Czech figure skating champion, captures a pivotal period in her life between the ages of fifteen and eighteen. Her days are filled with online lessons, physiotherapy sessions and, above all, a rigorous training routine. The camera, synchronised with the protagonist’s movements, takes us straight onto the ice, where the screech of blades and the thumping of pop hits blend with the shouts of her coaches. Without any contrived pathos, the film follows how, fall after fall, the young athlete works her way towards precision on the ice and autonomy off it.

title: The World Facing Us: ICE, the Manhunt
overview: ICE: three letters long unfamiliar to the general public. Established in 2003 in response to the 9/11 attacks, this federal agency—part of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)—is responsible for enforcing immigration and customs laws.

title: STYMIE
overview: A documentary based on the word 'stymie'.

title: Le Grand Bêtisier - 50 Ans de Rire
Papagayo
overview: A month after the Hamas attack and Israel's bloody retaliation, which marks the beginning of the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, an Israeli illustrator living in Spain breaks up with her long-term partner, a Spanish filmmaker of Syrian origin. Omar decides to continue working on the film they had been making together, using footage shot in the Middle East and the unfinished drawings left behind by his beloved. A story about religious fanaticism and its absurdities, and a painful dissection of the relationship between two people who wanted to be together despite their cultural differences.

title: The Echo of Whales
overview: Eight-year-old Yu-xin lives a colorful yet lonely life by the sea. Convinced her hiccups are a whale's gulps for air, she sends out calls for companions. Through a school vent, she finds one—a silent girl. They share adventures until Yu-xin realizes her friend is hiding something.

title: Disney Off the Page Adventures: The night before the royal fitting
Magical Secret Tour
overview: A mother of two who suddenly learns of her husband’s embezzlement and crushing debts; a researcher buried in debt; and an unmarried, pregnant woman with no savings. Three women who seem to have nothing to do with crime cross paths by chance and, through gold smuggling, form an unexpected bond as partners in crime. As they seize money and freedom, a revenge game begins—one that allows each of them to reclaim and rebuild their lives. The sight of women who have long gone with the flow of life, choosing to take their fate into their own hands even if it means crossing the line into crime, shines with a dazzling intensity.

title: A Month In Minnesota
overview: When a federal ICE invasion brought chaos and death to their streets and neighborhoods, an unlikely network of grassroots organizers, local business owners, students, and caregivers stepped forward to act. From a nurse midwife visiting pregnant women who were afraid to leave their homes, to a songleader helping people raise their voices in unified protest, the film showcases a diverse coalition who stood up for their community.

title: First Five
overview: An unprecedented, intimate look at the five young men who served as Coach Bob Knight's very first recruiting class for the Indiana University basketball team from 1971 to 1975.

title: Adam Conover: Big Divorce Energy
overview: In his hilariously raw and unexpectedly vulnerable special Big Divorce Energy, Adam Conover talks sex and self-discovery, dating after divorce and why straight men are the most repressed people in America.

title: LOOT: A Story of Crime and Redemption
overview: A daring look at the underbelly of the global art market, LOOT exposes the criminal network that used child soldiers to violently raid Cambodian temples then delivered blood antiquities to the homes of billionaires and elite western museums.

title: People Watching
overview: When a restless young woman starts fixating on a mysterious car parked outside of her apartment, the night takes a dangerous turn.

title: Tutto l'universo
overview: Marta has spent her life caring for her elderly mother. For years, she has used the excuse that she cannot leave her mother alone to hide from life itself, putting her own dreams and desires aside. Now, she is determined to do whatever it takes to make up for lost time.

title: Journey There
overview: Chun-hee is left alone in the world after the sudden death of her husband. Faced with her own illness, she puts her life in order, but she intends to keep the appointment she made with her husband for an assisted suicide.

title: Pikkuli and Starlight Reindeer
overview: When the adults of Sunny Moor Forest begin arguing, the magical star atop the Christmas tree flickers and dies, leading them to cancel Christmas. Young Pikkuli and his friends embark on a daring adventure to find the mythical Starlight Reindeer. Along their journey, they face challenges, meet magical creatures, and discover that the true magic of Christmas lies not in the star but in their love and unity.

title: December
overview: Amid December’s festive glow, refugees remain hidden in forests along the Poland-Belarus border. This powerful documentary gives voice to their silent cries.

title: Udumbanchola Vision
overview: When album designer Midhun takes over a struggling local TV channel, he uncovers a deadly rivalry behind its downfall. Using secrets and manipulation, he rises to power, but his ambition quickly turns to greed. Just as he dominates the industry, a dangerous international threat emerges.

title: DarkGame
overview: A determined detective is in a race against time to stop a twisted game show on the dark web, where captives are forced to compete for their lives.

title: Drunken Noodles
overview: Over two summers, between city streets and forest paths, young art student Adnan has a series of unexpected intimate encounters.

title: Beyond Appearances, Our Persistence
overview: Through the streets, churches, and memories of Ouro Preto, Brazil, this documentary explores the roots that shape the country's history and the voices that have resisted being erased. It revisits a past marked by slavery, faith, spirituality, and the resilience of people whose contributions have too often gone unrecognized.  Through discovery and reflection, the film explores a history that lives on in Brazilian culture, art, and traditions, inviting us to look beyond monuments and established narratives. To understand our roots is also to recognize those who, despite attempts to silence them, remain present in who we are.

title: Thank You for Your Review
overview: A people-pleasing waiter sabotages his own evening trying to impress his boss; a self-conscious friend competes for attention at someone else’s birthday dinner; and two sisters turn a simple meal into a battlefield. Through quiet frustrations and misplaced priorities, the night unravels into an elegant mess of misunderstandings. No wonder this restaurant’s online reviews are so confusing.

title: Wisdom of Happiness
overview: A deeply intimate and highly cinematic documentary featuring the Dalai Lama, who, at nearly ninety year of age, offers practical advice for navigating the 21st century's challenges.

title: When The Sun Burns Out
overview: Julia finds comfort in her high school teacher after losing her cat. This event triggers obsessions and fantasies that unsettle her for the first time. As the line between dreams and reality blurs, Julia must accept her pain to begin healing.

title: The Lost Plot
overview: Artur is a stand-up comedian who plans to turn his life around and write a book about the story of a female guerrilla fighter from the 1970s. He gets mugged and his computer containing his drafts is stolen, but an app takes photos of the people using the stolen computer and emails them to him.

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
overview: After his fiancée's death, an emotionally unstable man is approached by a mysterious man who offers him a second chance to bring back what was lost at a deadly cost.

title: Women as Lovers
overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

title: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm
Tills stjärnorna faller ner
overview: Sylvia and Marek are getting married. It's a scorching summer day and the entire family is gathered. But when the drink starts flowing and the dancing begins love is put to the test, loyalties are questioned and secrets are revealed.

title: In Transit
overview: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

title: Sukma
overview: Arini and her family went to a small town to start a new life, but it turns into a disaster after they find an ancient mirror in a secret warehouse.

title: Rodrigue in Love
overview: A struggling actor, Stéphane arrives with his troupe at the Avignon Festival to perform a boulevard play. There, he meets Fanny, a renowned actress, and falls under her spell. Taking advantage of a misunderstanding to get closer to her, Stéphane sinks into a lie that he will have to keep going for the duration of the festival... but which will quickly overwhelm him!

title: Спарта 2. Гоплиты
overview: Six years after winning the Sparta tournament, Nikolai Kudryashov gets the right to assemble a team to participate in the brutal TTC International Team Championship. To win, Nikolai needs the best, and he makes a risky decision: to invite two former rivals to the team - Andrey Filatov and Viktor Smolyar, whom he once defeated. Now the former enemies will have to unite and fight with elite teams from the USA, Germany, France and other countries. At stake is not only the champion's title, but also the honor of the country.

title: A Place to Heal
overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

title: The King of Time
overview: An overworked man goes to cabin in the woods hoping to fall into a time loop.

title: In-I In Motion
overview: In 2007, Juliette Binoche and Akram Khan took a break and co-created In-I, an original performance that toured the world. Today, Juliette Binoche revisits that exhilarating journey. Through unfamiliar images, she reflects on creation, its challenges, and the personal transformation it brings as a filmmaker.

title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
overview: Jeanie, who is homeless, works from her car in a dubious network marketing job. When she is invited to her old school friends' bachelorette party, she senses an opportunity to sell them her products. But she has underestimated how much she wants to finally be part of the group again.

title: Yugo Goes to America
overview: Three young friends from Belgrade drive from New York to Los Angeles in a Yugo – a cult relic of a car from the 1980s. A docu-comedy and a road trip with many unexpected encounters.

title: One Night in June
overview: One Night In June is a dark drama that introduces Lydia and John, as they face a crossroads in their relationship. Through lies, betrayal and vengeful rage they both commit acts they cannot un-do. John is left with an ultimatum that will change his and Lydia's life forever. This gripping short film confronts the nature of the human experience. Our mistakes, our choices, how they impact the ones we love, and the extreme consequences we face.

title: The Bryce Lee Story
overview: When thirteen-year-old Bryce Lee claims to be related to martial arts legend Bruce Lee to gain respect at school, the falsehood threatens to unravel his identity, his friendships, and his self-worth.

title: Matīss Kaža. The Impossible Self-Portrait
overview: The film follows Matīss Kaža during a period when his professional life has taken him from one country and continent to another. Together with Gints Zilbalodis, the director of the film Flow (Straume), he spent nearly a year caught in a whirlwind of international award ceremonies, events, and meetings—a journey that included the film’s path to the Academy Awards. Yet, this is only one facet of Kaža’s life and work. During the same period, he made his debut as a theatre director at three different venues in Riga and crafted the Lielais Kristaps (Latvian National Film Awards) and Spēlmaņu nakts (Latvian Theatre Awards) ceremonies as multimedia performances. The camera follows Kaža as he constantly creates, travels, and engages in new projects, all while maintaining an ironic perspective on both himself and the world around him.

title: Wayward: How Women Changed Snowboarding
overview: Wayward is a feature documentary about the women who changed snowboarding by refusing to follow the status quo. Spanning 4 decades of progression, the film weaves together rare archival footage and firsthand accounts from pioneering athletes who fought for visibility, opportunity, and respect in a male-dominated industry. As the sport has evolved and new generations push boundaries further than ever before, Wayward examines what it took to get here, and what still lies ahead. This is a story of resilience, rebellion, and the power of those who shaped a sport & a culture into what it is today.

title: The Squatters and the Fairy Princess
overview: On her 10th birthday, a self-identified Fairy Princess recounts her previous birthdays that have all taken place in a house amongst eccentric squatters.

title: Stay Good
overview: After causing a horrific accident, a young college student attempts to become a better person.

title: Macumbaria
overview: The mystical element plays an unusual role in the civilizing process of Brazilian society. Realms such as samba, malandragem, soccer, and Carnival reflect this process, which unfolded in the shadow of the Precarious. On the street, in the terreiro, at the bar, in the favela, at the crossroads, or on the floodplain—a multifaceted historical and cultural identity was forged, resulting from the intersection of Amerindian and African spiritualities and European popular Catholicism. Macumbaria explores the phenomenon of the “macumba complex” through the lens of historian Luiz Antonio Simas, the film’s narrator.

title: Winter Talk
overview: December 24. Hundreds of lorries are stranded at a port on the English Channel. Abbas, a veteran lorry driver, meets Pawel, a young Polish driver. Despite the language barrier, the two men are forced to spend Christmas Eve together.

title: Night of the Screaming Terror
overview: Night Of The Screaming Terror follows Dr Redfern as he visits St Peters mental asylum for the criminally insane. Inside he meets the eccentric Dr Mountford and his group of special patients. Each one with a bizarre and terrifying reason for their eternal detainment in the dark corridors of the asylum.

title: GANGSTALKER!
overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

title: Breezeblock
overview: In the heart of the forest, a man is building a concrete wall to protect himself from a fly that is swooping down towards him.

title: The Hinterlands of Our Memories
overview: A road movie traveling from Rio de Janeiro to the "sertão" (backlands) of Bahia. With the help of three survivors, the film revisits a 1971 massacre that took place under the military dictatorship. The attack claimed the lives of Captain Carlos Lamarca—the regime's public enemy number one—and José Campos Barreto ("Zequinha"), a community leader and former organizer of one of the few workers' strikes following the military coup. After years of fear and oblivion, the towns where the tragedy occurred now honor both men.

title: Teen Spirits
overview: In a deserted high school, a group of teenagers gathers for a mysterious choral ritual.

title: Lionheart
overview: Having grown up in the suburbs of Copenhagen, Luan knows the underworld and its rules better than any other life. That’s where he's belonged all his life. Now he wants to get out. The idea is simple. The reality is anything but. Old ties are not severed by a single decision. Issa has been by Luan's side since childhood, almost like a brother in a world where loyalty matters more than blood. A new beginning is not like putting on a clean shirt. You can change your address, your clothes and the company you keep, but the old rules remain. The body remembers how to stand. The eyes know who to trust.

title: Water Wears Away
overview: Time and water slowly wear away the stone of Kateryna’s faith in the future. Living as an emigrant in Prague, she returns to memories of a place where she felt at home: the years spent with her Ukrainian friends at the Sea of Azov. But the full-scale invasion of Ukraine continues to wash away everything she holds dear. Her hometown, Zaporizhzhia, lies close to the frontline, the family house by the sea of Azov is occupied, and the friends she grew up with have dispersed. These memories remain alive through hours of recordings from Kateryna’s personal video archive. Now, together with her friends in Prague, she tries to make sense of the unbearable weight of grief and loss one has to carry in the present. As she revisits her past, she also questions what to expect from the future, and how to keep the growing societal polarisation from occupying the space of friendship.

title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

title: How To Hide It
overview: A moment of weakness after a humiliating breakup leads Zahra, a young Muslim woman to play a forbidden lottery ticket. Her chance at escape becomes a spiritual crisis. While her coworker dreams of riches, she’s certain Allah is watching and waiting.

title: 7 Miles Out
overview: After her father's suicide in 1977, 11-year-old Ann struggles with grief, alcoholism, and promiscuity. Exploring her sexuality and self-destruction, she finds solace in art, overcomes family secrets, and achieves acclaim as a filmmaker.

title: Una Mujer Acompañada
overview: On the first wedding anniversary following her husband's death, Victoria hires an man to recreate a celebration just like the ones they used to have. Amidst memories, rituals, and a presence impossible to replace, the fantasy begins to unravel.

title: Charleston
overview: Charleston is a 1977 Italian comedy film written and directed by Marcello Fondato. It reprises the style of the film The Sting.

title: Flunked Up
overview: After butchering their final exam, two newly acquainted college students hatch a plan to steal and fix their answers

title: The Roses of Marrakesh
overview: Leila is the devoted housekeeper of Madame Isabelle, who lives in a luxurious estate in the Palmeraie of Marrakech. Leila maintains the careful order of this timeless bubble, where everyone plays their role to perfection. Between her and Yusef, the head gardener, a tacit, quiet, and restrained friendship has formed. When Leila’s sister arrives unexpectedly, revealing a heavy secret from their past, the tranquillity of this microcosm begins to crack.

title: Silver
overview: To help the girl he likes, a boy tries to sell his grandmother's silver necklace, only to be swindled by an evil dealer.

title: The Royal Cat
overview: In ancient Jinling City, General Kou's bodyguard cat Zhan Ao partners with the young Bao Zheng, Jinmaoshu and General Kou's daughter Kou Zhu to find truth, solve the mysterious case together, exposed a huge conspiracy.

title: Trackies & Pearls
overview: Teenager Levi sneaks out of his home to go raving, beginning to discover his queer identity and community. He is longing to reconnect with his late father, who will never know who Levi truly is.

title: The Extraordinary Life of Vera Valdez
overview: A portrait of Brazilian actress Vera Valdez, tracing her years as a model for Dior and, most notably, Coco Chanel; her flirtation with the French New Wave; her complex journey through motherhood; and her imprisonment and torture during Brazil’s military dictatorship.

title: The Soul Whisperer
overview: Theresia stays by the bedsides of the dying, praying for them and helping them pass away in peace. At the bedside of Varkichan, a wealthy farmer, she urges him to repent and forgive, but the stubborn Varkichan has no intention of dying this way, nor does he want to show any weakness to his son George and George’s wife, who have returned after ten years and are now waiting for him to die. How can the long suffering and inherited anger that have tormented everyone in the family finally be brought to an end?

title: Horizon
overview: As the twilight of adolescence gives way to adulthood, Casca, Ana, and Fú find themselves stalled on the roadside. The highway shifts before their eyes: a reverse road movie.

title: Директор
overview: Lavrenty, the narcissistic club director, is forced to work on a play with an ambitious newcomer. He sees her as a rival and plots against her.

title: Soft Transmission
overview: Partly eco-processed 8mm celluloid and tarot become a visual fascia, binding family through a shared fibromyalgia diagnosis and the mysticism of healing. Created in collaboration with the filmmaker’s aunt (a practicing medium), there is a resonance between their respective disciplines, where intuition, ritual, and material process converge. Like the experimental act of filmmaking itself, tarot opens up a lexicon for self-reflection, excavational storytelling, and embodied ways of knowing.

title: VIEWFINDER
overview: Evil is in the eye of the beholder.

title: The Next Day
overview: During a birthday weekend at a summer house, a group of longtime friends gather to celebrate, laugh, and relive old memories. As the night unfolds, an unexpected moment shifts the emotional balance of the group, leaving one of them silently confronting an experience he does not fully understand.

title: The Marist Children
overview: Hundreds of young boys spent some of the most formative years of their youth at the Marist boarding school in Mindelheim. Everyday life seemed normal and routine: a short walk across the street to school, lunch in the dining hall, free time, study time, dinner and table prayers. But after an abuse scandal could no longer be covered up, the school closed its doors. Today it is clear: for decades, the headmaster had been abusing young boys there. What really happened behind the walls of the Marist Order, where one of the largest church scandals took place? And why isn’t the perpetrator already behind bars?

title: Terrell & T.O.
overview: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

title: The Umbrella Fairy
overview: Qing Dai, a royal umbrella fairy, fails her mission to guard a sword fairy who escapes the royal pavilion seeking vengeance. This leads her on a journey with a young craftsman to prevent a war.

title: VHS
overview: VIVA HORROR STORIES is a 3-in-1 horror anthology where every story has a secret, every secret has a price, and every nightmare leads to terror. A cheerleader is haunted by a sinister presence on campus; a seemingly perfect romance hides a horrifying secret; and a celebrity couple faces an unthinkable choice when their child is born disfigured. Three terrifying stories. Three unforgettable nightmares. One anthology that will make you scream

title: GW:s mord - Familjetragedin i Svartöstaden
overview: The morning calm in Svartöstaden is brutally shattered by a blood-curdling roar. A mother and son are found dead. In the yard, a 19-year-old is apprehended, barefoot in the snow.

title: MATE
overview: Roommates who are far more than just roommates must confront the unspoken feelings they've kept buried inside.

title: La promessa di Patrizio
overview: The real story of Patrizio Oliva, raised in an extended family in a difficult neighbourhood in Naples. After the loss of his brother Ciro, Patrizio decides to collect his legacy and fight for redeeming himself and his family.

title: Dice-Ching-O-Mat
overview: Vilis, a scholar of Asian studies in his fifties, is trapped in a mysterious lift-like structure. When he realises that he no longer knows who he is, an intercom instructs him to leave through the red door and find the green door outside. Beyond the red door lies Vilnius, confined by the 2020 pandemic lockdown. There, Vilis encounters his wife and three adult children, yet feels like a stranger among them. As he searches for the green door, his family begins to fall apart.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: Three urban explorers enter an abandoned office building in search of forgotten spaces, but as the layout shifts and reality frays, they find themselves trapped in a 'liminal' maze that quietly erases their sense of time, place and each other.

title: Dead End
overview: Herman is a computer programmer and the father of a one-year-old daughter. When Lok appears, claiming to be his half-brother and pressing him about their father's death, Herman's everyday life begins to unravel. Then one day, Lok, who has been hovering around Herman and relentlessly triggering his trauma, suddenly disappears.

title: A story in white
overview: In a quiet, snow-covered mountain world, we follow two friends  searching together for a feeling they can’t quite name. As they journey through the white landscape, they encounter a mysterious snowman who is passing by unsuspectingly.  The film gently draws you into a space of silence, friendship, and the small miracle of simply being together, far away from everything. Made with cold fingers and warm hearts, it’s a love letter to nature, friendship, and the beauty of the unknown.

title: Memórias de um Figurante sem Nome e Outros Notáveis da Figuração
She Did It
overview: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.

title: Chō Uchū Keiji Gyaban Infiniti Taiyō ga Naita Hi
overview: Negative Emorgy emanating from MultiEarth A0073 coalesced into a massive void that swallowed the sun. The world lost its light and was engulfed in deep darkness. The most formidable enemy, Gavan Killer, who aims to annihilate all Gavans, pushes Reiji and his friends into an unprecedented life or death situation.

title: Life Is Life
overview: An elderly shepherd takes on big business when he becomes the only holdout against property developers building a luxury resort in his tiny Sardinian village.

title: Mohra
overview: Journalist Roma Singh is the daughter of a jailer. While taking a tour of the jail, she is molested by some of the inmates, and an inmate, Vishal Agnihotri comes to her assistance. She finds out that Vishal is in for four homicides, and decides to investigate further. She finds out, with the help of the owner of her publications, Jindal that Vishal was compelled to take the law in his own hands when the courts failed to punish the assailants of his sister and sweetheart. Soon, Vishal is released from prison, and begins to work for Jindal. It is then that he realizes that he has just walked from a walled prison, to an open prison, as the truth behind his release slowly but surely starts to dawn on him.

title: Date Night
overview: Danielle and Harry's latest attempt at kinky roleplay shines a discomforting light on what they really want from life.

title: The Drug in Our Pocket
overview: Examines how smartphones, designed to connect us, have radically reshaped childhood, adolescence and mental health. Through intimate conversations with young people, parents, and leading experts, the film reveals a generation that is thoughtful, articulate, and increasingly aware of how digital environments shape their attention, emotions, and sense of self.

title: BINGE
overview: A girl with an insatiable appetite goes on a late night adventure into a different state of mind.

title: Promise Street, 1988
overview: While working on the unfinished self-portrait of her bedridden mother, a young woman notices an unknown presence in her house.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Don't
overview: Two women, Morgan and Rea, relive their past relationship through a series of fragmented memories, revealing not just the past, but the distance between them now.

title: The Pension Heist
overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

title: The Broken Voice
overview: Letters, diaries and secrets left by its protagonists, historical and prior unknown materials revisit the life and death of Federico García Lorca, one of Spain’s most beloved and internationally recognized poets.

title: Arne Goes to Space
overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

title: The Romantics
overview: Liam returns to his hometown of Liverpool to reconnect with the memory of his long-missing sister, but an encounter with an old friend forces him to confront the grief he’s kept buried.

title: Nika's Room
overview: Jakob, a single father by day and sex worker by night, watches his teenage daughter Nika losing herself in the frenzy of nightlife. The more Nika rebels against him, the more desperately Jakob seeks comfort and validation from his client Martha.

title: Юрий Бутусов. Барабаны внутри
overview: For its creators, this film became, in a sense, a labor of love and duty. *Yuri Butusov: Drums Within* is a film about the director’s talent, his confrontation with reality, his mission, and love. Those featured in the film—Butusov’s students, actors who worked with him, his former classmates, close associates, and his "gang"—were unanimous: knowing and working with him was never, and could never have been, just another project. He changed the people he met and transformed the space around him; he would stir things up and create a swell of energy—making the whole cauldron boil. Yet, often enough, he himself found himself powerless against that very tide. Making a film about such a man—avoiding the trap of turning him into a monument and ensuring the result was anything but banal—was a formidable challenge for the filmmakers. They worked on the project for over a year, gathering a wealth of rare archival material and interviewing dozens of people.

title: A Quiet Man
overview: An intimate portrait of Romain Zaleski, an industrialist, philanthropist, and art collector who for years has flown under the radar. He left home with practically nothing but today, he is France’s fourth richest person with a net worth estimated at several billion euros. The fascinating and twisted paths that led Zaleski to acquire his remarkable fortune ran through Poland, France, and Italy.

title: Queen of Mahjong
overview: Queen of Mahjong follows the hilarious and heartwarming stories of love, family, and hidden secrets in the Long family – Village Chief Long with his 3 daughters and 1 son. With three couples navigating love and laughter in their own unique ways, how will it all end?

title: Lo que nos une
overview: Several years after a TV-related controversy, three former friends meet to make a film that explores the borders between fact and fiction.

title: Our Way to You
overview: Charlie and Hicham, both in their thirties, are deeply in love but unable to conceive; they are facing infertility. They embark on a journey of medically assisted reproduction. Over the course of three years—amidst hopes and disappointments—they put both their love and their bodies to the test, living through an odyssey that will profoundly transform them.

title: The Last Shuttle
overview: With Earth nearing collapse, a hardened scavenger discovers a lost mute girl whose family may offer their only hope of escape, forcing him to choose between self-preservation and redemption.

title: Blood on Snow
overview: A family goes back to their old, empty ancestral home in a snowy rural area. They accidentally wake up an ancient, evil spirit known as the Lady in White. Dark family secrets and a terrifying supernatural presence threaten their lives.

title: La Marea
overview: Tracing the waters of the Santa Barbara Channel and the passage surrounding the Channel Islands, guided by the belief of many coastal tribes that souls of the dead travel west over the ocean, La Marea explores the sea as a threshold between the living and the departed. Through tides, light and shifting currents, ancestral cosmologies intertwine with contemporary stories of exile and return. Created in dialogue with Bryan Senti’s musical composition, part of a larger body of work inspired by his father’s exile from Cuba by sea, La Marea carries these oceanic crossings into a shared reflection on displacement, remembrance and the invisible forces that continue to move through us.

title: FUN
overview: A 10-year-old boy encounters two teenage bullies with his pet rabbit on his way home from school. He needs to think of an escape plan while the two teens confront him with sinister games and an impossible choice.

title: XO
overview: They are two. They play a game, fight and compete, love and wander, yearn and mourn. They part and reunite, get bored and create, scream and dream. But can they defy the duality?

title: Bear Your Heart
overview: Desperate to fix his lacking in confidence, Trent attends a gathering hosted by an eccentric matchmaker.

title: The Evil Inside
overview: Once a showbiz icon in Taiwan, Ho Jen-jen—better known as Golden Phoenix—vanished after reckless gambling left her drowning in debt. She abandoned her young daughter, severing all ties. Years later, she collapses and wakes up in a sinister nursing home. Beneath the facility’s eerie calm lurks "Death Bet,” a twisted game where terminal patients' lifespans are gambled away. Desperate to escape and find her daughter, she soon realizes the true horror has yet to unfold, and the most harrowing secret is still waiting to be revealed.

title: I Knead You
overview: A heartbroken baker creates a life-sized bread lover with some mysterious flour, sparking a twisted love triangle that spirals into obsession, horror, and survival.

title: Cony, intimate Portrait
overview: This documentary commemorates the centenary in 2026 of celebrated Brazilian writer and journalist Carlos Heitor Cony. Guided by his widow, Beatriz Lajta, after 40 years together, the film reveals the man behind the public figure. Featuring previously unseen home footage of their travels, friends, and shared passions—including piano, painting, and books—as well as readings narrated by Pedro Bial and interviews with Cony’s daughter and granddaughter, the documentary offers a mature, female perspective on a fascinating life, capturing his profound humanity and capacity for affection.

title: The Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath
overview: Over forty years after the terrifying events in Louisville, the nightmare is far from over. The deadly chemical Trioxin has unleashed a horror that refuses to die, and the truth behind the original outbreak is more terrifying than anyone imagined. "Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath" continues the legendary horror mythology with a new chapter of zombies, government secrets, terrifying discoveries and the return of the living dead.

title: Vocabulary
overview: Andy, a young chunky Chinese newcomer, arrives in London’s gay scene full of wonderful dreams. What he finds instead: somewhat racist Grindr bios, slang he can’t decipher (“bog roll”), and rules no dictionary can teach. Over three sex/dates, he stumbles through the unspoken vocabulary of sex, love, and belonging.

title: Particles of Dust
overview: The corpse of a young man shows up at the shores of Atalante marking the return of Isidore to the territory of the living. But coming back from the dead is a delicate affair. As he follows the traces of his past lives in search of lost memories and the promise of a story, Isidore finds himself caught in a deceitful web of narratives within narratives, a world of Time Travelers and Doppelgängers, Picture Eaters and Textile Merchants, Phantom Friends and Phantom Lovers.

title: The Fading of Morning Light
overview: As a father reminisces about his late daughter, her ghost appears to remind him that the seeds of her favourite flower have sprouted, and today is the day he must set out to plant them.

title: Halo
overview: Min-joon, 27, who bears the burden of his broken family, delivers packages every day, dreaming of being a film director. A soothsayer lights a flame within him. Daily repetition and slippage create unique rhythms.

title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
overview: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.

title: Es frisst
overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

title: Field Reports
overview: An autistic documentary filmmaker studies two neurotypicals, trying to understand their shared way of being through objects, language and small social gestures. As the day draws on, his sense of alienation slowly emerges.

title: GW:s mord - Cyanidmordet
overview: A man dies of cardiac arrest in Norrtälje. When the body is re-examined, traces of cyanide are discovered. Leif GW Persson investigates the case.

title: Two Cigarettes, Three Nights
overview: Kanna is an illustrator living in Kyoto. Three nights with Haseo, a "guy friend" she reunites with after seven years, change the course of her life.

title: Twenty One Pilots: Electric Castle 2026
overview: Twenty One Pilots taking over Electric Castle’s Main Stage with an unforgettable show, bringing thousands of fans together for one of EC12’s biggest moments.

title: The World Isn't The Way You Know It
overview: In an old neighborhood of Istanbul that is on the verge of losing its genteel character, Meliha, a woman living alone, carries on with her life without leaving her home, finding pleasure in small everyday routines. One day, she gives her bank card and PIN to a stranger who brings her scarf back after it falls from her balcony, asking him to withdraw some money for a bowl of soup. But Meliha’s naive trust turns into a major crisis for her family. As they question their mother’s memory, their own distrust of one another gradually comes to the surface. “The World Isn’t the Way You Know It” takes a darkly comic approach to exploring how trust is shaped by class prejudice and roles within the family.

title: Livin'
overview: The great war — in all its manifestations of death and the thirst for life, the sorrow of loss and the happiness of those who survived, the relationships between friends and enemies, children and parents, people and animals, entire worlds — cannot be captured in a single story. That is why this film will unfold in several novellas, united by the theme of war that has become our life.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: Hold On, Pain Ends
overview: Ben Mayforth redefines adaptive climbing in his intense pursuit of 5.13.

title: DOUEN
overview: Sania, a first-generation Trinidadian American, is haunted by mischievous Douens and must confront the dark secrets and generational trauma buried within her family before the past claims her future.

title: Faust
overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

title: Spag
overview: As Quebec City reels from an unprecedented act of violence, the shooter’s final words make their way onto the public stage.

title: Call The Office
overview: Call The Office is one of Canada’s most iconic music venues. The venue created a vibrant social hub in London, Ontario and thrived for generations. It brought such notable bands as Radiohead, The Tragically Hip, Bif Naked, D.O.A, Link Wray, and Bad Brains to London. It also helped launch the careers of musicians such as Danko Jones, Sum 41, Kittie, and Death From Above 1979.  From the voices of the bookers, staff, patrons, and bands, this documentary examines what made the place so special.

title: Late
overview: After his sister Eva is kidnapped, a young man sets out with his father to find her. As they drive through the night, tensions rise, old conflicts resurface, and the situation begins to spiral out of control.

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Changes
overview: Changes is an original comedy about people in contemporary Prague who, at various stages of their lives, are trying to work out who they are, what they actually want, and whether they have fulfilled their dreams. With humour, grit and a sense of perspective, the film reflects on intergenerational relationships, identity crises and the pressures of a consumerist age, whilst delivering a series of unexpected twists. Prague is a city of seven bridges that connect both riverbanks and people’s destinies. A vibrant place where you are surrounded by people, and yet where one can feel painfully alone.

title: Sumpa Kingdom
overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

title: Krashanka 2.0. The Quantum Paradox
overview: After the events of the first part, where Ivan Zabiyaka built a ballistic missile, he takes on a new invention: a Time Machine, disguised as an old minibus.

title: Placenta
overview: Under grotesque, clinical observation, four androgynous subjects homogenize one another under the gaze of a passive reflector.

title: Too Tight to Move
overview: A young traveler tries out a brand-new, top of the line massage chair.

title: Fishbrain
overview: Desperate to escape her decaying coastal town but unable to abandon the grandfather who depends on her, Ori sees a way out when tainted fish wash ashore, but only if she can bring herself to put them on his plate.

title: Outside/Inside
overview: From Ji-hlava film festival catalogue: For seven years, the director follows the life of Ceci, a stray cat that gradually settles into his home without ever completely leaving the world of the streets. Their ever-changing relationship forms the backbone of this time-lapse narrative, into which other cats and fragments of the director’s life are woven: unfinished film projects, relationships with neighbours, his deteriorating health, and events unfolding in the city and across the country.  (...)This intimate chronicle of an unusual friendship simultaneously records the passage of time and the transformations of a human life, which becomes ever more closely intertwined with that of the cat.  “The presence of the cat is central, but not as a character in a narrative sense. Rather, she becomes a point of departure, a way to move away from a human-centred perspective, without replacing it with another fixed position.” — Maani Petgar

title: Baa: Ek Yoddha
overview: The silent struggles, scarifies, and unconditional love of a father.

title: Parallel Consequences
overview: Max and his friends, Pedro and Bruna, discover a time machine and decide to test it. What begins as an adventure quickly turns into a nightmare when Pedro inexplicably tries to kill Max, who must repeatedly travel back a few seconds in time to survive and uncover the truth. Caught in an unstable timeline, the three friends confront dark truths about themselves, the weight of their choices, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to rewrite destiny.

title: Fate
overview: The story takes place at a tourist resort in Hurghada, where a wealthy widow inherits the resort following the death of her billionaire husband. While managing the resort, she goes through several romantic experiences in search of a suitable life partner, until she meets a man with whom she falls in love.

title: GW:s mord - Sturebymordet
overview: 15-year-old Therese walks into the woods after a party near the ski jump in Stureby and never returns. Leif GW Persson examines the case.

title: Anton Špelec, Sharp-Shooter
overview: Anton Špelec (Vlasta Burin) is a producer of musical instruments by trade but a sharp-shooter at heart. He expects to be awarded a medal at a large parade in town where veteran sharp-shooters will be honored. When the town council is one medal short, Anton must wait another year for his prized possession. He drowns his disappointment in drink at the local pub and becomes so drunk that he insults the emperor who sentences him to jail. Instead of fulfilling the emperor’s orders himself, Anton sends his employee in his stead.

title: Carpe Diem
overview: Since Anna Weber gave the world the Carpe Diem Agreement, peace and prosperity have reigned on Earth. Everyone knows, down to the very last second, how much time they have left. When Anna’s own clock runs out, she is forced to realize that her husband David refuses to live out his remaining two years without her – thereby calling her entire life’s work into question.

title: Spying Stars
overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world.
