When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.

title: Wish You Long Life
overview: Wish You Long Life follows Adi and Maya, two childhood friends who have become estranged in recent years. When the sudden death of their best friend Reuben brings them back together, they reconnect and retrace the lives they once imagined for themselves and reckon with their past experiences with bullying, exclusion and antisemitism. Through this journey, they grapple with whether they should hide their cultural identity, or be proud of it.

title: Embers
overview: Huang Yan, a terminally ill crematorium worker, accidentally mixed up two sets of ashes during her work. When she confessed the truth, neither family wanted to swap them back. Only Yao Xue, the daughter of one of the deceased, believed Huang Yan. The two embarked on a wild and absurd journey to return the ashes, where they came to understand life anew and chose to live bravely in the face of death.

title: The Last Fellini
overview: Much has been told about Federico Fellini, but one chapter remains largely unexplored. It is the final decade of his life and artistic career. During the 1980s and 1990s, the film industry celebrated him while struggling to support his visions. The Maestro never stopped creating and fought to continue expressing himself. Sharing his dreams and extraordinary energy were exceptional companions: Roberto Benigni, Martin Scorsese, Nicola Piovani, Vincenzo Mollica, Milo Manara, and his inseparable secretary, Fiammetta Profili. Ultimo Fellini reveals the man behind the icon through three years of research, private archives, and previously unseen footage, beginning with the precious materials of Vincenzo Mollica.

title: Monster
overview: Visiting his cousins in a small Anatolian town during a book tour, novelist Kemal joins them for a long-overdue family meal. What starts as an ordinary gathering filled with old grievances and petty disputes gradually unravels, exposing a deeply buried trauma from their shared past.

title: The Ambersons
overview: In 1960s suburbia, Barney Amberson finds meaning through the ordinary rituals of family life with the department store mannequins he calls his own.

title: Sapiens
overview: Na Do-han, a man with Dissociative Identity Disorder, shares his body with four different identities. One dawn, he wakes up in a motel with blood-soaked hands and the word 'Run!' scrawled on a mirror. Soon linked to the disappearance of a wealthy corporate heir, Do-han becomes the prime suspect. Concurrently pursued by corporate lawyer Seo Hee-jae, he must interrogate his own identities, each concealing a secret.

title: It Ain't Me
overview: A young woman must face her worst decision to confront an abusive relationship.

title: Alexander the Great and the Accursed Dragon
overview: In Karagiozis's dream, a man‑eating Dragon seizes control of the city's aqueduct. In order to prevent panic, Rigas persuades him to accept his victims by lottery. When the lot falls on Rigopoula, twelve‑year‑old Alexandre, searching for the horse he adores, unexpectedly comes upon the Dragon. He does not panic. Selfless love completely conquers fear.

title: She Said
overview: A migrant worker recounts a strange tale about her past when her boyfriend proposes to her.

title: still dark
overview: Yuki, a blind young man who dreams of becoming a chef, is captivated by the Napolitan pasta at a certain restaurant. After pleading with the head chef, who tells him they aren’t hiring, Yuki begins working there as an apprentice. As he builds bonds with his senior part-time colleague Kenta and the head chef, he faces his dreams head-on.

title: Dragon
overview: In a stagnant mountain pool, A-Mao fishes for a hidden giant lizard, dragging others into a bloody, infectious madness. Paralyzed and numb, his broken husk crawls back to the murk. At his physical limit, can this eerie desire drive his will to transcend the flesh?

title: Nios
overview: On their last night on a Greek party island, a restless young man abandons his childhood friends to sail with a solitary fisherman—seeking freedom in the open sea, only to find himself truly alone.

title: Nuevas Raíces
overview: After fleeing the war in Ukraine, several families rebuild their lives in a village in Seville. Through different conversations and introducing us to their day-to-day, Nuevas raíces shows their process of adaptation, resilience and rooting in a land that, without seeking it, also begins to be home.

title: No Hands: The Wild Ride of the Schwinn Bicycle Company
overview: Founded in Chicago in 1895, Schwinn grew into an American icon, giving generations of kids their first taste of freedom on two wheels.  Narrated by Lance Armstrong, No Hands traces the company’s extraordinary rise, innovations and mysterious collapse while exploring its influence on childhood, BMX, mountain biking and American culture.  Through family members, cycling pioneers, collectors and industry leaders, the film reveals a story not simply about a bicycle company, but about memory, family, reinvention and what a first bike came to mean in American life.

title: Out of Date Defences
overview: Behind so many of the troubles of love lies a frustrating mystery: why do they behave the way they do? Late at night, we might write them off as mean, lazy, or actively trying to ruin our lives.

title: Voices Inside Your Head
overview: Diverse individuals (a demolition expert, a visagist, a physicist, an Indigenous leader, and a Santo Daime priest) recount how psychedelics transformed their lives in unexpected and profound ways.

title: A Ray of Sunlight
overview: Okhee is a lower-class diver in the city. One day, Eunyoung, the daughter of her late husband, comes to visit. What’s more, Kyeongsik, Okhee’s son, who is being chased by creditors, leaves his young son Junseo with them and disappears. Eunyoung wasn’t planning to stay long but misses the chance to leave due to Okhee's accident and the appearance of her step-nephew, Junseo. Eunyoung starts to live together with Okhee, but everything feels uncomfortable.

title: The Shimmering Shadows
overview: In the heart of the Haute-Gatineau forest at the height of hunting season, humans and animals cross paths and search for each other.

title: Honto ni Atta Kowai Hanashi: Aki no Tokubetsu-hen 2026
Railfan
overview: A curious, heartwarming documentary following a photographer as he makes a portrait series of autistic kids who love New York City subways. While overlooked by many, subways retain a magic in their ability to transport us to the destinations of our choosing. For autistic children, they can mean so much more. Following a group of these unique kids in New York City, Railfan explores the deep fascinations that autistic people have (a.k.a. “special interests”) through gentle observation, and invites you into a secret world where imagination and urban geographies overlap.

title: 4 historias increíbles
overview: A man recounts four absurd stories in which he is always the lead: he can never repeat a word, a doctor edits his wife's brain, a mind-reading app gets jealous, and a mirror only tells the truth.

title: Dhanushkodiyilekku
overview: The starkly different lives of two families intertwine across decades of shifting history. While one group barely survived the catastrophic 1964 Dhanushkodi cyclone, the other has only ever known immense wealth.

title: Saving Bella
overview: December 1941. Leningrad. A soldier is assigned to guard the city zoo in the midst of World War II. There, among starving workers and dying animals, he forms an unexpected bond with Bella the hippo. As the siege tightens, this fragile connection becomes his only anchor, forcing him to choose between survival and compassion in a world falling apart.

title: I Deserve a Lover Whose Every Rise Sets Fiery Dooms Raging Across the Skies
overview: Set between Tabriz and Tehran in the weeks between the Twelve-Day War and the subsequent conflict between Iran, Israel, and the United States, this film follows two Iranian artists whose lives have become inseparable from a vast private archive assembled over decades: photographs, documents, discarded objects, and traces of anonymous lives. Working somewhere between collecting, hoarding, preservation, and obsession, they have created an improvised museum of neglected lives, one in which sex workers, young soldiers, child labourers, gay lovers, and ordinary families emerge through abandoned albums, damaged belongings, and fragments of memory left behind by history.

title: We're Nothing at All
overview: On Valentine’s Day, a double-decker bus explodes in a fiery blast, killing many and leaving charred remains, with evidence pointing to a deliberate act by two passengers, Fai and Ike, a gay couple from troubled backgrounds living on society’s margins. As retired forensic expert Lung Sir investigates, he uncovers their tragic story of abuse, homophobia, and despair, culminating in their decision to end their lives in a suicidal protest against an unjust world, leaving behind a haunting message: “On a beautiful day, we end our unbeautiful lives.”

title: The Mentor
overview: She wants to forget her past but her new boss forces her to remember. Krissy, fresh out of prison, gets hired by a strict CEO named Portia. Soon, the mentorship turns into a game of revenge.

title: The Water Is Always Warm
overview: Follows the dissolution of a friendship as one friend becomes involved in a controversial religion. The haunted comedy unfolds through a series of dinners over the course of several years, each date farther apart than the last.

title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
overview: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

title: Niceland
overview: An elderly pop star seeking a calmer life away from fame arrives in Niceland, a gloomy tropical town, to perform what may be his last show.

title: Mieruko-chan
overview: One day, high school girl Miko suddenly gains the ability to see spirits. Surrounded by terrifying and grotesque apparitions, Miko chooses the most unexpected survival strategy: pretending she can’t see them. Whether her best friend Hana becomes possessed or her classmate Yuria starts to suspect her secret, Miko sticks to her plan — ignore everything with all her might. But as Hana begins acting more and more strangely… can Miko really survive this ordeal by pretending she doesn’t see a thing!?

title: How to Be Normal and the Oddness of the Other World
overview: Fresh out of a psychiatric hospital, Pia moves back in with her parents to get her life together. Torn between a new job, lovesickness, psychotropic drugs and social stigmatization, she emerges into a world where everything seems out of control.

title: Siti Vampire
overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

title: Dog without Feathers
overview: From the Agreste to the sea, the Capibaribe River inspires the poetry of João Cabral de Melo Neto and the dance of Deborah Colker. This documentary is a road movie in which performance, the body, and poetry fuel a journey that begins at the river’s source and flows out to the open sea, moving between the arid landscape and the ocean, between devastation and what endures.

title: The Story of Eve
overview: After a public scandal, an aging film star flees to a remote island with her devoted young lover where isolation blurs performance and reality.

title: The Ferry Man·The Dream of the Princess
overview: A quest for spirit stones uncovers a 200-year-old love between a wandering general and a dead princess, bringing three soul ferrymen together for a new journey.

title: A Price We Have To Pay
overview: Ignacio Ezcurra, the only Argentinian journalist sent to Vietnam in 1968, vanished in the most documented war, leaving behind a single haunting photograph of his lifeless body in the streets of Saigon. The mystery of his death was left unchallenged for decades. Until now.

title: Where to Find Foxes
overview: A new mother, kept awake by the sound of foxes prowling outside her home, ventures into the night to scare them off only to find herself a part of a strange and feral ritual.

title: Un Soir d'Été sous la Tour Eiffel avec la Maîtrise de Radio France
Shelby
overview: In the depths of the Louisiana swamps, Shelby lives an extraordinary life of adventure and survival. This documentary unveils his mysterious world of underwater logging, treasure hunting, and wild encounters where myth and reality blur together.

title: Nelly Rapp – The Gateway to the Underworld
overview: When Nelly reunites with her mother, she learns that an ancient vampire intends to open the gateway to the underworld—where a slumbering evil waits to be unleashed. Together with Valle and London, they must stop the vampire before disaster strikes.

title: Altera Partem
overview: Adam and two other men find themselves trapped in the hold of a ship. While the prisoners desperately search for a way out, the discovery of a strange breach in the wall will upend each of their beliefs.

title: Time's Up, I'm Afraid
overview: A hypnotherapist discovers she may be the one who has been hypnotised.

title: Children of The Wicker Man
overview: Fifty years after The Wicker Man, director Robin Hardy’s lost papers resurface, prompting his sons Justin and Dominic to explore the legacy of the cult classic, and their father. Together, they uncover the truth behind Robin’s role in the film and confront the complexities of independent filmmaking, family, and myth.

title: The Sentence
overview: A dramatized look into the last few hours in the life of doctor Ivan Šreter, whose abduction remains one of the biggest unsolved mysteries of the Croatian War of Indpendance.

title: Unspoken Bond
overview: A feature documentary about a relationship often overlooked: the bond between humans and animals—not a substitute for human connection, but a profound one in its own right. Through three lives transformed by an animal, it reveals a bond that heals and connects us as deeply as any human relationship.

title: Jeffrey Dollmer
overview: Dahmer finds a doll in 1991 and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it but is captured before he can finish his evil plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers.

title: Un'altra me
overview: A comedy about social newtorks.

title: Rebound
overview: Dee rebounds from one, funny failed date to the next, in the search for Mr Right. If only she could see that her best friend is right there all along - it's obvious, right?

title: Paul Ruins a Wedding
overview: Filmed entirely in a single-take bird’s-eye view, a clueless wedding guest steadily unravels the reception after professing his love to the bride.

title: Fuksas - Da tutta la vita
overview: This intimate documentary explores both the public legacy and private life of renowned architect Massimiliano Fuksas. Framed as a collaborative journey between father and daughter (as protagonist and director), the film delves into art, memory, and personal loss, becoming a deeply emotional space where they can truly discover and redefine their relationship.

title: Pension Patta
overview: After his father’s death, Rajan and his mother, Chalu, struggle to claim his pension and repay his debts. A search for a missing name leads Rajan on a journey that transforms him from a greedy young man into a generous one.

title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
overview: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

title: Das Institut für kurzfristige Wiederbelebung zur Aufklärung ungeklärter Erbschaftsangelegenheiten
overview: Dying is usually a straightforward matter. Unless the will contains formal errors. In that case, the Institute for Short-Term Resuscitation for the Resolution of Unresolved Inheritance Matters steps in to resolve unsettled claims. But when spokesperson Dr. Kopalski’s sister suddenly finds herself in the chair, he has to decide: the institute or his sister? Life or death?

title: Me, Myself and Vegas
overview: A young woman from England struggling to find a partner to walk her down the aisle goes to Las Vegas where she marries herself in this documentary of self love.

title: Pact
overview: In an attempt to lose weight, a heartbroken woman is consensually blackmailed by a dominatrix.

title: Tear Your Eyes Away From The Screen
overview: Time passes, but Cándido doesn't care. Scrolling through the screen of his cell phone, he has all the answers to the mysteries of the universe in front of him. The only answer he can't find, however, is the exact moment of his impending doom.

title: If I Only Had Wings
overview: As graduation nears, Kaelan, a teenager tries to make sense of his friendships, family struggles, and what comes next.

title: Stickball: The Little Brother of War
overview: A ragtag women's team of underdogs and outsiders must come together to defeat the incumbent champions, earn ancestral pride for their community, and settle a historic rivalry in the oldest and bloodiest sport in America: Native American Stickball.

title: Lunatic Dreamers
overview: A documentary film following the band the Felice Brothers as they write and produce their first album for Sony.

title: The Sleeper. The Lost Caravaggio
overview: A painting hanging in a house in Madrid is causing a stir as it is thought to be a lost work by the great Italian Baroque painter Caravaggio.

title: La era de la cancelación
overview: After discovering the controversial impact of the series "Sense8" and how it had touched lives around the world, Martín embarks on a journey across 11 countries to document stories—like his own—that have been deeply shaped by the show. Crossing continents, he meets fans and online friends, and even connects with some of the Netflix series' actors to discuss themes that span diverse cultures in a world that constantly keeps us apart.

title: Izhakalkkappuram
overview: In an ancestral home, Dr. Ananth Sivan, an ageing Gandhian scholar, holds firmly to his lifelong beliefs, while his filmmaker daughter Karthi begins to question his convictions. Through their everyday interactions, their relationship unfolds as they navigate the delicate space between ideals, belief, and empathy.

title: Girl Beast
overview: Girl Beast is a psychological drama with a magical  and heightened reality, that tells a Lolita story from Lolita's point of view. Sara is a girl beast, an object of desire and a being of desire.  The story is adapted from Cecilie Lind’s novel with the same title. It balances between self-assertion and self-destruction. Loss and liberation. Powerlessness and power.

title: The Masturbator - The Adventures of Edgar Hilsenrath
overview: Edgar Hilsenrath was one of the first who dared to face the trauma with grotesque wit and unrestrained laughter. In a mixture of animation and historical archive material, the film follows Hilsenrath’s alter ego from his novel “Fuck America”: a penniless, sex-obsessed writer in 1950s New York who is desperately trying to publish his memories of the ghetto under the title “The Masturbator”.

title: The Scout
overview: Sofia works as a location scout for a TV pilot filming in New York City. It’s her job to find the homes, businesses, and exteriors where the show will be filmed. Driving around the city's different neighborhoods, she enters the private spaces of strangers to photograph their cozy apartments and eclectic shops, stepping into the fabric of their lives while trying to satisfy the demands of her erratic employers. Over a day filled with these encounters, Sofia witnesses moments of curiosity, vulnerability, and quiet tension until her work takes a sudden, personal turn.

title: Negative
overview: When a young soldier reacts violently to a positive test result, an HIV testing clinic descends into a bloody mayhem as other visitors take sides and clash with each other.

title: Home Sweet Home
overview: When Gośka meets Grzesiek online, she's sure he's her Mr. Right. Grzesiek is crazy about her, showers her with flowers, and proposes in Venice, but soon enough, the picture perfect romance starts to crumble, revealing a darker side.

title: have you seen me?
overview: After his beloved cat disappears amidst a global pandemic, a lonely man turns to his neighbor for help. As isolation takes hold, their search becomes a surreal descent into loneliness, longing, and dimensional dissolution.

title: Oil Gobblers
overview: A zoologist and a biochemist go out into an oilfield with a cameraman and filmmaker to observe and study the elusive oil gobblers.

title: Unexpressed
overview: Anya, who has been living in Germany since the beginning of the full-scale invasion, returns to Ukraine and visits her ex-boyfriend at his photo lab. She already knows there is another woman in his life. As they spend the evening together, what has remained unspoken between them slowly comes to the surface. When Anya tries to leave, he stops her, and for a brief moment they fall back into a familiar intimacy, despite everything that now stands between them.

title: Auber 89
overview: Aubervilliers, a Parisian working-class suburb, in the 1980s: Fatsah Bouyahmed, then in his teens, recalls the past and revives solidarity-filled life stories from the archive footage.

title: Water Poem
overview: Water Poem is an experimental documentary short film in which a Vietnamese trans man recites a poem as images drift and shift beneath words, in an exploration of water against boundaries of time. A meditation on transness, ancestral memory, and grief on the body that carries the way a river carries sediment.

title: Cocaine: A Colombian Powderkeg
overview: Cocaine is more widespread than ever before with more regular users and seizures at an all time high. In Colombia, production is booming, and after years of relative calm, extreme violence has come back to the streets with the drug traffickers. This documentary reveals the reality of today’s cocaine trade from production to export.

title: Dream of Birds
overview: What happens when a forest loses its birdsong? Following clues hidden in the sounds birds make while asleep, Argentinian physicist Gabriel Mindlin uncovers a hidden extinction – not of species, but of memory – and sets out to revive vanished melodies before they disappear forever. Part detective story, part cutting-edge science, Mindlin's mission leads him to the dusty 1960s archives of Buenos Aires naturalist, confirming that some songs no longer echo in the biosphere. So he deploys "robot tutors" to see whether young birds can learn and spread the old songs once again.

title: The Perfect
overview: High-achieving teenager Pärli feels like a mountain range: cold below the knees and hot in her hands. She compares parts of her body to different seasons and playfully envies a dancing grasshopper's movements. If not a ballerina, she imagines being a violinist or lion tamer. Aspiring Black Swan Maarja took up ballet at her parents' urging, though she preferred hip-hop. Ballet lecturer and horse rider Irina teaches students to appreciate the technically perfect ballet body, yet struggles to find joy and tends to censor everything, even as she resists strict control. All three strive for perfection in life and on the dance floor. Ballet offers escape into a magical world but demands patience. Dancers repeat exercises and rehearse for hours, seeking precision despite pain, fatigue or waning motivation. Each movement takes time to master, perhaps only to satisfy a mother's high expectations.

title: Hinotama: Ball of Fire
overview: As his parents' marriage fractures and eventually collapses into divorce, high schooler Takeshi becomes increasingly obsessed with hunting for a mysterious 'ball of fire' rumored by a childhood friend. Using this quest to escape the quiet turmoil at home, Takeshi leaves his younger brother to shoulder the family's emotional weight without realizing it.

title: Magic Bibs
overview: The ambitious captain of a failing social netball team attempts to fix their losing streak with a spell, but it may cost the team their friendship.

title: Salí a caminar (volví a mi cuarto)
Tomorrow silence will come
overview: Shattered by his grandmother's death, Trizado, a depressed film student, sets off on a sensory journey. Interweaving family archives, tactile textures, and substance use, he contemplates grief, guilt, and a growing emotional disconnect from the world around him.

title: Smooth Summer
overview: As Hanna and her ten-year-old niece, Erle, get ready for a day at the beach, Hanna is faced with a dilemma: How can she manage to be both a cool aunt and a good role model in this situation?

title: Molly & Wors: Die Geheim Van 'n Gelukkige Huwelik
overview: The relationship between Molly and Wors is put to the test by unemployment, financial worries, and secrets. To top it off, Molly has booked an expensive boating holiday to save their marriage.

title: Return to Bloom
overview: Kazuki visits Bohol Island with his girlfriend, Sara. After spending happy days together, Sara suddenly disappears one morning. As Kazuki searches across the island, he senses a mysterious connection between Sara and the island’s nature, eventually leading him toward an eternal truth.

title: Frosty Nights, Santa Fights
overview: The Clausverse faces danger when Jack Frost seeks revenge against Santa Claus for the imprisonment of his father, Sam. Jack begins to turn traditional Christmas into an AI cold celebration, so Santa fights Jack from taking over Christmas.

title: The Cryonicist
overview: When her boyfriend is taken off life support by his family, a brilliant but obsessive college student risks everything to steal his body and DIY cryogenically freeze him.

title: Of Swallows
overview: A swallow’s eye is longer than other birds. Their visual acuity is said to resemble Raptors. For sailors, swallows are a good omen signifying a close shore. My father loved birds. Since his passing I've felt afloat. Lost and unanchored. At sea in overwhelming emotions. I close my eyes and look for swallows, as metaphorical groundings.

title: GunBlade & Me
overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

title: With You
overview: A woman’s travels unfold on screen while a man’s letters reach out to her from afar.

title: Men of Law
overview: A retired detective and his cousin launch a rescue operation when the detective's daughter is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, and law enforcement isn't doing their job.

title: Block 10
overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
overview: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

title: My Life for My Word
overview: The feature-length documentary "Za slovo ručím životem" captures the sometimes uncompromising stances of the internationally acclaimed Czech writer Radka Denemarková, as well as the accessibility of the themes in her work to an international audience. Denemarková regards her literary talent as a gift and sees the fight for the human dignity of those who would otherwise never be heard as her moral duty. Her novels, which reflect both our present and recent past – such as Hodiny z olova and Peníze od Hitlera  – have been translated into twenty-five languages. Thanks to her natural charm, openness and unique sense of humour during book talks and award ceremonies, the author has gained admirers all over the world.

title: SHE
overview: Liva, a young woman, is cleaning up after her and her late twin sister's 21st birthday, when she suddenly starts to hear strange sounds. She starts to investigate, but what she stumbles upon turns her birthday into her own personal hell.

title: The Class of 1990
overview: An East German student protest of the early 1990s, revisited by former acting students of Rostock’s “Ernst Busch” Academy.

title: Mitrata
overview: Mitrata follows three inseparable friends whose bond is hilariously and heart-warmingly tested by a chaotic twist of fate. Packed with laughter, loyalty, and life-changing choices, it is the ultimate celebration of the people who know us best.

title: Die andere Seite
overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

title: The Night
overview: Mika, a woman caring for her husband Anders who has Alzheimer’s, navigates her own loneliness and need for intimacy. When Ossian, a man working in home care, enters their lives, something is stirred in Mika – a reminder of her own vitality and desire, but also an uncomfortable truth about her situation.

title: The Jersey
overview: Two friends devise an absurd plan to sell a Maradona-signed jersey and quickly raise money for a trip. But what begins as a simple scam turns into a chain of mistakes, guilt, and shattered dreams.

title: I'm Not Your Heartthrob
overview: A documentary exploring acclaimed Brazilian actor Claudio Marzo’s relationship with fame and his own image as a heartthrob.

title: To Catch A Siren
overview: A young refugee desperately searches for her mother, who she believes to be a mermaid.

title: Terra Firme
overview: In a coastal village forgotten by time, young Juca approaches Zé Cangulo, a fisherman living in isolation on his boat. A silent bond forms between them, shaped by waiting and the sea. By bringing to light a submerged past in which the boy recognizes himself, this encounter opens up the possibility of a fresh start.

title: Benny Feldman: Butterfly Pavilion
overview: Benny Feldman's debut stand-up special. Filmed at The Bell House in Brooklyn.

title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

title: Distance
overview: Ambika drives her late best friend’s 13-year-old son, Dhruv, back to boarding school after his father’s sudden death. The ride is strained by Dhruv’s unexplained animosity, which worsens when Ambika’s careless driving breaks his prized windmill science project. The journey culminates when Dhruv confronts her with a painful shared secret.

title: The Nameless Ballad
overview: Death is a powerful muse. Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

title: Il était une fois le printemps
They Always Come at Night
overview: Galicia, 1976. During a family dinner, a paranoid neighbor warns of hooded figures emerging from the mist: A Santa Compaña. What starts as a perceived breakdown soon turns into a ritualistic siege.

title: Dear Nanni
overview: What if the only way to face life was to escape into cinema? Thirty years after Caro Diario, filmmaker Pablo Maqueda leaves Madrid on a Vespa, chasing the sun of Moretti’s Italy. With eight friends by his side, he embarks on a journey where laughter, memory, and film intertwine. As reels roll and roads unfold, reality gently fades – and what begins as a tribute becomes a meditation on how cinema doesn’t just reftect life, but transforms it.

title: Antes de Cambiar
overview: Carolina and Lucas are a couple celebrating their first anniversary. On their way to the place where they met, Carolina begins to have doubts about their relationship, the changes within herself, and what the future holds.

title: As Long As It Snows
overview: As a child, Margo witnesses her best friend vanish into a snowstorm, marking her for life. Twenty years later, now a teacher, one of her students vanishes under similar circumstances. During the search, she meets a man who bears an unsettling resemblance to her childhood friend.

title: What We Carry
overview: Stranded in the rural American South, an Ivorian couple must fight to escape an unknown predator.

title: Someone's Daughter
overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

title: The Blow
overview: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

title: Kingpins
overview: Drowning in unpaid bills, an actress-slash-waitress hatches a plan to rob her workplace. When the heist goes wrong, she must give the performance of a lifetime to clear her name.

title: Forever, This Ring
overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

title: Signs Of Fatigue
overview: A young music teacher named Ivan falls ill with a condition that seems indistinguishable from an ordinary flu. He tries to continue his everyday life but the symptoms do not subside and only intensify, gradually distorting his perception of the world and of himself.

title: Emily
overview: Following the steps of an ancient ritual, Michael is granted entry to a mysterious temple. Inside, he attempts to bring his lost love back to life.

title: Loulou
overview: Grieving his father, eight-year-old Sam chases a butterfly, saves it from a lake, and tries everything to keep his new companion LouLou alive.

title: El pintor de los milagros
overview: After an accident leaves his daughter in a coma, Francisco, a seasoned journalist, tries to rebuild his life by accepting a seemingly minor assignment: uncovering the origins of the ancient mural of the Black Christ, venerated by millions. His search leads him to Santiago, who reveals the untold story of the image's mysterious creator: a young man enslaved in 17th-century Peru, known only as "The Painter." Amid discrimination and suffering, the young man transforms his pain into an extraordinary work: a Black Christ that, over the centuries, would become the most important symbol of faith in our nation and one of the most venerated in the world. As he reconstructs this story of hope, resilience, and redemption, Francisco embarks on a journey that will forever change his understanding of faith and restore his belief that miracles are still possible.

title: Discovery
overview: Will recruits his friend Aaron to film the greatest discovery in the history of human kind.

title: Honey Bun
overview: After finding her mother drunk at a karaoke bar, a young woman reluctantly brings her home for the night. The two are forced to confront the complicated question of whether either of them truly love each other.

title: City of Masks
overview: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.

title: Good Old Days
overview: Four young skaters spend an afternoon claiming an abandoned factory as their playground, moving from one forbidden urban spot to the next. When the security abruptly cut their session short, the day ends with one of them under arrest. Years later, one of the skaters looks back on a fleeting moment of youth, freedom, and friendship that has stayed with him ever since.

title: Mindshare: The Download
overview: After joining Mindshare, Evan begins experiencing vivid flashes of a life he doesn't remember. The company insists these are normal side effects of neural acclimation, but Evan soon discovers that his memories have been edited, replaced, and repurposed. As he uncovers the identity of the man whose memories he carries, Evan realizes he is living a borrowed life, and Mindshare will do anything to keep him from reclaiming his own.

title: Cypress Under the Moon
overview: Atsushi Egawa is a 32-year-old aspiring novelist who works part-time and complains that the world is ugly and people are cruel. When his optimistic girlfriend finally leaves him, Egawa sets out to prove that society is at fault—and that winning her back will follow. His stubborn, illogical quest brings him into contact with others and forces him to confront his heartbreak and himself.

title: Contrapunto
overview: Luca is a teenager who loses his mother. On her deathbed, she gives him two letters: one for him and another for Ángel, his father, a renowned jazz musician whom Luca has never met. We follow Luca throughout the day as, motivated by his mother’s letter, he decides to deliver the letter to Ángel in an attempt to establish a bond with his father.

title: Tenfa
overview: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

title: Holofiction
overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.

title: Abode of Heaven
overview: For the first time in 35 years, musicians set out from the entrance of the Zangezur Corridor toward ancient Ordubad. In neighborhoods that have become part of the region's historical heritage, *Ordubad bayatis* are performed to the accompaniment of authentic music for the first time. Customs and traditions—spanning from the city center to the most remote villages, previously unspoken of and unique to this area—are being brought to life. The musicians' primary mission is to reveal the rhythms of Ordubad—rhythms that have endured for millennia yet remained hidden until now.

title: Million Dollar Guy
overview: After winning 12 million euros in the lottery, Andi turns his life upside down and buys everything he's ever wanted. But as he gains power and success, he starts to lose the things money can't buy.

title: Convent
overview: Thurgau, present day: For the anniversary of the Catholic convent of Tobel, the local TV station follows a community on the brink. Only two elderly nuns remain behind its walls, while overwhelmed civil servant Toni keeps things running. Secretly he hides Lee , a wanted hacktivist – rude, nerdy, and queer as fuck – beneath the convent walls. When Sister Hildegard dies and church and political authorities plan to turn the convent into a luxury yoga retreat, Scholastika fights back against patriarchal structures.

title: The Black Pearl
overview: A young engineer's dream of becoming a fighter pilot for the Royal Moroccan Air Force is put on hold until he unravels the mystery of his missing parents.

title: Sepultura at the Instituto Nacional: Labor Omnia Vincit
overview: In 2003, the courtyard of the Instituto Nacional—one of Chile's most iconic high schools—became the setting for a historic moment: a concert by the iconic Brazilian band SEPULTURA, organized by students.

title: Pick Up
overview: An uber driver’s day spirals into chaos when a passenger reveals the dark truth about his missing daughter.

title: The Third Murder
overview: When businessman Boban is murdered in the same manner as drug peddler Justin, DYSP Christy brings in ex-cop Swamy, an expert in serial killer cases. Their investigation leads to Aditya, a troubled teenager caught in conflict with his eccentric father, as hidden motives emerge and a deadly hunt begins to stop a third murder.

title: Florêncio Guerra e Seu Cavalo
overview: Is time a sentence? Florêncio Guerra, a simple old pawn, goes over life in this essay on humanity when he receives the difficult mission of his boss: to kill his horse!

title: 12 Letters of Christmas
overview: A Christmas movie.

title: Maria Merciful Mind
overview: A woman tormented by trauma, anxiety, and a fractured sense of reality reaches her breaking point until a life-changing confession forces her to confront her past, setting her on a powerful journey toward faith, healing, and redemption.

title: È andata così
overview: Cecilia, a determined mother of two with three failed relationships behind her, faces an unexpected crisis and turns to the three fathers of her children - Christophe, her first love and daughter’s father; Guido, her son’s father and former manager turned rider; and Tony, her estranged ex-husband and self-styled music manager - for support.

title: Lamina
overview: David spends his days sanding scars out of other people’s marble and wood, making the past look brand new again. Nights he sits outside his ex-wife’s loft like a man waiting for a ghost that never quite arrives. Then one barroom massacre changes everything. A stranger pulls him out of the slaughter a second before the shooting starts, almost like he’d seen it coming.  Now David is becoming unstuck. Moments stutter. Hours repeat. Reality folds in on itself. The stranger offers no explanations, only grim little jobs he calls the Moments. Some things, it turns out, can never be restored.

title: The Act of Cutting Away
overview: Insurmountable medical bureaucracy pushes Roland, a transmasculine college student, to the absolute brink. Desperate for top surgery but blocked by systemic gatekeeping, his reality fractures when he discovers a classmate running a clandestine, illegal dissection operation. What started as a struggle against healthcare politics instantly devolves into a grim, body-horror bargain for survival.

title: Into Black
overview: Amidst the chaos and destruction of the London Blitz, four women become trapped in an abandoned warehouse, where they must fight to survive against a murderous stranger known as The Blackout Ripper. Inspired by true events.

title: Lottie Dottie Chicken: The Movie
overview: When a clumsy stork mixed up the eggs during delivery, Lottie Dottie Chicken's first egg ends up in the nest of a fearsome hawk in the mountains.

title: I Want to Be Like You
overview: New Konstantin Bojanov movie

title: Sicrun
overview: Four young women on vacation take refuge in a nearby village after their car breaks down. Initially, the village seems quiet and ordinary, but as they spend time there, they encounter inexplicable events. When they try to leave, they realize they are surrounded. Upon discovering that the village has been under the rule of a tribe of jinn called Sicrun for centuries, the young women begin searching for a way to survive.

title: Kyiv. Day-Night
overview: The beloved main cast of the cult classic TV series Kyiv. Day and Night decide to take a road trip, reopening the doors to the memories of the past.

title: La Grande Histoire de la Marine
Reteté
overview: The 1990s. A radiant, indomitable girl is medicated until she becomes the well-behaved child the church demands. To reclaim the daughter she once knew, her mother must confront her congregation, her family, and even God.

title: Bleeding Humanity
overview: Stemming from her adoption, a curious girl navigates who she is and what defines her as human, confronted by her relationship with her sister and an exotic encounter that becomes the catalyst.

title: Midday Meal
overview: In a parched badland village that looks like the end of the world, Solan is the only teacher. After years of enduring the poorly paid temporary job, he holds one modest dream - to become a full-time teacher and to live in a proper house with his mother. But everything begins to unravel with the death of the benefactor who had funded the school’s meal program.

title: ContainMint
overview: After a disastrous poker game, DK Brooks steals a case containing $10,000 and mysterious mints, drawing the attention of a ruthless collector who will stop at nothing to get them back.

title: Bluebird
overview: Noah leaves London behind for the industrial banks of the Thames, where they’re invited into a state of in-between, as the city fades away and the river turns to sea.  Searching for direction on the quiet banks, they encounter a dancer, whose movement gives form to Noah’s unspoken thoughts. Stirred by the moment, they’re then met with a mysterious figure who reawakens their sense of purpose and hope. Noah begins to mirror the shifting landscape, learning to find comfort in flux.  A meditative, voiceover-driven film written by Zohrab Yoncali, based on the PhD research of artist Nic Farr.

title: Sinsin and the Mouse
overview: Still grieving the loss of her mother, Chizumi travels to Taipei at a friend's invitation. There she meets Shingo, aka Sinsin, who has a Japanese father and a Taiwanese mother. By spending time together in Taipei, Chizumi is freed from her feelings of loss.

title: A Winter Melody
overview: Luxembourg, 2004. An immigrant mother tries to do everything within her power to buy her child a piano for Christmas, navigating the socioeconomic challenges of their everyday life.

title: Purple Haze
overview: After a traumatic night, a passive boyfriend is pulled through the nostalgia of music into memories that force him to question whether he should confront the past or be the same in the future.

title: Jean Gabin - La guerre, c'est pas du cinéma !
Bhootu Aaya Bhago
overview: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

title: Swans: Newly Sentient Being
overview: Goodbye to this stellar version of Swans. Newly Sentient Being features superb recordings of Swans’ final concert of the “Big Sound” era, the apotheosis of 15 years of cosmic sonic expressionism, alternately heavenly and debased, visceral and transcendent.

title: The Night That Binds Us
overview: A lone student in Shanghai, struggling with family problems, finds romance with a middle-aged dorm manager.

title: Sul cammino di Francesco - La vita di Biagio Conte
MI SE PARE CĂ O SĂ SE TOPEASCĂ PODEAUA
overview: After a breakup, Matei returns Ioana's remaining belongings and discovers her new activity—swimming lessons—which she teaches at her home, undeterred by the lack of pools or other bodies of water in the city. In the middle of the lesson, Ioana tells Matei about her new life and the people in it: the three elderly students she teaches, Ina, Silvia, and Ion.

title: If You Are Reading This...
overview: Cassandra travels to Philadelphia in search of her brother, but instead finds a phylactery she must destroy. Cosmic horror descends upon her as her mission is impeded by a crawling force dragging her into madness. As she begins to understand what is happening, she becomes a victim of the same celestial force that made her brother vanish. Trapped with nowhere to go, she is nevertheless on the path to solving the mystery.

title: The Cycle of Love
overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

title: Relict
overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

title: The Six
overview: In the early 1980s, six young people came together in Antwerp and, armed with nothing but vision, courage, and radical independence, transformed the fashion world. Forty years later, they look back on a time when creativity trumped convention and commerce.

title: Thunder Queens
overview: A portrait of young women artists turning the volume all the way up, finding power in connection, and making the stage feel possible for younger girls coming up behind them.

title: Se métamorphoser?
overview: I long for a world built on solidarity. But when I take a closer look, I realize I’m not capable of that myself: I don’t know how to build healthy, equal relationships. So, with the help of the camera, I’m exploring the dynamics of my relationships with two people close to me, Mar and Christal. Where does my chronic sense of guilt come from? How can I find my way back to connection? An intimate cinematic-therapeutic journey of discovery.

title: Lāu Tsa-Pôo (Before We Say Goodbye)
overview: Two 60-ish Taiwanese men share ambiguous closeness, built on ritual and obscurity in an old local bathhouse. Amidst a near-death accident, the body offers a final confession, revealing a lifetime of repressed desire that surfaces only when time runs out.

title: My Christmas Storybook with You
overview: An unexpected Christmas romance sparks when a beloved children's author teams up with a gruff handyman to write a new book in a last ditch effort to save her career.

title: A Warm Gaze: Mehmet Güreli
overview: A Warm Gaze: Mehmet Güreli explores the multifaceted body of work of Mehmet Güreli, one of Türkiye’s leading artists and a master of music, cinema, painting, and literature. Through the lens of Gamze Terra, the documentary offers an intimate journey into Güreli’s profound and multilayered artistic universe.

title: One of Them
overview: Audrey is a young woman from Lens who dreams of escaping her fate when she meets the Authentiks, a group of Ultras football fans. With them she discovers the fervour of a new world and gradually changes her outlook on herself and the world in ways she never imagined.

title: Beyond the Smiles: Yani Tseng
overview: This film follows the historic and unparalleled rise, fall, and epic comeback of global golf icon Yani TSENG, who returns to the golf course, faces twists and challenges, and embarks on a quest to explore her life’s purpose in 2024.

title: The North
overview: A decade after they were best friends and roommates, Chris and Lluis set out on a 600 kilometer hike through the Scottish Highlands to reconnect with each other, nature and parts of themselves they lost.

title: Madeline's Curse
overview: Esperanza, a nurse about to retire, becomes involved in the lives of two young patients from a psychiatric center, fallen angels with opposite goals: vengeance and recovery through love.

title: Dead Company
overview: The official hand-animated movie for Royal Blood's third single and title track of their fifth album.

title: Frost
overview: A rational, and emotionally distant female police detective investigates the disappearance of a girl in a region famous for black magic and pagan heritage. Her investigation gradually becomes a journey into a mythical world.

title: BPC4
overview: Bpc 4 ever

title: Between the Lines
overview: In a small town near a military base, a woman in her late forties forms an unexpected bond with a young soldier, sparking a journey that challenges her marriage and faith – and ultimately leads her and her husband toward surrender, renewal, and the redemptive power of forgiveness.

title: JJ: Every Inch a King
overview: Jüri Järvet didn't believe in talent. When praised, he would reply that if people knew how hard he worked, they would stop calling it talent. He went to drama school because of a girl. He could never learn his lines sitting down. He went to the screen test for Grigori Kozintsev's "King Lear" almost as a joke. Lear, and later Snaut in Andrei Tarkovsky's "Solaris", made him one of the most internationally recognised Estonian actors. Yet he opened the sports pages before the arts section, made a mean stew, and turned up late to performances because of a game of chess. Thirty years after his death, Järvet speaks again. Drawn from unseen home movies, letters, interviews and memoirs, his own voice returns through AI. Jüri Järvet's story is told by Järvet himself.

title: Kärlek och andra diagnoser
overview: A romantic dramedy about a young couple on the Autism Spectrum who try to answer life's most difficult question: What the hell do you do when you fall in love?

title: Carta a uma Jovem Escritora
overview: Carta a Uma Jovem Escritora is a reflection on memory and forgetting, presented through five striking portraits of five Portuguese women writers: Olga Gonçalves, Graça Pina de Morais, Maria Cecília Correia, Alice Sampaio, and Maria Amélia Neto.

title: Dafne y Pol
overview: Dafne and Clara are two classmates who endure harassment at school because of their sexual orientation. Clara tries to stand up to her classmates' homophobic remarks by treating her relationship with Dafne as something completely normal.

title: Snow Leopard
overview: When his older sister Samantha leaves their small Colorado town for college, sixteen-year-old Owen is left behind with a silence he doesn't know how to fill. With Samantha hundreds of miles away, Owen finds himself drifting through empty rooms and long, quiet days as the distance between them slowly reshapes his world.

title: Welcome to Dolly's House
overview: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

title: Ghosthing
overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

title: Through the Cracks
overview: Plagued by a persistent rattling noise inside his head, a soon-to-be bridegroom desperately searches for its source and discovers an irrepressible truth.

title: Pripyat Piano
overview: 26 April 1986: Chernobyl’s reactor number 4 explodes and provokes the biggest nuclear disaster in history. Pripyat, where the plant is located, becomes a ghost city. Guided by former inhabitants, Eliška Cílková takes us in her quest of the town’s memory. Gracefully shot, the film reminds us the power of music where less expected.

title: Haunted House
overview: A local businessman wants to demolish an old house where children spend their time playing and growing up, in order to make room for parking his trucks. Luka, one of the boys, seeks help from a monster he believes lives in the house. But when that help comes in the form of his father being injured during the demolition, Luka begins to believe that he is responsible for the accident.

title: Space
overview: Ep 1. Jung-ho and So-yeon, a cohabiting couple in their 40s, previously agreed not to have children. However, Jung-ho demands a child, using his mother as an excuse. So-yeon, an unknown actress, feels deeply betrayed, and in that moment, her body turns transparent before his eyes. Ep 2. Pursued by a mysterious floating knife, In-cheol lives with his son, Jin-woo, following a business failure and divorce. Jin-woo abandons his dreams and breaks up with his girlfriend. After they argue and blame each other, Jin-woo leaves home. The knife chasing In-cheol finally locates their house. Ep 3. A year later, Jung-ho struggles with his failing restaurant afloat, while Jin-woo wanders without a home. Jin-woo earns, borrows, and even extracts money from Jung-ho. As they clash, Jung-ho finds it increasingly impossible to understand who Jin-woo truly is.

title: Master Zhong
overview: A girl meets Zhong Kui, the deity who vanquishes ghosts and demons. Partnering to solve cases, they discover a great conspiracy against the mortal realm.

title: Ruby, Ruby
overview: When they awaken a deadly curse, two young women, Ollie and Hannah, find themselves trapped in a haunted cemetery with a malicious predator, thrusting them into a nightmarish battle for survival against evils, both supernatural and human.

title: Yes, Mistress
overview: At 61, Steve leads a seemingly ordinary routine life. But behind this facade hides a much more complex universe: that of BDSM, where the body becomes a field of pleasure and exploration of submission. This anthropologically inspired documentary paints an intimate portrait of this man who, through his fantasies, seeks to redefine his relationship with the body, desire and his deep identity. By diving into his most abstract motivations, the film questions what this quest for control… and abandonment reveals.

title: Clubfoot
overview: After fleeing his unstable home, an adopted teenager and his only friend abduct and violently assault a younger boy. As night falls, their lives begin  to unravel.

title: Chumpa: A Doll Under the Basket
overview: Fourteen-year-old Muna wants nothing more than to stay in school, but her dreams are crushed by her village’s rigid tradition of forced early marriage. She turns to her teacher for help, only to be dismissed by the villagers, who ask what use an education could possibly be. In the end, the wedding proceeds, and her dream seems to fade with no way out.

title: Patintero
overview: A documentary on women who have chosen prostitution as their livelihood, tracing their  experiences, the factors that led them there, and its effects on their lives.

title: Royal Opera House: Carmen
overview: Carmen declares that any man she loves should beware. However, even she is unprepared for what will happen when she decides to seduce Don José, an army corporal who initially appears uninterested in her charms. Don José soon abandons his sweetheart Micaëla and his army job for Carmen, and joins her and her smuggler friends in the mountains. But Carmen quickly wearies of Don José's possessiveness. When she turns her attentions to the dashing toreador Escamillo, Don José's jealousy erupts into violence.

title: Last Night at the Alamo
overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

title: Buff
overview: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo buffalo for which she will trek the American southwest in an attempt to free it and herself. Starring Jena Malone (The Hunger Games series, The Neon Demon) and Joshua Close (Killers of the Flower Moon, Fargo TV series).

title: Carla Lonzi, A Feminist Story
overview: Alongside the public figure Carla Lonzi, considered to be so uncompromising, there is much to say about her private side, as fascinating as it was contradictory. There’s her tenderness and emotional fragility, her dependence on her partner, hence on a man; her complicated feelings about motherhood; and strained relationships with other women in the practice of collective harikiri called “consciousness-raising”. Drawing on invaluable, unreleased archive material, the filmmaker Francesca Archibugi, who was very close to Lonzi, brings her public life and private story, her ideas, and her legacy to the screen for the first time. These are key to understanding what women around the world are still going through and fighting for.

title: Siesta
overview: Conchita, a young woman unable to escape her constant exhaustion, embarks on a journey between dream and reality through a deserted Granada to confront herself and finish the Cruz de Mayo in time for the festivities.

title: Sweet Bitter Sweet
overview: A young Chinese woman relocates to London and works at a bakery while seeking love.

title: Dances with Weights
overview: After a misunderstanding, a famous strength athletics trainer accidentally finds himself at the position of training an elite dance squad, creating a conflict of interests which only increases after his protege Sashko falls in love with Milana, one of the the dance squad's most talented members. Will the two sides use their strengths to work together or will this match made in Hell crash and burn?

title: Un ángel para Maruja
overview: All but resigned to being trapped on the ground by an illness that makes orientation in flight impossible, a pigeon finds refuge in the home of Maruja, a lonely old woman determined to help the bird return to the sky.

title: Sally
overview: Shortly before her first major stage performance, Sally realizes just how ruthless the music industry can be. She comes under increasing pressure, caught between her manager's expectations and the strains of her personal life.

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: Ana the Cleaner
overview: Ana spends her days cleaning the homes of Chicago's elite while feeding an obsession with true crime. When one of her clients suddenly disappears, Ana becomes convinced she's uncovered the perfect murder.

title: The Girl with the Leica
overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

title: First Days
overview: Two spirits encounter each other in a limbo – a place between the earthly and the beyond. The two spirits are still trapped in their human shells, but have already lost the ability to speak. They will only spend a few days in limbo, before a wandering light leads them to the next world.

title: Nightmare Hospital
overview: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

title: Bagel GO
overview: To Ming, Yuhe sparkled brighter than anyone. She was certain Yuhe would win the Bagel Idol Selection and fulfill her dream. As for Ming, she dreamed of becoming Hero Bagel, a hero to save the world. Whenever Yuhe needed help, she could leap in and declare: “Here comes the hero!”

title: Die Prinzessin aus Glas
overview: Hans is the son of a glassmaker – and deaf. Where his daredevil brother failed, he sets out to free Princess Anna, whom a powerful duke holds captive in a glass cage.

title: Despedirse
overview: After a tragic event, Noah must take a road trip to say goodbye.

title: Caro mondo crudele
overview: Giovanna, a twelve-year-old born and raised in a small village near Grosseto, possesses an extraordinary imagination and cannot come to terms with the mysterious disappearance of her best friend, Mirko—who has left her all alone to face the bullies at school. Determined to uncover the truth, the courageous girl sets off on an adventure all by herself.

title: Scholarship
overview: A fictional action comedy about an incredibly clumsy robbery.

title: Haunted
overview: Mathilde, a troubled teenage girl who moves to the countryside with her family, finds out her new home is haunted by Isabeau, an amnesiac 19th-century ghost. The two form an unexpected friendship and team up to uncover Isabeau's past.

title: Passing The Bar
overview: A job interview at a cocktail bar goes wildly off-menu when the interviewer decides to down every drink made for him.

title: Wakesurf Lovers
overview: Amidst a rising wakesurfing craze, surf instructor Man (Renci Yeung) is falsely accused and publicly shamed online. Among the trolls is Chuan (Jeffrey Ngai), a surfing novice whose satirical video mocking her goes viral. Upon realizing the rumors were entirely fabricated and that he has ruined her reputation, a guilt-ridden Chuan signs up for Man's lessons under his real identity to make amends.  As they connect beyond the digital noise, a genuine romance blossoms. To clear her name, Chuan devises a plan to expose the disgruntled student who started the smear campaign, while encouraging Man to reclaim her professional standing by challenging celebrity coach Joe (Kevin Chu).

title: Posers
overview: Munro Logan And Emme Go To A Gig, The Gig  Afterwards Munro Realises His Friends Are Not Who They Claim To Be

title: Testing Testing Sandi Bachom
overview: An unlikely citizen journalist finds redemption on the frontlines documenting white supremacy and domestic terrorism in the United States, beginning with Charlottesville.

title: Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR
overview: In the 1980s, the GDR provided shelter to ten RAF terrorists. The State Security Service (Stasi) furnished these individuals — who had left the group — with new identities, enabling them to lead inconspicuous lives within the GDR. Among them was Silke Maier-Witt, a member of the second generation of the RAF, who had been involved in the kidnapping of Hanns Martin Schleyer. She recounts her experiences during her time in the socialist German state. Filmmaker Claus Räfle reconstructs how the Stasi protected these former terrorists and concealed their identities. Through interviews with Silke Maier-Witt, other contemporary witnesses, and experts — complemented by archival footage and photorealistic, AI-animated scenes (created by Helmut Fischer and Parviz Balucci) that capture the atmosphere of the era — the film unfolds as a historical documentary-thriller.

title: Pluto
overview: Green alien Pluto feels like a misfit on his stop-motion planet.

title: Ria
overview: Facing the threat of demolition from a ruthless developer, young folk-punk Ria joins her foster mother and their punk community to defend their home, the last surviving building standing amid the ruins of their neighborhood.

title: Foka
overview: Dr. Dimitri Foka, a Greek doctor from Turkey, survives a Nazi execution in Greece during World War II thanks to his Turkish passport. After graduating, he returns to his hometown, the island of Imroz (Gökçeada), part of Turkey, and becomes the island’s only doctor for many years. Following the Cyprus problem in 1964, state policies targeting the Greek population lead to dispossession, violence, and forced migration on the island, yet Foka refuses to leave.

title: Red Razor On Soft Skin
overview: A giallo horror film about Benny Lazar, a timid son forced by his mother Moira to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. What ensues is a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction.

title: Shabara
overview: An adventure written in the stars and across time.

title: Yoe Gone
overview: U Kyaw Khaung, an honest and dedicated railway gatekeeper, takes great pride in his humble profession and values integrity above wealth and social status. Despite financial struggles, he strives to provide for his family and raise his children with dignity. However, differences in values and growing tensions between generations begin to strain their family bonds. When unexpected circumstances bring a mysterious young woman named Bwe Ya into their lives, her presence gradually becomes a source of warmth and reconciliation. As the family faces hardship, misunderstandings, and conflicts driven by pride and material wealth, they must rediscover the meaning of love, sacrifice, and the true dignity of an honest life.

title: Heirloom
overview: After receiving an heirloom sauce recipe from his late father, a grieving son is consumed by his obsession with growing tomatoes.

title: Beach Fictions
overview: On a train, a novelist meets Tae-ju, a young woman who resembles the protagonist of her novel in progress. Tae-ju runs away from damaging rumors to a seaside town. There, she meets Man-hyuk, a street magician, and feels drawn to him—only to hear unsettling rumors about him. Unsure of what to believe, Tae-ju visits a fortune-teller mentioned as being remarkably accurate.

title: Bloodlines: Game of Death Chapter 3
overview: One day after the massacre of Unit 1 in dark secrets, the regime is trying to stop the demons from invading and conquering earth. At the same time our two heroes Scott and Raya meet and have to take a final stand at Walter’s bar. This is where the next chapter of the game of death begins!

title: The Little Ring
overview: A suspicious man drifts apart from his girlfriend over conflicts surrounding their artistic careers, forcing him to put his marriage proposal on hold indefinitely. After the pair travels to the Tibetan regions together, their relationship crumbles completely, culminating in an unexpected ending.

title: IU CONCERT - The Golden Hour
overview: Experience IU's first ever global cinema release, as the first Korean female singer to perform at the iconic Olympic Main Stadium in Seoul, the largest stadium in South Korea and the dream venue for music artists.  Starting with a thrilling acapella opening, the setlist is filled with beloved songs from across IU’s career. From the floating strawberry moon balloon, to fireworks and a stunning drone show, the enchanting stage production is a must-see in cinemas.  Embrace the happiness of the unforgettable 'Golden Hour' through IU's legendary performances and a fully-charged live show.

title: Black Soil
overview: In this portrait of the enduring contributions of Black farmers, Herbert Allen Jr. and his son, Trentis carry their family legacy forward as they steward the land with regenerative practices in the Mississippi Delta.

title: Togel: Diantara PHK dan Hutang
overview: After losing his job, Agus pretends to leave for work every morning to spare his pregnant wife the truth. Instead, he roams the streets looking for work and borrowing money just to survive. When Rijal, an old friend with a gambling habit and a talent for bad decisions, reappears, Agus tries his luck with a lottery "magic book" that promises winning numbers. Instead of getting rich, he is chased by debt collectors and forced to hide from his wife's family. Things get stranger when he meets Om Jhon, a quirky ghost who claims to know the secret to lucky numbers. Desperate for one number to change his life, Agus is pulled into a chaotic, darkly funny adventure.

title: Three Millimeters to You
overview: Tatsuhiko, a quiet high school student in the coastal city of Karatsu, spends his days fishing and drifting through adolescence. Just before summer vacation, Yoon-seul, an exchange student from Busan, joins his class. As they grow closer, Tatsuhiko gradually discovers the heartfelt reason she chose this small Japanese town. However, an innocent remark unexpectedly hurts Yoon-seul, and she abruptly returns to Korea. Unable to let go of his regret, Tatsuhiko makes a life-changing decision—to cross the sea in search of the girl he never truly had the chance to understand.

title: Thaainilam
overview: A father and his daughter came to India as refugees post-war in their country. Few good hands help them to rebuild their lifestyle.

title: Simon. The Conqueror!
overview: The world's greatest detective enters into the town of New Babel. Only to be faced with a grand mystery that only he could conquer... Maybe.

title: Beyond Love's Horizon
overview: Taeyoung and Jumi, a married couple who have closed down their shop, are at a loss. Then, like a miracle, new life arrives. The road through pregnancy, childbirth, childrearing, and caregiving proves far more grueling and arduous than expected. Overwhelmed by extreme physical and mental exhaustion, the couple fumbles, falters, stumbles, and slips again and again. And yet, their child is pure, absolute joy.

title: Why Not?
overview: Through the relationship between Maria Prata and her grandmother, Laura Góes, the documentary explores why so many people prefer not to confront issues related to the climate crisis despite the wealth of available information and the occurrence of recurring global tragedies. The film interweaves the pair’s walks through the century-old garden the family matriarch planted in the mountains of Rio de Janeiro state with interviews featuring prominent figures who have, in one way or another, engaged with this conversation.

title: Rhapsody for the Dead
overview: ‘Soo-ah’ spends hellish days everyday due to dating violence of her live-in boyfriend, ‘Hyun-woo’. ‘Anuat’, a man full of mystery, stays by the side of her. Soo-ah goes on a trip to an island with her only friends ‘Yoon-mi’ and Hyun-woo to celebrate her 25th birthday. On the night of the full moon, Anuat follows the footsteps of Soo-ah and encounters evil spirits surrounding her.

title: The One. For New York.
overview: Follow Dinosaur Jr. and friends across three wild days in the city as they take their "ear-bleeding country" from honky tonks to Tompkins Square Park.

title: Calendar
overview: A retired workaholic tries to put new meaning into his days. He comes across his wife’s tear-off calendar, with birthdays of friends and relatives marked. Calling people long since forgotten leads to consequences no one could have guessed.

title: There Will Be Snow
overview: As Fireworks, an intelligent urban system, transforms everyday life, a dance teacher from the fading city of Glaceterre is invited to the smart region just as a disillusioned engineer returns. Amid demolition and memories of ice and flame, she must choose between efficiency and human connection—and decide what it means to remain human.

title: Things I Left at the Theater
overview: Film critic Dogyeong belatedly learns of an old friend's death. As it happens, this comes not long after the demolition of an old theater in Gangwon Province. Somehow, the two events do not feel all that different to her. As her work as a critic takes her from place to place, Dogyeong searches for her late friend’s short film and visits theaters and screening spaces where it might once have been shown.

title: A Three-story House
overview: Six-year-old Wenwen pounds on her locked door. Ignored, she cries to Grandma, who threatens her with a slipper. Grandpa arrives, ordering Grandma to cook, and slaps her backtalk. The arcade poodle bolts to the roof while Second Aunt screams curses. Tension fills the entire house.

title: Dead Weight
overview: Hasan & Omar have to deal with the lifeless body of their friend after an all night study session. Hasan contemplates chopping him up or dissolving him in acid. Whilst Omar, more rooted in reality, insists they wrap him in a rug, take him to the car and bury him 'somewhere nice'. The only problem is, their flat is on the 14th floor, with no lift and it's broad daylight...

title: Ayahuasca Haunting: The Vine of Souls
overview: A reclusive prodigy turns to the occult, brewing ayahuasca, the fabled vine of souls, and unknowingly opens a portal, unleashing an entity from another dimension.

title: A Day Like a Week
overview: Stanley Truman is arrested by the police and subjected to an intense interrogation led by Inspector Thomas Pressman, who is determined to uncover the horrifying events that destroyed Stan and his family. But the more Stan reveals, the darker and more disturbing his story becomes…  Hallucinations? Manipulation? Demonic presence?

title: Where is Saoud?
overview: On a casual night out at the farmhouse, Hamood and his prankster brother Sa3oud perform a magic trick to an audience of friends. Hamood is successful in making Sa3oud disappear, but not reappear, and everyone ponders…Sa3oud wainah?A series of eerie events begins to unfold when a strange character appears at the farmhouse. The question becomes, is all of this a well-thought-out elaborate prank, or is it a series of unfortunate events?

title: Toy Bunny
overview: Following the events of Pet Bunny: Ivory (or Willow/"Will") has moved back in with her parents and their dogs. After the dogs rip apart a toy bunny - and a bottle of mysterious fluid spills, onto a wooden hare - this family finds themselves faced with an inhuman threat.

title: Honey's Christmas Wish
overview: After a variety of mysterious gifts and good deeds pop up around Honey's Guesthouse, Brittany tries to uncover who amongst the visitors is behind it in this charming Christmas whodunnit.

title: Sheroes
overview: An anthology film featuring three distinct, gripping stories titled Artist, Gear Up, and Punch.

title: Not for You
overview: Eunwoo, Seungwoo, and Yunyoung met at a support group for survivors of suicide loss. Having each experienced the loss of someone close to them, they often spend time together. They visit the Hantan River together, where Seungwoo's late father's ashes were scattered, and help Yunyoung move into her first place of her own. It was those they lost who brought the three of them together.

title: Liz Here Now
overview: Liz Baxter, who works as a nanny for a prominent, has a white family in Oakland, California, during the rise of the Black Panther Party in 1967. When Liz discovers that the Connor children are suffering under the hand of their mother, Jane, and attempts to step in to protect the children, she’s accused of participating in a Black Panther conspiracy.

title: The Fencing Tournament
