overview: At the final match of a fencing tournament, Anja watches her son lose to one of his friends. When his rivalry turns into racism and violence, she becomes the only witness to what truly happened. Torn between shame, ambition and the fear of admitting the truth, Anja finds herself caught in a profound moral conflict.

title: Between Summers
overview: Between french fries, TikToks, and sunscreen, carefree moments clash with self-doubt, and playful freedom with societal pressure. This is the vibrant world of adolescents searching for their place – on the lawn and in life. When the orange slide is torn down, the chapter of childhood comes to an end. Two years later, after the renovation, it's not just the public pool that has changed.

title: Close
overview: Keane, nearing thirty, finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Robo-Pal
overview: Lex Luthor deploys a robo-dog to hunt Superman and Supergirl, but the mission unravels when Krypto and the machine become best friends.

title: The Cursed Land
overview: A widower and his daughter travel's to Thailand's deep south to seek help from a Muslim doctor after unleashing a djinn in a rundown house.

title: The Ghost Has No Home
overview: After her sister’s sudden death, Oliwia returns from Berlin to Warsaw and unexpectedly becomes the temporary caretaker of her eleven-year-old nephew. In the days that follow, she faces a quiet reckoning: return to her life abroad or try to become a home for him.

title: Fish the Moon
overview: Follows a writer who begins getting calls from a government appointed censor who is tasked with monitoring his online output for ‘public security purposes’ and has a front row seat to his every move. Within that space—where things are created, consumed, edited and debated—a strange and unlikely connection occurs.

title: Echoes of the Fallen
overview: The mysterious appearance of the Black and White Impermanence spreads fear throughout Chang'an, prompting an investigation that reveals they are people controlled by magic.

title: Dancer of the Republic
overview: As Linda prepares to dance in a cabaret in Beirut, the end of the Lebanese Civil War is proclaimed. The announcement of the Syrian regime’s troops entering Lebanon makes Linda question whether the war has truly come to an end.

title: This Very Second
overview: After losing his partner, astronomer Wang Ren, Nuqiu takes a job as a janitor at the astronomical institute where Wang once worked. There he meets Lin, Wang's former colleague. As the two grow closer, an unseen force quietly pulls them together, like gravity.

title: Topol: On Top of the World
overview: Through a personal archive and portraits he painted throughout his life, the film returns to the moments he chose, and to those in which he almost missed the roles of his life. From them, a much more complex man than the charismatic star he is known for is revealed. An actor, inventor, and institution figure, who began to direct more and more of his energy elsewhere, away from the spotlight.

title: SAYANG
overview: Nancy, an Indian-descended mother, returns to her hometown and opens a sign language school while caring for her son Ajay, who lives with both hearing impairment and a neurological condition. Among her students are Mina, a Malay girl determined to become a Muay Thai boxer despite cultural expectations, and Sansan, a Chinese girl deeply bound to the ocean she loves. Along the vast coastline, three families and three children navigate faith, identity, and freedom, until their intertwined lives become a moving symphony of resilience and love.

title: Señor Apache
overview: Fifty-six years after their smash hit “Fue en un café”, the trace of stardom still beats in the present of Los Apson, the creators of border rock from Agua Prieta, Sonora. From a distance, in his prison cell, lead singer Frankie Gámez accompanies saxophonists Lichi García and Gil Maldonado on a crusade to reclaim the band's legacy.

title: CAMPEÓN
overview: Emma's life violently unravels as she is both the obsession of a narcissistic addict, and the fault line between identical brothers.

title: Sydney vs. Sean
overview: SYDNEY VS SEAN follows Sydney, a red-carpet host chasing perfection, and Sean, a bisexual nurse clinging to independence. A hookup grows into a passionate but volatile romance. After a year apart, the turbulent day of their divorce signing ricochets between past and present. When their eccentric notary arrives, he witnesses two lovers confront a bond that can’t be sustained, yet refuses to fade. Starring JANEL PARRISH (Pretty Little Liars, "To All The Boys" Trilogy) , T.R. KNIGHT (Grey's Anatomy, The Flight Attendant), RYAN POWERS (She-Hulk, The Mandalorian), and ARDEN MYRIN (Free Bert, The Righteous Gemstones)

title: Pimpin ‘  Ain’t Eazy
overview: In Oakland, a former abuse survivor turned female pimp runs her male escort business with her mentor's guidance. When a jobless man accidentally enters their world, he must adapt to an unexpected new life.

title: Pronouncement of Doom
overview: After being executed by a corrupt king, a knight returns from the dead to seek revenge.

title: Keepers of Memory: Nature in the Age of Fire
overview: Focusing on the catastrophic wildfires in British Columbia, this documentary blends Indigenous wisdom, ambient nature soundscapes, and personal testimonies—including survivors of the 2021 Lytton disaster. The film highlights the deep spiritual connection between humanity and nature, calling for environmental stewardship while exposing the ongoing grief of Indigenous communities stripped of their ancestral lands.

title: The Fade of Day
overview: Hunted by an unforeseen threat, a young father seeks refuge in the countryside. Stripped of his bearings, he questions the legacy he will offer to his newborn child.

title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
overview: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

title: Trevor Lies
overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

title: The Serpent Pace
overview: The Serpent Pace is an autobiographical documentary that follows filmmaker Estêvão Ciavatta Pantoja’s journey of regeneration after a fall from a horse left him tetraplegic. The film uses his personal experience as a starting point to explore how one can transform suffering into a virtuous process of reconnecting with life.

title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
overview: Three generations of Jewish women bound by music and trauma navigate the legacy of the Holocaust, from Vienna to London to Los Angeles, in a quest for redemption.

title: The Big Ashtray
overview: In a closed room, a man who may be guilty of something terrible prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

title: Eres especial
overview: A man discovers that being "special" isn't always a gift...

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
overview: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

title: Behind the Reflection
overview: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

title: The Banning Curse
overview: After the critical success of his first film at Cannes, Amiryousefi returned to Iran to find it banned by state authorities. It's a pattern that continued through his entire career, which the seasoned director looks back on in this imaginative, satirical portrait.

title: Harvested
overview: After a night of partying, newly graduated medical student Dr. Michael wakes up in an ice-bath with his kidney stolen and must go on an absurd quest to get it back.

title: Carlos Lacerda - A Voz que Abalou o Brasil
Torus
overview: In the distant future, the pilot of an illegal scrapping spacecraft recounts her experiences growing up in the slums of an industrial space station.

title: Jie
overview: A young Chinese boy, Jie, navigates a new life in the U.S. while facing quiet family tensions and begins to grow through an unexpected friendship.

title: The Green Eyes
overview: Chaya, 11, lives with her family in the Landes region, by the ocean. When they learn they’re being evicted, her older brother Nour falls into a deep and mysterious sleep. Chaya will do everything she can to wake him up, even going so far as to dive into his dreams to find him.

title: Rushes of a Killer
overview: Footage found in Amsterdam reveals the horrific events that took place behind the scenes of a sinister film project. The recordings show the disturbing creative process of an obsessive filmmaker in pursuit of absolute control.

title: One Eye Open
overview: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion.

title: Cidro Asmoro
overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: You'll Be Fine
overview: A woman slowly realizes her husband may not be who she thinks. Shot in a single unbroken take.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: Alberto Angela tells Julius Caesar
overview: An evening event set against the prestigious backdrop of the Colosseum, exploring the life, achievements, loves, and legacy of Julius Caesar—one of history’s most significant figures. Before an audience of young people, and accompanied by the musical accompaniment of a live orchestra, Alberto Angela retraces Caesar’s extraordinary personal and political journey.

title: A Way We Go
overview: For the past forty years, Ah Long has headed up a traditional Chinese musical troupe. But times are changing, and the troupe members leaving one by one, Ah Hui, is an aimless slacker with no plans for the future. Ah Hui’s best friend is Ah Gou, a young man who works as a welder making metal gates.

title: The Lament of Spice Island
overview: Two lifelong friends travel to Spice Island for a carefree summer, only to find that something between them is beginning to change.

title: Les monstres
overview: Car broken down, a couple dreads the monsters lurking in the night.

title: The Space We Call Home
overview: In the not-too-distant future, humans want to set foot on Mars, even colonize the hostile planet. The studies on this endeavor offer surprising perspectives on the ecological crisis on Earth. Discussing space travel, architecture, ecology, and the cities of tomorrow, this documentary essay unfolds a philosophical mosaic about our living spaces. What begins as a technological utopia leads to the central questions of our time. How do we want to live, work, and do business in the future?

title: 20 Cents
overview: Kluay went to the district office to apply for a deferment of his status as a monkey, but the longer he waited, the more unsure he became about whether it was better to be a monkey or a human.

title: Omeha
overview: Omega follows a special operations unit led by a commander known as The Artist. After missions behind enemy lines, humour, shared habits, and rituals become what hold them together,  allowing them to hold on to one another when returning from the very heart of hell. They are used to being seen as steel-clad “rexes”, and their operations are rarely spoken of out loud. But who is really hiding behind the masks?

title: After Contact
overview: After a bus crash kills three players, the Coritiba Crocodiles, a Brazilian football team, returns for a new season, discovering that breaking through grief is a battle fought one yard at a time.

title: Aali Mothi Shahani
overview: a young girl who makes an innocent wish to Lord Ganesha to grow up into an adult so she can make her own choices and do whatever she desires.

title: Solo Vivo
overview: A profound narrative about the history, resistance, and social impact of the Ecological Farmers Market (FAE) of Porto Alegre, RS. A sensitive look at the dignity of rural work, resilience in the face of climate extremes, and the strength of a community united by respect for the land to nurture human relationships and promote health through healthy eating.

title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
overview: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

title: As I am now, so shall you be
overview: An anxious mother is searching for her missing daughter while she deals with her deepest fears about her child's safety.

title: Conscience
overview: The filmmakers present the stories of ordinary people across three segments of this anthology film: "Trust," "Frenzy," and "Conscience." The lives of the protagonists have been ruthlessly ground down by a modern-day scourge: fraud.  Much is said and written today about the complex world of information technology and the importance of protecting oneself and one’s loved ones. Yet, not everyone possesses the caution, skepticism, wariness, and high level of awareness needed to stay safe; consequently, people of all ages and social backgrounds fall prey to scammers.

title: Silt
overview: Hadria, haunted by guilt she cannot explain, is talked into a weekend at an exclusive lakeside sanctuary by her best friend Sierra, and Sierra’s boyfriend Scott. She has never warmed to the hosts, Rick and Anna, but she goes for a shot at something with Mike Warner, a pro athlete sidelined by a knee injury. The property sits behind three locked gates, where hundreds of deer assemble, watching. The lake comes with lore, the kind that makes a good firepit story, and Bartleby, the eccentric owner, tells them it carries the genes of the Gods. Hadria doesn’t buy any of it, right up until the water starts proving Bartleby right.

title: Struwwelpeter - Wer nicht hören will, muss fühlen
overview: When Eli enters her grandmother’s house with her mother Renate for the first time, it quickly becomes clear why she has never met her grandmother. When Eli opens the forbidden cellar door, she not only learns about her mother’s cruel past, but also unleashes Struwwelpeter – and with him the violence inflicted on Renate as a child, embodied in the form of the ill-mannered child that should have stayed in the cellar forever. Struwwelpeter now avenges the past and the injustices of harsh, authoritarian child-rearing.

title: Rainy Day
overview: Small-time crook Victor Varnavas thinks he’s struck gold when kindly Beryl Cooke invites him into her home, until he discovers he can’t have his cake and eat it too.

title: Chirac sous les Tropiques, petits arrangements avec la République
DOOM II: The Super Sequel
overview: A Mere 11 Months after the Success of Doom, A Sequel released that blew Away the Masses. But does it Deserve the Title of a Super Sequel?  Join Cooper Berryman in the Second Doom Video, Looking into the 32 Maps of the Base Game, and Its Expansions!

title: Hunger Pains
overview: In rural Appalachia, a restless young woman defies her overbearing mother for her first taste of freedom, unleashing the monstrous appetite she’s been taught to fear.

title: Give Me Something Good
overview: During a Halloween party, a group of young adults accidentally unleashes something dark and wicked. Now trapped inside a house, they must stay hidden until morning.

title: Shining in the Mountain
overview: A disappearance case quietly unfolds in the heart of the Loess Plateau. Various characters become entangled in a massive trap woven by money. Baiguo, stuck deep in the mire, is about to have her fate rewritten. As the truth comes to light, the shackles are broken, and all these characters rediscover the value of life and the true meaning of existence.

title: 7 Days 7 People
overview: The story of Jinhwa, an indie musician at a crossroads of life, agonizing between ideals and reality as he meets seven close people around him for seven days.

title: Skjulet
overview: Krispin works for the Swedish intelligence services and when something goes missing from a top secret facility in Luleå he is burdened with an enormous secret...

title: Poor, poor Timothy
overview: In a nameless small town, Timothy vanishes during a local festival. One year later, Astride attends the same event with her friends. But suddenly, they disappear as well, and little by little, the entire town seems to empty of its inhabitants.

title: The Special
overview: Beatrice has just gotten out of an abusive relationship. Trying to find closure she meets her ex at a new pop-up, serving 'The Special'. Things there are not quite what they seem. Can she overcome her own fears.. and her growing appetite?

title: All Our Tomorrows
overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.

title: Overseas
overview: When Clarissa, a young copy editor, realizes that her father is destined to disappear, she proposes they complete an old, unfinished short story in an attempt to preserve his presence and legacy through the written word.

title: The making of Vincent - Dreams, Monsters & Independent Film
overview: Go behind the scenes of Vincent, the multi award-winning supernatural dark fantasy, and discover the creative vision, artistic collaboration and challenges of bringing an independent film about friendship, loneliness and monsters to life.

title: Cosmic Trace
overview: Hyeonji, an assistant producer for a YouTube channel, and Jihyeon , a struggling actor, continue living together while grappling with anxieties about the present and the future. When Hyeonji's father dies suddenly and Jihyeon's mother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, they find themselves overwhelmed.

title: Start the Show
overview: A horror musical short centering on a 1930s starlet as she fights for agency and survival in a cyclical Betty Boop inspired hell.

title: SHIRT!
overview: SHIRT! is a dark comedy that explores the notion of nature vs. nurture through the eyes of an adult only child who receives a surprising gift on Christmas morning.

title: Pig That Survived Foot-and-Mouth Disease
overview: A pig wanting to be a human is ready to give it his all, whatever the cost. A human wanting to be an animal is ready to give up everything.

title: The Elephant Odyssey
overview: The highly unusual trek by a herd of elephants as they diverted from their usual habitat and marched over 1,000 km in China across remote Yunnan Province. They attracted global attention, including live-streamed drone footage.

title: Antes de Você Eu Existia em Cores
overview: Caught between the enchantment of a budding romance in the 1970s and the coldness of a marriage worn down by psychological abuse, Rosa faces the painful realization that loving Antônio meant losing herself along the way.

title: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast
overview: In this one-episode special, James Gunn, Jennifer Holland and Steve Agee revisit The Suicide Squad and determine what is and is not canon moving forward in the DC Universe.

title: Intimate Bodies
overview: Lisa has come home from a disappointing evening, feeling forlorn and friendless. What Lisa doesn't realize is someone is there waiting for her.

title: Seeking Haven for Mr. Rambo
overview: The story follows Hassan and his dog, Rambo, as they embark on a quest to save Rambo from Hassan's vengeful landlord, whom the dog attacked. Through his challenging journey across Cairo to find a safe haven for Rambo, Hassan confronts his deepest fears and rediscovers himself.

title: Camino de Brujas
overview: After several failed attempts, Carolina finally becomes pregnant. She and her partner experience moments of happiness until a series of suicides begin among people close to them. This unearths a series of secrets involving her parents and a shadowy woman who appears in nightmares with the arrival of a new baby in the family.

title: Matcha Mountain
overview: Granny lives alone on Matcha Mountain. She rescues an injured balloon dog, addicted to matcha desserts by chance. Something begins to stir, and danger slowly creeps toward their fragile happiness…

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Psalms of Sorrow
overview: Worn down by a failing body and a father who has fallen into silence, Isaac is forced to choose between saving himself and remaining true to his conscience in a world where survival comes at a heavy price.

title: Oh My Ghost! Oh My God!
overview: A Japanese pop icon returns to her late mother’s birthplace in a mountain village, joined by a former classmate and her boyfriend. Their trek into the forest turns dark after disturbing ancestral spirits. Trapped in thick fog, fear manifests into inner demons as supernatural events unfold, blurring the line between self-discovery and a descent into madness.

title: The Wedding Bangles
overview: Argentina, 1967. On her fifteenth birthday, María mourns the end of her childhood while glimpsing an unfulfilling future as a middle-class woman. Tension escalates when her older cousin Bárbara pushes her to the breaking point.

title: All Saints Street - The Secret of the Old Castle
overview: A Halloween special for All Saints Street. The supernatural roommates of Room 1031 find their daily lives of rent, chores, and bickering interrupted by a mysterious old castle that sends out a summons. Facing an unexpected challenge of "life and death," the demons, vampires, werewolves, and angels must try to maintain their neighborly spirit and stick together through the spooky adventure.

title: Edwin: In Technicolor
overview: When struggling TV salesman Edwin’s life begins to fall apart, he is forced to navigate and confront the absurdity of his life.

title: The Lockdown Hauntings
overview: With the streets now empty, it isn’t just nature that is taking advantage of this unprecedented global disaster. Spirits are freer than ever before and the spirit of a notorious serial killer, AKA ‘The Locksmith’, is back from the dead and he has even more potential victims. Can self-isolating detective George Parker with the guidance of paranormal expert Jordan Myers, prevent more young women from becoming victims of The Lockdown Hauntings?

title: Please + Thank You
overview: A anxious klutz hopes to earn his food delivery driver’s forgiveness.

title: The Year Without Summer
overview: Extreme heat and fires sweep through Tambora, one of Jakarta's most densely populated neighborhoods. Uus returns after years away to live with his brother, Surya, an AC technician. Disturbed by the cramped conditions and constant threat of fires, Uus is determined to move to Japan for a better life, urging Surya to join him.

title: For the Family
overview: When a Slovenian-Australian teenager attends a community gathering, a secret she’s been hiding threatens her family’s place within their close-knit community, forcing her mother to choose between social acceptance and standing by her daughter.

title: Christine Sinclair: Kind of a Big Deal
overview: Christine Sinclair scored more international goals than any player in soccer history, men’s or women’s. Moving between the roar of the world stage and the quiet moments behind it, the film reveals a leader whose power lived in restraint, yet she carried Team Canada from underdogs to Olympic gold. A story of how quiet leadership can leave the loudest legacy.

title: Daisy Chain
overview: After an international tragedy, a group of friends makes a last-ditch effort to preserve their legacy. But when things don’t go as planned, everyone scrambles to stay alive the best way they know how.

title: The Man I Love
overview: Every year, on the eve of the 1973 UpStairs Lounge fire in New Orleans, a man returns to the house he shared with his lover who still waits to say goodbye all over again.

title: Sin Lives Upstairs
overview: In a Portuguese apartment building, two couples share the same structure, yet live in entirely different universes. Iara and Lusa, a Brazilian couple, face the silence and strain of a marriage marked by routine and an emotional distance from each other and their homeland. Upstairs, Pedro and Inês, a younger Portuguese couple, lead an intense relationship fueled by energy, impulsivity, and a still-vibrant intimacy. Between thin walls, sharp banter, and cultural misunderstandings, their co-existence becomes a stage for laughter, unease, and unexpected revelations.

title: Terrestrial
overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

title: The Death of a Bird
overview: Fabio and Leonor, two lost souls adrift in oblivion, take refuge in a house that isn’t theirs, living for a moment the illusion of a peaceful life that was never theirs, until the river calls, and the dream fades into awakening.

title: Горизонт, прожектор, яблоко, пепел, кочегар
overview: Forty-year-old Pasha arrives at an inconspicuous workshop on the outskirts of town and gives the shopkeeper a secret code: "Horizon, spotlight, apple, ash, stoker." This password opens a gateway to the past—a chance to see someone who can never be brought back. But first, Pasha must recall something he himself had long forgotten.

title: All She Wants Is
overview: A bitter actor puts a curse on a friend who betrayed her.

title: Tsume Kill: The Clapper Claw
overview: A struggling beauty streamer receives a mysterious nail gel and soon discovers that her growing nails have developed a violent life of their own.

title: Spot Fuera de Campo
overview: How much does light weigh? asks Clarice Lispector.  It weighs as much as a camera. It weighs as much as the person who turns it on. The weight of their heart. Of their old romances. It also weighs a little more because there are their memories, some unforgettable. But what's the point of calculating. What's the point of naming. Kilos. Words. That makes the light disappear. I was wrong, Clarice, light is not weighed, it is filmed. And whoever films it has to carry the weight that comes with seeing the light, the weight of wanting to see it again. I met a man who, when he turned on the camera, the light appeared. And he liked filming it so much that he went very close to the sun. But he told me that's not the light. That light appears when we wait seated in the dark. Like in a movie theater? I asked him. And then he didn't want to answer me anymore.

title: The Actor
overview: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

title: The Enigma of Franca Farmín
overview: Franca Farmín, a young aspiring YouTuber obsessed with documenting paranormal phenomena, travels to the remote Laguna del Olvido, convinced she can capture the unknown on camera and uncover a mystery that could make her go viral. Franca sets out in search of a legend?and becomes one.

title: MACE – An Out of Body Experience
overview: For the second time in his career, MACE returns to Milan’s Forum, bringing together on stage the artists who have given voice to his musical universe: Venerus, Gemitaiz, Joan Thiele, Salmo, and many others.More than a chronicle of a concert, the film is a journey through perception: from intimacy to collective experience, from control to ecstasy. Through the words of the artists and images of the preparations and the show, it follows the creation of a shared experience. Rehearsals, stage, and audience merge into a flow in which the boundary between reality and hallucination becomes increasingly blurred.

title: To the Victory!
overview: A dystopian story set in post-war Ukraine, where a frustrated film director struggles to make the most of his life after being denied the opportunity to pursue his movie-making career. Estranged from his wife and daughter, who have been living in Vienna and are reluctant to return to their war-torn nation, the director tries to find solace in his conviction that the difficult times will pass and life will return to normal.

title: Jakub
overview: Jakub presents an extensive ethnographical-sociological study of the life of the Ruthenians, filmed in the Maramuresh mountains in the north of Romania and in the former Sudetenland in Western Bohemia. The film was made over a period of five years during the time of both totalitarian regimes and was completed in 1992 after the revolution.

title: Salam Shalom - The Untold Story of a Jewish Family in Pakistan
overview: Salam Shalom follows Hazel Selzer Kahan, born in the predominantly Muslim city of Lahore to Jewish physicians who fled Nazi Germany. Now 86 and living in the U.S., Hazel revisits her hometown to preserve a legacy of refuge, survival, and cross-cultural kinship while confronting the complex layers of her identity.

title: The Trans Girl Next Door
overview: Yuta, a second-year middle school student, lives with his single mother. One day, a woman named Yuka suddenly appears at Yuta’s home. Yuka claims to be Yuta himself, having come from 10 years in the future—after enduring various hardships, he underwent gender confirmation surgery to become who she is now. Yuka urges Yuta to begin the process of gender transition as soon as possible, before he reaches adulthood. Although Yuta had begun to feel a slight sense of dissonance among his friends, he resists Yuka’s forceful pressure. A tug-of-war ensues between Yuka, who has chosen to live as a woman, and Yuta, who finds it difficult to accept that future.

title: Swear To Me
overview: Vasyl lives in a remote Carpathian village, where he bears responsibility for the household and helps his mother with traditional coverlets fulling. One evening, his younger brother Ivan arrives unexpectedly at the family home. Ivan is a gay soldier who, before being deployed to a front-line position, wishes to discuss his last will. In the event of his death, he asks to be cremated by his partner in Kyiv, rather than laid to rest in the village soil where he was never truly accepted. This request stands in direct opposition to local traditions. Vasyl finds himself torn between honoring his brother’s final wish and conforming to what is considered morally and culturally right.

title: Charbel: The Movie
overview: When Youssef Makhlouf was born in 1828, the small northern Lebanese village of BeqaaKafra had no idea it was welcoming a future saint. Saint Charbel would go on to bless and heal people of all religions, all around the world. This is simply the biopic of Charbel, the Saint of all Saints!

title: Halgi
overview: In a quiet Maharashtrian village, Janardan, a halgi player, inherits a family tradition he no longer believes in. For generations, his family has lived off the rhythm of the drum, but for him every beat carries caste, shame and suffocation. As events push him away from the halgi, his silence grows louder, until destiny pulls him back.

title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

title: I Went to Check On You Sleep
overview: Thirty-five years in the life of a couple, told through 2,000 notes and family photographs. Love, jealousy, pain, resilience, and death, reflected upon by Aldir Blanc, the creator of some of the most beautiful lyrics in Brazilian popular music — including “O Bêbado e a Equilibrista” (“The Drunkard and the Tightrope Walker”), written for his wife, Mari Lúcia.  Six years after Aldir’s death, the notes continue to emerge, hidden inside objects throughout the couple’s apartment in Rio de Janeiro’s Tijuca neighborhood. Mari revisits forgotten moments and opens the moving treasure trove of notes in the year Aldir — who died of COVID-19 in 2020 — would have turned 80.

title: A Season
overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

title: EON
overview: Invisible burdens pass from one generation to the next, growing heavier with time. In silences, habits, and everyday choices, the past quietly repeats itself, until we can no longer tell which part of our lives we have chosen for ourselves, and which began long before us.

title: Masha and the Bears
overview: Masha has to save her brother, who fell under the spell of the forest's evil spirits and turned into a goat. To break the terrible curse, the girl has to join forces with the fairy tale heroes she has known since childhood—the three bears.

title: Times of Innocence
overview: Inspired by the memories of Walter Lima Jr., this film traces the history of Brazilian cinema through the many adaptations (both completed and abandoned) of Inocência, a classic of Brazilian literature.

title: The Royal Christmas Mix-Up
overview: Lilah, a Manhattan-based professional gift concierge, travels upstate to rectify a gifting snafu when her client’s gift – a rare, antique nutcracker intended for the Queen of Monteblanca – accidentally ends up there. Upon her arrival, Lilah learns that the nutcracker has been accidentally designated as the grand prize for the local Christmavaganza Festival, and the only way to retrieve it is to compete in the Yuletide Games… together with her disgruntled client.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: Love Story Abhimanyu Ki
overview: Torn between her first love, Wasim Akhtar, and Abhimanyu Yadav, whom her family pressures her to marry, a simple girl faces a complex journey. Struggling with personal trauma and social expectations, she must navigate her emotions to choose her own path.

title: Echoes of Motherhood
overview: The love and conflicts between mother and daughter, and between husband and wife. The final chapter of Nakagawa Ryutaro's trilogy, depicting the forms of love that endure through loss and rebirth.

title: SALTITO: THE MOVIE
overview: In a dark and distorted reality, Saltonsito rescues his son Saltito (from this timeline) from his own mother, who has gone completely insane and allied herself with the evil Saltirico. From that moment on, father and son become the most wanted in Ricolandia. Forced to live in hiding and constantly on the run, Saltonsito decides to face the consequences of a past decision that changed everything, in a race against time to protect his son and reclaim what they lost.  Witness the grand finale of the Saltito trilogy this october 10st

title: Check list
overview: Leo is hours away from traveling to another country and still has things left to pack. Although perhaps that is just an excuse to kill time while waiting for a possible encounter with Ángel—the guy he wants to say goodbye to.

title: Rooster Girl
overview: After her return from abroad, sister Dongming plans a grand Western-style wedding for her younger brother Ajie. Yet their family brings home a rooster to ward off ill fortune for him, ruining all her arrangements. Their father's sole concern is the rooster, while their mother quietly settles an old score with Dongming over her past as a daughter. No one pays any heed to Ajie himself. On the wedding day, Ajie goes missing. Dongming then sets out to expose the absurdity of this family in her own way.

title: Lurker
overview: Mariana spends her day unsure as who's following her, if anyone is even following her at all.

title: Horoomon
overview: One woman. One racist lie. One lawsuit that shook Japan. Korean Japanese entrepreneur Shin Sugok takes on major media in this electro-shock legal thriller about refusing to be silenced.

title: Mr. Wonderful
overview: A deep dive into the world of Luiz de Freitas (better known as Mr. Wonderful), Brazil’s first Black fashion designer. Born in Pau Grande, in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state, he defied conventions and revolutionized Brazilian menswear with his unique personality, his brand, and his fashion shows.

title: Todo lo que Nunca
overview: Before she goes to live abroad, Tali and Yayo reunite. That night will make them question if their lives are heading where they want them to.

title: Everything is F***ed
overview: After the tragic passing of his parents, Max reunites with his siblings to deal with the aftermath.
A young photographer travels by bus. Along the way, encounters with various people lead her to rethink not only how she portrays them but also the way she relates to them.

title: Weethara is a Goatman
overview: As the demands of working life begin to consume her, Weethara dreams one day that a pair of goat horns has grown from her forehead. The strange memory of encountering the Goatman as a child resurfaces, after being buried for fifteen years.

title: Bisikan Nafsu
overview: UR is a famous Romantic Ustaz who is married to Alyssa who has a daughter named Nadia. Unbeknownst to Alyssa, UR is apparently a playboy. In secret, UR has also had a relationship with Alyssa's best friend, Aida. Alyssa caught UR with Aida, but due to their boundless love, Alyssa has forgiven UR and is still faithful to each other.

title: Frieda
overview: Southern Germany, 1984. Under the growing pressure of the Cold War, eleven-year-old Frieda begins to sense that her family conceals a secret, passed down through generations. Searching for the truth about her missing sister, she pushes back against the adults’ silence with the power of her imagination, as the fear finds its echo within her family.

title: The Suitcase
overview: During a gala, three friends stumble upon a suitcase filled with money and a dead body. Before they know it, they find themselves caught up in an unexpected and dangerous manhunt.

Trapped in a run-down circus, actress @A is forced to watch another prisoner, @B, on a monitor. As vicious social media attacks against @A intensify her nightmare, @B desperately tries to communicate about a disturbing clown painting. Caught between reality and delusion, @A must unravel the connection between the two to fight for her sanity and survival.

title: Rock Out
overview: High school punk rocker Kate and her ragtag group of friends, whom she calls a band, are competing in their local talent show. But Lewis, the self-proclaimed "semi-professional concerto opera singer" and Kate's arch nemesis, will stop at nothing to embarrass her and ruin their performance.

title: Parasites
overview: When two families vacation in paradise, an alien parasite crashes into their world, infecting the locals and unleashing chaos. As reality unravels, survival means facing what's inside - and what's coming. For fans of 'A Quiet Place'.

title: On the Road with Abbas Kiarostami
overview: For 25 years, Samadian traveled with Kiarostami and recorded their journeys. He now turns that footage into a film in the spirit of Kiarostami's own films, arranging within it the secret keys to the beauty and mystery of his films. Ten stories, ten journeys unfold, using the ‘car’ and the ‘road’ as motifs. What does it mean to be on the road with Kiarostami?

title: Touken Ranbu the Stage: Hiden Tsuki to Taiyou to Hoshiboshi yo
overview: Stageplay based on Touken Ranbu.

title: The Double
overview: Inspired by Andersen’s tale, The Double follows a Scientist who releases his shadow, only to see it gain autonomy, power, and eventually replace him. Across ten tableaux of about two minutes each, the 20–30 minute experience traces this transformation through a sequence of dreamlike scenes blending realism and abstraction.

title: The Oil in My Blood
overview: The Oil in My Blood, written as a fable to my daughter Mar, reimagines an oil platform as a sea monster confronting a mermaid. It reflects on promises of progress, Pemex’s exploitation, and Tabasco’s poisoned waters, where families endure precarious labor. Through memory and metaphor, it exposes how sacrifice sustains livelihoods while threatening land, sea, and future generations.

title: Sorop
overview: Called home to visit their dying uncle, two siblings discover his eerie resistance to death when a series of supernatural events haunts them.

title: The Wonka of Worcester
overview: A daughter inherits a century-old chocolate shop and its fading legacy

title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
overview: A dark, camp-infused comedy about Mel, a non-binary person coming to terms with their identity. Much to their dismay, Evy ropes them into a Samhain retreat with their friends Remy, Tyler, and Sage. All Hades breaks loose when a demon from Mel's past returns to haunt them all after a seance goes awry. Mel is confronted by the demon they accidentally summoned in childhood - a manifestation of fear, shame, and unresolved identity. While their friends navigate their own Queer expressions through drag makeup, chaotic flirtations, and substance-fueled denial, Mel’s journey unfolds more subtly.

title: Purgatory
overview: From the earliest times, people have wondered what awaits them after death? And although no one has managed to penetrate the core of the mystery, over the centuries there have been people who... knew and saw more. Fulla Horak, St. Faustina Kowalska, Bl. Father Stanisław Papczyński and St. Padre Pio - these are mystics who received the grace of being visited by the souls in Purgatory and who for a moment could see the final judgment, heaven, hell and what is most mysterious - purgatory.

title: Üç Harfliler: Mühür
overview: Fortune-teller Müzeyyen, a mansion filled with secrets and the darkness into which Fatma and her family are drawn...

title: They Made Monsters
overview: Joaquin has been raised by his monster-hunting father to kill. But when he hears the eerily humanlike cries of a captured creature, Joaquin begins to question where the true horror lies.

title: Cosmic Symphony
overview: Four iconic instruments, including The Wizard of Oz and A Star Is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future, a Cosmic Symphony. Directed by Oscar-nominated composer Laura Karpman, and featuring John Clayton, Susie Chung, Starr Parodi and Diane Warren, Cosmic Symphony explores a truth that every musician knows - musical instruments have souls.

title: The Gardener
overview: The gardener’s peaceful routine is disrupted when a loud, free-spirited musician moves in next door. As tensions rise between them, an unexpected connection blossoms between the unlikely neighbors.

title: Eye for an Eye
overview: A scavenger in a post-apocalyptic combine attempts to flea their tyrannical leader's control, but will her sister (their leader) let her

title: Siah
overview: An unknown creature enters the village, and the residents set out to drive it away...

title: SYDNEY CASH MAKES TOO MUCH ART
overview: Sydney Cash is an 80-year-old artist who can’t stop making art. When space runs out and time grows short, his family faces an urgent decision about the fate of his life’s work. Turning the camera on his father’s artistic legacy, a son confronts how a lifetime of compulsive creating impacted their family.

title: Die Zukunft ist Vergangenheit
overview: In March 2025, the Zurich cultural institution «Zukunft» was forced to close its doors for good. This prompted Stephan Schulz and Julian Kirchner to produce an independent, community-funded documentary. They document the final days of «Zuki» and the essence that made this gathering place so special.

title: Lippenstift
overview: Tomorrow is the funeral of Benedicte’s stepfather. She is 43, a psychologist, and a mother. She has to deal with her children’s anxieties about what to wear, see her patients before leaving, prepare sandwiches for the trip, and put up with her husband’s sarcasm. So far, she’s holding it together.

title: It’s Like This Forever Now
overview: A tension rises between a couple

title: Diaspora Power
overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.

title: O Ladrão do Pão
overview: A fiction from the series "Contos Tradicionais Portugueses," based on a poem by Alexandre O'Neil, telling the story of a fisherman tired of the sea, who departs to conquer a new life on land.

title: Jan Van Eyken & Pascal Braeckman: Backstage
Kuopattu rauha
overview: Documentary on Finnish peace organisations and pacifism.

title: Unification of Japan 77
overview: With Kyowakai’s new leadership in place, Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) becomes its fourth chairman and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) becomes Wakagashira. Former Keihin Rengokai leader Sunaga (Masataka Naruse) becomes shateigashira after the group is absorbed into Kyowakai. Soon after, Sunaga warns that Chinese delinquents are causing trouble in Yokohama, and former Keihin chairman Sakagami is kidnapped by a Chinese group.  Himuro and Tamura rush to rescue Sakagami, now considered a brother, and defeat his captors. Meanwhile, a conflict between Chinese groups and an extremist nationalist resident over a condominium leads to the stabbing death of café employee Han. The café is also forced to vacate after its landlord changes. Determined to uphold their code of protecting the weak, Kyowakai uncovers the Chinese organization Makino Group behind these incidents.

title: Flat Earth
overview: After years of obsessive research, a brilliant but isolated physicist succeeds in creating the world's first artificial black hole inside a secret laboratory. Instead of unlocking the secrets of gravity, the experiment tears open reality itself, revealing an impossible truth: the world is not a globe, but one of countless vast, layered planes stacked beyond human perception.

title: Meat the Future
overview: Tommy Watanabe, a kind-hearted but naïve Japanese yakiniku chef in Taiwan, believes that good food can make the world better. When a cynical teenager tells him to “become president and fix society,” Tommy takes it literally and launches an unlikely grassroots campaign. As his sincerity attracts public attention, a conman exploits Tommy’s trust and steals campaign donations, forcing him to confront the harsh realities behind idealism and politics.

title: The Day We Embraced the Universe
overview: A series of mysterious abductions by colorful aliens has been spreading fear across the globe. Amid the chaos, Aoi continues to live a peaceful life with her boyfriend, Yuzu. But one night, while Aoi is asleep, Yuzu is abducted by the colorful aliens. As anti-alien sentiment intensifies across Earth, Aoi begins rigorous training, driven by her desire for revenge. Then one day, deep in the forest, she encounters a different kind of alien...

title: Landscapes of Shame
overview: Navigating Ireland’s haunted landscapes, ecological extinction and cultural suppression emerge as intertwined forms of colonial erasure.

title: Seethe
overview: Ever since her father's sudden death by the Ciliwung River, Aci and her mother’s lives changed forever. Convincing herself the Ciliwung Spirit killed him, Aci vows revenge. Yet, her mother repeatedly insists asthma was the cause. Exhausted by Aci's escalating terror, her mother recklessly summons the entity, triggering an inevitable clash.

title: Tales of Ardenmore
overview: A brash knight-in-training must partner with the woman he spurned, on a quest to save his brother from an undead sorcerer. Together they must overcome rogue warriors, monsters and magic.

title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

title: End Tina
overview: A friendship comes to a violent end.

title: The Little Cousteau
overview: Undersea adventure in snowy city. A short cartoon film as a homage to Jacques Cousteau.

title: Pining for Douglas
overview: When an overworked social media manager returns home for Christmas, she finds herself torn between saving her hometown's beloved 150-year-old Douglas Fir and a budding romance with the son of the tech giant's CEO who plans to chop it down.

title: Mallory
overview: An original psychological horror short film where a group of cousins take a hallucinogenic drug, but one of them experiences a horrific trip that resurrects the memory that haunts her most.

title: Memory from the Sea
overview: Arūnas is an ageing fisherman on the Lithuanian coast. Yet every year, the fish are becoming scarcer. His second occupation is older than his first: after a storm, he goes down to the beach to search for amber, as has been done in these parts for centuries. During the long winter, when he cannot go out to sea, he sits at his kitchen table polishing the pieces he has found into jewellery, for which there are also fewer and fewer buyers. Amber was once the backbone of the local industry and tourism. Now it is one man’s way of filling his days and preserving his memories.

title: Whites Wash at Ninety
overview: Life of young Bronja, living in the '70s changed when her mother dies of cancer. After a childhood marked by the loss of her mother, her grown up life is again interrupted by a series of tragic events, which she overcomes with positivism.

title: Zebras
overview: A young man lends his house to a friend while he is away at work, leading the friend to embark on a schizophrenic adventure.

title: Foreign Blood
overview: Dennis, a man in his late fifties, leads a quiet life in Zakynthos, running a bar with Vera, his Bulgarian partner, and her 20-year-old son, Alex, whom he regards as his own. One winter night, Alex takes a mysterious foreign girl on a ride and causes an accident. Dennis rushes her to hospital, only to discover she is his estranged daughter. As her condition worsens and Alex disappears, Dennis must confront his past and choose between protecting him and seeking justice.

title: The Guy On The Ground
overview: The last known footage of a disgraced news broadcaster, Bill Marquette, is found amid a police database leak. After a tip about a news story that could help revive his career, he was never seen or heard from again.

title: The Ambitious
overview: The year is 2023, and elections are nearing in Goma, a Congolese city of one million people situated near the border with genocide-ravaged Rwanda. It is a region rich in valuable natural resources, where bloody conflicts over ethnic and economic issues have been raging for three decades, devastating eastern Congo. Two members of the La Lucha civil society movement decide to abandon activism in favour of a career in politics. Espoir, a young activist, stands as a candidate for the National Assembly on behalf of the opposition. Sankara who, confined to a wheelchair, has become a symbol of resistance, joins the outgoing president’s coalition. When rebel troops from the M23 group enter Goma, their dreams of democracy are thrown into doubt.

title: Tiddler
overview: A small fish with a big imagination gets lost in the deep wide ocean, until he is saved by his own storytelling.

title: Love, After All
overview: The everyday life of a married couple at a turning point: Lore wants a divorce—after almost 40 years of marriage.

title: Zebras
overview: Two detectives, one is an old school grizzled veteran and the other an ambitious rookie. Both from different races, genders, generations and backgrounds are paired up on a dangerous stakeout. Opposing realities clash only to be forced to work side by side against the very forces of evil.

title: Striguni
overview: Origolab, an internationally renowned genetical engineering company, establishes a new headquarters within the walls of a small medieval town in Istria and Boris, an ambitous up and coming biologist, gets a position in it. However, he discovers a terrifying secret: whilst Origolab might be on the verge of a scientific breakthrough with discovering eternal life, they have been kidnapping local children to achieve this, putting him before a moral dilemma. Should he try to save the most recent kidnapping victim? Or will he bend under the promise of the scientific discovery of a century?

title: Out of Hours
overview: A British Latino bartender is starting his shift when he receives an unsettling visitor.

title: The Only One
overview: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

title: Head in the Grave
overview: A woman may or may not see her deceased father alive again.

title: Sasquatch Story No.2
overview: A girl is preparing to meet her lover for a secret rendezvous in his car on a secluded forest side road late at night. Just as they settle in, they begin to sense that someone-or perhaps something-hidden in the darkness is silently watching them.

title: Jhingedaau 2
overview: As Khanalni goes missing, her two sons and their wives embark on a search to find her, uncovering unexpected challenges along the way.

title: Valentine's Day
overview: Agathe, married with two children, receives a text message for Valentine's Day inviting her to a hotel room.

title: Kalcer: The New Era ִ
overview: Famous for dominating their alley with their signature street style, The Kalcer (Andra, Ariel, and Milo) find their status challenged when The Siblinkz newly moved siblings Killa and Baskara arrive with an even trendier and more stylish look.

title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
overview: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

title: Treading Water
overview: Treading Water is a short film directed by Takashi Ogawa, selected for the competitive Asian Students' Film Conference section of the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival, where it will have its world premiere.

title: Deuce Purgatory
overview: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

title: A Lost Art
overview: Two career criminals risk it all on one last job for their ruthless boss, but their fall guy might just be the death of them.

title: Two or three things I still have of hers
overview: One morning Nicolás wakes up to a letter from his girlfriend telling him that she's leaving him. Among the few things he still has of her is her cat, Ricardo. Disoriented and lost in the uncertainty, Nicolás will take the path that the people around him, the city and fate itself lead him on.

title: Bonds, Roots and Passions
overview: The story of three survivors of a refugee boat accident. Hazel, a young Syrian woman, finds herself trapped between cultural traditions and family responsibilities. Hamza, after being released from prison, struggles to reconcile with his past while trying to build a new identity and life for himself. Meanwhile, Khaled, an Afghan refugee, survives by working as a shepherd in a small village, but his love for the village headman's daughter clashes with the rigid traditions of the community.

title: PHINDA
overview: In KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, retired schoolteacher Mama Zikhali gathers her class for one final lesson: the extraordinary 40-year story of Phinda, where pioneering conservationists, local communities and wildlife transformed a degraded landscape into one of Africa's oldest and most celebrated rewilding successes.

title: You no Mashallah!
overview: Usman is a young undocumented immigrant who, like so many others, came to Europe in search of a better life. However, all Europe has to offer is a precarious existence. He lives in a heated apartment and works as a food delivery driver. In just 24 hours, the delicate balance that sustains him will be upended, forcing him to make a drastic decision to survive and, perhaps, continue pursuing his dream.

title: Downwind
overview: Smokestacks rise like organ pipes over a coastal city, lined with oil refineries. Accidents at the plants occur with troubling regularity, and environmental disaster has become part of daily life. Residents protest the refinery’s planned expansion, even as they must coexist with the very neighbors who work there.

title: Christmas at the Interlaken
overview: Seven strangers attend an exclusive holiday party at a historic inn during a heavy winter storm, only to find themselves mysteriously trapped inside. They soon discover they cannot leave until each person confronts their past and finds what they have been truly searching for.

title: Voula
overview: Voula, a middle-aged woman, will try something crazy today in an attempt to draw people's attention.

title: Elisabeth: Rondo of Love and Death
overview: Takarazuka Revue Flower Troupe production of the Austrian musical 'Elisabeth'.

title: Life 2.0
overview: An operative navigates deep-space isolation, with only an AI hologram for company, until an enigmatic new companion arrives. An accident uncovers the truth about their origins, forcing a fight for survival against motives engineered back on Earth.

title: Un segreto da tenere in gola
overview: A lonely, rough young farmer gives shelter to a woman who has fled from her abusive husband, sparking a complex bond that tests his rigid daily life.

title: Doña Ninfa
overview: Jesús, a local young man, turns to Doña Ninfa to undergo a spiritual cleansing. Doña Ninfa is a fraudulent healer who performs rituals in a town that is itself alive a place that metes out justice against those who seek to profit through deception. During the ritual, the scene is terrorized by a light resembling a living entity that attempts to force its way into the house.

title: Putin's Playground
overview: For years, Russia has been trying to rebuild its empire. The hybrid war doctrine introduced by Putin in 2013 assumes attacking Western countries without declaring war. The invasion of Ukraine made us lose our sense of security. A pair of documentary filmmakers from Poland set off on a journey to look for answers to the question about the threats that may face Central and Eastern Europe.

title: The Voice of God
overview: Two child preachers search for a better life through the power of faith. 17-year-old Daniel, was once Brazil’s most renowned child preacher; today, as he nears adulthood, he grapples with the weight of an uncertain future. Meanwhile, 12-year-old João Vitor is at the height of his fame, reaching millions through his followers. Amidst livestreams and smartphones, he preaches to the masses. The film uncovers the childhoods concealed behind these public personas, reflecting a country in transition — a place where politics and religion frequently intertwine. As one cycle closes and another opens, they navigate a Brazil that has been forever changed.

title: Skybreaker
overview: An Albanian girl born with ‘the gift’ embarks on a dangerous quest to rescue her lover from a dark sorceress.

title: Habituation
overview: An expectant couple is on the move, traveling through a country struck by unexpected weather phenomena.

title: Dancing For Gold
overview: Dancing for Gold follows Laurence Fournier Beaudry and Guillaume Cizeron and Lilah Fear and Lewis Gibson through the Olympic Games they've spent years building towards. From arrival in Milan to their final days in Italy, the film captures the training, the pressure, the partnerships and the raw emotion behind the most artistic event on the Olympic programme.

title: Never My Love
overview: A married couple attempts to recapture the love they once had before life got in the way.

title: Lab Rat
overview: A deflated human test subject deals with the struggles of his strange career, and dares to break free and find his true passion.

title: AFL Open
overview: Meet Damon Rowett, AFL NSW/ACT Inclusion Rams Captain, and longtime Inclusion Football participant from the AFL Hunter Central Coast. Created in collaboration with Bus Stop Films.

title: Anatomy of a Crash
overview: Jediná vteřina is a feature-length documentary by Vít Klusák about the fine line between everyday bad driving habits and a tragedy that cannot be undone. Using a mobile phone at the wheel, fatigue, rushing through a yellow light, or the feeling that we have everything under control. Bad habits behind the wheel that usually go unpunished. But what happens when they don’t? The film follows four stories of road accidents and the people involved, who must come to terms with the moment when the lives of so many were changed forever. Through intimate portraits, cinematic reconstructions and unusual encounters between the perpetrators and their victims or bereaved families, it explores responsibility, guilt and the possibility of forgiveness. The film reveals our ability to excuse our own failings and poses a disturbing question: what if we are less different from the people who caused the accidents than we would like to admit?

title: Our Blue Youth
overview: Sharpshooter Xiang Qian meets top student Qin Feng. The two clash nonstop, from dorm brawls to shooting range duels, even competing over cafeteria meals: they sneak chili sauce into each other's food to make them tear up, and their midnight streaking is once live-streamed to the whole campus by a drone. Soon, Sanda martial arts queen Guan Yue and tactical whiz Ye Yu get dragged into the chaos. The four go from pranking and bickering to trusting each other with their lives, ultimately taking bullets for one another at a drug raid site.

title: Ghosts: Inside The Movie
overview: The Making of Ghosts The Possession of Button House

title: Kylie in Paris
overview: This documentary follows the arrival of a Los Angeles superstar who travels to France to shoot an exclusive film for Dorcel and take part in a retro-pop photoshoot for Playboy TV Europe.

title: Night Shift
overview: A near-future dystopia. During his first shift guarding the coastline, a young cadet has to confront the enemy whilst dealing with his retiring mentor who has a love for cake.

title: Alchemy in Venice
overview: In the eclectic world of Venice Beach, three artists searching for purpose find their lives unexpectedly intertwined.

title: A River Colored Red
overview: In a mining-scarred Adivasi village under the shadow of the state–Naxal conflict, a 12-year-old boy’s encounter with a Tiger Spirit in the form of his long-dead uncle leads him to his family’s missing buffalo while uncovering buried memories of loss and violence. A Mundari language film.

title: Gabriel
overview: When a young altar boy encounters the devil during a foot-washing ritual, he must confront the supposed incompatibility of his non-normative sexuality and his faith. Devotion, dominance, ecstasy and shame exist side by side in both cases, shaped by a longing for intimacy and acceptance.

title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
overview: The film travels through eastern PA and the surrounding region, collecting stories of haunted places, restless dead, curses, witches, and things that were never meant to be disturbed. When Nathan receives a call from an estate-sale dealer who has discovered a box of mysterious tapes bearing ominous handwritten labels, he agrees to come pick them up.  What begins as a simple errand becomes a journey through the forgotten corners of the region. Over the course of a single day, Nathan drives from one location to another, listening to the tapes as an unseen narrator recounts the strange histories and folk stories connected to each place. As each story unfolds, the soundtrack changes with it, turning the landscape itself into a series of haunted tableaux scored by The Marshmallow Ghosts.

title: Santiago
overview: At his grandmother's request, Santiago goes to the cinema in search of the man from whom he inherited his name, a Brazilian actor who passed away in the 1950s but who, on this night, will be brought back to life on the movie screen.

title: Al mal tiempo
overview: A man reflects on his entire existence while searching for a place to die.

title: Mawang: Jangan Sebut Namanya
overview: Bangka in 1981. A brother and sister were fighting over a 'pet' known as Mawang. A large, hairy, fanged and sharp-nailed creature. The older brother wants to keep Mawang, so that he can become powerful and wealthy. In the end, the Mawang was locked up by the younger brother in a sacred box. 30 years later, a griup of researcher accidentally finds and opens the sacred box. Mawang escapes and terrorizes them and the surrounding community.

title: Our Struggle
overview: A couple of time travelers break into a debate over killing history’s greatest monster in infant form; a chaotic living room chase causes them to reconsider their objective.

title: Kwibuka, Remember
overview: Lia, a Belgian-Rwandan basketball player facing the twilight of her career. Twenty years after fleeing the genocide, she is asked to join the Rwandan national basketball team. This journey stirs buried memories of a painful past: exile, family silences and the pain of a fractured identity. Through her eyes, the film explores confrontation between memory and the present, and a nation scarred by tragedy with a contemporary Rwanda brimming with life and creativity.

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: On a winter afternoon, with a storm about to break, Dani follows her cousins ​​Nora and Inés to a cube-shaped shelter in the middle of the woods. There, they perform a ritual to hold back the rain and save their friend—"the Presence." Dani must follow a set of rules for the ritual to succeed, but the moment Nora sacrifices an earthworm, she can no longer bear it and breaks the cardinal rule: never leave the cube.

title: The Father's House
overview: After her father’s death, Alessandra discovers that she has inherited a share of a rural property. Never having been acknowledged by him, she agrees to meet Cora, his legitimate daughter. Their encounter unsettles the images they have each constructed of the other.

title: Returning Where I Have Never Been
overview: In 1895, during the genocide of the Selk'nam people, 165 Indigenous people were captured in Chilean Patagonia and their children given to colonists as servants. A century later, a young Selk'nam woman, driven by a painful family history, returns to her territory to prove that they are not extinct.

title: Act Your Age
overview: Years after the cameras stopped rolling, a former child actor begins the difficult work of confronting what happened behind them.

title: Acharya
overview: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

title: Kentucky Bourbon
overview: Hoping to leave behind his battle with alcoholism, Ivory relocates with his wife, Zoë, to an idyllic suburban community. Their fresh start quickly devolves into an uncanny nightmare as their overly hospitable neighbors reveal an insatiable hunger, forcing Ivory to battle both the bottle calling his name and the terror closing in outside his door.

title: Meadow
overview: During a cabin getaway, a young woman facing an unexpected pregnancy begins to experience unsettling visions that blur the line between reality and something darker.

title: Out of Place
overview: Having lost his family during the war, Ali, a man in his forties, is left with nowhere to go but an abandoned train station, where he is forced to make a life among the wreckage of forgotten trains.

title: National Theatre Live: Mrs. Warren's Profession
overview: Vivie Warren is a woman ahead of her time. Her mother, however, is a product of that old patriarchal order. Exploiting it has earned Mrs. Warren a fortune – but at what cost?

title: Things Greater Than Us
overview: A group of friends are thrown for loop when they discover the reason their eccentric millionaire friend invited them to a cabin getaway is to share evidence of intelligent life from elsewhere in the universe.

title: Exposure
overview: An anxious small-town cop falls down a rabbit hole after finding a VHS tape in a missing girl's bedroom.

title: banano, banano
overview: Death arrives in a small town in the south of Guatemala City, with the mission of taking three people with her: a boy lost in a hill, a young woman adrift, and an old writer who always dreamed of being a filmmaker.  An essay that presents three short stories about Death and how living in this world makes her more human.

title: Raffle!
overview: After her parent's tragic death, a ne'er-do-well drifter makes her sibling's worst nightmare come true by trying to take over the family business

title: The Birds
overview: Yeok, a middle-aged teacher raising a son and a daughter alone, witnesses students fall to their deaths from the rooftop of the school where she works. Discovering that her daughter Hyejeong was also present at the scene, she presses her for answers, but Hyejeong only repeats the same words: 'There was a bird in the sky.' As the strange, unexplained deaths continue, Yeok, together with a reporter covering the case and a streamer who runs a birding channel, head towards the birds’ habitat.

title: Part-time Death Angel
overview: After his father's arrest shatters his once-stable life, college student Shinji falls into deep despair. One day, he is approached by his classmate Yuki, who invites him to join a strange part-time job—working as a "Death Angel." The job involves resolving the lingering regrets of the departed who cannot move on, and guiding them peacefully into the afterlife. Although skeptical at first, Shinji gradually regains hope as he helps each of the departed fulfill their final wish and pass on. Just as their part-time work seems to be going well, a secret Yuki has kept hidden is revealed, bringing an unexpected turn to their lives.

title: A Report for Minerva 2
overview: The lives of a mismatched group of guests and employees become entangled in a run-down hotel. Some have come in search of peace and a brief escape from their daily routine, while others long for change – or even love. A lonely clarinetist crosses paths with a young man looking for a romantic adventure, an unhappily married couple, an idiosyncratic hotel staff member, and also an alien sent from the planet Minerva 2 in order to report on the state of Earth. A mosaic of fourteen interwoven stories emerges through fleeting situations, awkward moments, interior monologues, and quiet observations. This experimental film by Miroslav Krobot and Lubomír Smékal is loosely based on the stage production of the same name by the S 23 Theatre Company, whose non-professional actors put together stage performances based on the dialogical acting method.

title: Get Undressed
overview: After years without seeing each other, Tsumugi goes camping with her former track and field teammates. Their excitement at the reunion fades when a conflict they were never able to resolve resurfaces. What no one can imagine is that they're sleeping on the site of an ancient execution ground, where centuries ago villagers were crucified naked. At night, their spirits emerge to hunt down the campers. And then Tsumugi discovers the only way to survive: by undressing.

title: Unmasking the Tylenol Killer
overview: A detective inspired by an episode of "Unsolved Mysteries" takes on the unsolved case of a death by cyanide.

title: The game of my life
overview: For 20 seconds, Raí gazes at the horizon before taking the free kick that would decide the 1992 Intercontinental Cup title between São Paulo and Barcelona. Blending manga, the PLACAR magazine archives, previously unseen VHS footage shot in Tokyo, and exclusive filming in Paris, the movie delves into Raí’s journey toward his world title victory in Japan—a portrait of the past, present, and future.

title: Dirty Laundry
overview: A writer faces the reality of life after college.

title: Passing Through
overview: Sam, a young adolescent, visits his older sister Lina in Marseille for the weekend.

title: Doctor Doomscroll
overview: An isolated young woman fights to survive a demonic entity that preys on people who are stuck in a social media doomscroll. To make it out alive, she must confront the purposeless person she’s become—and the loved ones she’s pushed away.

title: El Frío Que Guía Luz
overview: While waiting for the bus, a single mother is suddenly swept into her painful past as she tells her six-year-old daughter a tale.

title: The Brazilian Thing
overview: A young man who loves his wife wants rid of his troublesome mistress. He dresses up as a wealthy Brazilian and seduces her in a jiffy. He hopes to reach a settlement, that she must sign. In this settlement she will promise to break with her lover. He can then show that he is a faithful husband.

title: Roomies
overview: During a call with her best friend, a young woman vents about her increasingly bizarre roommate and the mental toll it's taking on her.

title: Cockroach
overview: During a doctor's visit, two siblings debate how to handle the care their mother needs. Their respective personal circumstances lead them to make a decision that reveals their true nature.

title: Wild Cards: The Disposable Man
overview: A dapper “dead-body” cleaner faces a crazy day that leads to darkly funny moments as he confronts life and death.

title: Chocolate for Christmas
overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

title: The Dog Whistle
overview: An obnoxious conservative politician is repeatedly pestered over the phone for an unknown reason

title: On March 12 And Every Day After
overview: A STORY ABOUT LOVE AND VIOLENCE. Linz, 12 March 1938: Milena, a young communist, is in a secret relationship with the seamstress Anne. Faced with the Austrofascist government under Schuschnigg and the Nazi invasion, she is at a loss as to whether she should stay with Anne in Linz or return to her family in Southern Carinthia. As she is trying to figure out what to do, she meets Johann, a soldier in the Wehrmacht, who is very keen to get to know her better.

title: La maleta
overview: Laura and Nacho meet on a flight, but their brief encounter ends when they pick up their bags. Laura proposes a game, revealing the suitcase belongs to terrorists.

title: Y'a pas de p'tits rôles
overview: An actress has to learn skills everytime she has an audition to have a chance to get the part.

title: Lego Batman - Red Hood's Retribution
overview: When Lego Batman's villains keep winding up murdered, The Dark Knight is perplexed because that's usually his job. With his new son Damian suited up as the latest Robin, the two embark on a mission to solve the mystery, get the crown, and save Bikini Bottom.

title: Scum of the Earth
overview: A documentary on rural American horror cinema

title: Nick Guerra: Risk Taker
overview: Nick Guerra turns everyday chaos into big laughs. Find out about the beauty of the skip intro guy, the soundtrack to future drug commercials, and why your brain and body can't see eye-to-eye. Risky comedy in front of a group of strangers.

title: Yamazaki Riverside - Over an Actor's Shoulder -
overview: The first documentary devoted to actor Yamazaki Tsutomu follows his pursuit of the craft as he confronts old age and cancer.

title: CHAI
overview: Two years after a defeat that kept him away from the ring, Henry flies to Thailand to join Saenchai, a legend of Thai boxing. Several weeks at his training camp, a rare immersion in his culture and family, and finally, a real fight. CHAI is the film chronicling this adventure and exploring a universal question: How far must one go to confront one’s fears?

title: The Lacey Way
overview: Teenage George Lacey does not fit in. She’s a weirdo amongst her conforming peers and a conformist amongst her weirdo family. Only the cows are kind to her. The real world calls to George. Tonight she answers.

title: The Death Notice of Eamonn McCarty
overview: With just one day left to live, a man scrambles to fulfil his life’s ambitions while stuck on the phone to customer care.

title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

title: Chirkut
overview: Based on a real-life incident at Rajshahi University in the 1990s, the film portrays campus life, friendship, romance, and the experiences of students during that era.

title: The Truth Rejects You, Cornelius
