overview: A mixed-technique animated short film about a downtrodden dog attempting to explain his toxic relationship with Avalutsa the frog to his psychologist, a talking lobster.

title: The Final Embrace: 'Chi come me'
overview: This documentary explores the phenomenon behind Chi come me, a hit theatrical production directed by Andrée Ruth Shammah and written by Roy Chen. Following its final sold-out run at Milan's Teatro Franco Parenti, the film examines how a powerful story about five fragile teenagers in a mental health center finding their voice through theater transformed into an intergenerational cult experience and a profound mirror of contemporary adolescent struggles.

title: Paper Cuts
overview: You've never watched a cheeky animated horror anthology with the aesthetic of a children's stop-motion TV show quite like this.

title: Reveal
overview: A hard drive found at an archaeological site in Méier—an old suburb of what was known as Rio de Janeiro—reveals previously unseen images of the preparations for a festive ritual celebrated during the Years of the Outbreak: the gender reveal party.

title: Traveling Alone
overview: Misaki, who has worked in Tokyo for ten years, spends quality time with her family and friends again in her hometown. At an event where classmates gather, she learns that the boy she liked in middle school has died.

title: The In-between
overview: Spirit medium Shih Han traverses the Bardo to guide a wandering soul, discovering a chilling truth: the elder ordered his son Wei to freeze his corpse for pension money, trapping his spirit in a cycle of ascending and descending. In helping the spirit break free from this sacrificial attachment, Shih Han also finds the path to heal his own unresolved past.

title: A Royal Christmas Secret
overview: When chef Emily Parker takes a job at Verdonia's royal palace for Christmas, she begins a romance with the castle's handyman Nick. But she doesn't know he's really Prince Nicholas and that his parents already have a bride picked for him.

title: Nothing Has Happened Yet
overview: Eunyul possesses a special ability to glimpse what lies ahead for her - but only when she sits on a certain bench on her home island of Geoje. Carrying Robert Walser's The Walk, a gift from an ex-lover, Eunyul returns to her hometown. There, she meets her senior Minjeong and Minjeong's partner Jigeun, someone who remains a painful memory for Eunyul. A stranger also travels through. And in these encounters, she comes face to face with herself.

title: A Summer of Nothing
overview: Filmmaker Alina Manolache arrives on an island in Greece with grand plans to film a documentary on Venus de Milo's repatriation, but the project does not materialise. Finding it impossible to accept the new situation, Alina decides to dissect her obsession for work and achievement, through an experiment of doing the exact opposite: nothing. But is there ever nothing? As she meets Mady, a local woman with a very busy family life, the study of nothing turns into a labyrinthine personal journey.

title: Chameli Ko Poi
overview: Chameli and Shere are friends, lovers, spouses, and rivals whose relationship is tested by humor, romance, and unexpected twists when Chameli’s scheming brother-in-law interferes for his own benefit.

title: The House of Dona Carlota
overview: Based on a true story, Dona Carlota leads a women’s soccer team from the suburbs of Rio de Janeiro on an international tour. Her home, which serves as the club’s headquarters and a space of freedom for the young women, challenges the prevailing morality and the dictatorship of the 1940s.

title: Inside 'Crystal Lake Memories'
overview: A dark secret from Pamela Voorhees' past emerges after her son's death, just as bodies begin turning up across the quiet town of Crystal Lake.

title: School Shooters: You Killed Me First
overview: After graduating, Jaime and Chloe plan a massacre at their high school during the summer.

title: Martha
overview: The film explores the life of the legendary pianist Martha Argerich, following her over nearly a decade and documenting her music, memories, friendships, past loves, and travels. Drawing on memories and concert archives, the documentary reveals this one-of-a-kind performer through the eyes of her daughter, Annie Dutoit-Argerich. Together with director Martin Mirabel, they explore key events in Martha's career, allowing viewers to discover intimate, unforgettable and never-before-seen moments.

title: Delicatessen
overview: A dinner turns into a ritual of subjugation when a woman is forced to eat her meal. The consumption becomes an uncontrollable, monstrous impulse, revealing the face of guilt.

title: Doggy-Dog World
overview: On the night of his band’s big come-back, a sober musician has a panic attack and locks himself in the green room with a bottle of schnapps. It’s up to his long-suffering best friend to get him through it and get him on stage.

title: Pacific Islands
overview: A middle-aged woman arrives at a hotel where important events from her past took place. The visit takes an unexpected turn when she meets a young man.

title: The Wartime Post 1942
overview: On 7 February 1942, in the hardest years of the resistance, the CPC Shandong bureau and the Shandong wartime government established the Shandong Wartime Post General Bureau in Shuangquan Yuzi village, Mashichi township, Yinan county, in the Yimeng mountains — a wartime communications organisation combining intra-party transport, party-newspaper distribution and postal service.

title: Two from a Trio
overview: In a small city in Spain, an amateur poet crosses paths with a pickpocket who helps him in unexpected ways.

title: Fubei Park
overview: The building is gone. After the fire, they planted flowers and trees. The past lies covered, as if no one had ever lived here. There is no stone. No name to speak. The park grew green, but nothing named who once had been.

title: A Proper Christmas
overview: When her beloved British grandmother Iris arrives just in time for Christmas, Nora, a warm-hearted small-town schoolteacher and devoted single mom, finds her carefully ordered life beginning to shift in ways she never anticipated. Settling into their cozy coastal Southern town, Iris brings with her six generations of family Christmas ornaments, an arsenal of proper British recipes, and an unmistakable talent for gentle meddling.

title: Artificial
overview: An undercover cop is assigned to monitor a humanoid robot, but an unexpected bond over art leads to a final task: creating a painting.

title: Once Upon a Time in a Horror Movie
overview: In every horror movie, there's one killer story...  Hoping for an unforgettable birthday, a group of friends sign up for an immersive horror-movie experience that promises to place them inside their own 1980s slasher film. But as the night unfolds, the lines between fiction and reality disappear, and what begins as a game of make-believe soon becomes a desperate fight for survival, where the only way to stay alive is to make it to the final reel.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: Follow Me
overview: When Gidon Lev was just 6 years old, he arrived at the Nazi concentration camp of Theresienstadt. When he was 85 years old, he took social media by storm.

title: Exuvia
overview: When a young man steps into at tailor’s shop, his wish is not for a new tie…

title: Bitter Kiss
overview: A chance reunion with a childhood friend forces an introverted young man to confront his long-buried desires.

title: The House Call
overview: Called in the middle of the night to treat a sick horse, a young equine veterinarian is faced with a series of unlikely encounters.

title: L’incontro
overview: At two years old, Giorgio Bazzega loses his father, who is killed in 1976 by Walter Alasia, a young member of the Red Brigades. As he grows up, the loss becomes a deep wound, leading him during adolescence into drug addiction and a desire for revenge.  Years later, Giorgio encounters the Gruppo dell’Incontro, a restorative justice initiative that brings victims and former perpetrators of political violence together. Through listening and unexpected encounters, he begins a journey of transformation and reconciliation, confronting the wounds of Italy’s Years of Lead and discovering how recognizing the humanity of the other can become the first step toward healing.

title: Through Silence and Wind
overview: Matteo Righetto, a writer, prompts us, through his reflections, to consider the meaning of the mountains and how to experience them. Can the mountains teach us something different?

title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
overview: Six months after his harrowing escape from a mysterious Russian island, Jake Fernsby is still drowning in PTSD. When a distress signal suddenly comes up from a missing fighter pilot, Jake and a crack team of soldiers are selected to save the pilot. Unbeknownst to Jake and his squad, they're being sent straight into the Beast's home turf.

title: The Beast in the Cave
overview: A young security guard enters a forbidden cave after hearing a cry for help, only to discover that something monstrous lurks within its darkness.

title: Piss Up
overview: During a drunken altercation on a stag-do, Callum witnesses a dark side to the man who will soon marry his sister.

title: Mary
overview: A woman has a spirit haunting her upon leaving her church.

title: living
overview: A short documentary set in a chicken slaughterhouse, where, amidst the filth, stench, decaying remains of animal carcasses and swarms of insects, a cat and her kittens manage to survive. In a place so deeply marked by human indifference to the death of other creatures, they paradoxically provide at least a hint of the unyielding desire to play, explore, or simply to live.

title: Vanished 2: Legend of the Mask
overview: Three friends investigate the mysterious legend of the Masked Monster.

title: Faces
overview: After Eric dies, his three best friends are entrusted with breaking into his phone to delete its hidden contents. But what starts as a simple task unravels into a deadly nightmare…

title: What We Missed
overview: After being blindsided by sudden breakups, two heartbroken friends agree to spend a week fulfilling the bucket-list dates they never got to share with their exes

title: Inside the Mountain
overview: In 1988, Paul Eastwood and his climbing partner became the first men to free-climb Britain's deepest open cave shaft, rising from within the UK's largest underground chamber and traversing around its highest unbroken waterfall, three times the height of Niagara falls. The iconic route will have gone unrepeated for almost 40 years. Decades later a new team of climbers, Olympian Molly Thompson-Smith and legend Steve McClure, will tackle the climb once again, hoping to join the few who have ever free-climbed the route.

title: Star of the Sea - The Football, the Troubles and the Aftermath
overview: In 1960s Belfast, Star of the Sea was one of Ireland’s most successful youth football teams, bringing Catholic and Protestant players together at a time of growing division. But as the Troubles took hold, the team was torn apart and the lives of its players changed forever.

title: Maut
overview: Defying his father's wish to pass on the family reindeer-herding business, a young Evenk decides to leave for the city to work—a choice that becomes a personal tragedy for the herder.

title: Jeju Olle
overview: After losing her beloved cousin and longtime manager, Indian star Alisha steps away from the spotlight and travels to Jeju Island to fulfill a promise they once made together. There, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha Sun-woo, a former K-pop idol and singer-songwriter who has retreated to Jeju after his own career and confidence were shaken by the past. What begins as a chaotic misunderstanding gradually turns into an unexpected connection. Over the course of a week, Alisha and Sun-woo explore Jeju's breathtaking landscapes, share music, laughter, and quiet moments, and slowly begin to open up about the wounds they have kept hidden from the world.

title: Hell Has No Fire Escape
overview: Inheriting her husband’s evangelical drug clinic, Ina Dry clings to faith - until an online romance with “Jason Momoa” awakens desires that threaten her ministry and those who rely on her.

title: Dirt in Your Face
overview: In the summer of 1987, Estonia languishes under Soviet rule, stifling free expression. 17-year-old Mihkel, a rebellious musician, and his rival Hendrik learn of a Finnish talent scout visiting Estonia. To impress him, they must journey to a distant rock festival on the other side of the country. They assemble a group, including Mihkel's secret love Liisa. Amid rivalry and chaos, they navigate challenges, discovering their true selves along the way.

title: The Night of Samhain
overview: Samhain in ancient Ireland, a young boy makes his first mask to hide from wandering spirits, but his family’s supper is interrupted by a visitor from the Otherworld.

title: Abductees
overview: A streamer begins experiencing missing time and seeing unexplained lights in the sky.  Taking her friend she tries to document what is going on with her.

title: The Monster From The Deep
overview: In 1891 Ireland, two boys take off on an adventure to see a beached whale.

title: Portrait of possible grief
overview: The memorial card — a small, rectangular piece of paper. A name, a date, a face. It is given when something has to be let go: an administrative act, wrapped as a memory. But what if there was someone whose job it was to create that final image?  Lilith is a photographer specializing in portraits for memorial cards. She is contacted when people believe the end is near. From nursing home rooms to cramped kitchens, she moves through the uncomfortable space between existence and farewell, where routine and mortality strangely and effortlessly intersect.

title: Explore Freedom
overview: Six people. Three routes. And a journey that changed everything.  Explore Freedom is a gravel cycling film produced by El Flamingo Film, presented by Rose Bikes about keeping an open mind, embracing the unknown and discovering what happens when people connect through adventure and cycling.  Join Marcel Kittel, Burak Öztürk, Sami Sauri, Tsellot Melesse, Petor Georgallou and Sara van Vliet on an unforgettable bike packing adventure across Europe. From the first intimate moments at the start line not knowing anyone to the emotional finale in Pula, Explore Freedom tells a story about cycling, human connection and discovering freedom beyond borders.

title: #UnderTheInfluence
overview: Brooke and Chelsea Haven agree to star in a reality TV show, where reality is negotiable, secrets are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

title: Sestry
overview: Ema (23) returns home unexpectedly and reunites with her sister Mia (15), mother and grandmother in their beloved garden colony. The sisters relive childhood games, laughter and nostalgia and their bond is quietly renewed as they say goodbye.

title: Amor Eterno
overview: Amidst a solar flare phenomenon, two recently separated lovers seek to reconcile their relationship by revisiting their favourite pastime of karaoke.

title: Above Eternal Rest
overview: Social worker Rita spends her working days in the apartments of lonely elderly people. She refuses no one, helping everyone in need. Rita's life will begin to fall apart as soon as her son finds himself in a situation that leads to his death. And the woman's life will turn into hell.

title: Emma Rough
overview: A father and daughter meet for the first time in New York after Emma, a 20-year-old woman, completes her military service in the IDF and flies to New York in search of her father, who has ignored her existence since she was born in Israel.

title: Pirjo in Sweden
overview: When Pirjo Heikkilä embarrasses herself in public at a charity event, she begins to believe that she needs a change of scenery. Pirjo learns a surprising secret about her family that leads her to Sweden. Pirjo sets off on her journey convinced that her true life awaits her in Stockholm—surrounded by royalty, new friends, and greater human dignity. But the trip turns out to be anything but dignified. She faces one awkward situation after another and an endless need to appear more Swedish than she really is.
The experience of Maya's grief and despair from a past traumatic experience.

title: Crunch
overview: A woman who suffers with misophonia has to endure a loud crisp eater on the train.

title: That Damn Cat
overview: A cat becomes envious of his owner's romantic interests.

title: CRYONIC
overview: In the near future, two girls must escape their cult when they are selected to merge bodies with a frozen entity.

title: We’re Getting Out of Here Alive
overview: A policewoman and a pharmacist fight to control a hostage situation -- one from inside a store, the other from the outside.

title: First Voice
overview: In 1989, when workplace sexual harassment was rarely recognized as a legal issue in Japan, lawyer Michiko Asahi takes on an unprecedented case after office worker Megumi Uehara seeks to sue her company and supervisor over harassment that cost her her job. Despite a rookie lawyer's warning that the case has virtually no chance of success, Asahi believes their fight could change the future. Facing a legal system and society firmly rooted in conventional attitudes, the women risk their careers and reputations to challenge the status quo and make their voices heard.

title: The Piano Tuner
overview: Trapped in a lonely marriage, Antonia finds unexpected connection when a mysterious piano tuner named Angelo arrives. As music awakens old memories and hidden truths, a quiet afternoon leads to a life-changing decision.

title: Frequency of Fear
overview: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

title: Delirium Tremens
overview: An alcoholic discovers a haunted blender that only makes margaritas.

title: Tootsie Doomsday
overview: When the "Tootsie Virus" spreads globally, it compels men everywhere to fall in love with one another, triggering an unprecedented crisis of a severe shortage of straight men.

title: Weekend Warrior
overview: Tess goes to a Larp and transforms herself into the Elf General Tauriel. When her foot soldier is wounded in a fight with orcs she heals him with a magic balm, which gives the weekend war games an unexpected erotic turn.

title: Fəridəm
overview: A new movie from CVN team

title: The First Taste of Loneliness
overview: A single mother has the idea of restarting her marriage life. During the process of contacting different men around her, she felt confused and did not know where to go. Until the emotions buried in her past memories were awakened, she finally found her own answer.

title: Alex Jones: One Day in Aberfan
overview: Alex Jones marks the 60th anniversary of the mining disaster that claimed 144 lives, including 116 children

title: You Know I Love You
overview: In Mexico City, during a visit to their patriarchal grandparents' house, rebellious seven-year-old Lucía and her siblings will stumble upon something that will change their lives forever: their grandfather's revolver.

title: The Quiet Applause
overview: SONG San lives on a rural ranch, spending her days helping her father, Ki-yeol, tend to the sheep, and playing freely in nature. Although her life appears idyllic from the outside, she carries a quiet emptiness inside. She feels that her mother, Sun-hee, gives most of her attention to her older brother, SONG Pul, who has a disability. As her longing for her parents' undivided love grows stronger, San overhears her father considering whether to send Pul to a group home. From that moment on, she begins to devise a small, secret plan.

title: Some Time
overview: Andrés and Emma took a break from their relationship just days before their first anniversary together. To avoid being alone, he spends that evening at a friend's family dinner, unsure of what to do. There, he discusses his situation with his friend's colorful relatives, reminiscing about his relationship.

title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

title: Make Some Noise: Mano Negra!
overview: In the 1980s, Mano Negra exploded onto the music scene. Fronted by Manu Chao, the band brought together a group of furious visionaries with a unique sound who set the world ablaze in just five years. This portrait raises a question: whatever happened to our utopias?

title: Kiriko's Baton: YELL
overview: Years after graduating from high school, music journalist Shō Kitamura is assigned to write about his former teacher, Kiriko Harada, a legendary choir instructor known for inspiring troubled students with her remarkable conducting and unwavering belief in them. But Kiriko has retired and mysteriously disappeared. As Shō reunites with former choir classmates and retraces their memories of their beloved teacher, he begins to uncover the story behind her disappearance and the profound impact she had on their lives. Inspired by Ikimonogakari’s hit song “YELL,” Echoes of Kiriko is a heartfelt drama about music, friendship, hope, and the enduring bond between a teacher and her students.

title: Desenlace
overview: At night, an almost empty office space is inhabited by lives, movement, and noise.

title: CAPTURED
overview: Andy, a stressed and obsessive wildlife photographer desperate for a competition-winning shot, sets out alone into the woods where his anxiety, lack of medication, and mounting frustration blur the line between ambition and self-destruction.

title: Squel, Confessions of the Carnival Queen
overview: After retiring in 2022, Squel Jorgea decided to return to Rio’s Carnival. A flag-bearer for over twenty years, she began her career at Grande Rio, where she danced for eleven seasons and became the first to represent both Mangueira and Portela, the two most traditional samba schools. After navigating single motherhood, she has rediscovered the physicality, movement, and strength that established her as a leading figure in the art form; she now dances a theme inspired by the book "Um Defeito de Cor", a son’s letter to his enslaved mother, a narrative that deeply resonates with her own life story. Between the silence and the beat of the drums, her dance transforms into a ritual, an act of resistance, and a celebration of Afro-Brazilian culture.

title: A Special Day
overview: A seemingly normal family home movie is interrupted by a shocking event.

title: Amazing Monster
overview: Maria comes from a sacred family and wants to become a miko in her village of Appare. When a secret that has been kept hidden for 18 years is revealed, a mysterious power awakens within her.

title: Sapiro vs. Ford: The Jew Who Sued Henry Ford
overview: In the 1920s, a Jewish lawyer challenges automobile magnate Henry Ford with a landmark libel suit that confronts virulent antisemitic attacks.

title: The Window
overview: A young man arrives at a family home, where a seemingly ordinary visit takes an unexpected turn when he is drawn into a strange and unsettling story surrounding an open window. Based on Saki’s classic short story, the film explores deception, imagination and the consequences of believing what you are told.

title: Vivian Campbell: Between Stages
overview: Def Leppard guitarist Vivian Campbell finally pursues the childhood dream he set aside for music: rally racing, finding in its speed, risk, and total focus a new way to live fully while continuing to live with Hodgkin lymphoma.

title: The Jesus Tapes
overview: Jesus returns to a disturbed, distracted world and is interviewed on a public access TV show.

title: Saint & the Sea
overview: As a storm approaches their coastal village, a fisherman’s family prepares for the departure of their 14-year-old daughter.

title: Not A Love Story
overview: Alec and Chenoa rediscover their friendship after 10 years apart. But family feuds bring them unimaginable tragedy. They overcome the anger and heartbreak and eventually acknowledge their love for each other and find reconciliation.

title: Omsorg
overview: A young woman's voice drifts among friends at a lakeside, where sunlight, water, and memory merge as she meditates on intimacy, desire, and the quiet urge to be free.

title: Clutch
overview: In a futuristic Lagos, Kay, bike mechanic prodigy, yearns to become a street racer like his idol Maze. Desperate to turn his dream into reality, he enters the dangerous Japa Rush. Will he make it to the finish line?

title: Disquiet
overview: Following a regular elderly customer's wish, a young supermarket cashier goes to check on her apartment after she vanishes. But once inside, she surrenders to a whole new drive.

title: Death Came Knocking
overview: In the summer of 1978, two cousins are trapped inside their childhood home by a group of strangers. As the night continues, survival slowly turns to murder.

title: Odium Zero
overview: 14 days ago, a comet ripped across the sky, unleashing the disaster now known as the Grayfall. Within hours, parasitic spores called Gray Matters transformed people into savage monsters known as Spikers, collapsing society overnight. Governments sealed off infected cities, buried the truth, and left the outbreak zones to rot. 16-year-old influencer Mai, refusing to believe the official story, breaks into Central Hospital—the outbreak’s ground zero—with her AI cobot, BooBoo. Inside, fear spreads faster than the infection as survivors turn on each other. After rescuing a little girl named Anna, Mai fights to escape a hospital overrun by Spikers. Her path collides with Ren Cade, a ruthless black-ops commander hunting her, while Dr. Theodore secretly pulls the strings from mission control. But Theodore has one more ace up his sleeve: Ares, a genetically engineered killing machine built for one job—and one job only: to take Mai down.

title: Grow
overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

title: yolo
overview: The director finds herself torn between her newfound role as a mother and the loss of her own place as a daughter while caring for her dying mother, in an intimate portrait of life starting and ending, and of how loss can become the foundation for new beginnings.

title: Hellbox IV - The Key Of Evil
overview: The key of evil is forged in hell, and a demon escapes with it, asking for help from the former priest Rodrigo, what he doesn't know is that the devil's bounty hunter is coming for the search, with all the forces of darkness with him.

title: A Letter to Home
overview: In wintertime Berlin, a cyclist finds a letter. A letter written from exile. Between documentary images and fictional scenes, the film unfolds as a reflection on home, distance, and absence.

title: El club de la seducción
overview: The film follows two men with opposing personalities whose lives unexpectedly cross paths. Driven by a debt, parties, romances, and impulsive decisions, they find themselves caught up in a series of chaotic situations that blend humor, action, and romance.

title: Nurture
overview: When a global pandemic shuts Hong Kong’s borders, hundreds of thousands of foreign domestic workers are stranded far from home. Among them is Sonia, a strong-willed Indonesian domestic worker whose world is shattered when she learns that her mother has died. Unable to return home, she takes it upon herself to organize the funeral from afar, piecing together a final farewell through a livestream thousands of miles away. But she’s forced to choose between her mother’s final farewell and the woman who depends on her for care.

title: MADE IN X
overview: Blending raw documentary realism with surreal, stylised dreamscapes, MADE IN X follows a young immigrant navigating life on the margins of a society that sees her as a label before a person. From workplace microaggressions to housing discrimination, her daily struggles are interwoven with poetic sequences where traditional garments, textures, and memories become tools of resistance and an escape. As fashion transforms into a language of identity and protest, the film explores how origin defines worth - not only for fashion items, but for people as well.

Follow a group of eight explorers and two leaders who reach a mountain refuge in the Pyrenees, only to be cut off by a snowstorm. When they take a headcount, they discover an extra child that no one remembers.

title: The Illusion of a Quiet Night
overview: Filmed during one night in July 2025 by forty filmmakers and hundreds of citizens, The Illusion of a Quiet Night paints a vast collective portrait of war-torn Ukraine. Between fear and exhaustion, moments of joy and scenes of the ordinary day to day, we watch as life goes on in spite of everything, witnessing the resilience of a nation gripped by uncertainty.

title: Before We Leave Tuscany
overview: A weary mother seeking solace retreats to a serene Tuscan villa, where the adorable Italian innkeeper and a handsome novelist with writer's block, draw her into a story of unexpected connection and renewal.

title: Eat Up My Brain
overview: After a bicycle accident, a traveler finds himself in the home of a girl he has never met. An attraction develops between them, gradually giving way to tension. Romantic intimacy turns into musical dissonance and collective psychosis, from which the protagonist struggles to escape.

title: The Distant Home
overview: Su-a arrives in Yangsan to visit her grandmother, but she is not home. The old lady is not someone with many places to go - just the bathhouse or the Buddhist temple.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: The Fall
overview: In the early 18th century, in the Blue Mountains of Jamaica, enslaved Africans who had escaped from plantations founded autonomous communities of Maroons. Queen Nanny, their supreme leader, led their struggle for freedom.

title: Frankie’s Way - When Baking Pizza Becomes a Crime
overview: Frankie lives in Prague and starts making Neapolitan pizza at home, out of a tiny electric oven, for the delight of his friends. After some months, what was a passion-fueled pastime ends up turning into an actual business. Thanks to word of mouth and social networks, tens of clients buy his pizza every week and his apartment turns into a social hub for pizza lovers. Is this the first step to a collective addiction? Success never comes easy, they say... and in fact, as soon as the word is out about these delicious pizzas, Pulcinella, guardian mask of Neapolitan traditions, senses the mockery and drags Frankie in front of the Supreme Court of the Commedia dell’Arte masks. Pulcinella believes Frankie has no right to customize such an ancient tradition to his liking.

title: Spring Song
overview: Short description

title: Neural Command
overview: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.

title: I promise I won't bore you.
overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

title: The Easy Way Out
overview: Ted returns to his hometown to find his big brother Jim at the end of his rope. But is it too late to save him?

title: Reminiscence
overview: After losing his girlfriend in a car crash, a teenage boy recalls old memories.

title: Outposts: Nothing Here is Yours
overview: Outposts have become a major tool for taking control of land in the occupied West Bank and displacing Palestinian communities. These communities face escalating daily violence, threats and when they simply can’t take it anymore – displacement. Over 60 Palestinian communities have been displaced since October 7. Israeli activists come in daily shifts, armed only with their phones, to document, confront settlers, and stand in solidarity as the Palestinian communities struggle to remain on their land.

title: Trinket Box
overview: A newlywed interracial couple Mike and Ava move to a new home set on starting new beginnings, but an historical evil, locked away for years, is about to break free and wreak havoc on their relationship and their lives.

title: Jeet Ki Zid
overview: Major Deep Singh loses his ability to walk after he gets injured during the Kargil war. Will he also lose his mind and his spirit? Or will he rise again?
In an Andean village in Peru, in 1982, Tato, a 12-year-old boy is forced into exile when his family is threatened.

title: Dante
overview: Raúl, a bodyguard on the verge of retirement, works alongside his son. Upon returning to work after an accident, he accepts an order to get rid of his boss's dog, Dante, a decision that puts him at odds with his son. Following failed attempts, Raúl confronts his feelings of obsolescence and must decide how far he will go to maintain his status.

title: Arina
overview: When fidelity has lost its meaning and love has turned into dependence, betrayal becomes a feat. The story of an artist who is looking for peace within, after war has knocked at her door.

title: The Dark Gets In
overview: When a documentary team set out to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a young girl, events soon take an unexpected turn, leading the filmmakers down an increasingly dark and horrifying path.

title: Sunday
overview: Over the course of a week in Santiago, Anastasia tries to maintain a sense of normalcy between work, her friends, and her relationship. But the approach of an inevitable event ultimately shatters the fragile balance that has allowed her to keep moving forward.

title: Maria of Maria
overview: Brazil, 1940. Maria, a young outlaw, discovers she is pregnant; after her band is wiped out, she flees to the Center-West to give birth and start life anew. She joins Getúlio Vargas’s "March to the West" government program, which promised land to small farmers. In the first half of the story, Maria confronts untamed nature—discovering that farming is an art. In the second, her past comes back to haunt her, and she must summon her fiercest, most indomitable courage.

title: Hope Chest
overview: Class Assignment: An oral essay on your hopes and dreams for your future. Eve’s Opening Statement: “I hope the FBI agent who finds my body is predisposed to sadness.”

title: Together as One
overview: In the middle of the Pacific, the Fiji Islands. A village, a community, nestled between ocean and mountains. An island shaken by climate change. Storm clouds loom ahead, while the Fijians remain calm and share a lust for life. Collective strength. Providence. Erasure. Words mingle with the elements, and nature intimately weaves together the relationship between humans and their environment. Two scales, two parallel ways of looking at things, but both speaking with one voice.

title: The French Renaissance
overview: A true artistic and cultural explosion originating in Italy, the Renaissance allowed France to discover the great Leonardo da Vinci and to build magnificent castles. During this period, Francis I, the “Knight King,” sought to adorn France with every splendor, while the Wars of Religion deeply divided the country. From the Loire Valley to Paris, which was establishing itself as a true capital, this journey through time offers a chance to admire spectacular achievements of the era, such as Leonardo da Vinci’s castle, the Queen’s Palace, and the Samaritaine Fountain.

title: AWM (Agney Weds Minal)
overview: Inspired by real-life stories and the lives of real couples, AWM takes you on an emotional journey of love, relationships, courage, dreams and the choices that shape our lives.

title: Miracle Summer
overview: Mahiro returns to her hometown after a long absence. There, a small miracle quietly awakens memories she has long kept buried deep within her heart.

title: Un mal partido
overview: An overprotective father clashes with his daughter's boyfriend during a family trip, leading to comedic tension as he struggles to accept their relationship while trying to maintain control.

title: The Borrowed Life
overview: In her screen comeback, Ella Cruz stars as a girl who becomes pretty in real life via a beauty filter app to make an impression on a crush. But the fragile illusion of her borrowed look begin to show and collapse as soon as real feelings grow.

title: a pink and red dress, made of satin… covered in flowers, mostly roses
overview: Elsa remembers her mother truly happy only when she was singing. As a child, she and her twin brother would secretly watch her perform at The Little Onne Theatre. Now grown, Elsa sings on the same stage, in the same flower-covered dress her mother once wore.

title: Razing Halloween
overview: After a successful Halloween, Nicole's brother, Gregory's candy is stolen by three goons. It's up to Nicole to get it back.

title: One Night Away
overview: Seher, living in a container camp in Antakya after the earthquake, finds herself chasing after the aid supplies she missed while trying to find a way to reissue her lost university exam entrance document the night before the exam.

title: Kalkutún, Trial of the Witches
overview: In 1880, an inexperienced prosecutor must indict a group of people accused of witchcraft and murder on the island of Chiloé. Meanwhile, a young peasant girl, to save her grandfather from the condemnation of the state, must be initiated into witchcraft.

title: Tales of the Sea
overview: Two young men from different backgrounds, with different upbringings and life stories, find themselves lost on a boat in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea. They soon realize that the only way for them to survive is to set aside their differences and work together.

title: The Tuk Tuk Guy
overview: Comedy hybrid short film following a Tuk Tuk driver who, while being questioned by two officers, recounts his previous night’s surreal experiences through an animated "stoned" lens. Five stories overlap as Hamama, the Tuk Tuk driver, tries to figure out what Hossam and Refaat want to know specifically Hossam, who came here for a truly weird reason.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: An Ideal Husband
overview: A prominent politician is preparing to expose a financial scandal. But then a woman who has invested heavily in the shady venture threatens to uncover a damaging secret in the politician's past if he exposes the speculation as a fraud. His problem is compounded by his wife's intolerance of the slightest character flaws.

title: Playback
overview: When Jess is given the footage of her missing sister’s last moments, she triggers unfortunate events to unfold.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: Mysteries of Our Summer
overview: A team of filmmakers travels around Lithuania’s summer festivals – from Midsummer’s Day and Assumption Day to the first day of September, which marks the end of summer – capturing short, playful moments of their journey on 16 mm film. By asking people they meet about miracles, faith, childhood, and memories, the filmmakers unexpectedly reveal hidden stories and sensitive confessions.

title: Trixie's Halloween Mattelathon
overview: Drag Superstar Trixie Mattell hosts her 2026 Halloween special.

title: Crystal Lake Girls
overview: When young, hot, nubile Madison agrees to spend the summer at the “Crystal Lake Retreat”, a new cozy institution for troubled young women instead of prison, she thinks her troubles are over. Girl fights and lecherous guards? No problem. However, for poor Madison, that is when the real trouble begins as this summer marks the 30th Anniversary of Jason’s murderous killing spree on Friday the 13th. Now Madison is locked in with seven other women as they are hunted by a serial killer known only as “the President”, several guards who are pigs, one head honcho who is a hottie and a couple of yahoos for the law.  Can she survive or will she become another victim?

title: Between Us
overview: Estranged after a past incident, Makoto and Kasumi reunite in their high school drama club. Through acting, they rebuild their friendship.

title: Illuminations
overview: A contemplative portrait of experimental filmmakers Nathaniel Dorsky and Jerome Hiler, and their shared devotion to the art of seeing that has shaped their work, their love, and more than fifty years of life together.

title: Answer
overview: Every afternoon, Mateo stops at a phone booth to make a call. His mother sees these calls as dangerous fantasies she fears encouraging. But in resisting, she faces a harder question: whether her denial is what's pushing her son away.

title: Afterglow
overview: On St. Patrick’s Day,  a lonely Indian student in Boston wanders into a lively Irish pub, where he encounters a mysterious Irish girl who pulls him onto the dance floor. As they dance, the boundary between memory and reality begins to dissolve, forcing him to confront the grief he has struggled to leave behind.

title: Tina and the Fly
overview: After a terrible breakup, a woman develops a toxic codependent relationship with a house fly.

title: Doggerland
overview: Instead of finding a “proper” job, Alf, pushing 40, lives with his mum and drifts though Norrköping’s cultural scene. Chats & faces, routines & intuitions, local politics & everyday life – the intimate and the social, in black-and-white analogue images.

title: Ensaiando o Brasil
overview: A sensitive portrait of the behind-the-scenes at the Tom Jobim Youth Orchestra in São Paulo, where young artists with classical backgrounds are challenged to immerse themselves in Brazilian popular music and create together. All scores are specially composed or arranged for the training orchestra, where these young musicians discover their Brazilian roots through a process that transforms not only the music, but the artists themselves.

title: Faraway Home
overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

title: The Tall-N-Short Halloween Special - Vol. VII
overview: The seventh annual TNS Halloween Special

title: Connection Lost
overview: After winning a scholarship, Bruno, a lonely young man, travels to Buenos Aires for the first time and sets out to meet Tomás, the virtual friend who accompanied him throughout his childhood but with whom he lost contact. To do so, he must follow the trail of photographs that Tomás used to send him in the past, reliving his day-to-day life until he reaches his house. The thread of images and past chats will be the key to understanding why the friendship broke down and, when the photographs lead down a dark path beyond the house, why his tragic fate came to be.

title: A Little Mischief
overview: Afshin, a graphic designer at a publishing house, buys a “Thing” action figure for a photoshoot, only to discover something strange about it.

title: Julienne
overview: Julienne intimately follows a woman whose obsessive diet and exercise regimen gradually drives her towards a fate she never saw coming.

title: Tendu Pointe Battement
overview: A celebration of dance, music, movement, language, and animation.

title: Chronique Printanière de la Famille d’un Mort-vivant
Flut
overview: Jonathan and Dominik work together on a ship. After a while, the two of them find the courage to talk about what they have in common: They’re both afraid to be openly gay.

title: Secrets Of The Viking Ship with Bettany Hughes
overview: The historian investigates the discovery of a group of Viking graves in the eastern Baltic that date back over 1200 years, predating the established start of the Viking era. Bettany follows the investigation from Estonia to Sweden, uncovering how scientists and archaeologists reconstructed the men's origins, kinship and fate, and uncovered a tantalising question. Could one of these warriors have been the legendary Viking king who inspired an epic saga?

title: Stars on the Ceiling
overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

title: Coast to Coast
overview: An overworked bureaucrat is tasked to fix the broken office printer when his routine errand spirals into a surreal odyssey across the island.

title: Swimmers
overview: Marco is a timid teen who has yet to discover his own agency. Over his summer break, he signs up for a lifeguard training course, where he becomes entranced by his polar opposite, Xavier; a boy of mystery and unknown sexuality. Not wanting to risk making a fool of himself or stand out, Marco hides his feelings. When Marco is partnered up with Xavier for CPR and in-water drills, a connection begins to form. As Marco's confidence grows, so does their friendship. When it becomes clear Xavier may feel the same way, Marco must decide whether to act on his feelings or let his queer joy pass him by.

title: The Meryl Streep Project
overview: What began merely as an entertaining performance, the 'Meryl Streep Project' has transformed into an icon of resistance, exposing the realities of women's rights in South Korea. However, following the COVID-19 pandemic, the project has taken an unexpected turn.

title: Cardi B: Tiny Desk Concert
overview: A unique live music by Cardi B, behind the iconic desk at the NPR Music offices.

title: One Night Stand
overview: A married man's reckless decision to cheat during a night out spirals into a deadly nightmare when his mysterious hookup turns out to be a calculated serial killer targeting unfaithful men. As she embeds herself deeper into his life-stalking him, infiltrating his workplace, and getting dangerously close to his pregnant wife-he's forced to confront the consequences of his betrayal before everything he loves is destroyed.

title: Not a Family
overview: The story follows Na Byeong-soo, a young job-seeker whose life is upended when his 60-year-old stepfather commits adultery. During the ensuing parental divorce, Byeong-soo visits a hidden property owned by his stepfather and encounters Geum Chae-rin, a 29-year-old pregnant tenant. Suspecting her of being the mistress, he demands that she leaves, but she refuses, sparking a series of chaotic and emotional conflicts that redefine their understanding of family.

title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale
overview: From unforgettable stages to a journey shared with A’TIN,  SB19 brings it all to the big screen.  The most awaited finale is coming to cinemas worldwide.

title: Rooted Out: Chapter One
overview: Set against the backdrop of the Southport Riots of 2024, a dispute between neighbouring families over a tree spirals into a volatile confrontation, exposing buried prejudice, racial tension, and moral hypocrisy.

title: Love & Sex on Streaming
overview: Having stumbled upon a crazy sex video featuring his girlfriend and her ex-boyfriend, and his perception of sex and love overturned by a sexy camgirl, a young man found himself in the world of live streaming.

title: Gentle by Birth
overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

title: Lesya Ukrainka's Pleyada
overview: At the tail end of the 19th century, a young up-and-coming composer and author named Larysa Petrivna Kosach Kvitka decides to take her amateur writing to the next level, and, along with a group of like-minded individuals forms the Pleiada Literary Association and takes on a new name: Lesya Ukrainka.

title: Seppuku: The Sun Goes Down
overview: Kakizaki Yuji’s period film is not like the jidaigeki films we are used to. While it deals with themes of seppuku, duty, and loyalty to one’s masters and the shogun, we see very little in terms of action. Instead, the film focuses on the inner thoughts and struggles of the protagonist—who is ordered to perform a ritual suicide—his wife, and their entire household, all leading up to the final moment.

title: Cold Call
overview: An extremely dedicated office worker begins to question her workplace’s mission of scamming strangers in order to return to their home planet. An eccentric and creative take on the absurdities of office culture and conspiracy theories, this dark comedy is utterly singular.

title: The Opposite Road
overview: “The best voice in Argentine rock.” That’s how Hernán Reyna, leader of El Corte, a cult post-punk band from the 1980s, is remembered. The Opposite Road reconstructs his story with home movies and testimonies, adding a missing chapter to Argentine rock

title: The Diego Nobody Saw
overview: An intimate documentary about Diego Armando Maradona, told from a unique perspective: through the eyes of someone who quietly stood by his side, capturing moments the world had never seen. Through exclusive photos and private videos, the film reveals Diego beyond the stadium and the myth, showing his most human side. For years, Jorge Luengo witnessed defining and everyday moments of Maradona?s life.

title: BAILAR O MORIR
overview: The most influential artists of Argentine pop step out of their own universes to create BOM.

title: Sometimes all you need is a red sky
overview: A child book’s illustrator goes all the way to South Korea to finish up his next project. However inside every spring-warm street the only thing that comes up to his mind is the girl with whom he thinks shares the same sky.

title: Bag Buddies
overview: Two dolls hanging from a young girl's backpack become instant rivals, until unexpected news makes them realize what truly matters.

title: Wild Horizon
overview: Rio de Janeiro, winter 2024. In search of the perfect wave, a fearless surfer meets a free-spirited mentor and embarks on a journey of self-discovery, realizing that the true Wild Horizon lies within her own soul.

title: PASTIS
overview: Sasha, 20, returns to her family’s sun-soaked home in the south of France with her friends—her first visit since her older sister’s death. What begins as an idyllic summer escape slowly curdles into something far more suffocating.

title: Hanami
overview: On a remote volcanic island that everybody wants to leave, little Nana learns to stay. Her mother, Nia, went into exile right after she was born and Nana grows up in the family of her father. One day, the family learns that Nia is ill. Nana begins to develop high fevers and is sent to the foot of a volcano for treatment. There she encounters a world steeped in magical realism, between dreams and reality. Later, when Nana is a teenager, her mother Nia finally returns to the island.

title: Adiós Buenos Aires
overview: Buenos Aires, November 2001. Argentina is embroiled in crisis, with the Peso plunging deeper and deeper. Julio Färber, the charismatic bandoneon player of the 'Vecinos de Pompeya', a five-piece working-class tango band, is trying to keep his head above water, but every month he is earning less and less from their gigs as well as from the traditional shoe shop he inherited from his father. At the very moment he takes the decision to leave his beloved Buenos Aires forever, it clearly appears that life is conspiring against him: overnight, the government freezes all bank accounts in the whole country, preventing Julio from purchasing the flight tickets and sparking violent protests throughout the town. And Mariela, a witty young woman and feisty cab driver, bumps into his car at full speed, damaging Julio's last possession of value before stealing his heart.

title: Ice-Skating  Class
overview: In the heat of Thailand, Mint goes through ordinary childhood days, often compared to her older sister. When her best friend Kao introduces her to ice skating, Mint discovers a new passion and begins to dream of taking classes with her friend. But in a country where winter never comes, her small dream soon encounters the realities of home.

title: The Great Magic Showdown
overview: Papa Smurf is honored to be invited by the great Homnibus to take part, with other witches and wizards, in the creation of the philosopher’s stone.

title: One Tina
overview: A friendship solidified in delusion.

title: La meute en réseau
overview: The web was meant to be a sanctuary of free expression. For many women, it has instead become a nightmare. Three times more likely than men to face death threats, rape threats and online smear campaigns, they are increasingly targeted by coordinated attacks designed to silence them and drive them out of the digital public sphere. Exhausted by this relentless abuse, many eventually choose to leave. Featuring testimonies from Marlène Schiappa, Ève Gilles, Élise Bordet and Laura Loock.

title: Por ahí
overview: Nacho, Benja’s best friend, is gone. In his place, there is only an obscure object. Benja waits for him, trying to decipher the clues he left behind. But even if Nacho does return, there is no certainty that he will be the same as before.

title: Aqui Comem Os Pombos
overview: A young man spends a day at the beach, contemplating the sand, sea, and sky as he narrates his thoughts and memories. Through silence and fleeting moments, he reflects on loss, grief, longing, and the absence of someone he deeply loved.

title: Play Gun
overview: Atlas picks up a pantomime firearm.

title: La pequeña gran boda de poco presupuesto en la casa de campo
John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
overview: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon.

title: When the World Will Look at Us
overview: A young man with sinister intentions goes to school with a weapon in his pocket. Their world is about to change. He arrives in the worst possible place at the worst possible time, as an overwhelmed teacher and his classroom debate the meaning of democracy.

title: Golem
overview: The village idiot lives in a hut with his sick mother. His neighbors are the Jewish family of the local blacksmith Mendel, and the guy is secretly in love with his youngest daughter Sonya.

title: This Is the One They'll Remember Me By
overview: Actress Robin Beck is thrown into a downward spiral when she hears rumors of the upcoming remake for the film that made her a star, PLACES! (dir. Bert Hayley, 1983).

title: Ultra Sound
overview: After a positive pregnancy test leads Wyn to discover she has no uterus, her life of sweeping romance is turned upside down, forcing her into a sudden and unexpected growth years later.

title: War of the Worlds
overview: Collage film built upon the audio of The War of the Worlds, directed and narrated by Orson Welles. Originally broadcast in October 1938 as a Halloween prank, the program famously triggered mass panic across the United States, as its format—presented as a series of live news bulletins—proved uncannily convincing. Absorbing the visual language of the contemporary media environment, W:A:R:O:F:T:H:E:W:O:R:L:D:S constructs a peculiar media-archaeological artifact. AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

title: Unbound Voices
overview: Village cadre Zhou Qinzhi and volunteer teacher Feng Ji overcame difficulties together to set up a choir, enabling girls in the mountainous areas to grow up amid life’s hardships and care from society.

title: Pinch Play
overview: Coach Gao strikes a shady deal with rival Coach Ma, throwing the game in exchange for sponsorship. Gao sends in bench player Ku, hoping for a quick out. But Ku's unexpected swing catches the other team off guard, and the young boy's raw passion reminds Gao why he coaches in the first place.

title: We, Brothers
overview: Two old fellow mobsters meet up at hideout to discuss their next job. They plunge into a conversation recollecting their past deeds together, which leads them into argument and rivalry, until one of them realizes something is quite wrong.

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: Casting Call
overview: Floyd, a lifelong lonely casting director who desperately dreams of having a girlfriend, turns his latest film project into a personal dating app to 'lock in' his perfect leading lady. By manipulating the director into casting 'The One,' he sets out to make her his first-ever romantic partner.

title: Fig
overview: Swimming in the sea, silent meals, attempts to hold on to intimacy — this is how the couple spends the final days of their relationship at an old summer house on the Caspian shore. Years later, the man lives alone in the house he once built beside that same summer place. The fig tree and the sea remain the same. Simple tastes and moments remind that life goes on. And solitude can be a conscious choice.

title: Soundos: Witte ruis
overview: Registration of the fifth comedy special by the Dutch comedian Soundos.

title: Gnomes
overview: A trip to a road side grave turns into a whirl of emotions as two people struggle to process the loss of a loved one.

title: Injury
overview: Saeed, a forensic medical expert who assesses compensation for bodily injuries, is confronted at work by a woman who claims he is responsible for her injuries.

title: Smart Love
overview: The end and the beginning of the relationship between Jade and Caio, the first human couple in history to be brought together by an artificial intelligence.

title: Brand New Landscape
overview: In bustling Tokyo, Ren delivers delicate orchids across the city, carrying the weight of his mother's absence and years of silence between him and his father, until one delivery changes everything.

title: The End Date
overview: Eat cauliflower with mayonnaise. Sort through papers. Take care of the chickens. Feed the metastases. Learn poems. Drink beer. Prepare his family.  Although doctors gave him three years to live, Yann Patou lived with cancer for 18 years. As death approaches, Yann tries to keep smiling and constantly reminds me that we must ‘hurry up and live.

title: Nico Carney: WEE LAD
overview: Filmed at The Bell House in Brooklyn, NY

title: FRIDA: THE GIRL JUST DOESN’T GO AWAY
overview: Explores the transformation from artist to icon of Mexican painter Frida Kahlo, one of the most recognized influencers of our time. The many representations of her, beyond a single image have been appropriated by diverse groups from Chicanx and Mexican identity, disability to queer representation, just some of the diverse groups within which Frida Kahlo has become an inescapable reference and symbol. An extraordinary and unique phenomenon, Fridamania! Combines the iconic, mythic with an inexhaustible consumer culture.

title: Snow at Zabala Park
overview: On his birthday, Luciano waits for Agustín in Plaza Zabala. He sends him voice messages downplaying the hours going by, but the wait begins to weigh on him more than he lets on.

title: My Nudity Means Nothing
overview: As a novelist, actress/screenwriter for François Ozon and director, Marina de Van is fearless, always eager to deal with taboos and expose herself. Mostly home-made and shot under the radar, Ma nudité ne sert à rien is a brave self-portrait of de Van as a forty-something wandering soul, asking herself about her work, body and relationships in the age of dating apps and one-night stands.

title: Afternoon on the Bridge
overview: A sad-looking man stands under a bridge cutting across the heart of city. When he skillfully skips stones, a woman watching him from the other side throws stones into the water.

title: Strangle
overview: Haunted by a recent encounter in the woods, a young man returns to a residential estate to track down a mysterious driver and confront the blurred lines of his own obsession.

title: Stop Being So Dramatic
overview: Haunted by a painful past, Julia escapes into a dark fairy-tale world where mocking witches force her to confront the emotional weight she has carried for years.

title: Blue Days
overview: Beaten by bullies in the schoolyard, a young man finds refuge in an abandoned house and in his lover’s promise of escape.

title: The Art of Adventure
overview: In 1957, world renowned wildlife artist Robert Bateman and spirited biologist Bristol Foster embarked on a global expedition in a Land Rover they called 'The Grizzly Torque' – a journey that ignited a deep love of our planet and set in motion a powerful story of environmental activism though art and science.

title: Hunted
overview: A story of ten years old Karl who is living in Berlin in the beginning of thirties.

title: Kan Kardeşi - Those in Between
overview: A few meters from the UN buffer zone, Ayşegül and her best friend Adnan grow up in Lefkoşa, the Turkish-controlled half of Cyprus’s divided capital. From the rooftops, they gaze at the European south – close enough to touch and yet out of reach: as the daughter of Turkish settlers, Ayşegül cannot cross the border. She works at a supermarket and dreams of a life in France, while Adnan aspires to a career as a professional badminton player. But family expectations, Ayşegül’s engagement to her jealous ex-boyfriend, and Adnan’s military service test their friendship and plans for the future.

title: The Logger
overview: “It’s warm at home” — a thought that carries the lumberjack as he cuts firewood in the winter taiga. He sees himself back with his wife and four children: first the stove, warmth for his own household, then the rounds selling wood to other houses, putting a little money by for the family. He is afraid that before long he will have to leave them.  The taiga itself seems to help him. But the taiga is a force beyond human command: it can warm, and it can burn, taking what is dear.

title: Matty Ryan: Live in Chicago
overview: Matty Ryan has shares stories about being too high for 7-11, billionaires stealing blood from their teen sons, how mummies started COVID, and much more. He turns small annoyances into big laughs, rides the line between chaos and charm.

title: The End of Nowhere
overview: A grieving woman wanders the beautiful and mysterious West Texas desert in her car searching for answers in the surreal and supernatural phenomenon known as "The Lights."

title: Why Don't You See Me?
overview: Through the mimicry of a shadow play, a storyteller guides us through the tale of a man willing to do anything to win a woman's attention, mistaking obsession for romance and fear for love.

title: This is Not An Apple
overview: Palestinian brothers Yahya and Reda live in a neighbourhood in Oslo where their role models are often local gangsters. What begins as a seemingly insignificant argument within the gang ends in an attempted murder that leaves Yahya with life-threatening injuries. Against all odds, he survives. The brothers are faced with the choice of taking revenge or choosing forgiveness.

title: Singgaramm
overview: An ordinary man finds himself cornered by a world that demands his surrender. Refusing to bow down, he summons the courage to stand his ground and sets out on a path that will rewrite his destiny.

title: Algo Más Para Decir
overview: Algo más para decir revisits images produced by the Cine Escuela Argentino project, an initiative launched by the Ministry of Education between 1947 and 1952 to support classroom instruction across the country.  The short film offers a journey through these images—acting as a window into the past—to observe what remains, what has changed, and what no longer exists.

title: Suzie dans la forêt
overview: Devastated by a painful loss, Suzie gradually rediscovers her zest for life through her encounters with animals, both domestic and wild.

title: EXP. MASC. AD
overview: An archival short film built from videos recorded in 2011 on a Nokia 5230 during the filmmaker’s high school years, when filming was simply an act of capturing without a defined purpose. Fifteen years later, those images are reinterpreted through editing on a Samsung A26. Through playful and violent fragments, the film explores the adolescent heterosexual masculine experience, while reflecting on the evolution of the mobile phone as a tool that first democratized audiovisual recording and, by 2026, also made editing more accessible.

title: Click Clack, Front & Caps
overview: On the drive home from a night-long hotel party, Eve finally gets a moment alone with the crush she’s kept secret for years, her brother’s best mate, and shoots her shot.

title: Seamless
overview: Julie Burton's costume shop creates works of art under tight deadlines- working so every piece on every actor appears seamless.

title: MUNCH
overview: When The Nice Guy Finally Gets The Girl…

title: Shapes and Sizes
overview: On the same day she performed as the before picture for a weight-loss app, a young woman auditions for a high-profile body positivity campaign. As the casting process grows increasingly questionable, the language of empowerment begins to feel quite similar to the shaming it claims to oppose.

title: The Paper Flower
overview: A male artist working at a book fair reunites with a woman he once had feelings for. Through books, their platonic love begins.

title: JJ Records
overview: Leuven, 1980. After the rock and blues years, Leuven, too, falls completely under the spell of (post-)punk and new wave.  Johan Janssens and Jeanot Ampen—shortened to “JJ”—open a small record shop in a dilapidated building on Parijsstraat; it quickly gains a reputation within the scene as being unconventional, independent, and underground.  JJ Records is een historische documentaire film over de donkere jaren '80 en vroege jaren '90, de jaren van de hokjes en bijhorende looks, de jaren waarin een heel nieuwe scene ontstaat. Maar bovenal is het een film over passie voor muziek in een tijd zonder internet en streaming, een tijd waarin een plaat gaan kopen in je favoriete platenwinkel nog een heuse gebeurtenis was.

title: Roterfluss
overview: Sir Gareth confronts a life of violence and transgression as he travels the Red River into Hell

title: East West Love
overview: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Tito's trip to Mombasa, Kenya turns into a girls' getaway with her best friend. What begins as an escape from heartbreak becomes a journey of healing and new possibilities with a charming local named Juma.

title: Pulsatrix
overview: Haunted by the early loss of her son, Neta struggles to find peace while working as a housekeeper on a remote farm with her husband, Nelson. When the landowners arrive for the weekend, her buried pain is reawakened and ignites a spiral of revenge, leading to an inevitable confrontation between grief, power, and justice.

title: The Return of Magnus Kirt
overview: Magnus Kirt is one throw away from the world title when his shoulder dislocates before the eyes of millions. A years-long struggle forces him to ask: what does a comeback mean when you can never return to the way you were?

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Method to the Madness
overview: After winning a chance to honor her late basketball-star twin sister, an awkward woman hires an unconventional basketball coach to prepare for a high-stakes free throw. As training grows increasingly unpredictable, an unlikely friendship challenges both women to confront grief, self-doubt, and the courage to believe in themselves.

title: The Great Diamond Hunt
overview: Katja dreams of going on her dance team's trip to Gothenburg but can't afford it. When her eccentric grandmother Lydia, a former jewel thief just out of prison, turns up with a plan to find a stolen diamond bracelet hidden at the Bakken amusement park, Katja and her brothers join the hunt, racing a smuggler's henchman to the diamonds before the team leaves.

title: The Name of the Song
overview: When her stubborn grandfather refuses medical treatment, Leyla travels to his rural Anatolian village to bring him back to the city. As his reluctance turns her quick visit into an extended stay, two different generations gradually adapt to each other's pace through shared routines and music.

title: La sera a Roma
overview: Federico, a journalist from Rome, finds himself the prime suspect following the murder of a young actor he had just met; he is forced to defend himself while his private life comes under scrutiny.

title: Ruedas
overview: After a brutal assault, an elderly palatero (ice cream vendor) is followed by a trickster spirit through a surreal Los Angeles where grief, magic, and resilience intertwine.

title: Enter the Television
overview: From Tom Seymour creator of the VHS Massacre Trilogy. Enter the Television is a feature-length documentary exploring the dark corners of television from obscure commercials to unconventional cable programming. It examines the evolution of media through an underground lens, revealing how independent voices survive within systems controlled by powerful media corporations.

title: Sternbrücke Forever
overview: A declaration of love to an edifice and its people, and a tirade against urban politics. Mehmet sells falafel, Martina has a kiosk and Stefan repairs cars. And every weekend, young people fill the clubs under the Sternbrücke – one of more than a hundred old railway bridges in Hamburg. But its time is up: the plan is to take down the bridge and replace it.

title: I Already had a Family
overview: A girl revisits her family and complications arise.

title: The Shadows of Trust
overview: A couple's idyllic life at a secluded country home unravels as disturbing events uncover buried secrets-and a mysterious neighbor threatens to expose everything.

title: The Hunt
overview: Detectives are picked off one by one from a seemingly unstoppable force.

title: Mimic
overview: A little girl with echolalia is left home alone at night with her mother, whom she no longer recognizes.

title: It's Harder Than You Think
overview: An odd connection with a hardware store worker makes an unstable teen reconsider his lethal plans.

title: Brimstone Terrace
overview: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

title: Solution No. 1
overview: A man, unable to hitch a ride back to his broken-down car with a new tire, rolls it back to his car while running.

title: Part of Nature - Die Zukunft von Mensch und Natur
overview: An essayistic film about the very core of humanity: we are beings created to live with and on the Earth. Yet still, despite knowing better, we destroy the very foundations of our existence. The film accompanies protagonists from the fields of philosophy, agriculture and forestry, and architecture. Their work has the potential to initiate necessary processes of transformation. Their stories are placed in a broader context: the individual as part of the whole, connection and belonging.

title: Also Fine
overview: Used to keeping quiet, Wei shuts out his parents' absurd antics behind closed doors. Neglected at home, Hsuan travels north by herself and stumbles into Wei's life. Taipei's starry nights, planes piercing the sky... these overlooked everyday moments in the city turn into a ray of light for them against an ambiguous future.

title: L'Hiver d'Edmond et Lucy
overview: Edmond, the squirrel, and Lucy, the young bear, live together in a majestic chestnut tree in the heart of the forest. When winter comes, they get ready to confront it... Between snowball fights and treasure hunts, they are going to have lots to do.

title: Gripper
overview: When happy go lucky skateboarder Pat snaps his friend's skateboard for a bet, the fallout is a lot more sinister than his immediate feelings of guilt.

title: Red Dirt
overview: When Emma Bennett, a teen girl living in the South, finds out life changing news, she has to find a way to navigate it with the help of her best friend Oliver, all while keeping it a secret from her step brother, Jake.

title: Home Video
overview: A 8 year old boy playing with a camcorder, while recording his house and atmosphere he accidentally records audio of his father talking on the phone, several phone conversations of the father reveal a meticulous planning of a POGROM.  On 28 February 2002, a three-day period of inter-communal (Hindus and Muslims) violence began in the western Indian state of Gujarat. This was the first pogrom where telephones and cellphones were used as a major operational tool and the riots were meticulously per-planned, thousands of people (official number : 1,044 ) mostly Muslims were killed in the three day pogrom. The riots were particularly carried out to target Muslim.

title: Deep Blue
overview: At 11 years old, Nicola has killed a man. It was his father, Lucio, who ordered him to do it. His reward? Abandonment. Twenty years have passed, and since that day Nicola has lived in Mexico with his uncle Nando, who raised him under a lie: Lucio was dead. A harsh upbringing in a ruthless country shaped him and taught him how to survive. Today, he's an adult working at the family restaurant, having buried the past under the weight of distance. But Nando decides to leave for good. On the eve of his escape, he chooses to reveal the truth: Nicola's father is still alive.

title: Wild No More
overview: On the verge of divorce, Yawen works at a quiet suburban bowling alley. A group of women rent out the venue for a wild bachelorette party, ready to savor their freedom. After a flashy show, they prank Yawen by handcuffing her and a go-go boy together before taking off. Sharing the same space, the two seem connected, yet remain unable to truly connect.

title: Rock It!
overview: When being sent to a boarding school for classical music, teenager Julia discovers rock music - and rock musicians. Torn between these two musical worlds, she has to find her own way.

title: The Tower
overview: RELIGION OF MESS.  A kaleidoscopic tapestry of colorful characters collide in a small Iowa town. Runaway children make a movie, aging idealists hatch a dangerous plan, aimless townie girls get into mischief, a mysterious mother digs for buried treasure, and shirtless man ponders the meaning of the town’s towers. Spooky, serendipitous resonances bubble up between stories where people play themselves in fictionalized as well as real life scenarios. In a world in crisis, filmmaking itself becomes a form of coping and celebration.

title: Zoey & Ben
overview: Unsuccessful actor Ben unexpectedly becomes the full-time parent of his nine-year-old daughter, Zoey, whom he has only seen every other weekend, after her mother is hospitalized following an overdose. Shot over a span of ten years, ZOEY & BEN follows their journey through life's triumphs and setbacks, charting Ben's transformation from a self-absorbed dreamer into a compassionate family man, and Zoey's evolution from a traumatized little girl into a confident young woman.

title: Karo Dame, Herz König
overview: Svenja longs to be closer to her father Ralf. Throughout her life, the globetrotter and multiple family founder was more often away than at home. When Ralf is diagnosed with terminal cancer, it suddenly becomes unclear whether they can overcome the distance that has grown between them. A seemingly mundane family tradition helps: playing rummy.

title: Die Sandale meiner Schwester
overview: A day at the public pool turns into complete chaos when two sisters dive for a sandal.

title: Damned
overview: A social-media influencer goes in search of an old, forgotten folk singer Naseem Bano, whose claim to fame was an off-hand compliment from Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan in 1988. He wants her to sing for his Instagram feed but she has forgotten herself. Late at night, when the whole hospital sleeps, she has a flash of memory.

title: Little Wonder
overview: Two friends escape the stresses of modern life by taking a trip to the countryside.

title: 25 Days
overview: Two old friends reunite and start a bond that unravels into something more than just friendship. When one of them has to leave the country for an internship, will their romance last?

title: Dead Wife Cult
overview: The life of cult icon Zoë Lund, through the eyes of her widower and an avid fan.

title: Lure
overview: As the sun starts to set in a secluded wood, an unwelcome guest emerges from the periphery, drawn into a glittering snare. Time slouches, voices murmur from between the trees and corrosion starts ahead of schedule. Be careful out there. You might catch your death.

title: Send the Rain
overview: Erika, a young Okinawan-Canadian woman, returns home to convince her aging grandmother, Oba, to evacuate their family farm. As tensions rise between the two strong-willed women, buried histories and generational trauma come to the surface, revealing a powerful story of resilience, legacy, and the bonds that survive even in the face of destruction.

title: Malick
