overview: The life of Senegalese immigrant Malick changes abruptly when Toni—the man he believes to be the dangerous coyote who brought him to Brazil—crosses his path again. Inspired by the true story of Modou Awa Dieye.

title: Living Among The Stars
overview: Seventy-year-old Irena lives alone and spends every day following gossip about showbiz stars and binge-watching her favorite TV show. Her life changes when a famous TV presenter in a sequin suit shows up at her door.

title: My Time Machine
overview: Adam is a young boy with Asperger's syndrome growing up in the aftermath of World War I. Inspired by H. G. Wells' The Time Machine, he dreams of traveling to the future and isolates himself in an old silo to build a time machine. Years later, he finally completes it, but it explodes upon activation. As Adam leaves the silo, he discovers a mud wall bearing a message carved by his mother. Stepping outside, he is astonished by the sight of cars, airplanes, and skyscrapers. Has he simply reached the future through the passage of time, or has he truly traveled through time and space?

title: Alter Yellow - Inspecteur Moutarde
overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this second episode, the yellow camera filmed a murder, Inspector Noé Morcati, also known as Inspector Moutarde, needs this evidence to solve the investigation

title: The Perpetual Journey to the Homeland
overview: Over 30 years of fieldwork, photographer Randa Shaath built an extensive archive of Palestine: decades of photographs of the people and places she calls home. In her living room, we open the archive together, guided by her rare gift for remembering a story behind each photo.  One more return to Albelad (the homeland), she glides through the photos, and with every return, a story surfaces. She holds onto a narrative in which hope was possible, and a free Palestine never felt far away.

title: NOT a Zombie Movie
overview: Chaos unfolds as Wyatt, a stoic ex-pot dealer, is forced to shelter with Henry, Hollywoods next idol, and Josh, the sketchy pizza delivery guy, in the wake of the zombie apocalypse.

title: Les Enfants Iront Bien
overview: Aaron is at the beginning of his adult life and is struggling with the responsibilities that come with it. He is still searching for his place in the world, while also doing his best to ensure that his little brother James grows up in the best possible circumstances.

title: Can You Keep a Secret?
overview: Unable to keep secrets and losing the people closest to her, Tanya turns to a therapist who offers an unconventional treatment involving a knife and a black candle.

title: My Own Bed Eating Me Alive
overview: Ramaz and Liza often spend time together, tasting soda and listening to electronic music. Ramaz bought some pineapples and dreams of treating Liza to some. Liza gave Ramaz a T-shirt, and he always wears it around the house.

title: Hermetica
overview: When a man goes missing from her district, solitary Irene agrees to meet with an investigator. What begins as a routine inquiry gradually turns into something more unsettling, drawing Irene into a surreal night where the boundaries between the investigation and her own past begin to blur.

title: Amarte
overview: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

title: SILIQ
overview: Set in a near future, SILIQ follows an advanced drone prototype on a classified cargo delivery mission across Taiwan. As it navigates landscapes through machine vision, it witnesses traditional rituals, everyday traditions, and traces of a rapidly changing world. Processing these encounters beyond its original programming, SILIQ begins to question the nature of memory, spirituality, and consciousness. Blending speculative science fiction with Taiwanese mythology, the film explores whether an artificial intelligence can develop its own understanding of humanity, and ultimately make choices beyond the intentions of its creators.

title: Changul: The Grip
overview: Set against the backdrop of the Gen-Z movement and the circumstances leading up to it, the film portrays a young generation refusing to remain silent in the face of growing challenges and despair.

title: GALDR
overview: After joining GALDR, a dating app for magical folk, a young man posing as a Druid matches with a mysterious witch for a seemingly ordinary first date. But as the night unfolds, he's pulled into a world of danger and magical chaos far beyond what he could have ever expected.

title: Day One
overview: While Yu and F are taking their dying friend, Sea, to see Avengers: Doomsday on day one, the trio gets trapped on the 50th floor after a blackout kills the elevator. They must find a way down before the movie starts, as Sea’s time runs out too.

title: A Touch of Love
overview: A haunted-house sleeper arranges a hookup in a haunted house, only to encounter the ghosts of a married couple from the 1980s. Can one night of passion overcome a century of loneliness?

title: Red Ledger
overview: Captain Georgina Lee captures and interrogates Ellis's handler on why she was sent to disarm weapons. But a piece of Lee's history is brought up that she can't escape.

title: I'M OKAY
overview: Beginning with a conversation with a man. Those conversations may have truly happened, or they may exist only within his own mind. In an attempt to hold on to something, he steals objects from his ex-boyfriend—things that seem useless, insignificant, and easily forgotten. As reality and imagination gradually blur together, he finally comes to understand where a relationship ultimately ends.

title: Falling White Leaves
overview: Thomas and Félix, a father and son long estranged, reunite for a picturesque photographic journey through the south of Puerto Rico, embarking on an adventure that leads them to an unexpected new descendant of their family.

title: Blind Date
overview: A nervous couple on a first date finds out they have a lot in common. But how much do they really know about each other?

title: Low Tide
overview: A retirement home by the sea. A storm is brewing. Élodie, 11, visits her grandmother Ismène, who seems lost in the fog of her memories. The young girl fights back against fate with a few notes of music. The fog begins to lift.

title: Gavin Matts: present
overview: A meditation on time and being alive, PRESENT is the follow-up comedy special to Gavin Matts: Progression (2023).

title: Touch of Tim
overview: Last year, Tim Rangström—also known as "Sporttouchen"—gathered a host of famous personalities for an unexpected football match between Sweden and Norway. With over 20,000 spectators in the stands, the match became a massive talking point and put Sporttouchen on the map as a new phenomenon in the world of sports and entertainment. This time, Tim is determined to surpass last year’s success. He is hunting for the perfect squad, planning halftime shows featuring world-class artists, and dreaming of the ultimate signing: getting Zlatan to pull on the Swedish jersey once again. Yet, at the heart of it all is Tim himself, the man who built an entire sports channel from the ground up. How did he get here? And what is he willing to sacrifice to outdo himself?

title: Meri Girlfriend Da Viyaah
overview: Bittu's peaceful life with his girlfriend Nimrat in Mumbai turns chaotic when his parents arrive unexpectedly. Unable to reveal their relationship, he introduces Nimrat as their housemaid. Their lie grows complicated when the male househelp falls for Nimrat and wants to marry her. As they struggle to keep their charade alive, family pressure and misunderstandings create chaos.

title: Ghost Board
overview: A woman sees a mysterious man and seeks answers in a Ouija board.

title: Gardener's Planet!
overview: A TV Gardener who discovers that the people whose garden he is working on aren't actually people at all but evil aliens from another planet and he has to defeat them before it's too late.

title: Separation
overview: 2022. The war has begun, and so has mobilisation. Lyosha searches frantically for his passport, terrified of being called up. His father stays behind in Russia and says nothing. Three minutes of film, simple yet powerful, about the mortal fear of being sent to fight in a war you don't want.

title: Angel's Torah
overview: This is the 100-year story of Angel Wagenstein. A direct witness to at least three historical revolutions, a participant in the underground resistance during the Second World War, a prisoner in a concentration camp, a fighter against fascism, a man sentenced to death, the creator of fifty-two screenplays, a film and theater director, the author of four novels and countless pages of non-fiction, and the recipient of hundreds of awards from all corners of the globe. A Bulgarian citizen and a German pensioner—a rebel with a sparkling sense of humor and an independent spirit—who managed to remain true to himself throughout every era he lived through.

title: Man at the Bottom of the Bag
overview: After dismissing a stranger's cryptic warning, a woman unleashes a terrifying force from within her Cheetos® The Flavor of Fear™ bag she has no hope of containing.

title: 144 – Apocalypse Not
overview: After a satirical tweet targeting Bolsonaro and the Universal Church, J.P. Cuenca became the target of 144 lawsuits and thousands of death threats from the evangelical far right. Seeking dialogue, he embarks on an 11,000-kilometer journey through packed churches, rodeos, German festivals, shooting clubs, home worship services, and gospel trucks across every region of Brazil. Amid ecological devastation, religious fervor, and an impending apocalypse, a Brazil in trance reaches an apotheosis of color, music, and faith.

title: The Nose - A Fading Case
overview: One morning, Bernhard wakes up without his nose. When his wife Sabine notices that other objects around the house have gone missing too, she starts her own investigation, trying to make sense of the strange events. Bernhard, meanwhile, turns his gaze outward, following an uncertain trail into the night sky that only he seems to see. In a web of red thread, blinking lights, and flickering stars, the two search, each in their own way, for an answer to the inexplicable  disappearance of their world.

title: The Renaissance of Oddity Todd
overview: In a world ruled by the authoritarian World Collective, the secretive Sonus master the power of vibration. When a deeper evil emerges, only a Sonus with a cryptic past can save humanity from a dark reckoning.

title: When Wine Meets Coffee
overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

title: Creature Fear
overview: In a small Wisconsin lake town, a poverty-stricken felon contracts a novel prions disease after ingesting tainted venison. As his descent into madness intensifies, he targets a Chicago musician and a mysterious singer, whose dream of recording an album together is threatened by the felon's violent unraveling.

title: She Looked Without Seeing
overview: Forget everything, or recover memory and remember. Let yourself fall and stop, or return to life and start again. Adrift, lost face-to-face, two women confront their fates. Is there not just one thing worth saving? Without hesitation, the desire to live, that rebellious fury that takes no heed of risks. And how do you save a world where poetry has disappeared?

title: Larnaca
overview: After embarking on a sailing trip on the way to their wedding in Larnaca, Ruth and Yona find themselves stranded at sea with no wind in their sails. As they wait for conditions to change, Ruth's past resurfaces.

title: Ангельский чин
overview: Open the door to a world nearly 500 years old! This documentary takes viewers to the Novodevichy Convent—one of Russia's most famous and enigmatic monasteries, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Behind its majestic walls lies not only the country's great history but also the living, poignant stories of women who dedicated themselves to its service.

title: Film Body: Eye Injury
overview: Film Body: Eye Injury disassembles and manipulates the photochemical surface of a 16mm film entitled Safety Gear: Eye and Face Protection dedicated to preventing eye injuries in work situations. Warning about the physical risks that can occur at work under specific circumstances is the theme of an industrial film, an ephemeral film exempt from copyright that, at times, seems like a sample of glasses. The new montage transforms the original ten minutes into a shorter footage close to the aesthetics of flicker film. It emphasizes the harmful nature of a film body that, underlining the fragility of vision, can cause migraines.

title: My First Love
overview: Young singer Paulinho goes viral online with an old song written for his first love, Nina. Upon seeing the video's success, Nina reappears with a proposal: Paulinho must perform "pagode" shows to save her father's failing bridal shop. In exchange, she promises to help him find a new girlfriend. He accepts the deal to hide the fact that he still has feelings for her, but their forced proximity reignites their old romance.

title: Nine Times Fired
overview: The film portrays the journey of Jeong Gyu-ji, who has faced nine layoffs from different jobs, and her growth throughout the experience.

title: Watch You Rise
overview: Follows Isabella Grace Cohn as she works to understand and expose the roots of sexual harm — her peers’, her mother’s, and eventually her own. Along the way, she meets diverse survivors, perpetrators, and experts. Together they explore the cultural, educational and legal gray areas that fuel the cycle of harm in a quest for hope and transformation.

title: Acid Rain: Stories from Crepúsculo de Cubatão
overview: A documentary that brings together personal memories and rare footage of the nightclub that operated in Copacabana from 1984 to 1989. Featuring interviews with DJs, staff, and patrons of Crepúsculo de Cubatão, the film explores the influence of British culture on the music and behavior of young people who were then labeled “darks.” More than simply telling the story of a venue, the documentary reveals the origins and behind-the-scenes dynamics of the vibrant cultural scene in Rio de Janeiro that emerged during Brazil’s political opening.

title: A Light in the Darkness
overview: Venturing into intricate cave systems, the deep oceans, and subterranean aquifers where light barely reaches, we meet the scientists who have dedicated their lives to creatures who have evolved in perpetual darkness, working tirelessly—often in obscurity—to understand and protect ecosystems and animals most people will never know exist. Paralleling the deeply personal journey of the film's director as he confronts a terminal illness, the story becomes a reflection on what it means to face one's own darkness.

title: Profs
overview: A retiring professor battles his ego, confronts his career, and engages with a rebellious former student – soon to be his successor.

title: The Wild Soul
overview: An odyssey towards the self, an invitation to rediscover sensitivity. It is a journey through time, countries, and elements – water, earth, mountains, form – an expedition that intimately explores, without judgment or taboo, the relationship humans maintain with other species, as well as the awareness we have of ourselves and of our planet.

title: Say It
overview: When a headstrong student gets trapped in a school bathroom with his racist bully, he must force a confession before they're found, or his final chance at justice will be lost.

title: Every Time I See A Cock I Go Funny
overview: When a Yorkshire coal miner's trousers get stolen, a scandal erupts that sinks the colliery into turmoil, exposing the hypocritical, horny heart of postwar British pride and masculinity.

title: Heritage
overview: Fifteen years after leaving Corsica, Marie and Daniel return to visit their elderly grandfather. Looking to capture their reunion, they pick up the family camcorder, but what they uncover is far from what they expected.

title: Interlude
overview: Following a failed suicide attempt, Clara is in a coma and discovers that the afterlife is a giant Scrabble tournament. It all makes no sense, and yet, she must win the competition to overcome her demons.

title: The Last Treatment
overview: The Last Treatment follows a renowned doctor trapped in a deadly night of crime, fear and impossible choices. As danger closes in, he is forced to fight for survival while facing revenge, sacrifice and painful decisions. Packed with action, suspense and emotional moments, the story explores a father's unstoppable love and the lengths he will go to protect those he cares for.

title: Midnight Dreamers
overview: In a post-dystopian world, two brothers are chased by a relentless hunter after the oldest abandons his labor camp post to seek a refugee haven in order to save his younger brother’s future.

title: Joy Will Prevail
overview: Architect Louis Kahn reluctantly takes on a country home for a tenacious businessman, sparking an unlikely friendship and a project that challenges both men to reconsider how they want to live.

title: I Got Ghosted
overview: Wayne searches the Ammerman Campus for the ghosts of Untitled's former hosts.

title: The Catcher
overview: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds. One day he defies his orders and makes one dangerous choice.

title: NieR:Orchestra Concert 12026 [YoRHa]
overview: A new multimedia NieR orchestral production featuring full orchestra, chorus, vocalists Emi Evans and J’Nique Nicole, giant-screen visuals and a narrated story connected to the Pearl Harbor Descent Operation.

title: Perla
overview: In the 1980s, a single mother who fled communist Czechoslovakia has to return to her homeland in order to pay an old debt. The risky trip is upset by unexpected events that bring secrets into the open.

title: …And I Saw Your Name on the Dust of the Houses.
overview: At seventy-two, my grandmother Rosi wanders among the properties she built in the past as she searches for her place in the world while dealing with the pain of loss and abandonment.

title: A Cha-Cha for the Fugitive
overview: A bisexual artist is waiting to move to New York City to be with his male lover while living with his girlfriend in a sumptuous loft in Taipei. In order to save enough money to implement the trip to New York, he joins the dancing group that formed part of the fat stripteaser's show. Later on, he takes his girlfriend to Yenshui for the firecracker festival and happens to witness a weird murder with video recorder in hand. He then becomes the target of the mysterious killer...

title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos
overview: Stela is twelve years old and only believes in what she can see, or not at all. Miguel, the youngest brother, believes in everything, especially in what doesn't exist. Two years after the tragic dive that killed their mother, they return to the mythical city of Paraty, where nothing is what it seems.

title: Feel The Burn
overview: Feel the Burn follows rival spies LaShay and Vivian, two elite operatives who are forced to reunite for a mission that tests their skill, loyalty, and hearts. Their target is Rudy, a charismatic operative with a shadowed past, with whom each has shared secretive missions under different identities across the globe.

title: Zogsool
overview: The vast Mongolian grassland stretches across the screen, with blue skies and beautiful clouds filling half the frame. Underneath, an oil tanker truck drives for some time along a scenic road, before coming to a stop in front of a small town. When the town is suddenly sealed off due to the COVID pandemic, Sumber, the oil tanker driver, is quarantined at the gas station. Khanda, a single mother who manages the station while being exploited for sex and labor by a corrupt government official and the greedy owner, is now also tasked with looking after Sumber.

title: Fortune Tellers Inc.
overview: Mai, now ready to enter adulthood, ventures out to the magical Fortune Tellers Inc. where mystical creatures reveal her future. However, after every reading, the object of the prediction materialises to Mai’s astonishment.

title: Barangay Love Stories: Like The Rain
overview: Who would have thought that a mistake between a TNVS driver and their passenger would lead to long-awaited love? But what if snobbish parents wouldn't approve of  their romance?

title: Tunnel Vision
overview: Tunnel Vision follows the hardcore graffiti bomber "Rolex", dedicated to a lost and rare discipline in the Stockholm graffiti scene – Painting hard-to-access innercity subway stations, knowing that as soon as he sets his foot next to the station platform, police and transit security will be on their way.

title: Barangay Love Stories: Paradise
overview: This showcases hope and love amid the challenges that Ling-Ling (Kira Balinger) faces after she gets hit by a vehicle and loses her ability to walk. Amid the loss of hope, she meets Lui (Josh Ford), a physical therapist who helps her learn to walk again and believe in herself. As Lui helps Ling-Ling with her recovery, they gradually fall for each other. Will they face their feelings for one another?

title: Mamu Nikantetau
overview: The Mamu Nikantetau expedition, meaning "Let's Move Forward Together" in Innu-aimun, is an annual walk aimed at promoting reconciliation and living together.

title: Hard Stuff
overview: The band "Noble Rot" is preparing for a concert at the Secret Place.

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

title: Thank You for Banking with Us
overview: After finding out that their father left a huge sum of money behind after his death, Mariam and Noura come up with an elaborate scheme to abscond with the money before their brother — who is legally entitled to half the inheritance — finds out about their father’s death.

title: Materia Prima
overview: Bolivia has the world's largest deposits of lithium, a metal that is essential for the energy transition. Without lithium, no electricity storage facility, no data centre, no electric car, no smartphone would work. The Europeans want the raw material to save their automotive industry. The Bolivians want it to combat poverty. While the Bolivian government negotiates with corporations from around the world, civil society groups are mobilising in rural areas, organised mainly by women. The film offers a rare insight into the Europeans' strategy to secure the sought-after material and carves out the conflicting interests towards extractivism and industrialisation in Bolivia.

title: The Pen That Will Not Bow
overview: The early life of Voltaire, before he became one of Europe's most influential writers and philosophers.

title: Plan B
overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

title: Wash Away
overview: A couple's relaxing trip to a remote lakeside resort turns into a nightmare when they unknowingly become entangled in the resort’s bizarre belief that its water can purify human souls.

title: Pat & Mat: Back to the Countryside
overview: Pat and Mat return to the countryside—coinciding with the 50th anniversary of their very first television adventure.  At their country retreat, the pair once again dive headlong into a whirlwind of DIY escapades, where there is no shortage of slapstick situations. For every problem, they have a "brilliant" technical solution at the ready.

title: Mister pot Pie
overview: In the wake of a bizarre tragedy, a disillusioned corporate wannabe spirals into a delusional obsession that threatens to destroy his marriage and sanity.

title: About an Intimate Matter
overview: Swarna is a dedicated high school science teacher who relocates to a conservative suburban town with her same-sex partner, Driti. They attempt to build a quiet life together, blending into the community while keeping their relationship private. However, their world is completely upended when one of Swarna's high school students discovers personal, intimate photos of her on social media. The discovery quickly leaks, placing Swarna under intense public and institutional scrutiny.

title: Homecoming Shenanigans
overview: Ivan returns home after six years abroad in Barcelona, hoping for a joyful reunion with his vibrant family. However, what begins as a celebratory welcome quickly spirals into chaos as deep-seated secrets surface.

title: Dead Bee Sting
overview: The story follows a tragic sequence of events that begins when Yusuf, a successful lawyer, loses his infant child due to a mistake. In the aftermath, Yusuf experiences an internal collapse, burdened by profound remorse and guilt, while his wife, Ayşe, falls into a deep depression—pushing their marriage to the brink of a major crisis. The film explores the weight of conscience by drawing a metaphorical parallel between the tragic fate of the deceased infant and a "dead bee," which serves as a symbol for lost innocence and inner suffering. Centered on themes of tragedy, loss, and guilt, the narrative unfolds as a journey of internal transformation; the characters must confront their own inner worlds, seek to forgive one another, and attempt to rebuild their lives in the wake of their pain, ultimately searching for the possibility of absolution.

title: Semiarid Paradise
overview: In 2007, while filming the documentary O Tempo e o Lugar, Genivaldo Vieira da Silva, known as Geno, a former activist with the Pastoral Land Commission, the Landless Workers’ Movement (MST), and the Workers’ Party (PT), said he intended to move within three years from Inhapi, Alagoas, where he had always lived, to his property in Santa Brígida, Bahia, which he described as his “paradise.”  Seventeen years later, Genivaldo had still not made the move to his promised land. The documentary seeks to understand why, while also exploring Geno’s spiritual side and the reasons behind his new political choices.

title: The Kids Are Gone
overview: Summer, 2005. On the outskirts of Montevideo, a kid goes missing without a trace. When the alleged authorities fail to act, his friends blindly follow the trails of a dark local legend in hopes of finding him.

title: Good Time Girl!
overview: A young woman still healing from a painful past, pushes herself to go on a first date in hopes of reclaiming a sense of normalcy. What begins as a playful, promising night out soon tests the fragile line between moving forward and confronting what she hasn’t fully left behind.

title: Damat Mektebi
overview: In a Turkish village ruled by the strict Ferman Agha, Miran opens a “Groom School” to teach local men how to respect women and win the trust of their families. His unconventional methods spark a series of comedic events that transform village life.

title: Monster
overview: Consumed by grief, a disfigured anti-hero embarks on a series of desperate attempts to relive his past – but it’s not the same.

title: What We Call Happiness
overview: The small, seemingly disconnected joys of three men and women gradually intersect in the wake of a major incident that threatens the world.

title: Château d'If
overview: Day after day, a mysterious spectator obsessively plays the same VHS tape, in which DANTE and MERCEDES rest exhaustedly under a tree after a long journey, where they seal their vow of love. As the tape progressively deteriorates, Dante realizes that Mercedes begins to repeat her lines inconsistently until she freezes. Upon becoming aware that his reality is a world of fiction, Dante gradually descends into madness, threatening to take control of the viewer's real world.

title: Until the End
overview: As the world falls apart, a woman's ex-husband asks her for one last, huge favor: to end his life before he changes.

title: One Scan Away
overview: Stranded walletless in Japan during his sister’s medical emergency, an Indonesian student finds his ultimate lifeline in a single QR code.

title: Aphasic correspondences
overview: An audiovisual essay constructed from Super 8 footage filmed during camera tests for the short film ‘La Trampa’. Through gestures, light, and silences, it reflects on what the image reveals and what it leaves unsaid.

title: Sweet Vampire
overview: Santiago goes out for the first time after a messy breakup and meets Marcelo, who awakens long-hidden desires, but their encounter spirals out of control following an attack by a mysterious creature.

title: The Smosh Halloween Special
overview: Jill, Danny, and Shannon throws a halloween party.

title: Moment by Moment
overview: Moment by Moment is a song cycle by Alexander Sage Oyen.  Oyen’s song cycle began as a concert at 54 Below in 2013, starring and made possible by close friends and collaborators, who encouraged the composer to create musicals.  In the film, we follow ten strangers in one city and delve into their dream and nightmare sequences, capturing the essence of real-life experiences .

title: Are We Monsters?
overview: A gay radical outsider, a flamboyant Muslim, and a nasty single mom live in a devout Muslim area on the Thai border under decades of martial law.

title: Bird in Hand
overview: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

title: Partnership
overview: In a near-future social media economy, a lonely streamer lands a job as the on-screen boyfriend of a famous influencer. As he navigates rehearsed romance and professional intimacy, the line between genuine connection and performance begins to blur.

title: Somewhere Over The Rainbow
overview: Two completely “normal” friends explore Bangkok in their own peculiar way, navigating its chaotic streets, questionable transportation, and very confusing customs. Along the way, one of them discovers that she’s… hungry. And that she really, really loves food. What begins as a simple mission to find grilled chicken and sato soon turns into an unexpected journey of food, friendship, and questionable life choices.

title: Hard as Puck
overview: A motley crew of para ice hockey skaters fight to keep their grassroots sporting club on the rink in this stirring, often hilarious documentary.

title: Intoxication
overview: During a remote houseboat bachelor party on Shasta Lake, a groom and his best man tangle with a shadowy New Age cult, only to inadvertently summon an ancient entity into their beer keg, turning their getaway into a floating nightmare.

title: Led by the Ashes
overview: Two sisters, Bethânia and Laura, reunite to discuss a family matter. They travel the roads of the Pernambuco hinterland in search of their father's body, Seu Lauro. At home, Bethânia's daughter edits a video in which the living and the dead become intertwined in a game of silences and revelations. Ao Sabor das Cinzas (Led by the Ashes) is a magical realism piece about the collapse of communication and grief conveyed in real time.

title: Anima of dawn
overview: Deep within the Albariscope, an underground labyrinth ruled by darkness and machines, two unlikely companions must learn to trust one another as they face danger and search for a path toward the light.

title: I'm Nothing Special Really
overview: Feri breaks up with her long-term boyfriend when she sees him getting intimate with his ex. Meanwhile, Navid likes Feri's sister Mariam and tries to get close to her, but an unexpected encounter changes the course of their relationship. Still feeling the pain of heartbreak, Feri sets off with Mariam in search of peace of mind.

title: The Book of Mary
overview: Marie, eleven years old, is experiencing difficult times. Her parents will separate. The perception of her universe is profoundly disturbed. This exacting portrait of a child immersed in her books, music and dancing casts a dispassionate yet touching eye on the girl's reaction to the new upheaval in her life.

title: The Passenger Andrzej Munk
overview: The documentary dedicated to Andrzej Munk, a leading creator of the Polish Film School, was created based on unique archival materials. They made up a story about a man immersed in history, his artistic evolution and the emotions accompanying this process.

title: In the Shadows
overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

title: Kafka of Kreuzberg
overview: Lisa witnesses a mysterious man leave an envelope on a bridge, soon picked up by a woman. The next day the story repeats, but the woman doesn't show. Instead Lisa takes the envelope and embarks on a Kafkaesque quest between time and space.

title: Hex
overview: Three young Norwegian women form a coven and start the black metal band Witch Club Satan. Before they know it, they are playing at major international festivals, but the battle has only just begun.

title: Albe su la mont
overview: In an isolated mountain shack the paths of three unnamed men collide. As the tension brews, a fickle, capricious and thoroughly alive Mountain asserts itself as the ultimate force over their fates.

title: The Quest for Emerald Mountain
overview: Set against the arid mountains and wide skies of West Texas, two best friends chase the perfect photo for a model train and in doing so, create an unexpected portrait of intimacy, creativity, and tenderness in male friendship.

title: Peru is a place to die
overview: Using footage filmed in Peru in 1950 by a foreigner, Víctor writes a letter to his son to question the country he will inherit: among heartbeats and ruins, he searches for a hope that still endures amid disillusionment.

title: Street Angel
overview: A hustler finds hope through his relationship with a faithful woman, until his violent past catches up with them. Set between barbershop, church, and streets, their story explores redemption's price.

title: Lo único que te Pido
overview: With only two months left to live, Sofía makes one final, unexpected request: to spend an intimate night with her former lover. Determined to fulfill her wish, her devoted husband Ángel sets out to find the man, who has been missing since 2002. What follows is an outrageous journey filled with deception, unexpected complications, and increasingly absurd situations that challenge the boundaries of love, loyalty, and marriage.

title: Because I Have To
overview: Miloš Šejn: lying down, awake. And above all, creating. This documentary essay follows an artist whose work is “born of wonder” and who effortlessly navigates his longed-for path out of the city. Instead of an endless stream of sensory input, the film offers a space for concentration and mindfulness—a space that may well extend beyond the seventy minutes spent in the cinema

title: The Divine Feminine Live
overview: A re-release of the live performance of The Divine Feminine by Mac Miller from 2016, as re-imagined by Sam Balaban in honor of its 10th anniversary.

title: Atile'i
overview: At the extremity of rain and fog there was a gate in the sea, beyond which lay the True Isle... the island of which Wayo Wayo was but a shadow. —The Man with the Compound Eyes by Wu Ming-yi

title: Adam’s Fire
overview: In the misty mountains of West Virginia, a grieving young boy who has lost all hope finds an unexpected friendship, a chance to heal, and the breathtaking power of forgiveness.

title: The Good Sister
overview: Springtime in Berlin occasions new beginnings, but has its darknesses too. When Sam is accused of rape, his sister Rose is asked to testify in the police investigation against him. Faced with uncomfortable questions and moral quandaries, Rose’s feelings toward her older brother are tested.

title: Los peligros de fumar en la plaza
I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
overview: Eiko, a Japanese American teenage vampire, suffering from agoraphobia caused by the trauma from the night her family was murdered and she was turned, is unable and unwilling to leave her family’s home. And she not only loses track of time, but time itself. Eiko spends most of her years avoiding others and trying not to live life as a vampire, but the world won’t leave her alone.

title: Élégie pour les Lilas
overview: The fate of the storied Parisian maternity clinic Les Lilas already seems sealed: it is not pro table enough. An unsentimental elegy about the staff, the patients and their fight.

title: The Whores Feast
overview: Filmed during a shared harvest dinner with organizers and collaborators, The Whores Feast brings together Ceyenne Doroshow of G.L.I.T.S., Victoria Von Blaque of Trans Equity Consulting, Lisa 张小华 of Red Canary Song, and Amalia Valentine of Decrim NY. Their conversation lingers over nourishment, labor, chosen family, honoring the collective practices of care that sustain communities through ongoing precarity.

title: Middle of Nowhere
overview: Kakuma means "middle of nowhere." It's also where Mo Jabari is from, a refugee camp in Kenya where seasons were sandstorms and survival was not a metaphor. He arrived in Canada with nothing recognizable except men fighting on a television screen. Middle of Nowhere follows Mo Jabari through the unglamorous world of Canadian independent wrestling, no guarantees, no safety net, and no one coming to help if you get hurt today. In a business built on fabricated spectacle, Mo's answer is simple: "I don't have to be a gimmick. I just gotta be me."

title: Aldir Blanc - Response to Time
overview: Dorival Caymmi’s definition of Aldir Blanc is unequivocal: “Aldir Blanc is a jeweler of words.” Treating everyday language as gold, Aldir created a universe of his own, capturing like no one else the everyday life of Rio de Janeiro and Brazil through songs, poems, and chronicles.  More than a film about the artist’s life or body of work, this is an immersion into his universe—his inspirations, his personal geography, and his singular way of telling stories. An adventure through the musical and literary labyrinths of one of the most intriguing minds in contemporary Brazilian culture.

title: Olor a hierba mojada después de la lluvia
Secret [Mis]communication System
overview: The film is based on the drawings and graphic illustrations taken from the patent “Secret Communication System”, registered as US2292387. When work on radio-controlled torpedoes began in the early 1940s, it became clear that an enemy would have little trouble intercepting the frequency of a control signal. In 1942, to fix that problem, the film actress Hedy Lamarr and the composer George Antheil proposed changing the carrier frequency of transmitter and receiver by means of a perforated paper tape, of the kind used in a player piano. Lamarr and Antheil’s invention folded musical logic into the mechanics of war, fulfilling the modernist utopia’s hope that art and technological progress might pass into one another.

title: Smirnov
overview: Wordless portrait of the outstanding filmmaker Andrei Smirnov.

title: Where's Your Sunset Spot?
overview: David, a gay high school senior, embarks on an end-of-summer road trip with his best friend Annie. Along the way, he begins to question what he thought he understood about his identity.

title: Elements of Endearment
overview: Following Ophélie through New York, the film unfolds in five chapters—Metal, Earth, Fire, Wood, and Water—each giving rise to a different tale of dating, desire, and intimate misadventure in the city.

title: The Dyer Tapes
overview: When three 15 year old classmates venture into a forgotten forest to film a school project on a 17th century witch, a trail of crude, wooden ritualistic items lures them into the clutches of a demonic force that turns their documentary into a bloody fight for survival.

title: HUELLAS. Echoes of State Terrorism in Mar del Plata 50 Years On
overview: Can the sea wash everything away? Huellas reconstructs the circuit of state terrorism in Mar del Plata, 50 years after the civic-military coup. Through the testimonies of survivors, family members and specialists, the documentary probes the indelible marks left by repression and the resilience of a community that demands memory. Because history never ends, it is written.

title: Pra que serve uma caneta sem tinta?
Come Over
overview: A triptych of intimate encounters where the same invitation, ‘come over’, sparks three entirely different expectations. Each scenario reveals the consequences of miscommunication, all shot in single, unbroken takes.

title: Demolition of a Wall
overview: “The scene depicts the collapse of a section of wall in a factory.” Three workers demolish a wall in the presence of Auguste Lumière.

title: Elena Quinteros
overview: The story of Elena Quinteros, a teacher and political activist who was detained in 1976 during the Uruguayan dictatorship.

title: Slava
overview: Karlsruhe, Germany, 1962. KGB agent Bogdan Stashynskii is trialed for the assasination of Ukrainian revolutionary and head of the now disbanded Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists, Stepan Bandera. However, Slava Stetsko and her spouse Yaroslav decide to take action and turn the trial into not just a memorial for Bandera, but a  thorough critique of the USSR's web of political assasinations  and the political indifference to the situation in the West.

title: What we left Unwatered.
overview: The members of a Mexican family—María Elena, Doña Aurelia, Doña Elena, and Luisa—are mourning their grandmother and mother, Tita, the matriarch of the household, who, before passing away, passed down to them her recipe for mushroom cream soup, which they used to share regularly as a family dinner. However, over the years, tensions arose among the family members, eventually severing their bonds. Their challenge now is to cook the mushroom cream soup just as Tita used to, while the ingredients and the kitchen come to life and serve as symbols of the family’s disintegration. María Elena struggles to keep her family united and the memory of her Tita alive.

title: Maybe We Should
overview: Determined to bring hope to their rural Pennsylvania community, a couple embark on an ambitious mission to establish a revolutionary therapy center for children with special needs.

title: The Apartment Complex Syndrome
overview: A flyer boy offers to help a female co-worker. When inside an apartment complex, he reluctantly does the same for a middle-aged woman. Soon, he'll have to fight for much more than a day's labor.

title: End of the Wall
overview: The desert between Sásabe and Nogales. It was there, in 2020, that a wall stretching along the border was erected. Thirty kilometres further on, the wall of rusted steel bars comes to an end, and the border between the US and Mexico is marked only by hills and ravines. Due to extreme droughts and heat, this stretch is one of the most dangerous overland migration routes in the world. On the American side of the border, a group of volunteers is providing aid to thousands of migrants, supplying them with water, food, and medical assistance. Each of them has different motivations, but they are united by one thing: a refusal to stand idly by and look the other way.

title: The Angels
overview: A desperate film student stranded in Los Angeles without a summer internship lands an interview with the mysterious producer Vip Armé. All the while, she's haunted by visions of the legendary silent-era director Lois Weber, America's first great female filmmaker.

title: My Dinner With Victor
overview: Two childhood friends meet after a long absence, but a cultural mix-up leads to hilarious – and deadly – consequences.

title: Shortparis. Любовь моя будет тут
overview: A film about how the concept of humanism is refracted through the band’s work. Faces and voices fill the frame, the surrounding space, the auditorium, and everyone watching the screen with meaning. Simple conversations about dreams, fears, favorite foods, or childhood memories are no longer idle chatter, but a way to bridge the distance—an attempt, time and again, to truly see the person before you, even when the instinct to look away is at its strongest.

title: Mountain, Hole
overview: The father-son relationship in a post-apocalyptic world

title: Escape Room 2
overview: Beneath Montjuïc, four people are trapped in an old tunnel, and a countdown of sixty minutes begins. Each second that passes tests what they will risk to get out, and whom they will trust along the way.

title: Kill Okiharu's Tears
overview: A woman with one year left to live meets a high school student who has lost all emotions other than joy.

title: Giants Do Fall
overview: It’s a classic David vs. Goliath scenario: in the oil and gas strongholds of Louisiana's River Parishes and Appalachia's Rust Belt, where false economic promises and industrial pollution have become the norm, fed-up residents square off against their politicians and big business, proving to be a formidable foe. Thrust into the role of accidental activists, the group exposes how racism, classism, and corruption fuel the systems around them, and channel their collective power to show that ordinary people can fight back – and that giants do fall.

title: My Tiny Little School
overview: With Ma toute petite école, Pascal Plisson follows, over the course of a year, the school life of the eight children living in the tiny hamlet of La Gurraz, in the Haute Tarentaise region. At the heart of this village of just 36 inhabitants, their school, threatened with closure, represents far more than a place of learning: it is the soul of an isolated community, where every birth and every pupil helps keep the village alive.

title: Awkwardness
overview: In just a few seconds, it can be an awkwardness between two people who avoid facing each other.

title: DESVELADO
overview: An unnamed young man spends his sleepless nights in the bathtub. He smokes, lies motionless in the water, and tries to escape his thoughts. Time and again, they revolve around Ben, his lover. Ben enjoys his freedom and refuses any emotional intimacy. Their relationship is characterized by the fear of attachment and loss. In dreamlike sequences, the protagonist envisions a different life, yet he cannot escape his fears.

title: Empowered
overview: Empowered follows seven remarkable Ukrainians — human-rights defender Oleksandra Matviichuk, singer Jamala, violinist Bohdana Pivnenko, kobzar Taras Kompanichenko, painter Anatolii Kryvolap, the band DakhaBrakha and cinematographer Serhii Mykhalchuk.  Through their work and everyday lives, the film shows a country that keeps making art, defending human rights and building its future even in the middle of a full-scale war. Its subject is not what Ukraine endures, but what Ukrainians go on creating and protecting.

title: Alone on the Torre
overview: Elite alpinist Colin Haley lays everything on the line in a legendary winter solo push on Cerro Torre – one of Patagonia’s most iconic and unforgiving peaks

title: Ahasa Tharam
overview: Ahas, a young entrepreneur and street musician carrying the weight of a tragic past, finds love with Tharuka, an ambitious waitress determined to chase her Bollywood dream. As their futures pull them in different directions, they must discover whether love is strong enough to survive the pursuit of their dreams.

title: Family Go to the Bad House
overview: Mother, Father and Child have just moved into their new home and are about to discover that the house is bad. A supercut of hundreds of horror films.

title: 29 Seconds to Midnight
overview: Two sets of brothers from South Philadelphia rob a bank on Halloween to pay for a dying brother’s cancer treatment, only to become trapped in a hellish loop when the clock strikes midnight.

title: Amber
overview: A young man is home alone for the night and gets some unexpected visitors.

title: Mundos para lelos
overview: A couple, after being rejected for a threesome, use a time machine to change the answer.

title: Nightmares
overview: The true story that became the basis one of the greatest horror movies of all time, following a journalist attempting to uncover the truth behind several unexplained deaths

title: Katumbiri Nutug Leuwi
overview: Believing that rainbows that reaches the river can bring magic, a group of children bands together to clean a river, hoping that angels may appear.

title: Broth
overview: After an on-air meltdown derails her career, former news anchor Rona Lawson is sent to report from a disappearing coastline. There, an unexpected friendship helps her discover that the future is not yet written.

title: In The Weeds
overview: An obsessive husband discovers an unkillable weed that begins to threaten his suburban and so-called "perfect life."

title: Auto-Anxiety
overview: Thoughts cannot be suddenly stopped, just like we cannot simply stop on the highway. The asphalt turns into a hypnotic stream, and the real world blends with absurd visions of a catastrophe. An experimental film about fear, an accelerated mind, and the impossibility of stopping the inevitable crash.

title: Once Again: The Start of it All
overview: In the year 2509, Dr. Obi Iheuche, a brilliant scientist and devoted father, is racing against time to save his terminally ill daughter. As Obi secretly develops a device capable of altering time itself, his work draws the attention of the institution for which he works. This film is an Afro-futurist meditation on fatherhood, memory, and the cost of love under unforgiving systems.

title: Don't Worry, Be Lonely
overview: With the help of a dating coach, Edward, who has never had a girlfriend, finally lands a date with Yue. It goes surprisingly well—until he discovers she is a vampire who preys on lonely men! Trapped, Edward must escape her deadly clutches to survive…

title: Ghostwatch: The Night That Terrified Britain
overview: Taking a look back at the 1992 BBC spoof supernatural documentary, when 11 million viewers were taken in by a fake investigation, presented by Michael Parkinson and Sarah Greene, into paranormal activity at a family home in Northolt, North-West London

title: La Mujer que soñaba bajo el agua
overview: Following the sudden death of their third newborn child, the Rangel family takes refuge in their lakeside home. Desperate to escape reality, Olga suffers a psychotic episode and begins to suspect that her husband and children have been replaced by imposters. Convinced that her real family has been abducted, she will stop at nothing to get them back.

title: Til I Rot
overview: The Dreamer wakes to find himself imprisoned in a cage by a sinister yet familiar entity. The only way out is to confront the demons that lurk in the recesses of his mind. Death may be better than being left to rot.

title: Seres
overview: When a strange object crosses the sky and triggers a global alert, two young couples find themselves trapped in a series of increasingly disturbing events. What begins as a getaway out of town transforms into a struggle for survival as they discover they are being hunted by unknown forces.

title: Traqueteo
overview: I look around and observe the landscape. I let myself go because that's all I have left: to listen, to look, to sleep, perhaps to dream. The rattle of the bus moves me.

title: Don't Play With Dead Things
overview: During their annual company retreat, the Shoplifters' team synergy is put to the test by psycho killers, demonic entitites and a pervading fear that they may never reach Brazil.

title: I Hope You Fall in Love
Sienna Spiro: Austin City Limits
overview: Breakout British singer-songwriter Sienna Spiro, one of music's most compelling new artists, brings her showstopping vocals and emotionally rich songwriting to a spellbinding ACL debut. She performs highlights from her debut album.

title: "Knock, Knock"
overview: Two people dressed as vampires. One clearly is. The other… isn’t so obvious. Who is the vampire? Open the door and find out!

title: An Old Hag Spins Wheel on the Moon
overview: On a planet close to extermination, a lone boy develops a bond with an unexpected friend.

title: The Fever
overview: Returning home after years abroad, a man finds that the locals are now consumed by a desire to leave. As a feverish contagion of unnamed dread spreads among them, young people mysteriously vanish.

title: Etude
overview: Etude follows a filmmaker attempting to reconnect with his estranged family. After years of his father's absence while his mother struggled to hold the household together on her own, his father returns terminally ill. With little time left, father and son must finally confront years of unspoken words and silence.

title: Pinball Beyond the Bumpers
overview: Pinball is a phenomenon loved all over the world.  Follow the “silver ball” from the 1600’s to the resurgence today with never-before-seen footage of rare games, rock stars, celebrities, past and present gaming legends, and more!

title: Redoubt
overview: Affected by the powerful images in the pamphlet Om kriget kommer (If war comes), farmhand Karl-Göran Persson begins fortifying his house. Through years of harvesting scrap-metal, he transforms the house into a fortress, meant to protect him and his neighbors when the enemy attacks. As the task progresses, reality and the threat of future destruction become intertwined, and construction becomes an obsession for the lonely Karl-Göran.

title: Fissures
overview: After her daughter moves away, Dalva begins hearing strange noises in the house where she has always lived. As she becomes aware of the cracks in a daily life that is slowly falling apart, something seems to be trying to emerge.

title: I Want to Tell My Story
Heartshell
overview: In this surrealist 2D animated film, a wounded heart encases itself in a protective shell and retreats into the depths of its own reflections, confronting themes of vulnerability, self-protection, and the difficult challenge of opening up.

title: The Bottled Captain
overview: Vanessa is a single mother haunted by a trauma from her past. Her son, Caio, is a creative child who seems to be escaping from reality. One day, the boy meets the little captain of a boat in a bottle who needs to set sail again, but the journey from the heart of Minas Gerais to the sea can be dangerous.

title: Duct Tape
overview: Two boys are kidnapped and thrown into a room. How will they get out?

title: Sohla
overview: In a small village where tradition defines destiny, young Pashya eagerly awaits his Sohla, the sacred coming-of-age ceremony. Dreaming of fame and idolizing Salman Khan, he sees it as his moment to shine. But when his father Ramdas's desperate attempt to ease the family's debts ends in tragedy, Pashya's world collapses.  Stripped of innocence, he shoulders the weight of survival with his mother and sister. As grief and duty converge on the day of the ritual, Pashya learns that Sohla is not just a spectacle, but an inheritance of resilience, sacrifice, and true manhood.

title: Gridlocked
overview: A rising prospective attorney messes with a local brothel to uncover sexual abuse and stir’s up a hornet’s nest. As his wife dies under questionable circumstances he connects the dots. Whilst being suspected for murder himself, he has to vanish into the small town’s underground to investigate beyond the eyes of justice.

title: Shyrmauyq
overview: Ayimkhan financially supports her son's family and goes into debt, but one day, his son's wife gets tired of country life and leaves.

title: Wonder Beast
overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

title: On the Other Side of the Bridge are the Things I Never Said
overview: After years apart, Mora reconnects with Luna—the great, unconfessed love of her youth—hoping to rekindle the friendship they once shared. During dinner, Luna reveals she had secretly been in love with her; this long-held silence brings to the surface buried feelings and questions about what might have been.

title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
overview: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office family drama.

title: The Bog
overview: A boy's body is discovered in a peat field, and a local drunk confesses to a decades-old murder. Policeman Broze reopens the case and is forced to confront his own role in the tragic game played by boys 30 years ago—a day he can't remember or forget.

title: Bed to the Future
overview: A young Scottish queer couple visit a futuristic bed shop where a simulator promises to reveal the perfect future for their relationship. Only it’s not quite what they had imagined.

title: Call and Response
overview: After a teen is caught kissing a girl in church by her traditional grandfather, she must decide whether belonging is worth hiding who she is, while he must chose if belief is more important than family.

title: Butterfly Stroke
overview: Ruth is an eccentric, determined woman who wants control over everything. Even death. So, she goes to Zurich for a tidy, orderly exit. But her chaotic granddaughter Lori gatecrashes, and will not go back home without her. They have an unexpected holiday together.

title: A Breed Apart
overview: An English cattle breeder and his 9-year-old son struggle to connect while settling in 1850s Canada.

title: Diary of a Simpy Kid - The Movie
overview: A pro-shot of Diary of a Simpy Kid: An Original Parody Musical, performed at Villagers Theatre in March 2026.

title: What Can't Be Mentioned
overview: 14 years after Dan Sallitt’s The Unspeakable Act (2012), we catch up with Jackie, now a married therapist-in-training who attempts to resolve issues of sexual dysfunction with her husband before deciding to visit her brother and newly pregnant sister-in-law.

title: Gadi
overview: A man living in a small Konkan hamlet who is grieving the loss of his child learns that he has no free will.

title: Reflected
overview: A man wakes up and slowly discovers he is trapped in a mirror world.

title: The Nutcracker Wish
overview: After Clara, a small town dance teacher, is gifted a 'magical' Nutcracker, the real-life version shows up at her front door. But what seemed a holiday serendipity may instead destroy her family legacy.

title: Only Old Friends Left Alive
overview: Retired Lao Cao and Xiao Lai, two old men, sit on opposite sides of a drinking table under an arcade in Taipei. They toast and talk nonsense like this every day, and they have done it for more than thirty years. A young director who meant only to watch somehow ends up at the table too, spending many absurd and moving nights with them. Years pass. Someone leaves, someone falls ill, and some relationships are repaired and then break again. The two men are old, they are nearly done with drink, and they no longer see each other often.

title: A Nadadora
overview: Costa da Morte, 1990s. Nico is a young girl who spends her days poaching alongside her father, Tano, a former heroin addict who shares his profits with her. But sometimes, a strange noise creeps into Nico’s mind. The world goes dark, and she loses consciousness, only to wake up somewhere else, with no memory of how she got there. As these absences become part of her life, Nico begins to venture into the unknown depths of her own mind, discovering something unexpected in the darkness: a strength that makes her feel less alone.

title: Some Detective
overview: Writer Hye-joo is trying her hand at a detective novel for the first time, but things aren’t going as she'd hoped. One day she receives a call from the mother of her ex-husband Tae-jae and sets out, beginning an unfamiliar journey. What follows is a series of encounters, some with people from Hye-joo's past and others arising from relationships in her present. These encounters may have little to do with her original purpose, taking her far off course. On a day she is supposed to meet her boyfriend, for instance, she never sees him and instead finds herself spending time with his son Yul-i and his friend Jong-i.

title: Darwin's Amazing Animals: Cats Around the World
overview: From the deserts of Africa to the forests and islands of Japan, explore the remarkable lives of the world's wild cats. Lions, cheetahs, jaguars, caracals, servals, fishing cats, leopards, Tsushima leopard cats, Pallas's cats and other feline predators reveal their surprising hunting skills, family bonds and struggles for survival. Guided by the animated Pallas's cats Manu and Tsunomin, this nature documentary journeys around the world to discover the extraordinary diversity and shared instincts of the cat family.

title: Vivre encore
overview: At the crucial moment when autonomy is lost, the question arises for older adults, their families, caregivers, and those who support them: What should be done with the time constantly gained over death? Within the confined spaces of homes or the cramped rooms of nursing homes, conflicts arise, losses and acts of solidarity play out, and bonds of tenderness and joy form—all of which speak to the richness and depth of life’s long journey. Behind the hushed silences, the apparent stillness, and the slow pace, new spaces open up to be explored…

title: A Call for Help
overview: A man calls his friend for help as something or someone chases him.

title: Perfume
overview: María Gabriela Epumer was a woman of innovative talent who created and performed rock music in the 1980s and 90s as a member of Viuda e Hijas de Roque Enroll, as Charly García's guitarist, and as a solo artist. Twenty years after her untimely death, Perfume access to 50 hours of footage she filmed herself?ranging from massive concerts to deeply intimate moments in recording studios and at home.

title: Patient 23
overview: Blinded by his own Hubris, Dr. lan Murphy dismisses warnings from his superiors that his patient is faking a rare disorder until his arrogance sparks a violent confrontation where the truth and his delusion collide.

title: Akshara
overview: Akshara is an emotional social-family drama that explores women’s identity, relationships, family values, and social challenges. The story follows a woman’s journey through emotional struggles, relationship conflicts, and societal expectations while searching for her own identity and choices.

title: あなたの息子ひき出します！
Le Mur
overview: Eliane and Laure, recently separated, are preparing to leave the apartment they shared. Eliane is packing her last boxes when she discovers dampness on the living room wall. Refusing to be solely responsible for the damage, she decides to call Laure for help. As the two women are forced to spend these last moments repainting the wall together, buried emotions resurface, marking the final steps toward their goodbye.

title: Little Ghost Laban Goes on Pranking
overview: Laban the Little Ghost is back with a new collection of cozy and just-spooky-enough adventures at the Good Morning Sun Castle. Together with his little sister Labolina and his best friend, the Little Prince, their days are filled with everything from trick-or-treating, birthday celebrations, and lost Christmas presents to unexpected guests and many other fun experiences.

title: About the Soufflé
overview: When Connor is unexpectedly told he needs to find another place to stay, he's thrust into the streets of Darwin with no safety net. A chance encounter with a local band of creatives leads him on a journey of growth and self-discovery as he battles to overcome personal traumas. Set against the unique backdrop of Australia's Top End, this experimental independent feature is both an intimate character study and a heartfelt love letter to Darwin - the city that inspired the filmmakers who call it home.

title: Perros
overview: Iván travels to a deserted island to reunite with his boyfriend, but tragedy strikes. In search of answers, he takes part in a ritual with a shaman… and something sinister crosses the threshold.

title: Sinner
overview: When the ostensibly unblemished prosecutor Kim Seokgyu is nominated for Minister of Justice, the opposition party raises questions about the 1994 "Migeum Arson-Murder Case." They allege that he conducted a coercive investigation against the illiterate suspect Hong Sunhwa and sought the death penalty; however, the crisis passes when a letter left by her comes to light. Yet, after belatedly reading her plea for her innocence to be conveyed to her son Eunsu, Seokgyu begins to reinvestigate the closed case. A prosecutor who once sought justice only within documents and courtroom walls confronts the truths he had overlooked through the voices of those involved.

title: Infection
overview: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

title: Fortaleza
overview: Brazil is preparing to welcome the world. Isadora is preparing to claim her place in it.

title: Memory Hole
overview: The film approaches Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four as a speculative archaeology: the visual markers of consumer society and political propaganda emerge through damaged advertisements and printed political materials.
Connects the years 1996 and 2026, featuring a time-travel storyline where member Nahyun finds a pager and travels back to 1996. A film featuring the girl group "AtHeart".

title: One Night At Slumber Mansion
overview: Morgan is so happy when Elaine is happy, nobody better get in the way of that...

title: Boxcutter
overview: On the way to the funeral of their estranged father, siblings Rob and James, along with their respective partners, search for a place to grab a bite to eat and stretch their legs. Along the bare stretch of highway, the group comes across a roadside diner and decides to stop in. They are met by the owners of the diner, the Curtis family, and after a strange meal and off-putting conversation, they get back in the car and continue on their way. The course of their trip is suddenly changed by a fatal car accident. Wrought with fear and guilt for what they've done, the group returns back to the diner to call the police and for whatever help they can find. What unfolds is a living nightmare that will uncover the terrible truth that even the best intentions are sometimes met with horrific consequences.

title: The Sleepwalker
overview: A college student, Niu Lang, turns his camera toward his roommate, Zhu Xing, who has a habit of sleepwalking, for a class project. In an attempt to capture his roommate's nocturnal behavior on film, he pursues what he believes to be a "true documentary." But one late night, an accident occurs.

title: A Gentle Apocalypse
overview: Consumed by a world of setbacks and expectations, Juno navigates the struggles of love, work, and loneliness. As her entire world crumbles, a strange encounter changes how she sees everything...

title: Dhara
overview: Deep in the mountains, Sharadha, a Sri Lankan rebel, is seriously injured after attacking an army base and is rescued by the young monk Samitha. While Sharadha recovers in the temple, she and Samitha find their respective beliefs put to the test. Can a rebel woman and a young monk, who embody collective action seeking freedom from oppression and an individual meditation in pursuit of inner freedom, essential needs for survival and uncontrollable desire, coexist in peace in the same space?

title: Blue
overview: Narrated by Marco Baliani, Blu takes viewers on a journey along Italy's coastlines and seabeds, blending mythology, history, and marine science. Through breathtaking imagery, the documentary contrasts the sea's timeless beauty with the urgent environmental threats it faces today, issuing a poignant call for ecological awareness and preservation.

title: Vendu
overview: A 18 frames per second film about gentrifiction, and the images and smiles on “For Sale” signs and political campaign signs. Made as part of the One Take Super 8 event on October 16, 2026.

title: Son of a Killer
overview: After a childhood scarred by the imprisonment of his parents for murder and abuse while in foster care, Tabaré, freshly out of prison himself, embarks on a journey to uncover the painful truth of his past, rebuild fractured family bonds and break free from inherited trauma.

title: Smarty
overview: Exiled director Nikita Lavretski (played by Belarusian director Sergey Kolosovski) strives to reunite with his wife across European borders. Reminiscing about the home he had to leave, he wonders whether he is stuck reliving his past forever.

title: Delta
overview: Felipe and Rosario are isolated in a house by the river, far from the city. However, a sinister presence already dwells within them.

title: Tales From The Kane Basement
overview: A spooktastic collection of micro shorts made by students from UCC Film and Screen Media.

title: Terri & Richard
overview: In 1960s New York City, Terri Thal was a manager of folk musicians, including Bob Dylan, while Richard Kostelanetz was a pioneer in the literary avant-garde. Now, sixty years later, they've met online and fallen in love.

title: Gardi Hutter - Da Zero
overview: After the global success of her legendary clown character "Hanna", Gardi Hutter has bravely decided against retirement and wants to reinvent herself once again. In the stage play "Zero", she embarks on the journey to new artistic shores and a new self.

title: The Time That Never Came
overview: In a world obsessed with youth, Sara chose to age naturally while Oskar, her partner, took an anti-aging treatment. Years later, when they reunite — divided by time but bound by the past — Sara begins a journey to reclaim lost love, confront buried emotions and find freedom.

title: Saturn or a Brief Treatise on Melancholy
overview: In Lagunas del Rosario, in the arid lands of Mendoza, Rubén Díaz—artisan, Malvinas War veteran, and healer known as Caballo Loco (Crazy Horse)—each winter solstice summons a secret ceremony exclusively for initiates. During a night-long vigil, pilgrims from distant places gather in search of relief from illness, grief, and pain. Surrounded by bonfires, prayers, and ancestral stories, the community attempts to conjure away the afflictions of a territory ravaged by drought and the vanishing of its waters.

title: FAM-ILLI
overview: Two struggling Juggalo rappers set out to create the ultimate DIY music video, documenting every step of the process as they chase underground fame and “family” loyalty. But as tensions rise and the line between performance and reality begins to blur, their chaotic creative project spirals into something far darker and more disturbing. Blending found footage horror with underground music culture, Fam-illi delivers a grimy, offbeat descent into obsession, friendship, and violence.

title: And Now It's Over
overview: Mauritius. A love story begins between Pierre, a local employee, and Louise, a French tourist suffering from anorexia. He shows her another side of his country: wild beaches, nightlife, bustling streets... Each, in their own way, dreams of escape and emancipation. But Louise's departure is approaching, and Pierre grows tense at the thought of staying on this island he is desperate to leave. He will risk everything in an attempt to escape a future that seems already written.

title: Wet Feathers
overview: After developing a phobia of pigeons, the eccentric Brett Trueman escapes to the underground town of Coober Pedy where he recounts experiences from his life.

title: Shaving
overview: Three years after escaping an abusive relationship, Suyeon retreats to her father's rural mansion to rebuild her life, writing horror fiction by day. When her caring boyfriend Shinji arrives for the holidays, a strange cut from a rusted razor sets something in motion. Something that wears his face but isn't him anymore. Isolated, with nowhere to run, they can no longer tell nightmare from reality as something begins to hunt them down.

title: Idol Seed
overview: An ex-FBI agent returns to a dying rural town to finish an investigation on his own terms, however, a cult begins to unravel his sense of reality.

title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.

title: Of astronauts and ghosts
overview: Pedro, the grandfather, Maria, the granddaughter, José, who works as a consignee, and a migrant mother in Spain: these four characters tell us a story that unfolds in the intimate universe of a single place, a labyrinth of relationships and revelations that becomes a surprising metaphor for the country's past and present within a family: a terminally ill grandfather, a youthful love story, the old man who refuses to die, the new man who struggles to come into the world... only one solution is possible...

title: Ya nos veremos por ahí
overview: During their graduation party, Óscar wants to let María know he has feelings for her before they go on separate ways. However, his escalating fear of rejection threatens to ruin his last chance.

title: A Life of an Artist: Kwon Jinkyu
overview: Kwon Jinkyu (1922-1973) was a sculptor who is regarded to have brought modern sculpture in Korea to fruition, opening the way to contemporary sculpture. Leaving behind over 420 pieces of work in terracotta and dry lacquer, he stands alongside painters Park Soo-Keun and Lee Jung-sub as one of Korea's foremost artists, yet he was never properly recognized in his lifetime.

title: The Dollhouse
overview: A real estate photographer creates a 3D virtual tour, and winds up pursued by a mysterious figure, located in the scan itself.

title: Dokument inifrån: Pojkarna - regissören och sanningen
overview: He was the acclaimed film director who had the voice of the youth and the ear of the powerful. His fall from grace was steep when he was accused of, and admitted to, sexually abusing a 13-year-old boy who had appeared in his films. In this documentary series, journalist Negra Efendić seeks the truth about Staffan Hildebrand.

title: The Goodie Bag
overview: An undergrad embarks on a networking meeting with an older woman who might offer more than he signed up for.

title: Kim Yun Shin Punches In
overview: Born in Wonsan in 1935, Kim is one of Korea's first-generation female sculptors. At 49, she gave up her professorship and left for Argentina, spending the next 40 years working in South America, following trees, stones, and raw gemstones. Then, at 90, she returned to Korea.

title: The Tunnel
overview: Suffering from post-traumatic stress after a violent assault in a tunnel, Janet Crane returns to the subterranean passageway to confront her fears and regain her freedom. When a hooded figure starts following her, the past and present collide as Janet tries to escape.

title: Etched In Pavement
overview: In a remote corner of Detroit, where the streets echo with both hardship and hope, two young men turn fighting into a language of survival, purpose and community.  Filmed over four years, Etched In Pavement follows Dwane Taylor and Michael Futrell whose weaving paths move through youth combat sports, professional boxing and their grassroots Guns Down, Gloves Up street-fighting movement. As they navigate fatherhood, loss, and those who came before, the film becomes an intimate portrait of generations caught between violence and purpose, survival and legacy.

title: The Silent Force of Louis Couperus
overview: The documentary explores Louis Couperus through his novels, short stories and letters. His childhood in the Dutch East Indies and his later perspective on colonial society shaped his writing, as did his experience of alienation and never fully belonging anywhere. In works such as The Silent Force (De stille kracht) and The Mountain of Light (De berg van licht), he explored power, masculinity and forbidden feelings without revealing too much of himself. Why does his personal life remain so controversial? The film sheds new light on Couperus and his times.

title: Sticky
overview: Set against the backdrop of the relentless pursuit of stardom in Tinseltown, ‘Sticky’ delves deep into the lives of three intertwined souls, each grappling with their own demons amidst the whirlwind of love, manipulation, and the chilling realization that in Hollywood, the line between obsession and rejection is dangerously thin.

title: Salome Learns to Dance
overview: A punk tour de force through an actor's sex dreams as she grapples with her character's eroticism. The filmmaker plays everyone, including a dog, and wears nudity and gender as a costume. A whole new meaning to "go f**k yourself."

title: MUNDO FRÁGIL
overview: A road movie following 2026 Pritzker Architecture Prize laureate Smiljan Radić from the Atacama Desert to the Cordillera mountains across Chile.
