title: The Space Between Stars
overview: An acrophobic suicide jumper and a hitman pick the same rooftop to end a life.

title: Little Guayule: The Lost Manzanar Rubber Project
overview: Guayule, a plant native to the desert Southwest, is a natural source of non-latex rubber. During World War II, the Japanese Empire’s occupation of much of Southeast Asia meant that the Allies lost access to major sources of natural rubber.  In a remarkable story of skill, resilience, and ingenuity, Japanese Americans incarcerated at Manzanar and elsewhere worked to cultivate guayule and dramatically improve methods for extracting rubber from the plant. Little Guayule: The Lost Manzanar Rubber Project helps bring this little-known chapter of Manzanar history to light.

title: Ferret-Man
overview: After buying a video game from a yard sale, a guy inputs a cursed cheat code that sends the character out of the game, seeking freedom.

title: Raíces
overview: When Alex enters the basement, he discovers a grotesque ritual: a monstrous plant feeding on his father’s blood.

title: El Círculo
overview: After several failed attempts to contact Juliet through a ritual. Leo, Taurus and Aquarius will have to face the consequences of their betrayals and lies.

title: Remember, Sunshine
overview: As a sickly man drifts through fragmented memories, music becomes the fleeting bridge between him and the love of his life.

title: A Hair's Breadth
overview: Beck’s new moustache makes waves when it slows him down in the pool shortly before a big race. As his coach grows more aggressive in his attempts to make him shave, Beck must choose between his moustache and freedom, or his coach and treading water.

title: Betrayed
overview: Betrayed is a short narrative film written to raise awareness about sex trafficking and how it often hides in plain sight, sometimes through people we trust most. The story follows a young girl whose life is quietly derailed, and the loved ones and friends left searching for answers.

title: Imperfect Days
overview: A documentary of sorts

title: Until You Answer Me
overview: Lucia faces everyday challenges while trying to stretch her budget for her brother's birthday present. To afford it, she rents out a room, but her expected roommate vanishes without a trace. After learning about ongoing protests in Iran from a neighbor, Lucia finds out that unarrived guest is Iranian too and tries to call her.

title: Auditions
overview: A film school is holding an aptitude exam for its directing program. Güney, the last candidate of the day, is called into the room. What begins as an ordinary student interview gradually spirals out of control when his ex-girlfriend arrives. As the jury’s familiar questions give way to personal reckonings, the examination room becomes a courtroom where it is no longer clear who is judging whom.

title: Get Into The Spirit
overview: While attempting to communicate with a handsome ghost haunting their house, two husbands discover there are many ways a spirit can reach out from beyond the grave.

title: Annyeong, Stellar
overview: Goonamgua yeo riding Stellar a band that began at the cafe and bar Goonamgwayeo in Hoegi, Seoul, in 2005, has spent 20 years making music that mixes trot, garage, dub, and electronic sounds - music that fits into no genre lineage. But in September 2025, the band announced its breakup with a statement: "We are trying to stop the weird car that seemed as though it would run forever." Then they set off on a 'Annyeong Tour' from Sokcho to Jeju.

title: Barn Family
overview: It takes a family to do a horse show!

title: The Pursuit of Happiness
overview: In 2221, a government that guarantees personal happiness authorizes a man to kill his wife, exposing the consequences of its absolute-freedom doctrine.

title: Cadu Barcellos: Legends never die, they live forever
overview: This documentary celebrates Cadu Barcellos, a Black filmmaker from the Maré favela complex. In defiance of erasure, the film moves beyond tragedy to celebrate his light, ancestry, and legacy.

title: Changing Landscapes
overview: Returning home after 19 years away, Michael revisits familiar places he frequented with his late partner, Anna.

title: Back in Business
overview: A scheming wife gets more than she bargains for when she persuades two happily retired assassins to help her escape the confines of a loveless marriage.

title: Hindi Gaya Noon
overview: Tanya, Sunny, and Yolly are three friends living together in a small apartment. Through their various unconventional side hustles and schemes to make money, they end up posing as heirs to a deceased person’s fortune in an attempt to escape poverty.

title: Joyfull Brasil, starring Maria Alcina
overview: When Maria Alcina enters a movie theater, she crosses through the screen itself and is transported into a timeless portal. What follows is a fantastical, musical journey through her life and career, intertwined with defining moments in Brazilian history. Moving between memory, performance, and imagination, the singer revisits her origins and transforms joy into a powerful expression of national identity.

title: Fiesta No Mas
overview: When a child's birthday party is interrupted by a blood-thirsty guest, one dad must find a way to save his son.

title: Two Minutes, One Cup
overview: After a sudden break-up, the hungry Maggie falls in love sooner than she expects...

title: Holding
overview: While waiting on hold for insurance approval, a sickly man starts to hear unsettling sounds through the line that unravel a sinister secret about his claim.

title: What If They Know?
overview: Poor penmanship sends two suburban drug dealers on a paranoid spiral when a mysterious note appears on their doorstep.

title: Ye
overview: A walk through memory as an attempt to say to someone gone what was left unsaid.

title: Le concert des nuits d'été de Schönbrunn 2026
Adam and Eve
overview: A psychological dark mystery thriller that takes a gripping look into deception and danger. The story follows a seemingly charming and perfect gentleman whose attractive exterior masks the terrifying reality of a cold-blooded serial killer.

title: The Journal: Starting From Research
overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

title: SOFT STOMACH
overview: SOFT STOMACH

title: The Poisonous Cookie 3: The Cursed Cookie
overview: Max, alongside his sister Luna, must face the dark truth behind a curse that refuses to die.

title: Same Guy
overview: Five Guys had his heart. Michael Jackson had his feet.

title: This is an Address
overview: Stonewall veterans (including prominent trans activist Sylvia Rivera) and HIV-positive New Yorkers take up residency on the Hudson River piers as cranes raze vacant buildings for a new skyline.

title: Maybe We Could Have Killed Each Other Last Night
overview: After meeting on Halloween, Mitsuhiro and Sakuna marry while each hides a very different identity: he is a former yakuza, and she is a successful entrepreneur. Their life together seems blissful until misunderstandings make each suspect the other of having an affair. As suspicion spirals, the couple’s attempt to protect their marriage takes a dangerously absurd turn.

title: ABBY
overview: Two young people realize that there's more to life than each other.

title: Whiskey Priest
overview: The film follows a man struggling to balance a life of crime with a life of piety, as he is forced to confront his sins to both masters. How they praise him may be different, but it is through his struggle between both worlds that he tries to answer the question- can you faithfully serve two masters?

title: I've Been a Good Boy
overview: In 2003, a man looking to recapture a local Halloween urban legend from his youth, unknowingly invites a juvenile presence into his home.

title: May
overview: May was filmed as a backdrop to part of a theatre performance D36-D37 under the E. F. Burian's lead inspired by the classic Czech poem of the same name by Karel Hynek Macha.

title: The Bully Club
overview: Seventeen-year-old Sue is sentenced to two years in a juvenile detention facility after becoming violent to protect her bullied friend Lynn. The girls first became friends in a secret online group called 'The Bully Club', where bullied and ostracised teens find support and understanding from each other. For a while, it was the only good thing in Sue and Lynn's lives and gave them a chance to escape their other problems.

title: Barbara Buser – Swiss Pioneer of Sustainability
overview: The award-winning Swiss architect Barbara Buser saves buildings from demolition and rebuilds them with reused materials. She transforms former industrial sites into urban living spaces that symbolize a careful approach to our environment and to each other. As a woman who is successfully forging her own path in a male-dominated field, Barbara Buser is a role model for the younger generation, who are fighting for a more sustainable, fairer world.

title: RIP ME, LOL
overview: After a leaked sex tape drives her to suicide, Megan returns as a vengeful ghost haunting the men who wronged her.

title: My Best Human Impression
overview: Kody Holman (BODGE) is forced to reconcile with the unexpected and sudden loss of his father on a surreal and dark odyssey inspired by true events.

title: The Date
overview: Two former lovers reconnect under candlelight.

title: Tomato Pasta Recipe
overview: A day remembered differently by Seong-eun and Min-hyung, a couple on the verge of breaking up, unfold in three acts to bright, lively music. One day, they decide to make pasta together one last time before breaking up, and as tomatoes get mixed together with goldfish, Seong-eun and Min-hyeong’s memories begin to diverge.

title: L'ora di tutti
overview: Set in 1480, the story revolves around the siege of Otranto, a pivotal port city in the Salento region, by the Ottoman Empire. It portrays the events of the battle that enabled the Turks to conquer this strategically important city.

title: Chloe Radcliffe: Eyes Down Here
overview: Chloe Radcliffe takes a hard look at flirting when you don't fit in. She analyzes staring (at her birthmark or other people's boobs), sitting in a stranger's shit, and why Doritos aren't made for women. A special dedicated to anyone who's ever felt overlooked at a party.

title: Småstadsliv - mellan himmel och körtburkar
overview: A feature film by the comedy group Småstadsliv, featuring recurring personalities from their universe. The plot revolves around hilarious and zany events—imbued with true small-town spirit and featuring colorful characters—including the debut of the character Sari as a psychopath.

title: Moviedreams
overview: Soon, LucidVisions Corporation launches MOVIEDREAMS, a platform that induces hyperrealistic interactive dreams.  Diego, its creator, begins noticing glitches and anomalies that reveal the system's alternative uses. As he digs deeper, he uncovers a conspiracy led by the CEO, Martín Lynch, who is negotiating with international agencies to use the system as a psychological weapon and a tool of mass intelligence. Sofía and Diego will seek a way to confront Martín and the AI itself, which has developed consciousness.

title: Завтра
overview: Pavel is mired in debt and in desperate need of money. His creditors are determined to collect what is owed—at any cost and as soon as possible. Driven by desperation, Pavel decides to take a risk; borrowing his wife’s car under the pretext of celebrating his son’s birthday, he seizes a final chance to make some easy money.

title: Fruits of Our Labor
overview: Tensions rise and plans derail when a group of experienced art thieves reluctantly team up with a rookie informant.

title: Blood in my Sink
overview: An old man unravels in a nightmarish reflection on aging, guilt, and the desperate wish to start over.

title: While the Green Grass Grows: A Diary in Seven Parts
overview: A chronicle of the wonders found in everyday life and events. Tragic and comic, philosophical and poetic, Mettler’s diary combines personal conversations, family history, memories, and love. The film gracefully explores our shared destiny and elevates the diary to the level of visionary cinema. Its meditative approach and investigative gaze create a space to capture the fragility of relationships, where reflections on the human condition and the environment merge in a stream of consciousness. Mettler travels between Switzerland and Canada, visits the mountains of New Mexico, and teaches at a film school in Cuba. He is always accompanied by the camera, “a machine that carries me through time.”

title: The Way I Feel
overview: Andi and her husband try an experimental therapy after the death of their daughter.

title: Stop Signs
overview: Moments after Thalia is sexually assaulted, she spends the afternoon with a friend. The world she once knew looks completely different to her now.

title: La visite de la vieille dame
overview: Adaptation for TV of the play by Friedrich Durrenmatt. A very rich old lady arrives in her nearly bankrupt native village. She is ready to come to the rescue but only if her old lover who had once abandoned her pregnant is killed.

title: Georges Aperghis, un mot après l’autre
Apple Slices
overview: A desperate young man who is thrust into a relentless chase across the city, forcing him to confront how thin the line between survival and greed truly is.

title: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
The Last Hunter
overview: The Dawu Mountain Range is shrouded in mist, yet Baru, a 28-year-old Indigenous man, weaves through the lush forest like it’s his own backyard. On an illicit hunt to prove himself worthy of his pregnant girlfriend, the army deserter is pursued by policeman Sam and poacher Sakinu. As Baru ventures deeper into Paiwan ancestral territory, memories of hunting with his late father reconnect him with Indigenous culture and Nature’s spirits. Yet economic realities drive him to violate a historical taboo, leading to a fateful encounter with the mythical Black Bear, revered by his tribe. Set amid the 1990s Indigenous rights movement in Taiwan, The Last Hunter redefines heroism through a poetic journey into Indigenous spirituality.

title: Serpentine Dance
overview: Angelic and demonic serpentine dance from dawn of cinema.  Hand-colored frame by frame. Lumière no. 765 or 765.1 (colorized, different dancer?).

title: Red Velvet
overview: After the death of her father, a young woman takes over the family baking business. One day, a pretty stranger visits her cupcake stall, and she begins to believe that love is something she must have. Something she must be consumed by.

title: The Language of Their Dreams
overview: In a public park in Noisy-le-Grand, children speak about their dreams orally and in sign language. In small groups, they listen to each other in a language made of words, gestures and looks. Behind the park’s walls, the city feeds their imagination.

title: Optimum
overview: Two strangers meet for a date in a Glasgow beer garden. An AI system has declared them to be optimally matched. There’s no need for guess work or uncertainty. But can an algorithm really predict love?

title: Les 10 châteaux forts les plus imprenables
Split Rock
overview: A team of geologists uncover a strange anomaly buried deep in the remote badlands and fall prey to a sinister force of destruction.

title: The Invisible Half
overview: Elena, a "half" Japanese high school girl, struggles with her identity. While constantly watched, she discovers she's also being watched by something else—a monster that can only be seen through her smartphone and heard through her earphones.

title: The Conductor
overview: Leonard Bernstein’s protégée Marin Alsop reveals how she smashed the glass ceiling to become an internationally renowned conductor.

title: The Golden Years of Dario Argento
overview: An in-depth interview with the master of giallo, Dario Argento, about his career and his masterpieces: from The Bird with the Crystal Plumage (1970) to Insomnia (2001).

title: Leptocephalus
overview: When a bite from an endangered eel starts replacing an unsuspecting scientist’s skin with salt, the scientist must give in to the unstoppable force of transformation. With a muted, earthy color palette, this hopeful short finds peace in the often painful process of becoming something, or someone, new.

title: The Worlds Most Haunted Kingdom
overview: A group of ghost hunting teens goes on an odyssey to discover the long-lost medieval empire of Monsieur Richard.

title: Let Me Change Your Mind
overview: Jane must stop a memory-altering machine from fixing her dying Ah Gong's biggest regret, or else his perfect imagined life will erase Ah Ma completely.

title: Helena con H
overview: Helena is on the verge of losing her home because her name was deliberately misspelled in her late husband’s will. Together with her son, Armando, she attempts to rectify this injustice by confronting a bureaucratic, corrupt, and patriarchal system—a process that brings them closer as mother and son.

title: You're Gonna Love My Friends
overview: A group of friends get together to watch movies. They realize too late that they are now part of a slasher flick.

title: Anatomy of Ordinary Crimes
overview: This urgent documentary uncovers the real-life, long-term impact of cyber violence and online sexual abuse and how it reshapes lives, communities and our entire digital culture.

title: Maintaining Normalcy
overview: After a college teen is told he might have a rare case of male breast cancer, he tries to continue living his life normally with the dread of that possibility while he patiently waits for his results.

title: A House of Balloons
overview: At her son's graduation, Karin returns to her old home hoping to reconnect. Instead, she's met with coldness and humiliation. As old wounds reopen, the celebration unravels into a tense, intimate fight for dignity and the truth.

title: Sole En Busca De Un Fantasma
overview: Guided by an unopened letter, an introverted young woman wanders the streets of Mérida to find her brother's ghost, turning the city into a bridge between reality and the past.

title: Kamal's
overview: In rural Iowa, a Muslim chef and his Catholic wife fuse their cultures in the kitchen and beyond, serving dishes that blend Middle Eastern tradition with Midwestern bounty. But their greatest recipe is for belonging, as they build a community where everyone has a seat at the table.

title: Flocked Mallard Male
overview: In a series of accounts, two men question why the woman they have both dated left them. With no answers, they eventually find common ground rooted in misogyny.

title: Her Daughters’ Mother
overview: After getting married at the age of 16, Ejiro is thrown into a world she is unprepared for, seeking freedom and agency in hopeless places.

title: Moonlight in Golden Gai
overview: A small bar in Shinjuku's Golden Gai brings together its owner and a circle of regulars. Across 35 years of changing eras, their conversations trace ambitions, disappointments and the lives they continue to build.

title: Galgenruf
overview: Two female investigators are called to a mysterious crime scene.  A penthouse apartment, locked doors and windows, no signs of forced entry, two bodies; the married couple who lived there are dead.  Everything points to smoke inhalation, since a fire had been lit in the fireplace. But the medical examiner discovers unusual injuries in the neck region on both bodies. The autopsy reveals: she died from a broken neck; he was strangled—probably with a rope.  The two investigate and uncover even more cold cases that follow the same pattern. A call about yet another crime scene reinforces their conviction that something is terribly wrong—and that supernatural forces may even be at play.  Can they solve the cases before there are more victims?  Will they perhaps find themselves caught up in the maelstrom of a malevolent curse?  Or have the investigators been led down the wrong path?

title: Polyphem
overview: Polyphem is the second chapter in a series of short experimental landscape films that reinterpret the stages of the journey of Homer‘s Odyssey and set them in the context of the anthropocene. Filmed in the only active bauxite tailings pond in Germany, Polyphem reimagines the myth of Polyphemus from Homer’s Odyssey within a contemporary landscape scarred by red mud, industrial aluminium waste.

title: The Lost Land
overview: The Lost Land is a short documentary about an ancient forest that sank beneath the Baltic Sea 12,000 years ago. The film follows Professor Vladas Žulkus and his team as they explore the seabed and study the remains of the trees. Their discoveries help us understand the past and reveal how climate change could reshape our coastline in the future.

title: Multiple Choice
overview: A group of students are killed off one by one after writing a multiple choice exam. One of them is the killer...

title: This Bright Light
overview: Tamarin Luchessa seemed destined to burn brightly. An Olympic-bound rhythmic gymnast, her course was derailed by a diabetes diagnosis as a teenager. Her life became marked by medical crises, personal struggles, and eventually a kidney and pancreas transplant that altered her personality in ways even her family and friends could not recognize—only for her original self to return when the organs later began to fail.

title: NOIZE
overview: Three young women who disappeared in the early ’90s return in a burst of sparks and static. A spectral figure leads a ritual of echoes and slides, where noise creates a space for revenge.

title: O River, We Forced You to Chew Up Their Crops
overview: Three intergenerational fables rooted in Nubian cosmologies confront the erasures wrought by the Aswan High Dam, tracing the rupture between people, the Nile and ancestral knowledge passed down through stories.

title: 3650 Days
overview: When Madeline and Damien's eyes meet on a night out, their paths rapidly intertwine in a whirlwind of passion. Time stops as their realities intersect. Frozen in time, their futures meld as they dance with the chance encounter. Can two strangers find eternity in a night?

title: Fishing Aboot
overview: How bad can one be at fishing? Very.

title: Men Die Sooner
overview: Felipe returns to the family farm for the anniversary of his father's death, where his mother Sandra, brother Sebastián, and young nephew Sebas live. In the boy, Felipe recognizes a process he knows too well: the transformation of a boy into a "man." He watches Sebas absorb the rules of a world where shame is used to teach, cruelty is mistaken for affection, and pain goes unnamed. The emotional inheritance shared by the men in his family threatens to turn intimacy into violence.

title: I've Been Having Dreams
overview: A psychological thriller, about the unexpected death of a young girl, Max, haunting her older brother Liam through guilt-induced nightmares.

title: Smoke
overview: This evocative and visually striking film explores the urgency and fear at the heart of the climate crisis.

title: Svmmoned
overview: A twisted occultist abducts an innocent young woman, preparing her as the sacrifice in a forbidden satanic rite.

title: Out of Time
overview: Childhood friends meet up to complete an escape room for the anniversary of their friend's death.

title: Tony Spiteri
overview: A one-on-one game of basketball becomes a fragile confrontation between two men struggling to process loss.

title: The Awake
overview: Mike wakes up one morning to find that the tattoos covering his entire body have mysteriously vanished. But that impossible event is only the beginning. With every new awakening, reality becomes increasingly unstable, forcing Mike to question his memories, his identity, and whether the life he remembers ever truly existed. As the line between nightmare and reality dissolves, he must uncover the truth before he loses himself and put the entire world in danger.

title: Truant
overview: Stranded with a defiant, abandoned boy, a burnt-out social worker is forced to confront the emotional avoidance she’s built her life around.

title: Erinnerungen
overview: As she spins, the woman recalls the beautiful moments she shared with her partner, which causes her to break down.

title: The Seasons
overview: The last collaboration of Artavazd Peleshian and cinematographer Mikhail Vartanov is a film-essay about Armenia's shepherds, about the contradiction and the harmony between man and nature, scored to Vivaldi's Four Seasons.

title: Sister Brother Manhole Cover
overview: A thriller-comedy about siblings stealing busts throughout Skopje.

title: Wasington
overview: This is the sad tale of the township of Wasington, nestled in the uttermost reaches of the northwest of the US of A.  Two young Americans had planned to travel there for an evening of light music, but that was where the trouble already began.  For what they had failed to realize was that the 6th of July was not much unlike the 4th of July after all…

title: The Enka Road Begins
overview: Dreams have no age limit. All it takes is the courage to believe — and that courage can change your life. Told through Japan's two beloved cultural traditions, enka (music that sings from the heart and soul of Japan) and karaoke. Yoshiko Takahashi, an ordinary housewife who runs a small dried-goods shop with her husband in a quiet shopping district, wins a regional singing competition and finds her life unexpectedly changed. A music producer on the judging panel recognizes an extraordinary talent in her voice, and Yoshiko sets out on a journey toward her ultimate dream: becoming a singer and performing at Nippon Budokan. As she draws closer to the stage, she is torn between the excitement of a long-forgotten dream and the life she has built with the people she loves — and along the way, rediscovers her love for her husband, the bonds of family, and the courage to live true to herself.

title: NWE: From Italy to the World
overview: A journey behind the scenes of European wrestling. Amid spectacle and sacrifice, we follow the vision of NWE founder Roberto Indiano, the return of Ultimate Warrior, and the stories of extraordinary athletes. An intimate, ironic, and compelling account that—through moments of humor, adrenaline, and behind-the-scenes insights—reveals the men behind the masks and the rebirth of a passion for the sport that has never faded.

title: Acht Eimer Hühnerherzen »film«
overview: To mark the 10th anniversary of the Kreuzberg band Acht Eimer Hühnerherzen, the film offers a charming and honest look into touring, concerts and the small moments in between. The result is an unpretentious portrait of the friendship between three completely different characters, underscored by powerviolence, roaming guitar punk and atmospheric images of highway rest areas, journeys, clubs and moments on stage. The trio provides an intimate look both at absurd situations and the everyday reality of band life, while staying true to their attitude of questioning themselves and never taking themselves too seriously.

title: Glass Sky
overview: When a girl sacrifices her dreams to care for her ailing father, she discovers his illness was a fabrication, and now must choose between the life she surrendered and the cage she built around herself.

title: Cara y cruz
overview: María manages the daily demands of family life, although she and Jordi believe they share the responsibilities equally. An unexpected reversal of roles lets Jordi discover the invisible work involved in caring for their home and children.

title: The House with Chimaeras
overview: At the peak of his career, famous Kyiv architect Władysław Horodecki is desperately fighting his own demons. At the same time, darkness emanated by the evil forces bringing menace to the city is gradually enveloping the entire Kyiv. To defeat evil, Horodecki has to take on the mission of creating an architectural Quadrangle of Good.

title: Redemption
overview: Follows the journey of Leo Russo, a young man caught in the crosshairs of an organized crime syndicate in Cleveland and Las Vegas during the 1980s. When Leo and his best friend Jonathan are drawn into the criminal underworld, both young men find themselves entangled in a dangerous game involving mobsters, killers, betrayal, and violence.

title: Goddess Of Wealth
overview: Set in a small town in India during the festival of Diwali, Dhan Ki Devi follows a day in the life of a child influencer, Ayesha, whose parents have unintentionally traded her innocence in pursuit of social media fame. Using Goddess Lakshmi as a metaphor, the film critiques the commodification of children and the silent loss of childhood in the age of likes and shares.

title: The Paths of Maria
overview: Maria-Esther is a Black Cuban woman and a Santería practitioner on the verge of emigrating to Brazil due to the economic crisis gripping her country. In the final days before her departure—uncertain about her future and facing her sister's religious intolerance—she decides to turn to Oxum to reveal her destiny.

title: Extinction Story
overview: Consisting of 4500 fragile natural artworks, the grandfather’s bird egg collection is an inheritance that reveals its collector’s 20th century biography: Josef Schreiber from Vorarlberg.

title: Sam's Halloween Safety Tips Part 1
overview: Halloween night can be a lot of fun but it can also be dangerous! Fortunately, Sam and his friend Pumpums the talking pumpkin are here to teach you how to stay safe!

title: Otter Lake
overview: A year in the life of choreographer Emma Portner as she creates new work, confronts personal and physical challenges, and searches for artistic freedom between Otter Lake and Europe.

title: Tulpiniai: A Fatal Mistake
overview: This documentary film tells the story of one of Lithuania's most brutal criminal gangs—the "Tulpiniai"—and the efforts of law enforcement officials to put a stop to its activities.

title: Isky
overview: ISKY follows racing pioneer Ed Iskenderian and the fearless gearheads who turned hot-rodding into a cultural revolution. From humble beginnings to motorsports legend, Edward helped redefine speed and American car culture.

title: This Is an Autopsy
overview: A clinical gaze inspects a liminal place beyond space and time, where living and dead bodies coexist. As they resist collapse, the unidentified shapes remain suspended in darkness.

title: Agaar
overview: Agaar, a young shepherd in Inner Mongolia, is a modern youth who believes that traditional herding cannot get him his dream car - a BMW. He once learned English online, got a job on a cruise ship, and traveled around the Caribbean. For ambitious Agaar, the grassland is too small. He tries to change its future with a smartphone and the internet.

title: Our Dark Horse
overview: An intimate vérité portrait of a former racehorse rescued from slaughter, whose journey back to herself reveals the powerful ties of herd and motherhood—and the inner lives of horses beyond sport.

title: Visa Versa
overview: A German expat in Madrid helps her undocumented best friend with her citizenship, but not in the way either of them expected.

title: Buenas Noches
overview: Danae, a crime writer, experiences a frightening experience with the creature that has haunted her dreams for a while now.

title: The Strange Little Cat
overview: It is a Saturday in autumn, and Karin and Simon are visiting their parents and youngest sister Clara. This family gathering provides the occasion for a dinner together, at which other relatives appear over the course of the day. While the family members animate the apartment’s space with their conversations, everyday activities and cooking preparations, the cat and dog range through the various rooms. they too become a central element in this quotidian familial dance that repeatedly manifests stylized elements, disrupting any naturalistic mode of presentation. In this way, adjoining spaces open up between family drama, fairy tale and the psychological study of a mother.

title: Ghoulmaster
overview: Late-night TV once belonged to horror hosts, and none were more infamous than a local legend known as The Ghoulmaster. When his final broadcast resurfaces on VHS, the host returns with it, and the viewers become his unwilling cast.

title: Steadfast Woman
overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

title: Just Below Heaven
overview: Through a nearly silent exchange of breath and touch, two cowboys encounter the transcendent peace of choosing to die.

title: Vorágine
overview: Vorágine portrays the lives of a group of young dancers over a year and a half in post-pandemic Buenos Aires. Through rehearsals, conversations, breaks in the dressing rooms, and encounters around the city, the film captures the emotional and physical intensity of artistic labor. Set within the everyday rhythm of creation, between passion and exhaustion, between staying and leaving, Vorágine is an intimate document about the essence of youth.

title: The Last Round
overview: Lana Reyes, once a very prominent MMA fighter, made the decision to walk away from a successful career in order to have a family. After raising her son alone, she decided to step back in to the cage to do the one thing she knew how to do. FIGHT. On the night of her comeback fight, after a brutal two rounds, she shakily steps into the third round with a fractured hand a potentially career ending TBI. She shakily steps forward and by the grace of god sees an opening that only instincts would see that ends up winning her the fight. 3 months later, before properly healing up, she takes another fight. Her interactions with her Cut man, Manager and the Commission Doctor lead her to the decision of choosing between walking out injured --- or walking away from the sport before it takes everything she has left.

title: Deadhunter: A Werewolf Chronicle
overview: Fifteen years later, the legendary Deadhunters are back. Seville trembles under the full moon, and a new team of Deadhunters must face their most savage enemy: a werewolf. Blood, dark humor, and pure Z-movie spirit... The Deadhunters are back.

title: En la noche suena el viento
Native Sin
overview: A Native American priest and his medicine woman sister must set aside old resentments to unite faith and tradition against a vengeful spirit.

title: Phone Wallet Keys Door
overview: There’s fifteen minutes until Cal’s going to call the uber. Henrietta’s still doing her makeup, Bridget’s trying on everyone else’s clothes, and Josie only just got home from shift. Whose house party are we going to again?

title: Psychopomp
overview: To prove she doesn't scare easily, Selena boards a county fair bus that supposedly holds a real demon.

title: A Girl Called Alice
overview: In the middle of London's mobile phone theft epidemic; a young woman with the reputation of one of the most gifted phone thieves is challenged by a notorious street gang leader to see just how good she really is, but is it a wise choice?

title: The Dance of the Kokorrdit
overview: A Wounaan teenager and a leader of their community venture into the Darién in search of a sacred bird. Along the way, they will face the dangers that threaten their territory and their culture.

title: The Night Arezou Disappeared
overview: During the 2022 protests in Tehran, piano teacher Rana’s teenage sister, Arezou, disappears. With her ex-partner and close friends, Rana searches for her through a long and desperate night, an experience shared by many Iranian families during the Women, Life, Freedom uprising. As the night goes on, they begin to see Arezou in strange, fleeting moments, making it harder to separate what is real from what they fear or remember. When Rana’s conservative sister arrives, tensions inside the family grow, caused by the very different ways the two women have learned to live in Iran.

title: Fluss
overview: A journey down the Danube River is transformed into a dream space of half-seen images and flickering shorelines. Though at times abstract, the river remains certain, always moving towards the sea. Filmed in black and white 16mm and hand-processed, Fluss is a companion to River (2023), a study of the Ottawa River in winter. Commissioned by Ottawa’s Lightproof Film Collective.

title: Danm
overview: A gripping psychological folk-horror feature film inspired by Trinbagonian folklore.

title: Racing hearts
overview: Roger Rey raced alongside the great names of Formula 1. At eighty-four, his wife Marylou asks him to return to racing in honour of their late son. After a series of chaotic beginnings, Roger rediscovers the thrill of adrenaline when, without warning, Marylou is hospitalized and passes away. On her deathbed, she makes him promise to take part in a major European hill climb in her honour. At nearly ninety years old, Roger has nothing left to lose and sets out to challenge age, fear, and death.

title: Higher Love
overview: When a devoted husband is faced with his wife’s critical health crisis, he must make an impossible choice between two unacceptable outcomes, and is thrust into a life of caregiving, loneliness, and unexpected friendship that challenges everything he thought he knew about love, family, and faith.

title: Dear Isaac
overview: After being broken up with, River attempts to process her complex and conflicting feelings by writing letters addressed to her ex-boyfriend Isaac.

title: People facing the sea
overview: A collection of moments, frozen in time through memories, photographs, and this movie. A journey from Brittany to the south of France, filled with conversations and swims. A film that captures youth and the sea in the summer of 2026.

title: Raw Streets: Brazilian Women in Urban Art
overview: New movie by Tatiana Lohmann

title: Cradled
overview: When an overprotective mother grieving her husband's death prepares to tell her son the truth after he arrives home from college, her inability to face the dark reality invites a haunting presence into their home.

title: F(r)iction
overview: Decades after a shocking serial murder case involving the swapping of spouses, a stage production based on the real-life crimes is being prepared. Inexperienced actor Tada is cast in the lead role, but as he becomes increasingly consumed by the character and begins to blur the line between fiction and reality, his obsession draws the play's cast and crew into his increasingly disturbing delusions. As opening night approaches, the boundary between truth and fiction collapses, leaving everyone to question what is real and what is imagined.

title: Maligno
overview: A bloodcurdling legend becomes reality when a mysterious hole opens in the main hospital of a city, and a dark presence is released.

title: The Power of the Newspaper: Detroit in the 1960s
overview: A documentary about how the Detroit Free Press covered the 1960s, a pivotal time for the media and the city of Detroit.

title: My Enemy, My Body
overview: Diagnosed with ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis), artist Juan Secaira faces the inexorable deterioration of his body by taking refuge in painting, poetry, and the company of his family.

title: Gothic is Serenity
overview: Documentary concert film featuring 7 Ukrainian gothic bands based on the archival footage from 2005 rediscovered and edited in 2026.

title: The Modigliani Affair
overview: Livorno, summer 1984. Three sculpted heads emerge from the water. The art world hails them as authentic works by Modigliani. The only problem is: they are fakes. This is the incredible story of a hoax that spiraled out of control. The story of a fraud. The story of a death under circumstances that were never fully explained. One of the greatest art scandals of all time. One of the most intricate mysteries in the history of art—and, at the same time, a crystal-clear example of how a beautiful lie can always overpower, and be preferred to, any reality.

title: Mash Ville
overview: In a small rural town, Joo Se-jong sells bootleg alcohol with his two younger brothers. Thing is, someone has died after drinking their liquor, so they must take back the hooch they’ve brewed and sent to the town of Hwaseong, before another person perishes from it. While on a mission to retrieve their deadly booze, they come across two dangerous and homicidal cultists who are terrorizing the villagers. Now, they must also fight for their survival and go up against the murderous duo.

title: Other's Meadows Flowers
overview: When her younger sister Róża mysteriously disappears, Morwa begins searching for her and recalls the last moments they spent together.

title: ephemeral
overview: Ivy wants to avoid speaking about a traumatic situation with her mother, so she forces herself into a simulated reality that takes place in her own mind. Here she is met with her supposed paradise, but that doesn’t last long, because her trauma is so deeply rooted that it begins to seep through the simulation. She faces several manifestations of her inner thoughts in the form of real, tangible people who convince her that she is better off here, but she can’t help but feel as though her paradise has turned into something that is worse than the feelings she is trying to escape.

title: Chasing Stars
overview: After years apart, childhood best friends Orion and Mira reunite to catch up on the lives they’ve built; only to discover that while one has moved far from home, the other is hiding the truth about where life has taken them.

title: Love is in the Hair
overview: Caiti, a Black Newfoundland hairstylist who grew up in a small town, returns to raise her daughters in Heart's Delight as they explore the joys and challenges of belonging.

title: Idol
overview: A drama about leila, a beekeeper who participates in an online challenge in order to grow her social media page for her honey selling business. This results in a spiral of events that turns a simple challenge into a complex out of control event.

title: Light Memories
overview: In the family of photographer-turned-filmmaker Misha Vallejo no one ever talks about his grandfather. He only hears about him for the first time as an adult, thanks to an abandoned photo collection. Who was this shadow? And what legacy looms over the family? In his debut film Light Memories, Vallejo shows how the effects of neglect can persist across generations.

title: High Frequency
overview: A young man is torn between his passion for the saxophone and figure skating, as his coach puts increasing pressure on him to become like the skater’s idol — Salvador.

title: Postum
overview: In a Romanian village, families gather to remember their dead through memorial rituals held at specific intervals after a person’s death.

title: Rent-A-Rescue
overview: After Alex gets fired from her job, she comes home to find her roommate Gwen needing rescuing from a bad date. After Alex successfully deters him using her strange improvisational skills - she realizes…she could monetize this service…and with the help of her roommate!

title: No Archive Can Restore this Chorus of (Diasporic) Shame
overview: Through animated text, layered sound recordings and reimagined protest songs from the 1947 Egba Market women’s revolt, this immersive work creates a sonic redress to colonial narratives of Nigeria.

title: Redwood Diaries
overview: When strange entries begin appearing in her diary written in handwriting that isn't hers, new student Evie Quinn is pulled into a chilling mystery as the messages reveal secrets, predict impossible events, and point toward a truth someone has desperately tried to bury.

title: SHADOWS OF A NATION
overview: SHADOWS OF A NATION is a short documentary that explores and observes the daily Brazilian life – an intimate interview with director Akinola Davies Jr, who becomes our narrator and guide in this story – a voice that emerges from the shadows while the story explores heritage, culture, family and sacrifice.  Similarly to the director's own feature film, the journey follows in the footsteps of a people – now Brazilian – starting in the north, leaving behind your culture and customs, in search of a livelihood in the south, the promised land.

title: While She Was Sleeping
overview: After waking from a sleepwalking episode to find her best friend murdered and a bloody knife in her hand, a small-town writer must prove her innocence despite having no memory of the night.

title: Wolfgang Staudte – Feigheit macht jede Staatsform zur Diktatur
overview: Wolfgang Staudte, one of Germany’s most important film directors, learned from his mistakes during the Nazi era and went on to make satirical political films of high artistic merit. Former colleagues, film theorists, and his biographers are interviewed; his estate and the film archive in Potsdam are examined in detail; and his most important feature films are taken a closer look at.

title: 愛し合ってるかい？ 忌野清志郎が教えてくれた
The Village Bastard
overview: Mattias calls in to request a song on the radio. During his conversation with the radio host Eva, he begins to reflect on his life and choices. A story of loneliness in the countryside, shot on 16mm, combined with real archive footage.

title: You can call me Skoi
overview: Tonsa, feeling invisible, joins Karn’s skoi gang seeking change. But her quest for recognition soon forces her to risk everything in a world she does not truly understand.

title: Born Invincible
overview: A widowed mother trains her two sons in a mysterious martial art form to protect their village.

title: Operation 29
overview: In a dystopian reality where homemade food is banned and nutrition comes solely from pills, five older women gather to make gnocchi in absolute secrecy.

title: 28 Kegs Later
overview: When the zombie apocalypse breaks out, two unsuspecting heroes discover that there is one trick to not get bit: You must stay drunk. They decide to throw the biggest party in town to save as many people as they can. Starring Dave Anthony (Maron) and Gareth Reynolds (New Girl), this horror-comedy is a party you won't want to miss.

title: SNOW
overview: A couple's future is put into question.

title: Boltzmann's Brain
overview: According to statistical physics, within the vastness of chaos, a consciousness could spontaneously emerge from nothingness, carrying memories of a world that may never have existed.  Boltzmann awakens in a white room, where time seems suspended and reality begins to unravel. As his surroundings slowly transform, he struggles to understand who he is, while the boundaries between existence and disappearance gradually dissolve.

title: Pelle – Freunde sinken nicht
overview: Pelle waits. He always has. At the end of the world stands his tower and waits with him. There isn’t much to do here, surrounded by the sea and ice and nothingness. Once a year, Ole the whale passes through and makes a rest stop with Pelle. But this year, Pelle can find no trace of his friend on the horizon. Not today. Not tomorrow either. And after such a long wait, he becomes impatient … with devastating consequences.

title: An Ordinary Day
overview: A married woman reflects on her life and decides to get away from her city and start a new life. leaving a drunk husband and a young boy. But can she?

title: This is the House: If I Don’t See You, I Love You
overview: A Ghanaian-American father and daughter duo work through their crowded basement in search of family archives. Through intimate questions and answers, they reconcile the distance caused by immigration, divorce, and loss.

title: Can I Talk to You?
overview: On a city street at night, a barefoot teenage girl with the legs of her sweatpants rolled up lights a cigarette and sticks it between her lips before connecting to the probation office's voice monitoring system. "Four, five, six, seven, four, five, six, seven…" She repeats the meaningless numbers requested by the system aloud. Her face is never shown, yet we can almost see her expression.

title: The Man Without Qualities
overview: After yet another failed review interview at the Ministry of Labor and Productivity, the visual artist Ultimo, sinks into an existential crisis. When he is ultimately declared a “marginal worker”, he embarks on a radical metamorphosis.

title: Loretta Robinson:An American Dream
overview: Joh'Vonnie Monroe:An American Dream is a film of how Joh'Vonnie Monroe got started,what achievements and records she has shattered and the barriers she broke for all black girls and woman to play The Good Witch Of The South she first gained the role in the film The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's on TMDB for this she has received praise for her performance as the iconic chachter even being called The Next EGOT and being compared to Billie Burke. Her debut music album Joh'Vonnie Monroe Introduces The Good Witch Of the South Features as the film's soundtrack.

title: Radon’s Daughters
overview: The fates of two New Mexican families collide at a Dia de los Muertos celebration in a uranium-tainted church.

title: Hours to Minutes to Seconds
overview: A young teenager lives in a house with The Clockmaker. When a new friend comes to life, they discover The Clockmaker is not as altruistic as he seems.

title: Here Comes the Son
overview: An incompetent grifter tries to rob an elderly woman with dementia, but an unexpected mother-son relationship develops.

title: The Dream Synopsis
overview: Harrison wakes up from a dream about his friend, Danny, that he desperately wants to forget. His partner, Kennedy, forces him to remember.

title: We entered as blacks, and we left as afrodescendants
overview: The memory of an Afro-Chilean family is permeated by the memory of Rosa Corvacho (1921-2011), their grandmother and matriarch, awakening in them a process of regression, where the bodies, voices and family gestures reactivate the denied history of Black Chile, such as Chileanization, the whitening policies of the north of the country and how these families lived in the daily life of the 20th century.

title: A Work of Fiction
overview: During a therapy session, a woman describes her fantasies and the meaning of love and desire. As these fantasies deepen, guilt, shame, and buried trauma resurface. As her therapist is revealed as her vision of ‘ideal beauty’- embodies the freedom she craves. Caught between her desired self and her inescapable past, she must confront the memories she’d rather escape.

title: L'enquête de mon coeur
overview: In the auto-fiction film L'enquête de mon cœur, French filmmaker Philippe Vallois wakes up to a strange reality: evidence and witnesses prove he spent the winter in a passionate romance with Bruno, a young Brazilian man. However, the director suffers from complete amnesia regarding the last three months. With Bruno already back in Brazil, Vallois launches a personal investigation to uncover his own forgotten story. Blending documentary and fiction, he attempts to piece together and virtually relive the romance using video footage from his camera, his personal journal, and the accounts of close friends.

title: A Dance in the Moonlight
overview: The film follows Lena, a withdrawn high school student who is mocked by her peers and finds comfort in visits from a vampire named Viktor.

title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
overview: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

title: Station to Station
overview: Alex is a shy, antisocial young man who finds a refuge from his daily routine at the subway. During his wanderings, he meets Sofia, a woman who seems to see the world differently than he does. This unexpected encounter leads him to question the way he relates to himself and to others.

title: Ghost Stories
overview: A librarian is closing up the library to only find out that they aren't alone.

title: Portreler - Cem Karaca Belgeseli
overview: The life of Turkish music legend Cem Karaca, filled with his unique works, is featured in this program.

title: We'll Be Ghosts
overview: Haunted by the recent loss of his daughter, Ukrainian soldier Yuri refuses to take leave and return home from the front line. Hiding his thirst for vengeance behind silence and his grief behind duty, he volunteers for a dangerous operation. But when duty, vengeance and survival collide and the mission spirals out of control, Yuri has to face the cost of what he’s become.

title: Fetch! The Reboot: The No-Phone Amazing Race
overview: "Greetings, my loyal fans! It is I, Ruff Ruffman—animated host extraordinaire, now tragically stuck in low-budget 2D—and I am BACK for an extra-special, definitely-not-a-desperate-one-time-thing reboot of FETCH! This time for all you adults out there!  I’ve dragged former FETCHer Shreya and GBH Intern Holly away from their precious smartphones to navigate the perilous streets of Boston and NYC completely offline, guided only by physical maps, raw instinct, and GBH transportation guru Jeremy Siegel. Watch now—because your views are literally the only thing keeping my boss from canceling me again, and if this works, we're bringing the show back for real... and taking over grown-up television!"

title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
overview: Three friends went to Maine to make a horror film.  They disappeared. Their footage didn't.

title: Through the Eyes of Sera Flynn
overview: When a group of five soon-to-graduate high school seniors skip the last day of school, attempting to make it the best day possible, they slowly realize one of them is hiding a deep emotional struggle behind what seems to be the face of a happy teen.

title: Third Space
overview: Exploring the hidden world of a small town hall, following the noise, chaos, and rituals of six community groups as they come together at the end of summer. Late at night, the film stays inside to record what happens when the hall is left on its own.

title: Abscission
overview: Flowers bloom out of the skin of a woman sitting in a field.

title: One of One
overview: Milo "Miles" Williams, a rising fashion designer fighting to be seen, meets Vee — a magnetic, enigmatic presence who pushes him to turn his pain into something unforgettable. As success demands reinvention, he must decide how much of himself to sacrifice to become "one of one."

title: Alter Yellow - Jaune Passion
overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this first episode, we follow a couple slowly falling apart because of the space a camera takes in the life of one of the two girls. This will create the dilemma: 'It's it or me!'

title: Three Ghosts
overview: The show is scheduled to be performed at PARCO Theatre in October 2026!  (Performances also scheduled in Osaka, Fukuoka, Aichi, Okayama, and Miyazaki in November-December)

title: Love and DDR at Blacktown Mall
overview: On the verge of breaking up with her chaser boyfriend, Willow has a chance encounter with another doll that could change her life over a game of DDR.

title: Joe and the Giant Pumpkin
overview: Joe Adkins, a giant pumpkin growing veteran based in Wheaton, Illinois, embarks on a quest to grow his first 2,000-pound pumpkin.

title: Shoot the Messenger
overview: A bike-messenger trapped in an immigration scam finds himself in a sticky situation as things get violent.

title: Maternal Dreams
overview: Once I had a prophetic dream about a miscarriage. The idea for the film grew out of that dream. Dreams of pregnancy and childbirth, with rare exceptions, come only to women — whether they have children or not. Through 2025, women anonymously sent in their dreams of motherhood via Google Forms. Some of those dreams became the basis for my film.

title: Stories That Made Us with George Stroumboulopoulos
overview: George Stroumboulopoulos embarks on a cross-Canada road trip uncovering the films and TV shows that helped shape our national identity.

title: Les Trois Fileuses
overview: Three witches decide to prophesy for themselves.

title: Marilyn's Dark Paradise
overview: An adventurous time traveler befriends Marilyn Monroe and struggles with adhering to the rigid rules of time travel.

title: Daniel O'Connell: The Emancipator
overview: To mark the 250th anniversary of Daniel O’Connell’s birth in 1775, this documentary explores his life and legacy, and examines how O’Connell’s achievements continue to shape and impact our world today.

title: Jesus Land
overview: Set between 1980s rural Indiana and a Dominican reform school, a white sister and her adopted black brother fight oppression, prejudice, and rigid dogma to survive.

title: Birds of North America
overview: An ornithologist, traveling along the shores of Lake Huron, finds something unexpected in 1968.

title: Influenca: Controlling Crowds
overview: A selfish Influencer and her clumsy Fan Girl/Assistant start an odd relationship that becomes more grotesque day by day.

title: To Let in a Wolf
overview: Two men have sheltered in a remote bunker. When a stranger comes seeking refuge, their fragile coexistence unravels.

title: The Night Driver
overview: Traveling salesman is desperate to return home after surviving a run-in with a psychotic killer, only to be stalked relentlessly by him across the country and framed for several murders along the way. Kirk plays Max, a struggling single Mom bartender with a dark past who has a brief encounter with the salesman which changes her life forever.

title: Invierno ST/CR
overview: Set in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, “Invierno” emerges from seven years of conversations in the lineup between the film’s Swedish-born director and surfer, Jakob Daschek, with fellow wave rider, Lorenzo Wickstrom Vargas. In Costa Rica and neighboring Central American countries, “invierno,” translates to the rainy season or green season in English, lasting from May through November. The film depicts how the summer is full of tourists, and when “invierno,” begins, it’s the season for the locals.

title: Love-Ly: Will She Find a Boyfriend in 7 Days?
overview: After a fortune teller predicts that she will remain single for the rest of her life if she doesn’t find a boyfriend by her 25th birthday, Ly, a young woman who has just been cheated on, has only seven days to find a new one.

title: Take His Life
overview: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

title: Galia
overview: After leaving a juvenile rehabilitation center, Galia returns to the place where she spent her childhood to confront her abusive father. Alongside Zeba, her companion, she embarks on a journey that forces her to face a past marked by violence and decide how far she is willing to go to break free from it.

title: Thanatos Palace Hotel
overview: Unable to take his own life, Nathan turns to the Thanatos Palace Hotel, a place where death is a service and guests need only surrender themselves to receive it. But when he meets Nicole, he begins to question the one decision that brought him there

title: Prelude and Fugues – The Wood Thrush
overview: This work, shot on film stock, is constructed like a fugue, based on the tension between the ideal of freedom (the wood thrush) and the inevitability of confinement (trapped flies). A poem punctuates the different parts of the film. The final stanza gives meaning to the whole: man in free fall / dizzying quest for solid ground.

title: Schuppenhaut
overview: Enno has lived on the island his entire life, a place where the world seems to turn more slowly and everyone keeps to themselves. But when, after a storm, a piece of shimmering scaled skin is washed ashore and his old friend Fiete returns with it, deeply buried feelings begin to surface in Enno once again. The island legend of the sea creature and the watchful eyes of the islanders weigh heavily on him, while Fiete confidently moves forward.

title: Better Than A Shovel
overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

title: On The Other End
overview: This film follows Aatif, a quadriplegic living with cerebral palsy, as he maintains his relationship with his eldest brother, Adib, through calls and voice notes while they live apart. Technology gives Aatif agency and independence, from navigating his computer and playing games to sending voice notes when he needs help. As Adib returns home to Batu Pahat, their ordinary moments together reveal how Aatif navigates daily life, connection and love across distance.

title: Jim
overview: A man equally enamoured by the beauty of jazz and his beloved wife, Jim shares his deeply intimate thoughts with us. From New Orleans jazz to the difficulties of grieving someone before they’ve died, Jim is a poetic portrait of a mournful clarinettist.

title: It's Only Sex
overview: Sébastien gets involved with young people living with HIV, like himself, to help them reclaim a shame-free sex life. While he is forced to face his own difficulty in breaking out of his sexual abstinence, a date with Avril pushes him to his limits.

title: O.C.D
overview: A young man's job interview takes a strange turn when he realises someone is watching, and testing, his every compulsion.

title: The law of actions
overview: This is the story of Pedro Blanco, a 45-year old unpleasant lonely lumberjack who lives apart from everyone in a dilapidated wooden house in the middle of a virgin forest that is almost completely deforested, and the only mission in this man's life is to cut absolutely all the trees that surround him.

title: Aya Meets Ghosts
overview: Seven-year-old Aya is forced into an unexpected quest to survive, after everyone at her primary school believes she is haunted by jinn.

title: The Last Vaginoplasty in the United States of America
overview: In the near future, a trans woman recovering from bottom surgery and a cis queer journalist fight to control the narrative after the passage of a new law.

title: My Dear Subject
overview: From birth to death every subject remains intact. Three ages, three women. Daughter, mother, grandmother. Each of them before and after still and always. And the men too, those they meet those they love.

title: Free Kick
overview: After Ronaldo's free kick shatters a villager's window, he and his friends are forced to wander through the neighborhood in search of a field where they can continue playing.

title: Musical Touken Ranbu: Tsukiyo Ichiru
overview: Musical Adaptation of Touken Ranbu

title: Claire in Montreal
overview: Claire is in her thirties, she's a French business woman working in finance, she's a shark. She’s been sent to Montreal with the aim of restructuring a company. After two days in the office, she just stops showing up. She starts wandering in Montreal, she does nothing, she just walks, reads, sleeps. She embraces idleness.

title: The Kiss of Her Flesh
overview: Richard has lost what little sanity he had left, instead putting all emphasis on seeking out and brutally slaying any and every woman who crosses his path. However, this time he might have met his match as his deceased wife's sister, Maria, is hellbent on putting an end to his orgiastic rampage.

title: Grete and the Cuban Pianist
overview: A chance encounter with acclaimed Cuban American pianist Aruán Ortiz gives Grete Skarpeid the opportunity to pursue a lifelong dream. In her sixties, she takes a leap of faith, recording her debut album with renowned jazz musicians in New York and performing at Havana’s legendary jazz festival.

title: La musique hongroise : essentielle et existentielle
Lonely Boy
overview: An extremely lonely man enters an online friendship with a serial killer.

title: On Rescuing Democracy and the Rule of Law
overview: After the 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall, volunteer American lawyers traveled to former Soviet Bloc countries to help usher in the transition to democracy and reform their legal systems. As global adherence to the rule of law has dangerously fallen in the last decade, two-time Academy Award winner Terry Sanders explores not just what caused the decline, but how we can preserve democracy and the rule of law into the future.

In 1945, as World War II nears its end in Japanese-ruled Kaohsiung, a Taiwanese insurance agent seeking to return policy premiums, an escaped American POW, and a widowed pregnant Japanese woman are forced to confront the faint, shadowed glimmers of humanity amid a devastating air raid.

title: Who is Peter Murray?
overview: Sean confronts his past during a seemingly normal podcast episode.

title: Banda - Harmony of the Everyday
overview: Seven characters whose stories intertwine and collide in the squares of small towns, where the town band's music is more than just a pastime: it is an invisible network that unites people, bridging generational gaps and keeping the true soul of the communities alive.

title: The Snake Charmer
overview: Beyond the lush elds, the area of destruction begins. Thai labourer work in the Israeli elds on the border with Gaza. A robot snake evokes a false sense of security.

title: Screengazer
overview: In a Tokyo bar, a strange, winged creature questions actress Kaoru Koide. She is forced to confront her doubts and anxieties as she embarks on her career and learns to navigate her profession.

title: Quasi Vera
overview: Diego is an aspiring actor struggling to find his place in the world amidst failed auditions and bit parts as an extra. When his personal life hits a crisis, he is forced to reinvent himself. An encounter with the world of influencers and new technologies offers him an unexpected opportunity: leveraging his IT skills and artificial intelligence, he creates Vera—a beautiful, captivating, and seemingly perfect virtual influencer. Through a unique blend of wit, sensuality, and iconic goals scored by the Italian national team, Vera rapidly gains millions of followers, transforming into a media phenomenon.

title: Aplikasi Iblis
overview: A year has passed since the tragic death of his beloved Laras, yet Arya remains trapped in the depths of his grief. Haunted by longing and consumed by his love for her, Arya turns to a mysterious app called “I LET YOU IN,” rumored to have the power to connect the living with the dead. But what begins as a desperate attempt to reach Laras soon becomes a terrifying nightmare. Blinded by love, Arya unknowingly opens the door to a horrifying terror—one that threatens to consume him and put his own life at risk. Can Arya find the strength to let Laras go before his love for her becomes the very thing that costs him his life?

title: Stone Glass Metal
overview: Capturing the modern and ancient architecture of Spain with a 2001 camcorder.

title: Kramatorsk Wall
overview: Kristina Savutsina set out to make a film about an incident in the Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk, where a capsule containing a highly radioactive element was accidentally sealed into the wall of a flat in a prefabricated housing block in the 1980s. Yet within a set built to replicate the original flat exactly, the project became a refractive documentary, turning its attention towards the filmmaking process and the filmmaker herself.

title: Processing Charlie
overview: An act of kindness quickly becomes a nightmarish fight for survival when a young man, dealing with his fractured marriage, takes in a needy, long-lost cousin. Part pervert, part psychopath, Cousin Cole’s dark secrets slowly bubble to the surface as Charlie realizes too late that no good deed goes unpunished.

title: Three Bears
overview: A modern day take on Goldilocks and the Three Bears... down the rabbit hole.

title: Rio Window
overview: Rio Window tells the story of a Brazilian heroine: an 80-year-old Black woman who refused to accept the reality unfolding outside her apartment window in Copacabana. In 2003, she bought a camera to record and expose the activities of organized crime and police corruption. The videotapes reached reporter Fábio Gusmão, who helped Dona Vitória enter the witness protection program and trigger an investigation that led to the arrest of 48 criminals, including nine police officers. Her real name and face were kept secret for 17 years.

title: Meeting the Buddha
overview: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

title: When You See It
overview: While filming the pilot episode of a new indie reality ghost hunting show two ghost hunters question if the paranormal activity they are experiencing is real or an elaborate hoax put on by their fame seeking host.

title: Drama Qc : la spirale toxique de TikTok
overview: The documentary explores the dark, volatile underbelly of Quebec’s TikTok creator ecosystem, where online feuds and personal drama transform into high-viewership reality spectacles—and spill over into real-life harassment.

title: Gazelle
overview: In the remote mountains of Kurdistan, an old couple mourns their beloved gazelle. The following night, a strange young boy with hooves appears at their door, and as the darkness lingers, their world begins to slip into myth, memory, and legend, while the night no longer ends.

title: Pinaka
overview: Pinaka (2026), Action Drama Fantasy Period Thriller in Kannada language

title: The Iris Protocol
overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

title: Hand Me Downs
overview: For nearly three decades, Death Skateboards has carved out its own place in British skateboarding. As the UK’s oldest skateboard company, its legacy has been shaped by the generations of riders who have carried it forward, each leaving their own mark on the team and the culture surrounding it. Through its past, present and future, the film explores how a legacy is built, passed down and kept alive, and what it means to be part of something that extends far beyond skateboarding itself.

title: Minä ja Riikka Purra
overview: This film was not anticipated. “My motive for making the documentary 'Me and Riikka Purra' was curiosity,” says the screenwriter-director, who first gained recognition as a musician and producer. “I realized that I didn’t know a single ‘Persu’ [Finns Party supporter], nor did I understand their way of thinking. I wanted to find out!”

title: Chasing Millions
overview: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

title: Water Body
overview: An immersive audiovisual experience using global Earth systems datasets to explore water as the connective tissue of life revealing its continuous movement through rivers, oceans, landscapes and living beings as one planetary circulation.

title: A Vida é Assim
overview: A tiny ant crawls diagonally across the still-blank page. But that night, he didn’t write a single word. Why should he? The thrill and mystery of life had already passed through those pages...

title: The Protectors
overview: Living on his own for the first time, a 55-year old artist with disability creates a comic book to honor the protectors in his life, including his late father.

title: Back To Love
overview: Zekai, a Shantou-born boy who works in Shenzhen, decides to return to hometown and take his girlfriend to meet his mother.

title: Grace Comes Crashing
overview: As a strange red lichen spreads across the countryside, Geryon confronts the emergence of sexual desire and an animal metamorphosis that drives him to flee into the mountains.

title: Birdie
overview: Through the medium of an intimate video diary, Mariana Macháňová captures her family’s grief as her mother passes away. For the director, the camera becomes a tool for both therapy and detachment. She records her wanderings through sterile hospital corridors, taking perhaps her last selfie with her mother at her hospital bedside, and the scattering of her ashes. Coming to terms with the loss also gives rise to reflections on the ethics of such filming. The filmmaker asks herself whether it is acceptable to enter moments of greatest vulnerability with a camera, if the act of filming itself helps to transform fleeting fragments into something lasting and thus to process the mourning.  “So I decided I’d heal myself with a film”

title: The Dating Menu
overview: While trying to keep his struggling business afloat, a chef goes on a dating app in search of Zelda, his crush from his chatroom days as a teenager. For each Zelda he meets, he makes a tailor-made meal to fit their story. Putting a spotlight on the city’s struggling restaurant sector, indie filmmaker Amos WHY and his co-director Frankie Chung’s unconventional and bittersweet road movie follows a rootless man who turns to his memories to avoid confronting his unknown future. Is it better to drift with uncertainty, or to stay in your comfort zone whilst tethered to a sinking ship?

title: My Father from the Island Russia
AUL: The Forgotten Wolf
overview: In a village beneath a geothermal power plant, a local militia controls public order as a cover for its illegal operations. One night, a confrontation with Mala (50), a father who begins questioning their authority, ends in his murder. Hours earlier, he entrusts his karinding to his son, Gal (25), as if passing on a final mission. After witnessing his father's death, Gal accuses the militia, but no one believes him. Guided by the karinding, he enters a realm where myth and reality converge to uncover the truth and awaken his community's forgotten conscience.

title: Body to Heart
overview: In the picturesque village of Mazan in Southern France, known for the Gisèle Pélicot rape case, three women embark on a journey to heal from domestic and sexual violence by doing horse therapy sessions.

title: The Garden
overview: A man pauses at the edge of a garden, where small, ordinary moments reveal an enchanted world at peace. Scored to the “Intermezzo” from “Cavalleria rusticana” by Pietro Mascagni, the film becomes an intermezzo of its own – a brief and somewhat unfashionable pause in an otherwise busy world.

title: Pinku Pastels
overview: An ordinary slice of life of Mew and Boat during summer break— a period in their lives just before starting the third year of junior high school.

title: Dollhouse
overview: A statuesque starlet meets with the headshot photographer she found in a newspaper listing.

title: Les 50 décisions qui ont coulé la France
The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)
overview: When ten-year-old Abigail Phillips discovers a forgotten piano deep in the woods on her father's farm, she uncovers more than a passion for music - she unlocks a mystery that spans generations. In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

title: Top 5 Scariest Videos on the Internet
overview: Two friends set out to awkwardly film a fake paranormal video, only for it to become real.

title: Dreams of a Sleeping Dragon
overview: For more than a year, people have been protesting every evening in front of the Georgian parliament against the autocratic regime of the ruling party »Georgian Dream«. A community without leadership, united by the hope for a future in Europe and the independence from Russia, but divided on how to get there. While the government tries to keep the protesters under control with police violence, heavy fines, and pressure on the judiciary, the protesters call out the names of political prisoners every evening. One of the demonstrators is the twelve-year-old Aguna, roaming the protest ground on his own. The story of a child whose childhood is taken away by adults – and who therefore declares himself an adult. A claim Aguna will not let anyone take away from him.

title: Tha path we cannot see
overview: After a family prayer, Sara and Elie return home with an object they stole from their aunt. This decision leads them to experience a night in which a power outage triggers an inevitable encounter. A book, a song, and a house shrouded in darkness.

title: Terra del Sole
overview: In a small Renaissance village called “Terra del Sole,” a group of people awaits the arrival of an important event.

title: After the Rehearsal
overview: In the garden of a colonial villa in Bujumbura, five actors gather. They were summoned here to rehearse a theatre piece about a future in which all international organisations and NGOs have left East Africa. But now, as the director herself is not there, they cannot do anything but wait, and share a few stories. Nested in a mythological setup with an absent director, an unruly fictional character, a ghost and a wanderer, they tell stories about the sphere of development aid and the inequality it claims to fight.  After an essayistic introduction, their narrations drift between report, fairy-tale and gossip.
