In an attempt to grasp a an increasingly elusive world, these monologues were developed out of stories, ideas and experiences from 5 years of artistic research and exchange between a Burundian and a German filmmaker.

title: Steve Against The Rapture
overview: Well the rapture finally happened, and the most regular middle man ever Steve has to fight through zombies and demons to clock into work on time, or else he's fired. Watch this story full of comedy, action, crappy VFX, and I guess Steve has to save the world on the side.

title: Aa Bata Aama 2
overview: An ambitious young man leaves his rural Nepali village to chase success in the city, only to return years later to an empty home and the heartbreaking reality of the sacrifices his parents made.

title: As a Person
overview: Six fragile, newly sober addicts have their boundaries pushed and their comfort zones threatened when they take an improv class at an inpatient drug and alcohol rehab.

title: Last Round
overview: A Berlin housing project for homeless men follows a different approach: acceptance, support, dignity instead of forced abstinence. A longitudinal observation of impressive horizontality.

title: The Lost Mariachis
overview: Blending road movie, archival footage, and essayistic elements, this documentary chronicles a filmmaker's journey through the Balkans in search of the last Yu-Mex singers. Through a lost film by Emilio "El Indio" Fernández, this bittersweet story takes a playful approach in exploring how cinema and music migrate and are reinterpreted in distant contexts.

title: Renato Freitas: Born to Disturb
overview: The film shows how Renato Freitas breaks into the spaces of institutional power, going head-to-head with corrupt political bosses and fighting radically for the lives of all people.  We go behind the scenes of these clashes, the persecution, and the resistance strategies of one of us in power.

title: Valleys of the Earth
overview: Valleys of the Earth is a story of redemption set in a post-apocalyptic United States several years after an enormous solar plunges Humanity into a new Dark Age. From the ashes, a militarized cult known as "the Watchers" rises. Led by their prophets, the Watchers believe this apocalyptic event was brought on by their Angels, and that it is as a means of giving humanity a fresh start. Isaac, our protagonist, attempts to flee his past and right his wrongs. Along the way, his story becomes entwined with Kellen, a young woman fiercely dedicated to upholding a promise she once made. If the two are to survive, they must learn to trust one another; however, the Watchers are everywhere, and will stop at nothing to recover what they have lost.

title: The Torch
overview: Meira foregrounds the historic and continuing resistance of the Meira Paibi, “women with torches” of Manipur. Emerging in response to the pervasive climate of fear produced by the enforcement of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958, the film traces how ordinary women transformed themselves into vigilant custodians of their communities. Meira situates the movement within a longer genealogy of women-led resistance in Manipur.

title: The Bicycle Thief 2
overview: A heartbroken cyclist tries to reconnect with his ex, from whom he stole a bike.

title: Whitewater Inc.
overview: A total loser has a bad day at work.

title: One Bench or Another
overview: After Bart's usual bench in the park is taken he is driven to sit next to Sam which leads to the most whirlwinding encounters that could happen on a park bench.

title: Out of Character
overview: On the eve of a vitrectomy in Cluj, a young ophthalmologist confides in his psychoanalyst, haunted by nightmares in which he botches the surgery and destroys his patient’s vision.

title: A Court of Claws and Riesling
overview: A young woman, dissatisfied with modern dating, adopts a cat despite her allergies – only to find that the combination of antihistamines and white wine has her hallucinating a handsome fae lord, straight out of her saucy books… But he may have sinister intentions.

title: Not Like the Others
overview: Tired of dating apps, a woman embarks on one final date.

title: Salt Electric
overview: 1990s Goa, a curious 18-year-old uncovers her brother's hidden VHS stash. What begins as a clandestine screening evolves into a tender, electric awakening of her own unfathomable desires.

title: Cukrkandl
overview: Annička Jesenská inherits her late uncle’s dental practice in the Austro-Hungarian border town of Medov, only to find locals loyal to a rival dentist allied with the schoolteacher and a sugar-candy magnate. Determined to help children, she discovers an exotic Peruvian herb that makes treatments painless and, with the support of local kids, challenges the entrenched interests to improve oral health in the community.

title: The man formerly known as Maxwell Milk
overview: Maxwell details his dairy journey as he mutates into someone unrecognizable.

title: Abegar 2026
overview: prepared and presented by Nigussu Film Production

title: La cuisine du Sud-Ouest se confie
Evanescent
overview: A young girl makes a bid for connection with her emotionally unavailable father.

title: The Floating Head of Frankenstein
overview: A mad scientist creates Frankenstein's Floating Head and Detective Rock must kick its ass. Shot in 2009, but unreleased until it was rediscovered in 2026.

title: Shireen
overview: A young girl clings to the fragile routines of her day as an unspoken threat closes in, until one evening, she returns home to a silence that changes everything.

title: Etude of Life
overview: In the war-torn Europe of 1944, a woman sees her life fall to pieces as she is forced to choose between her treacherous husband and an enemy officer.

title: Simon Small
overview: Bertil lives with his parents. One day, all of a sudden, a little thumb size boy appears under his bed! His name is Simon Small. The 2 boys bond right away and Nils shows Bertil a fascinating magical world right inside his bedroom walls. Neither of them will ever be lonely again.

title: Tides
overview: Tides observes the daily rhythms of lobstermen and kelp harvesters on Swan’s Island, Maine, where time is measured by tides and weather. Without dialogue or narration, the film immerses viewers in the tactile, sensory world of maritime labor: setting and hauling lobster traps, sorting the catch, lifting kelp from the water. There are no protagonists here, not even among the workers themselves. Instead, the film offers an attentive, quietly reverent portrait of labor as a collective practice, marked by moments of care, precision and tenderness that emerge through repetition. By focusing on these elemental gestures, the work uncovers the quiet knowledge and endurance passed down through generations, offering a contemplative study of human interaction with the environment and the unspoken practices that sustain a community.

title: A Shitty Smile
overview: At a red light, two strangers confess their darkest secrets through their car windows before the light turns green.

title: Okinawa Saudade
overview: A documentary depicting the journey of Okinawan-Brazilian descendants returning to their ancestral homeland and engaging with its history and culture.

title: Manami Guid Mag **** sa Mansion
overview: During the American colonial period in Brgy. Paraiso, Sagay City, Negros Occidental, the American-owned Insular Lumber Company established one of the largest hardwood logging operations in the world under a government forest concession. The film follows Caloy, a young laborer sent to deliver the payroll to a hacendero’s mansion on the night a catastrophe descends upon Sagay. As it tears through the workers’ settlement, the hacendero couple remains sheltered inside their mansion.

title: Lo que en nosotros calla
overview: Carmen Castillo is internationally known for her literary and film work, in which her Chilean roots and the political and human tragedies of her native country play a central role. In this film, she breaks the silence she has maintained for 50 years around her own history and that of her children. She looks back on events that began in 1970s Chile, when her 'compañero' Miguel Enríquez—like her, a member of the left-wing guerrilla organization MIR—was killed and she herself was abducted and imprisoned by the new dictatorship.

title: Animal Mating
overview: An experimental film about animal mating

title: Being Muslim After 9/11
overview: Twenty-five years after 9/11, film-makers Mobeen and Masood revisit their archive and reconnect with people across the British Muslim community to explore how life has changed.

title: Blind Ants
overview: In 1935, a storm caused an English ship carrying coal to run aground in Bizkaia. Residents of Algorta gathered to rescue the coal, but Sabas Jauregui ignored their pleas and dragged his children into the storm.

title: Direction les Champs
overview: This summer, the Tour de France is finally coming by the tiny village of Laventour. For our 8-years-old Sophie, there’s no way her big brother Benoît can miss it. Once the village’s cycling champion, he hasn’t spoken, left his room or shown any interest for the outside world for months. But Sophie isn’t giving up that easily : the peloton is coming… and so are they!

title: Postmortem
overview: A girlfailure stumbles from friend to friend while guarding a terrible secret.

title: Go! Anpanman: Pantan and the star of promises
overview: Anpanman saves Pantan, the old red panda. Pantan needs to fulfill his promise.

title: Edhi Alice: Take
overview: Edhi Alice: TAKE begins from the perspective of Alice, a gaffer pushed out of the field, as she confronts her own body, and transitions into the journey of another protagonist, Edhi, who discovers a new sense of embodiment. The narrative of transition expands beyond a personal life story to encompass relationships, bodily experiences, and the sense of space, becoming a cinematic transformation.

title: Violences dans le football - Et si on se calmait ?
Bartholomew the Ecumenical Patriarch
overview: Thirty-five years after his elevation to the throne of the Ecumenical Patriarchate, His All-Holiness Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew recounts his long journey from his birthplace, Imbros in the 1950s, to the Phanar and present-day Constantinople.

title: Upside Down
overview: After the loss of his most beloved, Ku the rabbit must face a new reality—literally turned upside down—accompanied by a magical being that will help him navigate his grief and the coldest winter of his life.

title: There's Something Beyond The Hill
overview: At a party, a girl tells a group of people an old tale about a boy who encounters a mysterious man carrying a lantern and a picnic basket on a rural road at night—an encounter that precedes strange events and a terrifying meeting.

title: Still Warm
overview: At 2:17 AM in a quiet izakaya, two women find an awakening of desire, sparked by a humble tamagoyaki. Moist, rolling, layering—a culinary rhythm that mirrors their fleeting yet fierce night together. As dawn breaks, the tamagoyaki takes its final shape, and both women quietly emerge transformed.

title: Bochincho - The Movie
overview: Based on the well-known poem by Jayme Caetano Braun, Bochincho, O Filme tells the story of an old man who, together with business partners, evokes his memories of a picturesque episode of his past in Rio Grande do Sul.

title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
overview: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

title: Mimosa
overview: In a utopian world where happiness is absolute, a suicide crisis threatens the very existence of humanity. As countless lives are lost and the global happiness index continues to decline, the AI Government assigns Mimosa the mission of restoring happiness and bringing population growth back to the world.  By chance, Mimosa encounters Ash, a man laughing at an advertisement featuring her face. Upon discovering that his happiness level is far below that of everyone else, she sets out to cure him. But as she delves deeper into Ash’s condition, Mimosa uncovers a key that could change the fate of their world forever.

title: Ubuntu Nation - The Voice of the Voiceless
overview: Created in 1994 with the goal of housing ten thousand people, the Dzaleka camp now has a population of 44,000 refugees. These are people fleeing political, religious, and ethnic conflicts in various countries, mostly the Democratic Republic of Congo. Living in poverty and victims of prejudice, the refugees are not allowed to leave the camp. Faced with this situation of abandonment, four young people came together to bring dignity, work, education, and above all, hope to the people of Dzaleka through the philosophy of Ubuntu.

title: Outsiders
overview: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

title: Rua 16
overview: Fed up with constant power outages caused by the utility company's negligence, the residents of Rua 16 decide to organize a collective effort to install solar panels and take control of their own electricity supply. However, internal disagreements and the fear of retaliation threaten the community's unity - even before the first panel is installed.

title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
overview: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

title: Chakkora: Lunar Love Bird
overview: Ravana Brahma, a carefree youngster, falls instantly in love with Julie and pursues her heart. When she mysteriously vanishes, he searches desperately to find her and uncover the secrets of her past.

title: Try Your Luck
overview: As a woman enters the elevator of her building, she finds a die lying on a board on top of a pedestal with the phrase TRY YOUR LUCK engraved on it. She soon realizes that it is only by using the die, and not the elevator buttons, that she can move between floors.

title: Mother Knows Best
overview: In the wake of a tragic accident, a mother's unwavering care pushes the limits of morality as she does whatever it takes to protect her son.

title: Your Daughter Looks Pretty
overview: A father/daughter hike is interrupted

title: SNOT
overview: A young woman gets sick and begins to panic as increasingly concerning things start coming out of her nose.

title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
overview: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

title: Short cuts : David Fincher's "The Game"
overview: David Fincher’s "The Game", reimagined in one minute and animated by Robinson Drosso.

title: Check and Worm
overview: Having become ruler, the Queen, generous yet naive, distributes the treasures of the Kingdom to anyone who asks. The experienced councillor however, has objections. A test of dance is held to prove the true intentions of the petitioners. Whoever dances with the greatest ease and grace will be seen as worthy, as this person’s movements are not hindered by the weight of stolen burdens and conscience. During the test, the Queen’s view of the world is irreversibly twisted.

title: Warm Blooded Animals
overview: Under vanilla skies, two dreamers lust for a life of freedom in a restless age of discontent. The young lovers stand at the precipice of adulthood, lingering on a stage in life where they could fade into oblivion or burst into flames.

title: Lamb of God
overview: A Youth Pastor's views on sexuality are put into question during an uncomfortable first date. When even more personal truth surfaces, he must decide if stepping outside familiar bounds is worth losing everything.

title: Shiina Ringo: Reiwa 8 Nationwide Tour
overview: Filmed at Tokyo's Sumida Triphony Hall on May 1, 2026, this concert captures Shiina Ringo with an exceptional ensemble of band musicians, a horn section, and a string quartet. Across a full-length performance from her Reiwa 8 Tootaikai tour, the arrangements balance precise detail with expansive live energy. The concert film brings the stage to cinema screens in stereo and Dolby Atmos, letting audiences experience the music with theatrical scale and sound.

title: SHOW/TIME
overview: In an aging tea house in Monga, Taiwan, a 93-year-old woman, regulars, attendants, and a stray cat share the rhythms of daily life.When a Japanese theater director enters, fiction seeps into reality, turning the tea house into a stage—a magical moment where life and performance intertwine.

title: Udgam: The Origin of Life
overview: Set in Chamba, the film follows community worker Rena and local farmers preserving indigenous seeds and traditional farming knowledge amid changing agriculture, water scarcity and uncertain rainfall. Their efforts reveal how seed conservation can protect biodiversity and support climate-resilient livelihoods.

title: Snared
overview: Join us on a journey around Auckland oceans and beaches, uncovering the impacts of fisheries on ocean ecosystems in New Zealand. Discover the balance we need to protect ocean life and appreciate the beauty of our marine life.

title: Grotesca
overview: Camila is a young woman tormented by cannibalistic thoughts. When one day her partner, Victoria, volunteers to satisfy that need, Camila is torn by an internal conflict that, in the days that follow, will make her oscillate between desire, love, and guilt, confronting the emotional roots of her compulsion in search of a decision.

title: PTI 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Celebrating the silver anniversary of Pardon the Interruption with a special double-episode event, marking a quarter-century of one of sports television's most enduring programs.

title: Dig OR Die
overview: America’s funniest home cryptid makes his return on film! This time, he must battle with a force that threatens to doom us all…

title: Distance
overview: Originally published in The Memory Palace by Nate DiMeo, Distance is a short-animated film that tells the story of Samuel Finley Breese Morse. His years as a painter, his personal story, and the path that led him to help shape one of the most important inventions in modern communication.  This project began as one of Ordinary Folk’s earliest passion pieces in 2020. It went through multiple visual explorations and experiments, guided by a long list of talented collaborators. The final film contains more than 900 hand-painted frames moving together to “create illusions of space and distance, to learn how to conjure the ineffable through the mere aggregation of lines and dots and stretch canvas.”

title: The Bible Camp Games
overview: Each year, young people come together at JCFilms Studios Film Camp to experience what it is really like to make a movie. They work alongside professional filmmakers and actors, learning about acting, directing, cameras, sound, production, and everything that happens behind the scenes. This film was created through that incredible experience and features actor Dean Cain.

title: Emiray: Macera Yolcusu
overview: A group of children playing in a library assemble a "Kündekâri" puzzle found in a package they receive. Completing the puzzle opens a time tunnel, sending the group to different locations. Emiray, Karaca, and Fatma go to a forested area inhabited by giants, while Zekai and Ruhi join a caravan journey in the desert. Set during Mevlana Celaleddin Rumi's childhood, these children, scattered to different places, try to understand the workings of their new dimension and solve the puzzle's loop to return to their own time.

title: Ghosts of the Gold Rush
overview: From the creators of Haunted Discoveries, Ghosts of the Gold Rush explores California’s darkest Gold Rush legends, from Hangtown’s violent past to a deadly mining disaster and asks whether history can leave something behind that never truly dies.

title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
overview: Ever since his mother moved to the city for work, Xiaoqing, who has lost his father, has had a dream: he too wants to go to the Lotus City. After many setbacks, his goal seems out of reach. But when he finds an old, rusty car in the reeds, he finds new hope: will he and his friends make it to the city?

title: Temporary Death
overview: A man films his second attempt at taking his own life as part of a dangerous experiment. After surviving his first death and inexplicably returning as someone else, he believes he can control who he becomes next. With two friends documenting everything under strict orders not to intervene, the experiment quickly spirals into something far more horrifying than any of them expected.

title: Nightblade
overview: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

title: 2 HOURS
overview: 2 HOURS is a zero-budget student short film about a workaholic who is so caught up in his work and goals that he slowly loses touch with the people and moments that actually matter.

title: Xianglian's Room
overview: Three children return home to visit their dying mother. The siblings argue endlessly over whether to remove life support, the inheritance, and matters of faith.

title: Flowers Bloom When Touched
overview: When a bride-to-be must prove her purity for her impending arranged marriage, she attempts the impossible: restoring her virginity.

title: Remote
overview: A lonely woman in a trailer watches live window views through webcams when she witnesses a murder. Armed with her tech expertise, she races to unmask the killer while staying alive.

title: Love Has Come to Town
overview: A series of vignetted conversations from strangers around Houston discussing the nature of a couple's relationship.

title: An Uninvited Neighbor
overview: Cho, a Korean immigrant in Paris, lives in a studio apartment that is suddenly invaded by Gregory, a pigeon born in Paris, who in sists on living with her. A heated argument unfolds about residency, permits, birth, and rights, and neither of them backs down. Or wins.

title: Fausse note
overview: In Paris, in 1990, an internationally renowned conductor gives his farewell concert at the Opéra-Comique. After the performance, an admirer manages to approach him. What seemed to be a chance encounter gradually transforms into a tense confrontation, revealing a long-buried shared past. As the night unfolds, memory, guilt, and the quest for justice resurface.

title: The Chip
overview: An insignificant image goes viral and changes everything…

title: Of Times There Were Before
overview: Of Times There Were Before is a portrait of Romila Thapar, one of the world’s most influential historians and public intellectuals. At ninety-four, having lived through much of the making of modern India, she stands at an unusual distance from the past she has spent a lifetime studying. The film began with a simple question: who is the person behind the historian’s name? Shot at her home in New Delhi, it is an attempt to encounter Thapar beyond the authority of her work and the public image built around it. What emerges is a portrait of a life still in conversation with its own time.

title: What if I never went into space?
overview: For years, my anxiety and I have been travelling everywhere, even going as far as outer space.

title: Seyran Ateş: Sex, Revolution and Islam
overview: The exemplary humanitarian work of Turkish-German radical feminist, lawyer, and imam, Seyran Ateş is the central focus of this compelling and revealing documentary. As a young Muslim girl in Berlin, Seyran grew up experiencing Islamic repression. Since then, she has dedicated herself to reforming Islam, opening the first mosque with no gender segregation and educating and empowering LGBTQ Muslim youth to embrace their sexuality. The film reveals a determined woman, one willing to put her life on the line in the name of religious reform and sexual freedom.

title: The Good Life
overview: The Good LIfe is based on the best-selling book by Drs. Robert Waldinger and Marc Schulz, directors of the Harvard Study of Adult Development, colloquially known as the “Harvard Happiness Study.” It’s the world’s longest running scientific study of happiness, initiated in 1938. The film follows five characters - Sabih Mir, a doorman who is just confronting retirement; Chris Taylor, a young dancer with the Alvin Ailey company, who is trying to understand what it means to age when your body is your livelihood and identity; D'yan Forest, a 91 yr old comedian, the world's oldest according to the Guiness book of records; Sally Quinn - journalist, novelist, and wife of the legendary Washington Post editor, Ben Bradlee; and John and Jay, two men in their 60s who have just adopted a young boy. All of them are trying to understand what it means to get older, or as we see it, to grow up. Featuring appearances by Rita Moreno, Susie Essman, Bernie Williams and Neil de Grasse Tyson.

title: Kitzel
overview: Two fluffy creatures play together affectionately, but their frolics soon turn uncomfortable, as cuddling becomes a free-for-all and boundaries are crossed.

title: Krunegård: Let's Fill Half of the Globe
overview: Markus Krunegård's celebrated show at Avicii Arena in October 2025 had the humble tagline "Let's fill half of the Globe". The show however, was anything but humble. Together with his band and guests such as Mauro Scocco and Miriam Bryant, Krunegård lines up new and old classics from his treasured box of songs. Everything performed with the unstoppable energy which has made him one of Sweden's finest live acts.

title: Wendehorn
overview: Tara is lead to a sacred forest after reading the Necronomicon. It it there that she is stalked by a creature that roams the woods and protects it's land and property.

title: Harry Goes to Hell!
overview: That lovable furry character, Harry the Hare in it for his next silly adventure... ETERNAL DAMNATION!!!!

title: Not from here (Not from there)
overview: Young people from different parts of Chile share their experiences of moving to and living in the capital, Santiago, reflecting on the challenges, opportunities, and personal journeys along the way

title: The Longing
overview: A couple running a restaurant hires young people who have been released from juvenile detention to help them reintegrate into society. The 18-year-old Yuto is keen to start a new life with their help.

title: Mom's Blues
overview: A small provincial town. A young doctor's morning begins with an anxious knock at the window. A panicked woman reports that her child is dying. The doctor rushes to help and discovers signs of abuse on the child's body. An investigation begins, and the doctor is drawn into the dark depths of a family tragedy.

title: Pani Vizhum Iravu
overview: During a trip to a century-old Kodaikanal bungalow, JK reports his lover Shabi mysteriously missing, triggering a tense police inquiry entangled with an unsolved murder, suspicious staff, and local thieves. However, as the investigation deepens, the boundary between reality and illusion shatters, exposing a harrowing confrontation with unresolved grief, guilt, and the fragile human mind.

title: Kintsugi… e sono la mia opera
Bathin
overview: Bathin is a horror short film that shows how a man surrenders his body to a malevolent god who watches him and manifests as the sun. With a gaze that unsettles and exhausts, Bathin seeks terror under the all-seeing light of the sun.

title: Midnight Nostalgia
overview: Tartu seems to breathe differently. 57-year old Maarja, a former violinist of the famous estonian punk band Vennaskond goes through the nightly city like a ghost, embodying Tartu’s bohemian spirit.

title: An Evening With Olivia Rodrigo
overview: In conjunction with the exhibit opening of “Olivia Rodrigo: the cure unraveled,” the Grammy Museum is thrilled to welcome three-time Grammy Award-winning artist Olivia Rodrigo to the Museum’s Ray Charles Rooftop Terrace for an evening celebrating and discussing her newest critically acclaimed album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love, her creative process, career, upcoming tour, and more. Attendees will have an opportunity to enjoy rooftop views, a café with food, and a cash bar prior and will have the chance to view the exhibit post-program.

title: Stray Girls
overview: A story from a working-class neighborhood in New Delhi, about a girl’s rebellion and it taking an unexpected magical turn.

title: ZOKUZOKU: Uncanny Layouts
overview: In a house in an area known as “Old Sakaizuka”, a series of inexplicable incidents begins with the appearance of a room that should not even exist. Through property photographs, personal testimony, social media posts, livestream footage and an institutional investigation, five different records gradually reconstruct what happened there. Each perspective reveals another fragment, yet the more the events are documented, the less reliable reality becomes.

title: Heartless
overview: The second volume of 'The Seasons' based on the poem 'Heartless' by Jaylan Salah.

title: Dazing Gaze
overview: A Grindr match sends two men from Singapore across the border for a night away from prying eyes—but something shifts as their gaze turns inwards onto themselves.

title: Une vie pour l'art : Gustave Fayet, artiste et collectionneur de la modernité
Behind the Paint: The Story of Slaughtered Goat
overview: Retrieved from archival footage, this documentary details the most tumultuous moments in the history of the infamous metal band 'Slaughtered Goat'...

title: LOUF
overview: In his debut feature documentary, Aziz Zoromba follows acclaimed chef Fadi Kattan and Canadian co-venturer Nicole Mankinen as they race to open a Palestinian restaurant in Toronto. While their dream takes shape, escalating attacks devastate Gaza and the West Bank. Part immersive food film and part urgent record, LOUF is a powerful meditation on diaspora, resistance, and the politics of preservation.

title: Mother's Love
overview: Sofía returns to her hometown seeking closure with her comatose ex-boyfriend, Paco, and to announce her upcoming marriage. But her visit takes a sinister turn when Paco's obsessive mother, Margarita, imprisons her and forces her into the role of her son's wife. As Sofía fights to escape, she uncovers a dark secret that threatens to unravel their lives and seal the fate of all three forever.

title: Broken English Theater
overview: Broken English Theater is a documentary-style comedy that revisits the bizarre legacy of Gerardo Directori, a Buenos Aires theater director who, in the early 2000s, ran a company dedicated to staging "educational" plays in English for language students, despite not speaking the language himself.

title: Tale of Tails
overview: Teenage girls draw in a picturesque field. Loner Jimin feels that her chance has come when Minji, the popular girl everyone adores, is bitten by a venomous snake.

title: Ciggie NO Biggie
overview: A Cigarette creates a rift between two long-lost friends at the night of their reunion. But the Cigarette chooses its own fate.

title: Why Did You Stop Me?
overview: A night-shift officer stops a car with no plates. The driver, a strange young woman, turns the routine stop very dark. Captured on bodycam.

title: The First Silence
overview: A gaslit woman battles with her memory of events.

title: Moscow Cairo
overview: In the 90s, and following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the resulting conflicts, four Russian girls travel to Egypt and start to mingle in the Egyptian society, developing a shared admiration towards it in a way that makes them unwilling to return to their homeland.

title: RUSSIA
overview: Shot on a single roll of Super 8mm film, with no editing or retakes, RUSSIA follows a poor young man from the Egyptian countryside as he confronts a haunting memory of his past and the lingering weight of his actions. Inspired by Emad Abu Saleh’s poem “Killer.”

title: On the Wings of Time
overview: Two college graduates grapple the progression of time.

title: Lona's Home
overview: For her birthday, Lona (9) received a teddy bear she named Moka. The bond between Lona and Moka filled a void left by her parents—Mama (34) and Papa (35)—whose busy work schedules kept them occupied. Moka remained a steadfast companion to Lona until the day the bear disappeared just as the family was reuniting, ultimately helping to restore the harmony that had once been lost.

title: Plastic Love!
overview: A pop-infused dive into Japan's love of packaging―and how it might hold the key to escaping a plastic-wrapped future.

title: Chloe
overview: An experimental short film that explores fragile relationship between memory, identity, and desire to preserve what time inevitably takes from us.

title: República Da Traição: O Filme Nunca Lançado
Hot Dirty Blood!
overview: Two friends wake up in the desert and try to piece together what happened the night before.

title: Little Pieces
overview: Alice returns to her estranged aunt's home to collect family photographs after her death. This simple errand unearths a buried family secret, pieced together from fragmented visions and stilted conversations with her mother. Reeling from the discovery, Alice reflects on what we inherit from our families and what we release.

title: Lost Tape
overview: A videotape capturing the final moments of an amateur urban exploration group, who break into the long abandoned home of an unsolved murder.

title: The Jade Stallion
overview: At a small-town liquor store, a longtime manager struggles to maintain his authority over a younger employee as the balance of power between them begins to shift.

title: Rancho Mirage
overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: When We Become Wind
overview: The third installment of Tux and Fanny

title: La Niña Perfecta
overview: A clash between a brother and sister over their dying father unearths a dark secret from their childhood.

When a young woman receives mysterious phone calls from her future self, she is given the chance to ask three questions about the life ahead of her. Unsure what to ask or what the calls might mean, she must decide how much of her future she truly wants to know.

title: The Vending Machine at the End of the World
overview: Minutes before an asteroid impact that will wipe out humanity, three friends decide the last thing they want to do before they die is get a bag of chips from a nearby vending machine.

title: Kill The DJ
overview: Diamond, a fierce underground DJ, gets an impromptu gig at a mysterious nightclub owned by the suspicious Miss Linda. However upon arrival, Diamond’s next big DJ set becomes a fight for survival in a nightclub that devolves into a house of horrors.

title: Dream Suicide
overview: A collection of films expressing dream suicide. Assembled by Dillon Hammi.

title: Cathodic Descent
overview: An analog horror short film by melon_manga. Inspired by films from the MUBI Fest Buenos Aires 2026 lineup.

title: Kissyfoot
overview: When Laura joins therapy and bemoans her misshapen leg, all Megan can see is a cute little foot. A ‘kissyfoot’ is what her critical husband would call it. As their friendship develops, Megan offers a simple, grisly solution that will make them both feel complete.

title: Allure of the Flesh
overview: When three witches move into a suburban neighbourhood, a conservative mother fears that her son will be seduced by their darkness.

title: Waves of Silence
overview: Between helping his mother run her hotel and looking after his birds, Amon who is deaf, feels an immediate connection with new water delivery man, Roberto, as best friend Daniella sets her eyes on him also.

title: Reap What You Sew
overview: A horribly disfigured man awakens and tracks down the doctor who made him a monster, killing all who stand in his bloody path.

title: How to Walk
overview: A short film by Concept Korea 2027 S/S in collaboration with 2X9HD.

title: Some Reddish Work
overview: Set in the 1600s, a group of women are filled with an uncontrollable desire to run, touch, and tear themselves apart

title: The Myth of Sisyphus
overview: As the world is ending and people across Los Angeles quietly vanish into blinding light, two teenagers journey to a radio tower to send a final broadcast, while a young man and his grandmother confront what it means to be the last ones left.

title: Closed Mouths
overview: Stuck in a loop regarding his career, financial well-being, and ability to reach life’s milestones, an aspiring screenwriter is forced to confront the realities of choosing his passion over practicalities. A tale as old as time for creative workers, this film ponders the choices we make for ourselves and others.

title: Who's Going to Fix Transit?
overview: In the wake of Ottawa's 2026 Mayoral Election, four of the major candidates are asked how they will fix the capital city's crumbling transit system, and prevent things from getting worse.

title: SANDIWARA
overview: Wahyu, the child of an officer, joins a protest where his father, Rama, is on duty, thereby jeopardizing their father-child relationship.

title: We'll see each other again, right?
The Children of Rustoord
overview: Heusdensebaan in Oisterwijk is now home to Hotel De Leyhof, but the site was once occupied by Rustoord Children’s Home. From 1927 onwards, the home provided shelter for children from families facing difficulties, for example when a parent had died or a mother was unable to care for all her children. The home was run by the Sisters of Charity. In 1975, Rustoord closed its doors.

title: The Life of Rose
overview: After a phone call with her grandmother, a granddaughter returns home for the holidays. Through their intimate conversations, two generations explore different perspectives on life, death, and what it means to cherish the time we have.

title: First Taste
overview: An extended family rises up to defend a young girl from a monster.

title: Mysticisme du Sud
overview: Three friends search for a magic lake that mysteriously appeared in South Tunisia. While some people think it could be a curse, others believe that this appearance exists because of local practices and occult rituals. People search for it, seeking the prophetic qualities it is said to possess. Between tales, strange visions and possession, we get through a region that is still searching for something more.

title: Patawater
overview: Having to write this overview in english for a film that will hardly leave spanish viewers sucks.

title: The Hollow
overview: After a botched robbery, Malik and Shad return to The Hollow with an unexpected presence in tow. As a detective closes in, secrets begin to surface.

title: Death Valley: El valle de la muerte
The Art of Walking
overview: Years after the loss of her best friend, Lorena returns to her hometown searching for meaning in her life and emotions.

title: Hello October: from Sam
overview: The nights are getting longer. The pumpkins are ripe. And the dead know what time it is.  Hello, October.

title: What It Takes
overview: Gaspar, an obsessive theatre director, sees his work threatening his relationship with Lola, who dreams of making a living from her music but is gradually giving up hope. Meanwhile, Victor, his childhood friend, who is involved in drug trafficking, is caught up in a disturbing series of murders.

title: Last Two Braincells
overview: A group of comedic and idiotic young men come together to do dangerous, disgusting and hilarious stunts, pranks and more. All with one goal in mind, to drop themselves down to their Last Two Braincells…

title: Douvina
overview: The film is a silent invitation to contemplation: on the winding paths of preserving memory, on what slips through our fingers in the present, and on our own place in the face of the departure of those we love, the disappearance of places, and the subtle marks we leave along the way.

title: Un uomo si alza dal letto
Antrian Nomor Kematian
overview: Nur rushes her critically ill father to a referral hospital, only to find herself trapped in a grueling battle against rigid bureaucracy. Amidst this agonizing delay, her father's condition rapidly deteriorates.

title: A Woman Dancing on the Waves
overview: Choi Se-dam's grandmother, Yoon Young-ja, wanted to write a novel titled A Woman Dancing on the Waves. She spent her life as a shaman, building the family up from nothing. But she never managed to write the novel and eventually forgot who the 'woman dancing on the waves' was. Making her grandmother, who is gradually losing her memory, the protagonist, Choi unfolds a strange and remarkable family history.

title: Remedy for a Broken Faith
overview: A journal entry brought to life, a woman explores grief and what remains of herself in the aftermath of loss. After years of numbing herself against emotions like anger and sadness, a moment of jealousy triggers new reflections and a journey of self-discovery. Or rather, re-discovery. In finding the courage to admit her feelings to herself, she recovers her strength to hope.

title: Insane Lightning in a Strange Bottle
overview: The story of West Michigan's The Rocky Road Shadow Cast.

title: Zeitgeist
overview: Five friends get together to make live videos in hopes of going viral and making money, but when it doesn't work, they decide to take a more extreme path, unleashing a power game led by the chat.

title: War Fun
overview: The documentary film WAR FUN explores the deeply human, yet taboo, role that humor and joy can play in war. Based on the research project War and Fun: Reconceptualizing Warfare and Its Experience (WARFUN) at the Chr. Michelsen Institute in Bergen, the film follows Professor Antonio De Lauri and his team of researchers as they investigate the experience of war from the perspective of those who fight. The research project aims to bridge the gap between the narrative and the reality of war.

title: Band Practice
overview: A New Orleans majorette and her band geek best friend attempt to check item #1 off their senior year bucket list: KISS GIRLS

title: Concrete Cowboy
overview: Jack, a wannabe cowboy flees to New York City to escape his past. But when his former gang members Ricky and Helen Hatchet come to town, they make sure that task ain't so easy.

title: When you leave, it will be night
overview: Nicolò joins a rehab facility to support his uncle Matteo during his final month there. As they navigate the community's daily routines and their own complex relationship, an unaddressed past guilt resurfaces, forcing them to confront deep family trauma and blurring the line between who is saving whom.

title: The Prince and the Kaiser – Yves Saint Laurent and Karl Lagerfeld
overview: At the International Wool Secretariat competition, 18-year-old Yves Saint Laurent and 21-year-old Karl Lagerfeld are honoured. Whilst Saint Laurent takes over Dior shortly afterwards and founds his own label, Lagerfeld becomes a master of constant reinvention. The former friends become bitter rivals, not least because of Jacques de Bascher, Lagerfeld’s flamboyant partner, who also comes dangerously close to Saint Laurent.

title: A Thrift Story
overview: It’s Amy’s last day at the no-name thrift store where she works, but she’s got one last difficult customer to deal with.

title: Carolina Blue
overview: On the cusp of adulthood, A 19-year-old woman who keeps putting off her life is forced into action when her grandfather stops putting off his, setting her on a journey to find him.

title: A Voz de Todos – Jornal do Fundão
The Blue Skies of Haru
overview: In this personal documentary, L.A. Alfonso turns images gathered on his phone into an encounter with memory, discovering that love has been the impulse behind his constant filming. Told through a voice reading the filmmaker’s words and composed for the vertical frame, the film explores family, distance, and the possibility of holding cinema in your hand.

title: Thicker Than Water
overview: Two estranged best friends find a way to reconnect after they discover a regenerative wine and begin testing its limits on each other.

title: I Dreamed of a Man Who Dreamed of Horses
The Compromise
overview: When a rising executive cancels their trip for another work obligation, her husband's hurt breaks open a marriage in which neither knew what the other was carrying.

title: Captivity
overview: Violence, obsession, and survival intersect in this confrontation between victim and predator... where only one can emerge unscathed.

title: AQUILEANO
overview: Upon encountering his new neighbor, Miguel realizes that something within him doesn't seem to make sense. Over time, his feelings become clearer, and the boy finally summons the courage to change.

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: Menino Ávio
overview: After a heated family confrontation, Otávio runs away from home in the dead of night and crosses the city toward the local gay nightclub. Amid hazy lights and dreamlike encounters, he embarks on a spiritual journey that reshapes the way he sees himself.

title: 36 Hour Walk
overview: A college student attempts to walk from his dorm room in midtown Manhattan to the end of Long Island in 36 hours. Legyaan Thapa directs “36 Hour Walk,” a personal documentary of a half-hearted journey built with wry, self-deprecating commentary. Vowing not to eat or sleep for a day and a half, the man sets off on his trip. For what reason? He figures he’ll discover that along the way. But soon, he’s hit with setbacks, poor planning, frustration, boredom, and physical pain. The hours wear on, exhaustion sets in, and the challenge reaches its conclusion. It’s an entertaining ode to lofty pursuits and half-assed follow through, built with shaky, lo-fi visuals and an affably lackadaisical attitude.

title: Merge
overview: Merge follows Ari, a young woman in her 20's who decides to step outside of her comfort zone through an acting class. While there, she meets an interesting group of students led by their enigmatic teacher, Joy, who challenges Ari to harness her deepest fears in order to peak vulnerability in performance.  Through an exercise with a self-assured partner named Nicholas, Ari is forced to lean into the unconventional teaching methods of the class, and her initial disbelief in the process transforms into a love for power and honesty.

title: Samasta Allegra
overview: Allegra is transported to a world where vegetables, the thing she hates the most, can speak. She meets Dewi Sri, a sorceress that is slowly losing her power. Allegra needs to help Dewi Sri before this magical vegetable world vanishes.

title: Wyppyd
overview: A serial sexual abuser given the moniker of "Whipping Tom," has been sentence to be exiled, but a vengeful nun inflicts a series of humiliating physical punishments onto the misogynistic scoundrel.

title: Static
overview: After a sudden solar storm disables technology across the globe, a young woman and her estranged father are trapped in an isolated farmhouse.

title: Heart in Your Throat
overview: Marina is thirteen and alone. After her grandfather's suicide, she wants to disappear, wishing her imagination could be real.

title: Betty
overview: Upon discovering her grandmother Betty’s poems, Oriana attempts to piece together her image in order to understand her own identity. Delving into her family’s past, she reflects on legacy, family, and absence. What remains of us when we leave?

title: ACROSS: Anatomy of the Forgotten War
overview: Scene 1: Cannelle, a human rights lawyer based in Berlin, is pursuing a case on war crimes in Yemen at the European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights (ECCHR). Scene 2: In Sardinia, Italy, STOP RWM activists continue their campaign against the illegal expansion of the German arms manufacturer RWM on the island and its arms exports. Scene 3: Jamal, a former civil servant in Yemen, arrives with his family in Jeju after fleeing the Houthi rebels. Linking Europe, the Middle East, and Korea, these three scenes, which evoke the opening of a large-scale political thriller, arouse both tension and curiosity. At their intersection lies the (forgotten) war in Yemen.

title: My Only Friend
overview: Lucas, a shy and introverted boy, is forced to interact with his classmates on a school project. He writes in his diary that Fernanda, his only friend, is the one who helps him get through a chaotic night.

title: I Think You're Hurting Them
overview: Through a series of real and imagined memories, a mourning woman reflects on her life and the person in the mirror that she doesn’t recognize.

title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming
overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.

title: Twisted Tie: The Movie
overview: An intoxicating office romance begins when Kang Do-jin, a perfectionist team leader at a VVIP spatial design agency, and Lee Sun-woo, a rookie who admires him, cross the line during a rainy night shift. Do-jin tries to control Sun-woo through secret "hands-on tutoring," but their dynamic shifts when sly client manager Baek Yi-geon intervenes, stirring intense jealousy and possessiveness between them.

title: Bea Arthur: The Documentary
overview: An intimate portrait of the actress celebrated for "Maude," "The Golden Girls" and "Mame." Built around a previously unseen interview conducted by producer and director Dan Watt, the film traces Arthur’s path from The New School and New York theatre to Broadway and television. Through Arthur’s own reflections and interviews with colleagues and close friends, the documentary looks beyond the tall, hilariously brassy public persona to reveal a woman who was also sensitive, vulnerable, compassionate and deeply committed to the people and causes she valued.

title: Moroccan Mint
overview: A gruff piano teacher is forced to confront his deeply buried grief when an energetic new student begins to break through the distance he keeps between himself and others.

title: Damned Old People
overview: Viejos Malditos is a sharp drama with a touch of dark humor that introduces us to Elías, a recently widowed, gruff, and ill-tempered old man who thought life couldn’t get any worse... until the cat arrived. Sick, exhausted, and stuck in his worst streak, Elías must not only cope with his inevitable decline but also with a scruffy, noisy feline that has decided to turn his nights—and those of the entire neighborhood—into a hellish concert of meows.

title: AKIAK
overview: A young indigenous woman in 1860's Alaska crosses paths with an injured bandit, who is being hunted by someone from the woman's past.

title: Do Not Rewind
overview: Trapped in a windowless room with only a VHS tape for company, Eden must decode the cryptic warnings of her predecessor, Jess, to escape a stalker's twisted psychological prison before she becomes his next victim.

title: Pneumothorax
overview: After a fortune-teller predicts her downfall, Aurora, a rising actress, commits a crime in an attempt to prevent it from happening. As she tries to justify her actions, Aurora spirals into guilt and paranoia.

title: Satanic Panic
overview: Four RPG players in the 80s are about to get a dose of satanic panic

title: Bradley Walsh's Million Pound Shot
overview: A brand-new quiz where contestants can win a million. But there's one huge secret twist in a night of drama, tension and life-changing outcomes. Would you take the shot?

title: Skondhokata
overview: A headless terror roams the dense darkness of the lonely night! Mystery in every shadow, fear creeping in every silent moment!

title: Xa lyu-k'ya | Un Mundo de Cerros
Volklore
overview: Volklore is an experimental video essay that explores the transformation of Czech folklore in the digital age of social networks. In a hyper-stylised influencer universe, traditions become a tool of marketing and commodification, remixed into seasonal trends, spectacle, and viral content.

title: Wild is the Wind
overview: After years gone, Ana returns to her village due to the death of her father. Her intention is to leave after his funeral but she feels the need to stay, fueled by the intention of a power company to install a wind farm that divides the neighbors and affects her family’s land. Her participation in this conflict draws her back into the life of the community. A process in which Ana questions her sense of belonging, evokes a painful past and discovers a fighting spirit that she did not know she had.

title: On a Bright Blessed Day
overview: Gita, an island woman traumatized by the sea, urges her fiancé Dama—a fisherman—to become a tour guide. Caught between the land and the sea, the two must choose one.

title: The Stage
overview: A personal assistant for her stage director father, Carrie Russell yearns for the stage. Her father unfortunately is unimpressed. With auditions being held for her father's final production and a rising star going for the role, Carrie takes her shot.

title: Rich Spalding: One Day, Like This
overview: Rich Spalding's debut comedy special, 'One Day, Like This'. Recorded at The Bill Murray, London, on the 26th of January 2026.

title: The Black Rock
overview: Summer, 1940. The Battle of Britain is lost. Operation Sea Lion is now in full effect. Germany invades the coast of Britain, only several fortresses are left standing in the defence against tyranny. Amongst the chaos, two enemy soldiers find themselves trapped in one such fortress together.

title: American Showdown 8 - Eine wahre Geschichte
overview: In the 1990s, five boys from East Berlin discover a passion for American action movies. They begin filming their own seven-part action series, "American Showdown"—shooting "guerilla-style" without permits. Years later, now adults, they reunite to revive their dream. They shoot the eighth installment of the series just as they did back then: on a shoestring budget and with plenty of passion. However, their ambitions and expectations have grown, and the filmmaking process puts their friendship to the ultimate test.

title: Camp Carnage
overview: In 1981, a slasher film titled “Camp Carnage” was set for release before being mysteriously cancelled. Now, 45 years later, the first surviving footage has been uncovered.

title: Lizzie
overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

title: A Semiotic Square for Violent Bear
overview: What does our culture dream? How can we locate that dream within the logics which govern our lives? Half collage, half essay, half serious, “A Semiotic Square for Violent Bear” is a busy, referential riff on the political moment.

title: Some Other Place
overview: Esther is back in her rural Utah hometown with one intent only: to break into her parents' house. She desperately needs her identifying documents in order to legally change her name and gender before it’s made illegal. Along the way she recruits her old friend and only ally in town - Markus - to assist her. Between the break-in and navigating Markus's intentions, she doesn't intend to stay long.

title: My Happy End
overview: All dogs chase their tails. A dog once succeeds in catching his own tail. That changes his life as he finds his best friend in it.

title: Bitter Sweet
overview: After two girl's friendship falls apart days before Christmas, one of the girls decides to rekindle their friendship through the sweetest gift.

title: One Point Perspective
overview: A graduating film student is jealous of his school's new resources.

title: Whispers of Thunder
overview: Whispers of Thunder is a Bhutanese anthology capturing the quiet rumblings and malaise of youth in the capital city. A man secretly yearns to cross-dress, while a drifting young woman finds herself tangled in indecision. Two roommates go through the rhythms of city life, quietly contemplating a sense of being left behind. Another young woman slips into a fragile psychological landscape where reality and illusion begin to blur, and in the final story, a young vlogger follows a rapper who navigates the absurd frustrations of everyday life.

title: Cowboy Stories
overview: A studio photographer in the midst of a complicated divorce tells stories of heartbreak, drinking and loss to his teenage son, slowly revealing his attachment to these memories and a plan to find an old girlfriend from his past. Loosely inspired by Sam Shepard's book Motel Chronicles.

title: Ruhaani Ishq
overview: Ruhaani Ishq is a passionate love story where love faces family conflicts, rivalry and fate, taking two hearts through romance, sacrifice, heartbreak and unforgettable moments.

title: To the Last Drop
overview: Plagued by nightmares, Joel is handed an impossible assignment. The Boss wants a new fix, but in the ruined world there is nothing left to collect. Wandering across the apocalyptic wasteland, Joel stumbles upon sunburnt Maarit, who decides to tag along. Back at HQ, The Boss, wracked by withdrawal, gives Joel an earful, while Maarit unexpectedly takes matters into her own hands.

title: Wanderer
overview: WANDERER is a religious action thriller set in an alternate, dystopian future where the United States has been disbanded and divided into eight individual factions. A lone wanderer journeys across these factions, carrying a forbidden item: a Holy Bible. Hunted relentlessly by faction leaders and their military forces, the Wanderer uses the Word of God to spread hope among the oppressed citizens and fight back against the evil forces controlling them.

title: The Man and the Tree
overview: The mango tree in Milton "Papa" Kāne"s backyard has been rooted to his family since the day he was born, his piko planted lovingly beneath it. Now facing a terminal illness, and city enforcement demanding the tree"s removal — more costs his family can"t carry — Papa takes matters into his own hands. Before anyone else can decide the tree"s fate, he gives it, and himself, a send-off no one saw coming.

title: This Shirt Used to Be Blue
overview: Something is terribly wrong when Gordon finds his blue shirt is now yellow. As the malaise of customer service calls and boardroom meetings take hold, he is horrified to find his waking reality crumbling, and a modern evil waiting for him in his dreams.

title: Tambu
overview: Tambuisa is a documentary exploring TambuFest, a day-long celebration of drumming and dance in Jamaica. TambuFest was conceived and produced by University of Pennsylvania anthropologist Deborah A. Thomas, musician Junior “Gabu” Wedderburn, and Dr. Nicholas Ferguson, a medical doctor and drummer. The word “tambu” is used throughout the African Diaspora to describe various drumming traditions and styles.

title: T.P.I.D. (The Priest is Dead)
overview: a priest is found dead inside his church, a newcomer becomes suspicious when the congregation greets his death with smiles instead of grief, leading him to uncover a disturbing secret.

title: Vertigo
overview: When Federico invites his friends Vera and Nico to try a mysterious new drug, the experiment quickly turns into a disorienting psychological journey. As the substance takes effect, reality begins to fracture and hidden tensions emerge. Between hallucinations and memories, the three friends are forced to confront the fragile boundaries between perception and truth.

title: The Last Transmission
overview: At an undisclosed location in a decaying future, “Last Transmission Live” briefs international treasures before sending them to the stars to represent the human race. When KEVIN ELSON becomes the 34th guest, a mysterious nearby local begins to track him  down.

title: You Don't Know My Name
overview: Separated from his incarcerated mother at birth, the filmmaker searches for her identity and uncovers deep ancestral bloodlines. As he gets closer to this life-altering truth, he navigates his way through systems designed to keep him in the dark.

title: Heart of the Lion
overview: Moving between life in London and Hong Kong, this film follows Kelvin Chan, a British-born Chinese lion dancer, as he explores how the routines and rituals of a creative, spiritual practice may provide their own sense of belonging.

title: Hazard Perception
overview: An expectant father and a woman haunted by her fear of driving spark an unexpected connection while waiting to be called in for their driving test.

title: Tacho Driver
overview: Gustavo Caymaris is a Taxi Driver in Montevideo, Uruguay.

title: PRANKS
overview: Follow the misadventures of Mike and Bren in their attempts to prank their school.

title: Rage
overview: A man ventures into a snowy forest seeking his wife.

title: The Sealed Box
overview: A single mother and magazine editor, distant from her grade-obsessed daughter, takes on an interview with an expatriate animation director, which brings back a long-forgotten childhood memory: a mysterious box that turns children into puppets and seals away their innocence.

title: Ehrlich Brothers – No Limits – The Grand Stadium Show
overview: The multi-award-winning magic duo ‘The Ehrlich Brothers’ have ushered in a new era of magic with their extraordinary illusions. Their shows represent magic at its very best, with the easy-going and likeable magician brothers, Chris and Andreas Ehrlich, captivating audiences of all ages.

title: Hello Debus
overview: A father makes requests on the answering machine of his son, who’s so paralysed he’s become a veritable still life. Overwhelmed, helpless; an absurd transformation begins.

title: Seven Days of Happiness
overview: Prokopiy, a 27-year-old boy with developmental disabilities, lives with his strict mother, Maria, who keeps him locked away for his own "safety." Life goes on as usual in a remote Yakut village until Prokopiy's cheerful sister, Aiyyna, arrives next door. She gives him warmth, attention, and a sense of "normality," and a simple, pure friendship blossoms between them, which becomes a revelation for the boy. Aiyyna leads him out of his locked room, takes him on a sleigh ride to a party, and for the first time makes him feel part of the outside world. But the closer Prokopiy gets to freedom, the more conflicts he has with his mother, who fears losing control and may not be able to protect her son from the pain society can inflict on him. A touching, harsh, and poetic coming-of-age story about a man who emerges from the safety of a locked world to an ambiguous freedom.

title: Dear Candidate,
overview: Uki, a Visual Communication Design fresh graduate who is still unemployed, suddenly receives an unexpected online job interview with no time to prepare. Living in a remote plantation area with poor signal, he must search for a stable connection while dealing with frustrating miscommunication with an impatient HR representative, all in hopes of passing the interview and securing a job.

title: Handmade Animation
overview: “Monitos a Mano” brings together three Chilean animated short films produced by Pista B: El Tamagochi Escarlata (Dir. Francisco Visceral, Screenplay by Ignacio Socías), Merrimundi (Dir. Niles Atallah) and Ánima del Amanecer (Dir. María Ignacia Hargreaves and Guillermo Arias)

title: The Variety
overview: Jin-hwa, a screenwriter in her mid-thirties, still cannot escape what happened 25 years ago. In her childhood, she was slapped by her gym teacher for no reason, and she has since been plagued by tinnitus and hallucinations.

title: The Guardian
overview: A young security guard begins his first night shift at an abandoned condominium slated for demolition. To survive until dawn, he must document the night with a video recorder and strictly follow a list of unsettling rules recorded on a cell phone by the previous guard. As the hours pass, he confronts paranormal events and spectral presences.

title: Heroic: Sabin Howard Sculpts the National WWI Memorial
overview: Imagine watching Michelangelo paint the Sistine Chapel. HEROIC is a heart-palpitating behind-the-scenes look into the studio of Master Sculptor Sabin Howard as he races a deadline to complete a lifetime project in just 4 years: with the world watching. One sculptor's brute force talent in the face of an impossible task-- a visionary punching up through the bureaucracy. It's not just about the art: sculpting serves the world in honoring veterans. Conflict in the studio: everybody gives everything. Love, betrayal, treachery. Who will rise and who will fall?

title: Liberate Us From Our Fears
overview: Four young adults attempt to overcome their greatest fears through a ritual. However, they underestimate the dangers of exposing themselves to forces they cannot understand or control.

title: Erased from the Map
overview: A man tells a journalist about the photos and memories from his childhood in home and village that will soon disappear for the new national capital city. With his brother, he returns to the places they once played, taking pictures and recreating stories as if the land was still the same.

title: Doris
overview: In July of 1979, 4 college students disappeared in the woods near Forks, WA. 10 years later their Super 8 camera was discovered,  and the footage was developed.

title: Bernd - Operation Germanenkind
overview: An in-depth look at how fascism hides behind facades of a tolerant, intellectual and open-minded society.

title: Shadows
overview: What begins as rehearsal becomes revelation when two young women discover that performance can reveal truths the script never intended.

title: Boiler Room No. 1
overview: Two young friends working on a steam ship, where nobody gets off, both aspire to be promoted to the coveted boiler room no. 1, which unbeknownst to them hides a dark secret.

title: Immortal Enemies
overview: A band retreats to a remote Appalachian cabin to record their new album, but their getaway takes a horrifying turn when they uncover the mountain's malignant past.

title: Delia
overview: An emotionally suppressed office worker caught in a supermarket hold-up finds an unexpected way to intervene, using dance to disarm the situation.

title: Run Koala Run
overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

title: Our friendship goes far beyond these experiences and recordings
Catenaria
overview: Ángela has until 9.00 pm to get hold of the money she needs. In desperation, she scours the city in search of a solution, facing a reality that has rendered her invisible.

title: Ponytail
overview: Laleh, a 35-year-old midwife, arrives at the home of Akhtar, a pregnant woman, to examine her. Against her own wishes, she removes the stillborn fetus and saves Akhtar’s life, only to discover that the house might be haunted by supernatural entities.

title: What to Say
overview: A crowd. A touch. Uncertainty. What now? Tereza finds herself in a room full of people, unsure of what to say, even though she feels so much inside. Words fail her, but her inner world is vivid and alive. Through a variety of textile materials, the film gives shape to her unspoken emotions and sensory experiences, transforming fabric into a language of its own. It is a story about the quiet struggle and gentle courage of searching for closeness.

title: Goruden Awa
overview: The sun is forever setting in Tokyo and Taro leaves the city behind. In the dark hour far away, he walks without arrival. Through nightly deserted villages, fields and forests, his phone lights the way, as wandering becomes plot and the landscape a space of projection.

title: Scream 'Til You Bleed
overview: SCREAM 'TIL YOU BLEED is a proof-of-concept short that follows a punk band on the brink of a falling out as they travel to a remote cabin for their last show. While gearing up for the gig, their lead guitarist encounters a violent entity determined to kill everything he knows and loves.

title: H.D.I.D.T.B.A.L.
overview: A woman has an existential crisis when she's asked out by a woman for the first time. What should she wear that shows her true self?

title: Diamond in the Ruff
overview: Two rookie crooks sabotage their own diamond deal with their idiotic conspiracy theories surrounding the sellers icepack.

title: Johatsu
overview: Meysam and Parisa discover that a mistake has been made during the burial of a family member in a village; an incident that soon draws everyone into the matter.

title: The Secret of Hotel New York
overview: Few buildings tell the story of a city as vividly as Hotel New York does for Rotterdam. Originally constructed in 1901 as the headquarters of the Holland-America Line, this landmark building has witnessed over a century of commerce, migration, war, decline, and urban renewal. Drawing on a wealth of archival material and a diverse range of interviews, the film weaves together the personal accounts of those who knew the building from the inside with the historical evolution of Rotterdam as a port city. From an office building and squatted property to its eventual transformation into a hotel, "The Secret of Hotel New York" presents the story of an enduring symbol of Rotterdam’s capacity for reinvention.

title: Cervantes Follies: A Documentary
overview: Through interviews with its creators, footage of rehearsals, and scenes from performances in the main auditorium of the Teatro Nacional Cervantes, the film chronicles the development of a show that pays tribute to a century-old Argentine musical tradition: La Revista.

title: Dayshift
overview: While cleaning a pole dance studio, a middle-aged woman drifts from routine into reverie.

title: Schurli - Der Liedermacher & Poet Georg Danzer
overview: To many of his friends, fans, and companions, he was “Schurli”; to a wider audience, he was Georg Danzer: a singer-songwriter, poet, and subtle intellectual. He became famous for his Viennese wit and songs like “Jö Schau” and “Hupf in Gatsch.” But behind that twinkle in his eye lies far more than just humor and pop songs: political and poetic, often melancholic lyrics, sharp observations, and a deep connection to people on the margins of society. To mark his 80th birthday, this ORF documentary traces Georg Danzer’s life through his songs and writings—featuring rare archival footage, memories from friends and family, and previously unpublished notes. A personal look at “Schurli Danzer,” at Vienna, and at Viennese culture.

title: Autumns Decay
overview: Autumns Decay is a two-minute experimental film, shot on 16mm and incorporating double-frame exposures and single-frame stop-motion, that explores the fragility of life and the human body through fallen leaves coming apart.

title: Pūtaringa
overview: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

title: Sandwiches & Sandwiches
overview: Created using vintage educational film and animation. Accompanied by original music created from the same source footage.

title: Taísa Machado — In a State of Encounter
overview: The film unfolds through a series of encounters: Taísa revisiting her personal archives and engaging in conversations with family members, friends, and mentors.

title: Stellar Romance
overview: Their first meeting transforms an extraordinary space expedition into an unforgettable love story. As they explore strange planets, witness the birth of stars, and uncover secrets hidden within the fabric of time, their love begins to challenge the laws of the universe itself.  But their relationship faces an impossible choice: save the woman he loves, preserve the future of an entire civilization, or risk changing the destiny of the cosmos forever.  Can love survive across galaxies, dimensions, and time itself?  Somewhere among the stars, two souls may discover that love is the most powerful force in the universe.

title: Cornfield
overview: A creative child with a passion for drawing escapes the confines of a rigid school system through her imagination, where epic battle between mice and a hawk mirrors her fight for self-expression - changing both her world and her teacher's.

title: What Are Friends For?
overview: Friends are seen having a disagreement over an issue of serious import.

title: RETSU (The Line)
overview: Before he knew it, the man found himself standing in a strange line. There was no beginning in sight, and no end to be found. The man was a biologist. Dreaming of one day making a historic discovery and earning worldwide acclaim, he was conducting research to determine whether apes possess intelligence.  Ahead of him stood an unfamiliar businessman, a woman in a purple dress, and a young man in the same work clothes as his own. He feels as though he might know them, but he can’t quite place them. It seems to be a mutual feeling; none of them have any idea why they’re standing in this line. In a society of constant competition and comparison, how are we supposed to live? And is it even possible to escape this strange line? A story that forces us to confront our way of life in a human society where we cannot escape comparing ourselves to others.

title: Sumikko Gurashi: The Sky Kingdom and Two Children
overview: The Sumikkos meet a Prince who descended from the Sky Kingdom on a rainy day. While it's been raining heavily in the Sumikkos' town, the Sky Kingdom is suffering a severe water shortage, so the Sumikkos travel above the clouds to help the kingdom with its crisis.

title: Woven Ground
overview: Composer Blair Coron takes his musical instruments, recording equipment and friends to the islands, glens and forests of Scotland to record directly in the landscapes that inspired the music.

title: Tonta que soy
overview: Between porn theaters, soda fountains in downtown Santiago, romantic movies and an episode of "Caso Cerrado", María Isabel tells her granddaughter a story from her youth about an impossible love affair with a married man.

title: From Concept to Showcase - K/DA FIRESTARTER Behind The Scenes | Fortiche Chit Chat
overview: Six years later, K/DA makes their fiery return.  From early sketches to the seamless final take, discover how the team reimagined the fashion runway as a living, breathing musical score.  In this exclusive interview, Fortiche Creative Director Marietta Ren storyboarders Benjamin Warnitz & Joséphine Meis take us behind the scenes of Firestarter to explore how our team brought the concept for K/DA's long-awaited comeback to life.

title: A Tree
overview: When urban development desecrates a sacred tree, a foreman silences the inexplicable afflictions that have taken hold of a migrant worker, only to dig up histories that refuse to be buried.

title: I Came to See
overview: In the Forest of Fontainebleau, a filmmaker follows a hunt. As she integrates into the group, she gradually becomes complicit.

title: Cut-Piece
overview: A story of power, conflict, and survival set in the underworld of Dhaka's garment waste trade.

title: Elderlyllness
overview: When a mother finds herself forced to take in her own mother after not seeing her for a long time, tensions begin to rise and strange events start to occur. Victor, the older brother, is determined to find the cause and resolve the problem.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Joonè Delam
overview: In a bid for closure a first-generation Iranian-Australian woman is compelled to confront her abusive father on his deathbed.

title: Curb Appeal
overview: From conception to construction, a dream home is built.

title: Daphne as Woman (Crying)
overview: Daphne joins an audition hoping to revive her acting career. But when a casting assistant pushes her beyond reasonable limits, the session turns confessional, revealing ugly truths about the industry.

title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
overview: Congratulations on finally coming out. Equal parts orientation, indoctrination, and camp, this satirical 90s corporate training video onboards "late-in-lifers" with everything you didn't know you needed to survive modern-day lesbianism.

title: The Doll Walk
overview: When the government attempts to erase trans identities, a group of trans women takes to the streets of New York City, demanding a future where trans people can exist on their own terms.

title: World Walker
overview: “Who’s he talking to?”  When a mysterious world walker travels from earth 8 to a different world to the one we live in and he encounters residents and then this leads to events happening

title: Analog Eyes
overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

title: Love, Acting
overview: In the late-night streets of Yokohama, Japan, a male prostitute encounters a film director. He boldly offers himself for an audition, only to be confronted with the haunting question: "What is love?" In the heart of downtown Tokyo, a same-sex couple who have been together for seven years find the spark in their relationship fading. They decide to invite a third person to join them, unaware that the arrival of this mysterious stranger will irrevocably transform their lives. Inside an adult cinema, a "money boy" in the back row meets a middle-aged married man in the front. Their transaction carries a hidden undercurrent of danger. In the vast expanse of the city, these young men are struggling to survive, wavering in their pursuit of affection. But in the end, what does true love really mean?

title: My Deer
overview: Detective Tristan Todd investigates Jericho’s house, searching for a missing woman. What she finds is that the best place to hide your prisoner may be in another reality... hidden only behind a deer mask.

title: Houden van Mij
overview: During a student date dinner, Casper meets Eline, a girl he has been set up with. While it's meant to be a fun and casual introduction, Casper hopes it might be the beginning of something more.

title: The Performance
