overview: 2026 Yale Symphony Orchestra Halloween Show

title: Beware of Dog
overview: After calling a number she finds on a bathroom wall, a young woman's search for intimacy leads her down a highway of strange desire.

title: s3guridad
overview: Tsong enjoys his late-night activities, mindlessly scrolling through Facebook until he comes across a post about a recent police brutality incident.  After commenting, he starts experiencing strange occurrences in his own home.

title: Eine Krankheit wie ein Gedicht
overview: Jelena Ilić's father suffers from drug-induced psychosis and has been in forensic psychiatry for five years. Now the day of his release is approaching. How can the director be sure that her father will not relapse and become violent again? How can a reconciliation be achieved? And how can society successfully reintegrate a mentally ill offender?

title: Kasha
overview: An evil spirit stalks and terrorizes a distressed teenage girl.

title: They Lurk Beneath Eyelids
overview: A couple faces various horrific and psychological ordeals while being trapped in a labyrinth of nightmares.

title: Son of Badriyah
overview: On their final day together, a boy and his great-aunt cling to small rituals together before an inevitable separation.

title: Last Minute
overview: As Mike gets ready to leave his life in London behind, his friend tries to convince him to stay.

title: Their Eyes of God
overview: A psychedelic journey into the mind of a man, and the faces of those he remembers.

title: Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Red Flags
overview: With the 2026 midterms closing in, Republicans are facing an unpopularity crisis as gas prices skyrocket and the war in Iran drags on. In this new special, “Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Red Flags,” Klepper hits the MAGA campaign trail to see if anti-communist hysteria, God's pronouns, and old-school Islamophobia can hold the GOP's fraying coalition together.

title: The Hour Of
overview: 'The Hour Of' follows three friends who gather for food and the final episode of their favourite Netflix show. What begins as an ordinary evening takes a terrifying supernatural turn, forcing them to confront something far beyond their understanding. As the night unfolds, their friendship is tested, their survival instincts are pushed to the limit, and the familiar comforts become anything but safe.

title: Memory Box
overview: The film follows a teenage boy as he packs up his childhood bedroom, preparing to leave behind an important part of his life. As he comes across different objects, he is reminded of memories from his childhood and teenage years, with each memory representing a different emotion and experience that has shaped who he is.  The film explores themes of growing up, nostalgia, family, friendship, and the difficult emotions that come with change. It is a Bildungsroman, as the story focuses on the boy’s personal and emotional development as he reflects on his past and begins to understand how his experiences have shaped the person he is becoming. Ultimately, the film is about leaving childhood behind while recognising that those experiences will always remain a part of him.

title: Ice, Men and a Starling
overview: On the frozen waters of Hiiumaa, 87-year-old Vello Jürjo, a legendary figure in the world of ice sailing, begins building his very last iceboat. Hearing the news, his grandson, director Mihkel Oksmann, rushes to document the process.

title: Archives from Hell: The Making of Demo_N
overview: A retrospective documentary series on the innovative experience in screenlife horror - Demo_N.

title: Title
overview: An episodic structure links scenes, each with its own internal narrative and logic. In dialogue with John Baldessari’s film ‘Title’

title: Yugen
overview: When the rain refuses to sleep and the sky forgets its peace, a girl born of pottery searches for the last mythical giant, hoping to save her fragile world.

title: The Life of the Party
overview: A year after an event that changed her and her loved ones' lives, Natalia must return and face those she hurt.

title: Mother's Day
overview: In a tiny Indigenous Mexican town where everyone is family, a secret pregnancy tests the forbidden love between two cousins. During the vibrant Mother’s Day festival, a public dance becomes a bold act of defiance that will change their lives forever.

title: Chopin
overview: “Chopin” tells the story of Chopin Wu (played by Liu), who returns home to small-town America where he grew up to amend an estranged relationship with his workaholic father (Dai). With a sudden appearance from his ailing grandmother (Chen), he is confronted by a past he had left behind. In the midst of a health crisis and a broken family, Wu is forced to re-examine old relationships, embrace a heritage he once denied and discover the importance of family and identity.

title: The Panic Inside
overview: How does a chronic people-pleaser, who struggles to say no to his friends' constant requests, finally learn to set boundaries, confidently say no, and reclaim his personal freedom?

title: BUFF
overview: Lost in a toxic gym bro regime, Tee spirals into an obsession with building the ultimate Adonis body.

title: Mallika Vilasam
overview: A protective man becomes suspicious when a young writer grows close to the mother he considers his own, only to discover that the stranger he feared letting into their home may become family.

title: when clouds return home
overview: As twilight deepens, memory, scent, and silence drift through the air— where clouds, birds, and feelings quietly return home.

title: MURWOMAN
overview: Inspired by the true events of "The Lipstick Killer"

title: Notes on Crashing Cars.
overview: As the wind blows, stories are being told.

title: A Pint of Ink
overview: Through photographs, home videos, letters and personal recollections, Ester Geislerová composes a portrait of Japanologist, translator, journalist, educator, calligrapher—and her father—Petr Geisler, a charismatic charmer who remained mysteriously elusive even to his closest family.

title: Demonology
overview: A small team of paranormal investigators are hired to investigate a remote property where a grieving couple claims to have encountered a demonic force. As they unravel the mystery, they begin to realize they are not welcome.

title: Backpay
overview: Backpay follows Steve, a desperate father fighting to save his marriage, who teams up with Murphy, a cop scarred by life as an informant. Their “simple” extortion plot—kidnap a corrupt politician and crack a safe—quickly spirals into danger.

title: Land of Fire
overview: In remote British Columbia, wildfires have become part of everyday life. The communities the film follows carry deep losses, visible in the burned forests and in the roadside posters of missing loved ones, many of them young women. Yet life here is shaped as much by resilience and solidarity as it is by grief.  Nikola Klinger has made a film about people facing complex challenges who nonetheless believe in a better future. By weaving together the interconnected lives of the locals, the film creates a layered portrait of the landscape and the people’s bond with the wilderness, its magic and its myths. Residents live in the shadow of unsolved deaths and the disappearances of young people, finding an escape from their troubles in community solidarity and modern-day rituals, such as the demolition derby at the local wreck yard.  “There is something alive out there in the bush; you can feel it, but you can’t see it.”

title: Singapore God
overview: To get to work, a man sprints through a city where mundane panic and disaster collapse into one frozen moment.

title: Don't say hop before you jump
overview: Director Nikita Lukyanov collaborates with creative director Can Dağarslanı for the short film Don’t Say Hop Before You Jump – featuring equestrian vaulting sisters Alice & Helen Layher. Shot on 16mm film,the visual short follows the German sisters when their daily equestrian vaulting rituals slip into the surreal. As their horse circles the arena anticlockwise, time begins to rewind, carrying the sisters back to the childhood where their shared rhythm began.

title: In the Trench
overview: A soldier lives in a small cloud of fear.

title: ROADTRIP
overview: Accumulated images and sounds from my life

title: Opens Tonight
overview: A showcase of 100 years of film programming at the historic Tampa Theatre.

title: Forever My Lady
overview: When women start going missing across the city, detective Shanel Reid is forced into an investigation leading her to Sebastian a dangerous man, whose disturbing obsession with one woman could leave more bodies and broken families behind.

title: Wreath
overview: Driven by their current principal's bureaucratic pressure, a group of teachers is forced to attend the funeral of a former headmaster they have never met. Lost and without a map, they embark on a journey toward a destination–and a man–that remains a complete mystery to them.

title: Toen we alles nog wisten
overview: When three friends reunite after not having seen each other in years, they find a camera that reveals the truth about what happened the last summer they spent together as a group of five.

title: Baile das Luzes
overview: A sensory immersion into the long-term projects of photographer Vincent Rosenblatt, a Parisian who has been based in Rio de Janeiro for more than 20 years. The film explores the worlds of Rio’s funk scene, the bate-bola carnival celebrations, and the sound-system parties of Belém do Pará, while also including a journey through Poland. In this polyphonic voyage, he unveils his visual obsessions and reveals a perpetual state of searching, in which life, image, and catharsis become intertwined.

title: Time & Time Again
overview: After moving homes, a young couple acquire the Timecrowave, a mysterious microwave that ages anything placed inside.

title: Cow forgot feet
overview: Just my personal film

title: For Me, For You
overview: Haunted by the collateral damage of his own ego, a young man sits with a notebook of past regrets and attempts to heal by leaving behind a message of forgiveness rather than fear.

title: Fruitcakes: Dawn of Drag
overview: Jolanda, a retired archivist, has spent most of his life in the closet. In the late 1970s, he stood on stage alongside his friend Mummo in Finland's first drag show, 'Happy Gays'; the performance was even broadcast on television, and Mummo became one of the first openly gay men in Finland. Then came AIDS, fear and violence. In April 1988, Mummo was murdered in his home; the police were unwilling to solve the case and the entire crime was hushed up. Now, more than thirty years later, Jolanda is opening up his own archive and inviting a new generation of drag artists to bring 'Happy Gays' back to the stage.

title: YED MERYEM
overview: he story follows a group of students from Bab Ezzouar University who go on a mysterious, adventure-filled trip from Algiers to Tamanrasset, with plenty of funny moments along the way. Meryem is chosen to protect the legacy of "TinHinan", the legendary Tuareg queen, and keep her heritage from fading away. Things get complicated when a businessman named Youssef tries to sabotage her mission.

title: GTA, le jeu no limit
overview: As GTA 6, the most anticipated video game in history, launches worldwide in November 2026, explore the story of Grand Theft Auto, a franchise that has evolved from a target of political and media backlash into a global pop culture phenomenon. After three decades of redefining gaming through its open worlds and unprecedented freedom, what does GTA's enduring success reveal beyond the controversy and high-speed chases?

title: Until We Bury Them!
overview: A group of neighbours has been evicted from the communal housing where they had lived all their lives. They decide to take revenge on the speculator responsible for the injustice.

title: Zone 51 : la base secrète qui intrigue la planète
Prudence and the Wandering Eye
overview: In a strange, purgatory-like room where workers exchange small bundles for coins, Prudence notices an elderly blind woman waiting in line. She offers to help, but her seemingly good deed soon takes an unexpected turn.

title: The Sons of the Lord
overview: DR. HAFNAOUI is a medical examiner who falsifies autopsy records every time he is ordered to do so by an organization whose power is extended. One day, by chance, the code received relates to a person so close to him. Surprise, astonishment, emotions, the discovery of the body which is in his hands pushes him to question!. What a life? What future? What values? What destiny. TO FOLLOW because destiny is sometimes a fatality.

title: Dreams of the Wild Oaks
overview: A race against time to save her freedom: Samaneh, a young Bakhtiari girl in Iran, must find a rare and endangered bird to escape a forced marriage and a tradition of Cease Blood Sacrifice, in a journey that challenges her beliefs and tests the limits of her father’s love.

title: Jennifer
overview: Jennifer is an Indian movie directed by Althaf Rahman starring Swasika. The feature film is produced by Antony Naduvattom and Binu Dev

title: A Town Called Needville
overview: Told through 35mm photographs and first-person narration, A TOWN CALLED NEEDVILLE traces the filmmaker's four-month inpatient stay at an all-women’s mental health facility in Needville, Texas.

title: Fire and the Thud
overview: A drunken man comes up with a permanent solution for taking care of a noisy, soul-sucking, gigantic modern-day nuisance.

title: Danhausen’s Very Nice, Very Evil Halloween Special
overview: Kick off your Halloween celebration with Danhausen as he welcomes the WWE Universe into his laboratory for an evening of spooky matches, scary Superstars and special guest appearances.

title: Yoshi
overview: A disillusioned young man contends with the 21st century.

title: Miriam
overview: A film letter from the director to her aunt, who was murdered by her partner. She talks about the aftermath of the femicide, her grief, the family’s persistent fear and how she has managed to break the silence to open a space for healing.

title: Gamophobia
overview: Simon is ready to take the next step and start a relationship, but there's one problem: he can't seem to figure out how Jayden truly feels about him. Jayden is more timid when it comes to love, keeping her feelings close to her chest and leaving Simon wondering whether she feels the same way he does.

title: The Gloom
overview: A social worker witnesses some disturbing events. She decides to trust her intuition and find answers to the questions that trouble her.

title: We’re All Going to Die
overview: The truth is one day we all die. But why is that a bad thing? In this film, Death will confront humanity's fear of dying through conversation and professional insight, unpacking whether dying is what we fear, or an absence of certainty.

title: The Moon is Always So Beautiful
overview: "The moon is always so beautiful, and the sun dies every evening. That is why I want to shout: I believe in nothing but the warmth of your hand in mine; that is why I want to shout: I believe in nothing, but love." (Víctor Jara)

title: Out of Orbit
overview: When everything changes overnight, a young couple must decide what comes next.

title: A Stolen Movie
overview: Camilo Restrepo reappropriates and remixes a real General Motors promotional film depicting an early-1960s exhibition across the Darién Gap in Chevrolet Corvairs. As the representatives of the global North’s industrial might bridge the same chasm that stands between today’s migrants and the United States, Restrepo considers the unequal flows of people and property between the Americas.

title: 10 Days till Halloween
overview: Nothing says autumn like the crunch of leaves beneath your feet. Or bones.

title: The Cosmic Roommates: Garbage Day
overview: Jake just wants a normal life, but his chaotic group of misfit roommates turns his world upside down. When mysterious, giant trash monsters threaten to destroy the city, the bickering roommates are forced to band together to save their home. To survive the ultimate garbage day, they must pull off the unthinkable and team up with their mortal enemy.

title: Bajau Laut - The Sea is Our Home
overview: Their stilt houses are burned down, their boats destroyed: the sea nomads of Borneo are stateless and can be displaced at any moment. The film explores the deep cultural roots and spiritual heritage of the Bajau Laut – the first inhabitants of the Semporna region – and contrasts them with the forced evictions targeting their oldest and most traditional villages. In the tension between eradication and assimilation, three chapters trace the evolution of adaptation, while local grassroots movements fight for the rights of the sea nomads.

title: Remembered If Outlived
overview: In the early 1800s, troubled painter Nora O’Hara lives under the suffocating rule of her abusive and domineering father. Nora learns of an arranged marriage to take place which unleashes dark forces which aim to harm her. Her immobile and mute mother serves as a reminder of what her fate could be if she refuses. A haunting option for freedom is born in the form of a dark ghostly figure, leading Nora to her fate.

title: Sally
overview: In this short film, gravity plays a trick on us and makes marbles rock and roll through the room, jump over the floor and even stand on their heads.

title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Carmen
overview: Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. She warns him not to fall in love with her, but his obsession knows no bounds. Damiano Michieletto’s searing production returns, casting scorching light on the lust, violence and destructive desire of Bizet’s ever-popular opera. An all-star cast brings this white-hot drama to life, with Ginger Costa-Jackson in the fiery title role, alongside Russell Thomas as the jealous and despairing Don José. Following his 2023 Royal Opera debut, Sesto Quatrini returns to conduct Bizet’s electrifying and sensual score.

title: The Surveyor
overview: An eager young surveyor takes her first solo job: a quiet, empty field. Routine. Nothing to it. Starring Chloe Breen (Obsession) and Michael Paré (Streets of Fire).

title: The Ectomilkers
overview: Sergeant and Gideon are tasked with navigating a godless land- helping clients with their paranormal hunting business.

title: 11 χρόνια δίκη Χρυσή Αυγή - ΟΙ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΟΙ ΤΗΣ
overview: Eleven years have passed since that 20th of April 2015, when the curtain opened on one of the most significant trials in modern Greek history. A long legal battle that concluded with the final, definitive recognition of Golden Dawn as a criminal organization, vindicating the victims and all those who persisted in the pursuit of truth and justice.

title: Evening Light
overview: 6 October 2025. In the evening the impossible happened. A white horse walked into a prison, looked into the cells, came out into the light.

title: Urgent Care
overview: A doctor is working her final night at an urgent care clinic that's about to close down when she finds herself confronted by a patient who seems to be possessed by a demon.

title: Crocodile Tears
overview: Hired to pose as a dead boy's girlfriend, a professional mourner finds her hardest act is keeping herself from falling apart.

title: Freedom – Shewit's Destiny
overview: To escape oppression and a haunted past, Shewit flees Eritrea, risking her life, setting out alone on the road towards Europe. At fifteen, after a three-year journey, she arrives in Switzerland, the country in which she places her hopes and dreams. Seven years later, without a residence permit and under constant threat of deportation, Shewit persists and fights to become a free woman.

title: Eyes on the Road
overview: After losing two loved ones to traffic accidents, Micki Harris started her journey as an advocate for safer road design. What began as a casual gathering between neighbors has grown into a state-wide movement to protect commuters and bring communities together.

title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
overview: Aberfan's grieving community takes on the government, demanding justice and removal of the remaining tips after the disaster that killed 144 people

title: Dear Son
overview: Mariam, a mute nun in a remote Lebanese convent, cares for an abandoned baby. When a French family arrives to adopt him, their painful separation awakens a maternal instinct that conflicts with her vows, forcing her to question her commitment to virginity and the life she has chosen.

title: HIDDEN
overview: After the sudden disappearance of a loved one, a woman is haunted by a shadow from her past.

title: Stoned to Death
overview: Two stoners find themselves being pursued by a masked killer after smoking a mysterious joint.

title: Sean McLoughlin: White Elephant
overview: Comedy special of Sean's 2025 tour show White Elephant, filmed at Leicester Square Theatre in London, UK.

title: Try Hard - La génération qui a inventé l'esport
overview: This three-part series is intended as a manifesto for a generation that grew up with the internet and helped shape this uncharted world by bringing esports to it. It tells the story of the birth of esports, as seen through the eyes of its greatest champions: teenagers from rural France who have become stars of a global discipline, played by millions of enthusiasts.

title: 生中継！相川七瀬 30th Anniversary ROCK KINGDOM TOUR 2026 -FINAL 日本武道館-
A Family
overview: A child actor wandering between reality and fiction, a prisoner using his furlough, and a woman trapped at her son’s christening. A day in the life of each of the three members of a family over whom the same question hangs: Who am I, and who do I want to be? Three stories about identity, separated by time, but united by blood ties and a decision that will mark the lives of all three.

title: The Knock Shadow
overview: A young female therapist at a psychiatric ward in the ‘80s encounters a patient whose symptoms lead her to question what is real and what isn’t working in the field.

title: Final Party
overview: A strange party has foreseeable consequences.

title: Metamorphosis
overview: ​This short drama film follows Ethan, a young book reviewer obsessed with perfection, turns to AI after losing all inspiration, and what starts as a harmless shortcut soon becomes something he can’t control. ​Inspired by Franz Kafka's Metamorphosis.

title: Endi Dark Evil
overview: An early-twenties grocery clerk gets her worldview flipped after being stalked by a paint demon.

title: Hapus
overview: Key is on probation at a production house. Her boss asks her to erase a mysterious figure from a video, a figure standing behind a “history expert” who is about to talk about the 1998 tragedy. She tries again and again, and fails, while strange things keep happening to her. A short horror film about the 1998 riots and the erasure of history.

title: Long Shot - A Filipino Curling Tale
overview: What began as a sporting experiment turned into a grand dream. Amorana founder Alan Frei and three top Swiss curlers of Filipino descent want to bring the Philippines to the Winter Olympics. In order to achieve this, they must not only compete against strong opponents, but also navigate the complexities of being caught between two countries and identities. In curling rinks far from major sporting stages, the team grows together and begins to believe in the seemingly impossible.

title: Avenca
overview: An ordinary morning. A swimming pool. Two women. The reflection of the water distorts the words as Melina and Renata try to save what still remains. But what is the weight of loving something that no longer fits in the same place?

title: No More Punk Time
overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

title: Poirot is a teenage girl and they killed her boyfriend
overview: June 1985. When Veronica discovers her boyfriend's dead body in the pool after a high school house party, she decides to become a detective on par with Hercule Poirot and find out who the killer was.

title: FEROPOLIS
overview: For seven decades, FER has been a place where ideas become innovations, knowledge drives progress, and boundaries exist only to be pushed. This is not merely a story about the past, but about people who believed that knowledge could change the world  -  those who had the courage to imagine what did not yet exist and to create what was yet to come.

title: Where Are the Pigeons ?
overview: Victor, a passionate birdwatcher, is convinced that all the pigeons have vanished. When he meets Abby, a photographer, there’s no doubt for him : she is the mastermind behind their disappearance. What follows is a duel between Abby's budding love and Arthur's growing paranoia, where everything is held together by a feather.

title: Remember That Time
overview: In an unprecedented cinematic experiment, five strangers, led by an enigmatic facilitator enter a Nordic LARP (Live Action Role Play), about grief, love, and loss, where the line between performance and reality begins to dissolve.

title: Pumpkin Carving with Sam
overview: Sam is getting a head start on his pumpkin carving. How are you getting ready for Halloween?

title: A Plot of Fate
overview: An ordinary mother–daughter quarrel takes an unexpected turn after a visit to a mountaintop temple.What starts as a familiar clash of wills quietly slips into something uncanny, where destiny seems to intervene at the most unpredictable moment.

title: Rusambo
overview: Ru$ambo follows the journey of Hanayashe, a Shona bride whose lobola ceremony unravels into a maze of accusations and secrets when the bride price mysteriously disappears. With the marriage now in limbo, Hanayashe is forced to confront a painful truth: someone within her trusted circle has sabotaged her big day. To reclaim her future, she must untangle the motives of her family and close friends, exposing hidden agendas, fractured loyalties, and long-buried tensions. Inspired by whodunnit-style mysteries and African folktales of tricksters and betrayals, Ru$ambo transforms a seemingly straightforward theft into a gripping tale of suspicion, deception, and cultural reckoning.

title: The Cover Up
overview: The Church, long-proclaimed bastion of virtue, is now facing an historic reckoning as residential school survivors in Canada seek justice. With the discovery of 215 bodies at the former residential school site in Kamloops, BC in May 2021, a watershed moment in Canadian history exploded into the world's consciousness. First Nation, Inuit, and Metis survivors across the nation told police their stories of abuse, neglect, experimentation, and even murder for decades -but their truths were considered lies until physical evidence proved otherwise.

title: The Witches of Pool Bottom
overview: When a teenage girl's body-image fears become physical, she decides to destroy them - quite literally.

title: La Nit del Foc
overview: It's all chaotic. Children are shouting, playing, making a mess, eating whatever they want, and making the world their own. Not an adult voice is heard disturbing the madness. It's San Juan, the night of fire was yesterday, but the party continues... What happened? Where are the parents? With a few shots and four drawings, the film evokes the most perverse and funniest childhood fantasies.

title: A Maniac In Town
overview: A lonely girl is relaxing at home until she notices a stranger spying on her. That same day, she hears on the radio about a brutal murder committed by a maniac who is still on the loose.  The girl, frightened after seeing a stranger lurking around, locks the door immediately, but soon realizes that the danger is inside her home.

title: Agbara Nla: The Return
overview: When a feared village doctor rises with dark spiritual power to terrorize the land, a young courageous couple, Olatomi and Olaboye, must embrace their divine calling to confront evil, ignite revival, and prove that no power is greater than the name of Jesus.

title: Punto de Rocío
overview: Inés and Marina, two friends, sneak into their swimming club and confront their suppressed desire. A decade later, the same patterns repeat themselves. Shifting between past and present, the story reveals how the depth of their feelings for one another are measured through their connection to water.

title: Blow the Horn
overview: Three couples arrive at a Brooklyn artist’s studio expecting individual sessions with their psychologist. Instead, they discover their therapist left behind a letter and a series of sealed envelopes instructing them to conduct their own unconventional group therapy session, which quickly spirals into an increasingly volatile confrontation as long-buried secrets, betrayals and uncomfortable truths come to light. As the partners turn on one another and their relationships begin to unravel, the session builds toward a series of revelations that challenge everything they thought they knew about each other.

title: The Expert
overview: Emma and Philip are both interviewing for the role of "Happiness Expert" at a company - but who deserves that position more?

title: The Informant
overview: Eighty-two-year-old Juris Kalniņš has found his name in the archives of the Committee for State Security of the Latvian SSR, where he is identified as an informant. Both during the Soviet era and today, he remains an uncompromising free thinker who has devoted most of his life to photographing people and documenting the spirit of the times. With the camera now turned towards Juris, he is ready to delve into his past to understand how his name could have ended up on a KGB file. What makes a person an informant – a piece of paper, mere suspicion, the opinions of others, or one’s own actions?

title: The Trinitarians
overview: Three demonic horsemen harvest human souls to resurrect Zazarus, an omega-level entity imprisoned since Olympus fell. As they near the final soul needed to break his chains.

title: F**k Face
overview: During a casual game of Scattergories, four friends discover that the most dangerous thing in the room isn't time, guns, or bad language- it's how well they know each other.

title: Why Andorra?
overview: With a sense of adventure and curiosity, we explore the micro-country of Andorra to understand how it has become one of the safest and most peaceful locations in the world.

title: Only the Sea Knows
overview: After his best friend’s suicide, Jan returns from Belfast to Catalonia. With his ex-girlfriend Laura, he drives to their coastal hometown for the funeral. As distance gives way to memory, their guarded conversations uncover the unresolved fracture that once separated them.

title: Synthetic
overview: Struggling with emotional numbness, Yara discovers mysterious pills that can manufacture specific feelings, from courage and love to happiness and empathy.

title: Organize İşler: Karun Hazinesi - Organize Sohbetler Beyaz Özel
overview: The White and Organized Crimes: Karun Treasure team has come together! In Organized Conversations White Special, we're discussing the details of Organized Crimes: Karun Treasure.

title: LYCEUM
overview: After the entire student body mysteriously drops out, a young and obedient maths teacher must survive an absurd training session to land the first job he so desperately needs.

title: Sam's Harvest
overview: Every year, millions of innocent pumpkins are discarded. This year, they’re fighting back.  Please dispose of your jack-o’-lanterns responsibly.

title: Lost and Found
overview: Two young men take it all in on a journey to nowhere and everywhere in the eye of the rocky mountains.

title: Sensory pits
overview: Louis, 26, hasn’t left his apartment for 367 days. His Parisian flat is surrounded by stacks of pizza boxes and the flickering glow of old films. There, he drifts further from the world. Loneliness and anxiety tighten their grip, trapping him in a loop of writing, smoking, drinking, and reliving the past. One day, Adèle moves in next door.

title: UNME
overview: Peter stuck in the room with something that looks exactly like him. He has to survive through the night before the nightmare has come.

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Touching the Sky
overview: Touching the Sky takes the viewer on a voyage of human powered flight like never before  - following wingsuit base jumpers in the European Alps, and a paragliding team across the Himalayas in Pakistan.

title: Night Adrift
overview: When a wild hen night spirals out of control, a Deaf bride-to-be’s bond with beloved hearing friends over the course of her life is about to shatter. Can she endure her friendship or face a truth she’s long tried to silence?

title: Where the Fear Ends
overview: In 1976 a small group of women in Montgomery County, PA sat together around a kitchen table to discuss the Women’s Movement. They were aware of women wanting to enter the workforce, go to college, and create ways to balance all of it with their roles as wives and mothers. They thought it might be a good idea to set up a women’s resource group and have a place that women could come to discuss ideas and receive support. Then the hotline started ringing. Volunteers answered the calls. And the calls kept coming. The majority of calls were from women sharing that they were being abused by their partners and they needed help. The Volunteers were shocked and sprang into action to build an organization that addressed the needs of domestic violence victims.  Fifty years later the Women's Center of Montgomery County has grown into a thriving organization with seven offices and more than 150 Volunteers and one of the most effective domestic violence organizations in the country.

title: Portrait
overview: A lonely old man invites a male escort to his home in a last stitch effort to live the life he was too scared to live.

title: Dialling...
overview: After a late night shift Jake cycles through his contact list of friends in the hope to get a lift home, but with none of them answering he becomes confined to this phonebooth.

title: in the heart there is a stone
overview: Naomi calls Matteo and compares him to the sea: how can you ask the waves to be anything other than waves? To have known him is enough. His answer is less enthusiastic, and finding herself emptier than she had thought, she heads into a rocky valley to find inner connection: to hear what the rocks, trees, and wind have to say about it all.

title: The Eternal Look
overview: Ivan, a film student, has found the perfect actress during his casting recordings, even though she never showed up. The young man repeats the castings again and again in an attempt to find the girl who gave him the perfect look. But... does she even exist?

title: Toxic Moon
overview: Set in a mid-90s Pine Barrens town in New Jersey, Toxic Moon follows zine writer Scuz Lanchester as she investigates a string of murderous hit-and-runs and a mysterious ooze infecting the woods, wreaking genetic havoc on every creature it touches. Lo-fi monstrosities, trash synths, bloody leather, killer cars, woundfog, slimerats and vampire bats: Toxic Moon is a rotten feast for the senses, entirely captured on VHS-C.

title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

title: Feel My Empty Soul
overview: Burnt-out social worker Chan, 40, meets Hei, 16, searching a carpark for a non-existing exit to freedom. Reminded of his own lost ideals, Chan initially relates to the boy but ultimately shatters his dream due to professional pressure.

title: Visitas de Uma Parente Afastada
overview: Over the course of seven years, Mariana Viegas photographed the sets of some of the last productions shot on 35mm. Today, she returns to the perspective she had as a young woman, back when she worked with directors such as Šarūnas Bartas, Pedro Costa, João César Monteiro and Manoel de Oliveira. Joined by a few guests, she will take us on a journey through a surprising archive, in an encounter between photography and cinema, creation and life.

title: The Golden Rat: Perils of Plague and Possession
overview: A group of conspiracy sleuths travel to NYC in a desperate attempt to stop an ancient sinister golden rat from unleashing its wrath upon the city.

title: TroIA
overview: Martin, a graphic designer trapped in front of a blank screen, struggles unsuccessfully to finish a logo. When inspiration fails to come, he turns to TroIA, an artificial intelligence that promises to help him. But as the tool learns from him, Martin begins to wonder how much of what he creates is still truly his.

title: The Whispers
overview: Few hours after their first meeting at a party, a girl and a boy are lying next to each other.

title: Beyond
overview: Follows people living with and beyond cancer as they discover strength, connection, and a new sense of possibility through climbing. Set between indoor walls and wild mountain rock, it is a powerful story about recovery becoming adventure.

title: Inhabitant
overview: Porter, just fired from another job, returns home to find an inhabitant living in the thresholds of his apartment.

title: Feed the Dark
overview: Snowbound high in the mountains, a ski patroller realizes her injured colleague has been possessed by a ravenous demon.

title: Ukraine Ghost Ship
overview: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine’s mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed and over 50 people lost their lives. Upriver, as waters drained, ancient ships’ timbers were uncovered on the newly exposed beach. Now, a Ukrainian archaeologist Dmitro Kobaliaa has assembled an international team to recover these remains, to reveal the story of a vast Russian military flotilla sent to conquer land around the Black Sea coast. It’s a battle still raging today. As fighter jets shoot overhead, Dmitro’s discoveries reveal a history of Ukraine before Russian rule, a history the Russians are trying to destroy, but one Dmitro is desperate to preserve.

title: The Heart of a Dominatrix
overview: Dominatrix Innana Justice, based in Paris, offers a behind-the-scenes look at BDSM—and, of course, at the role of a dominatrix. Spanning several chapters and featuring an ensemble of international sex workers and performers, this dynamic portrait explores a wide range of topics and practices related to BDSM, work, and community—from sessions to activism.

title: Pianke
overview: The story of a young German boy and his father who befriend a Jewish family during WWII.

title: The Model Reality
overview: A man is subjected to subliminal messaging.

title: Cómo La jungla de cristal cambió Hollywood

overview: A young Bulgarian man drives a truck along an Austrian highway, 71 people sealed in the cargo hold with little air. Will he follow instructions from his handlers or lean into his humanity? Based on a true story that changed Europe’s refugee policy in 2015.

title: 5000 Strokes
overview: Carolina Modena and Cristina Ganem arrive in Antarctica with an extraordinary challenge: to swim five thousand strokes in its icy waters, without thermal protection. They barely know each other, but the expedition confronts them with the cold, exhaustion, and an extreme landscape that tests their bodies and transforms their relationship. What begins as a connection between fellow swimmers gradually becomes a deep friendship.

title: Staircase at Midnight
overview: Sex worker Kitten makes his living on the streets of rainy Bristol, England. Hired by a police detective to inform on a missing persons case, Kitten is drawn into a web of crime and conspiracy, investigating forces of corruption that are fast closing in.

title: Sand Roads
overview: SAND ROADS is a journey told in two chapters - one filled with the spirit of youth; the other imbued with the weight of adulthood - showing the eternal struggle for self-discovery, adventure and how friendships can transcend life itself.

title: Mountain of Gold
overview: Gold fever has gripped northern Niger. In search of the precious metal, and despite the risks, an army of researchers has invaded the sites of interest. While camps are set up and dismantled as rumours of new leads spread, Moussa and his companions are banking on the Ikazan vein.

title: April 15th
overview: A lemonade stand ruins a girls trip.

title: From me, Your little poet
overview: A poet who brought his wife back to life through poetry.

title: Blood Before Bitcoin
overview: Myrna, a former gang member, runs a roadside motel with her younger boyfriend, Floyd. When her old gang arrives for a mysterious Bitcoin heist, buried grudges, jealousy, and betrayal threaten the score- and the new life Myrna fought to build.
In today’s world, messages get misunderstood. Transmission is interrupted.

title: Moving Forwards
overview: Six friends. One normal summer night. A future that suddenly disappears. As the months begin to move on, the friends left behind each find their own way of carrying the absence of who they lost. When they reunite, old memories resurface, reminding them that moving forwards doesn't always mean leaving the past behind.

title: Indigo Elsewhere
overview: At the edge of an unnamed city, two unemployed, directionless trans lesbians connect in a reality-shifting way.

title: ALL4NTG
overview: Gabriel goes on the forum ALL4NTG every day to cope with his daily solitary life. Yet, something far worse than the missing sun above his head will come to haunt his solitude.

title: Thousands of Meters, Hundreds of Hours
overview: Through interviews with women who have been trained in the craft of making traditional Lepoglava lace we learn about this symbol's role in the creation of Lepoglava's identity and how it connects local women across time and space.

title: Skeptics and Believers
overview: An atheist and a religious man ponder life's questions in a bar.

title: Pickpocket
overview: A pickpocket who has spent his life invisible spirals into paranoia when he suddenly feels exposed.

title: Some Like It Hot
overview: A short documentary about the magnificent madness of the Finnish sauna culture, in which no place is too strange, too small, or too dangerous to build a sauna.

title: God, Please Save Gucci Mane
overview: Pray for Radric Davis

title: Figure it out yourselves!
overview: Banana and Snail embark on a cross-country road trip to a destination that holds deep personal significance for Banana. But as the miles pass and their journey unfolds, Banana refuses to reveal the meaning behind their destination, leaving Snail to wonder what secrets lie at the end of the road.

title: Early Winter's Sorrow
overview: An elderly writer arrives at an abandoned village, where only derelict houses remain. He goes to the farm where he spent his childhood. After a new bridge was built, the village was plagued by robberies and threats, and his family moved to a small remote farming community. Their peaceful working environment was threatened by Russian soldiers monitoring the village by air and making harassing visits. The personal stories of the small community that we witness are adapted from the novels of Revaz Inanishvili.

title: Les Duos Impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11ème édition - 1ère partie
Limbung
overview: In his old age, Lazuardi, a former detective who raised a vampire child as atonement for his sins, is faced with the reopening of his old case, while the vampire child started to feel distant.

title: Mr. Lucky
overview: Lakshman, an IT professional ironically nicknamed Lucky, finds himself trapped in a life full of misfortune. Everything changes when a mysterious cap turns his luck around, taking his life in unexpected directions.

title: Something In The House
overview: A married couple and their daughter struggle with the child’s behavioral issues. The birth of a baby in the household disrupts an already fragile balance, pushing their shared life into disconcerting and darker directions.

title: 城市印象深圳之剧场版
The Static
overview: A disturbed teenager finds herself questioning reality.

title: Portrait of Many Faces
overview: A documentary on the diverse and unique students of the IIT Madras BS Degree Programme in India, which strives to spread education to all.

title: O Que Acontece Por Trás Das Câmeras
The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
overview: This drug awareness short follows Billy, a teenager who smokes weed for the first time and turns his night into a hellish nightmare.

title: Untitled
overview: An experimental visual and audio exploration into the subconscious mind of Lazarus.

title: (Failing to Make) A Documentary About My Sudanese Family
overview: A filmmaker sets out to document a trip with his family in the shadow of a civil war, but finds the process undoing the film itself.

title: Scali
overview: Betrayed and abandoned by his boss and childhood friend after a road crash, a truck driver must choose between the desire for revenge and the survival of his own values.

title: Sometimes
overview: Caught up in the chaos of her responsibilities, a young woman is oblivious to the turmoil weighing on her life as she leaves work. However, her pent-up emotions begin to surface, her reality is transformed, and she must overcome the obstacles in her mind to find herself.

title: Follow You There - A War Bride Story
overview: Andrew Rodgers is a professional musician from St. John's, NL. As a songwriter, he is always on the hunt for new and interesting stories to write about. After discovering a remarkable story in his own family, Andrew travels to Fair Haven, NL to talk to his Great Grandmother, Joan Masters, who is a war bride originally from the London area of Great Britain. She lived through WWII, met Andrew's Great Grandfather, Sam Masters, during his service in WWII, and together they travelled back to Sam's hometown of Fair Haven, NL to begin a new life after the war.

title: Sepulchre
overview: A man returns to his old apartment to find that even though his girlfriend left, the memories did not.

title: Jackal
overview: Uncle visits his niece

title: Maharashtra Epstein Files
overview: Plot TBA; inspired by the real-life scandal surrounding the self-styled godman Ashok Kharat alias 'Captain'.

title: Manduka
overview: A girl suffering from schizophrenia accidentally meets four criminals. Meanwhile in an hide and seek with Police and the criminals lies the mystery.

title: Egg
overview: Struggling after his father's death, Josh goes to visit his father's oldest friend Ray, who lives off-grid in remote Wales. Surrounded by wild birds, Josh finds an abandoned egg and is compelled to find its nest to return it and takes Ray along with him. While talking, the two men find a way of sharing their grief and looking forward.

title: Strangers and Their Babies
overview: Four people of Vietnamese descent retrace their families' flight across open water to Taiwan, uncovering two Penghu Island refugee camps left out of UN records — where 106 babies were born, many without papers.

title: Shh
overview: Investigating a supernatural disturbance, exorcist Paddy Mullins and his team venture into an abandoned military installation where silence is essential… until it isn’t.

title: La guerre des sens
overview: Iris has always believed that beauty lies in what we look at and listen to. The creature, however, only has eyes for what she can smell, touch, and taste.

title: My faith, your face
overview: A young french girl goes on a quest to find her ex-boyfriend through the streets of New York after he has broken up with her. Yearning to see him again, the desperate lover spends nights and days trying to reach him.

title: Deviant
overview: After a successful video date, Brooklyn invites Cameron over to her rented Airbnb in Joshua Tree to take things to the next level. Their evening soon gets interrupted by a masked intruder who takes them captive with mysterious intentions. To survive the night, they're forced to confront a sordid past that reveals a disturbing connection.

title: For Your Suffering
overview: A young boy lives in the shadow of his abusive stepfather - until tonight.

title: "THE THING IN THE LAKE"
overview: A dastardly creature emerges from the lake. Can the two sketchy friends Hans and Henry survive?

title: Running Snake
overview: Desire, shame, and loneliness from a young woman’s perspective.

title: The Ghost of Piñera
overview: Bastián receives a visit from his friend Franco, who gives him a peculiar gift: a pellet gun.  That day, the former president of Chile dies and begins to appear to Bastián in the form of a Cloth Ghost.  All of this occurs amidst the rise to power of the far right in Chile.

title: Le grand jeu de Jessica Chastain
Wolfmask 2: The return of Dario Durant
overview: As the survivors try to rebuild their lives, Víctor, the brother of one of the victims, forms a group to stop what many believe is just a legend. But revenge never rests, and the past always finds a way to return.

title: The Ghost in the Graveyard
overview: Hoff Matthews remembers the time he got chased out of a graveyard by a ghost while trick-or-treating.

title: Woman Who Sold Her Shadow
overview: Yuko Kawai works at an advertising agency in Tokyo, but her ordinary life leaves her anxious about the future. As she nears her 28th birthday, a fortune-teller warns that her next yes-or-no answer could change her fate. Soon, a mysterious man offers to grant her wishes for a year in exchange for her shadow. When success and good fortune begin to arrive, Yuko must ask whether getting everything she wanted will truly make her happy.

title: Ice in the Pocket: My Father Giuseppe Sinopoli
overview: Marking 25 years since the unexpected passing of renowned conductor Giuseppe Sinopoli, his son Giovanni uses archival footage, home movies, and personal interviews to bridge the gap between his father's public persona and private identity. The documentary serves as a poetic dialogue between father and son, reflecting on family legacy and the contemporary relevance of classical music.

title: The Whistling Game
overview: A woman searching for her missing brother travels into the wilderness of Dartmoor, England, documenting her investigation as she follows the trail he left behind. As her search deepens, she encounters an ancient mystery, while her camera captures increasingly inexplicable events.

title: Munchausen
overview: A young man walks into a toilet during a party.

title: A Festa da Desordem de uma Umbra Eterna
Proposals for the Interpretation of a Dream
overview: A young woman is plagued by a recurring dream of a mysterious house.

title: Koko: The Invisible Dog
overview: Koko was like any other dog, except invisible. One day she got sick. Then angry. Then she started eating people.

title: The Lost Princess of Hackney
overview: A self-proclaimed Elvish Princess finds herself stranded on our world in the Hackney Marshes. Without any magic to return home, she searches for purpose but develops an unlikely friendship with a sceptical student filmmaker.

title: Aarambham Oru Albaniyo Katha
overview: Four unemployed graduates from Bethoorpara, North Kerala, face ridicule from family and society. When they finally land a job, it brings unexpected trouble, forcing them into a desperate struggle to escape.

title: Near Light
overview: Divorced and out of work, a village schoolteacher tries to recover a lost sense of closeness with other people. She offers a former pupil a driving lesson. Their brief encounter will change how both of them see the world.

title: I Fell, Remembering You
overview: In her final days before leaving the country, a young girl spends time with her brother learning how to ride a bike.

title: Boy
overview: An interview of sorts.

title: Jão: Cada Lembrança Nos Trouxe Até Aqui
Spoon
overview: A ritual is seen taking place, while results come to fruition, it is still considered a failure.

title: Chess Set
overview: Returning to his grandfather's home, Jack remembers the games of chess they shared many months ago

title: Chéri on Top
overview: Rebecca recounts the disastrous afternoon she has just experienced. She had planned the perfect gender reveal party for her pregnant friend Daphne. But Lennart, the soon to be father, behaves like a child. His actions trigger a wild chain reaction that turns what was meant to be a joyful afternoon into a nightmare.

title: THE SNORE
overview: Good night. All tucked in. But then the snore begins. What starts as a woman's irritation of her boyfriend’s snoring curdles into obsession, and sleeplessness mutates into something monstrous. Parasitic, the snore burrows into her mind. Her world shrinks to the rhythm of his breath. Reality warps. The house becomes a fever dream of noise and rage. By morning, the question remains: who’s the real monster? The snorer, or the one who can’t bear to hear it?

title: Brother Joseph Again
overview: Brother Joseph Again is a rigorous, faith-filled investigation into one of the most fascinating questions in Church history: what did Joseph Smith really look like?

title: Halcyon Daze: The Final Voyages of Disney’s Star Wars Galactic Starcruiser
overview: Follow director Carrie Coaplen's journey from casual interest to full-on obsession with Disney’s one-of-a-kind, award-winning, yet short-lived interactive theater experience. Be immersed in a universe of live-action adventure and colorful fantasy characters, as they experience profound feelings shared by dedicated cast members and fixated fans. As the “Halcyon” potentially docks forever, what will become of this innovative playground that brought superfans together?

title: 15 Aala Kamra
overview: The room features an old cupboard tied with a sacred red thread. Pandit convinces the group that supernatural spirits live inside and warns them never to open it, turning the cupboard into a constant source of fear and humor throughout their stay.

title: Investigation: City of Pipes
overview: In 2014, Kaohsiung was struck by an unprecedented petrochemical gas explosion, exposing once again the city's unresolved dependence on heavy industry. Through a fictional investigation, this film adopts "voice" as its investigative method. Beginning with the ruptured petrochemical pipeline that caused the disaster, it gradually reveals the relationship between Kaohsiung's petrochemical industry and its citizens, while uncovering an industrial history that spans Taiwan's transition from authoritarian rule to democracy.

title: TIDES
overview: After the loss of a loved one, a grieving teenager named Mara battles with her identity, struggling to be her own person without the one she has lost. As buried memories resurface along the beach, her grief progresses from sadness and nostalgia to anger and distress, leading to an eventual emotional collapse and an intense breakdown.

title: Tiliche
overview: A Tiliche dancer from Oaxaca loses his colorful fabrics in an attempt to assimilate into the unfamiliar, gray world that surrounds him.

title: Southern Ontario Gothic
overview: A woman faces her darkest hour in downtown Toronto.

title: Vessel
overview: Potter Rick Rudd curates and protects the nation's fragile crafted legacies within the walls of Quartz Museum of Studio Ceramics. The film follows the construction of one of Rick's latest works in intimate detail, silently capturing his hands forming the clay into another masterpiece. Rick reaches out for help to realise his vision and find release from the daily challenges of single-handedly running a world-class museum.

title: BEWARE THE WHITE FOG
overview: A white fog envelopes a school, bringing something sinister with it.

title: Suki Waterhouse: Austin City Limits
overview: Suki Waterhouse’s set at Austin City Limits on October 3rd 2026

title: I Dream of Snakes
overview: A spell for the dying who wish to be transformed.

title: Once Upon a Rex
overview: A documentary reminiscing on the 70 years history of a beloved cinema in Padua.

title: One More Thing
overview: The short film follows Kwen, a student/worker struggling to juggle the demands of her job, her studies, and her friendships.

title: Meong, Bikul, dan Kisah Si Pemburu
overview: A boy wants to prove himself by carrying out Siwaratri: no food, no drinks, no moving, no talking, and no sleep. While doing it, he experiences an imaginative journey as a hunter, and learns the true meaning of self-control and attentiveness.

title: Dawning Soul, Traveling Light
overview: To project is to use light to make the past present; so too do our souls refract the radiance found in the world. In the throw from the lens to the screen, a single frame can become a cosmos: space and light and time become one in the same.

title: The Date
overview: Jazmín is excited: this afternoon she will have her first date in years. Filled with a nervous energy, she wonders what the day will bring – but as the minutes roll by, things do not turn out the way she had hoped…

title: From Gaming to Murder: The Killing of Breck Bednar
overview: Told by Breck Bednar's family and friends, this powerful series reveals how the innocent world of an online gaming group became the stalking ground of a predator. Lewis Daynes created a fantasy life of a tech millionaire in order to isolate and groom 14-year-old Breck. Despite Breck's parents' desperate efforts to protect him, Daynes lured Breck to his murder with the most cynical of lies.

title: Bodies Under The Bridge
overview: Three high school mean girls bully their friend Adeline, but they don't realize what's coming for them.... or who....

title: No Place Like Home
overview: Housing is a human right. Why should people go through so much trouble for a right that everyone deserves? Everyone should have access to affordable housing. As it stands in New York City, housing has become a commodity for the profit of few. No Place Like Home is a documentary that explores this issue and hopes to get people thinking about possible solutions to this problem.

title: The Space Between Myself and Myself
overview: A young soul called "The Self" recollects the memory of his past while having an ego death in a possible future.

title: Hudke Ki Pyaang Pyaang
overview: In a small Himalayan town, Vikas and Jyoti, a Dalit boy and a Brahmin girl plan an escape to the city through government teaching jobs. When paying the required bribe demands selling his ailing father’s ancestral shop, Vikas hesitates, causing their relationship to crack.

title: Chura Vita
overview: Seeking the secret of Okinawa’s legendary longevity, Swedish traveler Nicolina Svensen arrives on the famed Blue Zone island and discovers a culture caught between past and present, where ancestral foodways, sacred rituals, and handcrafts are quietly disappearing.

title: The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull
overview: "The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull" explores —through the editing of social media footage— the collective act of touching public statues, particularly on their intimate parts, and everything this gesture reveals about contemporary culture.

title: Twincredible!
overview: With the final innings of the 1991 World Series buzzing through their television set, this portrait of struggling new parents Bert and Annette unfolds over one night in their half-finished home, where an argument stirs emotions neither of them fully understand.

title: The Most Stuck-up Girl in Town
overview: The 50th Hunger Games through the eyes of Maysilee Donner (fan film).

title: In the Shadows, We Lose the Sense of Colour
overview: Katka was thirteen. Roman was forty. The summer camp Chachaland, once a place of joy for children, became a place of abuse. What followed were years of therapy, depression, and PTSD. As an adult, Katka found the strength to write a blog and take her abuser to court.The film is an intimate testimony to how abuse continues to shape a life long after it ends – and how the courage to speak out can be both deeply painful and profoundly healing.

title: Lena’s Farm: Motherless Egg
overview: Lena’s dog finds an egg in his bowl. How will it hatch without its mother?

title: KILLING TIME with Sam
overview: Halloween can’t come fast enough.  Sam’s just KILLING TIME.

title: The Beast in Me
overview: A man has something to hide from his date.

title: ALAEA
overview: A grief-stricken son faces a series of strange events after finding blood dripping from his father’s attic.

title: There's A Roach Inside
overview: A school principal is assaulted by surreal happenings.

title: Under My Skin
overview: One evening, Gabriel throws a party with his friends to celebrate the conviction of the man who abused him as a child. With Lucien by his side, he turns the party into a flirty dance floor in an attempt to escape his past. Caught between Lucien’s gentleness and his own need for desire, Gabriel unwittingly reenacts the confusion between affection and control.

title: Creation
overview: The Hungarian word "alkotás" (artwork) has a dual meaning – it can refer both to the process of creation and to the finished artwork. The film tells the story of how a canvas comes alive, how playful, abstract forms are created, each one carrying its own human narrative.

title: Not Alone
overview: Mothers and fathers of gay, lesbian, and trans children from Georgia, Moldova, Russia, and Ukraine travel to Berlin to walk together in the Pride parade. Living under one roof, they prepare for the march — painting signs, cooking borscht, and reflecting on how their relationships with their queer children have evolved over the years.

title: Über Unterbiberger
overview: Franz Himpsl is an athlete, teacher, trumpeter, chaotic spirit, and founder of the Unterbiberger Hofmusik. Together with his wife Irene and their sons Xaver, Ludwig, and Franz Jr., he breaks through the barriers of Bavarian folk music, blending it with jazz and influences from around the globe. Their motto: Respect – and don’t piss your pants! The film accompanies them on musical journeys around the world: to Marrakesh, the pyramids, Alexandria, the Nile, and even the skies above Iran – while Father Franz returns to his roots in the “Woid,” the deepest Bavarian Forest.

title: Night Watchman
overview: James takes on the job of a night watchman, unknowingly replacing a man who died just one week prior.

title: No Running In The Halls
overview: Alice finds herself trapped in an alternate dimension after using the school elevators and has to survive the staff who have become distorted versions of themselves.

title: Leading Your Birds
overview: Seita is a musician living in Tokyo who is facing a severe creative block. He disappears, and his sister, Azumi, a young deaf girl, finds him in the mountain house where they spent their childhood. Isolated, he tries to get back to composing and begins recording birdsong for inspiration. The two brothers start living together there. Azumi's presence, movements and sounds, which initially irritate Seita, help to unlock the boy's creativity over time. However, the artist becomes bothered again when Taichi, Azumi's boyfriend, decides to pay a visit.

title: John le Carré: A New Life
overview: Traces le Carré's life from an abandoned child to an intelligence officer and then a master novelist who transformed betrayal into literature, and who spent a lifetime ‘controlling the story of himself.'

title: OLATS
overview: A recently unemployed man, looking for a distraction between job applications, becomes addicted to an online gambling app until it begins taking more than just his money.

title: As You Were
overview: In this loose homage to Steve Martin's "L.A. Story", Harris is a young man figuring his life out in New York City. Muddled relationships and struggles with commitment and change leave Harris confused and stuck in an unhappy status quo, struggling to figure out which direction to take his life. Through the help of new connections and New York City itself speaking to him, Harris is able to start to change his life for the better.

title: Low-Hanging Fruit
overview: A trans woman discovers a mysterious pair of artefacts and tries to sell them on the black market, hoping to escape her past. Meanwhile, a consciousness waits for a body to inhabit.

title: Leaping
overview: A short film based on the nature of dreams

title: Dear Sunshine
overview: Na-yeon, a nurse who works night shifts, can sleep during the day. But there are days when she cannot.

title: Stênio
overview: In his studio in Juazeiro do Norte, woodcut artist and "Master of Popular Culture" of Ceará, Stenio Diniz, rediscovers a piece of wood - scarred by termites after years of neglect. Through his memories, the lessons he has learned, and his artistic practice, his actions reveal a co-authorship with nature - and the persistence of someone who keeps popular culture alive.

title: Chasing Plastic: Team Korea Great Grand Masters
overview: Follows Korea's Grandmasters ultimate frisbee team as they pursue their first championship at the 2024 World Masters Ultimate Championship.

title: Blue Fiddle
overview: Molly is a ten-year-old girl who believes that if she learns to play the fiddle like her dad and wins the All-Ireland Music championship, her father will wake from his coma.  Still in a coma, her dad is moved to a rehab centre, where Molly befriends Malachy, a grumpy old man who plays the fiddle beautifully and is told he has magic in his hands. They connect as she coaxes him to teach her to play and together they go in search of the magic that only music can bring.

title: I've Never Seen This Sink Before
The weight of water
overview: A guy, who just woke up, has to face the tough reality of water weight.

title: The Plastic Country
overview: The new film from leading youth ocean and climate champion Kal Glanznig (Rising Up) is an eye-opening investigation of the impact of plastic on our bodies and ecosystems.

title: PR
overview: PR follows a middle-aged man in Hawaii who quietly trains for months to deadlift 300 pounds. To the gym-bros around him, his daily grind looks like vanity, ego, or some late attempt to impress women. But his real motivation remains private, as most true motivations do. Set against the ordinary rhythms of local life, PR uses time, repetition, and routine to let the everyday breathe. The film looks for a Hawaii hidden in plain sight; not the postcard fantasy, and not the weight of history, but the mundane spaces in between, where small acts of discipline and love can become their own kind of triumph.

title: The Wonder Years I: It's Not Too Late / Maybe You're The Same As Me
overview: Filmed in Mexico City and Santa Barbara, CA. July 2024.

title: We Wish
overview: Every wish has a price, especially the ones made without thinking. When two people have the same desire, accidents are sure to occur!

title: Aftermath
overview: A massacre survivor and a filmmaker form an unlikely bond as they slip down the rabbit hole of paranoia, in a desperate search for solace and truth.

title: Aash khanoom Jan
overview: It centers on the children of a traditional family who decide to travel to Tehran to visit their elderly parents after the pandemic ends. Arriving from various locations, they gather just as the family matriarch—affectionately known as "Khanom-Jan"—is preparing her annual *ash-e nazri* (a traditional ceremonial soup), leading to a series of bittersweet events.

title: Synthetic Politics
overview: Can cinema ever be apolitical?

title: Haunted Heartland
overview: Gather around the campfire with Storyteller Brian "Fox" Ellis for four Central Illinois legends. From Illinois Wesleyan’s Lady in Red and Peoria State Hospital’s Old Bookbinder to Springdale Cemetery’s Witches Circle and the Cole Hollow Monster, Haunted Heartland explores the history behind the mystery and the real people whose lives inspired stories that still spark our imaginations. TV Special released by PBS Illinois Public Media WTVP.

title: Come To Me
overview: A beautiful girl is drawn into the depths of a forest by an eerie, other worldly presence calling out to her. As she ventures deeper and deeper into the darkness of the woods, she discovers something sinister and haunting, eventually falling into a dreamlike nightmare.

title: Curse of the Ghoul Logs
overview: Halloween's favorite tradition goes post-apocalyptic with the Hallowarrior filmmakers and their trove of Junk O' Lanterns.

title: Performance of the Year
overview: Olivia, a struggling actor, is forced into the biggest audition of her career with the last director she'd ever work for. Her whole life is turned upside down when she is pushed to her limits for this pretentious director's masterpiece.

title: Revenge of the Celluloid
overview: In the underbelly of a monochromatic world lurks a mad embalmer conducting a sinister experiment. A generative machine disguised as a moving picture show turns children into mindless ghouls. One woman aims to put an end to M. Balm's cinema of horrors.

title: Now What?
overview: An intimate portrait of a relationship suspended in time - a breath held before the plunge. Alice and Paul have exhausted words; the silence between them resonates with everything unspoken. They stand at the edge of something irreversible, knowing change must come, yet unsure if they're brave enough to face it.

title: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu
overview: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu is a new live concert with accompanying film & full-length album that uses field recordings, concert specific homemade instruments, organ, modular synths, vocals, flashlights, electrical interference, and elements of musique concrete to express the bizarre emotionality, conflicted sexuality, relentless darkness, and singularly unsettled moonscape of this most incredible of midnight masterpieces.

title: Nesting
overview: A man attempts to appease his mysterious kidnapper who showers him with suffocating, distorted affection.

title: Quarter Century
overview: Quarter Century is a quiet exploration of a universal yet deeply personal question: What does it truly mean to exist?

title: Letters from Tibet
overview: Letters from Tibet follows an exchange across time between a British colonial officer and a contemporary archivist. Tracing how Tibet has been framed through colonial correspondence, photography, and cinema.

title: Topanga
overview: A woman gets a flesh eating bacteria

title: Samhain: The Birth of Halloween
overview: Michael Londra, host of the popular travel series Ireland with Michael, takes a spine-tingling journey through Ireland to uncover Samhain, the ancient Celtic festival that gave rise to Halloween. Blending rich history, haunting folklore, and modern traditions, the film reveals the origins of a holiday now celebrated in many parts of the world.

title: Synchronicity
overview: Two solitary walkers cross paths at night in a deserted city. As they draw closer, the city changes. Rhythm, synchrony, and direction come to the fore. The walkers and the city intertwine in a single movement.

title: La foil histoire de la Route du Rhum
Memory of a Sunset
overview: An elderly man visits a cemetery after being summoned by his brother, who died several years ago. The meeting turns out to be a ruse orchestrated by Death itself, which has come to claim him because his time has come.

title: Yasha
overview: Yasha follows Hana, a young teacher driven to desperate measures after losing her job. In need of money for her son’s life-saving operation, Hana is willing to endure any hardship, humiliation, or consequence to give her child a chance to survive, and the film remains firmly focused on its protagonist’s relentless struggle throughout. Never saccharine or manipulative in its portrayal of maternal determination, this is a story that feels raw, tense, and authentic.

title: Guesthouse
overview: In southwest China, Xiuzhi navigates her migrant-worker guesthouse alone with ease while raising three young daughters—until a baby boy disrupts this fragile balance.

title: The Nights
overview: La Pichi is a woman born on the fringes of Buenos Aires, gifted with an extraordinary talent for storytelling. Night after night, she transforms her own life into tales infused with humor, imagination, tenderness, and irreverence.

title: さよならの前に、できること
Take Care
overview: In the days following the death of her grandmother, Hope witnesses her mother and uncle clash over cultural protocols surrounding the burial, while processing her own grief.

title: Grayscale
overview: Paul, a drug dealer-turned-reseller, has lost his supply of sneakers. His boss, who lent him the money to buy the shoes, confronts him about Gabriel, Paul's business partner who has supposedly disappeared with the supply. The conflict between these three men will come to a boiling point: paranoia, obsession, and murder.

title: Hit the Books, Harry!
overview: A stressed, under-prepared college student spots a girl across the empty library as he crams for his exams.

title: HOST.mp4
overview: After an encounter with a still life, Tristan treks deeper and deeper into relics of his internet-fueled childhood.

title: Flying with the Crows
overview: When a night of celebration is interrupted by a vengeful drug dealer, a young man uncovers a betrayal that forces him to choose between revenge and the lifelong friendship he’s never been able to leave behind.

title: Verity
overview: A man wishes for Verity to be real, but sometimes wishes shouldn't come true.

title: City of Graves
overview: In the heart of Cebu City, Carreta Cemetery has become more than a resting place for the dead—it is a source of livelihood and home for generations of families. Through the lives of a lapida maker and the people who call the cemetery home, City of Graves explores a community shaped by resilience, tradition, and survival. It is a portrait of how life quietly endures in a place built for the dead.

title: Inochi Ga Umareru
overview: "Inochi Ga Umareru" is about inner story from The Land of the Rising Sun , Japan.

title: Child of Sinaï
overview: In the Sinai desert, within sight of Sharm el-Sheikh's glittering resorts, nine-year-old Bedouin boy Jarah faces a very different future. His family sends him to camel herder Mohamed to train as a jockey for Zalaga, the region's most prestigious camel race. Victory promises honour for his family and freedom for the boy.

title: Crossing The Rhineland
overview: After a large attack on an American base in the Rhineland, Germany, SS Officer Heinrich Louzer is sent and makes it his main duty to capture and kill the ones who got away.

title: Making The Line
overview: MAKING THE LINE is a character-driven feature documentary that delves into the world of competitive Hula — where athleticism and artistry are inseparable from a living Hawaiian cultural tradition. At its heart are Kumu Keano and Kumu Lono, two master Hula teachers and life partners who lead a diverse group of dancers striving for excellence in the art and discipline of Hula.  Guided by two modern-day queer Kanaka whose lives infuse the story with emotional truth and cultural nuance, MAKING THE LINE unfolds over three years, exploring tradition, resilience, and identity in a rapidly changing Hawaiʻi. As the demands of excellence intensify, so do the complexities of life both on and off the line. Their story becomes a portrait of devotion, transformation, and the enduring power of Hula — revealing that it is far more than dance; it is the heartbeat of a people.

title: Anthony Lin's The Lull
overview: Camp Counselor Jason wakes up inside an empty car. Scared out of his mind, things unseen haunt Jason as he must come face-to-face to an eerie consequence lurking. Lurking all around him till his night’s end.

title: Our Wish, Our Colors
overview: An elderly man brings home a broken fan and wrestles with it for hours until the blades spin again. He has put the blades on backward, but the wind is still cool. "My illness is the same as this fan." Suffering from hearing loss and mental disability from a fall, he collects discarded objects in a small patch of woods in the heart of Haeundae and builds a world of his own. His granddaughter, who enrolled at art college only to lose the desire to draw, begins instead to capture her grandfather’s world with her camera. His world is full of useless things and incomprehensible happenings, but she willingly joins him on his outings.

title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
overview: We’re all just floating, waiting for someone to find us.

title: Adab Dalam Berkurang Ajar
overview: We are taught to be polite, respectful and mindful of others. But when politeness becomes restraint, the courage to speak, question and challenge can be mistaken for disrespect.  Inspired by Usman Awang’s Kurang Ajar, this documentary explores the tension between manners and courage, conformity and freedom.  Through the work of Freedom Film Network, we discover how film can become a space to question, provoke and speak truth to power — while asking: can we challenge without losing our sense of adab?

title: Rose Tinted
overview: The IRIS glasses can make anyone in front of you look like a completely different person. This is Maddie's last resort.

title: BRITTLE HOME MOVIE 1997
overview: This is the only film reel my father ever shot in the place where I spent my childhood. Unfortunately, almost nothing remains: the memories of a bonfire in our garden back home, captured on film in ’97, now worn away by time.  A whirl of aquamarine blue dances wildly, occasionally allowing me a glimpse of something hidden beneath layers of melted and corroded emulsion.  The flames trapped within the frames vanish, submerged beneath layers of moisture.

title: The Cornell Seven: IMPACT x Nightline
overview: Secret recordings, accusations of gang rape and ketamine-fueled partying. What happened inside a Cornell frat house?

title: IO SONO L’ASSENTE – Storia incompleta di un disadattato di successo
Tomson Highway: Permanent Astonishment
overview: Tomson Highway: Permanent Astonishment, inspired by his award-winning memoir Permanent Astonishment, follows Highway's extraordinary life, from his birth in a tent in northern Manitoba and years at residential school to his groundbreaking plays The Rez Sisters and Dry Lips Oughta Move to Kapuskasing, which transformed Canadian theatre.

title: In the Name of the Father
overview: Three estranged brothers reunite at a notary's office to settle their late father's estate. What begins as a routine procedure turns into an emotional battlefield, where the true inheritance is silence.

title: Sonora
