overview: In silence, three people share the same house: Ayla, a young Indigenous trans woman, is pregnant; Ferreirinha, a down-and-out accountant, harbors pro-Bolsonaro delusions; Sebastião, a lonely elderly man, is at war with the gardens. Sound trucks, campaign jingles, and evangelical hymns pierce through the walls: the public space outside devours their private lives. Deafening.

title: Bez Kralja, The Fool
overview: As his circus fades and his donkey nears her death, Johan the clown spends an evening with a theatre owner confronting a life without a witness, and asking where the stars go when they die.

title: Getting Rid of Grunt
overview: Two housemates have to work together to get rid of a one-night stand, who refuses to leave, and refuses to talk.

title: The Channel Shooter
overview: ND // Not Yet Disclosed

title: Domsey on Strike
overview: Domsey on Strike chronicles the historic labor struggle waged by predominantly Haitian immigrant workers at Domsey International, a massive textile sorting factory in Brooklyn. Filmed on-site by Matthew Noyes, Gillane Seaborne, and Stan Joseph during the height of the labor dispute, the documentary captures workers organizing against wage theft, racism, psychological abuse, sexual harassment, restrictions on bathroom breaks, and other exploitative working conditions.

title: Müller-Wohlfahrt - Der Arzt der Champions
overview: A Sky Original documentary about one of the most influential figures in German sports history: Hans-Wilhelm Müller-Wohlfahrt.

title: Two Hander
overview: A woman arrives at a parking lot to retrieve a car.

title: On the Edge
overview: After years of meth-fuelled chemsex, Jay is caught in a relentless cycle of relapse, paranoia, and recovery. With the support of close friends, he begins confronting his addiction through self-awareness and openness. But even as he recognises its devastating cost, the grip of addiction continues to test his mind, his relationships, and his hope of reclaiming a healthy life.

title: The Beauty of Intensity
overview: An introverted young man hires a service called “Epizos,” which replaces past romantic relationships with actors. But when Adán hires the service, the person who knocks on his door is the very person he wanted to replace.

title: Lost and Found: Thirty Years, Not Together
overview: Canadian Jessi's search for her Romanian birth mother reveals a sister adopted under the same name and a web of lies.

title: Home 79
overview: Khmer movie

title: Tokyo, Outsider
overview: As boundaries and relationships continue to shift subtly, young people drift on the cusps of "outsider" and "insider", wandering between the foreign and the familiar.

title: Day of sacrifice
overview: On a summer day at the beach, a marine otter guides us through its home. Despite massive human presence, nature endures and adapts. However, something even greater casts a shadow of uncertainty over the future of this area.

title: The Perfect Soup
overview: Roommates, Todd and Linda go on a series of dates. Only to realize love might be closer than they think.

title: Dwijihwa
overview: Kumaresh, on the run from a repressive right wing party, must spend the night at the home of a comrade who undergoes a strange shift over the course of the night, which progresses in anxiety and outright terror.

title: The Flower Kings: Hope
overview: More than three decades into an extraordinary career, Swedish progressive rock pioneers The Flower Kings return with HOPE, their 18th studio album and one of the most ambitious statements of their storied journey. Balancing refined musicianship with fearless creativity, the album is both a celebration of the band's legacy and a bold leap forward, embracing the grand, cinematic scope and adventurous spirit that have made them one of progressive rock's most beloved acts. title: Dead on Arrival
overview: When a simple cash drop goes wrong, two sleazy criminals are driven down a path of mystery, violence and betrayal.

title: Phantasmagoria
overview: Leo tries to come to terms with having lost his best friend Olivia. Through his stream of consciousness, memories become unearthed and a shadow of her haunts him.

title: Cadu: Veqan Vampir
overview: A new "Cadu" movie by Alikhan Rajabov

title: A Fragile Paradise
overview: As storms intensify and the future of Fire Island grows uncertain, those who care for the island reveal what it means to protect a place they love that may not last.

title: Are You Worthy?
overview: Thought to be an urban legend, a killer returns to a small town to complete his mission. One family and their friends must fight back to stop this unrelenting force and uncover the truth behind the killer's motives.

title: Final Sale
overview: An optimistic antique shop owner is in denial about the haunted activity at her shop, putting herself, her employee, and her customers in potential harm's way.

title: Hilol
overview: At twenty-three, Hilol has been raised by her father like a son. Her mother died when she was born, and though she was once a Taekwondo champion, she now has little to do other than caring for her father at home. Her older sisters, each struggling with problems of their own, try to arrange marriage for Hilol. Then, she runs into her childhood friend Doniyor by chance, which stirs feelings she does not quite understand.

title: The Return of Captain Kabonga
overview: Inspired by the World Wrestling Entertainment, a group of non-professional wrestlers from the Suez Canal city of Ismailia come together to stage performances across Egypt. With limited resources, they are hoping to embark on a journey that will decide the future of their wrestling careers.

title: In
overview: POV short film

title: Love Is Just a Death Away
overview: Sometimes life starts after death for someone. Like for a little parasite, who walks with a rotting corpse of a dead dog around an old landfill. Trapped in his unpalatable body he tries to find love and friendship.

title: White Guilt
overview: From civil rights warrior and black militant to fearless dissident, Shelby Steele unmasks white guilt as the toxin that poisoned America -- destroying merit, igniting riots, demolishing standards, and now arming global chaos from campus bloodlust to civilizational suicide.

title: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport
overview: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport is a Thriller/Horror story based off the Wattpad Webstory by PRNCSPLM also known as Chase Pulumbarit, adapted by Aliah Dela Cruz.

title: Once Upon A Poet
overview: When a disillusioned young poet discovers a forgotten script and a decaying flower in a dream, she is thrust into a creative awakening that forces her to confront and find her true voice.

title: Tears of the Lonely Army of the Golden Triangle
overview: At the junction of Thailand, Myanmar, and Laos lies the “Golden Triangle,” a vast forested region once rich in gold and gemstones but long turned into a lawless frontier shaped by conflict and the drug trade. After the Chinese Civil War ended in 1949, a remnant force of the Republic of China army retreated into this region. Led by General Li Mi, the “Yunnan Anti-Communist National Salvation Army” grew from a small unit into a several-thousand-strong force, but remained isolated in the jungle, ultimately becoming a “lost army.”

title: Behind The Passion
overview: A non-profit human rights organization in Argentina discovers what is happening to Nepalese workers in Qatar during the leadup to the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
overview: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses’ stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn’t disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

title: City Of Illusions
overview: We erase, rewrite, correct and create. Construction of the subway in Thessaloniki has been going on for over 20 years. Scientists, politicians and many others have been searching for and excavating artefacts of historic significance. These artefacts have been found, kept in secret and hidden. The city has been constantly erasing its centuries-long past, always carrying a new “me” in its underbelly of streets. Then, a woman is invited back to her motherland to save it from a contagious amnesia..

title: Bea
overview: Seventeen-year-old Yasmin discovers an intimate video of her has been shared without her consent and tries to remove it and identify who circulated it.

title: Hot Sand
overview: Co-directed by Rockaway residents, Emma Hastil and Kaia Abraham, “Hot Sand” was shot over the summer of 2025 in Rockaway. It’s a dreamy little glimpse of a hot summer day in a small town, following the people who make the community so unique, yet familiar.

title: Time Capsule
overview: Grief consumes Luiza since the loss of her father months ago. In her daily life, she battles memories of the tragedy and tries to move forward, despite an absence that seems to be everywhere. Then, an unexpected memory regarding the “treasure” her father left behind leads her to find comfort where she least expected it—and to view her own loss in a different light.

title: Selfie: The Possible Lives
overview: Ten years after Selfie (2019), Ferrante goes back to Rione Traiano in Naples diving in the frames that were cut out. He finds a choir of vital and restless teenagers, and asks himself not what kind of the life did they had, but what kind of life they could've had.

title: GUM
overview: With his future on the line, Nate races against the clock to uncover a lost file that could save his job. With a family depending on him and the walls closing in, he plunges into a chaotic maze of paperwork. As he frantically searches, he gorges on the strange, addictive gum, turning every rustle and creak into a ticking bomb.

title: Until Your Last Breath
overview: In a post-apocalyptic Montana where the dead hunt the living, a young survivor's search for independence sets in motion a tragedy he and his sister cannot escape.

title: Stained
overview: An art therapist and nanny are unexpectedly brought together one night by their wealthy client, forcing three generations of women to confront the stains of their past. As long-held tensions resurface and emotional wounds are reopened, they begin to question whether every stain can truly be washed away.

title: Madeleine
overview: Madeleine moves through her days feeling increasingly distant from herself and the world around her. As she wanders aimlessly, the voice in her head questions promises of happiness, the apparent joy of others, and the point of carrying on. Amidst moments of anguish, silences, and thoughts she cannot silence, Madeleine confronts a loneliness that seems ever present, even when she is not alone.

title: A Pulga
overview: One hot night, a child captures the ‘beast’ that has long haunted the chicken coops in their village. The next day, racked with guilt at having hunted it down, she joins her cousins to save it from the adults’ punishment, but hides the fact that it was her hand that wounded it.

title: Shadow of Hope
overview: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.

title: Where the Rain Nests
overview: In a rural town in southern Chile, three teenage friends spend their final months before finishing high school, facing a future that could pull them away from the place where they grew up.

title: Prosthetika
overview: Sara, a tormented special effects makeup artist, plumbs the depths of her subconscious to confront her complex relationship with her appearance, reconnect with her identity and – if she can – find her way to self-love.

title: Recovery
overview: "I wanted to make an action film. An action film featuring a woman." Yeonjeong talks about her dream before a huge wave, and immediately she is throwing herself around the mat at a jiu-jitsu gym. To understand action means to understand the body, which is why she learns surfing as well as martial arts.

title: The Sound Between
overview: Penelope, a former dancer living with Alzheimer’s, revisits her youth while her daughter Olivia helps pack up their family home.

title: Faultline
overview: Charlie and Sage Jackson are growing up in a world where the rules don’t affect everyone equally. As their family faces pressures shaped by law and circumstance, the siblings must navigate questions of belonging, opportunity, and the futures available to them. Faultline is a social drama about the systems that shape young lives—and the people too often left out of the story.

title: sich langsam nähern - Begleitetes Lebensende in sieben Kapiteln
overview: In seven astute chapters, this film documents the work of doctors and nurses in the palliative care unit at Vienna General Hospital or outpatient hospice care, accompanying patients on their final journey. Although we see family members and impending goodbyes in the dialogues, the film gradually delves deeper into the relationship between the dying and their healthcare professionals: repeatedly, the tension between professional care and emotional closeness is palpable.

title: Decay
overview: A troubled man remembers a past relationship while kicking a rock.

title: Calming Winds
overview: Struggling with his smoking addiction, Rich has to quit smoking before his partner Char leaves him. Searching on the internet for solutions he finds a peculiar pop up add that'll grant him his wish, by removing Rich's ability to create a flame.

title: There Are No Rules
overview: After a freak sun incident leaves the world without color, one man is inspired to quit smoking.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by Georges Perec’s A Man Asleep, the film examines contemporary alienation in a today’s emotionally numbed world of hyperconnectivity and endless information.

title: Jeanmaire
overview: At the height of the Cold War, Brigadier Jean-Louis Jeanmaire a respected general officer in the Swiss Armed Forces was accused of passing highly sensitive information to the Soviet Union. His primary contact was Vassili Denissenko, a Russian military attaché and suspected KGB agent. We look back at a case that shook Switzerland in the 1970s.

title: The Korean Black Eyes
overview: In 1966, the girl band ‘All Stars’ was formed centered on drummer Kitty (Jun-im Lim), a third-year high school student. They left the country with an understanding that they were going to perform in Southeast Asia. However, they arrived and put on a spot to perform, sometimes risking their lives, for the soldiers on the battlefield of Vietnam. Kitty was recognized for her musical talent, and formed the five-member girl band ‘Korean Black Eyes’ in Bangkok in 1971. The band moved onto Beirut as their base and toured throughout the Middle East and Africa, including Egypt and Nigeria. When they entered Spain in 1973, they went on a concert tour with Cliff Richard, Julio Iglesias, and others. They recorded an album in Portugal at the suggestion of a local producer, but had to quickly escape the country when the military revolution broke out. Wherever they went, including Vietnam and Lebanon, they encountered turbulent scenes of modern history.

title: All Because of Rosie
overview: Markus Ethan and Jake Johnson take a chaotic and life-changing detour while on the way to Rosie's Halloween rager.

title: Tortured Mind
overview: A killer is confronted with the realisation that his victim may have been dead long before he killed him.

title: Scavenger
overview: Spring, 2019. Cody disappeared one night. He left his father $167 and Isaac a note... Now both men are picking up the pieces, never anticipating their paths will cross.

title: All Is Time
overview: The film follows four voters from the same polling station in Rio de Janeiro between 2002 and 2022. Over the course of 20 years and three Lula elections, time transforms their convictions, affections, choices, and the very way they view the world.

title: A Murder
overview: Crows.

title: Geriga
overview: In the remote village of Naivad, Kerala, villagers follow GERIGA, a sacred ritual to summon the dead. Desperate for viral fame, Vijay and his four YouTuber friends stage the ritual as a hoax, but horror strikes when Vijay is possessed just as news breaks of his father's sudden death. Now, the group must fight supernatural forces and finish the ritual in twelve days to free him before time runs out.

title: What Shall We Do with a Drunken Sailor?
overview: A Captain and his crew are sailing the high seas when their voyage is unexpectedly interrupted by the arrival of the authorities.

title: Long Live Kong
overview: A gigantic gorilla travels to Hollywood to become a movie star. Once established as an icon, a powerful businessman offers him a world tour. Thus, the gorilla travels to Argentina in 1978, where he is last seen in Mar del Plata.

title: Light it Before it Burns
overview: The notion of protected natural areas as an untouchable open-air museum is increasingly coming up against the reality of climate change. According to experts, one of the paradoxical tools for landscape regeneration could be controlled burning and the temporary destruction it entails. However, in Markéta Ekrt Válková’s documentary, scientific arguments and positive examples from abroad come up against the scepticism of domestic firefighters and politicians, as well as the deep-rooted fear and ignorance of the local population.

title: Where Do Black Men Live?
overview: Where Do Black Men Live? explores the experiences of low-income and housing-insecure Black men in Cambridge, Massachusetts, amplifying voices too often excluded from conversations about housing, urban policy, and racial justice. Produced by The Black Response and based on 25 ethnographic interviews conducted by Haitian sociologist Stephanie Guirand for her doctoral research, the film uses a verbatim theatre approach, with its dialogue drawn directly from the words of the men interviewed. Eight men, portrayed by actors, are brought together in an imagined circle where they share deeply personal experiences of searching for, securing, and maintaining a place to call home. Directed by Corinne Spencer, with co-directors Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga and Joy Wrolson, Where Do Black Men Live? transforms research and lived testimony into an intimate exploration of housing insecurity, systemic racism, resilience, and the fundamental question of who gets to feel secure and at home.

title: Peripheries
overview: Multidisciplinary artist David Hartt (Canadian, born 1967) transforms John Vanderlyn's immersive historical painting, Panoramic View of the Palace and Gardens of Versailles (1818–19), into a dynamic contemporary installation, offering viewers the opportunity to explore questions of place and perspective.

title: The Taste of Democracy
overview: Worldwide, 545 restaurants currently hold two Michelin stars. Earning two stars is a rare achievement. Closing such a restaurant to start again takes courage. In 2018, Onyx in Budapest became the first restaurant in Central and Eastern Europe to earn two Michelin stars, thanks to Katalin Pintér's dedication. In 2020, she transferred a 42.5% stake to her daughter Anna, who boldly decided to reinvent Onyx.

title: Scenes from a modern wedding
overview: Guilherme Gomes’s signature documentary approach to Daniela and Fernando’s wedding.

title: Maman Bibi Coco
overview: Célia, a mother in her thirties, finds herself suffocated by the daily demands of full-time parenting with a young son she can’t bring herself to stop breastfeeding, a fading marriage with her clueless yet devoted husband Bastien, and the grief of her father's recent death. Her fragile routine is upended when she meets Jérémy, a fellow parent who ignites her passion for music and awakens long-dormant feelings. Written, directed by and starring real-life couple Célia Millat and Bastien Garcia, this charming and intimate feature debut captures a woman at a turning point, exploring the vertigo of motherhood, the return of desire, and the challenge of finding one’s balance.

title: Power-Man
overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.

title: Double Edge
overview: A gripping, razor-sharp independent British thriller filmed on the streets of London. Double Edge follows Alex (Ryan Hill), a man pulled deep into a high-stakes web of crime, fluid loyalties, and espionage. Forced into a deadly game of survival against the ruthless Kane Voss (Taner Hassan), Alex quickly learns that in this world, every choice is a double-edged sword.

title: One Last Day In The UK
overview: On her 28th birthday, Kyle is determined to enjoy a special day with Kieran, her partner of four years. As they move through London together, Kieran fills their day with thoughtful surprises, affection and moments that remind Kyle of why she fell in love with him. But beneath the celebrations, something feels wrong. Kieran is distracted, unusually emotional and increasingly desperate to make the day perfect, while Kyle struggles with the familiar loneliness she has felt within their relationship. As the day unfolds, the couple find themselves caught between the love they still share and the difficult realities neither of them has been willing to confront. What begins as a celebration of their life together gradually becomes an emotionally charged reckoning with what their future might look like. One Last Day in the UK is an intimate Black queer romantic drama about love, loneliness, sacrifice and the painful moment when loving someone may no longer be enough to stay together.

title: Rebellion
overview: In 1981, 12 young Asian men stood trial on terrorism charges for defending Bradford from an imminent racist attack. Their fight for their city – and their freedom – became international news, awakening public consciousness to the rise of fascism and the far-right.

title: Advisor 101
overview: Short film version of 4EVE's music video ที่ปรึกษา

title: Sly's Pack
overview: Nesmith, Gary, & Tony are smoking weed on the roof of a parking garage, but as they leave, they see what appears to be a cult, and the trajectory of their night takes a turn for the worse.

title: The List of Unpredictable Things
overview: An absurd nightmare experienced by a young artist whose anxieties stem from worrying about unpredictable disasters.

title: Fantasy Art. Luis Royo, Romulo Royo, Goya
overview: Luis Royo, one of the world's leading fantasy art illustrators -an artistic style that encompasses sword-and-sorcery, science fiction, strange creatures, and the grotesque- and Romulo Royo, an internationally renowned painter, embark on a journey to Italy inspired by the most fantastic side of Francisco de Goya. We enter a universe of beauty, struggles, heroes, and heroines that goes beyond his canvases.

title: The Ring
overview: Alone in his apartment, a man begins to suspect he just might not be.

title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
overview: Hidden Colors 6 examines overlooked stories of Black American resistance, resilience, innovation and cultural survival.

title: Senrab
overview: London, 2026. As independent music venues rapidly shut their doors, new bands like Senrab are forced to take their voices underground.

title: Fever Dreams
overview: Nick pieces together a mystery from his childhood: who, or what, killed his mother.

title: Two Prayers
overview: A Muslim man seeks a new place to pray, leading him to the local church.

title: كوبايه قهوه
overview: cup of coffee

title: The Big Nothing
overview: A delusional crime scene cleaner searches for a way out of the life, an impossible feat in the face of his vengeful boss.

title: Skyclimber: Scaling the Eiffel Tower
overview: Urban free climber Adam Lockwood attempts to scale the Eiffel Tower in a documentary that is equal parts high-altitude adventure and intimate personal portrait. A film that builds its tension with the precision of a heist movie, mapping every step of an audacious ascent.

title: The Hunting Blind
overview: Two friends reunite at their old hunting blind. But soon, one of them will begin to wonder if they are the only ones there...

title: The Ordinary Star
overview: Actor Nawazuddin Siddiqui is asked to study Ashok, the actual resident of the room the actor is going to inhabit for the filming of Star, Dibakar Banerjee’s short in Bombay Talkies, 2013. The fiction director, the documentary filmmakers and the actor, bit by bit, construct the lead character of Bombay Talkies, Porandar Vithal. Ashok feeds this construction through his own life. The Ordinary Star is a documentary that ponders over the nature and cost of the cinematic process, it’s invasiveness, it’s need to devour so that it can create, and the endless search to live a life less ordinary.

title: Pittsburgh Bad Lieutenant
overview: A Pittsburgh cop fights for peace and social justice while evil forces conspire to destroy him.

title: Sensibilities of the Heart
overview: Two friends pour their hearts out over a tension-filled dinner.

title: B0YG1RL: VISUAL ALBUM
overview: REALITY / TV  / V-I-N-E-T-T-E / HARDCORE QUESTION / MOND LAN FINI / DJ TRAVELLA / power off / FOLLOW ME / SHOW ME / new wave / GAZÉE / IAMNOT / angel

title: Kinship
overview: Embark on a global journey, with a seasoned world traveler as your guide, as we seek to understand our changing relationship with animals. With food, tradition, and innovation as our touchstones, we'll see what it means to leave behind exploitation in favor of compassion and kinship.

title: Where Is My Head 2
overview: khmer movie

title: Believers
overview: A ragtag amateur cricket team from the UK tours The Gambia to face a national side far beyond their level. As losses mount and bonds deepen, they discover what the game truly means to them.

title: Eye to Eye
overview: Tyler wakes up with the ability to read others’ minds upon making eye contact, but must immediately say their thoughts out loud. Now he and his friend Brick must get rid of the curse.

title: The Innocence of Water
overview: In a community in Jujuy, where access to water is a privilege, Pamela works for Amelia, who is responsible for the town's water crisis. As the neighbors confront her, a children's game pushes the conflict beyond its limits.

title: James McNeill Whistler
overview: Tate Britain is now holding the first major retrospective of Whistler in three decades. This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.

title: American Voices 2026
overview: Over the past six years, a team of filmmakers has been following more than a dozen Americans in eight states across the U.S., charting their views about changes in the country and in their own lives. Now, a month before the midterm elections, how are these Americans — from a doctor to a pastor to a barber to a construction company owner to a retiree — feeling about the direction of the country? "American Voices 2026" asks how their hopes and fears have evolved amid another polarizing election season, a faltering economy, and a war with Iran that's now in its eighth month.

title: A FATHER FIGURE
overview: A behind the scenes look at the inspiration behind Jon Bellion’s third studio album ‘FATHER FIGURE’ and the lead up to his live performance at Forest Hills Stadium.

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: Hypnagogic
overview: A man suffering from sleep paralysis falls asleep, but how does he know when he's actually woken up?

title: I TAKE STRAYS
overview: A quiet disappearance unsettles the seemingly ordinary life of a mother and daughter. As the days pass, subtle cracks begin to appear, leading Mandy toward something she was never meant to find.

title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

title: Rise of the Pumpkin: The Curse of Billy Hollow
overview: A young boy stumbles upon a pile of pumpkins in the woods and decides to destroy them, unknowingly summoning a ruthless, pumpkin-faced killer who begins to hunt him down on Halloween night.

title: H30: The Ultimate Halloween
overview: October 31, Halloween. Michael Myers escaped the asylum and now he has only one goal: to kill his sister Jamie and everyone who stands in his way.

title: Song Bird
overview: Coming up on the one year anniversary of her grandmother's passing, Taloa, a young, mixed-Choctaw woman, is still deep in the throes of grief. One night, a mysterious man steps in to help.

title: Gabe's Sister
overview: Two young siblings get ready for their dad's anniversary church service while navigating unspoken tensions in the household.

title: Lads Being Lads: Well & Truly Fucked
overview: The lads, whilst on the run from the ever persistent and ruthless Deputy O'Leary, seek aid from Greyville's local street merchant and all around odd case, Dalondis. Who offers his hand in keeping the lads out of O'Leary's relentless sight as he continues to hunt them down for a crime they are unaware of.

title: Providentia
overview: Just how far will a village go to ensure their god of harvest is satisfied?

title: I suoi occhi mi parlano ancora
Run
overview: London has fallen. Food is scarce, hope is fading, and the undead roam the streets. When two survivors embark on a dangerous supply run, an encounter with the infected forces them apart. Alone in a city overrun by the dead, each must fight to survive and find their way back to the other.

title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet!
overview: Based off the Wattpad Series by PRNCSPLM the third book in the series following The Both Sides Of Me. The last and final year of Junior High in 10 Sapphire everything changes when Chase's Ex Mackzyn transfers in his school and his section.

title: Haití Deportation Crisis
overview: Earlier this year, the Trump administration ended temporary legal status for hundreds of thousands of Haitians who had fled violence and upheaval for the U.S.  The administration said Haiti was now safe enough for them to return home. But what is the reality on the ground?

title: Gravidade Zero, Confusão Total: Dois Alunos Fora de Órbita
Gaffer
overview: As the manager of an unruly Sunday League team, the Gaffer lives for the 90 minutes every week where he’s in total control. But when his best player goes missing just minutes before the most important game of the season, the Gaffer’s fragile authority begins to crumble.

title: Dead Crows
overview: A paranoid teenager, at home alone, becomes haunted by the spirit of a boy that he killed, and the two try to find absolution with one another.

title: Which Way I Fly Is Hell
overview: A landscape film built around a slow descent, from snow-covered summits into the depths of a frozen abyss. Light and sound slip inexorably downward until they encounter a strange presence: a sine wave transformed into a voice, unreal, obsessive, and spectral. Borrowed from John Milton’s Paradise Lost, the title Which Way I Fly Is Hell evokes a trajectory of descent in which every direction seems to lead deeper into the abyss.

title: Dreamscape
overview: Dreamscape is a quest on the weight of times we never imagined would become our reality. In the quiet hours of sleep, when our defenses soften, buried emotions rise to the surface, often more vivid than waking life. For those shaped by migration and marked by generational trauma, dreams become both a refuge and a mirror. This film explores how the unconscious mind reflects collective and personal struggle. It journeys through the inner worlds we create to survive, to heal, and to simply endure whether that's building coping mechanisms through faith, art, somatics or activism.

title: Held in Trust: The Future of Hawaiʻi’s Public Lands Beyond Military Leases
overview: A half-hour documentary examining the history of U.S. military use of Hawaiʻi’s public trust lands and the consequential decisions approaching as longstanding military leases begin to expire.

title: The Date
overview: Blanca has a date with herself on the streets of Mexico City. Through pop aesthetics, femininity, and playful exhibitionism, the film explores the intimate relationship between a woman, her body, and the city where she lives.

title: Infectious
overview: Years after a global collapse caused by a strange pandemic, a former healthcare worker testifies in court about an illegal transplant operation that may have triggered the outbreak. What began as an illegal heart transplant ended up releasing a virus capable of turning those infected into violent, cannibalistic creatures.

title: The (First) Last Screenplay
overview: Debbie Scott, an influencer turned film producer, clings to the crumbling illusion of her studio's success. Until reality itself begins to fracture, forcing her to confront a truth no amount of editing can fix.

title: Where do I go from here?
overview: Majd and Shahfaisal live together in a residential group for unaccompanied refugee minors in Germany. Here, in the protected environment of the group, for the first time after fleeing, they should be able to live a life true to who they really are: teenagers who are just developing a personality, have dreams and are looking for their place in society. But how is this supposed to work if they are not even part of this society due to their refugee status?

title: Jesse's Birthday 2005
overview: When Mark films his friend's birthday party, he finds a stranger slowly intercept the party. Mark must therefore try to figure out the stranger's identity before the stranger completely takes over.

title: Never Again
overview: Historically, war has been regarded as a man’s domain, making the presence of women on blood-soaked battlefields all the more heroic. Yet neither men nor women, nor humanity as a whole, have managed to make any previous war the last one. The Doomsday Clock keeps ticking forward, and there is no reason to stop its second hand.

title: The Forbidden Aunt
overview: An actress documents her enigmatic Serbian aunt's story, revealing family secrets and personal history in a dark comedy exploring female trauma across generations.

title: Chambord : les derniers trésors d'un géant de pierre
Faites du bruit pour Jésus
overview: Journalist Clément Hamelin seeks to understand why young people of his generation are converting to evangelicalism.

title: Brief glimpses of ahead
overview: I left the psychiatric hospital yesterday. I filmed myself in the shower of the CAPSUL 17 emergency unit. I felt the need to create something that would bear witness to the mixed-state episode I went through. This is the film made during my bipolar episode.

title: Kirkasta Valoa
overview: A young criminal's dreams of a big deal go south as he goes on a surreal voyage through life and death.

title: The Unknowing of Things
overview: The ten-minute Pragmatognossia plays with the letters of the Greek alphabet, through the voice of a small child who is coming out into the world for the first time. Old photographs, worn documents, faded seals, handwritten notes, tax registers, invoices, stamps, ... cracks in time but also little flames that keep the entire memory of the state alive, frame by frame".

title: La Prospettiva [1653]
overview: Perspective and permanence inform Ben Russell’s playful La Prospettiva (1653), filmed in the Colonnade at the Palazzo Spada in Rome, capturing the central composition of the Baroque illusionism masterpiece but also modest moments of the labour  dedicated to its upkeep.

title: "Gunslinger"
overview: Improvisational found-footage film made using a moviola

title: The Undiscovered Country
overview: In the wake of a college student's unexplained disappearance, her classmates struggle to make sense of her absence, a mosaic of overlapping memories, fragmented conversations, and shifting perspectives begins to reveal the complex truths they have concealed from one another, and from themselves.

title: Lotus
overview: Sultan, an illiterate elderly woman, searches for her hospitalized husband's room. Wandering through the hospital's labyrinthine corridors, she crosses paths with completely different lives and confronts the harsh realities of life.

title: The Faust Bible: How Murnau Made Magic
overview: The groundbreaking visual effects of F.W. Murnau’s FAUST have remained shrouded in mystery since its release 100 years ago. Now, the publication of a long-lost book assembled by the filmmaker’s closest collaborators has revealed the spectacular secrets of this expressionist masterpiece. Utilising a trove of newly-unearthed sketches and on-set photographs, this exclusive Program Notes short documentary by Amos Levin and Ben Porro explores the artistic vision and technical wizardry behind the film’s most astonishing sequence: the flight around the world.

title: Caboose
overview: A short train ride in a foreign country

title: Get Lost
overview: Lost deep in the woods, a hiker's journey takes an unsettling turn when he encounters a stranger.

title: The Gendered Feed
overview: Every day, people are on their phones scrolling TikTok with the algorithm built for them. A video about confidence becomes a gateway to the manosphere. A makeup tutorial leads to a spiral of unattainable beauty standards. Curiosity tips into radicalisation. The ‘Gendered Feed’ follows a team of young researchers who set out to understand how this happens, creating blank accounts, watching what the feeds become, and tracking how gender shapes the spiral.

title: Britain's Nuclear Bomb Scandal: Our Story
overview: This is the extraordinary story of Britain’s postwar atomic weapons programme and its devastating legacy. The film reveals the full extent of the British government’s nuclear tests in Australia and the South Pacific in the 1950s and 1960s.  39,000 British and Commonwealth servicemen witnessed 45 atomic and hydrogen bombs and hundreds of radioactive experiments. The documentary exposes the debilitating health conditions that have blighted the lives of veterans, descendants and indigenous communities ever since.

title: A Long Way to Go
overview: Exploring the human realities of immigration through the intertwined journeys of three women—nurses who leave their home countries, the Philippines, Ghana, and India, to join the healthcare workforce in the United States. Their stories illuminate the emotional, economic, and cultural complexities of migration, revealing what it means to live between worlds while sustaining deep ties to families and communities across continents.

title: A Night Tale
overview: In the turning of night and day, one girl stays awake; the other seems to have lost her words. They exchange with each other, and their silence—is she her companion, or her reflection? The city will wear away in time, but some frequency still lingers in the damp dark.

title: Lassiguili
overview: This intimate documentary follows a bride-to-be who, according to Manding tradition, must spend the three days before her wedding in seclusion. Silence gives rise to questions: Was her mother afraid too? How can she be gentle, strong and true to herself? Between rituals and prayers, she enters a state of deep introspection and senses there is very much she has not been told.

title: Rainy Day Mother
overview: A mother revisits her old family photographs, now damaged by floodwaters. As she sifts through the fading images, she and her son engage in occasional conversations about religion and marriage.

title: Rust
overview: Accidentally locked out of the theater just minutes before curtain, two young actors and ex-lovers are forced to confront the unspoken truths of their breakup and the fear of a future about to tear them apart.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: 10 Days Apart
overview: To save their fading love, a couple chooses ten days of silence, writing letters instead of speaking. On the final day, he discovers she was fighting a battle alone and loving him more than he ever knew.

title: Seven Circles of Hell
overview: A Ukrainian female soldier and five male soldiers recount the horrors they witnessed and endured on the front line, and their difficult struggle to return to a normal life. The result is a poignant portrait of a generation forced to live with the psychological consequences of a war imposed upon them, and of a society that will continue to bear this burden for a long time to come.

title: Falling Stars
overview: A film by Steven M. Irawan & Avanah Adderson

title: Burning in Dreams
overview: Memories of dreams are like a piece of paper filled with words in our minds, leaving only burnt fragments upon waking. If these memory snippets are edited together, would it be a documentary of nightmares? Or a stream-of-consciousness short film akin to collage art?

title: Stopped
overview: Having lost her mother as young woman Rachel quickly became a mother herself, relishing everything that comes with family life. After losing her father, her dog, and her eldest son leaving home she has found herself at a crossroads, feeling stuck creatively. She decided to find a dancer willing to train her to dance again. This film is the story of that journey, not only of Rachel’s but of the young recently retired ballet dancer willing to make himself vulnerable too. When we don’t know the answers sometimes all we can do is physically move and this film charts this journey of discovery and acceptance.

title: Celebrating Tchaikovski
overview: When an impatient female driver's determination to get past a refuse truck threatens the safety of two bin men who disarm their bully with their own infectious and delightful interpretation of art.

title: Les nouveaux influenceurs, quand le savoir devient viral
Desire to Heaven
overview: A visit to friends gradually turns into a meditative journey, where images of mountains and people acquire an autonomy of their own through sound.

title: Egregore
overview: Two friends meet up at a bar, only to be interrupted by transphobic demons.

title: Air
overview: A selection of memories, dreams, conversations from different places and of different people captured on Tri-X Super 8 film. Everything seems mixed and jumbled up, yet is unified through a dynamic soundscape. This is a film-diary that jumps through time and space, and finds connections between various sceneries and situations, which ordinarily would not find each other together. Made over the course of two years of accumulating footage and sound.

title: The Bride
overview: Undead Elizabeth searches for her husband, for whom she was crafted.

title: Nachtcafé
overview: People seeking shelter during winter in Cologne enter a church. In the darkness, a voice arises. Gradually, a picture emerges of a city marked by those who transit it, but often go unseen.

title: After the Curtain Falls
overview: After joining a school theatre production to cope with a shaky home life, Cole is forced to deal with his trauma directly after a tragic event blurs the lines between art and reality.

title: Luboš
overview: Luboš lives his daily life in fear of dirt. What most people take for granted can be a source of anxiety for him and an obstacle he must constantly overcome. The documentary follows his daily activities, how he copes with his situation, and his journey toward peace of mind.

title: A Photographer in Cannes
overview: Red carpet photographer Erlend Štaub, who has also been the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival official photographer for several years, spends his days at glamorous parties, socialising and taking pictures. Then he spends his nights working on these pictures to deliver them the next morning. He is very much in demand and his talents as a photographer are also highly appreciated abroad. He has been attending the Cannes International Film Festival for fifteen years in a row. It is a hard job that requires social skills and great physical strength. Part of his success is to find out "where is the line when people start feeling great".

title: Next Stop Paneriai
overview: A train pulls into snow-covered Paneriai, raising a cloud of snow in its wake. Eitvydas Doškus’s Next Stop Paneriai offers a distinctive continuation of the cinematic exploration of the city begun in Once Upon a Vilnius. This time, however, the railway becomes the axis of a story about multilayered time. Traces of the past are preserved by the Paneriai Memorial and an abandoned tunnel inhabited by bats, semi-feral cats and crumbling houses mark a vanishing present, while children playing at school turn our gaze towards the future. These layers of time overlap like images changing one after another through a train window, making it impossible to clearly distinguish what has already happened from what is yet to come. A meditative film distinguished by its evocative soundtrack, Next Stop Paneriai creates a sensory portrait of a part of Vilnius that is most often simply driven through.

title: Snakes and Ladders
overview: Two friends give up on revision in favour for a friendly game of Snakes and Ladders.  While playing the conversation that follows becomes as unpredictable as the game.

title: Astrodude: A SolarBalls Movie
overview: An older, future version of Astrodude's son travels back or intervenes to try and stop Astrodude from going missing on his next major space mission.

title: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
overview: A man is sentenced to death by hanging at Owl Bridge during the American Civil War.

title: The Writer 2
overview: A writer, who is a former pilot, faces difficulties while writing a new screenplay.

title: Border
overview: Holding onto the promise of a new life beyond the border, a young man follows a smuggler through a remote and unforgiving landscape, only to encounter the unexpected.

title: Untitled Cat Commercial
overview: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

title: The Great Maia
overview: "Great Maia" is an extra-special film of the "Dinosauria Animated Series", it is set in the Two Medicine Formation during the Late Cretaceous and follows a young first-time mother Maiasaura as she tries to protect her first clutch of eggs.

title: Burn It All
overview: A young couple, determined to build their future on land confiscated from the Mafia, find themselves fighting an enemy challenging their very notion of resistance and love. A tense, straight horror that will leave you on the edge of your seat.

title: Noir et Blanc
overview: After a month of hiding, Detective M has been called by a police chief to investigate the murder, not knowing if he’s in on it or not.

title: A Mourning Star
overview: Our story follows a young boy lost in a forest who encounters a mysterious fallen star. The star offers to guide him home but as their journey unfolds, it becomes clear that things aren’t quite as simple as they seem.

title: The Black Sheep
overview: When her troubled younger brother bursts into her home covered in blood and carrying a bag of stolen cash, a woman must decide whether to save him or finally let him answer for his actions.

title: Tumbleweed
overview: A mysterious stranger enters an unknown tavern. There he must accept his fate.

title: The House Party Massacre
overview: 8 partying friends are Violently killed by a killer

title: Home Address: Womb
overview: A mother gives birth to her newborn and gets filled with instant dread. She doesn’t want to see her child grow up and leave her. So she arranges to have her baby pushed back into her womb. Her son grows up inside of her, where she can keep him safe.

title: Riversong
overview: A fisherman faces his past with the help of a river spirit.

title: Evil Spiderman
overview: Evil Spider-Man comes home to a pissed off roommate

title: Manual Wind
overview: Carlos, a young funeral home worker, steals belongings from the dead. When he secretly sells his late father's watch, the object begins a journey that connects several lives across Mexico City, while tensions with his brother continue to grow.

title: The Horrors of Respawning
overview: Mark invites eight people to the island for a series of challenges, risking their lives to prove a missing member of the SMP has respawned. Meanwhile, JJ's facade begins to slip as the other members reveal secrets that were previously unknown.

title: A Country Dog
overview: Based on Shirley Jackson's short story "The Renegade," A Country Dog follows a family whose move from the city to an isolated rural community promises a fresh start until their beloved dog is accused of killing a neighbor's chickens.

title: The Interned
overview: During an office Halloween party, an intern accidentally unleashes a demon that possesses her coworkers, forcing her to fight for survival - and a shot at a full time job.

title: Le Pimple
overview: A whimsical explanation for why pimples seem to appear out of nowhere.

title: AAA Héroes Inmortales 2026 - Week 2
overview: Héroes Inmortales 2026 is a professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide. It takes place on October 24, 2026, at Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City, Mexico.

title: Microcosmos. A Cabinet of Curiosities
overview: An experimental documentary animation presented as a contemporary Cabinet of Curiosities: a poetic inventory that collects the mythical, the human, and the ephemeral relics of Valencia's urban art scene, touching upon urgent themes of social protest and the fragility seen after the Dana disaster.

title: Shirley Temple (short film)
overview: A silly interaction between a server and a restaurant guest turns into a beautiful moment of connection over sobriety.

title: Sun's Rose, Moon's Lapis
overview: A wounded soldier ventures into a realm where the line between dreams and reality blurs. There, he meets Lapis, who leads him to a castle tower to awaken his sister, Princess Rose.

title: Extraordinary Aliens
overview: This feature-length documentary film, Extraordinary Aliens, started from a personal attempt to document a specific context—people who have migrated from China to the U.S. for higher education in arts and lingered in NYC as art makers and workers. It followed the lives of four artist friends: Lu Zhang, Xingze Li, Yulin Gu, Yushu Wang—how they make work, how they make money, what they eat, where they find home.  And then it grew into broader stories about why and how we stay, or not stay; why and how we make art, or are not able to; about transformation from privileged students to constrained laborers; about being queer, about what kinship means to us when being away from home and the way money and care weaves through; about memory and emotions, vulnerability and interdependence; and last but not least, about making home meals together and sharing recipes.

title: Can GPT Dream of a Pink Elephant?
overview: The film stages quasi-clinical encounters between aphantasic individuals and an AI system, then re-films digital footage on 8mm to return synthetic vision to material fragility.  Approximately 4% of the population has aphantasia, an inability to form visual images in the mind’s eye. They understand what an elephant is, what pink is, yet see nothing when they close their eyes. The film places this absence of inner images in dialogue with an AI system that produces images excessively, asking whether synthetic vision and human non-vision might reveal each other.

title: Kitty
overview: Neurodivergent Kitty, lover of trinkets and Kate Bush, finds her favourite jumper ruined and must find a replacement. When the perfect jumper seems unattainable, she’s left with one choice: sell her precious collections, or risk losing the jumper forever.

title: Freakshow
overview: While a group of mimes are getting ready for a performance, one of them reaches a breaking point.

title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
overview: Unable to reach Lianhua Town, Xiaoqing stumbles upon the frame of a car buried under silt four years ago. Then a wild idea strikes him: restore the car and drive there. Meanwhile, Dapang, eager for a tasty treat, and Gezi, who needs to deliver a letter for his grandma, also need to head to Lianhua Town. They strike an agreement with Xiaoqing. Zhang Zhigao, a volunteer teacher concerned about the children’s education, joins the team to rebuild the car. And so begins this pursuit of a dream. United by the resolve to set off, they embark on an extraordinary journey.

title: Conception Game
overview: When single Missy (39), fresh from heartbreak and desperate to conceive, discovers a world of free sperm, she dives right in. But semen with no strings attached is scuppered when newbie Patrick (40) unwittingly breaks the rules of the game.

title: The Nine O'Clock Trot
overview: Annie (Kalli Tant) is a recent graduate who has spent six months caring full-time for her grandfather. When he dies, she is broke, unemployed, and unable to afford a funeral. Refusing an unbearable council public health funeral, she keeps his death a secret and turns to the local parish priest, becoming entangled with Father Adam (Johnny Vegas).

title: Soundweave
overview: At the end of a lost village, a lost father, and lost memory, there is a sound that shall not disappear.

title: No Tengo Dinero Para La Nostalgia
Matière noire : la traque de l'invisible
The Abomination
overview: A young boy attempts to play the piano, then a ukulele, before abandoning both for static, meaningless black-and-white imagery.
