overview: Sophie and her partner Alex have a meeting with a man who might be able to help Sophie fulfill her dream of motherhood, but things don't go as planned.

title: The Old Gods
overview: Deep from within the ocean, a monster arises to reclaim the earth.

title: Les grands buffets, bouillon : les coulisses des plus grands restaurants
Super 8mm
overview: A boy comes home; no one is there, just a small suitcase in the entryway. He doesn't know what's inside… and, of course, he shouldn't know.

title: Bumble:Shadowed
overview: A routine night out takes a surreal turn when Baciu—long shadow-banned on Bumble—inexplicably gets a new match. The boys soon discover that the app's shadow ban isn't a simple system error, but a terrifying algorithm that gradually erases its victims from reality. They are forced into a desperate race to beat the code before Baciu fades into oblivion, all while the indifferent system silently continues to run.

title: Widdershins
overview: Hazel casts a spell... its effects are different than she expects.

title: Last Stand at Butte City
overview: In 1880 Montana, a reclusive rancher is given 30 days to abandon her homestead when the railroad claims her land, forcing her to confront the trauma that has bound her to it for decades.

title: ROSARIO ORTEGA, CARRER SANT RAMON 9, 08001 BARCELONA
The Windy Day
overview: A single kite string ties four kids together through childhood, friendship, and loss. As their bond begins to unravel, they are forced to confront what it means to grow apart and leave the past behind.

title: Caballero Bonald. Fragmentos de navegante
overview: Caballero Bonald: Fragmentos de navegante is a meta-documentary that blends memory, fiction, and poetry in a journey between Spain and Colombia, in which an actor learns to portray the author at three different stages of his life, embarking on a reverse journey toward lost innocence—from the poet's final years back to his childhood.

title: river man
overview: As a homeless alcoholic struggles through withdrawal, haunting memories and creeping paranoia blur the line between reality and delusion

title: Las orejas no tienen párpados
overview: Mariela unexpectedly reunites with her first boyfriend, Leandro, when an old book she dedicated to him decades earlier finds its way back into her hands. As a love that has lingered for over 30 years is rekindled, Leandro must make a decision.

title: Grilled Cheese
overview: Colby gets possessed by a grilled cheese sandwich.

title: Brew before you cry
overview: In a small coastal town, a ridiculous yet suspicious fatal accident puts a widower under everyone’s watch. A claims investigator who’s been on the losing end for far too long decides this might just be his one shot at getting something right.

title: The Fight to Be Heard
overview: The Amnesty International UK explores the human stories behind protest and the growing pressures faced by protesters in the UK today.

title: Bald Mountain
overview: A balding, middle-aged actor travels to Italy for a hair transplant from an eccentric surgeon in order to revive his dying career.

title: All The Things We Haven't Done
overview: A lonely young man goes through an ordinary day while listening to a voice message, slowly rediscovering the small moments and connections that make life feel a little less empty.

title: The Bovannian Descent
overview: Filmed inside GTA: SA following the plot of a country named Bovannia, undergoing change in it's government continuously, but what is the change that really happens?

title: High Side x Bol d'Or - Le Film
Parky
overview: How did a miner’s son from working-class Yorkshire, who rose to become television’s greatest interviewer and die a knighted Sir, never truly believe in himself? A revelatory portrait of Michael Parkinson – the man behind the ‘Parky’ icon as told in his own words and from those closest to him.

title: All of Us
overview: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.

title: Pasukan Singa Kardus
overview: Akmal and his three best friends roam around Singkawang wearing a cardboard barongsai, searching for someone that can teach them the proper way to lion dance.

title: The Child's Mother
overview: Set in the east German city of Halle, the documentary tells the story of Anne who became a mother at the age of 17. Her daughter Leonie, now aged 14, runs the risk of taking the same path to drug addiction. To break the cycle, Anne is determined to change her life, but can she become the role model her daughter needs before it’s too late?

title: British Museum Stop
overview: A short stop-motion film about two friends’ hatred of the British Museum in Amsterdam.

title: Smile of a single Flower
overview: Ottrai Poovin Punnagai (Smile of a Single Flower)' captures the life of Rajalakshmi Senthilkumar, a Bharatanatyam teacher in Chennai, through the eyes of her son. While it celebrates her role as a mentor, it also reveals the simple, beautiful moments of a small girl whose life blossomed through dance, passion, and devotion. A gentle, intimate portrait of a life lived with grace and love.

title: Anak Danau
overview: Her mother was gone, a void in her heart. But a tiny fish, a gift from her father, filled it with hope. Until one fateful morning, when the fish was nowhere to be found.

title: Under the Red Light
overview: A documentary film about photographer Romualdas Požerskis.

title: The Life and Times of Some Cricket
overview: Filmmaker Evan W. Gerdes challenged himself to shoot and edit a short film in less than ten minutes, and chose to document the movements of a small cricket across the floor of a cafeteria.

title: The Things We Carry
overview: When a filmmaker discovers that her paternal grandmother is absent from her family archive and memory, she begins a journey to reclaim her forgotten life. With only a name and a photograph, she pieces together fragments to build a relationship with an irreconcilable past.

title: A Real Grey Area
overview: Attempting to stage an historical reenactment on Coney Island, a contractor working for a powerful client speaks with a representative from a rental company regarding the unconventional use of an electric generator.

title: Kumarangk: Sacred Women's Business
overview: A bridge divided a state. The Ngarrindjeri women at its heart reclaim their story.

title: Entre a Lei e a Rua
Radiography of Santiago (FM)
overview: One day in June 2026, a camera travels through Santiago by car while the radio stays on without pause. Radiography of Santiago captures an ordinary morning in the city through FM signal

title: Primer amor
overview: Manolo is a young “barra brava”—a fan of the Deportivo Cali soccer club—who must flee the city with Camila, his pregnant girlfriend, after getting involved in a fight between rival fan groups. Manolo and Camila arrive at his grandfather’s house in the middle of the countryside, where they must adjust to a different way of life as the pregnancy progresses and the soccer season unfolds. When Deportivo Cali makes it to the final, Manolo is faced with the decision of whether to travel to the stadium to watch the game and follow his passion for the team or to be present for the birth of his child—a difficult choice for a passionate fan.

title: A Loaf of Bread
overview: By the end of the second World War, three prisoners wish to escape from the train carrying them from one concentration camp to another. To make it happen, they need to get food first.

title: This is a film, and I’m the director?
overview: A filmmaker begins making a film about another artist. She is there to observe, listen, and stay behind the camera. But keeping her distance becomes difficult when the project begins to stir something in her.

title: Oli
overview: A Kānaka Maoli soldier returns to Hawaiʻi after losing a comrade in arms for which he blames himself. Suffering from PTSD and survivor"s guilt, Paʻakai attempts to adjust to being back on the ʻĀina. He struggles to connect with his mother, family, and friends from high school. Recognizing her son is troubled, Kaiʻs mother recommends oli (chanting) as a means to help. Can ancestral knowledge help Kai heal?

title: Phoneia
overview: In a world, where phones dominate our daily lives, we tend to miss out on other aspects of life. We miss opportunities to have meaningful interactions and underappreciate the nature surrounding us.

title: Devilwoman
overview: A film director try to make a good film but then realized the arrangement from producer was awful, the leading actress is not what he wished, even the important prop on set was disappeared. Director wants to make arts but he only feels the pressure from the acclaimed executive producer KIN GEN HAO. Then devilwoman appears, she met someone she loves, but when everything seem so beautiful, she realized there's a big mistake.

title: Cats Cradle
overview: A day at the beach goes awry when Chris is forced to find a new place to live.

title: Sinking Rockaways
overview: A short documentary by Columbia University Graduate School of Journalism documentary filmmaking postgraduate student Sahar Sedaghat, following local resident Quinn Robinson and the Dune Squad as they work to restore and protect New York’s Rockaway coastline.

title: New York Never Let Me Down
overview: Charlotte Wells drops into the YWCA of the Greater Capital Region to visit Paula Spiro, a legendary drummer and drum teacher (whose former students include Luscious Jackson drummer and original Beastie Boy Kate Schellenbach). Having left New York in 2024, the elderly Spiro recalls her life in the city with wonderment and an unerring sense of rhythm, in a tribute to the artists and queer elders being pushed out of the place they shaped.

title: A Peaceful Halloween Day
overview: A young boy sees his brother’s ghost return from the dead to help him overcome his mourning.

title: Sirkular
overview: When her mother falls ill, Putri becomes responsible of her mother's profession of clam-shucking. This role slowly takes Putri to repeat the same tragic cycle that her mother unfortunately experienced.

title: All Bubbles Gone In The Sky
overview: Grace, a 25-year-old woman, looks back on the days before graduation with her friend, Frame. Back then, she had planned to confess her love to him, but that day unexpectedly became the last time they would ever meet

title: Effigy.mp4
overview: When a camping trip goes awry, a couple must double down on their efforts to survive.

title: Transfigurations (An American Gothic)
overview: Charlie Hastings, after vanishing during the Summer of 1993, returns home two years later. His parents, Maggie and Forest, must decide if this homecoming is a miracle or an omen.

title: Show me From Behind the Wall
overview: After several years of distance, Mary Jane agrees to reunite with a group of former friends for a trip meant to offer reconnection and rest. However, the reunion quickly becomes uncomfortable. Old wounds, unresolved conflicts, and buried secrets begin to surface, turning the experience into an increasingly tense and claustrophobic one. Isolated in a house far from the city, the women are forced to confront the past and face the emotional consequences of deep trauma. The film offers a disturbing portrait of the psychological deterioration of a woman pushed to her limits, where sanity dissolves and nothing is exactly as it seems.

title: It’s Time to Come Home
overview: Inside a military hospital we watch the lives and fortunes of people learning to adapt to a new reality. Following a long and hard rehabilitation process, the New Year is coming, with all its festive bustle, and after that, the long-awaited discharge.

title: Watsky x Infinity
overview: "Watsky x Infinity" is the visual film for the album "x Infinity". The 2016 visual album by rapper and poet George Watsky features 18 interconnected music videos for each song on his album of the same name.

title: The Dweller on the Threshold
overview: Following the disappearance of her father, a young woman seeks closure through looking into the last case he was working on.

title: The Ballad of the Dirty Water
overview: For years, agriculture has been blamed for the bad Danish aquatic environment. But farmers believe they don't bear the responsibility alone. For each year, large amounts of untreated wastewater are discharged into the same aquatic environment. But who's right? On opposite sides of a highly topical conflict, the farmers and scientists stand: Is agriculture the biggest culprit - or does the wastewater play a bigger role than previously thought?

title: Epitaph
overview: In Epitaph, filmmaker Cecilia Araneda returns to her long-estranged homeland, eco-processing 16 mm film with leaves and fruit gathered from her ancestral home, weaving a lament for her family’s past and the vanishing landscapes of home.  Filmed in both Chile and on the Tablelands in Canada, a site central to the modern understanding of plate tectonics, Epitaph incorporates eco-processed 16 mm footage, video, documents from public and private archives, and found footage to weave an epitaph to a home in the process of leaving the filmmaker, first as a result of exile and then to the gradual movement of time.  Epitaph has been eco-processed on-site in rural Chile at the site of the filmmaker’s father’s family using boldo, figs, fig leaves, walnut leaves, apples, apple leaves, fall grapes, fall grape leaves, olives, olive leaves, plums, mint, yard flowers and other vegetation.

title: Donbas Within Reach
overview: Dariia Kovalchuk travelled there from Prague with a friend. She remembers Donbas as a place where she spent carefree holidays and fell asleep beneath the stars. Now, however, she finds empty streets and houses scarred by Russian shelling.

title: The Tragic Tragedy of John Low
overview: When struggling Director John Low is the first person to discover the low angle shot, he attempts to capitalise off of the idea by putting it under his own copyright.

title: Joqueta
overview: Filipa, a young jockey whose talent remains undiscovered, lives in her brother's shadow until she has to step in for him in a race after he is injured, finally getting the chance to show who she really is.

title: Welcome Home
overview: "Welcome Home" follows 19-year-old, Riley, an aspiring TV reporter who starts a private investigation into the October 11th, 1979  homicide.

title: Dick Dangerous: Christmas EVIL
overview: The Horror of Halloween returns to steal Santa Claus' energy! Can Dick Dangerous and friends stop the Demon's conquest of Earth, or will it be a Christmas Massacre!

title: Moving in time
overview: An apartment building in the east of the Netherlands, near the German border, is destined for demolition. It is the birthplace of the eccentric Henk, who, sixty years later, still lives there. If you desire nothing else, you are already living in paradise. Henk spends his days on a small stool in his kitchen, listening to pirate radio stations—music that transports him back to a bygone era. The building, once vibrant and defined by its post-war architecture, now stands deserted. As former residents revisit shared memories and reflect upon the past, Henk resists the inevitable.

title: TeleXZikora
overview: Zikora leaves her polished but lonely life in Houston for a semester at Lagos Metropolitan University.

title: Bekel-Bekelan
overview: An unexpected incident! A teenager find six "Bekel Balls" left in front of his door. What happens next? No one knows. But don't take it too seriously. Because what happens next isn't important anyway... At least for him.

title: Fabrica
overview: A collection of portraits from Drobeta-Turnu Severin and its surroundings.

title: Ananab Ananab
overview: When an eleven-year-old boy loses his mum’s attention to her new church (and a charismatic but creepy pastor), he must learn to speak in tongues to get her back.

title: Just How Things Are
overview: Clement just lost the love of his life. Failing to reconnect with his sister, Nelle,  he learns that he must take drastic measures to ensure the possibility of ever reclaiming the ideal life he once had.

title: Sweet Fang
overview: Bored with the taste of blood, a vampire finds sweet relief in a feast of red confections.

title: Hermit
overview: A young programmer fools his boss after discovering an AI capable of doing his work in seconds, but the abundance of free time drags him into a physical transformation of Kafkaesque proportions.

title: EXO PLANET #6 - EXhOrizon [dot] in CINEMAS
overview: EXO brings the grand finale of its sixth solo tour, the [dot] encore concert of EXO PLANET #6 - EXhOrizon, to cinemas around the world. The show is broadcast live on 8 November 2026, with delayed screenings in some territories, on the big screen with immersive sound.

title: Quick Fix
overview: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

title: Cena Familiar
overview: Unable to accept their parents' death, Silvia decides to bring them back to life to celebrate one last family reunion.

title: wedding songs
overview: In 16th century Shingly (Kochi, Kerala) Kabbalist Nehemiah Ben Abraham Mota was rumoured to have the power of levitation. This film assembles the ruinous remnants of the places where these and other miracles occurred.  His legacy are a series of wedding songs precariously assembled and archived, danced to by an interfaith following who worship him as a village deity.  Using celluloid processed by hand, wedding songs is a collaboration with Mota’s light and the body of the film.

title: Birds on Ice
overview: In winter, the frozen lake in Ladakh, a high-altitude region in the Himalayas, becomes an ice rink where children train for ice hockey. Young Tashi loves the sport more than anything, but her family cannot afford even a pair of skates. As she waits endlessly for her nomadic parents’ return, her grandfather grows older, and her best friend is preparing to move away.

title: Final March
overview: A soldier returns home from a long combat deployment, his house seems different than he remembers

title: Replanting a Garden
overview: After a devastating coral bleaching event, Jamaican fishers, scientists and sanctuary wardens search for resilient coral to restore their reef. As they replant and rebuild underwater nurseries, their efforts reveal how conservation can strengthen both ecosystems and the coastal community that depends on them for survival.

title: Hunting Rabbits
overview: 3 girls hunt men for sport in a local nearby forest.

title: Wolf's Egg
overview: A child growing up in the countryside is caught between the masculinity role imposed on them and the identity they find in fairy tales, while in real life also being forced to become a wolf.

title: The Man in The Mirror
overview: To Emma, her husband Jason’s death was a painful mystery. To the police, it was an open-and-shut suicide case. But to P.I. Alan Schmidt, it was a descent into madness he’s desperate to forget. Haunted by the memory of Jason’s frantic rants about a malevolent entity lurking in the mirror, Alan retraces Jason’s final hours.

title: The Unrooted Bloom
overview: In a fractured America, a biracial woman journeys between her White conservative roots and her Black ancestral past, confronting the cost of identity in a nation built on division.

title: Kyle Kinane: Vermont Comedy Club
overview: Filmed in Burlington Vermont at the Vermont Comedy Club on July 20, 2024 and added to Kyle's Youtube channel with no further details or description

title: Абаасылаах хаус 2. Финал
overview: After the death of a friend, a group of young people travels to a cursed alaas to fulfill his final wish. However, instead of a simple farewell, they find themselves in a realm where the boundary between the living and the dead has all but vanished. To escape, they must confront otherworldly forces, find unexpected allies, and defeat an ancient evil. Beneath the series of wild, humorous, and perilous adventures lies a story about true friendship, self-sacrifice, and the courage to let go of those who can never return.

title: Driving Lesson
overview: First time behind the wheel, and the person who sat beside us through it

title: The First Date
overview: Two women hit it off in a bar and embark on an unforgettable psychedelic first date.

title: Arriving: 2015
overview: 2015, the year of the so-called “refugee crisis”: Hundreds of thousands of people sought refuge in Germany from war and persecution. Once there, they faced numerous challenges: They had to settle into and make a life for themselves in a country that was foreign to them. Ten years later, eight refugees meet for the first time—and look back on their shared experiences.

title: Dehumanized
overview: Evelyn is no stranger to street harassment from vulgar men — she has to bury herself in her phone just to stay sane while walking home. However, as she slowly loses her identity to being the victim of a gore-obsessed stalker, this dependency on distraction leaves her unaware of just how dangerous her situation has gotten.

title: Daylight: A Twilight story
overview: Aless, an adaptive teenage girl discovers the wonders of the Twilight saga and becomes obsessed with it.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: Investigative reporter George moves to New York, but needs a roommate. Knowing no one else in the city except her childhood best friend Trish, George agrees to move in with Trish’s city bestie, Avery, an aspiring actress and full-time mess. Due to a clash of personality and a series of mishaps, the two women quickly end up at each other’s throats – and competing for Trish’s friendship. Until one day when Trish mysteriously vanishes. The women are then reluctantly forced to team up to track down their friend, only to discover that Trish’s disappearance is just the first of many secrets.

title: Ohana Vendors
overview: A documentary about the incredible employees that work for Blind Vendors "Ohana, the largest employer of blind and low-vision staff in all of Hawai"i.

A high school boy experiences his first crush and overthinks every small detail, looking for guidance from his American MMA partner who lives a fast-paced expat lifestyle. After trading all their so-called philosophical advice, both guys face their own bitter failures in love and realize there was never any formula to begin with.

title: Kiva - Call of the Wisdom Keepers
overview: In 1968, medicine man Raymundo Tigre Perez (Mexico/USA) had a vision. He saw Indigenous Wisdom Keepers from all over the world united in a circular pit – with a fire in the heart – performing a ceremony. A spiritual ceremony for the Earth, for Peace and well-being of all living beings.  Only later he discovered that this was a KIVA, an ancient ceremony of 3000 years, already used by the Original Peoples of North America (Turtle Island). Hundreds of native Wisdom Keepers answered his Call and these KIVA ceremonies have been taking place around the world for more than 30 years. The KIVA ceremony is a collective CALL from the Original Peoples of all continents: they have never lost touch with the Earth and with this Ancient Wisdom and Original Principles, they can remember and inspire us to restore the balance with the Earth and with each other!’

title: He's Not Alone
overview: An idealistic man struggles to cope with the fact that his nightmare from the night prior might have actually been real.

title: Perpetual Agony Mechanism
overview: A man is seen performing a transaction to procure his needs, only to expend his newfound energy toiling away for more resources.

title: On Wild Horse Plains
overview: A man travelling across the central plains of Australia is bound to four mysterious bags in the tray of his ute - soon he must confront what they contain.

title: Under the Peach Trees: The Story of the Hochstetler Family
overview: A massive family association gathers hundreds of people from across the country to celebrate their common ancestor: An Amishman named Jacob Hochstetler. Living on the frontier of the French and Indian War, this family’s faith is tested as they are attacked, kidnapped, and adopted into a new way of living that would change the family forever.

title: From Darkness to Blue
overview: A woman and a group of environmental volunteers struggle to protect sea turtles as they work to heal the damage caused by human activity. Through an observational approach, From Darkness to Blue explores the sacrifices made to protect these creatures, the challenges faced along the way, and humanity's responsibility toward nature.

title: The cycle of life
overview: A can of soup reflects on its role in feeding humanity and wonders whether it will be remembered after it is gone.

title: Titanic : les 10 faces cachées du mythe
Floating, Rest
overview: In a secluded forest, the emotions of three men intertwine.

title: The Godawan
overview: Resurrection of the great Indian Bustard shown by stop motion film created with blue pottery.

title: The Chase
overview: A middle-aged man who is in the habit of smoking begins to be confronted by the image of an elderly lady every time he does so; as the woman’s presence becomes more frequent, the smoker begins to rethink his habit.

title: My First Time
overview: A witty and warm story about Nada, a woman who believes she doesn't need a man to be happy, and Antonio, a professional male escort whom she meets at the urging of a friend. Their unexpected encounter develops into a sincere friendship full of humor, charming dialogues, and twists.

title: King of the Jews
overview: When Alice and Benj’s eight-year-old Jewish son, Ezra, is cast as King Herod in his school Nativity, the couple clash over whether to intervene. The debate escalates as the two argue over who has final say in an interfaith family. Benj, playing the ‘Jewish card’, insists they should stay out of it, scarred by memories of his own overbearing parents, that is, until he sees Ezra’s gleefully murderous rehearsal.

title: Dirty Dose
overview: Trapped in an endless routine, a forensic medical examiner spirals into heroin addiction and becomes a victim of illegal organ trafficking. Losing her grip on reality, she begins hunting a mysterious man who may have destroyed her life.

title: The Clouds of Odessa
overview: February 24, 2022. Veronika Vasylyeva, a Ukrainian film director and screenwriter, falls into a state of deep sadness over what is happening in her country and the uncertainty surrounding her future in cinema. During the war, she begins to think about the film she had always wanted to make, one she may never be able to bring to life: a love story.

title: Through the Dust of Time
overview: Wugou Village faces cultural erasure as young people migrate away. The ancestral farmlands and grand "huofang" estates have become hollow monuments. Alan and her friend Amei remain within these quiet walls. Their daily exchanges capture the profound resilience and quiet fate of traditional Hakka women.

title: Techiq
overview: Margarita and Evaristo, a peasant couple, live alone in their hut at the foot of the Malintzin volcano. Every day they wait for the Techiq bird to announce the return of their son, who migrated long ago in search of work and has not returned. One morning, Margarita falls ill, and a forest creature appears before Evaristo. Is it death, or something more?

title: Faith (Short Film)
overview: One man goes through the same routine day by day with the responsibility of saving the world, but he will discover something that will question everything he's ever known.

title: Neighbors from the Sky
overview: Over the span of three years, the film captures the depletion of the wild bird population surrounding one person’s home during a spike in the avian flu.

title: Contumazá
overview: A contemplative gaze toward the town of Contumazá, in the northern highlands of Peru. Beginning with a murder that occurred a century ago involving the director’s great grandfather, the film reflects on the passage of time through the daily routine of her mother, conversations about an event that is almost forgotten, and the faces of the townspeople. The landscapes and traditions of the town gradually reveal the beauty, solitude, and poetry of its inhabitants.

title: I'll Be Doggone
overview: Describing the last visit to a loved ones home, stripped of its character and put on the market, with the backdrop of the destruction of the animatronic band, The Rock-afire Explosion.

title: Journey to the End of the Ego
overview: The scene is the almost mythical landscape of Ben Loyal, one of Scotland's most remote mountains towering over the Arctic Ocean. The cliff is one of the finest sweeps of clean unclimbed rock to be found anywhere in the land. The climber is the thought-provoking controversial live-wire, who goes by the name of Franco Cookson. This is the epic story of the UK's most dangerous trad route and the 105 days of climbing it took to realise one man's dream; 'Nothing is Lost' E12 7a.

title: Louve, une vie dans les Alpes
The Things That Vanish
overview: In an old house by a remote lake, 81-year-old Sumie lives alone, her memory slowly fading. Michi, the 27-year-old caregiver who comes to look after her, has a slight tendency to steal. Michi feels guilty for not having returned an old wristwatch she found.

title: Nine Mountains: Paraghost
overview: Gongneum, driven to the brink of death by school violence, awakens from a three-year coma. Following Yeosunji, a shaman who claims to know about her memories and her family's whereabouts, she heads to Ahopsan Forest. There she encounters the bullies, including their ringleader Kim Gayoung, and confronts memories of her forgotten past. Inspired by the real Ahopsan Forest in Busan, the dense bamboo grove becomes a space suspended between reality and the otherworld, where spirits of those who died unnatural deaths wander and "parasitic spirits" — restless souls that inhabit other bodies—begin to consume the forest.

title: London Vice
overview: An adrenaline-fuelled, indie heist thriller following an architect caught in the dangerous web of a ruthless mob boss. Forced to orchestrate the ultimate heist, he assembles a crew of four elite thieves for a high-stakes operation: infiltrating a heavily guarded London casino to steal the multi-million-pound "Chameleon Diamond."

title: Un río de aguas profundas y luminosas
overview: In the mid-1970s, as a child, Susana accompanied her father, Pedro Juajibioy, on various journeys throughout the Putumayo region, where he collected plants while dreaming of establishing a botanical garden in his hometown of Sibundoy. Today, together with Susana and Brayan—a young botanist from Sibundoy—we traverse those same paths in the Colombian Amazon, following in the footsteps of Pedro, who is well-known for having accompanied the ethnobotanist Richard Evans Schultes on his explorations of the region between 1941 and 1953. This legacy lives on through the work of Brayan; inspired by Pedro’s original garden—which was destroyed by a landslide in 2000—he has created a new conservation space in Sibundoy and resumed the task of collecting and caring for plants. "A river of deep, luminous waters" accompanies these journeys, revealing how knowledge is passed down through generations and remains vibrant among those who continue to practice it within their own territory.

title: Erô
overview: The term "erô" refers to sacred knowledge within the context of Afro-Indigenous religions. "Erô" is also the nickname of Erodimar - a fierce and resiliente woman, a heroine of the hinterlands.

title: Vangmoolam
overview: A Confession he wants to make. and he wants you all to watch it , But are you sure you can handle it? Try not to be disturbed by it. Maybe he’s inside you, too.

title: The Entwinement of Fate
overview: Su Kinadsusumpat nu Bagi (The Entwinement of Fate) follows siblings Aisha and Ali as they navigate grief and survival within their Moro community after the death of their parents. The only inheritance left behind is their father’s small tinagtag business—a Maguindanaon delicacy that becomes both their livelihood and their last connection to home.  Determined to preserve her father’s legacy, Aisha continues making and selling tinagtag. But as a young lady forced to take her mother’s roles, the burden of keeping the business alive slowly wears on her.  Meanwhile, Ali struggles with the weight of their circumstances. Torn between keeping his father’s memoir and moving forward with his dreams, he began to question whether holding onto tradition is worth the cost. As circumstances deepen, the siblings are forced to confront the grief they have long avoided, the fractures within their identity, and the fragile bond that continues to entwine them together.

title: Csavarhúzó
overview: A man is seen fulfilling purpose alongside the use of his tool compatriot. When their journey ends, an engulfing meaninglessness pursues and haunts them both.

title: How to cut your hair
overview: Dalia lives in a house dominated by routine and traditions. Wanting to cut her hair, she faces opposition from those around her and begins a small rebellion, cutting the frame with scissors, shattering the continuity and logic of her world.

title: Mannerists
overview: In an empty space, two hands meet and try to get closer.

title: You Should Dream of Flying
overview: Children’s games, school essays and driving lessons: summery snapshots that circle around each other from the everyday lives of refugees, held together by the hope of returning to normality.

title: Skin Writing
overview: Particles accumulate under the skin, causing itching and hives that follow the unsuspected lines of unnoticed scratches, minor scrapes, or bumps. Skin writing is an attempt to understand these glyphs that rush to the surface of the skin to project something onto my skin, from the inside out.

title: The Dong Goblin
overview: Despite the warnings of a caring mother, Ashwin can’t resist the temptation of self pleasure. His actions catch the eye of the sinister Dong Goblin who teaches Ashwin a lesson he won’t soon forget.

title: Gushen 2026
overview: New Comedy Theater

title: Gloria
overview: A short film that captures a life-changing dilemma for a Mexican-American bride standing on the brink of traditional expectations. As Gloria prepares to marry her fiancé, Rodrigo, she is consumed by her secret, forbidden love for Emilia—a graceful, queer white woman who refuses to remain hidden in the shadows of heteronormativity. Through flashbacks to the night before the wedding, the film reveals the intense passion and friction between the two women. After an ultimatum from Emilia and a tense discovery by Gloria's sister, Sophia, the reality of their secret shatters the veil of the wedding festivities. Back in the present, Gloria faces a stark ultimatum: if she proceeds with the wedding, Emilia will leave to pursue a life of authenticity and freedom, fleeing the concealment of their relationship. As Rodrigo unknowingly waits at the altar, Gloria is left with the ultimate, breathless choice—honor her cultural tradition, or risk everything to follow a path of true self-discovery.

title: Nine Days of Sadness
overview: An isolated gamer accidentally discovers an analog-style game that promises deep human connection with an anonymous player on the other end of the screen --- only to discover the horrors the game is built on.

title: Never Call Paul: Commercial
overview: A narrative-less short film adaptation of the crime-comedy podcast Never Call Paul using remastered BTS footage from the EvCo Productions archives.

title: On To The Next
overview: Matthew moves out of his apartment complex at UC Irvine only to be met with a ghost of himself roaming his room.

title: Who Raised You
overview: Upon the death of her grandmother, Tia's party boy father inherits her family home. His surprise arrival blows up Tia's life, pushing her grief to a breaking point. With the help of her friend Layla, also grieving the woman who raised her, Tia is determined to run far away. Instead of the escape Tia intended, life offers the girls refuge in each other.

title: El murmullo del agua
overview: During a birthday party, Luca, a sensitive and lonely boy, begins to feel out of place among the other children. As tensions rise, he takes refuge in the fantasy of being a mermaid, imagining a place where he can breathe.

title: The Visitor
overview: Every morning, for a while, Willow Damiani has been waking up on her backyard lawn. She can't remember why or how but when odd occurrences start to happen and a strange figure begins visiting her every night, she begins to question what is real and what isn't.

title: The Many Hands of Sekar Neferu
overview: Seeking to rid his arm of a curse, Kasten heads to the Tears of the First Martyr - a sacred waterfall said to heal any wound. However, upon arrival he is met with a blighted land and an abandoned temple. But is he alone, or do the many hands of Sekar Neferu still guard this ruin?

title: Vulnus
overview: After shaking off a fall, a skater with an injured arm passes by a figure whose gaze penetrates the wound.

title: Stage Kiss
overview: When an intimacy coordinator must advise a real-life couple on a classic scene, unlikely history between both girls blurs the line between love and forbidden desire.

title: 771 Days
overview: "Mom made it home alive from the street protest again today!" As soon as Zainab Entezar opens the door to her home and walks in, she is greeted by her young son and embraces him. She goes to the women’s street protests as though heading to work, and every time she leaves home, she fears she may never see her son again.

title: Nien
overview: Between dream and remembrance, two drifters move through a decaying world in search of a vision that may never have existed, where only the quiet ache of forgetting remains.

title: Doomed
overview: In search of who he really is, Omi uncovers a version of himself he was never meant to find, his Identity, it turns out, it can be its own kind of horror.

title: My Friend, Kev
overview: A filmmaker reconnects with an old friend, quietly revealing the distance time can create.

title: Most Likely
overview: As the night progresses, his crush Gregory seems to be getting closer to him...

title: Apocalypse
overview: 40 years ago, this pine forest saw the Apocalypse. It resurrected once, but will it be able to resurrect after another Apocalypse?

title: Born Twice
overview: At 11, Simon Gronowski jumped from his mother’s arms on a Nazi train bound for Auschwitz. Eighty years later, he plays jazz, speaks in schools, and befriends the son of a Nazi. A film about survival, memory, and forgiveness—told with intimacy, music, and the force of one man’s refusal to hate. His story is a warning, and a gift.

title: Home Sweet Home
overview: Struggling to find his place during his first year at university, a lonely international student finds comfort in an unexpected conversation that reshapes the way he perceives home and belonging.

title: Curtain Call
overview: Theo Burton is confined to a desolate room with no connection to the outside world. He must solve a string of riddles that are given to him by his captor in order to survive.

title: GAZA | The strip of extermination
overview: First film documentary of the atrocious genocide. Without statistics or specialized voices, only "wild anthropology" from the bowels of the Gaza Strip; the cruel experience at the moment of the facts, bombardment, destruction, and the heartbreaking pleas of the children for the ceasefire. The inhuman suffering of the wounded, mostly children and women; the massive displacement to the shelter in Rafah, a place that Netanyahu promised would be safe, but in a crime against humanity was bombed, despite this, on the ruins is celebrated the Ramadan. As humanitarian aid arrives and as a symbol of the unwavering spirit of the Gazan people, the beautiful and sweet Nour (16 years old) performs a song of love for Palestine, dedicated to the victims of all wars and all genocides.

title: MORIAH
overview: In the unforgiving Wild West, a young gunslinger marked with two red crosses over his eyes undergoes a mysterious ritual under the silent watch of mounted men. As he crosses a dry riverbed, he catches a glimpse of a veiled woman and a blindfolded child waiting among the trees, unsure whether they are real or only visions. Haunted by fragments of the ritual that brought him here, he is forced to confront a single irreversible choice, one that will determine whether he completes the rite or becomes its next victim.

title: See the Sea
overview: As a result of a series of unexpected coincidences, one of the three closet-sitters gets out from his natural environment, but in his absence longing for the friends starts to crystalize…

title: Normal Men
overview: A man remembers his “normal” childhood.

title: The Scam Artisan
overview: Day by day, sharp and manipulative Jordon Teaspoon sells modern or as some say: "scam" art to his wealthy, high paying clients. Teaspoon's business is booming as usual, until an old client resurfaces threatening the existence of the phony life Jordon has built.

title: Paris Paloma - Sounds Like Art
overview: Singer-songwriter and self-proclaimed history nerd Paris Paloma performs new arrangements of her songs with a choir and string section at the Museum of Fine Arts in Ghent. Through insights into the works of Hieronymus Bosch, Camille Claudel, Elisa de Gamond and others, she highlights the feminist influence on her songs and her life.

title: Bot Love
overview: AI is being used to fill the void of loneliness, desire, and grief, but can it truly replace human connection?

title: Suspiro
overview: A bakery cashier who can’t cook decides to bake meringue cookies to confess her love to the boy she likes on Valentine’s Day.

title: No Longer Humans
overview: After death inexplicably vanishes from the world, Baron, a drifting trans teen, is pulled into a night of disoriented desire and unraveling violence — where chosen family, fractured identity, and buried memories collide in the horror of becoming no longer human.

title: What Does A Baby See
overview: Through the eyes of a baby, an ordinary day filled with familiar faces slowly takes a darker turn. As night falls, strange things begin happening around the crib, and a mysterious presence emerges from the shadows. But what does a baby really see when no one else is watching?

title: Return to Fear
overview: After surviving a trauma, a woman returns home only to be haunted by her past fears, forcing her to confront demons for survival when evil revisits.

title: Master/Control
overview: After diligently working in service of humanity for years, Stolidistech Operating System model 4.1 - designation “Control” - is caught off guard when his replacement, Stolidistech Operating System 5.1 - “Master” - is brought in to replace him. To buy himself time, Control offers to teach her how to better serve humanity, and in the end, manages to teach her about the simple beauty of life…

title: Les tempêtes, vivre avec le trouble dysphorique prémenstruel
overview: Cléo suffers form PMDD (PreMenstrual Dysphoric Disorder), a mood disorder which affects her psychologically and physically every month before she gets her period. Trying to understand her disorder better, she meets with other people who suffer from it.

title: First Day, Last Year
overview: Jun and Aira spend the first hours of the new year together. A year passes. Photographs, journal entries, and an empty street remain from their encounter.

title: Revenge
overview: a story of friendship, betrayal, and muddy boots

title: Mother's Household Ledger
overview: After moving to a provincial area, I decided to live with my elderly parents and discovered my mother's 50-year-old ledger. At first, it seemed like a simple household record, but as I continued to flip through it, I realized it captured the essence of our family's life. The ledger includes records starting from the day I was born in 1972, revealing various family events, as well as depicting the struggles of my father with unemployment and my mother's diligent management of the household. The ledger, which stopped in 2016, reflected my mother's way of enduring life, and although she is now losing her memory, it allows her to revisit our family's past.

title: Massagers 4 Sale
overview: A young woman's relationship with her father reaches its crisis point when he mistakenly purchases a new line of 'massagers' and 'toys' for their Chinatown gift shop in danger of being closed down.

title: Scroll
overview: A young man's obsession with his phone turns into a brutal struggle when it falls into a narrow gap by his bed.

title: Art, Chaos, Riot
overview: The documentary follows María Riot, an artist, activist, and sex worker from Argentina, as she develops her photography project “Archivo Puta” through conversations, encounters, and photo shoots. It offers a personal glimpse into María’s life, her creative process, and her journey into photography. At the same time, the film explores the portrayal of sex work and questions the boundaries between objectification, self-determination, and political expression.

title: Alone?
overview: A man becomes convinced that he isn't alone in his bedroom.

title: Voyage
overview: nature only

title: Not as I Remember
overview: As the holidays approach, Danas returns to the place where he grew up. There, he reunites with a childhood friend, revisits familiar places, and recalls family stories and moments from the past. However, upon returning, he realizes that much has changed. The places and people that once felt close now seem more distant and somewhat unfamiliar.

title: Bliss
overview: A worker trapped in the monotony of his office job discovers an emotional escape hidden behind his desktop windows

title: Deadly Revision
overview: Udin is a creative worker in the field of graphic designer who is pressured by his client named Tina, a young politician who demands many things from Udin. However, Udin felt helpless with Tina's demands because he still wanted to get the next service projects. So Udin had to be forced to do what TIna wanted.

title: El Arribista
overview: A man, bored of a life without purpose, completely reinvents himself.

title: Uncle, Where Are You Going?
overview: A peculiar journey begins on Jeju Island. The artists transform into Sim Bong-sa and Ppaengdeok Eomeoni, slipping into a playful parody of The Tale of Simcheong, where reality and performance blur. A philosophical yet joyful road movie about failed artists restoring themselves.

title: All Our Voices
overview: Cartagena de Indias, the walled city on Colombia’s Caribbean coast, isn’t the first place that comes to mind when you think of rock. But by the edge of the sea, an alternative music scene pulses with life. Bands move from punk to emo to post-punk to goth, while a community keeps alive the chance to be free from prejudice, the chance to be part of something unique.

title: Bron Lewis - Chaos
overview: Bron's life is complete, utter chaos. Three kids – an emotional tweenager, a four-year old stalker and the middle one. Just when things couldn't get any harder, she bought a puppy. A million plates in the air, even more smashed on the ground around her feet. Bron wears the battle scars of an ex high-school teacher and is still reeling from the initial shock of motherhood 12 years ago. Tackling juggle-parenting, teaching, career change and flailing mental health, if you've ever thought 'if one thing goes wrong, we're all dead meat' this is the show for you.

title: Until We Talk
overview: Rami's 13-year-old daughter is killed in Jerusalem by a suicide bomber. When the grieving father meets Palestinian Bassam, an unlikely friendship develops between the two fathers. They do not yet know what tragic twist of fate will bring them even closer together.

title: Peace 20 30
overview: On October 7th, Maoz Inon loses both of his parents and chooses to transform his grief into a struggle for peace.  He is joined on his journey by Aziz Abu-Sarah, a Palestinian from Jerusalem carrying his own loss. Together, they set an almost impossible goal: peace by 2030. In the face of war, pain, and despair, the film asks whether it is still possible to believe in a different future.

title: Unsettled Soil
overview: When three couples come together for an amazing chance to be in a reality show will quickly realize that this will not be anything they will forget.

title: Forever Home
overview: Forever HOME  follows a young couple’s dream to provide the best possible life for rescued farm animals by rethinking the concept of “home.” At their refuge, they base their designs on the needs of the individual animals, replacing conventional barns with customized homes. Paul, an architect, calls it "animal centered design." With empathy and boundless imagination, they’re bringing architectural design to the world of animal care and providing a blueprint for a compassionate, sustainable future. This unique film is a celebration of life and creativity!

title: Still Life
overview: On a split screen two parallel and contrasting narratives unfold. The world of art and the realm of the everyday are integrally connected and yet hugely disparate. A pair of hands working relentlessly inside a home fade away; while a painting hanging quietly in a museum gains fame.

title: Summer's End
overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

title: Tying The Knot
overview: Moments before a young gay man says “I do”, his father says “No, you don’t”

title: The Forest
overview: A story about primeval forests - a world of subtle connections that have been formed for thousands of years. Cedars, spruces, firs grow here, and on the European continent, such forests have survived only in the north of Russia.

title: Françoise Robbit
overview: The true story of Françoise Robbit, the inventor of the movie trailer.

title: Web Extraction
overview: Arachnophobia is a curious phenomenon.... A research subject reveals his horrifying altered form during a rescue attempt...

title: Roam Around
overview: The class is over, the streets are open, I am alone wandering around the city.

title: Domestic weights and measures
overview: An almost diary, featuring cats and bats, a hearse and horses, and much animation. Backdropped by a community arts project, the “our planet in motion” orrery kit and a new take on timelapse. All elements locally sourced. Experimentally friendly and audience curious.

title: Lights out
overview: Desperate to escape his own life, a shy young man becomes captivated by a girl at a café and attempts to approach her, only to discover that reality is far less appealing than the fantasy he has created in his mind, leaving him unable to find a genuine connection.

title: Unic-Moto 50
overview: Unic Moto follows Estonian motorcycle culture, garage devotion, and a Tallinn-to-Vilnius ride marking the Baltic Way’s 35th anniversary.

title: The Fish & Egoland - The Great Marmolada
Como amar a mixtli
overview: With Armando Montaño, a lawyer, as our guide and friend, we explored various municipalities in the state of Puebla, in the hills and mountains; we investigated the loss of species, the displacement of communities, and their sociocultural implications in the Puebla region. For Armando, who has been climbing mountains for more than 20 years, the loss of flora and fauna signifies a spiritual void, a weakening of humanity. We observed how these communities, steeped in pre-Hispanic legacies, find refuge and a home in the land and how they watch their homes crumble with increasing frequency.

title: Composting Cinema: Essays on the Soil
Fireflies in the Dark
overview: Set amidst the ethnic violence that erupted in 2023 in Manipur, Northeast India, Fireflies in the Dark explores survival, resilience, and the human cost of civil conflict. Three interwoven stories craft distinct but connected portraits of lives caught in the strife: a pregnant woman struggles to give birth as gunfire surrounds her; a young boy searches for his mother with only a displaced stray calf for companionship; and a cafe owner risks her safety to shelter those fleeing for their lives.

title: the thought of the innermost being
overview: A workplace missive flows into dreamlike self-reflection, permeating hypnotic images of labour at a London fishmonger. Thoughts drift with repetition.

title: everything i saw before i returned to your side
overview: A dying mind starts dreaming for the last time before their death. As the dream continues and the mind simultaneously decays, the dream starts to lose its shape.

title: Egg
overview: Mahiro (32), anxious about losing her eggs, forms relationships with the men in her share house through egg dishes. But as she becomes aware of their strange dreams and her own growing obsession, she begins to confront herself.

title: Octobre à Paris
overview: On October 17, 1961, 30,000 Algerians demonstrated peacefully in Paris to protest the discriminatory curfew imposed upon them and to demand Algerian independence. Under the authority of the then Prefect of Police, Maurice Papon, the demonstration was brutally repressed, resulting in the deaths of dozens of Algerians. Historians cite eleven thousand arrests, dozens of murders, demonstrators thrown into the Seine, hundreds of expulsions, and just as many complaints that went unanswered; all for a night that would become a blind spot in the national narrative. No investigation, no trial, and certainly no commemoration. The day after the demonstration, Jacques Panijel began filming *October in Paris* to alert the public to the massacre that had just taken place in the streets of Paris. The film was banned by the French authorities. It obtained a distribution license in 1973. It was first shown in theaters in October 2011.

title: EPIPHANY
overview: Vicente goes back and forth between prison and society because of problems with alcohol and drugs. But the problem goes further, revealing the psychological disorder that keeps him away from his son and redemption.

title: Something Scary
overview: A man returns to his dead father's house and finds a projector and a box of reels. Based on the short story "Six Six Six" by Laird Barron.

title: Los Sagrados Alimentos
overview: Bernie de la Renta is an ordinary worker and family man who must make a great sacrifice to belong to a powerful sect.

title: Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City
overview: New York City has always been shaped by migrants. Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City, collectively created by high school filmmakers from Educational Video Center’s Youth Documentary Workshop, examines what it means to be an immigrant in New York amid increased immigration enforcement and ICE activity under the Trump administration.  Focusing on the experiences of street vendors, the young filmmakers explore the relationship between migration, work, community, and belonging while examining how federal immigration policies affect the people whose labor and cultures help make New York City what it is.  Through a youth-led lens, Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City asks what the promise of a “sanctuary city” means when immigrant New Yorkers continue to live and work under the threat of detention and deportation.

title: Ringos Tally
overview: Set in the Arizona Territory in 1882, Ringo’s Tally follows infamous outlaw Johnny Ringo as he rides alone through the desert, hunted by the law, haunted by his enemies, and slowly losing control of himself. Drunk, exhausted and stranded after losing his horse, Ringo follows a distant firelight to a lonely campsite, where he meets a mysterious stranger carrying a dime novel written about his life.

title: The Scale
overview: Dawson, a submissive people-pleaser, must cut ties with his vanity-ridden friend group led by the conniving Cade.

title: Roaming over the Horseback
overview: On the vast, desolate grassland, injured Mongolian rider Sichintu is forced to end his horse-racing career and return home. Faced with the fate that his beloved horse may be sold, the departure of old friends, and uncertainty about the future, he finally makes a choice true to his heart. He leaps onto the horse’s back once more, reuniting with all that he once lost.

title: SIKLAB
overview: When a college student's secret double life as a masked vigilante is discovered by his oldest friend, the two must navigate their evolving bond and the sudden dangers closing in around them.

title: The Foul-Mouthed Granny
overview: A man's loving memories of tending to his acerbic mother weave together remembrance, routine, and artistry in a lyrical reflection on familial bonds, loss, and generational connections.
