overview: At an art gallery, a disillusioned assistant's pretence of normality is pushed to breaking point when a sudden act takes place.

title: Takkuuk
overview: Takkuuk is an Inuktitut word meaning to be attentive or to look closely. It is often used to describe the environmental and cultural changes in the Arctic. In the film of the same name, we meet musicians and researchers from the Arctic who explore life, communities, and the challenges they face.  The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

title: Fists and Chips
overview: Holly and Three Bellies battle over a bag of chips to discover nothing is worth more than being alive.

title: Not Just Me
overview: A young couple attends a family dinner where no one dares speak the truth.

title: Les Duos Impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11ème édition - 2ème partie
Liquid Courage
overview: An aspiring artist is stuck as a bartender when she is encouraged by a loud, talking bottle of alcohol to throw everything away and chase her dreams.

title: Milk
overview: A tooth extraction introduces a watchful child to his mother’s new love. In Milk, tenderness turns grotesque, ordinary gestures uncanny, and love unfolds as a tale equal parts sweet and unsettling.

title: A Casa É a Ruína de uma Casa
overview: The House Is the Ruin of a House maps a tiny house that has stood for a hundred years at the centre of the mouth of a giant, barely extinct volcano. It speaks of the permanence of this house, but also of its imminent disappearance. It follows the enormous, broad, contradictory, threatening, deafening movements of the earth, the wind, the sea and the weather, and projects a future of extinction onto the present (a landscape that resembles that of a distant past).

title: Run and Hit
overview: Two boys find out how to go back in time and accidentally create a time loop.

title: Render
overview: Luke takes a new drug called 'RENDER' that gives him intense euphoria while he regularly sees a prostitute that he has an abnormal relationship with. After taking this new drug for a period of time, things start to spiral out of control for Luke.

title: CHAPS
overview: When a holiday heist goes sideways, a reckless crew drags their rookie runner into a chaotic game of cops, robbers, and betrayal. As the night spirals further out of control, one bad deal could turn their first big hustle into their last.

title: Like a Monster: a video poem in 5 parts
overview: Vintage filmstrips and projectors were widely used in classrooms during the 1960s and 1970s as educational tools. A filmstrip is a 35mm roll of still images that advances manually through a projector, often accompanied by recorded narration on cassette tape. Unlike digital video, filmstrips do not move continuously; the turning of a knob allows for pauses and reflection. Viewers are cued to advance the frames by a beep in the audio, creating a rhythm that emphasizes attention and shared experience. The project draws inspiration from Dada cut-up poems, in which clipped words from printed materials were rearranged to generate spontaneous and unexpected meanings.

title: Leonidas
overview: Hiro, a young Korean man in Japan, meets Aoi, a digital artist from a wealthy but restrictive family. As their relationship deepens, they visit a charkha studio, inspiring Hiro to create music again. Aoi rejects her family’s corporate expectations and stays at Hiro’s mother’s house. When Hiro gets an unexpected music opportunity in New York, they plan to go together, but Aoi’s father pressures them to separate.

title: My Son’s Sugar Mama
overview: A protective mother discovers a wealthy, older woman is showering her young son with gifts and money. As she sets out to expose her, she discovers the woman's obsession with her son is far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.

title: 2 Lizards
overview: Two lizards are grappling with the reality of the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic in New York.

title: Every Grain of Dirt
overview: Every Grain of Dirt documents life in South Lebanon under ongoing threats of displacement and war. As sweeping evacuation orders force over a million people from their homes, some choose to remain. Among them is Ismail, a shepherd who refuses to leave his village — even as bulldozers arrive to erase it, nearly burying him alive as he stands in defiance before the machine.

title: Simon Says So
overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

title: Agent 67
overview: Agent Abdulrahman has spent years counting the war dead and pinning photographs to a wall. In every photo, a pale man in purple watches from the back. That man belongs to the Family, a dynasty that elects one member each generation as the Sadness Prince. When a photograph of the Agency's own lobby turns up, Abdulrahman opens the Book of Agents and summons Ahmed Mazin, Agent 67.

title: from 5 to 7
overview: Life from 5 to 7

title: Shoulders
overview: On their fifth date, a woman uncovers a dark secret about her seemingly perfect boyfriend.

title: Adi Nyemeh – Daughters of the Forest
overview: Across Arunachal Pradesh, women carry generations of ancestral forest knowledge. Gathering plants, herbs and other produce, they sustain their families while preserving a deep relationship with the forest amid growing social, economic and environmental pressures.

title: MaeBee : The Camping Trap
overview: Mae plans to reunite her parents on a camping holiday.

title: Case File 427-26
overview: A sister brings her brother to see the unfinished house she's moving into. Still under construction and eerily quiet, the property harbors an unsettling presence that neither can explain.

title: KDE: The Documentary
overview: This is the story of KDE — from Matthias Ettrich's 1996 Usenet call for a better Linux desktop environment, through the Qt licensing fight that split the free desktop world, the KDE 4 release that nearly broke the community, and the powerful reemergence.

title: Invasion of the E-Bikes: Scourge of Our Streets?
overview: Investigating the e-bike boom and the rise in illegal, high-speed versions.

title: Kibboutz Nir Oz, aux portes de Gaza
Oliver, talk to me
overview: A portrait of a Sarajevo man.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Personal Whore(or): Ho Ho Ho
overview: As Flynn (Oliver Chally) and Leaf (Marissa Margolin) seek relief from their traumatic experience with The Watcher, they go to an Anti-Christmas party to loosen up and blow off some steam. This party, hosted by the rebellious daughter of Santa Clause (Greta Van Eck), takes a wicked turn as someone is mysteriously murdered. Flynn, once again, must solve the mystery, and get the party goers home for the Holidays.

title: March of the Jaguars
overview: Follow the journey of three jaguars in the Pantanal region.

title: a tour of hollow contortions
overview: A girl attempts to give a tour of the UNCW library, but she is thwarted by her own bodily contortions and guilt regarding a certain "body." Submitted for the 48-Hour Film Competition for UNCW.

title: Flowers We Couldn’t Touch
overview: A tribal girl and her mother struggle to hold onto their land as conflict between the state and an armed resistance movement tightens around their community.

title: The House
overview: A teenager calls his friend over to talk about a reoccurring dream he has about a house.

title: Punk Brighton
overview: The documentary utilizes 15 years of interviews, live performance archives, and animation to capture the city's fierce DIY music scene. Rather than focusing solely on the music, it explores how the communal movement tackled broader political and social issues, including confronting fascism, rocking against racism, and rallying the community to save the Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club.

title: Max Capacity
overview: While packing up her family home, a woman and her boyfriend discover her dead dad’s nude centerfold.

title: Cruising
overview: A low-resolution night, a camera dancing the choreography of cruising, the formal voice-over of a horny narrator, and bodies that imprint their absence. It is an ethnography of macho lust in the dark, spanning from the local to the European.

title: Toda La Verdad
overview: When a young Dominican-American woman uncovers African ancestry through a DNA test, her search for answers about a relative's hidden past forces a reckoning with long-held family beliefs about race, class, and identity.

title: Dusk Chorus
overview: David Monacchi, a hi-tech explorer, knows the Amazonian forest well, but his means of exploration are unusual. A sound artist, “field recorder”, and eco-acoustic composer, he understands terrain through sound. For the sound landscape of this region is as rich as the diversity of wildlife that produces it. Today, global warming and humans are threatening species, and sound pollution itself is involved in the extinction of some of these; nature being well constructed, the sound spectrum of the forest is based on a subtle balance, in which each species communicates on a very specific frequency, never interfering with the others. The upheaval caused by man, through the installation of a pipeline for example, upsets this balance.

title: REBORDOSE
overview: Ramona spends a night of excess with her best friend, but a tragedy at dawn changes everything. Haunted by the trauma, she must face consequences that will alter her life forever, trapping her in a reality that feels like an endless hangover.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Lunar July
overview: When the gates of the spirit world open during Ghost Month, getai becomes more than just a show. Rooted in Malaysia`s Hungry Ghost Festival traditions, the film explores the taboos and unspoken rules behind the getai stage, and the price of breaking them.

title: Birthday
overview: A man dozes in the glow of his television. When the picture starts to fizzle, he gives the set a whack with his cane. An old solution to an old problem. But not every problem stays old.

title: Ciclo de Lavado
overview: Marina and Lucía, two flatmates, discover a unique feature of their new washing machine.

title: CRUSH.EXE
overview: The Underground Student Body of Jackson High School has spied on students and staff for years, collecting blackmail and manipulating campus politics. However, one member, Lucy, has gone rogue and is about to leak their most dangerous file of all: THE CRUSH LIST. The entire fate of the school rides on one girl, Nina, who has a chance to chase down Lucy and put an end to her wicked plan. If Nina fails, she will have to confront her own greatest secret: that she is in love with her best friend Kate.

title: Bermuda Riots Are Different
overview: An examination of a decade of race riots between 1968 and 1977, alongside a triangle of colonial influences: Bermuda, Great Britain, and the USA.

title: Albatross
overview: Following years of neglect, Gianna and her estranged father, David, struggle to overcome the harsh realities of substance abuse, the death of a loved one, and the guilt of their actions.

title: Born 2 Feel
overview: Two angels wander around the Duwamish River Valley. Asking questions, feeling feelings.

title: Du Fria
overview: Emily appears to be an ordinary property manager, but she harbours a deep-rooted desire for revenge. In a forgotten basement at her workplace, she holds Chris captive – the son of the man who destroyed her life.

title: Alkohola spēle
overview: The World Alcohol-Drinking Championship is underway, and the Latvian team has made it to the final — a source of pride for the entire nation. Yet behind this seemingly impressive achievement lies a much harsher reality. The film reveals the devastating consequences of alcohol consumption and how they affect not only the individual but also those around them.

title: The Brown Note Challenge
overview: A kid tries the Brown Noise Challenge and now he will regret it.

title: Arzamas. Lullaby
overview: An essay on a return to the city of childhood, where private memories of a catastrophe, historical traces, and Leo Tolstoy’s night in Arzamas fold into an uneasy image of the place. Present-day Arzamas, archival testimony, staged images, and the author’s recollections sit in the film as separate layers of time. The night Tolstoy lived through in Arzamas opens a realm of dream, where the past meets a future that, for the author, has already become a memory. Little by little, from those layers, Arzamas appears — a beautiful, scarred city.

title: Cheap Suits
overview: On an ordinary day, the lives of two hitmen, a drug lord, his son, his son's friends, and other criminal's will be changed forever, all over a suitcase.

title: Fails of Suspense
overview: When comic artist Jane McSween gets locked out of her flat, her day goes from bad to worse when her attempts to break back in result in the accidental death of her neighbour, and draws the attention of a local crimelord.

title: The Mystery of Osu Land
overview: Global superpower Gbajaebija and its ally Osu Land dominate and oppress other nations. When conventional power fails, the faithful nation of Irapada receives divine guidance, uncovers the secret behind their power, and rises to conquer.

title: The field
overview: A girl is awakened by a strange sound. She will follow it...

title: Graduation 2026
overview: Two graduates studied side by side for four years, afraid to confess their feelings to each other, until graduation day arrived...

title: HOME TV
overview: A host for HOME TV finds herself in the heart of life on Kyiv’s central streets. Asking locals, displaced people, and visitors of the capital “what is home?”, she comes across different views and circumstances. The collage of answers gradually blurs the question itself, leaving her face-to-face with her own search.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: MLW Saturday Night SuperFight 2026
overview: Saturday Night SuperFight marks MLW’s return to pay-per-view for the first time in seven years and represents the biggest premium live event on the league’s 2026 calendar.

title: Milky Way
overview: A morning argument and a milk jar takes Jurgis on an unexpected journey, during which returning home becomes the greatest challenge of his life.

title: Etude of Silence
overview: Etude of Silence (Iran, 2026, 17 min) follows a young actress who is repeatedly cast as dead bodies in film productions until the boundary between performance and reality begins to disappear. The film follows a young aspiring actress who survives on the margins of the film industry, repeatedly cast as corpses, victims, and silent bodies in low-budget productions. As she spends her days performing death for the camera, the boundary between performance and reality begins to dissolve, leading her into an unsettling confrontation with invisibility and self-erasure.

title: Nevrine
overview: Akshay, a young man, loses the girl he loved dearly. He recalls the moments he spent with her.

title: Computer No. 03
overview: The disappearance of a USB drive with unknown contents prompts an investigation into its whereabouts.

title: We Are Wild
overview: When a young abused housewife runs away from home she finds herself in a 1970’s utopia in the woods with a ragtag group of misfit hippies. Is she free or did she give up one prison for another?

title: Onnopata
overview: After his father's death, Ratul, an engineering admission aspirant, struggles to make ends meet by working as a clown at various events. While copying his friend's coaching notes, he meets Tiha, sparking unexpected feelings as he navigates academic pressure and the societal challenges faced by engineering aspirants in Bangladesh.

title: How to make friends
overview: A sad story about loneliness.

title: Choke On This
overview: A lonely competitive eater turns to a condescending mentor to push him to his absolute limit for a hot dog eating contest.

title: Révolution Française (Rappel)
overview: “I am, we are. / We do not need more. / It’s up to us to start.” The energy of the revolutionary people and the words of the revolution, through the history of cinema, from its origins. Reminder: we must take back the Bastille.

title: Big Boys Don't Cry
overview: A camera enters the hypermasculine world of bouncers and bodybuilders in Cairo. Beneath the layers of performance and sculpted bodies, is it able to reach a core that is humane and vulnerable?

title: The Game
overview: Converted into a non-human character the protagonist enters a digital space. A territory that is being constantly reshaped and avatars imposed upon the players. Using video game imagery, the film examines the similarities between events in the Balkan corridor and the logic of video game worlds. It explores how certain groups are perceived through virtual environments and dangerous analogies.

title: Sport: Good for Body and Mind
overview: Many villages had their own sports clubs, and numerous sporting events also took place in our province. Film footage was regularly shot at these events. This is a compilation of archival footage showcasing these physical activities.

title: K.907
overview: After fiddling around with reality-hopping gadgets, good pals K and 907 embark on an alternate universe bender. The two quickly realise you can't enjoy a multiverse daytrip if you're sitting on unresolved conflict. How ruff.

title: The World Came Flooding In
overview: The World Came Flooding In is an immersive VR documentary reconstructing memories of the eastern Australia floods in 2022, which is representative of similar events that happened recently in various parts of the world.

title: THIS TOWN AIN'T BIG ENOUGH FOR THE BOTH OF US
overview: Aubrey meets Indiana, a wannabe cowboy. When they bond over their unhappy marriages, a romance blooms between the two. But when their husbands find out, could it be the end for both of them?

title: The Ones Who Stay
overview: Four young Cuban artists choose to stay in Cuba amid the country’s largest migration crisis. LA RETAGUARDIA offers an intimate portrait of those who stay behind, watch their loved ones leave, and continue shaping the identity of a generation they fear is fading away.

title: The Goyfriend
overview: Aviva is excited to bring James to his first Passover Seder, until her parents admit that grandma has no idea that her potential future grandson-in-law isn’t Jewish. Determined to keep the peace, Aviva’s family attempt to pass James off as ‘one of us’.

title: Calidis
overview: An escaped witch performs an incantation. Created as part of Dillon Hammi’s DREAM SUICIDE series.

title: Cutting Room Floor
overview: A desperate director-auteur turns serial killer after discovering the missing piece to her festival submission is the thrill of murder.

title: TOMORROW(?)
overview: A guy spends a night out with his childhood best friend for what seems like the last time.

title: Wasteland in Embers
overview: 2012, Bashang Grassland, Hebei in China. A small town smothered by sand and unemployment after the coal mine shuts down. A girl with an intellectual disability lives with her grandmother, holding on to each other. When the grandmother suffers a sudden stroke, the responsibility of her care is passed around among the children, bargained over and reduced to a sum of money. The girl becomes the family's unwanted burden. After an argument, they quietly close the door and leave her on the other side.  She walks out into the wasteland alone. For the first time, the world falls silent. Warm evening light wraps around her, a sheep following close behind. She passes through ruined fields and abandoned villages. As night falls, she moves toward a room glowing red in the dark, and the light slowly takes her.  Life goes on. Only a girl who once existed slips away, without a sound.

title: The Slow Down
overview: When his car breaks down on the side of the road, a driver in a hurry is forced to stop and sit with the stillness he’s been outrunning.

title: Carlton Taylor Has Major Problems
overview: In the days before Christmas, Carlton Taylor has his life in perfect order. A meticulous textbook editor devoted to facts, structure, and the sanctity of the printed word, he has spent decades doing one thing well. Then a young CEO arrives to drag his longtime publishing house into an AI-driven future, and Carlton discovers exactly how disposable a lifetime of expertise can be.

title: Stud
overview: A woman and her dog hope to meet someone special on an afternoon walk in the forest.

title: Morning Echo
overview: After months of silence, Gabriel wakes to find his ex-boyfriend, Omar, in his kitchen cooking breakfast as if nothing ever happened. As the morning unfolds, unspoken tensions and unresolved feelings rise to the surface, forcing Gabriel to confront whether intimacy can exist without truth, or if some things are better left in the past.

title: Vaterstadt
overview: When an all-women* drumming group is founded for the first time in a small town in southern Germany, it throws a 400-year-old children’s and local heritage festival into disarray—and with it raises the question of how tradition, identity, and social change are reconciled.

title: The Next Station : "H.O.P.E Station” Documentary of CGM48 5th Generation / CGM48
overview: A documentary filming the intensive training and personal journeys of the five members of the 5th Generation of the Thai idol group CGM48: Chifa, Lewlew, Namphet, Punpon, and Tara.

title: After The Freeze
overview: In the wreckage of a messy divorce, a single-mother poet finds her world upended when her first love resurfaces after twelve years, forcing her to choose between the safety of her new life and the passion of her past.

title: the forest of great mystery and emptiness
overview: a person while exploring a forrest seemingly jumps through multiple planes of reality

title: Charmed
overview: Fed up with the pressures of their senior year of high school, best-friends Stella and Fiadh remember their childhood favourite novel, 'The Map to Myrtle', and decide to embark on a journey to the fictional world of Myrtle Valley in search of the Magic Charm of Eternal Youth. However, they quickly discovered that everything in this surreal land was not quite as it seemed.

title: A Distant Spring
overview: To fulfil her grandmother's dying wish to be buried in her hometown in North Korea, Ji-won and her father set out on a perilous journey across the border, carrying with them the ashes and their hidden tensions of nationality and identity.

title: El amor en tiempos de cumbia
overview: The work begins with the accidental discovery of an SD card, weaving together a narrative that combines found footage with audio documentary.

title: Homunculus
overview: A student photojournalist searches for a missing fellow student on campus, but he realizes the horrifying truth once he enters the dark room.

title: Promettimi
overview: “Promettimi” is a spell-like dialogue that imagines and invokes a queer future, navigating desire, reality, and collective transformation.

title: The Rocky Road To NYC
overview: When a young man (Cian Ryan Murphy) is awoken to his reality and snatched from his dream life in New York City, he loses his job and thus begins his quest to turn that hallucination into a tangible truth.

title: Gansey
overview: As a woman washes and puts a Guernsey jumper out to dry, the symbolism of the jumper and the design of its stitches creates a sense of identity for the island.

title: Between Herds and Horizon
overview: Set in Ladakh’s Changthang plateau, this observational documentary follows Changpa nomads and their pastoral way of life. As climate change, shrinking pastures and changing aspirations reshape their world, they navigate an uncertain future while holding onto their traditions and identity.

title: Sour
overview: When a sesh goes wrong.  Best Film - Quicktime Film Festival  People's Choice Award - Shorties Film Festival

title: Jamlitz: A Documentary Fairy-Tale
overview: The Lower Lusatian village of Jamlitz/Jemjelnica was once a thriving artists’ colony. Later, the Nazis built a concentration camp there, and from 1945 the site served as a Soviet special camp. Now Friederike, the great-granddaughter of an artist, returns, hoping to use her family’s creative legacy to revive the village and heal the wounds of collective memory.

title: VOXEL
overview: A short film about the nature of the digital world.

title: The Duel
overview: Byrant is Love

title: Chiatura Is My Pride
overview: Story of Chiatura and Anastasia's childhood.

title: Todos a mi alrededor parecen estar bien
Birthday Candles
overview: Kamran Baxşızadə went to fight as a volunteer in the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War in the autumn of 2020. In a battle that coincided with his birthday, he lost his sight. The film begins where the war news ends: a young man returns home – to a world he can no longer see – and must learn everything anew, from the space around him to the question of what to do with his life now. The camera follows him through his everyday life, which is not heroic but tests his tenacity and endurance. The film observes how hope and stubbornness build a life where it seems impossible.

title: Lunar Spells
overview: By the light of the blinding moon, mother of solitude.

title: The Dungeon: West Virginia Penitentiary
overview: Ever since I was a kid I have been interested in the paranormal and now as an adult I can finally discover the truth for myself. I visited the West Virginia Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to see what I could find. Who knew that on my first investigation, I would get far more than I ever bargained for.

title: Blade
overview: Sophie, a vulnerable teenage girl caught in a cycle of emotional validation and humiliation by a boy who objectifies her, blurs the line between fantasy and reality as her longing for affection begins to consume her sense of self.

title: Moral
overview: Moral is a quiet family drama set during Lucía’s birthday. Natalia is preparing a simple celebration when her estranged partner, Roberto, unexpectedly returns after years of absence.  His arrival disrupts the fragile atmosphere, bringing unresolved history and tension back into the home. As the day unfolds, Natalia is forced to navigate the emotional weight of the past while trying to protect the moment for her daughter.  Seen through Lucía’s innocent perspective, the story explores the silent fractures within a family and the lingering impact of absence, memory, and unspoken choices.

title: Ticraḍ
overview: A documentary exploring the dying tradition of ancestral Amazigh tattooing in the Djurdjura mountains of Kabylie, Algeria.

title: My grandpa, Mileta
overview: A grandson makes a portrait of his grandfather.

title: Creators of Wonder: A Journey through Illusionism
overview: Set in a timeless magic shop, this documentary frames magic as a fundamental human need. Guided by the wonder of two young children watching a mysterious shopkeeper, the film bridges the golden age of illusionism with its future, featuring performances and interviews with world-class magicians from the Magic International Grand Gala to explore the soul and poetry of this ancient art.

title: The Centre Cannot Hold
overview: Through speculative poetic narrative and tactile 16mm imagery, Corsica’s serene landscape gradually uncovers the island’s complex histories of belonging.

title: Pope Joan vs Mephisto
overview: The old legends did not die. They are simply waiting for the moment to return, when reason and the unknown meet in a dark journey to the limits of human consciousness. A philosophical thriller, inspired by the great legends that were born and shaped in the ideological universe of Protestant Europe and the Reformation. Myths, fears and archetypal questions as they are reinterpreted in the film for the modern world. With a deep dive into the dark depths of the human mind, the film poses the most crucial questions about human existence, faith, guilt, freedom and the limits of human nature. When these boundaries between good and evil, between reason and madness, between the human and the supernatural begin to collapse and take on threatening dimensions, in an increasingly disturbing modern reality.

title: Lichenlike
overview: A story of lichens, inertia, and fusion.

title: Ephemeral: part 1
overview: On the last day of sixth grade, a boy walks one final time through the hallways, classrooms, and the places where he grew up alongside his friends. What seems like an ordinary day gradually turns into a quiet farewell. As the hours pass, every conversation, every laugh, and every corner takes on new meaning. For some chapters do not end with a grand event, but with a final moment we only truly understand once it has already gone by. *Ephemeral* is a story about childhood, the passage of time, and those everyday moments that—without warning—become lifelong memories.

title: Queen of Canada
overview: Romana Didulo, the self-proclaimed 'Queen of Canada,' drew in devotees from across the country. Former followers reveal how they were pulled into a cult, and what it took to break free.

title: Refusal of The Necropolis
overview: A dead man knows nothing of his death; he simply walks through the world, seeing and hearing. Even in his state of alienation, he refuses the idea of ​​dying.

title: Bear with me!
overview: A man notices a teddy bear strangely placed on top of a tree and tries to get it down.

title: Unhealed Wounds
overview: A sentimental journey of a desi family navigating the loss of a husband and father as they regain control over their lives.

title: The Staircase
overview: After getting trapped in a mysterious staircase loop, A guy struggles to find his way home, only to discover that reality may not be what it seems.

title: The Mummers
overview: After a boy is taken by a group of mummers, his older brother spends years searching for him, eventually becoming the very thing that took him.

title: Dead Man Walking
overview: An agent of a nameless corporation embarks on a journey across the Midwest filled with reflection, danger, and echoes of his past to deliver legal documents to a mysterious purchaser. The catch? These seemingly mundane documents just may hold cosmic implications.

title: 3 Lambs
overview: In a post-graduation landscape of boredom, uncertainty, and struggle, there is a desire for the simpler life: a shepherd and artist in the middle of the rural South.

title: The Hugo incident
overview: Alex, an employee at a failing high school, finds Hugo the Dragon. Hugo loves children and he loves making them happy. However, Hugo may be hiding a dark secret.

title: Caught Between Lands
overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

title: The Ones Who Bought Bushwick
overview: The Ones Who Bought Bushwick investigates the historical, political, and economic forces driving development and gentrification in Brooklyn’s Bushwick neighborhood.

title: Language of the Wind
overview: The story follows 16-year-old Shatu, who has spent her life tending cattle but secretly longs for city life. The day after her wedding to her traditional cousin Ardo (17), she finds a potential path to escape. As they lead their cattle to graze, the silence and tension between them build into a heavy confrontation of unspoken truths and life-altering decisions on the plains.

title: Dealers of Hate
overview: Across Central Europe, reports are mounting of Ukrainian refugees — the vast majority women and children — facing harassment and attacks. What’s really behind the headlines about Ukrainians, who were welcomed with open arms in 2022, now facing hatred and hostility? And what role do local politicians play in fueling the violence?  The Kyiv Independent’s new documentary investigates anti-Ukrainian aggression in Germany, the Czech Republic and Poland, the countries that have taken in the largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees since Feb. 24, 2022. Journalist Danylo Mokryk and his team uncover the stories of Ukrainian women who have faced harassment and analyze tens of thousands of posts on X, revealing how hate speech on social media and in political rhetoric escalates into real-world violence.

title: The Beauty of Static Shots
overview: A quiet look at the vibrant everyday life inside a busy market captured entirely through still frames

title: 29-O Dana
overview: 29-O Dana reconstructs the decisive hours of the floods that struck Valencia province on 29 October 2024, tracing the warnings that arrived and the choices made as the emergency unfolded. Alongside relatives of those who died, the film confronts the political response—and the questions the disaster leaves unresolved.

title: The Way Out
overview: The Way Out drops you right into the action across the globe, from heavy Alaskan spine lines to local backyard laps in Whistler. It represents a path toward total freedom, whether tracking Hoji, Chris Rubens, and Mark Abma across the iconic Swiss Alps, or capturing breakout skier Lucy Leishman storming through Japan’s deep powder with three legendary freeskiers. Remedy for an Ordinary Life is a mirror of what it's like to try and comprehend change. It goes back and forth in time, between old childhood tapes recorded by Filmmaker Nancy Nanda’s parents, and her turning the lens back onto them, decades later.

title: Unused Documents
overview: A documentary following a scam victim who gathers evidence of online concert ticket fraud to get a refund. But speaking with an investigator reveals how complex justice limits her hopes for resolution.

title: What a Steal
overview: A realtor and his online-auction partner make a killing stealing from luxury homes until they target the wrong homeowner.

title: Mask Murder

title: Something's in the Water
overview: A man enjoying his day in the park is interrupted by a seemingly lost little boy who is not what he seems to be.

title: Sterile
overview: Through crucifixions, fisting and forest rituals, a group of queer and trans friends create a folk-horror love letter to radical intimacies. Produced over 6 years, Sterile offers a utopian/dystopian vision blending original footage with once banned silent movie Häxan (1922), practical special effects, explicit performance and commentary to present a joyous, affirmative documentary about lost times in nature in a trans- and queerphobic world.

title: Queezy visits the Races

title: Dare To Do Right!
overview: An observational documentary follows four twenty-year-old missionaries from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints who come to live in the Balkans for two years. In the heart of secular Slovenia, they attempt to find new converts on the streets, all while living under strict rules: they are not allowed to listen to music, have limited access to the internet, and must never separate from one another.

title: Dreaming of a Dream
overview: Set in 1990s Berlin, “Dreaming of a Dream” follows Kerem, a sensitive 12-year-old Turkish boy on the edge of adolescence. When Kerem steals an adult magazine from a local store with his friends, this little adventure soon begins to strain his relationship with them and with his mother. For the first time, Kerem finds himself wrestling with desire and shame, and with the unspoken codes of masculinity.

title: Motherland
overview: Patria I is a medium-length film by Juan Ibarlucía and Magela Crosignani that reimagines the form of the Baroque oratorio within the post-industrial landscape of Argentina in 2026. Drawing on a south american reinterpretation of the myth of Cain, and employing music, poetry, performance, and installation art, the work takes the audience on a powerful sonic and emotional journey that spans an extraordinary range of human experience—from extreme violence to compassion and tenderness.

title: The Bell-Eyed Goat

title: The Policewoman
overview: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.

title: wake up, my art

title: Nukegara

title: Son Of A

title: From Young to Old: Historical Film Footage from the Zaan Region
overview: How were health, sport, leisure, care and everyday life viewed in the past? As part of the Month of History, the Zaanstad Municipal Archives presents a special film evening featuring an exclusive compilation of historical footage from its own film collection. The compilation shows how residents of the Zaan region worked, exercised, relaxed, lived and cared for one another over the years. The screening offers a unique glimpse into the past of the Zaan region.

title: Carter Country
overview: Carter Country is a feature-length documentary that chronicles the extraordinary two-year journey of Jimmy Carter, America’s most unlikely presidential candidate, and the small Georgia town that stood behind him every step of the way. Through the lens of Plains, Georgia, a community of just 700 residents, the film captures the forgotten spirit of 1976, a pivotal moment when a humble Southern town unexpectedly became the political capital of the world during one of the most remarkable presidential campaigns in American history.  Featuring a voice cast of more than 40 performers, many of whom are Plains residents and members of the Carter family portraying their own historic relatives, the film offers an authentic and deeply personal perspective.

Is it worth peeling back one’s own reality in order to be seen?

title: Bombarded by Corruption
overview: In 45 minutes, the documentary explores the circumstances surrounding the 1995 attack on the Río Tercero Military Factory, focusing on the causes and the context of the tragedy. Río Tercero natives Fernando Colautti, Guillermo Vigliecca, and Francisco Carranza are the filmmakers behind this production, which combines a journalistic tone with a cinematic format. Marking the 30th anniversary of the Río Tercero explosions, the film addresses the question of "why it happened." The project is supported by the National University of Río Tercero (UNRT); the legislation establishing the university was primarily driven by the goal of providing historical reparation to the city following that state-sponsored crime.

title: Act of Love

What begins as a journey tracing the image of an animal gradually transforms into a reflective narrative in which digital representations and physical encounters intertwine, extending toward themes of creation and annihilation.

Moore has continued a decades-long friendship with the islanders, and beginning in 2016, he spent 10 years revisiting the community to document what traditions have remained and how life has changed on the island. Weaving together 16mm outtakes from the late 1970’s with contemporary HD digital material, “Returning to Berneray” is a personal portrait of a place and a filmmaker’s relationship to it.

While the father presents an impeccable, upright, and irreproachable public facade, his daughter, by contrast, reveals a detestable and abhorrent public side. Finally, the arrival of a new family member opens a crack in the household structure, unleashing a chain reaction of irreversible consequences that will alter the nature of their bonds in a profoundly unsettling way.

title: Eyes Eyes Eyes

As fear and desperation begin to take hold, one person makes the decision to leave. They never return.  Set within a fictional, claustrophobic nightmare, Eyes Eyes Eyes explores greed, survival, and the darker instincts that emerge when people are pushed to their limits. As trust begins to fracture and uncertainty consumes the room, the film asks how far people are willing to go to save themselves, and what they are prepared to sacrifice along the way.  Sometimes, the greatest threat isn’t what’s in the room, but what people are willing to do to get out.

title: Encik

title: Out Of Sync

Determined to maintain their independence, they encounter moments of frustration and uncertainty that reveal the hidden effort required just to keep up. Through their experiences, the documentary asks: as technology continues to shape our future, are we building a world that includes the generation that helped shape our present?

title: Rate My Ex

He searches her name online and he stumbles upon a website called ‘RateMyEx.com’, where he finds numerous reviews from her former exes. With the reviews in mind, Jonathan contemplates whether the date is even worth going on anymore.

title: Adrift/A Rift
overview: An omniscient voice narrates the dissolution of a relationship against a montage of faceless malaise set in a beach resort.

title: Image Interjections

Raw material whose hidden interior is looking for a way to be spoken.The film is an inquiry into bodily memory and the impossibility of resonance.  Breathe in — as if lifting layers of earth.  If your throat is clenched — let the body talk.  Breathe out — let a feeling take on flesh.  You are here. You sound. You breathe.

With extraction drawing closer, Milo must decide whether or not to carry out his mission.

Later, Anita goes to the garden gazebo and is devastated to find Antoni close to Bianca, who is holding Anita's personal love letter. Amidst a sudden thunderstorm, Bianca mocks Anita from afar and embraces Antoni, causing Anita to flee in tears. A flashback reveals that years prior, a science fair project built by Anita and Bianca malfunctioned and exploded in front of a laughing crowd, leading a humiliated Bianca to tear off her matching necklace and blame Anita for ruining her. In the present day, Bianca corners Anita in the school bathroom to confront her about the past. During the heated argument, Bianca admits her deep insecurity and resentment over the science fair disaster. Seeking closure, Anita offers Bianca the "B" necklace she has kept for years, but Bianca refuses it and walks out, leaving Anita alone with her reflection and unresolved tension.

For three years he records a file that documents at the same time a relationship and its transformation. While Mima's voice goes out, Manuel finds in the music a way to sustain what is leaving: not to retain it, because he understands that that is not possible, but to accompany it while it is still there.

It offers a deeply human perspective that seeks to raise public awareness. In a world where numbers are counted every day, the director attempts here to count the names. Gifted with exceptional talent, Li-Chen won a national championship in junior high school, only to fall into confusion after entering high school—caught between boxing, academic expectations, and his Indigenous identity. As he struggles to find his path, his performance in the ring declines, dealing a heavy blow to his confidence. Jing-Wen, from the Nanjing Indigenous community in Sanxia, New Taipei City, is seen as a promising Olympic boxer of her generation. Yet deep down, she is uncertain about her future in boxing. The only reason she continues training is the weight of others’ expectations. Despite growing up in an urban Indigenous community, she finds no real sense of belonging in the city.

title: The Strongest Team in Vilnius
overview: From playing on neighborhood courts to winning numerous titles in basketball tournaments. The “Ferimstos” basketball players, who call themselves the strongest team in Vilnius, invite you to join their eighteen-year-long story of friendship—a journey through basketball courts, arguments, wild parties, and eternal love.

The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.

The forest slowly ceases to be merely a physical location and transforms into a space of inner experience, where reality, time, and perception begin to blur and intertwine.

title: Another Side of the Wall
overview: After graduating from university, Jiawei’s relationship fell into crisis. He chose to stay in Hong Kong, while his girlfriend insisted on returning to her home country to prepare for the civil service exam. Their long-distance relationship gradually wore down their feelings and patience, yet neither was willing to compromise for the other, and so things dragged on. Then one day, Jiawei heard the girl next door—a Hong Kong local—learning to play a guitar song, which happened to be his favorite. The sound of the guitar drifted through the thin wall of their subdivided flats into his empty room.

title: Body Electric
overview: A rework of the new iPhone 15 commercial featuring a singing wall socket. In place of the machine loneliness of the original, a different song from the early Vito Acconci playbook. A direct address to the viewer/listener from a virtual assistant. The new ambient intelligence promises security, rapid response, predictive analysis, microgeneration, efficiency. Here it delivers funwashing messages from the cloud for users in a performative essay on domotics. Talk back from the data harvest and Orwell’s “never sleeping ear.” To challenge them is to “fight the future.”

title: The Tara on Her Head
overview: An elderly man has always perceived reality as tilted. Gradually, however, everything seems to turn upside down—even the image of Green Tara, to whom he makes daily offerings.  His youngest son, a monk at a temple, is summoned home; he finds himself navigating the boundary between reality and illusion as he tries to understand what is happening to his father.  The most conceptual film in the competition reinterprets themes and figures from Tibetan Buddhism, transporting them into a realm suspended between spirituality, paradox, and irony.

title: Coconut Tale Chapter One
overview: A woman finds a coconut on her daily commute path every day. The recurring discovery leads her to investigate the source, unraveling a mysterious secret tied to her past

title: Intrusion
overview: An arrogant vlogger disturbs what should not be disturbed.

title: A Work Thing
overview: Evelyn and Ben are being blackmailed by a coworker, which forces them to find a way to keep their secret safe before they're exposed to the company's president; Evelyn's husband.

title: An Akoon
overview: “An Akoon” means “To be”. An Akoon is a poetic, experimental, and intuitive film that confronts the weight of existence, a yearning to return to a state before becoming, before the weight of consciousness. In the depths of inner turmoil, the film dives into war, grief, anger, fear, and remorse, rooted in the profound bond between mother and child.

title: Your Life Sucks, Here's Why
overview: Cora must choose between seeking help from the real world or an oddly comforting, perfectly-perfect 1950s show, 'The Fix It Family'.

title: Burning Roots, Blooming Fire
overview: In a changing village steeped in old lore, a young girl steps into a forbidden grove and uncovers a long-silenced red bloom; she awakens memories buried by power and time. Her quiet act stirs forgotten histories and resistance, blending folklore and reality to reflect on loss, memory and survival.

title: In illo αTempore
overview: Part seven of cycle "The Requiem Films". “I imagine that almost everyone who has come across this piece is familiar with the phrase ‘in illo tempore’. In illo tempore—in that time. […] Let’s pause for a moment on ‘tempore’. Let’s consider, as laypeople might, what part of the original phrase this is. Of course, it is technically ‘time.’ [..] When an extra letter ‘a’ appeared in my mind—which has a tendency to complicate all sorts of concepts to the limit—it completely changed the perspective of everything. ‘aTempore’ was born. What did that mean to me? If ‘tempore’ is, theoretically, ‘(at) that time,’ then ‘aTempore’ would mean ‘non-time.’ Now we have ‘That Non-Time.’ Does this mean we should think of time that has stopped? Or perhaps of different spaces, sensations? […]” - as the introductionary note to the movie says.

title: Azul
overview: Blue ceases to be merely a color and becomes a persistent presence—an everyday reality that takes hold each day; it carries a weight, a meaning, and a past that still dwells within it.

title: Exit From The Lumière Factory
overview: The Lumières’ classic was shot in three takes. Statistically, over a working life, each worker leaves the factory some 9,000 times.

title: Memories
overview: We follow Linda and Matilda through their day as each grapples with the consequences of death and mourning. Matilda follows a more depressive take on mourning, locking out the world and allowing the grief to overcome her. Linda follows an optimistic look at life, trying to continue on with life as if nothing happened, but small things keep reminding her of the dead.

title: Aydinlar - Where the World Ends
overview: The children of Moynaq know the sea only from their grandparents' songs. They play among abandoned shipwrecks that have long since become rusting witnesses to a lost world. The Aral Sea has almost completely vanished, but the hope that it will return, as bitter as it is futile, persists.

title: Libertad
overview: After surviving a near-fatal assault, an Indigenous, transgender teen escaped Mexico 30 years ago, eventually becoming a trans healthcare provider in California. When her mother’s health starts to decline back in Mexico, she risks it all by petitioning for asylum as her only chance of seeing each other again before it’s too late.

title: Acta de primavera
overview: Acta de primavera enters a public school in Madrid through the people who make it their daily world: students, teachers, and staff. Their perspectives form a collective portrait of school life, inviting us to listen closely to the experience of belonging to—and shaping—a shared institution.

title: Mindman
overview: An omnipotent man takes control of an unexpecting civillian.

title: Jaunt
overview: In a stark warehouse office, Justice is weighed down by mounting deadlines and an endless to-do list. But every day, he finds escape in a one-hour ritual that reignites his spirit.

title: La lave ne brûle pas
overview: Filmed in 16mm, this poetic journey reconnects gender transitions with the Earth's movements and the lava flowing around its core.

title: digital teenage death
overview: Using archival clips of the band who defined the filmmaker's teenage years, this film is a meditation on the loss of youthful ambition and the unsettling feeling of becoming someone you never imagined you would be.

title: The Spoon
overview: A film about a spoon.

title: Poker Roulette
overview: Two men face each other across a poker table in a secret underground game where every losing hand means pulling the trigger. As the rounds unfold, a young newcomer and a seasoned veteran confront fear, chance, and the thin line between courage and recklessness, while a silent dealer oversees the game. With each turn, the stakes rise and survival becomes a matter of nerve as much as luck.  Shot on 16mm film, Poker Roulette is a silent short film about risk, fate, and the choices we make when there is no turning back.

title: Women of Revolution
overview: Film by Mina Akbari

title: And many more
overview: A toxic man struggles to balance life and relationships.

title: Maia: Threshold of Worlds
overview: In a small city shop, Maia practices the locksmith’s trade in a unique way: aided by an ancient power and a magical door, she can repair keys that hold extraordinary secrets. Accustomed to solving any puzzle with ease, she finds her skills challenged when a mysterious elderly woman hands her a broken key that defies every known technique. Just as she is about to give up, Maia discovers that the object does not respond to conventional methods and that the only way to repair it is to cross into the dimension hidden behind its own door.

title: Bully - Leider Live! Die letzten Stunden vor der Show
AMBIENTES

title: Pay As You Go
overview: A struggling tenant wants to escape his Pay-As-You-Go Life Tariff, but must first confront a relentlessly cheerful Customer Support officer conducting a routine “Life Utility Check-Up”. A Kafka-esque comedy set in a world where everything is chargeable.

title: The Visitor
overview: After receiving a strange phone call late at night, a young man is visited by a mysterious stranger who claims to know something that he has forgotten.

title: Scissor
overview: ​A chilling psychological descent unfolds as an ordinary box conceals a terrifying obsession, trapping a solitary man in a claustrophobic web of suspense and dread.

title: Pale Faces - Mom (Found Footage)
overview: A son confronts his mom about a weird, scary video he found on her computer.

title: Soundtrack to a Coup d’Etat 2
overview: A documentary about Thai political conflicts and the Thai monarch's brilliance in jazz music.

title: Before it Dissapears
overview: Amidst the harmonious coexistence of water, emptiness, and time, there lies a town on the banks of the Uruguay River called Liebig—a place where beauty and neglect, fact and conjecture, water, children and the elderly, memories, stories, night, fish, and fire all mingle, alongside a reality suspended in time.

title: CAN I COME HOME NOW?
overview: A quiet stroll through the heart of Paris, where solitude and memories are imbued with a unique melancholy.

title: Dear Future Ejaculators
overview: Ledermann & Marschner create an opulent iconography of testicles: Whatever’s in the sac, they expose to the studio lights with with relish and no taboos. The viewer’s gaze glides over naked testicles, touches baroque jewellery and explores questions of relationships and responsibility.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: The city is full of holes. The visible ones and the invisible ones, the recent ones and the old ones. Amidst an apparition, a chase and an encounter, someone tries to find what is missing.

title: Tingatinga Between Two Homes
overview: An orphaned painter returns from China to his native Tanzania for a wedding, with warmth and gentle humour.

title: It’s Not Your Mother
overview: Left alone at home, Daniya receives mysterious messages from an unknown number warning her not to open the door to the person claiming to be her mother. As she searches for a rational explanation, she is drawn into a situation where trusting her own perception becomes just as dangerous as the threat waiting outside.

title: Winter Wind
overview: When a ghostly stranger warns them of a deadly wind storm, a gang of thieves takes shelter in the very town they once robbed.

title: Land of Metal
overview: A cam performer caught between algorithms, desire, and isolation begins to question the world around her. With its cyberpunk aesthetic and surreal narrative style, the film explores digital intimacy, control, and the search for connection beyond the screen.

title: Outside the Lines
overview: Monet spends her time painting and being with her roommates Vince and Henri. Everyday, she paints on the sidewalk by a mural. One day a girl, Brandy, sits next to her and draws. Monet immediately falls for her and keeps going back to meet this girl. Eventually the two girls start getting closer, leading to a deep connection and newfound love.

title: Kilometer 9 or Since When Do You Stop to Look at the City
overview: On a December night, the sound of motorcycles and fireworks fills the streets of Medellín, as the improbable connection between two young men from almost opposite worlds unfolds through a conversation that lays them bare, along with the labyrinthine streets they wander. Both face the constant threat of death and oblivion; at every stop, they pause to observe the city, holding on to that fleeting moment amidst the uncertainty.

title: Camp Zapaka
overview: A summer camp in the 1980s tells the same eerie story about the alleged "Pine Killer".  Miranda, a scared young camper truly believes it exists unlike the other campers which they think is a hoax. She ends up finding foreshadowing  clues and turns out...there is a certain someone out to get the whole camp...

title: Betty
overview: A short film about Betty - a reclusive woman in love with a dead body

title: All Sacrifices Made for the Love Over Yonder
overview: A troubled Filipino teen looks to his friends and family for self-understanding and empathizes with their hardships, using this newfound knowledge of his Filipino identity to let his individuality and ethnicity co-exist while wishing his loved ones a pursuit for their own peace.

title: Free Therapy
overview: A young Man reckons with his life alongside an eccentric Therapist, both finding different ways of coping with pain.

title: Vagabond
overview: A solitary man traverses landscapes. He travels, contemplates, and dreams. He seems to possess nothing except the backpack that accompanies him and interacts almost without any interaction with other human beings during his journey. Without him seeming to notice, a dog crosses his path at every step. Perhaps it is looking for an owner.

title: Christine
overview: A lonely mid-thirty music teacher, Christine, moves to work in a secondary school for boys, where she meets 16-year-old talented pianist, Marwan, and starts to offer him private lessons. Their relationship grows more controversial, and her students and colleagues terribly questions the truth of her relationship with Marwan, the thing that pushes her into a difficult crisis with herself.

title: Mother, Algorithm
overview: POV: your son goes viral… on your influencer bestie’s page. And now the whole internet thinks she’s his mom.

title: Seriously This Is the Last Time
Miscellaneous
overview: A 17 year-old girl is going through a box of her late dad’s belongings with her best friend. Meanwhile, her mum struggles even to get out of bed. As Mia tries to distract herself from her grief, she becomes obsessive about going through the belongings.

title: my movie 2
overview: A collage of Rickey Dion Rowe II's childhood.

title: The Host
overview: After checking into an Airbnb, Nick is warned never to open the door if someone rings the bell. When he ignores the warning, he encounters a terrifying entity, and becomes part of a cycle passed on to the next guest.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: One Year on the Kostiantynivka Frontline
overview: From the start of the battle for Kostiantynivka to the street by street combat that is still raging on, this film follows the struggle for control of the city over the span of a year. With a special focus on the experience of Ukrainian infantry in the age of drone domination, this documentary shows the new brutal reality of how the war is fought. This is done by following soldiers as they complete missions on one of the most dangerous frontlines of the entire war. As the Russian invasion approaches the heart of unoccupied Donbas, the battle for the city is vital for control of the Donetsk region, which Ukraine refuses to surrender without a fight.

title: Test 1
overview: Experimental film by Musa.

title: Habeeb stars in a vlog
overview: A short film about love and longing.

overview: Featuring: D-Dogg, Zendaya, Ben Nelan

title: Freedom Rides
overview: The 1965 Freedom Ride marked a turning point in the Australian civil rights movement when a group of 29 University of Sydney students, led by Charles Perkins, travelled through rural New South Wales to challenge racism and segregation against Aboriginal people. 7 of the Riders were Jewish, including future Chief Justice Jim Spigelman. Intimately observed by director Eliya Cohen, the film documents a commemorative journey in 2025, when Stand Up brought a new generation of Aboriginal and Jewish youth together to recreate the steps of the historic trip, building on the unique allyship between these remarkable communities.

title: Thank You for Thinking of Me
overview: At the height of 2020’s Black Lives Matter protests, a young mother fights for her innocence after surviving a near death car accident while mistakenly injuring a police officer.

title: Crossings
overview: An inspiring story of determination and the human spirit, Crossings follows 23-year-old Edo Tanas, a three-time SUP foil world champion attempting a world first: a three-day solo foiling journey across the Hawaiian archipelago. With nothing more than his board and paddle, Edo journeys more than 270 miles from Hawaiʻi Island to Kauaʻi. As he encounters dangerous channels most boats avoid and endures unpredictable winds, shifting swells, and the physical toll of returning to the water day after day, nothing is guaranteed. Preparation can get Edo to the starting line. From there, the ocean has a say. Will the conditions align? Can his body withstand three days of relentless effort? Edo sets out alone to connect the islands in an entirely new way.

title: Ick Boy
overview: After a public scandal, Ben, a disgraced college student, hides from accountability until a phone call exposes how far his actions have reached.

title: We're Not Alone
overview: Two friends get attacked while housesitting.

title: All the Rooms We Need
overview: Behind every door, a different room of life. A pregnancy to protect, one to terminate, a confused teenager, a disoriented mother. At the family planning clinic, they are all listened to. Every single one. All the Rooms We Need is a radical observational documentary that, for the first time, offers unprecedented access to the family planning clinic at Policlinico of Milan, a place where rights take the form of the faces, bodies, and everyday choices of the doctors who represent an essential public service. Moving freely between ages and timelines, within a single location, the film explores the doubts, fears, courage, laughter, and experiences of women and girls.

title: THOUSAND AND ONE COMMUNISTS
overview: The film unfolds over two days in the life of Aashik, a young activist in the Marxist party’s youth wing in Kerala. He and his comrades navigate a world increasingly defined by war, inequality, and political disillusionment—forces that steadily erode Aashik’s mental well-being. Though his personal life offers him little comfort or joy, he remains unwavering in his commitment to political struggle, channeling his turmoil into activism.  As tensions escalate and hope feels distant, the film culminates in a powerful final sequence: civil society flooding the streets, united in resistance and demanding a more just future. In this convergence of collective anger and collective hope, Aashik’s world finds the possibility of renewal.

title: Sinal
overview: The plot follows João, a 60-year-old farmer and member of a group of "Penitents", who flees his community carrying a stone. In the city, João encounters paranoia and insomnia; amidst the chaos, he meets someone who tries to convince him to return the stone and reconcile with his people.

title: Man in the Wave
overview: Man in the Wave is an intimate portrait of a New England engineer who unexpectedly finds purpose, connection, and healing through surf photography—after a life-altering diagnosis of multiple sclerosis. As he wades into the ocean with his camera, he captures the quiet rituals of a tight-knit surf community while navigating the slow progression of his illness. Told through stunning imagery and deeply personal interviews, the film explores resilience, identity, and the quiet power of showing up.

title: Is This Good?
overview: We all face expectations about who we should be, how we should look, and what we should achieve. This film explores where those expectations come from, how they shape us, and what it means to break free from the pressure to be perfect.

title: The Pain Department
overview: A short documentary that follows the specialist pain team at a leading hospital in Western Ukraine as they treat soldiers injured in the war using the latest medical techniques.

title: Fever Dreams
overview: Nick pieces together a mystery from his childhood: who, or what, killed his mother.

overview: Part of "The Process Tapes"

title: NOT 21
overview: At a college house party, an underage, socially awkward young man unexpectedly becomes the center of attention when he dominates a game of beer pong against the popular kids. However, his newfound popularity takes an embarrassing turn when his attempts to fit in go horribly wrong.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: Dead Man’s Party

title: Bridport Torchlight Procession
overview: Bridport Torchlight Procession in Dorset has been shrouded in tradition, with locals believing it has little history. Step into a journey through time, uncovering its origins as a celebration event, marking elections and how it has evolved over the decades and become a cornerstone of local culture.

title: When Reality Bleeds Out
overview: A man goes for a stroll in the woods and leads himself through an existential odyssey

title: The Way We Look at Things
overview: Lines that turn into insects, an entire swarm, a landscape – before dissolving once again.

title: Duckweed
overview: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

title: When You Sleep
overview: Kris, a 30-year-old man who loses an emotion every time he sleeps, fights to stay awake before he loses himself and the woman he loves.

title: Terminus
overview: A struggling middle-aged bus driver, trapped in the monotony of his routine, is faced with an alternative that could finally change everything.

title: La Sinfonía de los Bichos raros
overview: In the extraordinary neighborhood of Los Matorrales, hidden behind a massive wall in the city, lives Macha, a kind-hearted and dreamy cockroach who sings while helping at her father's legume shop. Everything changes when the business faces imminent closure. To save the store, protect her community, and fulfill her dream of becoming a singer, Macha convinces her group of friends—fellow misfits like a spider, a centipede, a vulture, and an opossum—to form a band of "weird bugs" and enter a human reality TV show. Through music, humor, and adventure, they discover the true power of friendship and self-acceptance.

title: Aroma de Baunilha
overview: In a game of desire, obsession, and flesh, *Aroma de Baunilha* reveals that true horror never arrives without an invitation.

title: It’s Not Sweet
overview: Eleven-year-old Hong and his sister are only allowed to eat watermelon the day before his birthday buffet—a family tradition that is increasingly difficult to uphold amid strife.

title: The Cost of Dreaming
overview: Every year, millions of people decide to pursue a creative career. Few are prepared for what it asks of them. Through deeply personal stories from artists across different disciplines, The Cost of Dreaming explores the sacrifices, uncertainty and emotional reality hidden behind the pursuit of artistic success

title: THE BOX
overview: Living alone in an isolated rural cabin, Max’s quiet routine is disturbed when a mysterious wooden box appears on his doorstep containing an old photograph of his home. After throwing it away, the box inexplicably returns  and with it comes a series of increasingly disturbing events. As Max begins to realise he may not be alone, he finds himself caught in a sinister cycle that has haunted the cabin long before he arrived.

title: Check
overview: On the eve of a military deployment, two old friends meet for dinner.

title: The Freedom of Being Alone

One September night, while listening to a different Lou Reed album, I decided to edit, upload, and schedule this short film.  One October night, this short film was made public.

title: Dunganda Street Sounds
overview: An energised showcase of Yolngu culture, language + community, Dunganda Street Sounds brought together musicians living on + around Dunganda Crescent in Ramingining. With visual direction shaped by Jason Durrurranga + Michael Dawu, this proto-YouTube music video anthology sees boss men from Waak Waak Djungi guiding the next generations. Widely known across north-east Arnhem Land via its independent CD release, its film counterpart has rarely been seen in the years since + is shared here from project coordinator Allen Murphy’s digital archive.

title: THE EXORCIST
overview: The Exorcist (2025)  Who taught us that black magic is bad magic? In an experimental vertical format video, Krade explores the taboos surrounding witchcraft, the etymology of the word "necromancy", and the link between colonialism and folk magic. This short film, published in three parts on Instagram and YouTube,  belongs to a larger and ongoing work, including a self-published essay.

title: Acciaio
overview: In the landscape of Monte Amiata, organic memory and industrial presence merge. The traces of human activity settle into nature like silent apparitions, blurring the boundaries between the man-made and living matter.

title: Occupation of the Inner Life
overview: Mysticism and femininity circle a young woman’s desire to reclaim her history. She asks when she will fall in love, and the answer is elusive: she will have to wait until her world expands.

title: Bloom
overview: During the first months of the pandemic, an old woman withers and blooms alongside her flower.

The horrendous weather prompted me to delay the visit however, and create this, a multimedia project consisting of clips of plants at my home, images from the internet of the reserve, and me reading out the reserve's website header and wikipedia page."

title: A Radiant World
overview: Plot is not available.

overview: Dude grieves over the death of his girlfriend but then orders an Android copy of her.

Cereal Killer:A Halloween Special
overview: A Halloween Sequel to Abraham_11’s Cereal Killer, made exclusively for halloween

title: Amoeba
overview: Amoeba is a vibrant comedy short about social anxiety, the pressure to connect, and the power of small acts of friendship.Think Pixar meets Euphoria. Or Inside out but with single-celled organisms...and ketamine.

title: A Black Rail's Tale
overview: A tiny Black Rail guides us through South Carolina’s former rice plantations, revealing how landscapes engineered by enslaved people have become a refuge for one of North America’s rarest birds.

title: Ed Gamble: Live
overview: Recorded in Salford, UK, Comedian Ed Gamble explores neighbourhood message groups, terrible honeymoon choices and the wonders of a British budget hotel breakfast.

title: Embers Across The Tides
overview: Xiaojing, a bright 16-year-old girl, longs to escape her small town and suffocating home, develops a fascination for Yixin—a stylish, intelligent tutor who returns from the big city after losing her job.

title: Running on Luck
overview: An easy victim is being hunted down by two hit men. The job is straightforward, and escape appears impossible. However, fate changes when their gullible target discovers a four-leaf clover.

title: The Story of a Soldier
overview: The mobilisation of the army changes the life of a young man. He becomes a figure on a chess board of war. A piece of shrapnel blinds him and his cries of "I cannot see" become a refrain symbolising the horrors of war."

title: G.I.Z.M.O.
overview: After tech-wiz Andrew Miller gets hacked himself, he follows a set of mysterious coordinates to an unknown facility, where curiosity gets the better of him.  Part of 48 Hours 2026

title: Hip Hop Mediterraneo
overview: "Hip Hop Mediterraneo" follows Social Waste, an independent music collective that has been carving its own path outside the conventions of the music industry for 25 years. Its members, scattered across different parts of Greece, reunite to create their new album and hit the road once again. Through personal moments, conflicts and archival material, the film reveals both the strength and the difficulties of collectivity. With sharp political and social commentary, Social Waste merges hip hop with the musical traditions of the Mediterranean. A musical road movie about co-existence, freedom and the power of togetherness.

title: Reanimator
overview: After a filmmaker revisits a core childhood memory that sparked his fear of bugs, he decides to taxidermise a dead bee, giving his fear a creative outlet.

title: Something in Common
