title: F**k Me in Saint-Gilles
overview: During a jam session in Saint-Gilles, the story of Harry and Tina’s explosive, erratic, lustful affair emerges through music. Every tune reveals a crescendo of sensuality, a heartbreak pause - their jazzy romance is the ultimate 'matching each other's freak'.

title: Uncle Thuận
overview: The parents came to the GDR as contract workers and now run a restaurant in North Rhine-Westphalia. Their daughters ask questions about self-determination, belonging, and happiness.

title: The Flight of Butterflies
overview: The Flight of Butterflies is a documentary about Dariush, a 22-year-old autistic young man, exploring his everyday life, his work, and his personal dreams. Through quiet observations and intimate encounters, the film reflects on individuality, human potential, and the ways people seek to express themselves in a world that often struggles to understand them.

title: The Room of Others
overview: Mietta, a retired woman in her seventies living alone in Milan, opens her home to Ibu, a Senegalese friend, and his pregnant wife, Bousso. What was meant to be temporary accommodation becomes a long-term arrangement, as their son Khadim grows up alongside them. Over the years, tensions and differences challenge their domestic balance, but also create the possibility of building a family beyond blood ties.

title: Los portadores (heraldos neón)
overview: New short by Bruno Varela (Mexico City, 1971), an experimental film and found-footage artist based in Oaxaca.

title: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall
overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.

title: Gambit
overview: Leonard, a conflicted introvert, has been convinced by his brother Tyler to jointly rob a jewellery store. Leonard, unbeknownst to Tyler, has been persuaded by his lover, Olivia, to take the money and run. In this crime drama, Leonard will have to decide what his final move will be.

title: Midnight Sun
overview: Surabaya is a bustling city, and this documentary captures a 24-hour cycle in the lives of three people whose lives have been shattered by circumstances beyond their control, yet who refuse to be victims.

title: Dear Marcelle
overview: Four queer friends meet at Marcelle's house to get ready for Carnival, but Marcelle no longer wants to see them and leaves them standing on her doorstep without explanation. Shocked and confused, the four friends try to save their friendship from silence.

title: A Sunflower in Delhi
overview: In a tiny women’s only beauty parlour, generations of devoted customers, including the filmmaker’s family, reflect on letting their hair go grey. The film meanders between the intimate oasis of the Sunflower Chinese Beauty Parlour and the bustling city landscape outside.

title: Built in a Night
overview: İzmir's gecekondu neighborhoods sit at the film's center. Homes built through migration, roofs raised overnight, and resistance against demolition are recalled. Hand-drawn symbols and wall slogans bring oral history to life. Archival footage, present-day filming, and drawings intertwine. The film reconstructs gecekondu's memory as a form of right to housing and resistance, tracing a forgotten era.

title: The Ancient Forest
overview: For thousands of years, ancient forests have sustained life on Earth. Hidden deep within remote nature reserves in Russia, some of the last untouched old-growth forests have remained virtually unchanged since prehistoric times and are rarely seen by human eyes.  This breathtaking documentary takes you into these remarkable ecosystems, where towering trees support an extraordinary web of life. From fungi and insects to birds and mammals, every species plays a vital role in a delicate natural balance. Revealing the hidden connections between trees and the countless organisms that depend on them, the film is a powerful tribute to the resilience, beauty and importance of the world’s last primeval forests.

title: Our Last Movie About Lisbon
overview: This is our last movie about Lisbon. The starting point is this question: If one day the water swallows this city, what will be the traces of the struggles we shared in these streets? The strength of affections and bodies in motion, determined to disrupt normality, brings us back to the surface. The trace of this struggle will be our ability to imagine together another city, another world

title: Dan & Kat Hide a Body
overview: Dan and Kat are social media influencers on a couples vacation to Venezuela. When they accidentally hit a woman with their car, their picture-perfect getaway takes a dark turn. Rather than face the consequences, they attempt to hide the body and cover up what happened. Dark hilarity ensues as they scramble to evade accountability from both the law and the internet, while desperately maintaining their carefully curated online personas.

title: Pedro e O Lobo - Uma adaptação Criativo Espaço de Arte
War Has No Children
overview: A documentary composed of four stories exploring what it means to be a child during war. In this environment war becomes part of everyday life, and childhood becomes fragile and vulnerable.

title: Journey
overview: An artist runs out of paint days before an exhibition. Desperate for money, he decides to run a hustle: he swaps his brushes for a Bible and heads to the market, performing as a preacher. As he tries this new performance, his path crosses with a dancer.

title: Fatima
overview: Fatima is a model student at her strict school and an obedient daughter to her overprotective father. But in secret, she smokes and trains her voice, developing real singing talent. In a society where singing in public is taboo, she can never let her guard down.

title: Horizontal/Vertical Drift
overview: Part of "The Process Tapes"

title: 1H
overview: Tenderness by the hour. Two teenagers check into a cheap hourly hotel for their first time and stumble, red-faced, into their first real moment of closeness. Mara Cohn tells an unvarnished, laconic and moving coming-of-age story somewhere between fumbling and feeling.

title: Ji.hlava30: Thinking through film
overview: What all is happening and unfolding between the world, the camera, and the audience? This edited film, composed of footage from the festival’s “Minutes from Jihlava to the Mind” series, masterclass recordings, and interviews, weaves together the reflections of guests at the Ji.hlava International Documentary Film Festival on how meaning is created, what film representation does to reality, and how rhythm, editing, sound, and creative choices transform our perception of the reality being depicted. The filmmakers’ perspectives, methods, and questions about the nature of the documentary come together in a reflection on film as a means of understanding and as a space where one can question, discover connections, and rethink the world and one’s own view of it.

title: Fairy Godmothers Inc.
overview: At 'Ursitoare SRL', magical godmothers are hired out on a commercial basis. But when newcomer Dana is sent to work her first christening, the plan backfires and a family's world is turned upside down.

title: Between Us and the World

Seventy years later, local youth from Laayoune (El Aaiún) revisit locations that may have appeared in the footage. From ocean to desert to oasis, under trembling starlight, they share their thoughts on life, dreams, and utopia as they search for an uncertain upstream.

title: Pretend you're my girlfriend

title: Mother

For a year and a half, the camera was in the hands of her eldest daughter. This candid documentary chronicle tells the story of how a woman and her loved ones learn to live a new life, grappling with their fears and discovering new strength.

So, we introduce The Hills Brothers, a brotherly duo of musicians, local to Portsmouth, who spend their nights hosting several Open Mic nights all over Portsmouth and Hampshire. Take a deeper look into why they find these Open Mic nights more than just a fun night to express yourself and your music. Understand why these nights create a community for musicians and why venues like Casemates are essential for the artists support.

title: Behind The Passion
overview: Qatar 2022 was the most expensive World Cup in history. Behind the spectacle sat a system built on bribery and forced labor, one that consumed the men who built it, and a governing body with every reason not to look. In Rosario, Argentina, a human rights organization shaped by the horrors of its own country's past set out to make sure someone did.

title: A Revolta dos Miseráveis

title: Kamukuwaká - The Call of the Forest
overview: Created by Indigenous director Piratá Waurá with producers Studio Kwo XR, Kamukuwaká takes us deep into the Amazon to the struggle of the Wauja people. Stewards of Brazil's first demarcated indigenous territory, they defend their homeland against farmers, loggers, wildfires and climate change. Drawing on ancient myths and their hyperconnected youth, the Wauja stand as a beacon of resilience. Through intimate 360° filming and 3D scanned environments, Piratá brings his people's wisdom in their Arawak language to global audiences, so we may reconnect to Nature as we face an uncertain future.

title: To the North

title: Vessel of Inversion
overview: When everyday objects are detached from their original context and function, they fall into a transitional state between the familiar and the unfamiliar. Their pure objecthood—once concealed by functionality—becomes open to close observation. The camera, in a composed and detached gaze, observes these objects as they move or remain still within an uninhabited space, allowing them to resemble a form of spontaneous dialogue. Through the visual combination of transitional spaces and objects stripped of functionality, the work depicts the psychological state of individuals confronting order, isolation, and uncertainty within enclosed structures. Using low-light imagery, a film-like texture, and objects arranged in stillness or perpetual motion, it creates a sensory atmosphere suspended between reality and dream.

Determined to find answers, they turned their grief into action.

title: The New Library – Part one | 1983 - 2026
overview: As Rotterdam’s Central Library enters a new chapter, The New Library – Part One documents a defining moment in the life of one of the city’s most recognisable public buildings. Following the careful dismantling of its distinctive interior, the film traces the library’s origins and explores how it has embodied changing ideas about knowledge, public space, and urban life over the past forty years. Combining archival material with contemporary voices, it places the building within Rotterdam’s continuous process of reinvention, asking how a city can move forward while remaining connected to the places that shape its collective memory. The first chapter of a documentary diptych, the film offers a timely portrait of an iconic Post ’65 landmark and the questions its future raises for the city and its inhabitants.

title: Untitled Film Disinfection Project I
overview: As Borges once said, “Censorship is the mother of metaphor.” This 16mm structural film explores how state control breeds its own linguistic and visual resistance. Created in response to China's "zero-COVID" policy—with its harsh lockdowns, relentless testing, and severe restrictions that tragically culminated in the Ürümqi fire—this project treats developed image-less Ektachrome film as an "unclean" object in need of cleansing. By applying chlorine dioxide to film surfaces—following government disinfection guidelines during the pandemic—the work transforms physical material into a metaphor for censorship and information control in mainland China. Untitled Film Disinfection Project examines the delicate intersection of public health measures, state control, and artistic resistance.

Together, these perspectives trace a continuum from surveillance to touch, from estrangement and detachment to texture, vulnerability and participation.

title: Need and Desire

The cinematic act becomes incantation: a process that destroys and reconstructs simultaneously. Still memories become an “emulsional” landscape. The 16th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League Tournament in Takasaki
overview: The full schedule for the 16th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League Tournament, which kicks off on Sunday, November 1st at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, has been decided. This tournament will be divided into two blocks, Red Goddesses and Blue Goddesses, with 9 teams in each block, for a total of 18 teams. A total of 72 official matches will be held until Saturday, November 28th at the Okazaki City Gymnasium in Aichi. The top two teams from each block will advance to the final tournament.

title: Neighborhood Autobahn
overview: Who de nes borders and determines which side you are allowed to be on? A cinematic observation along the former Marienborn border checkpoint in Saxony-Anhalt.

title: Siddhartha Suburbia
overview: A short avant-garde film by Šimon Vaitovič, his first cinematic work. The story of a young man who believes he is beginning to experience a spiritual awakening in a world he feels a deep distaste for. Yet something is not quite right.

title: Pieces of a Place I Left Behind
overview: Beyond the bustling barriers of Hout Bay, forgotten fragments lie idle. Derelict vessels and structures stand dormant, suspended in time; unbeknownst to the world around them, uncertain how much longer they shall remain.

title: No Way Back
overview: Three years after the apocalypse, Germany has fallen under the control of a ruthless new regime. In a world overrun by the dead and ruled by the merciless, Antonio, a broken survivor haunted by loss and betrayal, struggles to find a reason to keep going. But as the ghosts of his past refuse to fade, he discovers that the greatest threat isn't the dead wandering the earth — it's the people who are still alive.

title: Ashes of the Mountain
overview: A lone wanderer climbs a snowy mountain, haunted by the ghosts of their past. Set in a surreal space between life and death this charcoal mixed media film follows the journey of a relationship between a father and a daughter.

title: A Place in the Middle
overview: From aerobics to performance art, what really goes on inside Amsterdam’s deconsecrated churches? As the number of so-called third places where people can gather continues to shrink, perhaps churches could once again fulfil that role. These former sacred spaces still bear traces of their original purpose. How does the history of these buildings shape the activities that take place there today?

title: Laiba's Home
overview: Laiba ka Ghar explores resistance, love, and hope. Jasmin, a young mother in her twenties, valued education but married at 16, had her first child before 18, and moved to Bengaluru with her husband after being ostracised by her family.

title: Press Enter to finish the day
overview: Through the testimony of an employee haunted by work-related dreams, this film explores how work seeps into our nights, affecting our mental health. Meanwhile, video games offer a refuge where players eagerly embrace challenges and missions, often within virtual spaces that replicate the very workplaces at the root of their suffering.

title: 4C's Monster Movie
overview: A Monster Movie, brought to you by 4C.

title: Subway Under The Chicken Coop
overview: Two boys decided to dig a subway under a chicken coop and got into trouble.

title: Hoodoo
overview: Young people enjoy a carefree life. A little violence is just part of having fun, but at some point the fun stops being fun. There are supposed to be people who make huge profits from war. For the individuals directly affected - pawns on the chessboard - is this business model fatal?

title: Women Around Me
overview: The story of three women who are undergoing a transformation of their lives due to the events caused by the Great War. Yaryna is looking for her fiancé, who is probably in Russian captivity, and volunteering for the East. Kateryna is adapting her family's routine after her military husband's leg amputation. Daria is building her life after losing her husband in the war.

title: Found
overview: An abandoned house explorer (Mara) finds something super shocking s scary in the basment but wait....The house she went in was haunted and she was (spoiler warning) actually dead the whole time (spoiler alert) and she finds her own corps in the basement and she was on the missing poster and she's stuck in a time loop I think perchance. Play the film backwards and on 2x speed for a surprise and hidden message... (Super scary watch this short film at your own risk please)

title: The Last Summer Camp
overview: Two best friends have spent every summer at the same summer camp. Now it’s their last one, and they both know nothing will ever be the same again. As part of their camp duties, they are ordered to destroy an anthill. A heated argument stops the job and before they can make up, thousands of ants swarm in, ready for revenge...

title: Bwgan
overview: Six-year-old Betti isn't used to sharing her Mam, especially on her birthday. But when a baking disaster sends them into town for a new cake, an unwelcome gatecrasher turns a simple trip into an unexpectedly difficult adventure.

title: Redwood Understory
overview: Redwood Understory is an exploration of the flora, fauna and fungi of the redwood forest. Filmed in 16mm in extreme close-up, in short bursts, the film gives the feeling of exploring the forest floor on hands and knees, blinking at the wonders illuminated by the shifting light.

title: Think Twice
overview: Mike just wrapped a late-night shoot when four masked men jump him in the parking lot, pistol-whip him and drive off with his whole camera package. He wants his gun. Jada wants the one thing they left behind: a chapstick that fell out of a robber's pocket. Magic is high tonight, and four robbers are about to find out why you think twice before you mess with the wrong ones.

title: Possible Futures: Designing Tomorrow in the Netherlands
overview: Following five teams of designers investigating the future of water, energy, housing, mobility, agriculture, and care, the film explores how design research can help imagine and debate the future of the Netherlands.

title: Mono No Aware
overview: "Mono No Aware" is a short film shot on Super 8 film that creates a brief visual poem expressing the Japanese aesthetic concept of the sweet melancholy we feel in the presence of the beauty of things, precisely because we know they will not last forever.

title: Iraganeko mamuentzat
overview: I have decided to embark on this journey to meet the ghosts of my past. After many years, the time has come to bring out everything I have inside and face it. To do this, I will return to the town of my childhood.

title: The Inheritance
overview: Two sisters are forced into a confined space to deal with their inherited traumas and estranged relationship in the face of their mother’s death.

title: Something happened in that house.
overview: And you know what.

title: Flame of the Forest
overview: After a quick taste of freedom, a young nurse arrives home and gets blamed for her grandmother’s death.

title: Mizrahi Mismatch
overview: Judith and Menahem met in 1959, and wed within weeks. They are fire and water, ghormeh sabzi and gachun, yet somehow have survived 67 years together.

title: The Book of George
overview: From Brooklyn's concrete jungle to the heart of the Everglades, meet George McKenzie Jr., a Black photographer transforming his lens into a beacon of change. Swapping the weight of a gun for the promise of a camera, George found his calling amid nature's raw grandeur, capturing everything from city pigeons and rats to elusive panthers.

title: Trasadi
overview: Darpan Maskey, 20s, is haunted by someone performing a weird ritual. Severe hand wounds and whispers haunt Darpan as he slowly begins to realize the predicament he is in. To get out of this situation, he takes the help of his friend, Kiran, a young priest who desires to help out his friend and to stand up on his own feet, independent of his father. He takes Darpan and tries to help him in his own way, as Darpan has to make tough decisions. This leads to a situation both of them could never have predicted.

title: The flash drive killer case
overview: This Mockumentary horror about officers find flash drive in the park And it was found that there were 3 video clips that were less than 1 minute long, as follows Video 1 Joe Possessed by a ghost and hit on the head into the wall Video 2 a curse movie film scene and Video 3 show William O Jack got shot by Fred and police found out Fred is the owner of that flash drive and the how the flash drive killer case was begin.

title: Imago
overview: A young man wakes up in a pine grove and begins to draw a place he remembers: a small grove by the sea, traced with nothing but a blue line. He tells his friend that he would like to return there someday, and the two decide to go looking for it. This is the premise of the “great adventure” the two friends — driven by the desire to find a place drawn from memory — are about to embark on.

title: Menudita
overview: Sofia (15) lives with her mother, Soledad (40), and is eagerly awaiting the arrival of her best friend from the internet, Irina (15). Both girls suffer from eating disorders. Sofia and Irina spend the day walking around the city, but when they return home, Soledad has discovered their secret.

title: Crimson
overview: At a crowded passport renewal office in Tehran, Neda, a young modern woman, clashes with Yasser, a conservative man, when she refuses to retake his passport photo.

title: I Want To Be A Butterfly
overview: On the day of his school recital, nine-year-old Khimo struggles to tell a story about a child who dreams of becoming a butterfly, as fragments of his childhood reveal a disturbing truth hidden beneath his innocent imagination.

title: to be judged
overview: "In this society, you’ve already lost anyway—I’m just not white, I’m not cis, I’m not hetero," says Gem. Together with Naomi, Gem is part of Munich’s vibrant Ballroom scene—a queer subculture historically pioneered by Black and Latinx trans women. Here, in a world flipped on its head, being outside the white, cis-heteronormative box isn't the exception; it's the norm. It is a vital sanctuary of celebration, free from stares, slurs, or the constant need to justify one's existence.  But as the night unfolds, the boundaries between escapism and harsh reality blur. In the category of Realness, trans individuals compete to see who blends best into a cis-normative world—a survival skill judged as an art form. Why do these safe spaces actively replicate the very judgments of the outside world, and how did they become a chosen home? Through raw, intimate access to Naomi and Gem, this documentary explores the heart, joy, and deep-rooted complexities of Munich’s Ballroom community.

title: Don‘t Disturb
overview: After his father's death, an estranged son keeps the death certificate to extort his family for a share of the inherited land. But when he trespasses onto the property, he unknowingly insults the 'Datuk Gong' beneath a sacred tree, unleashing a terrifying curse upon himself.

title: Gaman
overview: Bhau and Mai, an elderly couple from rural Konkan, travel to Mumbai to stay briefly with their sons for minor medical treatment. Though their sons-Pratap, Manohar, and Sharad-are well settled and caring, Bhau and Mai struggle to adjust to city life, longing for their village home and fields. Meanwhile, Kundan and Tara, siblings displaced by floods in Uttar Pradesh, arrive in Mumbai seeking work. After much hardship, Kundan finds employment at Pratap's catering business. During Ganeshotsav, Bhau and Mai return to their village, and Kundan and Tara accompany them to assist. In the absence of their city-settled children, the siblings fill an emotional void, forming a deep bond with the couple.  When Kundan and Tara must return to their own village to claim flood compensation, Bhau and Mai are left alone once more. Bhau later passes away, and aging forces Mai to move permanently to Mumbai. The village home and fields fall silent.

title: A Folk Story
overview: An unsettling encounter unfolds along a lonely road. Blurring the boundaries between folklore, belief, and the supernatural, A Folk Story is an experimental short mystery horror film that explores the unknown through the lens of a traditional folk tale.

title: Insanity
overview: 7 friends go on a camping trip after a year of not seeing each other. Everything is going well until a killer wielding a sword and bow comes to join the party...

title: Odít se do vzdoru – Šáhín Bágh
Aktos
overview: Twelve-year-old Batyr has been secretly working on a daring project with only his loyal dog, Aktos, by his side. When a sudden crisis threatens his plan, Batyr must race against time to finish it before it's too late.

title: Unlock
overview: After an accident abruptly ends his BDSM relationship, MilkBottle completes a final video task reflecting on his journey from Shandong, China to London, UK. As a webcam porn influencer, he confronts homophobia, sexual racism, and the blurred boundaries between digital and physical realms in search of a paradoxical ‘true self.’

title: Of the Land
overview: A Samoan musician born and raised in Hawaiʻi, spends the day with his best friend Alex, chasing dreams of music, romance, and a future beyond their everyday lives. But as casual jokes and familiar spaces give way to increasingly painful encounters, the two are forced to confront how differently the place they call home sees them.

title: Illuminated Crevices
overview: Expanded horizons. A penumbra of virgin vision. An exercise and trial in subjecting the sensor to unfavorable conditions to excavate what should be seen by the untainted eye.  Dim all the lights, and kill all the sounds.

title: this, too, will be liquid
overview: All bodies are made of water – and the water around us keeps rising. A poetic-meditative experiment in black-and-white that blends biography and melting glaciers.

title: Some Faceless Memories Pt. II
overview: The second short film of the series, merging multiple memories about curiosity together in a 10-minute short film.

title: Mark Hama: In Service
overview: At 16, Mark Hama entered the Yashica camera factory to support his father and siblings; years later, he gambled on an independent film camera repair business in the U.S. to provide for his wife and sons. Now in his 80s, Mark reflects on a lifetime of choices driven by duty to others while remaining one of the few original craftsmen practicing this disappearing art of camera restoration.

title: Zahartzaro feministarantz, Boga-boga
overview: A Basque documentary that highlights the 30-year history and collective empowerment of Boga-Boga, a feminist group for older women in Ondarroa, Basque Country. It focuses on the voices and lived experiences of older women, proposing an active and collective view of aging.

title: Allo Neredallo
overview: In rural Telangana, close friends Ganga and Suresh face separation when Ganga prepares to leave for the city. During a playful moment, Suresh accidentally hurts her, misinterpreting her first menstrual cycle as an injury. As traditional rituals isolate Ganga for marriage, their friendship is tested by silence, distance, and the pressures of growing up.

title: SILENT ANXIETY
overview: Neil is tired. Tired of college, tired of the constant reminders from home, and tired of pretending that everything is fine. A simple message from his mother becomes one more thing he has to carry alone.  Follow him through a single, restless day of headphones, half-hearted shrugs, and quiet moments where his composure starts to slip. Where his day takes him is something you'll have to see for yourself.  Silent Anxiety never explains what is wrong, and it doesn't have to. It's about the anxiety people carry quietly, often hidden behind indifference, and the loneliness of not having the words to say it.

title: Feral City
overview: A disgruntled Big City detective hunts down his prime suspect in a city known for nothing good.

title: The Making of The Shepherd’s Lamb
overview: A documentary about the making of Ed' Morrow's hand-drawn debut feature film. Ed' reflects on three years of work on The Shepherd’s Lamb, looking back on how the project began, how its characters and visual identity developed, the challenges of learning animation while making the film, and the creative decisions that shaped the final cut.

title: bearing fruit of fondness, Grounds of Coherence #2
overview: Filmed in Northern Isle of Skye, bearing fruit of fondness is a 16mm black and white film hand processed with a type of invasive cotoneaster that is native to Eastern Asia, brought to the UK in the 19th century as an ornamental plant. Working with elemental kinship, the process guides a capacity to relate to pain while grounded in the understanding of interdependence, where concept of belonging erodes through patterns of mother-child relationships that extend to nation and citizen, land and dweller. The film features a single-take vocal performance of the script in Chinese by Shen Xin, interspersed with breath and stillness against the Southwest storms heard from their home.

title: Hair Curlers on a Bald Man
overview: The exploratory film “Hair Curlers on a Bald Man” is dedicated to Georgy Frantsevich Millyar (born de Milieu), a unique figure in Soviet cinema — the actor who played “every imp, troll, and hobgoblin”, the unforgettable Baba Yaga and the allegorical Koschei in the fairy-tale films by Alexander Rou, as well as a host of other parts and walk-ons. Drawn from documents in the Russian State Archive of Literature and Art, the Museum of Cinema, Mosfilm, the Gorky Film Studio, Gosfilmofond, the Russian State Archive of Film and Photo Documents, and the Gelendzhik Museum of Local History, the film turns into Millyar’s own archive — a mythical territory where the actor’s life and the history of Soviet cinema assemble into a collage on memory and on a person’s place in history.

title: Words in the Wind
overview: Inspired by the Yunnanese concept of chit-chatting, the film gently moves through the everyday lives of Yunnanese women navigating the northern Thai-Myanmar border. From doorsteps to coffee shops, the camera lingers to capture fragments of memories, histories of flight, and the echoes of lives shaped by conflict.

title: Tutuvi
overview: A glimpse into the life, work, community, and collaborations of Japanese-Korean artist and designer Colleen Kimura.

title: The Big One
overview: A man's relationship is strained by his addiction to $1 wagers.

title: Velvet Burn
overview: A portrait of drag artist Ally Starr.

title: Grind
overview: The offer of a promotion threatens to dismantle a man's life.

title: Harvest
overview: A man gets abducted and must fight to escape.

title: Fish, Chips & Faith
overview: The uplifting story of a Leeds restaurant bringing communities together by serving Kosher and Halal food under one roof.

title: The Minotaur
overview: The Minotaur is a retelling of the Greek myth about a half man / half bull who is imprisoned in a labyrinth by King Minos. The film is made from 35mm slides found on eBay, each with a drawing scratched into the surface. Employing 2,500 drawings, The Minotaur took 10 months to make—having gone through several early forms including as a computer game and a clumsy animation made solely from mosaics. Music written and performed by Stephen Crowe.

title: In Search of Honey
overview: While a beekeper living on the border of Latvia awaits for a constantly deteriorating harvest of honey, the residents of the country decide to search for their „honey“ in the capital or abroad, leaving behind man-made landscapes frozen in time, all of which tell stories about the life that once flourished in the smaller cities.

title: Total Control
overview: The video piece makes use of both surveillance and thermal imaging and is based on the artist’s personal experience of normative exercise of power in a museum space, asking whether all kinds of bodies have safe access to art.

title: Triana. El faro que no cesa
Black Holes
overview: Across a desolate mountain landscape, two sightless figures embark on a journey toward a solitary tree whose living eyes have watched over the world for centuries.

title: Silent Connections
overview: On a rainy afternoon in Mexico City, Gonzalo, a young man from Sonora, burdened by grief and distance, takes refuge on a park bench. There he meets Yolitzli, a deaf young woman from Oaxaca. Through gestures, silence, and falling rain, an unexpected bond emerges between them, transforming the way they communicate and reminding him that true listening reaches far beyond the ears.

title: Moonfish
overview: By the sea they live—a mother and her deaf daughter. The father is far away on a fishing trip. Some whisper he’s long dead, lost to the waves. Yet the mother and daughter still cling to hope, fragile though it may be. And then, one day, a miracle comes ashore.

title: A Light In The Attic
overview: A girl hears a music box coming from her dark closet, and gets her older brother to investigate the mysterious sound.

title: NENA SACRA
overview: One day, goalkeeper Neno got his jaw caught in the goal net... and survived, justifying the creation of a new religion.  Now, in this documentary, Pastor Serjão—spiritual leader of the "Devotees of Neno"—marks 32 years of love and gratitude for his god with a 332 km trek from Santarém to Guimarães.

title: Angel & Meow
overview: A meta-cinematic odyssey where the boundaries between a composer's studio and a sci-fi galaxy dissolve through the power of music and an unlikely friendship.

title: My Dear Stranger
overview: Vennela after a major accident goes through trauma and is unable to come out of it , who later meets Surya who attempts to bring joy into her life .

title: Beach Day
overview: Fish, bodybuilders and soccer games re-materialize in a boy’s mind. Inspired by childhood videos and transitioning, Beach Day is a collage of past and present, digital and analog, imagined and real. Digitized camcorder video, rotoscoped animations and narrated anecdotes merge with ambient noises to create an unravelling of time.

title: NYRA II
overview: Trapped in a series of looping dream timelines, Nyra is hunted by an unknown killer and must find a way to escape before the cycles consume her.

title: Pozos
overview: A former combatant of the Malvinas war reviews historical events of his life while Alzheimer's progresses little by little inside of him.

title: My Best P@l
overview: A young and massive metal pole becomes an unusual vehicle for desire. Through the fantasy of being loved – and fucked – the film playfully blurs the boundaries between object and subject, intimacy and projection. In a short, provocative form, it queers the understanding of the body, eroticism and desire, revealing their absurd and yet surprisingly human dimensions.

title: Knar
overview: In a quiet village, the body of an elderly man, Bhimsen Chhetri, is prepared for his final rites. His legs are carefully tied, his body bound with ritual precision, and the mourners stand in silence as tradition is followed without question. As the funeral procession begins, the film shifts decades into the past. A younger Bhimsen helps carry the body of his friend named Balmiki along with one old man and another young man through mustard fields toward the riverside for cremation. During a brief rest, a young man and an old man went to collect the wood into the jungle leaving Bhimsen alone with the corpse. What follows is an unexplainable event.

title: Loa Loa
overview: In 1920, Teresa and Maria live on a farmhouse. Maria does all the housework: she looks after Teresa, cooks, washes clothes, sews, and sings to her at bedtime. But when Teresa falls asleep, Maria doesn't rest; she continues with her chores. A visit from a neighbor arouses Teresa's curiosity, making her daily routine more interesting.

title: WABBIT
overview: A man is gifted a mysterious mask that causes him to lose his mind.

title: A Norway Visit : Skjolden
overview: Skjolden is a beautiful and luscious town in Norway's deepest and longest fjord of Sognefjord. Camouflaged in the bright, green mountains lies tips, facts and awe which will capture any viewer's attention.

title: DOGFACE
overview: After Jack  invents a machine that teleports him and his stepbrother to a parallel universe, they encounter a serial killer in a dog mask

title: 100 Second Lumination
overview: Part of "The Process Tapes"

title: Making a Mother
overview: What makes a mother? A short animation exploring matrescence, the often unseen and deeply personal metamorphosis of becoming a mother. This film reimagines ancient wisdom for contemporary motherhood, offering language, beauty, and recognition to an experience many feel, but few can name. A new mother is in a process of radical change – morphing, transforming, transcending. But does anybody see her?

title: The Rug
overview: Hamed, a hardworking rug cleaner in Tehran, faces a dilemma after discovering that one of the expensive Persian rugs he picked up for cleaning is missing. Desperate to find it and avoid the hefty cost of replacement, he retraces his steps, growing increasingly suspicious of his friends who handled the order the previous evening.

title: God is Real
overview: After successfully covering up Paul McCartney's death, two CIA agents are tasked with the impossible... convince the entire world that God is real.

title: Me Too (Make Films)
overview: A novice documentarian wants a place at film school and sets out to shoot a study of an interesting person. Finding no one at 11 at night, she ends up at the Smolensk Cemetery, at Aleksei Balabanov’s grave. Trying to make a film of it, she comes away with a string of botched sketches: a couple on a first date; a painter who has spent years on a portrait of Balabanov;people who turn up to drink and argue about cinema. It was dark, the camera pointed the wrong way, she had promised not to show a thing, she walked out on her subject. Everything that mattered was not caught on camera, and so it was drawn.

title: Baby Fate
overview: When an ordinary day at home takes an unexpected turn, revealing just how fragile life can be and how the end of one generation can expose another.

title: Façade
overview: In an apartment building, a variety of residents live side by side. Behind each door lies a personal secret. Some darker, some stranger than they first appear. Outwardly cheerful Joosep, dreamy Pille-Riin, withdrawn Ott, and nosy Magda – each harbors an inner world that slowly begins to seep through the wallpaper and walls. As the residents struggle to keep their secrets hidden, cracks begin to spread through the building’s facade. Soon, all their secrets threaten to come to light.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Nieuw Hemel Jaar
overview: In the film Nieuw Hemel Jaar, five women sing excerpts from a poem by artist Ad van Rosmalen, accompanied by the choir Bocca Bella. Through the singing of these excerpts, not only body and mind are expressed, but also the soul.  How could it be otherwise? In singing, body and mind are connected and become imbued with soul.

title: Mono No Aware
overview: The spiritual journey of a human being -an idealized model, a prophet of purity- on the path toward the Nietzschean Übermensch, reinterpreted through a contemporary lens. From the social darkness of the Camel, taking its steps through a desert of melancholy and solitude, to the verbal force of the Lion, reflected in its absolute moral freedom and freedom of thought, up to the birth of the Child, the very manifesto of innocence, ruled by instinct, physical ecstasy, a continuous search for the Self, and constant linguistic experimentation.

title: Deadsight
overview: A cold-blooded contract killer known only as Deadsight executes without hesitation in order to clear his criminal record.

title: El jazz latino no es para siempre
Opetael
overview: When 19-year-old artist Megi is rejected from her dream art school, her childhood imaginary friend, Opetael, mysteriously reappears. Together, they must figure out who is the serial killer who murdered the course's top three accepted applicants - before the killer strikes again...

title: Free Zone
overview: Exarchia, Athens. A place of left utopias and a fiercely contested site of gentrification. For the Iranian activist Abtin, the political struggle becomes a threat to his own freedom.

title: Unconditonal
overview: What would you do for your cat?

title: Living Geometry
overview: A movie about triangles and absolutely NOTHING else.

title: Catfood
overview: After hearing mysterious reports of a creature kidnapping people in the night, Estelle finds herself too scared to feed her cats. Her granddaughter, Aurora, does it for her.

title: El silencio de Allen Robert Angelo
My Dyslexic Mind
overview: A journey of acceptance, growth, and confidence within a mind with dyslexia, revealing the cracks of inaccessibility embedded in the education systems.

title: Enemies: A Tale of Friendship
overview: “The Thunder From Jalandhar” and “The All American” Azeem “the Dream” have battered each other across the Pacific Northwest’s indie wrestling circuit for over a decade. Under the banner of All Star Wrestling, they’ve honed their routine to perfection.  But when All Star Wrestling goes up for sale, Thunder and Azeem must learn how to step out of the spotlight to ensure the survival of the organization and usher in a new generation of wrestling talent.

title: Blind Spot
overview: An unconventional experimental animated horror film presented as recovered security footage from a Singapore office building that mysteriously burned down at 4:44 a.m. Framed as archived files, the film presents seemingly mundane CCTV loops of an empty hallway, a stairwell, and an office. As time goes on the footage glitches and deteriorates until eventually revealing something unnatural.

title: Structure
overview: Through the eyes of a parking ticket machine, we experience the everyday realities of a city lobby: angry passersby, playful children, graffiti taggers, bickering couples, and drunken antics. Dissatisfied with its disrespectful patrons and constant view of the mundane, an act of rebellion sends the machine to uncharted territory.

title: Quit Deacon Me Around
overview: A Deacon's faith is put to the test when an eccentric coroner follows him home, claiming to have trapped a demon.

title: The Shoe
overview: After entering a mysterious shoe repair shop,  a young man discovers his shoe no longer fits trapping him in a place where even escape feels impossible.

title: MEMORY
overview: A reflection of childhood memories.

title: Rules of the Game
overview: After a heist gone wrong, the one remaining survivor of the crew is left to reckon with the crime. With a bag of money and the body of his dead brother, he sets out on a revenge plot against the person responsible.

title: Shirt Story
overview: When a dying man turns into a shirt, his daughter must find a way to keep him warm.

title: Air Pangea
overview: A man prepares for death, washing and wrapping himself in the kafan as his mother reminds him only deeds and prayers matter. As the soul transcends the body, it confronts visions of the afterlife — demonic figures, mythical creatures, three guarded doors — exploring death through sex, drugs, and rock and roll as much as ritual and prayer. Plunged into a metaphorical sea of memory, love, and loss, he searches for his mother's voice amid the waves. He awakens on a lake shore met by angels. What lies beyond the waterfall? Sex drugs rock and roll?

title: C'MON, PLEASE!
overview: Erol, Kenzie, and Akmal were students eating and relaxing together at a meatball stall. Suddenly, Akmal ran into his friend, Mahesa, and the two became engrossed in a long conversation. This left Erol and Kenzie feeling awkward and bored. They exchanged subtle signals, hoping to head home soon. After a long wait, Mahesa finally said his goodbyes. Erol and Kenzie felt relieved when Akmal suggested they leave, effectively bringing the tedious situation to an end.

title: The Class Video
overview: A young philosophy student has to record himself on video introducing himself and talking about what is most important to him, his home, his family and his friends.

title: Love is light
overview: a silent film about a man with unorganized attachment that jumps to a conclusion after a argument

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: Streetlight
overview: A Girl is injured in a car accident, and attempts to find help while suffering from hallucinations.

title: Keep Staring
overview: An uneasy young man and his friend run out of gas in a remote park, only to find out they are not alone.

title: Farewell
overview: After taking his own life beneath their recurrent willow tree, the spirit of the tormented Sergio finds itself in a void. Upon seeing his friend Adolfo holding his lifeless body, he realizes the impact of his death. Desperate, he breaks through the barrier separating the two worlds and attempts to reach out to him.

title: The Wronged of Juiced
overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

title: B*tch
overview: Her womanhood was shaped by strict expectations: the lmmaker searches for belonging in the tension between her rural Slovakian roots, her sexuality and her creative callings.

title: In Our Panic
overview: A grandmother tells her young grandson about a monster covered in white fur — one said to devour children who lie or steal. The frightening tale leaves the boy with lasting trauma. Grown up, the grandson learns of the painful past his grandmother had long kept hidden, deepening his understanding of family and love.

title: Scatterbrain
overview: When his brother goes missing, Myles must confront himself to find him.

title: Sweet New Suit
overview: This film takes place within the lives of two friends that conflict with one another, as "Q" can't take responsibility for his actions and loosely getting "Jazz" involved.

title: Wrapped in Wool
overview: On a cold snowy winter day, Bernadette, a sweet lonely older woman sits alone in her warm but quiet house. Surrounded by empty sofas, wool and knitting needles, she feels useless and longs for someone to knit for, to look after and to love. Until a frozen puppy suddenly appears at her front door.

title: Rae's Video Diary
overview: Through unfiltered diary entries, a growing teenager documents her peculiar growing pains – both heartbreaking and hilarious – that shape who she’s becoming.

title: Solitude
overview: A teenager is going through a tough time, struggling with anxiety. After he is haunted by an eerie dream, he is forced to confront his inner demons.

title: The Balcony in Shanghai Still Burns
overview: Sixteen years after leaving, a 1.5-generation Chinese-Canadian returns to her native city alone, seeking to reconnect with the place that once was home.

title: Greeley's Creamies
overview: A mysterious snack cake brand leads its victims into a deadly parallel world if they stop consuming it.

title: The Woodsman
overview: Two college siblings flee from a mysterious monster and learn the value of friendship and family.

title: The Sea Ate the Chair
overview: What year is it now? And what time is it? Why do I understand time?  On a walk by the sea I find myself asking questions that cannot be answered and cannot be left unasked.

title: Estranged
overview: A young couple have a peaceful evening at a park when they meet a strange young girl carrying a black balloon. Later that night, strange things begin to happen, turning their ordinary evening into a disturbing experience where nothing is quite what it seems.

title: I See No Death
overview: The film follows a newly formed Ukrainian unmanned systems unit from its first deployment in the Donetsk region and on to operations on Russian territory. The daily lives of these modern-day warriors unfold in cold cellars and trenches, where destruction becomes a technical task and death is reduced to a few pixels on a monitor.

title: Golden Haze
overview: A top student, haunted by the pressure to succeed, finds her rigid equilibrium disrupted when she stumbles into unexpected journeys and quiet moments of self realisation through external circumstances. Until, for the first time, with naked, unguarded eyes, she peeks into the bright sunlight beyond the haze, and realises, she is freed from the soulless, uninvited notes, the world beyond that halo of light has always been waiting for her, to play out her own shining future.

title: Doble-6
overview: A group of friends play an ancient "cursed" board game — and a death foretold becomes reality. To stop the spirit of their deceased friend, they must face paranormal forces, an eccentric shaman, and the absurd rules of the game itself. Horror with humor and a double 6.

title: Projet Theresa
overview: On July 29, 1999, Octave DUBOIX is arrested for the murder of his wife, Theresa. On February 4, 2002, after a turbulent trial, the man is found guilty of the charges against him.

title: A Yellow Hat
overview: There is a hat. A yellow hat. It is smiling. And the person who wears it is smiling too; with an unnatural, frozen grin. In the glow of the screen, the entire room begins to feel wrong.

title: Focal length
overview: A Film By Setareh Azad

title: TOE′S
overview: After injuring his pinky toe while working at a distribution center, Mingi receives a mysterious package. Inside is something unexpected, something he could never have imagined.

title: A Matter of Interest
overview: A group of wealthy investors gathers at a secluded estate to negotiate a business deal with a questionable arms dealer.

title: La entrada
overview: The door that is never where you leave it it's the image of an inestable life, where uncertainty is the only certainty. Every return home becomes a disturbing search not only for the door itself but for the conviction that inside it resides something to belong to. As routine repeats, the man tries to adapt, memorize and negotiate with the unpredictable. But the effort itself wears him down: the house it's not a shelter anymore but a constant reminder that nothing is guaranteed.

Told from the perspective of a medical case file, "99" recounts the true story of a diabetic patient who loses both hands after a fatal surgical error, exposing the fragile boundary between human mistake, bureaucracy, and justice.

title: (Blue) Glitz Finale
overview: Part of "The Process Tapes"

title: CAPTCHA
overview: Cédric has a videoconference interview to get a job in a bank. But the recruiter seems strangely artificial. With the help of his roommate, Cédric tries to find out who is really hiding behind the screen.

title: Life In Every Breath
overview: A samurai abandoned as a child survives years of war, only to return home and find his village destroyed and his family gone.  Facing one more loss, he swears vengeance and steps into an uncertain future.

title: Outshine
overview: One day, the light in one lighthouse burns out. When the keeper replaces it with an even brighter bulb, it sparks the competitive spirit of the keeper across the water. The two soon become entangled in an absurd duel of increasingly outrageous lighting upgrades. As their one-upmanship escalates, they seemingly forget their original responsibilities as lighthouse keepers…

title: Maryse
overview: Between the solitude of the training room and the immensity of the sea, Maryse, a former bodybuilding champion, performs her routine once more. In the quest for a body pushed to its limits, she reveals her relationship to femininity, appearances, and bodybuilding as a form of self-sculpting.

title: This is Not a Heartbeat
overview: Interrogates how science is translated, mythologized, and weaponized through the story of one misunderstood sound: the fetal heartbeat. At six weeks, the so-called ‘heartbeat’ is not the sound of a heart at all, but machine-generated audio. Yet this manufactured signal has become deeply emotional and politically charged, used to restrict abortion access across the U.S.

title: Kronoshock
overview: Nestled in the middle of a secluded valley and surrounded by green meadows and rivers, an imposing mass of snow and rock rises abruptly. The adventurous Lord Cliffrider hopes to be the first to achieve the summit of his longed-for mountain, but as time passes, this dream vanishes like the smoke from his pipe. This is a silent stop-motion film about the ambitions of a climber to reach the top.

title: Les Duos impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11e édition
Spring
overview: A furry creature climbs a world of coiled springs, until escape reveals another meaning: spring.

title: Espwa Haiti: Against All Odds
overview: ESPWA (Hope in French Creole) is a feature-length documentary that explores the role of Haitian artists as guardians of the nation's voice at a time when national institutions and governance are absent or failing. The film examines Haiti's history and the repercussions of the recent assassination of President Jovenel Moïse as the country attempts to rebuild itself on the path to security and prosperity. Espwa is a story of resilience, offering exclusive access to the account of Joverlein Moïse, the assassinated president's son, who shares his testimony for the first time.

title: Threaded: Adelaide
overview: A documentary event exploring the designers, photographers and makers shaping South Australia’s fashion scene.

title: The Automotive Dead
overview: Three guys are working away in the autoshop on a classic car when things take a turn... The car becomes possessed and will devour anyone in sight. Will Paul and George survive, or will they be run down by THE AUTOMOTIVE DEAD!!!

title: Who wants to be the devil's secretary
overview: Daniel Tello is the guest in the famous show "Quien quiere del diablo ser secretario" where he has to answer all of the 15 questions to win the big prize of the 8 vehicles of Fucha.

title: Pit Of Bones
overview: 4 Friends go camping and get put into The Pit of Bones

title: The Night Moses Died
overview: Weighed down by others' ideas of who they should be, nineteen-year-old Moses carries more responsibility than most while searching for space to become themselves. An unlikely kinship with retired showgirl Carmel opens the door to another life, where sequins and stories illuminate a nuanced coming-of-identity story celebrating selfhood and survival.

title: Noli me tangere
overview: If the sun drowns in a sea of mist / And a wave of darkness covers the world / And sight vanishes from every eye and gaze / And the path is lost among lines and circles / You who wander, who searches, and who understand / Have no guide but the eyes of words. The Egyptian poet Ahmed Fouad Negm wrote these lines in the early 1970s. Today, they are sung by a woman who stands with her back to the horizon. Noli me tangere is a journey in which personal history is inevitably disrupted by the course of history in Lebanon. It begins at the moment when the very idea of tomorrow suddenly loses all meaning.

title: ROBO-FRIEND
overview: Comedy skit about a new instalment of artificial intelligent robot pets.

title: Before Dawn
overview: A spacious apartment on the third floor is the only one with the lights on. Clinking glasses, chatter, and laughter. It’s a classmate reunion. They are going to hang till dawn, just as they did on their prom night. And it all goes well until people start disappearing without leaving a trace.

title: Widows
overview: During her husband’s wake, a grieving woman is drawn into a group of widows who tempt her toward a new beginning.

title: Impersonation
overview: Pratiroopa is a portrait of look-alike artist named Jaishri Raju who has been impersonating  Dr.Vishnuvardhan for more than two decades for a living. The film follows his journey as an impersonator and how he manages to fill the massive void left behind by the star, performing and recreating his iconic moments and songs, and in-turn entertaining fans.  The film also reflects upon the larger subcultures of rural orchestra and company theatre in Karnataka.

title: Terugweg
overview: The sensation of going home alone intoxicated, slowly sobering up and getting ready to sleep

title: Abnegation
overview: In a world irreversibly damaged by Al data centers, a couple is forced to rely on the very same tool responsible for creating resource scarcity. With the Al in her ear and her thoughts, a wife faces an irrevocable choice.

title: All I Dream
overview: An eight year old girl tries to pluck a mago from a mango tree

title: every pixels loving memory
overview: A partial autobiography of my body in its existence on and off screen. My body as an image alienated, pixelated, detached and repurposed from its skin and blood.

title: ARK
overview: The new ‘Green Ark’ at Meise Botanic Garden is designed to protect endangered plant species in the face of a global biodiversity crisis. Following the construction of this carefully controlled environment, ARK draws parallels between the processes of construction and conservation, and urges architecture to assume an active role in protecting biodiversity.

title: Linear Endjoy
overview: The phosphor layer of a cathode ray tube visualizes the final vanishing of an electron beam – its last “happy” moment.  A Pale Blue Dot Matter Wave.  A minimalist short film exploring the traces of electronic imaging and perception. It operates between physical materiality, temporality, and subjective experience.

title: Lo Que Permanece
overview: Julián finds in Izel a close friend, someone who understands the pain of growing up in a home consumed by violence. In her, he finds the affection he cannot find in his brother. But he is unaware of the darkness some places carry, and of the truth behind the pain that haunts his nightmares.

title: Preparing Innineu: Partridge Cleaning in Sheshatshiu
overview: Partridges are a common food source for Innu First Nation People in Labrador, especially in Sheshatshiu. Partridge is Innineu in Innu-aimun. This film captures a cultural workshop at the Manishan Nui Gull Island Gathering, filmed by Innu youth Reighlyn Penashue and Karlianna Pokue, with help from emerging filmmakers Heidi Atter and Charlie Pye-Strowbridge.

title: What’s a Star Without You?
overview: A frog sets out to overcome the death of his wife through a farewell letter.

title: The Gates of Irkalla
overview: A team of ancient Greek mercenaries is hired to rescue a governor's daughter from a cult. But the dead are coming back to life

title: LIPOLAS CARNEIROS: O Último Código
overview: When a series of mysterious blackouts begins revealing hidden messages across the city, Lipolas Carneiros discovers that his past is connected to a secret project capable of rewriting people's memories. Teaming up with his closest friends, he races to uncover the truth before a powerful organization erases every trace of it. Facing dangerous chases, unexpected betrayals, and impossible choices, the group embarks on a mission that could change their future forever.

title: Solstice
overview: The disruption of an isolated rural town's tradition sends siblings Kaid and Caroline out of their town on a path that's subject to troubling rumours and haunted legends that warn against those who walk along it.

title: Nizhalilirundhu Velicham
overview: When life's rejections push a man to his breaking point, an unwavering bond pulls him back into the light.

title: solanaceae
overview: solanaceae is structured like an invocation. A voice addresses us without revealing its origin. It speaks of rituals, healing and intoxication, of a knowledge that has been revered and persecuted for centuries. Only gradually does the perspective shift: the voice does not belong to a human being. It is not a plant being invoked—the plant itself speaks from the ground. In a time of collective exhaustion, the work asks about other forms of knowledge, memory and transformation. The starting point is research into henbane, a plant that has been associated with magical practices and transformation for centuries.

title: Witch
overview: When a young content creator suspects her illness is a result of her stepmother, she begins to fight fire with fire...

title: The Anonymous Failure of the World
overview: A reflection about the conflict between dreams and reality. The director makes a visit to the island of Paquetá, where he has memories of childhood, friendship and love.

title: Purple Roots
overview: An unnamed man descends from his garden into a series of strange and increasingly disturbing spaces, where a pale figure known as the Beak appears without warning. As reality begins to unravel, he encounters creatures of evil, a motionless woman, something concealed within a sealed black box, and a disturbing presence beneath the surface.

title: Pieces (Nov. 15, 1975)
overview: Part of "The Process Tapes"

title: Covers
overview: A lonely drunk grows a desire to help another after discovering a seemingly confused naked man in his home.

title: Pioneers
overview: Pioneers, Written and Directed by Cooper Shelton, follows four young boys who venture down into ancient underground city, with one goal. Find an ancient giant that supposedly terrorized the civilization that dominated the depths a millennium ago.

title: Newcomer
overview: A 19th century séance opens a door to something far worse than the dead.

title: Waiting For The Savior
overview: The early 2020s were among the hardest years in the history of independent Armenia. In 2022, businessman Gagik Tsarukyan announced the construction of the world’s tallest statue of Christ, calling it a symbol of national revival. Armenians from every corner of the country take part in the project. The people wait… They wait for the Savior.

title: Captured
overview: A teen discovers a vintage camera filled with photos of her own escalating, deadly fate. She must find a way to fight the curse before time runs out.

title: Where Time Lingers
overview: A woman's daily routine is upended when she finds a reminder of times she'd repressed.

title: Procrastinator!!!
overview: A light-hearted, comedic story about a college student scrambling to finish an essay at the absolute last minute.

title: Split
overview: An intimate documentary exploring self-love, self-created erotica, and the fluidity of masculinity and femininity. Centering one individual’s relationship to their own body and desire, the film blurs the boundaries between artist, performer, and subject, framing erotic self-expression as an act of autonomy, reflection, and self-intimacy.

title: Nail Polish
overview: A young woman, confined by the claustrophobic walls of her room, forms an intrusive thought and quickly spirals into a frenzy of overindulgence and self-destruction.

title: Ten to Twenty Spoil Heaps
overview: The land is gone, but the slag heaps remain. A re ective exploration of soil and resources, labour and destruction, home and loss in an East German mining landscape.

title: Amoris
overview: Amarus is a travelling salesman of sorts in a world where some choose to carry the whispers of their souls in handcrafted wooden boxes. Loosely inspired by Plato's 3 phases of love (Scala Amoris), we follow Amarus through various flashes of romance, in a metaphorical tale about vulnerability, closure, and self-revelation. Blurring the lines of music video and cinema, AMORIS spotlights the core of what's most important to both...storytelling.

title: Awaken, My Children
overview: From through the thick smoke, the creation monster speaks to us, more animal than god. It regrets its biggest mistake of all: creating civilisation. Just what have we done?

title: Slumber Seas
overview: A stop motion animation to support an original song about sleeping and dreaming.

title: Baaldo, una emergencia pop
overview: Baaldo is an emerging artist who is in the process of creating what will be the second album of his career. However, everything becomes complicated along the way when a health issue arises that may leave him unable to sing again.

title: 61 days of bracelet
overview: A story he never planned to tell. A coincidence he couldn’t explain. And something that refused to stay lost.

title: Dug. Or, The Moral Of The Story Is
overview: Mikey got drunk. But it’s no aw bad, know wit ah mean? A film about getting lost up a back alley in a British town with too many cul-de-sacs. Proof that the Scottish gift isn’t bagpipes – but rather the ability to spin any old nonsense into an epic.

title: The Life Cycle of a Grey Ant
overview: Blending fiction and dance, THE LIFE CYCLE OF A GREY ANT is a retro-futuristic ballet that flips a middle finger to modernity.

title: Seeing Thru Imperfect Glass
overview: Broken glass, plastic prisms and warped reflections are accented by a guitar and banjo soundtrack in Seeing Thru Imperfect Glass. The rigid control of cinematic sight is released with this in-camera edited double exposed film.

title: Falling out of Love
overview: A short experimental animation depicting the continuous deformation and sequential metamorphosis of mechanical, industrial, and biological forms within a monochromatic space.

title: analog sentimentalism
overview: When Vienna goes missing and the world stops caring, best friends Daya and Brianne never give up hope on their search, unknowing that Vienna remains beside them through everything. Things fall apart, and friendship is tested while Vienna doesn't mind disappearing completely.

title: Buffalo Corridors: Jefferson Avenue
overview: Residents of the East Side venture on a walking tour through their neighborhood. As they head down Jefferson Avenue, they grapple with their history and future — particularly in relation to the Kensington Expressway.

title: Garden Sanctuary
overview: My Walk on the 2nd of October.

title: The Audition
overview: An aspiring actor goes to an audition where his true talents will be put to the test.

title: Lulan
overview: A TNVS driver receives an unusual pickup order which later reveals secrets from the past.

title: The Church
overview: The rework for The Church

title: Accounts of a Killing
overview: The film is a collection of testimonies about how people remember the death of a young man in the town of Khuldabad in the Deccan. Through these memories of a death, each different from the other, the film attempts to sketch a portrait of the town, its people and the contested times we live in.

title: Heralds of the Monsoon
overview: Who has the elephant on their conscience? A Matti tree and a butterfly conduct an investigation together.

title: Renderfamily
overview: Returning to his “taxidermy museum” childhood home, Tyler sorts through his grandmother’s belongings as memories of her dementia resurface.

title: Look, We're in Europe
overview: Building houses far from home: through their own mobile phone images, Bangladeshi construction workers in Kosovo offer a raw glimpse of life between precarious work and dreams of a bett er future.

title: last night job
overview: a janitor has a unfortunate encounter that leads to his demise.

title: Wet Whales
overview: Bodies drift at the water's edge, colliding with one another and surrendering to the rhythm of the waves. A harmonious interplay of sun, water, touch, and the simple joy of losing oneself together.

title: Should I worry about a dream ?
overview: A sequence of incoherent and poetic images that appear in the mind during sleep

title: The Executioner
overview: In this ode to classic slapstick comedy made entirely in Blender, watch this ghoul's multiple execution attempts on a rat living in his home.

title: The Incoming Tide
overview: Thirty villages, each with a different landscape of life, and one sea that embraces them all. This documentary records the scenery, the people and the traces of life layered there over a long time. Like the incoming tide, time keeps flowing into the villages and out again. Some leave; others return. The villages change little by little. Yet the sea is still there, and so are the people's memories and lives. The film slowly observes the memories of home and the time of life held by those who have lived alongside the sea.

title: Null Adjustments
overview: Null Adjustments follows the repair of the Buchla 100 at the Library of Congress, an early modular synthesizer built by Don Buchla for composer Morton Subotnick, who used it to create Silver Apples of the Moon. Shot on 16mm film and employing optical printing techniques, the film pays homage to the instrument’s emergence in the 1960s and showcases its continued playability today.

title: Immigrant
overview: An animation about a woman who is forced to be an immigrant due to her love for her country and family.

title: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism)
overview: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism) lingers between a guided meditation, a (dream*)time travel and the prothesis of the self in the digital sphere. It questions self care procedures in western societies and how these are affected and emptied due to the ruling capitalist system. The body floats in the digital space, slowly degrading as well as the imagined (and real) woods.

title: Traicionera
overview: Short film shot in Casares over 48 hours—between September 25 and 27, 2026—for the "Cortos Exprés" competition at the 13th New Andalusian Cinema Festival.

title: The Descendant
overview: Something is living in my house.

title: Megh |06|
overview: If thoughts opened up onto dreams, one would look up and see in a cloud resting on the hill crest, an elephant poised to butt a riverbank. Handmade crystals of argentum painted on old acetate in the dark. Hopes of seeing the light. Falls back apart on itself. An utterance of royal poet: for fame home left bids cloud voyage journey sail sky far away. Emulsion cracks, base cracks, held by tape on both sides. Palm leaves crumble and 4K scans are pointless, dust gets in anyway. When it rains snakes crawl up into the spines of trees and look closely when the lightning strikes you can see their scales shine in the moonlight.

title: A Guy from Kleinmachnow
overview: A queer auto-narrative between desire, ecstasy and regret. In the club, by the lake or going home at night – one's own judgement is often faster than the question of how one really feels.

title: Lima
overview: Lima, the mischievous one; Lima, the untamed one.  Lima, shrouded in fog; Lima, the restrained one.  Lima, the wounded one; Lima, the beloved one.

title: Waking
overview: As a famous actress slips into a waking nightmare, reality begins to unravel around her. Haunted by strange visions and cryptic clues, she is forced to confront a secret buried deep within her past.

title: Ghost on the Lake
overview: The story of a couple who move to a new area and discover their good fortune in having a lake only a short distance away. They go exploring, only to find it abandoned by all its residents except one, and they are wary of her. After hearing claims of a ghost in the area, they decide to investigate. They are shocked and amazed by the events they witness on this quiet little lake.

title: Alwest
overview: The land of Omeray, caught up in political conflicts, is gradually being invaded by a powerful army. Grégeois, a high-ranking official, is one of the last lines of defense against this threat. When he is attacked, he manages to send one final magical message to Hélèse, the leader of the village where his children live, to warn them of the approaching danger.

title: THE BOWL
overview: Investigating a staged suicide at a grim apartment, a detective finds a diary naming the real killer. As he records his findings and describes the suspect, he is ambushed from behind and shot in the back.

title: Farligt
overview: “FARLIGT” | 2026 | A film by Joachim “Jokke” Larsen | Packed with skateboarding, action, and wild street moments. Straight out of Aarhus. Expect full skate parts from Jokke Larsen, Simon Kammer, Herman Hvam, Skateducate, Frederik Norup, and Morten Wohlert. Huge Homiez sections and gnarly interludes.

title: Three Little Pigs
overview: Two teenagers' darkly comic mission to steal a pig's head sends them on a nocturnal journey through the heart of Hong Kong, culminating in a poignant act of resistance to honor an absent friend.

title: Where did our river flow to?
overview: When does a river start dying? Who will remember the river once it disappears? Blending observation, oral histories, and personal narration, the film moves between memory and the present, revealing how ecological change quietly alters landscapes, livelihoods, and cultural traditions as the community learns to live with its absence.

title: Cá e Lá - 40 Years on the Stage
overview: A forty-year theatrical journey led by two women, where migration becomes living memory on stage. Cá e Lá is a bilingual story of resistance, remembrance, and creation.

title: Journey to Agartha
overview: After a sudden wave of disappearances, Mammoth Cave National Park closes to the public.  In an effort to make a name for himself, Investigative Journalist Collin Briscoe attempts to uncover the truth by interviewing the family and friends of the first victim, MacKenzie Hunt.

title: SISTERS
overview: Cristina blames herself for her sister's death. A year later, she appears in the dark hallway of her house.

title: Ghost Hunters
overview: Three friends go into an abandoned building to look for ghosts. After many unsuccessful efforts, one of them lashes out and accidentally angers the ghost

title: Son of The Dragon
overview: Corrupted by an online community, a deeply troubled young man sets out on a journey to transform himself into something beyond human.

title: Beyond The Threshold
overview: A novice filmmaker delves into an unresolved case from the past, unwittingly awakening ancestral forces that begin to transform her and those around her in dark ways

title: Mission Lavia : le mystère des chauves-souris d'Afrique
Alone
overview: A lonely young man is spending a night by himself in his apartment and begins to suspect he might not actually be alone.

title: El extraño
overview: A drunkard is visited by death incarnate, warning he's on a doomed path. The man decides to cheat death in a desperate attempt to survive.

title: A Trout and the Last Waltz
overview: Born in rivers, yamame trout journey to the sea and return as cherry salmon, connecting forests, rivers, and coastal communities. This documentary explores how dams, abandoned forests, and renewable energy development have disrupted these natural cycles, examining what economic progress has cost the environment and the cultures shaped by it.

title: From: Saul
overview: Saul confronts his own guilt and fear through dreamlike visions of his grandmother’s house. In his dreams, a mysterious female oracle suggests that the only way to free himself from his sin is by eliminating the “sinner.”

title: Listen To The Force
overview: Ting and Yun are a young couple living together in their urban apartment. Through a series of everyday moments: preparing juice, cleaning dishes, sharing silence, their story gradually unfolds with the “Push Hands”-practice, where each gesture becomes loaded with meaning.

title: Retruco
overview: In a seedy bar, a game of truco pits Vittorio against Amaro, a violent and domineering player. As the stakes and threats escalate, Vittorio activates a hidden recorder. The police burst in, revealing a trap set to capture Amaro.

title: 5x4
overview: Sky and 1/4 sky.

title: The Night Shift
overview: An employee explores his workspace during the night shift.

title: Do Not Be Afraid
overview: A transgender woman miraculously becomes pregnant with the second coming of Christ.

title: The Morale
overview: After the deaths of David Nightingale’s wife and daughter, he arranges a meeting with the CEO who indirectly killed them.

title: Yuen Long Knight
overview: The story explores Yuen Long's drug problem and its resulting generational trauma from a unique perspective— a “superhero" is someone who’s willing to shoulder greater responsibility than others.  The story is told from the perspective of an older sister who returns to her old home years later for her graduation thesis, getting to know her younger brother after their parents' divorce -old memories resurface at the place she once lived. Meanwhile, the younger brother is about to risk everything to save his friend who is trapped in a drug network. Can old wounds be healed and relationships reconciled?

title: c.s: A Melbourne Experience
overview: Vast landscapes of a suburb in Melbourne, Australia

title: What I Want
overview: Struggling to find her footing in her first year of college, Chloe attempts to join the school’s dance company. Unbeknownst to her, the company holds many dark secrets. In this story of love, Chloe faces a challenge— follow her true passions or fall into the pressures of conformity.

title: Clocks
overview: A mistake made at dinner with his girlfriend, Arlo, opens some deep wounds for Marcus that may lead to the collapse of their relationship.

title: La priora
overview: In Cazalla de la Sierra, Carmen Ladrón de Guevara rescued an old Carthusian monastery in 1980 and transformed it into a unique cultural center and a meeting point for artists from across Europe. Decades later, after years of conflict, she no longer controls the Charterhouse she helped bring back to life. Today, she lives opposite it, gazing at it daily from her patio—caught between the memory of that dream and the traces that still remain.

title: Sweet Dreams
overview: Twenty-five-year-old influencer Elena wakes up in her room, her world blurred by the side effects of medication and fragmented memories. Confined within this enclosed space, audiences embody Elena, piece together clues step by step, and unearth a heartbreaking, cruel truth. As traumatic memories come rushing back like a tidal wave, Elena must confront her past. This time, the audience will make the choice for her: to succumb to an endless cycle of agony, or to bravely step into an unknown future.

title: FULL MAJOR PSYCHOSIS
overview: A young man wishes to finish writing his script, but his father has grown tired of him wasting his time and takes matters into his own hands.

title: And I See
overview: The world, unfixed. When mortality shakes me, the search for joy means making the familiar new. Here’s to starting a new life where sight is an affirmation of life. Will you look with me?

title: Weaving Our Wisdom
overview: Indigenous men go in the bush to discuss the problems facing the people in this day and age.

title: This Is Not About Breasts
