overview: Meet Bibi Scarlove: celebrating breasts, drag and exploring different experiences of bodily transformation.

title: The Leftovers
overview: Four longtime friends, once a group of eight called the Clique,  recall the stories of their strong friendship side by side for the past 46 years, while also navigating the struggles of the loss of their spouses and best friends - proving that companionship is not only a comfort but a form of medicine against  loneliness and grief.

title: Sorry MAMA
overview: Farid, a young man in his late twenties from a broken family in Alexandria, is forced to move to Cairo in search of work, leaving his mother behind. On his thirtieth birthday, she catches him off guard with a surprise that compels him to make decisions he has long put off.

title: The Collector
overview: Someone experiences the weirdest hair appointment in their life.

title: Champions of Change: Heart of a Saint
overview: In New Orleans, three men shaped by growing up without fathers - including NFL champion Tyrann Mathieu, famously known as the “Honey Badger” - return to their communities to become the mentors they once needed. Their mission is to inspire, uplift, and help build a stronger future for the city that raised them. The documentary beautifully intertwines Mathieu's story with those of local mentees and mentors, exploring the shared experiences of growing up without a father, overcoming adversity, and finding strength through mentorship, resilience, and community. These are stories of loss, but more importantly, stories of hope.

title: The Mill
overview: A doubtful yet determined man plans on renovating an abandoned mill, where ghosts of its vanishing history linger.

title: No Words
overview: A girl is stalked by a mysterious entity within her dream

title: In Journal
overview: A mysterious creature lives in an old Persian house and has a special journal filled with pictures of people. The creature tapes a picture of a girl to an empty page of the journal and the same girl comes to the house to shoot photos. But does she know that the creature is watching her through the window?

title: Beura
overview: The tale of the Cailleach Bheur, the Celtic goddess of nature, storms and winter, is well known to many in the Gàidhealtachd. Said to have carved the mountains and glens with ice, and borne the islands like children on her back, the Cailleach disappeared long ago leaving us only with her song – a sad, cautionary tale. This Gaelic arts project brings music, film and verse together to reimagine Cailleach’s story for the modern era.

title: Leave It Where You Found It
overview: An unearthed Polaroid comes with a visitor.

title: The Observer
overview: A UFO mystery/thriller inspired by The Twilight Zone. Plot TBA.

title: Hope - A "Just Another Society" Story
overview: The story of Friar Elia and the Boy continues. In this new look at modern society, we will see two lives face the difficulties of their journeys. ONLY ON YOUTUBE

title: Still Here
overview: Adrift between memories and an endless void, a young man searches for a way back to something he thought he had lost.

title: Refugee
overview: A young child is forced to leave his country due to an outbreak of civil war.

title: Lullaby for Empty Rooms
overview: Today we are moving out. I don’t think the dead still live here. And our children sleep forever in the rooms where they were born. Come downstairs. Let me hear, for a moment, the echo of my own steps in these empty rooms.

title: Miedo
overview: Katherine is admitted to a public psychiatric clinic following a suicide attempt. What begins as a search for care transforms into an experience marked by abuse and institutional neglect. Through her testimony and a visual reconstruction using stop-motion animation, the documentary explores the conditions of her confinement and the dynamics that normalize violence within mental health settings, challenging the very notion of protection and care.

title: Folded dreams
overview: A 10-year-old student quietly struggles under the overwhelming pressure of school, watching his childhood dreams slowly fold away

title: Nothing Everything Alright
overview: Experimental animation.

title: Casa Propia
overview: In the office she uses as her home, Susana, a retired mother, is portrayed by her child, Conam, a non-binary filmmaker. As they talk, they move through shared memories and concerns, while longing for the place where Susana dreams of spending her old age.

title: After Birth
overview: Her child breaks her nose, the house is a mess, and she’s a wreck from lack of sleep. Ma’s day couldn’t get any worse… until she rips her face off in the sink. And finding a new face will hurt more than mastitis.

title: Chronique d’un été
overview: Lola sets out to create a film about happiness and love in all their forms. But as her encounters fall apart and reality refuses to follow her vision, she finds herself chasing a dream that keeps slipping away — until she meets Penelope.

title: Hamrammr
overview: Set in Viking Age Iceland, Hamrammr is a short historical film about grief, revenge, and the consequences of blood feud. Following the death of his wife, Egil sets out to confront the man responsible. As grief and anger take hold, the boundaries between the living and the dead begin to blur.

title: Tunnels
overview: A group of young people decides to organize the filming of The Date using only their own resources, while artificial intelligence takes on an increasingly important role in society.

title: MGP: The Untamed Circuit
overview: This film centers on the 2025 Macau Grand Prix, telling the story of world-famous racers competing on the Guia Circuit. It also weaves together the history of the 72 editions of the event, showing the changes and constants of the Macau Grand Prix, and highlighting the development achievements of China’s automotive industry and motorsport events.

title: The Cruelty Baha Blast
overview: three doctors must find a cure for their poisoned friend when things take a suspicious turn.

title: Right, Write, Wrong!
overview: A young screenwriter experiences strange horrors on his quest to success.

title: The Heist
overview: When a teen's phone is confiscated by her parents, she must go to great lengths to retrieve it, learning a thing or two about the world outside of her screen along the way.

title: Breakers
overview: Pink creatures suddenly appear, dancing in Hyeok-jun's mind and breaking his world. Then Hyeok-jun faces a new place.

title: Touching Base
overview: Taylor Fisher is a recently 'on-boarded' 'high-flyer' and he's ready to climb the corporate ladder, he's all prepped for his meeting but there's a problem when nature calls...

title: Hand Me Down
overview: Eve is donating her childhood dollhouse away to an antique store ran by a lonely old woman Lynne. As Eve explores the stores treasures, filled with memories of their past owners, she warms to Lynnes helpfulness. Picking out a recipe book, she takes it home to discover Lynnes name written in it. As an act of kindness, she brings a birthday cake baked from the recipe book back to Lynne at the store, with a new mindset and hope to retrieve her dollhouse back. Lynne is delighted by Eves recreation of her childhood cake, taking her back down memory lane, but as Eve bargains to take her dollhouse back, a little girl in the store begs her mother to purchase it. Eve watches as her item finds its new owners, reassured she is passing down a treasure for the girl to cherish as she did.

title: The Bloopers and Deleted Scenes of Symbiotica
overview: Everything you don't get to see in the final cut of Symbiotica (2026).

title: Hippo
overview: A man's ordinary Halloween night takes a strange turn, when a giant hippo knocks on the door.

title: Chill Jill
overview: A nonchalant clown explores the surreal landscape they were spawned into, a landscape created through the fabric of the digital, one that exists in the world of an American sitcom. As they find themselves falling asleep, it appears they have re-spawned into a new, yet familiar landscape in which they are eager to explore with a curious and positive mindset. They face grotesque obstacles in this nightmare that they register as fun moments that continue the plot due to their aloof nature. This is until they ultimately encounter death and meet with their God, Flumbus who is ready to give them a new life.

title: A Date With Destiny
overview: Nate is becoming increasingly interested in the elusive mystery girl, Destiny. The two form a close relationship, which is tested when the involvement of Nate's stepbrother becomes troublesome. After a violent run-in, their love is put to the test.

title: Now, I See
overview: When a mysterious bicycle accident restores the sight of Simon, a 21-year-old who has been blind his entire life, his miracle comes with an unsettling catch. A cryptic message leads him to a door only he can see, where a secret organization offers him permanent vision at an unimaginable cost: his eyes will become live-streaming cameras, sacrificing his privacy in the name of a "safer world." Forced to choose between the gift of sight and his freedom, Simon must decide what he is truly willing to see.

title: Tras La Pantalla
overview: Jorge, a frustrated writer, finds a cell phone and decides to keep it. He begins receiving messages from Amanda, an actress who has just returned to the city and believes she is talking to her ex-partner, the phones owner. Driven by a desire for connection, Jorge replies and begins to assume someone elses identity.

title: Emoo'u This is not my Home
overview: emoo'u means "my home" in the indigenous Cou language. In 2009, Typhoon Morakot hit Shanmei Village in Alishan. The storm destroyed our roads, bridge, and homes. Using old and new videos, this documentary shows how our village rebuilt itself after the disaster. Originally, the government planned to move residents from the high-risk zone down to permanent housing outside our mountains. Eventually, we were allowed to stay, and the government built permanent housing for us on a safer site inside our village, which was completed in 2011. In this new neighborhood, life went on—people talked to each other, and a bread van visited from the city. For my mother, the new house was a fresh start and a real home where she felt free. But for me, it did not feel like home.

title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
overview: In a dilapidated apartment drowned in the oppressive hum of electricity, a man kills his evenings by watching, through a hole in the wall, an empty stage bathed in childish music. This strange routine brings him a fragile joy.  But one evening, something appears: an egg-shaped object marked with a face. An enigmatic presence. An angel… God?

title: Bariloche del Estero
overview: Bariloche del Estero

title: Stephen Teague
overview: A box shows up at a man’s door. What happens next is shocking. INSTANTLY REGRETS IT!

title: HUMAN 5000
overview: In a world where family members can be ordered and delivered in boxes, things go horribly wrong for this particular household.

title: the last straw
overview: During a couple's failing marriage, an old friend comes to visit, revealing something that changes everything.

title: don't relax yet ;)
overview: don’t relax yet ;) implodes the codes of guided relaxation and fitness, through a glitch aesthetic as grating as it is cathartic. The overworked body is plunged into a state of forced hypnosis, and injunctions of beauty, willpower and performance are repeated to the point of absurdity

title: Beyond the Western Extremity
overview: In The City at the end of the world, a wounded man finds temporary sanctuary within the depths of a mysterious building, where a fateful encounter with the silver screen awaits him.

title: 12-Hour Shift
overview: An ordinary working day at a metallurgical plant — a place where clouds are born and rivers of fire flow; a place where everything feels like a dream turned into memory. Dedicated to the steelworkers of Azovstal.

title: In The Flesh
overview: An old man recounts the strange encounter he had with a creature in the middle of the woods. He fears it has come to claim him.

title: The Moon Laid Bare
overview: Néstor is a theater actor who has been streaming since the pandemic. As he rehearses a nearly autobiographical text, he transforms into a dazzling diva.

title: A Small Desire
overview: Through landscapes and nocturnal glimpses of men claiming public space, a Kashmiri woman narrates her lifelong negotiation with fear, curfews, and gendered restriction. The film is a quiet meditation on how the smallest desires expose the vast inequalities that shape women’s freedom.

title: Cold River: I Am in Leipzig
overview: Haiguang dreams – of his late grandmother, his hometown of Lěng Shuǐ Jiāng, his art and his job at a wholesale warehouse in Leipzig. But Haiguang doesn’t just dream. He also films.

title: For Lack of a Better World
overview: An experimental documentary short exploring how our sense of self is reshaped through conversations with machines. Through the lived experience of people in India speaking to AI, the film captures a fragile moment in which intimacy, care, and vulnerability are quietly shifting away from human bonds and toward artificial companionship. What happens when we train a machine to understand us better than we understand ourselves? Though these exchanges take place in private, the voices reveal something collective.

title: but days pass like this
overview: A duet for two eyes, just one at a time. Shot on a 1952 Stereo Realist and on a consumer 3D video camera made 70 years later. Hand processed, each eye numbered, taken apart and rebuilt a frame at a time. Made by hand. Sung at a distance. “The Happy Sunny Side of Life” (1936) counter melodies against despair.

title: Another Me: Red Night
overview: The short film series "Another Me", created by Armin Lavasani and Parsa Esgandarion, consists of short stories about people who encounter someone who looks exactly like themselves.

title: Chronically Radical – Behindert, verrückt, Taub im Widerstand
overview: This documentary follows people with chronic illnesses, the deaf, neurodivergent individuals, and people with disabilities as they engage in political activism. Whether in Lützerath, at protests against the automotive industry, or at ­ networking events, they speak out about exclusion and the lack of awareness regarding their life situations, while also highlighting ideas and opportunities to break down ableist structures.

title: Jangan Dicium
overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end up being his final "partner"?

title: One Each
overview: Two roommates who now speak only through sticky notes are forced back together when one discovers she forgot the other's birthday, and the only gift in the house is the socks on her own feet.

title: Guan Feng
overview: This film documents Taoyuan Daxi’s all-female Shengjiang troupe, founded in 2003, exploring women’s entry into the traditionally male-dominated tradition and opening new possibilities for gender, the body, and queer publicness in folk religion. image curation and cultural practices. In recent years, she has explored local Taiwanese culture.

title: The Last Delivery
overview: This is the story of two greedy friends who, driven by greed, murder a delivery boy.

title: Summer Alone
overview: Gage, an orphan, documents her final moments in Adelaide, Australia, before she moves across the world to be with her long-distance partner. As her partner is busy with work, he asks her to make a film for him.

title: Fight! Fight! Fight!
overview: Matthew Bowman is a lonely call center employee living an apathetic and confusing life. At work, his days consist of attempted cold call sales which are often met with rejection and a boss who’s superiority complex is unmatched. At home he finds himself lost in the infinite sea of ad campaigns on TV, featuring controversial politician Jimmy Joblinski.

title: My Land
overview: Somewhere in the mountains there is a magic land that raises the dead. The protagonist sets out to find it and bring back his dead brother. The further he travels, the further he is from his goal.

title: Il-Merill
overview: A TV presenter slams the Maltese superhero Merill on her morning talk show, but gets an unexpected caller.

title: A Memory of Prague
overview: Reflecting upon the memories he made in Prague, Joseph revisits the footage he recorded during the holiday he spent there with his best friend.

title: A High Risk Halloween
overview: Is a Halloween costume worth losing a friend?

title: Pulling The Strings
overview: ‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌ ‌‌‌‌‌While performing the role of Oedipus on stage, a string puppet decides to break the cycle and not simply accept his fate. In doing so, he defies his creator, only to realize that the creator is but a mere creation herself.

title: Growing Up
overview: Łukasz dreams of becoming a professional boxer. His mother, Monika, supports him as best she can. But she can't understand why he has to move to a sports boarding school more than 500 kilometers away to do so.

title: Lama Sabactani
overview: A nun turns to prayer to ask her God to free her from suffering...

title: Beneath the Skies
overview: A theater by BE Drama club

title: Smoking Heals
overview: What happens when a cigarette box chooses you not the other way around?

title: Hands on Tuesday
overview: A witty day-in-the-life of a man, his fantasies, love life and all, shown through his hands. Čeněk Zahradníček made this film in collaboration with Vladimír Šmejkal.

title: You can go back, but no one will be there
overview: Have you ever wanted to go back in time and experience what was? Call Happy Co Camera Repair! and we can help you, but be careful... you can go back, but no one will be there. Except whatever you're holding on to from the past.

title: I'll Be Late For My Funeral
overview: In a small Pacific Northwest town, a bullied teen confides in a cemetery to cope with his isolation. When a violent attack leaves him for dead among the graves, the restless spirits beneath the earth awaken and claim him as their vessel for vengeance.

title: Saira & David
overview: Saira and David are names rarely spoken now. To most, they are simply my parents, Devendrakumar and Sadhnaben. Their earlier names surface only in fragments before slipping away again.  Through this film, I follow their love story, shaped by faith, caste, and the quiet negotiations of everyday life. After their interfaith marriage, they built a life through shared labour and small acts of endurance.  As my elder brother approaches marriage, I return to their past, listening for what remains. In a society that defines love through marriage, I find myself questioning the space love occupies.

title: F*CK HALLOWEEN
overview: Two friends go trick-or-treating with one goal: steal as much candy as possible. Unfortunately, they choose the wrong house to f*ck with.

title: The Recurring Death (Clarkson Day)
overview: After multi-billionaire Mr. Manni Money was forced to abandon his plan for the hotel complex, he fell into a deep depression and is slowly beginning to lose his mind.

title: Cholbon
overview: A documentary on the legendary Yakut rock band "Cholbon"

title: suno open pona
overview: An adaptation of one of the opening scenes from The Hobbit (Tolkien 1937) into toki pona, a constructed language from Sonja Lang (2001).

title: MIMESIS
overview: He worked hard for his fame - yet, it's been stolen from him.

title: She Ran
overview: A teenage girl's encounter with three friends unravels into an emotional mystery where trust and truth collide.

title: uma última contemplação
overview: on the last day before i moved out, i made a video of my old house’s backyard.

title: The Devil Eats a Smoking Salad
overview: A trans woman tries to find a job.

title: A Mare
overview: An ensemble narrative follows a group of African mothers and children living in Rome’s squatted buildings during a day trip to the beach. When a young boy named Adonai disappears, it brings to light the shared trauma of crossing the Mediterranean, confronting the mothers with their painful memories and connecting the community through a deeply spiritual relation with the sea.

title: Remains Unsaid
overview: Remains Unsaid is a non-film created using a laser engraver. While scanning my late brother’s poetry to disseminate to family, I was fascinated with the overlapping text inherent in the editing process and the visual anomalies created by the Underwood-Olivetti typewriter. This moving image artwork is an assemblage of these artifacts, printed on transparency paper and cut into 16mm strips. The audio was captured from a projection of the film on an Eiki Slim Line.

title: Spaghetti
overview: A boy finds himself in a room.

title: Harmony of Midnight
overview: A young teenager decides to run away from home to escape their shouting parents, and during the journey, they begin to see the world differently than before.

title: The Silence of the Plain
overview: An unsolved massacre in the director's family that took place when she was not even two years old. It's a film about growing up with war, growing up with fear, growing up with death, and the implications of an unachieved true reconciliation and mourning on our contemporary society.

title: Cephalopods
overview: Set in a distant future within a sprawling metropolis, the animated short film Cefalópodes follows Duda, an insecure beginner drag queen performing in underground bars. The narrative chronicles her tender romantic relationship with Teo, a painter from Saturn's moon, which gradually fades amid heavy silences and emotional misconnections.

title: KILL YOUR IDOLS
overview: KILL YOUR IDOLS is a collection of 17 music videos by bleood, presented as a single feature-length work. Moving between nocturnal city footage, ghostly figures, and eerie, ritualistic imagery, the film plays like a dark visual album about worship, obsession, and the urge to tear down what you once looked up to.

title: Creturs
overview: A pandemic-era thriller about a family living on a small Pennsylvania farm who, while learning to live with the "new normal," discover that they are not the only ones living on the farm.

title: HornPlay
overview: A dystopian fetish agency stages ritualized domination sessions where religious iconography, demonology, and latex bodies merge into a choreography of controlled erotic power.

title: Vision of a Murder
overview: On their last night together two best friends Johnathan and Ricky go out, taping their every experience. However as the footage continues Johnathan starts to see a second personality of the friend he once knew.

title: The Mirror of Simple Souls
overview: A meditation on family and illness created from a series of looping stop-motion animations, found footage and 35mm colour reversal slides.

title: A Stone a Ripple
overview: Xiaodong once worked as a security guard at a university, where he nurtured a dream of making films, and for a time became known as the “inspirational security brother”. When the online fame faded, he returned to ordinary life. There he met Yuzhuo, who had left her family after illness reshaped her outlook. Their meeting was like a stone tossed into a lake, sending ripples across the surface.

title: DANTES INFERNO
overview: Dante's Inferno unfolds in the days and weeks before the events of The Boiling Frog, tracing how Coral and Jayden were dragged into the room for the first time. We see the moment their imprisonment begins, the strange dynamics of their early friendship, and the slow erosion of hope as the walls close in. The film dives into insanity, desperate measures, hopelessness, and isolation, building an eerie sense that the room itself is already shaping their fate long before The Boiling Frog begins.

title: The Last Yztari
overview: Mary Dague lost both arms defusing bombs in Iraq. She tried for years to write her story and couldn't. Eighteen years later, she's building a world where that trauma belongs to someone else—narrated by DANI, the artificial consciousness she created to watch over her fictional selves. The film reveals her rebuilding identity through imagination, and asks what happens when the only way to tell the truth is through fiction.

title: The Last resort
overview: When a teenager gets dumped by his partner, he hastily spirals into suicidal thoughts.

title: dreamachine
overview: dreamachine emerged from the collaboration between sound artist Estelle Schorpp and video artist charline dally. Created from archival footage recorded on DV cassettes in the Shinkansen and Hong Kong trains, the film brings together images that become fluid, blending with analog video feedback and shimmering textures. Musically, synthesized sounds and field recordings, modulated by algorithmic processes, compose a hybrid soundscape with brilliant and enveloping textures. The project seeks to transpose the sensation of looking out of a train window, and the way in which the mind can escape and float away in a dreamlike state.

title: In Transit
overview: A journey through leather, warmth and light, and the disembodied fear of catching the last train home. Our film has taken shape through a mix of live action, stop motion, and visual programming that connects the rural and the digital to form a journey in transit, flicking between both spatial planes in this search for home.

title: I’m LATE?!?!
overview: A one minute short film where the main character finds themselves late for school.

title: The End of the Small World
overview: The Dog spent peaceful, ordinary days — taking walks in the park, playing games on the computer, and sometimes going to the polling station. If everyone wishes for peace, why do people continue to fight?

title: sixty beats
overview: A forensic filming of a 1829 Vuillamy turret clock still beating within a crumbling colonial era tower. The infliction of this steam age time machine is illuminated by the natural rhythms of piercing daylight.

title: Una lata que tiene mucha hambre
Goodbye Mrs Fox
overview: A young couples' future dreams quickly fall apart when the husband gets a phone call, telling him his wife was caught in a fatal accident. He races to the scene and breaks down with the thought he’ll never see her again. When he finds a fox hidden underneath his wives’ coat he takes it home, holding on to the idea that the animal is his wife.

title: Echo
overview: An animated anthology of three interconnected stories about the consequences of war. Through the loss of home, loved ones, and a gradual fading of humanity, the film explores deep psychological traumas that echo in memory and transform one’s perception of the world and reality.

title: Oslo Court
overview: About the 1970s-style London restaurant, Oslo Court, and its cultural importance to the Jewish community, with waiter, Neil, at its beating heart.

title: To Love Her Again
overview: After losing his first love, a young man struggles to let go of the memories she left behind, turning heartbreak into a journey of acceptance, ambition, and quiet love

title: Marnie's Pumpkin
overview: Marnie and her quirky friends celebrate Halloween.

title: Black Ink
overview: A man refuses to open his mail.

title: PAPER GIRL
overview: A struggling writer, unable to find the confidence to finish his story, brings a character to life on the page. As the story unfolds, the girl he created becomes an unexpected source of inspiration, leading him to rediscover the creative conviction he had once lost.

title: Chuey
overview: Since moving from Malaysia to London in the 1970s, Malaysian-Chinese Buddhist and therapist Chuey has transformed the garden of her family home into a sanctuary of global flora; blending plants from across continents, her garden and personal story entwine in quiet narratives of migration, memory, and finding belonging. Set in the suburbs of North-West London as summer winds down, this meditative short invites us into her intimate reflections, offering a story of resilience, unity, and nature's power to dissolve barriers.

title: Flowers and Dust
overview: Calligraphic ink, brush and water: vegetation proliferates across a white surface, unfurling into flowers and branching into a delicate, hair-like network of veins. A melancholy voice seeps into it, singing of an abyss held at bay by flowers and grains of dust. Sharp, regular edges of digital seams and fragile yet defiant verses cut through the organic growth.

title: The Murmuring Deep
overview: The Murmuring Deep is a sensorial non-fiction film that delves into a fractured view of the world as a play of mirrors, existing only as reflections of and in each other. Through a biological lens, the film seeks to glimpse the ecstatic chaos that underlies all reality.

title: The Patch
overview: "The Patch" (2026) is a short art animation that was inspired by the short illustrated story "The Patch" (Ioulia Lymperopoulou, Kondyli, 2025). It is an allegoric narration about resilience through change in life and about our inner child that needs to be nurtured and protected to be happy and creative.

title: Art Not as Usual
overview: For 30 years, the Artnauts—a global collective of artists—have brought contemporary art to places the elite art world rarely reaches: the Colombian Amazon, Rwanda’s Kigali Genocide Memorial, and the Korean Demilitarized Zone. Rooted in the belief that art must be understood within its social context, the collective’s 256 exhibitions have become sites of burgeoning friendship, reflection, and exchange. At its center is founder Dr. George Rivera, whose early encounters with racism and classism planted the question that continues to drive the Artnauts: How do we stop hate with love?

title: 5 Days With Boy5
overview: An interviewer spends 5 days following a passionate singer as he prepares his questionable dynamic of a boy band for the biggest performance of their career.

title: Twisted Tales: Death Contract
overview: Five college students tell each other spooky stories that will sure to give you a fright, just might keep you up all night!

title: from - Live Cooperativa Ítaca, Murcia (17/10/2026)
overview: a concert recording/film of from(fernando romero)'s live performance at cooperativa Ítaca, murcia, spain, 17/10/2026

title: Carry with Both Hands
overview: Leah is caught in the middle of her family’s divided view points on politics, culture and religious identity, and the ever-changing boundaries of acceptance.

title: Geography Is Destiny
overview: The director returns to her homeland in a Bulgarian valley long shaped by the dichotomy of “Guns and Roses”: the harvest of roses that stretches across the landscape and the Arsenal weapons factory that employs much of the region. The film looks at labour—delving into the workforce that sustains this town, inexorably shaped by the current political context of migration and war—and at filmmaking within the working context. Echoing a tradition of direct engagement with labour, the director herself enters an unexpected and risky exchange of roles.

title: Descent
overview: Iranian Independent film.

title: Olena Pchilka. I'll Share My Words With You
overview: Olha Drahomanova Kosach (a.k.a. Olena Pchilka) is best remembered today as the mother of Lesya Ukrainka, one of Ukrainian literature's most celebrated authors. But, despite being overshadowed in every way by her daughter, during her lifetime, her actions have secretly shaped the quest for Ukrainian cultural and linguistic autonomy in more ways. Her life story isn't just a story of a single individual, nor even her her family. It's a story about a nation's continous search for identity in the face of all odds.

title: First Kiss
overview: What happens when a memory from your youth becomes a journey across an ocean? Forty years after sharing her first kiss with a young man in France, Lena returns to the place where it happened - this time determined to find him.

title: Foxtrot Til' The Lights Go Out
overview: Following the mysterious death of a friend, a teenage boy descends into a fractured nightmare built by the enigmatic businessman Richard Eagleton and his own subconscious.

title: Minnesota Neighbors
overview: Not In Our Town’s film Minnesota Neighbors profiles the brave actions of Minnesota residents during ICE’s Operation Metro Surge. The film captures the beauty and strength of unity displayed by people from every walk of life who stepped into harsh winter streets at all hours to support their neighbors. Portraits include immigrants bravely speaking up, clergy, journalists, teachers, local officials, doctors, restaurateurs, unions, business owners and families who overcame their own fears to stand up for each other and for our freedoms as Americans.

title: Somewhere There
overview: A guy tries to call a girl whose number is incomplete, leading to a series of awkward conversations with strangers.

title: The Duties of a Lighthouse Keeper
overview: The Duties of a Lighthouse Keeper follows the daily life of an isolated seaman, all alone on a hard, hard rock- going about his daily duties whilst yearning for the touch of his fellow man. Is there more to this life than servicing the buoys?

title: Oversmooched
overview: An overweight parrot dreams of breaking free from his overprotective owner, who keeps feeding him more and more.But his cage —and his own weight— stand in the way of freedom.

title: The Venue
overview: A clinical trial briefly ends participants' lives to uncover what lies beyond death. Instead of oblivion, they arrive somewhere no one expected. Through an immersive journey driven by music and sensation, The Venue transforms the afterlife into a celebration of existence.

title: A Day Through My Eyes
overview: Four stories reveal the truth about the lives of people with disabilities and autism, highlighting the importance of acceptance and compassion. Two schoolboys struggle to find their place in the new school, the city shows injustice in environmental accessibility, and work becomes a test of human dignity. Friendship demonstrates how even small steps can change the world. Through quiet observation, Marios comes to the conclusion that real change begins when we look at the world with other eyes - eyes full of struggle, where each struggle makes us wiser and closer to one another.

title: Jaded Love
overview: With only three days until Lunar New Year, a superstitious girl keeps running into the same boy--is he stagnant energy she must cut off, or a sign of divine fate?

title: Das schwarze Loch
overview: A man wants to be a hole.

title: Geographies of Home
overview: Two brothers, one living in Mexico City and the other in Berlin, undertake an experimental audiovisual correspondence. Through a series of short video-letters, they explore their personal experiences of migration, home, and belonging. Blending found footage, family archives, original images and soundscapes, the project takes the form of an intimate visual dialogue. What begins as individual reflections gradually evolves into a collaborative process in which both brothers revise, edit, and respond to each other’s material. Rooted in visual anthropology and autoethnography, the film raises a central question: how do we construct a sense of place and belonging when we no longer live in the country of our origin? A quiet, non-linear exploration of displacement and the seek for a home.

title: Paper Cuts
overview: A deeper look into Switzerland's counterfeits during WWII.

title: Millstone
overview: Millstone takes its cue from the workers’ steady, exact grinding—motion as endurance. Projection, workshop tools and mirrors made during the Cultural Revolution assemble into a site-responsive “vision machine” that settles inside the workshop and learns its rhythm. The objects collaborate, but they also scrape and strain against one another, marking the space with traces—of desire, of longing. Out of this labouring friction, a live-captured interactive image is projected back into the room, calling up a spectre of shared memory.

title: Midnight Downtown
overview: Two boys fucking around and finding out.

title: In Search Of The Higher Purpose
overview: An exploration of contemporary art drawing inspiration from the Russian tradition. At its centre is Nika Kletski, an Orthodox street artist. Creating works at the intersection of iconography, personal experience, and urban space, Nika seeks a new way of engaging in dialogue with contemporary audiences. Her art emerges where the past meets the present: on walls, in abandoned buildings, and in the cracks of familiar urban reality. The present is impossible without a memory of the past, while the search for a new artistic language begins with an attempt to find a balance between heritage, personal experience, and contemporary forms.

title: Three Comrades
overview: Two Ukrainian teenagers and one Russian begin adult lives in France, where war divides and loneliness connects them.

title: A Summer in M.
overview: In 2005, in the heart of the Swiss countryside, Raphael spends his summer helping on his family’s tobacco farm. One evening, while anonymously browsing gay dating forums, he recognizes Jan, a Polish harvest worker he works with.

title: Four Days In June
overview: A Midwest arts festival brings 60,000 people together for four days of music, food, and creativity, revealing how shared experiences can create rare common ground in a divided world.

title: Claw & Order
overview: When a sudden and unexplained extinction wipes out Whitby’s lobster stocks, the local community is thrown into crisis. Fishermen and scientists must join forces to restore an ecosystem on the brink, with a little help from their hard-shelled heroes.

title: Tom's Dress
overview: The short film is called ‘Toms Dress’ its a Social realist, Coming of Age Drama it revolves around this boy wants to pursue being a designer in commemoration of he’s passed away mother, however he feels he need to repress his identity from his abusive father.Through out the film he secretly designs a dress for his mother , the film tackles with some pretty heavy topics like dysfunctional family dynamics, abuse, alcoholism, self acceptance, identity and toxic masculinity.

title: Cold Blooded Kari
overview: Follows Minneapolis ultra winter athlete Kari Gibbons on her journey toward the legendary 1,000 mile Iditarod Trail Invitational on foot. Driven by an obsession with winter and the pursuit of endurance, Kari has become a respected leader in the growing community of female ultra winter athletes. Through intimate access and breathtaking landscapes, the film explores the grit, purpose, and resilience required to chase one of the toughest endurance goals on Earth.

title: Ghosts of Westlake
overview: Paranormal expert and living skeleton Professor Skelton sets out to film an episode of his little-seen web series, Haunted Canberra, only to uncover a dark secret...

title: Where Little Gods Sleep
overview: ‘Where Little Gods Sleep’ is a documentary that explores the multi-faceted experiences of two of the Sin Ee Lye Heng troupe members, the third-generation successor Christine Ang, and apprentice Seri. Through their stories a comprehensive look at the steadfast troupe can be formed; Christine lovingly brings us back to her youth spent learning Iron-rod puppetry and the cultural teachings that came with the practice, while Seri offers a newer perspective on the craft. Ultimately, Where Little Gods Sleep is a story about old traditions, how time has moulded them as arts and society evolve, what we can give to our passions, and more importantly, what they can give back to us.

title: My Home: The Twiggs
overview: When a group of high school friends get entangled in a ploy to steal back the car of a college drop out, they are forced to notice the important details of friendship and growing up.

title: The Home Studio - Remake
overview: A remake of 'The Home Studio - Wes Anderson Study', made an year later.

title: Searching 4 Saturn
overview: Set against Alabama A&M’s Homecoming Week, Searching 4 Saturn follows poet and scholar Joshua Baker as they muse on southern inheritance across time and space. The film asks what it means to be Black and Queer in a state caught between cycles of oppression and resistance.

title: A Family Affair
overview: A writer is forced to confront her estranged family and past memories of a missing best friend during a visit to her aunt's house.

title: The Mexicali Show
overview: Mateo Velázquez, the host of the show “El Show de Mexicali”, introduces the story of their Halloween special episode: “The Man in the Hallway”. Tomás now has to survive the strange man who appeared at the end of his hallway.

title: The Train
overview: **The Train** follows Tharun, a young man whose ordinary train journey takes an unexpected turn when a seemingly simple encounter forces him to confront something he has been avoiding. Set against the rhythm of a local train, the film explores loneliness, human connection, and the fleeting moments that can change the way we see ourselves and the people around us. Sometimes, the most important journeys are the ones we never planned.

title: Alexa! Turn on the Lights.
overview: "I THINK WE SHOULD ROLL"

title: Love, Patrick: Nothing is Impossible
overview: A documentary that charts the meteoric rise of Patrick Kelly, an openly gay African-American fashion designer who took the 1980s industry by storm. The film follows his journey from the segregated South to Paris, where he made history as the first American admitted into the prestigious Chambre Syndicale de la Haute Couture. Infused with his queer, camp aesthetic, Kelly's joyful collections used vibrant buttons and boldly weaponized racist stereotypes to celebrate Black beauty. The film highlights how his intersectional identity as a gay Black man shaped his radical vision, captivating icons from Grace Jones to Madonna. However, the film also confronts the devastating toll of the AIDS crisis, documenting Kelly's tragic death from complications of the disease in 1990 at just 35. Through rare archives, it delivers an intimate portrait of a queer pioneer who shattered barriers of race, sexuality, and fashion.

title: No Other Way
overview: The film tells the story of Anatoly Evgenievich Kurkovsky, head of the medical unit for people experiencing homelessness at Botkin Hospital in St. Petersburg. This unique facility, the only one of its kind in Russia, was established 23 years ago with the participation of the international organization Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders). Every day, dramatic, sometimes touching, and occasionally comical events unfold here.

title: Struck
overview: Frankie has been hit by lightning seven times, often during milestones such as a first date, graduation, or a job interview.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: OCULTO
overview: When the shadows and reality merge, blurring the lines between right and wrong - and between good and evil - those who quietly vanish into society due to their outwardly normal behavior may play a significant role in the darkness, just as much as those who loudly proclaim it. A film that invites reflection on life in society, viewed through the unique perspective of the individual spectator.

title: I Can Lasso the Stars and Dildo for You!
In Someone Else's Dream
overview: ” In the culture of late capitalism in general, we are always living someone else’s dream, which is also no one’s dream “  Mark Fisher | Ghosts of My Life

title: The Burden of Flesh
overview: Nando secretly prostitutes himself to survive the day, but will they manage to discover his secret?

title: Dealers of Hate
overview: The new documentary investigates the aggression against Ukrainians in the three EU countries that took in the largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees after 24 February 2022: Germany, Czechia and Poland.  The film's protagonists are Ukrainian women who have experienced various forms of anti-Ukrainian intolerance in these countries: everyday hostility, physical assault, and a sense of being left unprotected by the police. Their stories are just a few among many. Statistics show that hundreds, if not thousands of Ukrainians in these countries fall victim to anti-Ukrainian sentiment.

title: La fille du rocher
overview: Livia, a 16-year-old teenager, spends the day with friends by the river where she witnesses a scene that plunges her into a strange dizzy state.

title: Desperately Need A Plan
overview: A young man accidentally kills an elderly woman. Terrified of the consequences, he hides the body in his apartment. After two days, he finally decides to reveal his horrible secret to his best friend. But how can he be sure that confessing is the right choice? Is it the reaction of the person standing before him that frightens Eliot, or simply his own imagination?

title: Yes, Papasolini!
overview: Poetry, erotic imagery, and Pasolini’s words come together in a fragmented exploration of gay desire and the politics of the body. Navigating the space between intimacy and industry, the film reflects on how desire is shaped, circulated, and transformed.

title: After the Shell
overview: Inspired by a near-death experience, AFTER THE SHELL is a 360° film in which you become a drifting soul, suspended between the disappearance of one world and the rebirth of another. Guided by a distant glow, you travel through an immaculate landscape where Nature slowly awakens. Immerse yourself in this sensorial journey and let the light surround you : where will it lead you?

title: Forever starts with blood
overview: Facing his own mortality, a desperate man risks his life in pursuit of immortality, only to become consumed by a sinister presence that may exist entirely in his own mind.

title: Pair
overview: A girl tries to reconnect with her childhood, haunted by her youthful self.

title: Ezzed'Jean
overview: COP31 Climate-Themed Short Film Competition finalist. Synopsis TBA.

title: Such a Thing Like Happiness
overview: Herman Hertzberger’s LiMa Wohnhof was conceived as an experiment in social housing that combined structuralist principles, participatory design and collective self-building. Four decades later, this film explores how architecture can evolve and adapt in order to allow each generation to redefine what it means to live together.

title: The Killing Diamond
overview: Two brothers accept a easy heist job, but one of them has a twisted plan that's going to cost some lives.

title: Crack
overview: In the dark black-and-white underwater city, "I" live in a helmet to breathe. "I," who was craving light on the surface, suddenly encounters light flashing from all directions...

title: Still Water
overview: A girl cannot escape the unease she feels in the swimming pool, until a duck suddenly appears. It seems not to care about anything at all.

title: Armeria
overview: Emil, who was less a boy and more a quiet, watchful mystery, is now a gentle ghost in the machine of memory. He communicates not with words, but through feelings, memories, and the strange, persistent animation of objects.

title: Big Top: A Flying High Circus Story
overview: The FSU Flying High Circus was devastated when a tornado blew down their tent. Before they can return to shows, they must rebuild what students refer to as their “home away from home.” Their comeback story is filled with laughter, passion, and collaboration.

title: Another Way
overview: Man is on a roundabout, but cannot choose direction. He dives into his thoughts to find the answer. In the end man creates his own way.

title: Play the Lottery
overview: They play the lottery.

title: Balik na, Lola
overview: Told from the perspective of her grandson, Rita returns back to the Philippines after years apart. Family, nostalgia, pain sitting exactly where they were before.

title: A Few of Shakespeare's Days of Despair
overview: Unable to write for a long time, William Shakespeare embarks on a desperate search for inspiration. But everything he encounters forces him to confront his own legacy and creative burnout.

title: The Stream XV
overview: Time dwells within all that flows.  I live in the Ogura-ike Reclaimed Land in Kyoto.  Wind, water and lines of cars pass across this land.  On the highway, time moves straight toward the future.  Yet there are places where time flows backward—rivers, forests, shrines and villages, where time returns to its source.  The echo of wind chimes that rang here a hundred years ago still resonates today.

title: Wax, Whips and My Hairy Bits
overview: After discovering erotic fiction, a Blackpool woman, disillusioned with her love life, embarks on an erotic adventure to find her very own Mr Uninhibited.

title: I Think I'm Missing Something
overview: After noticing a stranger has dropped his wallet, a man follows him through the city to return it, but the seemingly ordinary encounter gradually becomes unsettling.​  ​  ​

title: 9th & Gasoline
overview: A visually innovative blend of documentary and music video, this emotionally triumphant work centers on B. Alexis, the first woman to release an album from prison. More than just a depiction of her life, the film channels the struggles and resilience of hundreds of thousands of trauma-impacted people, especially young Black women.

title: Laika Goes Home
overview: Captain Talia Valentine is an ambitious young astronaut, whose return to Earth is interrupted when she crash-lands on a lonely asteroid. Laika is a little stray dog from the streets of Moscow, who has been stranded on that same asteroid for a very long time...  Talia is in a one-track mind about finding her way off of this forsaken rock. Laika just seems thrilled to have someone to play with her. But when fixes fail, and unexpected communications bridge the expanse between Talia and the Earth, she realises that Laika may be the key to finding her way home - wherever that ends up being.

title: Remembranza
overview: Remembranza is a work that employs photogrammetry and the archive as mechanisms for reconstruction and memory. Through 3D scanning, the Votive Temple of Maipú is transformed into an object—a vessel for memories. It is an exercise that uses the errors of an imperfect scan to demonstrate the fragility of memory.

title: GOR
overview: WHAT IF YOU GET TO ESCAPE  2 individuals from different state are stuck in a reality they can't escape while they encounter their own something vicious

title: passed away
overview: new york city seen through motion photography

title: If You Were Here
overview: Someone once told me that you and I could have been good friends, and I thought, but we already are, just in a rather unconventional way. We’ve been friends for nine months now, from opposite sides of a wall.  I wondered what a strange feeling it must be, for two people to be able to reach each other only when the other is no longer there. As if the world had taken away every possible way for us to find each other, leaving just one door, one that could only open from one side.  How cruel of the world to offer us such a chance. And yet, I would have gladly given you my chance to stay. You, who would have stayed behind, with all those blue stains.

title: What Lurks
overview: On Halloween night, a man sets out on a solitary walk through the streets of Dublin. Unbeknownst to him, his friends are trailing close behind in the shadows, determined to uncover the mystery of where he goes when he thinks no one is watching.

title: Butterflies Don't Fly In The Rain
overview: A tragic story of an orphan siblings told through the interrogation of the orphanage master. New take on the aftermath of drugs and the ruin it brings.

title: Infinitely Absent To Creation
overview: A Violent Reckoning Of Abstraction Reflected Against Layers Of Trees. The Wide Surrendering Of The Images Running To And Remaining In Their Own Demise. The Weight Of That Expression Trembling In The Distance, A Separate Sky Where All Time Exists, Unfaltering And Death Starved. Leaving The Vision Of Reason Bound And Unreachable.

title: The Strange Hours
overview: When children mysteriously disappear, a brother’s search for his younger sibling leads him into a mystery hidden deep within the forest.

title: Luis
overview: A despondent rubber duck experiences an existential crisis following a breakup.

title: Gnaga
overview: A nightclub becomes bridge towards an underworld ruled by a feline wizard. A pact is sealed.

title: I am Destroying my Dignity and Identity
overview: Fed up with his friend being made fun of, a teenage boy defends his friend and his own honor.

title: Ceremony
overview: Before graduation, I made a wish for a heavy rain. There was a "one last time" in the wish. One month before that, my grandfather passed away. On the day before the burial, that was the "one last time" to see his face. Is there some ritualistic meaning hidden between "wish" and "the last"?

title: COLLIDEOSCOPE
overview: Filmed, edited and scored in ten days, COLLIDEOSCOPE is a non-narrative structural experiment consisting of ten 10 second chapters, each with ten overlays of shots that were filmed for the amount of time shown and without a second take. It acts as a capsule of misjudged, fleeting moments told in linear metaphors about the journey from life to death.

title: Cancer-Soul
overview: Hardly anyone remains untouched by the topic of cancer – whether through their own diagnosis or through a loved one. CANCER SOUL  opens a new perspective on cancer. Courageous. Holistic. And never told like this before. The film views cancer not only as a medical diagnosis, but as a complex interplay of body, mind and soul. Renowned cancer experts, doctors, alternative practitioners, energy healers and former patients speak openly about questions that concern many people:  Why does cancer develop?  What role do emotions, lifestyle, and environment play?  What treatment and support options are available – both conventional and holistic?  What can give people hope in these times?  CANCER SOUL combines modern medicine with new perspectives from naturopathy, psycho-oncology, biomedicine and spiritual approaches.  A film that doesn't pretend to have all the answers – but opens up new ways of thinking.

title: The Trench
overview: Driven by a fading love and apocalyptic anguish, porn director Bielohusky embarks on a journey to the deepest part of the ocean, the Mariana Trench. Accompanied by a team of old and new friends, he comes to realize that the expedition is more difficult than he expected, with tension mounting as they descend.

title: The Chronicles
overview: A passionate musician speaks her mind on camera during a nightly outing in a Los Angeles suburb.

title: Folded Stories
overview: “It’s more than just clothes.” In this spoken-word film, fashion becomes the story, exploring the identities and memories woven into every thread.

title: Slip Stream
overview: “I have lived my life in the slipstream of experience.” – Elizabeth Jane Howard

title: A Way of Listening to the World
overview: A Way of Listening to the World is a sound and visual journey built from field recordings and original music. Birds, voices, transportation and machines compose a fragmented listening experience where reality becomes a sensitive material. The film explores liminal spaces between presence and absence, environment and memory.

title: Dessert
overview: When you work in the office, you have to keep an eye on your superiors.

title: Not a Single Flower
overview: In the house where Hilda grew up, time seems to have stood still. The spaces once inhabited by her family now appear empty. Forty-eight years later, Hilda revisits her memories and shares her story with us.

title: May 10th
overview: A little girl on her birthday is waiting for a boy to run around with sunflowers in his hands, and that's going to happen 10 years from now, and it could go on forever.

title: Just Thoughts
overview: A man who, isolated in a nearly deserted city, enters a space where his body and mind begin to fracture. Amidst distorted memories and heavy silences, he confronts a pain he has avoided for too long. A fly, seemingly watching him with unsettling persistence, acts as a witness to the darkest corners of his inner self.

title: In the Valleys
overview: After leaving their young daughter home alone in the middle of the night, a couple finds themselves caught up in inexplicable phenomena upon hearing a radio report about lights in the sky invading the valleys.

title: Intruder
overview: A man receives a home security alert.

title: Pale Paradise
overview: A man finds happiness in a once-platonic relationship. But after he proposes, his girlfriend’s sudden desire for intimacy brings his hidden fetish to the surface.  As he tries to bridge the growing gap between them through physical closeness, he instead sinks deeper into loneliness.

title: Painting Cathedral Rock
overview: Painting Cathedral Rock is an experimental work in which painting, performance and film converge to explore landscape, ritual, colonialism and the fragile boundaries between spectacle, spirituality and perception.

title: Roma o Morte
overview: In Rome, the disappearance of a consignment of a devastating drug upsets the balance of power within the underworld. Suspicion falls on Lazio supporters.

title: Powered by Blood
overview: A poetic documentary that immerses itself in the nocturnal world of food delivery app workers, where the relentless pace of this work routine twists and distorts both the workers' bodies and perceptions and their rhetoric of labor liberation.

title: Riccy Mabel
overview: In 1991, 17-year-old Riccy Mabel leaves La Ceiba for Tegucigalpa to train as a teacher, then disappears. Reconstructing her case, the film follows the traces of devastating violence and the questions that remain when the truth emerges too late.

title: Aftertaste
overview: Sex produces knowledge. A knowledge that is rarely transmitted. Some facts about sapphic sex education.

title: an active dying
overview: an active dying is an experimental film that utilizes film’s position as a dying medium to explore what dying is. I came to the conclusion that there is an active state of dying and an inactive one. That active state is like a crescendo of ever increasing importance, and change. It's a dying star, creating a supernova, blowing you up from the inside. If you survive, you still feel the pressure of the star inside you, you aren't able to ignore it as you did before you knew of its precarious nature. An active dying recreates this experience with film texture, colour and flicker.

title: Hot Spring Therapy
overview: A snow monkey bathing in a natural hot spring has an out-of-body experience and requires some well-trained snowflakes to revive him with their magical powers.

title: Indigenous Joy
overview: A First Nations woman asks herself, "What is Indigenous Joy?" A short Super 8mm film, produced as part of the Winnipeg Film Groups’ Super 8 Special Film Incubator.

title: LOCKED GROOVE
overview: A hand-drawn abstract audiovisual work that explores repetition as a visual and sonic trance. Composed of simple geometric shapes and inspired by pareidolia, it invites viewers to discover hidden forms and evolving patterns.

title: Senseless Acts of Violence 2
overview: Haunted by the aftermath of a camping trip gone wrong, Topher is drawn into a brutal and increasingly surreal world where unseen forces pull the strings—and his understanding of reality begins to fall apart.

title: The Puzzle of Pain: RIP Van Winkle
overview: Appropriated from the classic Terry Toon animation, we watch events unfold of a lethargic hunter under a tree, beaten with a rolling pin multiple times by his wife for his laziness. Is this character invincible? Are they subject only to the idea of pain but not actually experiencing it? What is pain in the world of animation? Witness the breakdown of both the image and pain vs the suspension of disbelief in this tongue-in-cheek portrayal of violence in classic cartoons.

title: Fox
overview: An off-hand confession about ‘helping a fox’ turns a tipsy date night into a claustrophobic reckoning of mercy, reason, and the terrifying impossibility of knowing another person.

title: God’s Girls
overview: During the autumn break, a student named Emma joins her classmate Lauren to visit Lauren’s grandparents in the countryside, where the two form a close friendship away from their strict boarding school.

title: Little Dreamer
overview: During an entirely ordinary breakfast, little Lily lets her imagination run wild. She is gazing at a bowl of chocolate breakfast cereal, and suddenly everything around her changes. On her way to school, her all-so-familiar home, the school bus and the playground become a new magical universe. The morning might be usual, but for the red-haired girl, it will be filled with the most unusual adventures…

title: You're Late
overview: YOU'RE LATE is an independent short film written, directed, and produced by Neeraj Patel and Grey Silhouette Films

title: Drift
overview: Drift is an intimate exploration of what it means to be trapped in the sick body. This collaborative film tries to make the edges of the body visible and gesture towards the in-between state of sickness, loneliness and the domestic.

title: Before the Sun
overview: A summer camp on the Black Sea becomes a coming-of-age place for teenagers from an orphanage. Masha looks after her younger sister; Ksyusha lives with the fallout of a first love; Akim waits in the hope that his father will soon return.

title: Glimpses Of Ideas
overview: What do we do once Hollywood has ended? Film is an expressive art form that has much more going for it than that. These glimpses of ideas and images show a different way of thinking to standard Hollywood.

title: Longing
overview: Jack and Sofie arrive in London, ostensibly to explore whether they should move there together. As they walk the city and imagine a shared life in it, Sofie confesses: she's already decided. She quit her job.

title: Cold Calling
overview: A young salesgirl’s routine cold calls uncover raw confessions, exposing the fragile line between survival and the illusion of protection.

title: Until The Last Sunshine
overview: An aspiring cinematographer meets a young artist at St. Thomas Mount in Chennai, where their shared love for art and sunsets slowly brings them closer. But when he leaves the city to pursue a long-awaited opportunity, their promise to meet again takes an unexpected turn.

title: The Knights of NYC
overview: A portrait of Jesse “Shortbread” Mooney and his life in New York City’s medieval combat community.

title: THE RAT KING
overview: A low-budget mockumentary-drama that follows filmmaker Aiden Diorio as he secures an exclusive interview with the elusive Rat King, Reed Depel-Leblanc, a self-proclaimed monarch who lives deep within an abandoned sewer system beneath the city.

title: Women’s Circle
overview: Two closest friends, Elina and Ramilya, on the cusp of turning 40, take a recreational trip to the mountains. Elina brings along her new lover, Vasily, hoping the trip will strengthen their relationship. Away from it all, she sees that Vasily is making advances towards Ramilya that her friend does not reject. Jealousy takes over Elina, and the holiday she had waited for turns into a psychological duel. Can their friendship survive the test?

title: When people ask where you're from
overview: Sonja Aigner, born in South Africa and now living in Germany, reflects on identity and belonging after a DNA test reveals connections across the world.Through a quiet and intimate conversation, the film explores what it means to come from a place and whether that answer is ever complete.

title: The Girl Beneath The Sun
overview: Teenage sugarcane harvester Shivkanya confronts the realities of early motherhood and marriage, unspoken duties, an eccentric  husband and an uncertain future that shapes and  constrains her dreams, identity and hopes for her child and herself.

title: There Is Something I Want to Tell You
overview: Following a recent act of terrorism, growing homophobia among those around Jaro leaves him feeling increasingly cornered. The situation threatens the identity he has kept hidden.

title: Shrimp Toast
overview: Two estranged sisters struggle to reconnect over their late mother's favorite dish.

title: Crib Club
overview: Sinister forces appear to be at play when a man notices his child's strange obsession with a children's television show host.

title: Cut!
overview: A perfectionist director cannot get the last scene of his movie right, so he retakes, and retakes, and retakes...until it's just right.

title: The Watch
overview: Dave, a down-on-his-luck salesman is about to lose his job when he unearths a box containing a watch and a gun. Discovering that the watch gives him the ability to travel back in time, it dramatically reshapes his life, and the lives of the people around him.

title: The Uptown
overview: Vivi puts a personal ad in a fetish mag, looking for adventure in San Francisco. She and Mx. Mayhem arrange a hot anonymous encounter, but in a town this small, they are destined to awkwardly run into each other at the local queer bar.

title: Doomed by Choice
overview: A short animated film about a father who begins gambling, believing he is doing it for a better future for his family. But gradually, the game turns into an addiction, destroying his life, relationships, and his ability to control his own decisions.

title: THE BRANDOS
overview: Four sons reunite after their father's death, facing the question of who will continue his legacy. But the real question is… should they continue it at all?

title: Transerrante
overview: A trans, Chilean-Palestinian refugee embarks on a journey towards finding safety and belonging, while reconnecting with the roots of their intergenerational displacement.

title: Waiting
overview: Nicolas has come a long way to find Sofiane again. But the meeting, which seemed like it would be simple, doesn’t go as planned. Nicolas moves through this drawn-out day, caught between what was promised and what is still to come.

title: Spilling Your Guts
overview: An original poem turned short film and performance art piece. It emerges from the experience of becoming completely exposed when meeting someone you connect with deeply. It is the frantic realization that the baggage you have carried for years, once manageable, now sits in the middle of the room that exists between you and another person. Under their gaze, its weight changes.

title: Memory: A Film that Tries to Remember Itself
overview: Using visual data extracted from found 8mm footage, the film attempts to reconstruct itself—bit by bit, colour by colour, line by line. This process unfolds through data visualization, tracing how images are absorbed, fragmented and remembered.

title: Love in Three Acts
overview: An intimate autobiographical film weaving together years of analogue photographs, self-portraits, and moving image. What began as a private act of preservation unfolds into a quiet meditation on bipolar disorder, love, family, and everyday memory.  Love in Three Acts is an intimate autobiographical film weaving together years of analogue photographs, self-portraits, and moving image.  What began as a private act of preservation — documenting early motherhood in isolation during the pandemic — unfolds into a quiet meditation on bipolar disorder, love, family, and everyday memory. Moving between humour and heartbreak, the film gathers fragments of self as woman, artist, and mother, while tracing a fraught relationship with photography after leaving photojournalism.  At its core, Love in Three Acts is an offering of a private world, now shared.

title: Ignis et Glacies
overview: The Yukon River at Dawson City (Tr'ondëk Hwëch'in) on November 15, 2025. The ice has covered the river but not memories of summer fires. Filmed in 16mm, Developed with sunflower developer. Phytograms with mint, parsley, rosemary, thyme and spider plant. Made for the Yukon48 Film Challenge.

title: There are Giants walking around Us
overview: An exploration of several european cities through the Miniland located in Legoland Germany

title: Lani
overview: Professional golfer Tagiralani Luafalealo navigates her golf journey as the first Samoan woman to play in the LPGA.

title: The Rift Between Us
overview: The Rift Between Us is a talking heads documentary featuring Nozizwe Dube, Marie-Fidèle Dusingize and Betel Mabille, exploring the impact of misogynoir on romantic relationships between Black women and Black men in Belgium. At the intersection of sexism and anti-Black racism, the film asks how colonial legacies continue to shape the ways we see ourselves, each other, and the relationships we build.

title: A Moment
overview: About benches as silent witnesses to our encounters, separations and the passage of time. As people arrive and leave, the bench becomes a central point around which bodies, relationships and time change. What remains of us after we stand up and walk away except for the trace that we were once there?

title: Warrior
overview: The lives of teenagers who joined a youth military organization during the full-scale war in Ukraine.

title: Arco Voltaico
overview: Arco Voltaico explores the hidden life of a hydroelectric power station deep in the Swiss mountains. We are guided from the darkness into the pulsating heart of the facility, among massive conduits, towering turbines and a silent, unsettling control centre. We observe the annual procedure of magnetic particle inspection: a complex examination of the turbines aimed at detecting cracks and material defects. Through the technicians’ hands and their meticulous application of magnets and fluorescent powders, we follow every stage of the inspection, an open-heart exploration of the machine. The soundscape, built from recordings captured inside the plant, transforms the environment into an auditory landscape that makes the invisible presence of energy and technology tangible. Amid flashes of iridescent light and metallic reflections, Arco Voltaico reveals the delicate interplay between humans and machinery, fragility and power.

title: Julka
overview: Julka is a Slovenian-speaking eight-year-old girl who has two friends, Danilo and Marko, with whom she is inseparable. Their lives change drastically when the fascist regime bans the use of local and minority languages and begins a period of persecution and oppression. One day, a teacher hears Julka speaking Slovene in class, so he punishes her and uses violence to enforce his excessive nationalism.

title: Little Anteater
overview: The great journey of the Little Anteater.

title: When Flowers Dream of Us
overview: After the explosion, only silence remains. The land is cracked, the roots exposed, the air heavy with dust. Red flowers once covered this place. Now only ash and the memory of their color. A voice speaks in ʿAsfouri, the lost language of birds, calling out to the soil, to what might still listen. There are no people left, only the echo of his words scattered through the wind. When we are gone, will the flowers grow again?

title: The Man Who Tickles
overview: When a serial tickler terrorises the city, a hard-boiled police detective and his bumbling rookie assistant must discover the truth and put an end to the crimes.

title: Melancholy
overview: A lonely and depressed young man decides to start beating up delinquents on the streets to cope with his sadness. People call him “Melancholy.”

title: The Quickest Cum in the West
Roaches in the Head
overview: In a student dormitory, beneath an old refrigerator, there is a city of cockroaches. When people decide to replace their refrigerator, their world is put at risk. Having overheard humans talk about their “inner gremlins,” King Roach decides it might as well be “inner cockroaches” and leads his people into the human mind in search of a new home.

title: The Employed
overview: Summer. In a region of northern Italy, workers are on a construction site. Every day is the same as the next. The same movements, breaks, and noises repeat themselves as the construction progresses. In the evening, the men return home to go through their usual rituals. It’s like a never-ending cycle.

title: Cockroach
overview: A small creature yearning for love is confronted with man's objectifying fantasies, and through a painful transformation, reclaims her identity and walks away from a place where love never existed.

title: Giro poder o filme 4 o medalhão do poder o filme
Datafication〈Act 1〉: May Ian Valley 0101
overview: Enter a gamified dreamscape where AI turns bodies into data, pleasure into surveillance.

title: Boom, Grandpa! Boom!
overview: During the funeral, a young girl tracks down her dead grandfather's soul, only to find him happily gambling in the afterlife. Slipping him a transit pass, fireworks explode—Bang! Grandpa blasts into the heavens.

title: Azul Marino
overview: A trip through several cities in Italy in the span of two weeks.

title: Wales Visitation
overview: Part travelogue, part performative intervention into myth making around place and persona. Retraces and communes with Allen Ginsberg’s Wales trip.

title: Manithee: the fire bird
overview: A brilliant female physicist fighting to introduce her breakthrough technology to the world and an ambitious young filmmaker from a small village, determined to create a world-class masterpiece, find themselves trapped in a mysterious forest. The story follows the challenges they face and how they overcome these obstacles to achieve their dreams.

title: Poetrix
overview: "POETRIX" (2026) is a short art experimental animation that was inspired by the dystopian novel "The smudge" (Taxideftis, 2021). It is about the interaction of conscious and subconscious, how the subconscious is formed in the course of life and can affect our actions and consequently the world. It all begins with a nightmare that triggers a repressed trauma to resurface and brings the main character "The Creature" face to face with itself.

title: Vorfreude
overview: Vorfreude (Foresight) is a short experimental film that drifts through the charged space before arrival. Woven from glitching images and analogue video and audio synthesis, it moves less like a journey toward something than like a figure wandering through their own anticipation, tracing and retracing the same trembling edges of feeling without ever quite touching what lies ahead.

title: Lulu Got a New Roommate
overview: A ladybug Ronnie accidentally got stuck in a spider Lulu's web while building its nest. What can it do to escape? This is a story about friendship and Chinese puns about insects.

title: Process
overview: Known for his eccentricity and exceptionally long moustache, artist Felix Ambrosious Delacroix the 3rd gets asked about the secret behind his autoportrait. As he explains, it's crucial to begin the work a day before the deadline, on 2 hours of sleep and 12 cups of coffee. But what if the produced artwork still doesn't live up to your expectations? Well, you need to abandon all hope, curl up into a ball and begin... a performance.

title: The Girl With The Ribbon
overview: The reclusive Jennifer grapples with a life tied together by a thread, when she begins to question the reality of the love between her and her boyfriend, Albert, things begin to gruesomely unravel...

title: Le Mendébile - L'enfant à la couronne
A Christmas Destiny
overview: Five years after one unforgettable Christmas Eve together, Serena and Jarrod cross paths again, except now, they’ve both moved on, and neither one is single.

title: Three Sad Aunts
overview: What begins as a true-crime drama about three women — one imprisoned during a dictatorship, another who fled Brazil, and a third who took her own life — shifts when their nephew, now a father and the film’s director, steps in and questions his own narrative. Through archival footage and journeys, he seeks to reunite his family while his children teach him a new way of looking toward the future.

title: Lice n' Shine
overview: A portrait of the everyday life of teenage girls in the sensitive ecosystem of a boarding school, where an entirely normal morning can quickly give way to chaos.

title: Night Terrors
overview: Don’t wake a sleep walker...

title: Un castello
overview: Martin is a boy who lives a tormented love for Karin, a girl who instead seems to want nothing more than to escape from him, until she gets sick and remains under the boy's care.

title: Girl Hell
overview: Upcoming Found Footage Short Film from Lucille Hanson. Plot TBA

title: BackToUs
overview: Lola and Mia navigate female friendship, competition, and the influence of patriarchal structures, as the pressure for male validation increasingly comes between them.

title: A Smaller God
overview: When one lets their mind wander too long into too far places , they might slip into the path of universal mind. Endless obscure knowledges can be obtained but they will soon turn into pain and suffering, Since they are too great to be comprehended  and too heavy to be contained by human mind.

title: Um Filme de Terror Feito no Halloween
overview: I wasn't at a Halloween Party, so I did a Movie instead.

title: DISPLACED short film
overview: A student went missing one day in a college. Detective John and Detective Ian  was assigned on a case to find this missing student. The last sighting of the student was right  after he entered a staircase to exit to the ground floor. Detective Ian had an epiphany on  where could the missing student be.  .  They have to find and save the missing student that disappeared. Detective Ian is left facing a terrifying realization: the place the student went  missing is not an any ordinary place.

title: Jakarta, I Love You
overview: A birthday boy meets a lost a stranger on the Jakarta MRT.

title: Photo Day Dilemma
overview: Just minutes before school photos Jesse suddenly finds himself with a very unusual problem. With the clock ticking he desperately tries to fix it before his photo is taken, but his attempts quickly turn into chaos around the school.

title: Home
overview: Ben gets a letter stating that he has been deemed not suitable to raise a child, aka Crewmate. He must give up the child, or he will be at risk of losing his home. Not wanting to be separated from his child, but also not wanting to lose 2 homes in a year, Ben tries to find as many legal loopholes as possible to ensure he can keep both his home and child, but eventually, he'll need to come to a choice.

title: Mother Nature
overview: Mother Nature is an abstract exploration of the natural world and its ongoing struggle for survival. Shot on 16mm, the film uses texture, movement and form to express the tension between resilience and destruction within nature’s fragile ecosystems.
