The film has been physically altered through a series of material interventions—baked in an oven, bleached, hand-painted and scratched—transforming the celluloid itself to mirror the erosion, violence and beauty found in nature’s own processes. The experimental soundtrack was created by capturing the hidden sounds of plants through sensitive microphones, amplifying the subtle vibrations and internal rhythms of organic life.

title: SAKANA
overview: Kana accidentally falls asleep while taking a bath and is transported to the ruins of another world ruled by mutant fish. Holding a katana, she battles fish-headed people and a giant eel. When she wakes up and thinks it was only a hallucination, a character…

title: Tabungan Yang Dimakan Waktu
overview: A high school student realizes that her cash savings for college are damaged.

title: dead. ____ escape
overview: A nightmarish experience in a cemetery.

title: Spinoza’s Rainbow 1
overview: A prelude introduces the algebraic calculation of a rainbow’s arc, reputed to be by Baruch Spinoza and dating back to 1687. A shadow observes itself, connecting two points. Through a series of single, double and triple exposures, the three colour records of 16mm film emulsion converge and diverge. Breath becomes a source of movement, and language transforms into frequencies, as if they could become light, through the recitation of three poems by Friedrich Nietzsche from 1887.

title: TAKE A SEAT
overview: A journey to accompany the lost. Through the voyage of Hailey, Gubo and Tata, we aim to be there for you during your lowest moments. We want to say maybe wait a little longer, maybe stay just a bit more.

title: Ghost Noon
overview: Vom Geist der Schwere! Become a ghost at noon, open a spectral drift with no terminus—escape, defection, exile, nomadism—from this point on one cannot be pinned down by any exact and unshifting identification in time or in coordinates. Under the shadow of the state machine’s perpetual operation, hauntology emerges as a methodology of survival against a pervasive spiritual decline—even as it all is ultimately destined to fail.

title: Flower Shield
overview: A girl dreams of protection for people in Ukraine.

title: Ember Notes
overview: A saxophonist struggling with burnout loses his passion for music, until unexpected connections offer a new way to rediscover his spark.

title: Rugosa
overview: A survivor lives out her days beneath the soil of a vicious wasteland. Her peace is shattered when a mysterious creature threatens her existence.

title: Somebody wants me dead
overview: Haunted by a mysterious voice telling him, “I want you dead,” Happy begins suffering from terrifying disturbances that follow him into the night. As sleepless nights turn into violent encounters and unexplained occurrences, he seeks help from a psychiatrist but soon realizes that whatever is haunting him may be far closer than he imagined.

title: StarFall
overview: The little star descends toward the earth, bound to a journey it knows will end in ruin. The distant stars pleading for its return are the echoes of reason—an internal warning it chooses to ignore. Just as stars vanish from our sight with the dawn, the protagonist fades away with the first light of day, unable to exist in a world where he was never meant to belong.

title: Medium Close
overview: Found footage from 1980s TV movies, camera tests and commercials is aligned with an invented narrative exploring conventions of cinema, love, relationships and their sometimes painful consequences. Cynicism and cliches along with love and regrets frame a narrative that is at once personal and every person.

title: The Ad
overview: A young man must come to terms with a malicious infomercial and its terrifying host.

title: The Dreamweaver
overview: High above in space, the Star Cat weaves a magical blanket from dreams each night, bringing children beautiful visions. But when a ravenous Rat begins gnawing at its glowing threads, dreams turn into nightmares. To restore light and peace, the Star Cat sets out to stop the intruder and protect the dreams of humankind.

title: The Country Gentlewoman
overview: A Georgian era inspired short film that brings you the best of festive entertaining. Join Arabella and Margaret as they navigate the complexities of tricky ex-partners, the art of hosting, and perfect wine pairings.

title: Haavens
overview: A relationship fractures due to distance as shipments move in and out of the port of Rotterdam. On the days the port is closed, the vast area becomes a landscape used by other inhabitants. The film was hand processed and painted in Rotterdam, along with the process-related optical sound.

title: Zebra
overview: A boy who keeps seeing a crying zebra encounters a girl who longs to be seen.

title: The Last Ally
overview: Poland, spring 1945. In a landscape suspended between the end of the war and the beginning of uncertainty, two survivors meet: a Polish prisoner on the run and a young German deserter.

title: Beware of Loss
overview: As children, we all had something that once felt like the most precious thing in the world. For the protagonist, it was a toy that was always by their side. Yet now, having grown up, they find themselves no longer cherishing that toy as they once did.  “Why do we eventually forget the toys that once meant the most to us?”  Through the documentary, we explore how the things we hold dear change as we grow. In the place once occupied by a beloved toy, other precious things have taken its place—friends, family, relationships, and memories.

title: Gossips
overview: Dhriti finds a mysterious bracelet after which mysterious occurrences happen around her.

title: SPROUT
overview: This coming-of-age fantasy follows thirteen-year-old Evie as she escapes the pressures of modern life through extraordinary adventures with a mysterious companion.

title: Like Fire
overview: A short film based on the poem of the same name. A woman relives the ardent and haunting memories of a lost love that she wants to forget.

title: Guttural
overview: Commissioned by Take Your Medicine And Smile for their Compulsive Creation series as part of the Short Film Showoffs monthly screening series.

title: A Letter To Mr. Stapleton
overview: An introduction from one party to another.

title: Moko: Bisikan Logam Tua
overview: Behind the beauty of the sea and the calm hills of Alor Island, lies the mystery of an old bronze drum called Moko, an inanimate object with magical powers that is believed to be able to come to life, change form, and even demand sacrifices. But for the Abui people, Moko is more than just a sacred myth; it's a wedding dowry and an "eternal debt" that can delay burial and force parents to sweat until their last drop of blood. Through Yoel's emotional narrative and the silent cries of the guardians of tradition, this documentary reveals a profound question: where is the line between inherited dignity and the shackles that cost humanity tears?

title: Day of Worlds Aligning
overview: An experimental documentary where descendants get to be in the same space with their deceased family member once again. While Mom and the Aunties are busy with Grandpa’s memorial day, his spirit comes back to visit without them knowing.

title: 12.08/F0F1
overview: A group of people experience peculiar symptoms after a solar eclipse.

title: She Looks Like Latte
overview: After a dog named Latte mysteriously disappears, a filmmaker pieces together recovered footage and audio diaries to reconstruct the events surrounding the disappearance. The search for answers uncovers something unsettling about the neighborhood cats, and the dog that came back.

title: Beyond the Doors of Club 708
overview: A poignant short documentary that explores the legacy of an iconic venue in Atlanta's Black LGBTQ+ community. Once a vibrant hub for connection and celebration, the club's sudden closure left a significant void in the lives of its patrons. Through archival footage and personal testimonials, the film chronicles the rich history of Club 708, reflecting on its cultural impact and the community's resilience in the face of loss. This documentary not only captures the essence of what the club represented but also imagines the possibilities of what could have been, highlighting the ongoing need for safe spaces in the community.

title: The Sledge
overview: Three siblings accidentally damage their father’s sledge, the family’s main source of income. Determined to make things right, they set out to earn money to cover the damage. But when they find a bag full of cash, they face a difficult choice: keep it or return it to its rightful owner?

title: City
overview: An animated reflection on the role of the individual in the ever-changing urban landscape, drawing on Mykhailo Semenko’s futuristic poetry and the realities of contemporary Ukraine.

title: Running Late
overview: One man’s surreal morning routine.

title: Demontage
overview: On the outskirts of Lüdenscheid in Germany, Sandra runs her late father's car recycling business. It is a place where discarded car parts find new owners, and where people find work, structure and a sense of belonging. Together with her employees Holger, Markus and Kevin, who would struggle to find work elsewhere, Sandra has created a fragile utopia. However, a growing chain of external pressures threatens not only the business, but also the lives that are intertwined with it.

title: Yolanda
overview: Yolanda (60), a well-known podiatrist in Machalí, struggles to conceal a dark secret. When her daughter Macarena reveals her own trauma, Yolanda finds the strength she needs to confront her past.

title: Untitled Mix
overview: An ambitious young DJ and his stoner sidekick have their friendship tested as they attempt to get airtime on a local pirate radio station.

title: D3STRO
overview: A young couple shares a deep passion about food and desire for each other. They put all their efforts to satisfy all their fantasies, until they come with the ultimate culinary experience. One must be eaten and the second must feed from the other’s flesh.

title: Iakwe: Hello, Goodbye
overview: Based on real events, a young traveling salesman who after being adopted at birth, meets his blood relatives for the first time by chance while knocking on doors in Northwest Arkansas. The film explores the power and complexity of family bonds from a Pacific Islander/Marshallese perspective.

title: Switch
overview: A young woman tries to leave her old life behind. Dark forces pursue her, and she experiences a moral awakening.

title: Eight Heels and a Hard Truth
overview: Set in the Southeast—where LGBTQIA+ histories have long been under-documented—Eight Heels and a Hard Truth follows a Mexican-born trans woman who survived silence, violence, and erasure in the Deep South’s bail bond world before reclaiming her voice and joining other leaders in Atlanta. The film honors the resilience of trans women like her who not only survived, but thrived as “ladies” in the South—often unseen, but never without power.

title: Symbiotica
overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

title: Let There Be Light
overview: A flickering streetlight becomes a site of pilgrimage when people begin to believe its flashes spell out “yes” and “no” – guiding them through the unbearable uncertainty of existence.

title: I Met Papo And Pepe
overview: A lost, nameless girl, struggling with the challenges of forced migration, finds freedom on a journey into the magical past of an elderly Caribbean immigrant named Papo.

title: Last Bell
overview: Christopher goes to a seemingly regular school day when he decides to take an innocent nap, only to wake up and find the entire school gone and as the truth unravels so does the horror...

title: Sarah Was Here
overview: Ponytailed pot head and Swiss train graffiti spotting legend Jean-Claude Röschli is still struggling seven years after his daughter's suicide.

title: Once in the Morning
overview: Consumed by everyday routine, the main character gradually stops noticing the beauty of everyday moments. But her son sees the world differently. His ability to imagine and dream, along with memories of her own childhood, help the woman rediscover joy in life and the beauty of the surrounding world.

title: Gazawyat: Hadeel
overview: Far from the news, a silent genocide seeks to crush the humanity and femininity of women in displacement camps. The film dives into spontaneous moments of shared storytelling, where displaced women gather to reclaim their selves through ancient rituals. It is their attempt to rebuild the fortress of femininity dismantled by displacement, a bold declaration that the dignity of the body is the enduring reflection of the soul amidst the ruins.

title: Miracle Whip
overview: Sebastian Winterfold (Michael Louis Hassiepen) applies for the job of a lifetime.

title: The Signalman
overview: "A man must be obedient to the signs," says railway signalman and poet Ezra Miles. This film is poetic journey into his thoughts from a box about mental health and the divine.

title: Executioners
overview: Through fragments of Andrzej Wajda’s films, a found-footage essay explores the conflict between the individual and power, the persistence of collective memory, and class struggle.

title: Franca
overview: In a small town, Franca, a single mother, tries to hold onto her last remaining child, Juan, while society, the justice system, and her own past seem to conspire to tear him away from her. Left without child support and with her older children in the custody of an unfaithful ex-husband, she survives by stealing food, negotiating with lawyers, and enduring the judgmental gaze of a traditional town—as well as that of her mother, a flirtatious woman who, despite loving her, never fails to point out her mistakes.

title: Towards Jimagawod
overview: Inspired by the oceanic novel Black Wings by Taiwanese Indigenous Yami/Tao writer Syaman Rapongan, this immersive documentary transforms audience readings through AI speech recognition-driven response into a collective literary ritual, resonating with the author’s voice and memories between MR and projection space.

title: Poké Wayang: The Forest Where "Good Morning" Disappeared
overview: Well, here we are in Sunrise Forest... But wait, something seems a bit strange.

title: Chimeras Tonight (Too Mercury)
overview: In this dreamlike animation, two women fall in love and are metamorphosed into strange creatures, symbiotic with the natural world around them.

title: Spirit Chasers
overview: By generating image from sound, the film imagines landscape as something transmitted, remembered, and continually re-formed rather than simply seen. The film begins with an original audiovisual composition whose oscillator trace is screen-captured and used as the underlying structure for the image.

title: Standing Prayer II
overview: A film prayer. Giraffes gather in an enclosure to usher a mysterious ritual.

title: Job Seeker
overview: A first encounter between a jobless gay and a job seeker and it is also a love story. Both characters connect as they understand one another and share their feelings. This film is an episode that feels warm and is full of joy in the little things.

title: Sorgin 1615
overview: In 1615, three friends celebrating the summer solstice in the Basque Country face a nightmare when a sinister figure emerges from the darkness.

title: Yuri Far Far Away
overview: Yuri lives far to the north in a village near the cosmodrome. He is passionate about fantasy and dreams of an incredible discovery that will make him famous. One day in the forest he finds a UFO...

title: I'm The Director Of This Film
overview: In this film, I am the director

title: Perfect Imperfection
overview: A conversation between a uni-bound student and his mentor. Exploring themes of voice and vulnerability.

title: Land of Enchantment
overview: Land of Enchantment explores the quiet majesty of northern New Mexico. Inspired by the legacy of early landscape photographers, the film approaches the region not as a travelogue but as a visual study of light, land and time.

title: Along the Way with the Gray Whales
overview: The film tells about the fate of a species that was on the verge of total extinction due to whaling in the past, and today is listed in the Red Book of Russia.

title: Shadowland
overview: Haunted by the men who came before him, a solitary truck driver with a penchant for song must decide whether to repeat the past or forge a different future.

title: Half a Decade of Projecting
overview: A behind-the-scenes look at going to the movies, from the projection booth.

title: Oscillations
overview: Oscillations is an experimental animated short constructed from a filmed live oscilloscope performance combining synthesized sampling, live guitar and analog signal imagery. Continuing the tradition of visual music explored by pioneers such as Oskar Fischinger, the work transforms sound into shifting geometric forms and rhythmic electronic landscapes. Utilizing William S. Burroughs’ cut-up method, fragments of text derived from the “Pale Blue Dot” passage in Cosmos are recombined into evolving poetic structures. Through repetition, fragmentation and oscillation, the piece gradually shifts from cosmic reflection toward an inquiry into memory, place and the unstable idea of home.

title: Eating Disorders, Ethnicity and Culture
overview: Eating disorders can affect anybody, from any age, sex, gender, and background. Yet limiting stereotypes still exist about who can be affected by eating disorders.

title: Etudes of Consciousness
overview: Three surrealist études explore the inner world of a human being: a man on the metro struggles against obsessive forces, a young girl loses her balance under her mother’s pressure, and a boy confronts Anxiety but friendship helps him overcome it. Stories about fear, loneliness, and support.

title: The Gloria! Project
overview: A short documentary exploring the life and legacy of queer Latinx civil rights leader Gloria Casarez. Produced over the course of a decade, the film traces Gloria’s journey from her childhood in “the Badlands" of Philadelphia, to grassroots organizer in the anti-poverty and HIV/AIDS movements, to her historic appointment as the city’s first Director of LGBT Affairs. Told through a rich blend of personal archives and voices from her community, the film captures how Gloria’s "boots on the ground" philosophy broke down barriers to ensure everyone had a seat at the table and how her legacy serves as a blueprint to continue the fight against the erasure of marginalized communities.

title: Worst Roomate Ever
overview: A woman finds her friends roommate tied up in the bathroom

title: Boo Bash
overview: Trevor is spending his Halloween birthday alone and forgotten. He suddenly receives a mysterious letter inviting him to a haunted house where a scary surprise awaits his arrival!

title: Let Me Go
overview: Following a death in the family Anna must confront her past in order to carve her future

title: time is a bird
overview: Light is motion, motion is time, time is a bird. Repetitive, seasonally cyclical process of recording Icelandic webcam screenshots, this time focusing on the light monsters that through camera lenses and glass fibres travel great underwater intercontinental distances. Visually encoded in this film is the message, "There is no valid reference frame in which light is at rest."

title: The Prince of Seven Bridges
overview: An eccentric French opera singer living in St. Petersburg reaches the final round of a prestigious vocal competition at the Kremlin. But to gain recognition, he will have to do more than simply win: he must decide whether he is willing to trade his freedom for the conventions of the state-run cultural scene.

title: Fractured
overview: An experimental, performance-driven film that explores the quiet disintegration of a relationship. Through restrained gestures and minimal interaction, it captures two individuals struggling and ultimately failing to rebuild what’s lost, arriving at the realisation that some chapters must end.

title: inthebalance...wanting
overview: Our choices have consequences that define our future, but how can we have all the information we need to make choices when our lives are so limited.

title: The Happy Pig Brand
overview: Four young piglets go on a workplace visit with their school, getting a sneak peak into their possible future at ‘The Happy Pig Brand’.

title: Malik Mata
overview: Two students, cut classes and take a forbidden shortcut through an isolated field where children have mysteriously gone missing EVERY OCTOBER 15. Along the way, they encounter a strange man who begins hunting them. Trapped in the field, the two must find a way out before they become the next victims.

title: 1018 Months
overview: A biographical drama woven from documentary footage, reconstructions, and recollection. Galina Alexandrovna — heroine, mother, grandmother, actress of her own fate — lives through decades in which fact and invention intertwine. More than ten years of filming, from the hot summer of 2012 to her last summer in 2025, turn a private life into a myth. A story of memory stronger than death, of love, and of a refusal to vanish.

title: Intellectual Property
overview: Science Fiction  Two young adults girls from different lifestyles attempt to work together to stop a new addictive drug on the market, Felix.

title: MOTH
overview: In a dark wardrobe, in the land of moths, a dictator is dying! But only you will know how the stubborn little bug will finally be crushed, and by whom.

title: Yesterday afternoon, Mei went to do abortion
overview: Yesterday afternoon，Mei went to do abortion. The appearance of a sorceress planted a seed of terror in her heart.

title: Grave Danger
overview: A grave robber is terrorized while looting corpses in a cemetery.

title: The Six Seconds
overview: A son contemplates what his final words will be to his dying father...

title: 1 15 41 Tragedy to Triumph
overview: The University of Virginia community, and the UVA football team suffered an unthinkable tragedy in 2022. Lavel Davis Jr., Devin Chandler, and D’Sean Perry were killed in the first and only mass murder in college athletics. The remainder of the season was canceled, and the program faced an uncertain future.  Three years later, the man responsible for those murders was sentenced, forcing mothers, survivors, and teammates to confront their grief once again. Amid that emotional weight, head coach Tony Elliott and a resilient veteran group carried UVA on one of college football’s most remarkable turnarounds. With the memory of their fallen teammates guiding them every step of the way, 1 15 41 Tragedy to Triumph gives testimony to a powerful story of resilience, remembrance, healing, and hope.

title: Gaetjens
overview: A movie-essay about the soccer player Joe Gaetjens, the first Haitian player to score a goal in the World Cup in the iconic match between England and U.S.

title: The 16th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League Tournament in NUMAZU
overview: The full schedule for the 16th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League Tournament, which kicks off on Sunday, November 1st at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, has been decided. This tournament will be divided into two blocks, Red Goddesses and Blue Goddesses, with 9 teams in each block, for a total of 18 teams. A total of 72 official matches will be held until Saturday, November 28th at the Okazaki City Gymnasium in Aichi. The top two teams from each block will advance to the final tournament.

title: Our Big Great Totally Awesome (And Practical) Escape
overview: A younger sibling sneaks their brother out of a burn unit in a California psychiatric ward, going on a journey that involves cigarettes, ice cream and video game worlds as they chase an impossible plan to rowboat home to Hawai‘i, drifting further into a dream neither can hold onto.

title: novem
overview: novem is the ninth in a series of abstract poetic films made by the BIG TOP collective of Trace Nelson and Peter Sandmark. The film uses archival and found 16mm and 8mm footage along with original footage shot by the duo then hand painted and collaged in editing. The film has an original soundscape, using voices and various noise instruments, to add to the film’s sense of anxiety and disembodiment, as figures cartwheel through rock formations and cloud landscapes.

title: The Encounter
overview: What happens in a formerly friendly apartment complex, now on the verge of collapse, when the terrified, isolated residents receive a half-blurred message from an unknown sender? Of course, each of them misinterprets it according to their own desires.

title: James Magee and the Hill
overview: Artist James Magee spent over forty years building installation in the West Texas desert, El Paso. Often working alone or with one assistant, Magee constructed four stone buildings, in the shape of an equidistant cross, containing his large steel-and-glass sculptures.  “James Magee and The Hill” takes the viewer to the artist’s studio and to The Hill, which he worked on until his death in 2024.  Magee and The Hill have been profiled in The New York Times and several international art magazines. The Hill is a mysterious, spiritual construction of a visionary and unique American artist.

The resulting footage is a symbolic representation of the way I experience anxiety, which is primarily through repetitive, racing thoughts. The finds include objects unlike any other: curiously shaped bronze heads and masks covered in gold foil.  The scale of the site and the number of treasures make Sanxingdui one of the most important archaeological discoveries of our time. Was this city once the capital of the ancient Shu kingdom – a kingdom whose very existence was doubted by some?  At Sanxingdui, Bronze Age treasures speak to our imagination and open a new chapter of history.

overview: In Ouro Preto, longing stirs the scene anew. It weaves memory across the fissures of time. Desire is reborn, vibrant and alive - a city set amidst resonant, enigmatic machines. Fragments of affection, time, desire, and place.

title: Brad Upton: Code Blue
overview: Brad Upton has spent decades finding the funny in getting older. In CODE BLUE, he may have more material than ever.  From pill caddies and bad drivers to marriage, kids, generational differences and the indignities that come with aging, Brad brings his sharp, boomer perspective to an hour of comedy about a life well lived—and a body that occasionally has other plans.  Behind the laughs is a deeply personal story that gave Brad a new appreciation for taking life as it comes, enjoying the ride and finding humor even when things don’t go according to plan.  Funny, personal and unexpectedly heartfelt, CODE BLUE is Brad Upton at his best: laughing at life, aging on his own terms and proving there’s always something worth finding funny along the way.

title: A Vision for Vision

From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

This full comedy special captures Tammy Pescatelli at her best, with an energetic delivery that keeps the audience engaged from start to finish. title: Trapiá, Um Outro Sertão
overview: In the heart of the hinterlands of Paraíba, in Northeast Brazil, trapiá is the name of a tree that defies both the sun and the drought. This documentary portrays a rural community in the midst of a transition away from a traditional way of life. title: Caso Isolado
overview: Following an accident involving a delivery worker at her workplace, Cristina - a light-skinned Black woman - begins delivering cosmetics in João Pessoa. title: forming en route

As we wander from place to place through reflections and shadows, intermittently entering into different worlds, we notice how the activities of the inhabitants shape our experience of the environment. The people, architecture, weather, the everyday details, given equal significance in forming the landscape of the film with a dreamlike inner logic.

title: De Barriga Pra Cima
overview: Here in Monte Alegre, we dream of land, we dream of water, of the sky; we dream of things that exist and things that do not yet exist. A film created as part of a cinema workshop in the *quilombola* community of Monte Alegre, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, Espírito Santo.

title: Cabeceira
overview: After being kicked out of the house by her mother, Rita returns to find her younger sister, Chica, all alone. Together, they set out for a walk through a landscape marked by loneliness and a lack of prospects.

title: La taquigrafista
overview: In 1976, during Argentina’s last military dictatorship, 17 Mercedes-Benz workers were forcibly disappeared. Only a few documents from their story have survived: some photographs taken by their coworkers, a fragment of a silent film, and documents written by police spies who had infiltrated the factory with the complicity of the company’s board of directors. Among these archives is an image of three women whose first names and occupations can only be guessed at: stenographers. Mari, one of them, is the recipient of a letter that weaves a tale of her past amid the fog of a present marked by the factory’s closure, after seventy years in the Buenos Aires suburbs.

title: La línea del mar
overview: In a small town on Colombia’s Pacific coast, five young people spend their days by the sea. They walk, talk, and sit in silence, while time seems to stand still and the landscape becomes part of their friendship. As the ocean advances, an inevitable farewell looms.

Their encounter leads Nisa to reconsider her own past and future.

title: ENDGAME: Trump’s Midterns
overview: Trump's midterms: Democracy under threat in America. From Washington DC to Mississippi, South Carolina, New York, Tennessee and Colorado, Four Corners reporter Mark Willacy investigates whether the greatest threat to the elections comes from within the Trump administration itself. Donald Trump may not be on the ballot, but the election is a referendum on his presidency. With his approval rating at a record low, Trump is rallying his MAGA base, warning of electoral fraud and impeachment if the Democrats take control of Congress. Former Trump insiders are sounding the alarm over efforts to undermine confidence in the vote, including the prospect of ICE agents being deployed at polling places. Their warning: a desperate president could go to extraordinary lengths to cling to power.

title: Zindabad
overview: In the heart of the Karakoram, a Pakistani climber attempts a first ascent in his own backyard, where the biggest peaks have long been claimed by outsiders. Set against the long shadow of 9/11, which reshaped access, perception, and opportunity across Pakistan’s mountains, the expedition becomes a lens on a deeper imbalance. Mueez’s climb is an attempt to shift that dynamic, and to imagine a future where the next generation of Pakistani alpinists define their own routes, on their own terms.

title: Salzwasser
overview: When his father cries in front of him for the first time, Jona doesn’t know what to do. He leaves the house and enters the dark. title: Calexico
overview: Ash, a 28-year-old Chinese American and rebellious aspiring artist, escapes her family's expectations. He travels to Calexico, a border town in California, where he forms a close bond with Lo, a Mexican student who crosses the border to deliver flowers to his uncle's florist in the United States. Both are stuck in limbo – living castaways in a foreign country, facing social pressures, family expectations, and questions about identity. During the last day together, they are forced to define their relationship.

title: Resurrecting The Night
overview: The Film explores the inner world of artist Ma Wei-a small town-scene trapped in eternal night. Initially, there were only dull spectators, flat characters and Ma Wei herself, paralyzed by a creative crisis. Everything changes when her own creation, He Ling, gains free will. Between the creator and the work begins a fascinating struggle. Through the collision of illusion and hard reality, he Ling breaks the narrative shackles, and Ma Wei undergoes spiritual liberation, embarking on a new artistic journey.

title: Reflection

On the night of his birthday, while standing on the edge of suicide, an unexpected phone call and a mysterious girl named Layan pull him back from making a fatal decision. Her words give him a small sense of hope and connection he has not felt since his father’s death. As Ahmed struggles to reconnect with reality, his mental state begins to deteriorate. He starts hearing voices, seeing disturbing visions, and encountering a mysterious double of himself that seems to represent his inner darkness and unresolved trauma. Torn between healing and self-destruction, Ahmed is forced to confront his grief, loneliness, and fractured identity before losing himself completely. “Reflection” is a psychological drama that explores loss, depression, isolation, and the silent battle within the human mind.

title: Manama Cairo

The film captures an unusual meeting of cultures and the personal identity that grows from it.

title: Everlasting Quijote
overview: This documentary chronicles the creative process behind the ambitious artistic project «Viva Don Quijote», conceived and developed by the German-Russian artist Genia Chef.  Originally inspired by a tribute to the illustrator Teodoro Miciano, the film offers an intimate look into Genia Chef's studio as he reinterprets Miguel de Cervantes’ universal literary masterpiece through a contemporary artistic lens. Rather than following a conventional biographical structure, the documentary explores the convergence of classic Spanish literature and modern plastic arts, capturing the philosophical depth, aesthetic challenges, and ongoing relevance of the iconic knight in today's visual culture.

title: Cow Farm

title: local color
overview: Local Color documents the daily life of people who live, work, visit and play in Hanoi. Once the central city of America’s most elusive enemy during the Cold War, the film asks what is to become of the red that once brought the western world to its knees? Where is it fading? What colors replace it? Who will be responsible moving forward? Local Color is an observational documentary that investigates the limits of observational documentary. Starting with a relic of the Vietnam War, Local Color expands to explore how images, propaganda and a local scene is created.  Local Color is a film about labor and leisure. It is about the past, the present and the future and it is a film about a city and its people. Local Color a film about Hanoi, Vietnam.

title: Fault Lines

Through a man’s return to his native village, the film delves into questions of identity and lineage, while capturing the intimate conflict between medical efforts to halt loss and a collective memory—frail yet persistent—that refuses to vanish.
